description.ja: 複数年にわたる計算 capex コミットメントとキャパシティ戦略: ハイパースケーラの10年計算契約、5GW Trainium キャパシティ・コミットメント、GW 規模のデータセンター電力フットプリント、アクセラレータ・ベンダーの複数四半期バックログ配分、ハイパースケーラ建設ケイデンス、先渡し供給 8-K コミットメント、ハイパースケーラ・キャパシティ・ワラント、Vera Rubin / MAIA アクセラレータ・コミットメント、Tesla の計算 capex、戦略資産としての capex ポジショニング、クラウド事業者とアクセラレータ・ベンダー間のキャパシティ・カップリング。(capex の売上開示は business.ai_revenue_disclosure 側でカバー)
description.es: Compromisos de capex de cómputo plurianuales y estrategia de capacidad: contratos de cómputo de hyperscaler a 10 años, compromisos de capacidad Trainium de 5GW, huella de energía de centros de datos a escala GW, asignación de backlog plurimensual de proveedores de aceleradores, cadencia de buildout de hyperscaler, compromisos de oferta forward 8-K, warrants de capacidad de hyperscaler, compromisos de aceleradores Vera Rubin / MAIA, capex de cómputo de Tesla, posicionamiento de capex como activo estratégico, acoplamiento de capacidad entre proveedores de nube y proveedores de aceleradores. (La divulgación de ingresos asociada al capex la cubre business.ai_revenue_disclosure, no este tema.)
description.fil: Multi-year na compute capex commitments at capacity strategy: 10-taong compute deals ng hyperscaler, 5GW Trainium capacity commitments, GW-scale data-center power footprint, multi-quarter backlog allocation ng mga accelerator vendor, cadence ng buildout ng hyperscaler, forward-supply 8-K commitments, mga hyperscaler capacity warrant, mga commitment para sa Vera Rubin / MAIA accelerators, Tesla compute capex, positioning ng capex bilang strategic asset, capacity-coupling sa pagitan ng mga cloud provider at accelerator vendor. (Ang revenue disclosure ng capex ay sakop ng business.ai_revenue_disclosure, hindi nito.)

nodes.label: AI-Revenue Disclosure Rewrite
nodes.short_label: AI-Revenue Disclosure
nodes.description: The 2026 rewrite of how AI revenue is reported to capital markets: SEC AI-revenue concept release and Corporation Finance staff guidance, audited monthly-revenue and WAU disclosure cadence from foundation labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI), Big-3 hyperscaler AI-services 10-Q footnote breakouts (Microsoft Azure AI Services run-rate, Alphabet AI Services segment), AMD AI-accelerator revenue 10-Q segment footnote, AI-accelerator IPO and S-1 disclosure cohort (Cerebras, Tenstorrent, per-counterparty risk-factor tables, hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity disclosure), per-token-margin reporting.

label.en: AI-Revenue Disclosure Rewrite
label.ja: AI売上開示リライト
label.es: Reescritura de divulgación de ingresos de IA
label.fil: AI-Revenue Disclosure Rewrite

short_label.en: AI-Revenue Disclosure
short_label.ja: AI売上開示
short_label.es: Divulgación ingresos IA
short_label.fil: AI-Revenue Disclosure

description.en: The 2026 rewrite of how AI revenue is reported to capital markets: SEC AI-revenue concept release and Corporation Finance staff guidance, audited monthly-revenue and WAU disclosure cadence from foundation labs (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI), Big-3 hyperscaler AI-services 10-Q footnote breakouts (Microsoft Azure AI Services run-rate, Alphabet AI Services segment), AMD AI-accelerator revenue 10-Q segment footnote, AI-accelerator IPO and S-1 disclosure cohort (Cerebras, Tenstorrent, per-counterparty risk-factor tables, hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity disclosure), per-token-margin reporting.
description.ja: AI売上が資本市場にどう報告されるかの2026年リライト: SECのAI売上コンセプトリリースとCorporation Financeスタッフガイダンス、ファウンデーションラボ (OpenAI、Anthropic、xAI) による監査済み月次売上・WAU開示の定期化、Big-3ハイパースケーラのAIサービス10-Q脚注開示 (Microsoft Azure AIサービス・ランレート、Alphabet AIサービス・セグメント)、AMDのAIアクセラレータ売上10-Qセグメント脚注、AIアクセラレータIPO・S-1開示コホート (Cerebras、Tenstorrent、相手先別リスクファクター表、ハイパースケーラ・アンカーのワラント持分開示)、トークン単位マージン報告。
description.es: La reescritura de 2026 sobre cómo se reportan los ingresos de IA a los mercados de capitales: concept release de ingresos de IA de la SEC y guía del personal de Corporation Finance, cadencia de divulgación de ingresos mensuales auditados y WAU de los laboratorios fundacionales (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI), desgloses en notas 10-Q de servicios de IA de los Big-3 hyperscalers (run-rate de Azure AI Services de Microsoft, segmento AI Services de Alphabet), nota de segmento 10-Q de ingresos por aceleradores AI de AMD, cohorte de divulgación de IPO y S-1 de aceleradores AI (Cerebras, Tenstorrent, tablas de factores de riesgo por contraparte, divulgación de warrant-equity de anclas hyperscaler), reporte de margen por token.
description.fil: Ang 2026 rewrite kung paano iniuulat ang kita ng AI sa capital markets: SEC AI-revenue concept release at staff guidance ng Corporation Finance, cadence ng audited monthly-revenue at WAU disclosure mula sa mga foundation lab (OpenAI, Anthropic, xAI), mga 10-Q footnote breakout ng AI-services ng Big-3 hyperscaler (run-rate ng Microsoft Azure AI Services, segment ng Alphabet AI Services), 10-Q segment footnote ng AI-accelerator revenue ng AMD, cohort ng IPO at S-1 disclosure ng AI-accelerator (Cerebras, Tenstorrent, per-counterparty risk-factor tables, warrant-equity disclosure ng hyperscaler-anchor), pag-uulat ng per-token margin.

description.en: **AI agent security standards extend to the "third-party-vendor boundary" and "URL-naming entropy."** The Mythos unauthorized-access incident (contractor + naming-convention guess + third-party leaked data) replays the Vercel-Context.ai supply-chain pattern, this time at a frontier-model access-control layer. By Q3 2026, "frontier model preview / early access third-party vendor environments" will be required to clear a common security baseline of SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forum, and endpoint URLs / subdomains will move to randomized, hard-to-guess naming. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **AIエージェントのセキュリティ標準が「サードパーティベンダー境界」と「URL命名エントロピー」に拡大する。** Mythosの不正アクセスインシデント(契約者 + 命名規則の推測 + サードパーティのデータ漏洩)は、Vercel-Context.aiのサプライチェーンパターンを再現しており、今度はフロンティアモデルのアクセス制御レイヤーで起きた。2026年Q3までに、「フロンティアモデルのプレビュー / 早期アクセスのサードパーティベンダー環境」は、SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forumの共通セキュリティベースラインのクリアが必要となり、エンドポイントURL / サブドメインはランダム化された推測困難な命名へ移行する。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Los estándares de seguridad de agentes de IA se extienden a la "frontera de proveedores externos" y la "entropía de nomenclatura de URL."** El incidente de acceso no autorizado de Mythos (contratista + adivinanza de convención de nomenclatura + datos filtrados de terceros) repite el patrón de cadena de suministro de Vercel-Context.ai, esta vez en una capa de control de acceso de modelo de frontera. Para el Q3 2026, los "entornos de proveedores externos para preview / acceso temprano de modelos de frontera" deberán superar una línea base de seguridad común de SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forum, y las URLs / subdominios de endpoints pasarán a una nomenclatura aleatorizada y difícil de adivinar. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang "frontier model preview / early access third-party vendor environments" ay kakailanganing pumasa sa common security baseline ng SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forum, at ang mga endpoint URL / subdomain ay lilipat sa randomized, mahirap-hulaang naming. reasoning.because: The Mythos Preview breach combined contractor credentials, the Mercor leak, and naming-convention guessing — exactly replaying the Vercel-Context.ai supply-chain shape.
reasoning.given: Frontier-model preview environments rely on third-party vendors and predictable subdomains, so identity + naming entropy is the new attack surface.
reasoning.so_that: Third-party preview vendors must clear a SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forum baseline and endpoint URLs move to randomized naming.
reasoning.landing: By Q3 2026; common third-party-vendor security baseline + randomized endpoint naming visible at frontier labs.
reasoning.plain_language: Hackers reached Anthropic's secret model by guessing its web address and using a contractor's stolen login. Soon labs will randomize URLs and require stricter contractor checks.

because.en: The Mythos Preview breach combined contractor credentials, the Mercor leak, and naming-convention guessing — exactly replaying the Vercel-Context.ai supply-chain shape.
because.ja: Mythos Previewの侵害は、契約者の認証情報、Mercorのリーク、命名規則の推測を組み合わせており、Vercel-Context.aiのサプライチェーンの形をそのまま再現している。

because.fil: Pinagsama ng Mythos Preview breach ang contractor credentials, ang Mercor leak, at naming-convention guessing — eksaktong umuulit sa hugis ng Vercel-Context.ai supply-chain.

given.en: Frontier-model preview environments rely on third-party vendors and predictable subdomains, so identity + naming entropy is the new attack surface.

given.es: Los entornos de preview de modelos de frontera dependen de proveedores externos y subdominios predecibles, por lo que la identidad + entropía de nomenclatura es la nueva superficie de ataque.
given.fil: Ang frontier-model preview environments ay umaasa sa third-party vendors at predictable subdomains, kaya ang identity + naming entropy ang bagong attack surface.

plain_language.en: Hackers reached Anthropic's secret model by guessing its web address and using a contractor's stolen login. Soon labs will randomize URLs and require stricter contractor checks.
plain_language.ja: ハッカーはAnthropicの秘密モデルにそのウェブアドレスを推測し、契約者の盗まれたログイン情報を使ってアクセスした。まもなく研究所はURLをランダム化し、より厳格な契約者チェックを義務付けるようになる。
plain_language.es: Los hackers llegaron al modelo secreto de Anthropic adivinando su dirección web y usando el inicio de sesión robado de un contratista. Pronto los laboratorios aleatorizarán las URLs y exigirán controles de contratistas más estrictos.
plain_language.fil: Naabot ng mga hacker ang lihim na model ng Anthropic sa pamamagitan ng paghula sa web address nito at paggamit ng ninakaw na login ng isang contractor. Hindi magtatagal, ira-randomize ng mga lab ang URLs at hihingi ng mas mahigpit na contractor checks.

By Q3 2026, third-party preview vendors are expected to clear a SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forum baseline and endpoint URLs to move to randomized naming.
summary_short_locales.ja: Mythos Previewの不正アクセスインシデント(契約者の認証情報、Mercorのリーク、推測された命名規則)は、フロンティアモデルのアクセス制御レイヤーでVercel-Context.aiのサプライチェーンパターンを再現している。2026年Q3までに、サードパーティのプレビューベンダーはSOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forumのベースラインをクリアし、エンドポイントURLはランダム化された命名へ移行すると予想される。
summary_short_locales.es: El incidente de acceso no autorizado de Mythos Preview — credenciales de contratista, la filtración de Mercor y una convención de nomenclatura adivinada — repite el patrón de cadena de suministro de Vercel-Context.ai en una capa de control de acceso de modelo de frontera. Para el Q3 2026, se espera que los proveedores de preview externos superen una línea base de SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forum y que las URLs de endpoint pasen a nomenclatura aleatorizada.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Mythos Preview unauthorized-access incident — contractor credentials, ang Mercor leak, at hinulaang naming convention — ay umuulit sa Vercel-Context.ai supply-chain pattern sa frontier-model access-control layer. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, inaasahang ang third-party preview vendors ay pumasa sa SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forum baseline at ang endpoint URLs ay lilipat sa randomized naming.

bridges.text: Cisco's May 4 ~$400M Astrix acquisition explicitly governs API keys, service accounts, OAuth tokens, and machine-to-machine credentials AI agents now use at scale, with planned integration into Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo. Combined with FIS + Anthropic embedding engineers inside FIS infrastructure with full audit trail, today's evidence re-activates the dormant third-party-vendor security baseline thesis.

text_locales.en: Cisco's May 4 ~$400M Astrix acquisition explicitly governs API keys, service accounts, OAuth tokens, and machine-to-machine credentials AI agents now use at scale, with planned integration into Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo. Combined with FIS + Anthropic embedding engineers inside FIS infrastructure with full audit trail, today's evidence re-activates the dormant third-party-vendor security baseline thesis.
text_locales.ja: Ciscoの5月4日 約 $400M でのAstrix買収は、AIエージェントが現在大規模に使用するAPIキー、サービスアカウント、OAuthトークン、機械間認証情報を明示的にガバナンスし、Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duoへの統合が計画されている。FIS + Anthropicがエージェント決定の完全な監査証跡とともにエンジニアをFISインフラに埋め込むことと組み合わさり、本日の証拠はドーマントな第三者ベンダー・セキュリティ・ベースライン・テーゼを再活性化する。
text_locales.es: La adquisición Astrix de Cisco del 4 de mayo por ~$400M gobierna explícitamente claves API, cuentas de servicio, tokens OAuth y credenciales máquina-a-máquina que los agentes de IA ahora usan a escala, con integración planificada en Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo. Combinado con FIS + Anthropic integrando ingenieros dentro de la infraestructura FIS con rastro de auditoría completo, la evidencia de hoy reactiva la tesis de línea base de seguridad de proveedor-tercero dormante.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 4 ~$400M Astrix acquisition ng Cisco ay tahasang namamahala sa API keys, service accounts, OAuth tokens, at machine-to-machine credentials na ginagamit na ngayon ng AI agents sa scale, na may planned integration sa Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo. Pinagsama sa FIS + Anthropic na nag-eembed ng engineers sa loob ng FIS infrastructure na may full audit trail, ang ebidensiya ngayon ay muling nag-aaktibo sa dormant third-party-vendor security baseline thesis.

bridges.text: Oracle's SuiteCloud Agent Skills is the first non-foundation-lab vendor to publish skills-as-a-product with signed-distribution as the default security frame. That's the same shape the prediction's third-party-vendor-boundary thesis projected, applied one layer up at the skills marketplace rather than at the preview-URL surface. Useful but partial.

text_locales.en: Oracle's SuiteCloud Agent Skills is the first non-foundation-lab vendor to publish skills-as-a-product with signed-distribution as the default security frame. That's the same shape the prediction's third-party-vendor-boundary thesis projected, applied one layer up at the skills marketplace rather than at the preview-URL surface. Useful but partial.
text_locales.ja: OracleのSuiteCloud Agent Skillsは、デフォルトのセキュリティ枠組みとして署名配布を採用してスキル・アズ・ア・プロダクトを公開する初の非基盤研究所ベンダーである。これは予測の第三者ベンダー境界テーゼが投影したのと同じ形であり、プレビューURL面ではなくスキルマーケットプレイスで一段上のレイヤーに適用されている。有用だが部分的。
text_locales.es: SuiteCloud Agent Skills de Oracle es el primer vendor no-foundation-lab en publicar skills-as-a-product con distribución firmada como marco de seguridad por defecto. Esa es la misma forma que proyectaba la tesis de frontera-de-vendor-third-party de la predicción, aplicada una capa más arriba en el marketplace de skills en lugar de en la superficie de preview-URL. Útil pero parcial.
text_locales.fil: Ang SuiteCloud Agent Skills ng Oracle ay ang unang non-foundation-lab vendor na naglalathala ng skills-as-a-product na may signed-distribution bilang default na security frame. Iyan ang parehong hugis na inaasahan ng third-party-vendor-boundary thesis ng prediction, na inilapat isang layer pataas sa skills marketplace sa halip na sa preview-URL surface. Kapaki-pakinabang ngunit bahagya lamang.

bridges.text: ClawHavoc + Cisco's marketplace findings are about poisoned skills inside hubs, not about the third-party-vendor preview-access boundary or randomized URL-naming the prediction targets. Today's evidence sits adjacent to the claim rather than supporting or refuting it.

text_locales.en: ClawHavoc + Cisco's marketplace findings are about poisoned skills inside hubs, not about the third-party-vendor preview-access boundary or randomized URL-naming the prediction targets. Today's evidence sits adjacent to the claim rather than supporting or refuting it.
text_locales.ja: ClawHavoc + Ciscoのマーケットプレイス発見はハブ内の汚染されたスキルに関するものであり、予測が標的とする第三者ベンダーのプレビューアクセス境界やランダム化URL命名に関するものではない。本日の証拠は主張に隣接して位置し、それを支持も反証もしない。
text_locales.es: Los hallazgos de mercado de ClawHavoc + Cisco son sobre skills envenenadas dentro de hubs, no sobre el limite de acceso-preview-de-vendor-tercero o naming de URL randomizado que la prediccion apunta. La evidencia de hoy se sienta adyacente al claim en lugar de apoyarlo o refutarlo.
text_locales.fil: Ang marketplace findings ng ClawHavoc + Cisco ay tungkol sa poisoned skills sa loob ng hubs, hindi tungkol sa third-party-vendor preview-access boundary o randomized URL-naming na tinatarget ng hula. Ang ebidensya ngayon ay nakaupo katabi ng claim sa halip na sumusuporta o nagtatanggi dito.

bridges.text: Mythos staying gated to a curated partner roster keeps the third-party-vendor-boundary failure mode visible exactly as the thesis assumed, with the practitioner-side narrative reinforcing the cause-side pressure even though no remediation framework has shipped.

text_locales.en: Mythos staying gated to a curated partner roster keeps the third-party-vendor-boundary failure mode visible exactly as the thesis assumed, with the practitioner-side narrative reinforcing the cause-side pressure even though no remediation framework has shipped.
text_locales.ja: Mythos が厳選パートナー名簿へのゲーティングを保つことで、テーゼが想定したとおりに第三者ベンダー境界の障害モードが可視のままとなり、実務者側のナラティブが原因側の圧力を補強し続ける — 救済フレームワークはまだ出荷されていないが。
text_locales.es: Mythos manteniéndose cerrado a un roster curado de socios mantiene visible el modo de fallo del límite del third-party-vendor exactamente como asumió la tesis, con la narrativa del lado practitioner reforzando la presión del lado-causa aunque ningún marco de remediación se haya enviado.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mythos na nananatiling gated sa curated partner roster ay pinananatiling visible ang third-party-vendor-boundary failure mode gaya ng inaakala ng thesis, kasama ang practitioner-side narrative na nagpapatibay sa cause-side pressure kahit walang remediation framework na naipadala.

bridges.text: The continuing Mythos contractor-URL-leak narrative is the canonical case the prediction relies on — Altman's Apr 21 broadside keeps the third-party-vendor-boundary failure mode in public view exactly as the thesis assumed.

text_locales.es: La nota de investigación de Cloud Security Alliance enmarcando el escape de sandbox por inyección de prompt en IDE agéntico a través de la divulgación de Antigravity cristaliza el riesgo de límite-de-tercer-vendor a través de investigación industrial, mientras que las patas de URL-entropy y línea base del Frontier Model Forum permanecen pendientes dentro de la ventana.

bridges.text: Proofpoint's Mercor-to-Mythos analysis confirming that leaked naming conventions + third-party data fed the unauthorized-access vector, Zenity's FedRAMP In Process Status plus Gartner Hype Cycle and Fortune Cyber 60 recognition pulling third-party security baselines forward, Microsoft's Zero Trust for AI reference architecture, and the CSA Agentic Trust Framework directly materialize the precondition for a third-party-vendor + URL-entropy baseline.

text_locales.en: Proofpoint's Mercor-to-Mythos analysis confirming that leaked naming conventions + third-party data fed the unauthorized-access vector, Zenity's FedRAMP In Process Status plus Gartner Hype Cycle and Fortune Cyber 60 recognition pulling third-party security baselines forward, Microsoft's Zero Trust for AI reference architecture, and the CSA Agentic Trust Framework directly materialize the precondition for a third-party-vendor + URL-entropy baseline.
text_locales.ja: ProofpointのMercor-Mythos分析が、漏洩した命名規則 + サードパーティ・データが不正アクセス・ベクトルに供給されたことを確認し、ZenityのFedRAMP In Process StatusとGartner Hype CycleおよびFortune Cyber 60認定がサードパーティ・セキュリティのベースラインを引き上げ、MicrosoftのZero Trust for AIリファレンス・アーキテクチャ、CSA Agentic Trust Frameworkが、サードパーティ・ベンダー + URLエントロピー・ベースラインの前提条件を直接物質化する。
text_locales.es: El análisis Mercor-a-Mythos de Proofpoint confirmando que las convenciones de nomenclatura filtradas + datos de terceros alimentaron el vector de acceso no autorizado, el FedRAMP In Process Status de Zenity más el reconocimiento de Gartner Hype Cycle y Fortune Cyber 60 adelantando las líneas base de seguridad de terceros, la arquitectura de referencia Zero Trust for AI de Microsoft, y el CSA Agentic Trust Framework materializan directamente la precondición para una línea base de proveedor-tercero + entropía de URL.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mercor-to-Mythos analysis ng Proofpoint na nagpapatunay na ang nakaleak na naming conventions + third-party data ay nagpakain sa unauthorized-access vector, ang FedRAMP In Process Status ng Zenity plus ang Gartner Hype Cycle at Fortune Cyber 60 recognition na naghahatak sa third-party security baselines, ang Zero Trust for AI reference architecture ng Microsoft, at ang CSA Agentic Trust Framework ay direktang nagma-materialize sa precondition para sa third-party-vendor + URL-entropy baseline.

detail.description: **AI agent security standards extend to the "third-party-vendor boundary" and "URL-naming entropy."** The Mythos unauthorized-access incident (contractor + naming-convention guess + third-party leaked data) replays the Vercel-Context.ai supply-chain pattern, this time at a frontier-model access-control layer. prediction_summary_locales.es: **Los estándares de seguridad de agentes de IA se extienden a la "frontera de proveedores externos" y la "entropía de nomenclatura de URL."** El incidente de acceso no autorizado de Mythos (contratista + adivinanza de convención de nomenclatura + datos filtrados de terceros) repite el patrón de cadena de suministro de Vercel-Context.ai, esta vez en una capa de control de acceso de modelo de frontera. Para el Q3 2026, los "entornos de proveedores externos para preview / acceso temprano de modelos de frontera" deberán superar una línea base de seguridad común de SOC 2 Type II + FedRAMP Moderate + Frontier Model Forum, y las URLs / subdominios de endpoints pasarán a una nomenclatura aleatorizada y difícil de adivinar. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.title: Open-weight 1M-context era arrives as the new floor by Q3 2026
nodes.description: **The "1M context as default" open-weight era arrives in full by Q3 2026.** DeepSeek V4's "1M context designed in, not bolted on," Qwen3.6-27B's 262K → 1M extension, Claude Opus 4.7's 1M context (Bedrock), and GPT-5.5's long-context strengthening all point the same direction. By Q3 2026, "native 1M context" becomes the floor for open weights, and existing 32K-128K models drop to legacy. RAG pipelines flip from "search → context-insert" to "dump everything in + dynamic prune," and vector DB vendors are pushed to redefine themselves as "long-context cache optimization layers." In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.en: **The "1M context as default" open-weight era arrives in full by Q3 2026.** DeepSeek V4's "1M context designed in, not bolted on," Qwen3.6-27B's 262K → 1M extension, Claude Opus 4.7's 1M context (Bedrock), and GPT-5.5's long-context strengthening all point the same direction. By Q3 2026, "native 1M context" becomes the floor for open weights, and existing 32K-128K models drop to legacy. RAG pipelines flip from "search → context-insert" to "dump everything in + dynamic prune," and vector DB vendors are pushed to redefine themselves as "long-context cache optimization layers." In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「1Mコンテキストがデフォルト」のオープンウェイト時代がQ3 2026までに本格到来する。** DeepSeek V4の「1Mコンテキストは後付けではなく設計段階から組み込み」、Qwen3.6-27Bの262K → 1M拡張、Claude Opus 4.7の1Mコンテキスト(Bedrock)、GPT-5.5の長コンテキスト強化は、すべて同じ方向を指している。Q3 2026までに、「ネイティブ1Mコンテキスト」がオープンウェイトの最低水準となり、既存の32K-128Kモデルはレガシーに転落する。RAGパイプラインは「検索 → コンテキスト挿入」から「全部投入 + 動的プルーニング」へと反転し、ベクトルDBベンダーは「長コンテキスト・キャッシュ最適化レイヤー」への再定義を迫られる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La era de "contexto de 1M por defecto" en pesos abiertos llega de lleno para el Q3 2026.** El "contexto de 1M diseñado de origen, no añadido a la fuerza" de DeepSeek V4, la extensión de 262K → 1M de Qwen3.6-27B, el contexto de 1M de Claude Opus 4.7 (Bedrock) y el refuerzo de contexto largo de GPT-5.5 apuntan todos en la misma dirección. Para el Q3 2026, el "contexto de 1M nativo" se convierte en el piso para los pesos abiertos, y los modelos existentes de 32K-128K caen al nivel legacy. Los pipelines RAG cambian de "búsqueda → inserción de contexto" a "volcar todo + poda dinámica", y los proveedores de bases de datos vectoriales son empujados a redefinirse como "capas de optimización de caché de contexto largo". In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "1M context bilang default" open-weight era ay buong dadating sa Q3 2026.** Ang "1M context designed in, not bolted on" ng DeepSeek V4, ang 262K to 1M extension ng Qwen3.6-27B, ang 1M context ng Claude Opus 4.7 (Bedrock), at ang long-context strengthening ng GPT-5.5 ay lahat tumuturo sa parehong direksyon. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang "native 1M context" ay nagiging floor para sa open weights, at ang umiiral na 32K-128K models ay babagsak sa legacy. Ang RAG pipelines ay lumilipat mula sa "search → context-insert" papunta sa "dump everything in + dynamic prune," at ang mga vendor ng vector DB ay napipilitang i-redefine ang sarili bilang "long-context cache optimization layers." In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

summary.fil: **Ang "1M context bilang default" open-weight era ay buong dadating sa Q3 2026.** Ang "1M context designed in, not bolted on" ng DeepSeek V4, ang 262K to 1M extension ng Qwen3.6-27B, ang 1M context ng Claude Opus 4.7 (Bedrock), at ang long-context strengthening ng GPT-5.5 ay lahat tumuturo sa parehong direksyon. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang "native 1M context" ay nagiging floor para sa open weights, at ang umiiral na 32K-128K models ay babagsak sa legacy. Ang RAG pipelines ay lumilipat mula sa "search → context-insert" papunta sa "dump everything in + dynamic prune," at ang mga vendor ng vector DB ay napipilitang i-redefine ang sarili bilang "long-context cache optimization layers." text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4 ships 1M context as a designed-in property, Corpus2Skill demonstrates that hierarchical-skill-tree navigation beats dense retrieval and agentic RAG on WixQA without an embedding index at serve time, and PolyKV proposes a shared multi-agent KV-cache pool. Together they materialize the consequence the prediction projects: pipelines flip from search-then-insert to dump-and-prune, and vector DBs are pushed toward long-context cache layers.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4が1Mコンテキストを設計上の特性として出荷し、Corpus2Skillが階層的スキル・ツリー・ナビゲーションがサーブ時に埋め込みインデックスなしでWixQA上で密検索とagentic RAGを上回ることを実証し、PolyKVが共有マルチエージェントKVキャッシュ・プールを提案する。これらが組み合わさり、予測が投影する結果を物質化する: パイプラインがsearch-then-insertからdump-and-pruneに反転し、ベクトルDBはロングコンテキスト・キャッシュ層に押し進められる。
text_locales.es: DeepSeek V4 envia contexto 1M como propiedad disenada-por-dentro, Corpus2Skill demuestra que la navegacion de skill-tree jerarquico supera a dense retrieval y agentic RAG en WixQA sin un indice de embedding en serve time, y PolyKV propone un pool de KV-cache compartido multi-agente. Juntos materializan la consecuencia que la prediccion proyecta: los pipelines voltean de search-then-insert a dump-and-prune, y los vector DBs son empujados hacia capas de cache long-context.
text_locales.fil: Ang DeepSeek V4 ay naglalabas ng 1M context bilang designed-in property, ang Corpus2Skill ay nagpapakita na ang hierarchical-skill-tree navigation ay tinatalo ang dense retrieval at agentic RAG sa WixQA nang walang embedding index sa serve time, at ang PolyKV ay nagmumungkahi ng shared multi-agent KV-cache pool. Magkakasama silang nag-mamaterialize ng konsekwensyang ipino-project ng hula: ang pipelines ay lumilipat mula search-then-insert papunta sa dump-and-prune, at ang vector DBs ay itinutulak patungo sa long-context cache layers.

description.en: **Capital markets reset their valuation of "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" inside Q2 2026.** ServiceNow's **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** on Apr 23, IBM's same-day decline, and the chained falls of Salesforce / Workday / Oracle reveal a shift in how capital markets weigh "AI cost-savings benefit" vs "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Inside Q2 2026, expect Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports to make the "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis explicit, and market-cap math to move from "seats × ARPU" to "share of API calls touched by agents." Lagging analyst consensus updates mean another 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) likely see 15%+ drops in the next two quarters. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **資本市場はQ2 2026中に「AIエージェントに置換される企業向けSaaS」のバリュエーションをリセットする。** 4月23日のServiceNowの**-18%(史上最悪の単日下落)**、IBMの同日下落、Salesforce / Workday / Oracleの連鎖的な下落は、資本市場が「AIによるコスト削減効果」と「AIによるレガシー・ワークフローSaaSの置換」をどう天秤にかけるかが転換したことを示している。Q2 2026中に、Gartner / Forresterのマジック・クアドラント / ウェーブ・レポートが「Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS」軸を明示し、時価総額の計算式は「シート数 × ARPU」から「エージェントが触れるAPIコールのシェア」へと移行すると予想される。アナリスト・コンセンサスの更新が遅れるため、今後2四半期でさらに3-5社(Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheetなど)が15%以上の下落を見せる可能性が高い。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Los mercados de capitales restablecen su valoración del "SaaS empresarial desplazado por agentes de IA" dentro del Q2 2026.** El **-18% (peor caída en un solo día de la historia)** de ServiceNow el 23 de abril, el declive de IBM el mismo día, y las caídas encadenadas de Salesforce / Workday / Oracle revelan un cambio en cómo los mercados de capitales sopesan el "beneficio de ahorro de costos por IA" frente al "desplazamiento por IA del SaaS de workflow legacy". Dentro del Q2 2026, se espera que los reportes Magic Quadrant / Wave de Gartner / Forrester hagan explícito el eje "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS", y que la matemática de capitalización de mercado pase de "asientos × ARPU" a "cuota de llamadas a API tocadas por agentes". Las actualizaciones rezagadas del consenso de analistas significan que probablemente otros 3-5 nombres (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) verán caídas del 15%+ en los próximos dos trimestres. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Iri-reset ng capital markets ang valuation nila ng "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" sa loob ng Q2 2026.** Ang **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** ng ServiceNow noong Apr 23, ang same-day decline ng IBM, at ang chained falls ng Salesforce / Workday / Oracle ay naghahayag ng pagbabago kung paano tinitimbang ng capital markets ang "AI cost-savings benefit" laban sa "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Sa loob ng Q2 2026, asahan ang Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports na gawing explicit ang "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis, at ang market-cap math na lumipat mula sa "seats × ARPU" papunta sa "share of API calls touched by agents." Ang lagging analyst consensus updates ay nangangahulugan na isa pang 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) ay malamang na makikita ng 15%+ drops sa susunod na dalawang quarter. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

detail.description: **Capital markets reset their valuation of "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" inside Q2 2026.** ServiceNow's **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** on Apr 23, IBM's same-day decline, and the chained falls of Salesforce / Workday / Oracle reveal a shift in how capital markets weigh "AI cost-savings benefit" vs "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Lagging analyst consensus updates mean another 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) likely see 15%+ drops in the next two quarters. prediction_summary_locales.es: **Los mercados de capitales restablecen su valoración del "SaaS empresarial desplazado por agentes de IA" dentro del Q2 2026.** El **-18% (peor caída en un solo día de la historia)** de ServiceNow el 23 de abril, el declive de IBM el mismo día, y las caídas encadenadas de Salesforce / Workday / Oracle revelan un cambio en cómo los mercados de capitales sopesan el "beneficio de ahorro de costos por IA" frente al "desplazamiento por IA del SaaS de workflow legacy". Dentro del Q2 2026, se espera que los reportes Magic Quadrant / Wave de Gartner / Forrester hagan explícito el eje "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS", y que la matemática de capitalización de mercado pase de "asientos × ARPU" a "cuota de llamadas a API tocadas por agentes". Las actualizaciones rezagadas del consenso de analistas significan que probablemente otros 3-5 nombres (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) verán caídas del 15%+ en los próximos dos trimestres. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Iri-reset ng capital markets ang valuation nila ng "AI-agent-displaced enterprise SaaS" sa loob ng Q2 2026.** Ang **-18% (worst single-day drop ever)** ng ServiceNow noong Apr 23, ang same-day decline ng IBM, at ang chained falls ng Salesforce / Workday / Oracle ay naghahayag ng pagbabago kung paano tinitimbang ng capital markets ang "AI cost-savings benefit" laban sa "AI displacement of legacy workflow SaaS." Sa loob ng Q2 2026, asahan ang Gartner / Forrester Magic Quadrant / Wave reports na gawing explicit ang "Agent-native vs Legacy SaaS" axis, at ang market-cap math na lumipat mula sa "seats × ARPU" papunta sa "share of API calls touched by agents." Ang lagging analyst consensus updates ay nangangahulugan na isa pang 3-5 names (Workday / Atlassian / Box / Smartsheet etc.) ay malamang na makikita ng 15%+ drops sa susunod na dalawang quarter. nodes.title: Big-3 hyperscalers gate AI capex on per-token-margin floor by Q3 2026
nodes.description: **Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) reset the AI-capex ROI narrative — Q3 2026 sees the first hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.** With combined 2026 capex guidance from Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), and Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) totaling ~$650B-$700B against Wall Street's "AI ROI reality check," the Apr 29-30 prints either validate the **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis or trigger a multiple compression. By Q3 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — the first explicit "AI infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud, ending the 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. Frontier-lab anchor deals (Google $40B / Anthropic, Amazon $25B / Anthropic, OpenAI $20B / Cerebras + Microsoft) become the visible pressure relief valve. text_locales.ja: 4月29-30日のMag-7プリント衝突がPowellの最終FOMC記者会見と重なり、4月28日のWSJ駆動OpenAI収益ミス・テープ・クラックの上に、まさに予測が投影した通りに到着している。予測が指摘する着地ウィンドウ - プリント + FOMCがAI-capex ROI議論を単一の24時間テープに圧縮 - はスクリプト通りに物質化している。残された検証は、少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラーが2026年Q3までにトークン単位マージン・フロアでcapexを階層化するかどうかだ。
text_locales.es: La colision de resultados Mag-7 del 29-30 de abril con la conferencia final FOMC de Powell llega exactamente como la prediccion proyecto, encima de la cinta del fallo-de-ingresos-de-OpenAI impulsada por WSJ del 28 de abril. La ventana de aterrizaje que la prediccion nombra - resultados + FOMC comprimiendo el debate del ROI del capex de IA en una sola cinta de 24-horas - se esta materializando como guion; lo que queda por verificar es si al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 tierara capex sobre un piso de margen-por-token para el Q3 2026.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 29-30 Mag-7 print collision kasama ang final FOMC presser ni Powell ay dumarating nang eksakto sa ipino-project ng hula, sa ibabaw ng Apr 28 WSJ-driven OpenAI-revenue-miss tape crack. Ang landing window na pinapangalanan ng hula - prints + FOMC na nag-co-compress ng AI-capex ROI debate sa iisang 24-hour tape - ay nag-mamaterialize gaya ng inilarawan; ang natitira sa pag-verify ay kung kahit isang Big-3 hyperscaler ay mag-tier ng capex sa per-token-margin floor pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **Mag 7 Q1 earnings (Apr 29-30) reset the AI-capex ROI narrative — Q3 2026 sees the first hyperscaler to publicly tier AI capex by token-margin gate.** With combined 2026 capex guidance from Alphabet ($175B-$185B), Amazon (~$200B), Meta ($115B-$135B), and Microsoft (Azure-laggard rerating risk) totaling ~$650B-$700B against Wall Street's "AI ROI reality check," the Apr 29-30 prints either validate the **per-token-revenue exit-velocity** thesis or trigger a multiple compression. By Q3 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — the first explicit "AI infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud, ending the 2024-2025 "spend or die" doctrine. description.en: **The "AGI-clause unwind" sets a template — by Q4 2026 at least one other foundation-lab × hyperscaler contract is publicly amended to drop a discretionary "capability-trigger" clause, replaced by fixed-end revenue-share + non-exclusive cloud distribution.** Apr 27's Microsoft/OpenAI rewrite is no longer just about Azure exclusivity — it converts a binary, board-discretionary IP-revocation risk into a **calendar-bound revenue cap (2030)** and **multi-cloud distribution as the new default**. Google × Anthropic's $40B / 5GW deal, Amazon × Anthropic's $5B + $25B / $100B AWS commit, OpenAI × Cerebras + Microsoft, and the upcoming Cerebras IPO ($22B-$25B mid-May) all sit on similar capability-trigger language. **By Q4 2026 we see at least one of those contracts publicly restructured to mirror Apr 27's pattern** — fixed-date revenue cap, non-exclusive license, multi-cloud distribution clause. The "AGI" word becomes a financial-instrument primitive, not a metaphysical one. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「AGI 条項アンワインド」がテンプレート化する — Q4 2026 までに、少なくとももう 1 件のフロンティアラボ × ハイパースケーラ契約が、裁量的な「能力トリガ」条項を撤廃し、固定期日の収益シェア + 非排他的なクラウド配信に置き換える形で公に修正される。** 4/27 の Microsoft / OpenAI 書き換えはもはや Azure 排他性の話だけではない — 二者択一かつ取締役会裁量による IP 失効リスクを、**カレンダーで縛られた収益キャップ (2030)** と **新たなデフォルトとしてのマルチクラウド配信** に変換している。Google × Anthropic の $40B / 5GW ディール、Amazon × Anthropic の $5B + $25B / $100B AWS コミット、OpenAI × Cerebras + Microsoft、そして 5 月中旬予定の Cerebras IPO ($22B-$25B) はいずれも類似の能力トリガ文言を抱えている。**Q4 2026 までに、これらの契約のうち少なくとも 1 件が 4/27 のパターンを反映する形で公に再構成される** — 固定期日の収益キャップ、非排他的ライセンス、マルチクラウド配信条項。「AGI」という語は形而上的なものではなく、金融商品のプリミティブとなる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **El "desmontaje de la cláusula AGI" sienta una plantilla — para Q4 2026 al menos otro contrato foundation-lab × hyperscaler se modifica públicamente para eliminar una cláusula discrecional de "capability-trigger", reemplazada por revenue-share de fecha-fin fija + distribución cloud no exclusiva.** La reescritura del 27 de abril Microsoft/OpenAI ya no se trata solo de la exclusividad de Azure — convierte un riesgo binario y discrecional del consejo de revocación de IP en un **límite de ingresos vinculado al calendario (2030)** y **distribución multi-cloud como nuevo estándar**. El acuerdo de Google × Anthropic de $40B / 5GW, el compromiso AWS de Amazon × Anthropic de $5B + $25B / $100B, OpenAI × Cerebras + Microsoft, y la próxima IPO de Cerebras ($22B-$25B a mediados de mayo) todos se basan en lenguaje similar de capability-trigger. **Para Q4 2026 vemos al menos uno de esos contratos reestructurado públicamente para reflejar el patrón del 27 de abril** — límite de ingresos con fecha fija, licencia no exclusiva, cláusula de distribución multi-cloud. La palabra "AGI" se convierte en una primitiva de instrumento financiero, no metafísica. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "AGI-clause unwind" ay naglalatag ng template — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, kahit isa pang foundation-lab x hyperscaler contract ay pampublikong susuguin upang alisin ang discretionary "capability-trigger" clause, na papalitan ng fixed-end revenue-share + non-exclusive cloud distribution.** Ang Apr 27 Microsoft/OpenAI rewrite ay hindi na lamang tungkol sa Azure exclusivity — ito ay nagko-convert ng binary, board-discretionary IP-revocation risk patungo sa **calendar-bound revenue cap (2030)** at **multi-cloud distribution bilang bagong default**. Ang Google x Anthropic na $40B / 5GW deal, ang Amazon x Anthropic na $5B + $25B / $100B AWS commit, ang OpenAI x Cerebras + Microsoft, at ang paparating na Cerebras IPO ($22B-$25B mid-May) ay lahat nakaupo sa katulad na capability-trigger language. **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, makikita natin ang kahit isa sa mga kontratang iyon na pampublikong nirestructure upang sumalamin sa pattern ng Apr 27** — fixed-date revenue cap, non-exclusive license, multi-cloud distribution clause. Ang salitang "AGI" ay magiging financial-instrument primitive, hindi metaphysical. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.ja: 5月5日の金融エージェント・ローンチに加え、5月4日のFIS AML共同構築が、AGI条項アンワインド予測(4月28日)の前提条件を延長する: Anthropic Applied AIエンジニアが、エージェント決定の完全な監査証跡とともにFISインフラ内に埋め込まれていることは、レガシー・ハイパースケーラー・ラボのAGIトリガー・ロックインではなく、並行エクイティ・ビークル契約パターンを反映しており、構造的エクイティ・ラッパーを実際のGTMビークルとして硬化させている。
text_locales.es: El lanzamiento de agentes financieros del 5 de mayo más el co-build AML de FIS del 4 de mayo extienden la precondición de la predicción de desenrollado de cláusula AGI (28 de abril): los ingenieros Applied AI de Anthropic integrados dentro de la infraestructura FIS con rastro de auditoría completo de decisiones del agente reflejan el patrón de contrato de vehículo de equidad paralela en lugar del bloqueo de disparador AGI heredado del laboratorio-hyperscaler, endureciendo el envoltorio de equidad estructural como un vehículo real de go-to-market.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 5 finance-agents launch plus May 4 FIS AML co-build ay nag-eextend sa precondition ng AGI-clause unwind prediction (Apr 28): ang Anthropic Applied AI engineers na naka-embed sa loob ng FIS infrastructure na may full agent-decision audit trail ay sumasalamin sa parallel-equity-vehicle contract pattern sa halip na sa legacy hyperscaler-lab AGI-trigger lock-in, na pinapatigas ang structural-equity wrapper bilang isang real go-to-market vehicle.

bridges.text: The May 4 parallel JV launches advance the consequence the prediction names: the Apr 27 Microsoft + OpenAI rewrite shape — fixed-end revenue cap, multi-cloud distribution, no discretionary capability-trigger — is now visibly extending beyond a single contract into structured-equity vehicles that monetize frontier-AI as a commercial-deployment template.

text_locales.en: The May 4 parallel JV launches advance the consequence the prediction names: the Apr 27 Microsoft + OpenAI rewrite shape — fixed-end revenue cap, multi-cloud distribution, no discretionary capability-trigger — is now visibly extending beyond a single contract into structured-equity vehicles that monetize frontier-AI as a commercial-deployment template.
text_locales.ja: 5月4日の並行JVローンチは、予測が指摘する帰結を前進させる: 4月27日のMicrosoft + OpenAIの書き換え形状 — 固定期限の収益キャップ、マルチクラウド配布、裁量的能力トリガーなし — が、フロンティアAIを商業展開テンプレートとして収益化する構造化エクイティ・ビークルへと、単一の契約を超えて目に見えて拡張している。
text_locales.es: Los lanzamientos paralelos de JV del 4 de mayo avanzan la consecuencia que la predicción nombra: la forma de reescritura de Microsoft + OpenAI del 27 de abril — tope de ingresos de extremo fijo, distribución multi-nube, sin disparador discrecional de capacidad — ahora se extiende visiblemente más allá de un solo contrato hacia vehículos de capital estructurado que monetizan la IA de frontera como una plantilla de despliegue comercial.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 4 parallel JV launches ay sumusulong sa consequence na pinangalanan ng prediction: ang Apr 27 Microsoft + OpenAI rewrite shape — fixed-end revenue cap, multi-cloud distribution, walang discretionary capability-trigger — ay nakikitang lumalawak na ngayon lampas sa isang kontrata papasok sa structured-equity vehicles na nagmu-monetize ng frontier-AI bilang commercial-deployment template.

bridges.text: OpenAI on AWS Bedrock under the Apr 27 post-exclusivity reset is the first cross-cloud frontier-model deployment that exercises the new contract template, and Project Glasswing's published partner list shows the disclosure precedent extending to gated-distribution programs. The Apr 27 unwind keeps spreading along the contract surface even without a second public amendment yet.

text_locales.en: OpenAI on AWS Bedrock under the Apr 27 post-exclusivity reset is the first cross-cloud frontier-model deployment that exercises the new contract template, and Project Glasswing's published partner list shows the disclosure precedent extending to gated-distribution programs. The Apr 27 unwind keeps spreading along the contract surface even without a second public amendment yet.
text_locales.ja: 4月27日のポスト独占性リセット下のAWS Bedrock上のOpenAIは、新契約テンプレートを行使する最初のクラウド横断フロンティアモデル展開だ。Project Glasswingの公開パートナーリストは、開示前例がゲート付き配布プログラムへ拡張されることを示す。4月27日のアンワインドは、まだ第2の公開修正がないままでも契約面に沿って広がり続ける。
text_locales.es: OpenAI en AWS Bedrock bajo el reset post-exclusividad del 27 de abril es el primer despliegue de modelo frontera multi-nube que ejercita la nueva plantilla de contrato, y la lista de socios publicada de Project Glasswing muestra el precedente de divulgación extendiéndose a programas de distribución gated. El unwind del 27 de abril sigue propagándose por la superficie del contrato incluso sin una segunda enmienda pública aún.
text_locales.fil: Ang OpenAI sa AWS Bedrock sa ilalim ng Apr 27 post-exclusivity reset ang unang cross-cloud frontier-model deployment na nag-eehersisyo ng bagong contract template, at ipinapakita ng inilathalang partner list ng Project Glasswing na ang disclosure precedent ay umaabot sa gated-distribution programs. Ang Apr 27 unwind ay patuloy na kumakalat sa contract surface kahit walang pangalawang public amendment pa.

bridges.text: OpenAI on Bedrock is the first contract amendment landing in the post-exclusivity world; it directly demonstrates the fixed-date plus non-exclusive distribution shape the prediction expects sibling labs to mirror over the next two quarters.

text_locales.en: OpenAI on Bedrock is the first contract amendment landing in the post-exclusivity world; it directly demonstrates the fixed-date plus non-exclusive distribution shape the prediction expects sibling labs to mirror over the next two quarters.
text_locales.ja: OpenAI on Bedrockは、独占性後の世界に着地する最初の契約改訂である;次の2四半期にわたって同種のラボが反映することを予測が期待する固定日付プラス非独占的配布形状を直接示している。
text_locales.es: OpenAI en Bedrock es la primera enmienda contractual que aterriza en el mundo post-exclusividad; demuestra directamente la forma de fecha-fija más distribución no-exclusiva que la predicción espera que laboratorios hermanos repliquen en los próximos dos trimestres.
text_locales.fil: Ang OpenAI sa Bedrock ay ang unang contract amendment na lumalapag sa post-exclusivity world; tahasan nitong ipinapakita ang fixed-date plus non-exclusive distribution shape na inaasahan ng prediction na gagayahin ng kapatid na labs sa susunod na dalawang quarters.

text_locales.es: El lanzamiento OpenAI-en-Bedrock del 28 abr operacionaliza el reset del 27 abr convirtiendo el lenguaje de licencia no-exclusiva en un despliegue cross-cloud en vivo — exactamente el arco de replicación-de-template que la predicción proyecta. El riesgo de concentración del IPO de Cerebras sobre G42 + MBZUAI mantiene el stress-test de disclosure vivo pero no es en sí mismo la siguiente enmienda de contrato. Señal moderada-a-fuerte.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock launch ay nag-o-operate ng Apr 27 reset sa pamamagitan ng pag-convert ng non-exclusive license language sa live cross-cloud deployment — eksaktong template-replication arc na ipina-project ng prediction. Ang Cerebras IPO concentration risk sa G42 + MBZUAI ay nagpapanatiling buhay ang disclosure stress-test ngunit hindi mismo ang susunod na contract amendment. Moderate-to-strong signal.

text_locales.en: The AGI-clause-unwind retrospective and OpenAI's monetization response carry forward the prediction's structural framing without producing a fresh contract amendment. text_locales.es: El retrospectivo del unwind de la cláusula AGI y la respuesta de monetización de OpenAI llevan adelante el encuadre estructural de la predicción sin producir una enmienda de contrato fresca. El IPO de Cerebras concentra el siguiente vector de presión pero no es en sí mismo la señal de réplica-de-plantilla que pide la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Ang AGI-clause-unwind retrospective at ang monetization response ng OpenAI ay dinadala ang structural framing ng prediction nang hindi gumagawa ng sariwang contract amendment. bridges.text: WSJ Apr 28's revenue-miss tape sharpens the structural force behind the Apr 27 AGI-clause unwind: as compute funding tightens against a sceptical revenue tape, capability-trigger clauses convert from option value into open-ended commercial risk. The structural pressure for further contract restructurings is now visible in the stock tape; no second contract has been amended yet.

text_locales.en: WSJ Apr 28's revenue-miss tape sharpens the structural force behind the Apr 27 AGI-clause unwind: as compute funding tightens against a sceptical revenue tape, capability-trigger clauses convert from option value into open-ended commercial risk. The structural pressure for further contract restructurings is now visible in the stock tape; no second contract has been amended yet.
text_locales.ja: WSJ 4月28日の収益ミス・テープが、4月27日のAGI条項アンワインドの背後にある構造的な力を鋭利化する: 懐疑的な収益テープに対してコンピュート資金が締まるにつれ、能力トリガー条項はオプション・バリューからオープンエンドの商業リスクへと変わる。さらなる契約再構成への構造的圧力は今や株式テープに可視化されている。第二の契約はまだ修正されていない。
text_locales.es: La cinta del fallo-de-ingresos del WSJ del 28 de abril agudiza la fuerza estructural detras del desmontaje de la clausula AGI del 27 de abril: a medida que el funding de compute se aprieta contra una cinta de ingresos esceptica, las clausulas de capability-trigger se convierten de option value a riesgo comercial open-ended. La presion estructural para mas reestructuraciones de contrato ahora es visible en la cinta de acciones; ningun segundo contrato ha sido enmendado todavia.
text_locales.fil: Ang revenue-miss tape ng WSJ Apr 28 ay nagpapatalas sa structural force sa likod ng Apr 27 AGI-clause unwind: habang ang compute funding ay tumitindi laban sa skeptical revenue tape, ang capability-trigger clauses ay nagiging mula option value patungo sa open-ended commercial risk. Ang structural pressure para sa karagdagang contract restructurings ay ngayon nakikita sa stock tape; walang pangalawang kontrata na inamyendahan pa.

detail.description: **The "AGI-clause unwind" sets a template — by Q4 2026 at least one other foundation-lab × hyperscaler contract is publicly amended to drop a discretionary "capability-trigger" clause, replaced by fixed-end revenue-share + non-exclusive cloud distribution.** Apr 27's Microsoft/OpenAI rewrite is no longer just about Azure exclusivity — it converts a binary, board-discretionary IP-revocation risk into a **calendar-bound revenue cap (2030)** and **multi-cloud distribution as the new default**. Google × Anthropic's $40B / 5GW deal, Amazon × Anthropic's $5B + $25B / $100B AWS commit, OpenAI × Cerebras + Microsoft, and the upcoming Cerebras IPO ($22B-$25B mid-May) all sit on similar capability-trigger language. **By Q4 2026 we see at least one of those contracts publicly restructured to mirror Apr 27's pattern** — fixed-date revenue cap, non-exclusive license, multi-cloud distribution clause. The "AGI" word becomes a financial-instrument primitive, not a metaphysical one. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **「AGI 条項アンワインド」がテンプレート化する — Q4 2026 までに、少なくとももう 1 件のフロンティアラボ × ハイパースケーラ契約が、裁量的な「能力トリガ」条項を撤廃し、固定期日の収益シェア + 非排他的なクラウド配信に置き換える形で公に修正される。** 4/27 の Microsoft / OpenAI 書き換えはもはや Azure 排他性の話だけではない — 二者択一かつ取締役会裁量による IP 失効リスクを、**カレンダーで縛られた収益キャップ (2030)** と **新たなデフォルトとしてのマルチクラウド配信** に変換している。Google × Anthropic の $40B / 5GW ディール、Amazon × Anthropic の $5B + $25B / $100B AWS コミット、OpenAI × Cerebras + Microsoft、そして 5 月中旬予定の Cerebras IPO ($22B-$25B) はいずれも類似の能力トリガ文言を抱えている。**Q4 2026 までに、これらの契約のうち少なくとも 1 件が 4/27 のパターンを反映する形で公に再構成される** — 固定期日の収益キャップ、非排他的ライセンス、マルチクラウド配信条項。「AGI」という語は形而上的なものではなく、金融商品のプリミティブとなる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **El "desmontaje de la cláusula AGI" sienta una plantilla — para Q4 2026 al menos otro contrato foundation-lab × hyperscaler se modifica públicamente para eliminar una cláusula discrecional de "capability-trigger", reemplazada por revenue-share de fecha-fin fija + distribución cloud no exclusiva.** La reescritura del 27 de abril Microsoft/OpenAI ya no se trata solo de la exclusividad de Azure — convierte un riesgo binario y discrecional del consejo de revocación de IP en un **límite de ingresos vinculado al calendario (2030)** y **distribución multi-cloud como nuevo estándar**. El acuerdo de Google × Anthropic de $40B / 5GW, el compromiso AWS de Amazon × Anthropic de $5B + $25B / $100B, OpenAI × Cerebras + Microsoft, y la próxima IPO de Cerebras ($22B-$25B a mediados de mayo) todos se basan en lenguaje similar de capability-trigger. **Para Q4 2026 vemos al menos uno de esos contratos reestructurado públicamente para reflejar el patrón del 27 de abril** — límite de ingresos con fecha fija, licencia no exclusiva, cláusula de distribución multi-cloud. La palabra "AGI" se convierte en una primitiva de instrumento financiero, no metafísica. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang "AGI-clause unwind" ay naglalatag ng template — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, kahit isa pang foundation-lab x hyperscaler contract ay pampublikong susuguin upang alisin ang discretionary "capability-trigger" clause, na papalitan ng fixed-end revenue-share + non-exclusive cloud distribution.** Ang Apr 27 Microsoft/OpenAI rewrite ay hindi na lamang tungkol sa Azure exclusivity — ito ay nagko-convert ng binary, board-discretionary IP-revocation risk patungo sa **calendar-bound revenue cap (2030)** at **multi-cloud distribution bilang bagong default**. Ang Google x Anthropic na $40B / 5GW deal, ang Amazon x Anthropic na $5B + $25B / $100B AWS commit, ang OpenAI x Cerebras + Microsoft, at ang paparating na Cerebras IPO ($22B-$25B mid-May) ay lahat nakaupo sa katulad na capability-trigger language. **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, makikita natin ang kahit isa sa mga kontratang iyon na pampublikong nirestructure upang sumalamin sa pattern ng Apr 27** — fixed-date revenue cap, non-exclusive license, multi-cloud distribution clause. Ang salitang "AGI" ay magiging financial-instrument primitive, hindi metaphysical. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.ja: **Mag 7 決算 + 4/28-29 FOMC が、Q3 2026 までにハイパースケーラからの初の **トークン単位マージンでゲーティングされた capex** 開示を強要する — 4/27 の OpenAI / Microsoft 協定 + Anthropic / AWS Trainium のシリコンレベル ディールが新ドクトリンを定礎する。** 2026 年の Mag 7 合算 capex 約 $700B (Alphabet $175B-$185B、Amazon 約 $200B、Meta $115B-$135B、Microsoft 約 $146B FY26 から FY27 で約 $170B へトレンド) は、すでに「信仰に基づき capex を報いる」から「具体的な利益を要求する」へとシフトしたテープに着地する。**4/27 の契約再構築は AI ラボの計算リソースをハイパースケーラ自社シリコン経由に明示的にルーティング** している (Anthropic との AWS Trainium / Graviton、スケールでの Meta-Graviton CPU)。Q3 2026 までに Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社が **増分 GPU capex を Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限でゲーティング** する — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」となる。NVDA $5T クラスの時価総額と AMD / Cerebras IPO 軌道は維持される。支出曲線は折れないが、その開示言語は折れる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Las publicaciones de Mag 7 + FOMC del 28-29 de abril fuerzan la primera divulgación de **capex con margen-por-token gateado** desde un hyperscaler para Q3 2026 — el pacto OpenAI/Microsoft del 27 de abril + el acuerdo Anthropic/AWS Trainium a nivel de silicio anclan la nueva doctrina.** El capex combinado de Mag 7 de ~$700B para 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 tendiendo a ~$170B FY27) aterriza en una cinta que ya ha pasado de "recompensar el capex con fe" a "exigir ganancia tangible." **Las reestructuraciones de contratos del 27 de abril enrutan explícitamente la computación de los AI-labs a través del silicio propiedad del hyperscaler** (AWS Trainium/Graviton con Anthropic; CPUs Meta-Graviton a escala). Para Q3 2026 al menos un Big-3 hyperscaler **gatea públicamente el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen-por-token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — primer "umbral de ROI de AI-infra" explícito de un cloud público. La capitalización de mercado de NVDA tipo $5T y la trayectoria de IPO AMD/Cerebras se mantienen; la curva de gasto no se rompe, pero su lenguaje de divulgación sí. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 ay magpipilit sa unang **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure mula sa hyperscaler pagsapit ng Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal ang nag-aanchor sa bagong doctrine.** Ang pinagsamang Mag 7 capex na ~$700B para sa 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending sa ~$170B FY27) ay tumatama sa tape na lumipat na mula sa "rewarding capex on faith" patungo sa "demanding tangible profit." **Ang Apr 27 contract restructurings ay tahasang nagru-route ng AI-lab compute sa pamamagitan ng hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton kasama ang Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs sa scale). Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscaler ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI-infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud. Ang NVDA $5T-class market cap at AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory ay nananatili; hindi mababasag ang spend curve, ngunit ang disclosure language nito ay babasagin. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

summary.ja: **Mag 7 決算 + 4/28-29 FOMC が、Q3 2026 までにハイパースケーラからの初の **トークン単位マージンでゲーティングされた capex** 開示を強要する — 4/27 の OpenAI / Microsoft 協定 + Anthropic / AWS Trainium のシリコンレベル ディールが新ドクトリンを定礎する。** 2026 年の Mag 7 合算 capex 約 $700B (Alphabet $175B-$185B、Amazon 約 $200B、Meta $115B-$135B、Microsoft 約 $146B FY26 から FY27 で約 $170B へトレンド) は、すでに「信仰に基づき capex を報いる」から「具体的な利益を要求する」へとシフトしたテープに着地する。**4/27 の契約再構築は AI ラボの計算リソースをハイパースケーラ自社シリコン経由に明示的にルーティング** している (Anthropic との AWS Trainium / Graviton、スケールでの Meta-Graviton CPU)。Q3 2026 までに Big-3 ハイパースケーラの少なくとも 1 社が **増分 GPU capex を Bedrock / Azure / Vertex のトークン単位マージン下限でゲーティング** する — パブリッククラウドからの初の明示的な「AI インフラ ROI 閾値」となる。NVDA $5T クラスの時価総額と AMD / Cerebras IPO 軌道は維持される。支出曲線は折れないが、その開示言語は折れる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
summary.es: **Las publicaciones de Mag 7 + FOMC del 28-29 de abril fuerzan la primera divulgación de **capex con margen-por-token gateado** desde un hyperscaler para Q3 2026 — el pacto OpenAI/Microsoft del 27 de abril + el acuerdo Anthropic/AWS Trainium a nivel de silicio anclan la nueva doctrina.** El capex combinado de Mag 7 de ~$700B para 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 tendiendo a ~$170B FY27) aterriza en una cinta que ya ha pasado de "recompensar el capex con fe" a "exigir ganancia tangible." **Las reestructuraciones de contratos del 27 de abril enrutan explícitamente la computación de los AI-labs a través del silicio propiedad del hyperscaler** (AWS Trainium/Graviton con Anthropic; CPUs Meta-Graviton a escala). Para Q3 2026 al menos un Big-3 hyperscaler **gatea públicamente el capex incremental de GPU sobre un piso de margen-por-token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex** — primer "umbral de ROI de AI-infra" explícito de un cloud público. La capitalización de mercado de NVDA tipo $5T y la trayectoria de IPO AMD/Cerebras se mantienen; la curva de gasto no se rompe, pero su lenguaje de divulgación sí. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
summary.fil: **Ang Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 ay magpipilit sa unang **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure mula sa hyperscaler pagsapit ng Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal ang nag-aanchor sa bagong doctrine.** Ang pinagsamang Mag 7 capex na ~$700B para sa 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending sa ~$170B FY27) ay tumatama sa tape na lumipat na mula sa "rewarding capex on faith" patungo sa "demanding tangible profit." **Ang Apr 27 contract restructurings ay tahasang nagru-route ng AI-lab compute sa pamamagitan ng hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton kasama ang Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs sa scale). Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isa sa Big-3 hyperscaler ay pampublikong **maglalagay ng gate sa incremental GPU capex sa Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — ang unang tahasang "AI-infra ROI threshold" mula sa public cloud. Ang NVDA $5T-class market cap at AMD/Cerebras IPO trajectory ay nananatili; hindi mababasag ang spend curve, ngunit ang disclosure language nito ay babasagin. detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **Mag 7 prints + FOMC Apr 28-29 force the first **per-token-margin-gated capex** disclosure from a hyperscaler by Q3 2026 — Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft pact + Anthropic/AWS Trainium silicon-level deal anchor the new doctrine.** Combined Mag 7 capex of ~$700B for 2026 (Alphabet $175B-$185B, Amazon ~$200B, Meta $115B-$135B, Microsoft ~$146B FY26 trending to ~$170B FY27) lands into a tape that has already shifted from "rewarding capex on faith" to "demanding tangible profit." **Apr 27 contract restructurings explicitly route AI-lab compute through hyperscaler-owned silicon** (AWS Trainium/Graviton with Anthropic; Meta-Graviton CPUs at scale). By Q3 2026 at least one Big-3 hyperscaler publicly **gates incremental GPU capex on a Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token-margin floor** — first explicit "AI-infra ROI threshold" from a public cloud. nodes.description: **By Q4 2026 KV-cache-compression dtype is exposed as a first-class deployment knob in every major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM all ship a `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (or equivalent) flag with TurboQuant + at least one alternative (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Apr 27-29 makes this a near-certainty: **TurboQuant lands at ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 already in-tree** with a fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) hitting 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** at Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demoing multi-agent shared-pool quantization, and **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** circulating before Google's official Python release lands in Q2 2026. The economic forcing function is the same Mag-7 capex tape the Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report just cracked: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that can move from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x. By Q4 2026 hyperscalers gate Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing on opt-in compressed-cache tiers, and the hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis from yesterday's report tightens via this lever rather than via fewer GPUs. description.en: **By Q4 2026 KV-cache-compression dtype is exposed as a first-class deployment knob in every major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM all ship a `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (or equivalent) flag with TurboQuant + at least one alternative (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Apr 27-29 makes this a near-certainty: **TurboQuant lands at ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 already in-tree** with a fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) hitting 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** at Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demoing multi-agent shared-pool quantization, and **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** circulating before Google's official Python release lands in Q2 2026. The economic forcing function is the same Mag-7 capex tape the Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report just cracked: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that can move from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x. By Q4 2026 hyperscalers gate Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing on opt-in compressed-cache tiers, and the hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis from yesterday's report tightens via this lever rather than via fewer GPUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **2026年Q4までに、KVキャッシュ圧縮dtypeが主要な全推論スタックでファーストクラスのデプロイメント・ノブとして公開される — vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLMのすべてが、TurboQuantと少なくとも1つの代替手段(KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention)を備えた`--kv-cache-dtype turboquant`(または同等)フラグを出荷する。** 4月27日〜29日の動向で、これはほぼ確実となった: **TurboQuantがICLR 2026 + Google Researchブログに掲載**、**SGLang PR #21419はすでにツリー内**で、フューズドカーネル書き換え(#23134)がbf16スループットの93〜105%に到達、**NVIDIA kvpress**はDecoding-Press成熟度に達し、**PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** がマルチエージェント共有プール量子化をデモ、**コミュニティのMLX + Triton + vLLMポート**が2026年Q2のGoogle公式Pythonリリース前から流通している。経済的な強制関数は、4月28日OpenAIミスのWSJレポートが直撃したのと同じMag-7 capexテープだ: メモリ帯域幅律速のロングコンテキストワークロードがFP16から3.5ビットに移行できれば、トークンあたりの実効コストを約5〜6倍削減できる。2026年Q4までに、ハイパースケーラーはBedrock/Azure/Vertexのトークン単価をオプトイン圧縮キャッシュ階層でゲートし、昨日のレポートが示した増分GPU capexのハードウェア上限テーゼは、GPU削減ではなくこのレバーを通じて締まっていく。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para el Q4 2026 el dtype de compresion de KV-cache se expone como una palanca de despliegue de primera clase en cada stack de inferencia importante — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM todos envian un flag `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o equivalente) con TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** El 27-29 de abril lo convierte en una casi-certeza: **TurboQuant aterriza en ICLR 2026 + blog de Google Research**, **SGLang PR #21419 ya en el arbol** con una reescritura de kernel fusionado (#23134) alcanzando 93-105% del throughput de bf16, **NVIDIA kvpress** en madurez Decoding-Press, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demostrando cuantizacion de pool compartido multi-agente, y **ports de la comunidad MLX + Triton + vLLM** circulando antes de que aterrice el lanzamiento oficial Python de Google en el Q2 2026. La funcion forzante economica es la misma cinta de capex Mag-7 que el reporte WSJ del fallo de OpenAI del 28 de abril acaba de quebrar: cada workload de contexto largo limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pueda moverse de FP16 a 3.5-bit reduce el costo efectivo por token ~5-6x. Para el Q4 2026 los hyperscalers gatean el precio por token de Bedrock/Azure/Vertex sobre tiers opt-in de cache-comprimido, y la tesis del cap-de-hardware-sobre-capex-incremental-de-GPU del reporte de ayer se aprieta via esta palanca en lugar de via menos GPUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang KV-cache-compression dtype ay ilalabas bilang first-class deployment knob sa bawat major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM lahat ay maglalabas ng `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (o katumbas) flag na may TurboQuant + kahit isang alternatibo (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Ang Apr 27-29 ay ginagawa itong halos kasiguraduhan: **TurboQuant ay lumapag sa ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 ay nasa-tree na** kasama ang fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) na umaabot ng 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** sa Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** na nag-demo ng multi-agent shared-pool quantization, at **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** na umiikot bago ang opisyal na Python release ng Google sa Q2 2026. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag-7 capex tape na binasag ng Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na maaaring lumipat mula FP16 papunta sa 3.5-bit ay nababawasan ang epektibong per-token cost ng ~5-6x. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang mga hyperscaler ay mag-gate ng Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing sa opt-in compressed-cache tiers, at ang hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis mula sa report kahapon ay tumitindi sa pamamagitan ng lever na ito sa halip na sa pamamagitan ng mas kakaunting GPUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

so_that.ja: 主要な推論ランタイムすべてがTurboQuantと代替(KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention)を備えたkv-cache-dtypeフラグを出荷し、ハイパースケーラーがそれに基づいてトークン単価を階層化する。
so_that.es: Cada runtime de inferencia importante envia un flag kv-cache-dtype con TurboQuant mas una alternativa (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention) y los hyperscalers tieran el precio por token sobre el.
so_that.fil: Bawat major inference runtime ay maglalabas ng kv-cache-dtype flag na may TurboQuant kasama ang isang alternatibo (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention) at ang hyperscalers ay mag-tier ng per-token pricing dito.

plain_language.en: AI servers are about to ship a single switch that shrinks memory use 5-6x, so cloud providers can charge less per word without buying more chips.
plain_language.ja: AIサーバーは、メモリ使用量を5〜6倍縮小する単一スイッチを出荷しようとしており、クラウドプロバイダーはより多くのチップを購入することなく、単語あたりの料金を引き下げることができる。
plain_language.es: Los servidores de IA estan a punto de enviar un solo interruptor que reduce el uso de memoria 5-6x, asi que los proveedores de nube pueden cobrar menos por palabra sin comprar mas chips.
plain_language.fil: Ang AI servers ay malapit nang maglabas ng iisang switch na nagpapaliit ng memory use ng 5-6x, kaya ang cloud providers ay maaaring magpa-singil ng mas mura per word nang hindi bumibili ng mas maraming chips.

title_locales.fil: KV-cache-compression dtype magiging deployment knob ng inference stack pagsapit ng Q4 2026

detail.summary_short: Apr 27-29 stacks the evidence: TurboQuant lands at ICLR 2026, SGLang PR #21419 + fused-kernel rewrite #23134 hit 93-105% bf16 throughput, NVIDIA kvpress matures, PolyKV demos multi-agent shared-pool quantization, and community ports circulate. By Q4 2026 every major inference stack exposes a kv-cache-dtype flag and hyperscalers tier per-token pricing on compressed-cache tiers.

summary_short_locales.en: Apr 27-29 stacks the evidence: TurboQuant lands at ICLR 2026, SGLang PR #21419 + fused-kernel rewrite #23134 hit 93-105% bf16 throughput, NVIDIA kvpress matures, PolyKV demos multi-agent shared-pool quantization, and community ports circulate. By Q4 2026 every major inference stack exposes a kv-cache-dtype flag and hyperscalers tier per-token pricing on compressed-cache tiers.
summary_short_locales.ja: 4月27日〜29日が証拠を積み上げた: TurboQuantがICLR 2026に到達、SGLang PR #21419 + フューズドカーネル書き換え#23134がbf16スループットの93〜105%に到達、NVIDIA kvpressが成熟、PolyKVがマルチエージェント共有プール量子化をデモ、コミュニティポートが流通している。2026年Q4までに、主要な全推論スタックがkv-cache-dtypeフラグを公開し、ハイパースケーラーが圧縮キャッシュ階層でトークン単価を階層化する。
summary_short_locales.es: El 27-29 de abril apila la evidencia: TurboQuant aterriza en ICLR 2026, SGLang PR #21419 + reescritura de kernel fusionado #23134 alcanzan 93-105% del throughput de bf16, NVIDIA kvpress madura, PolyKV demuestra cuantizacion de pool compartido multi-agente, y los ports de la comunidad circulan. Para el Q4 2026 cada stack de inferencia importante expone un flag kv-cache-dtype y los hyperscalers tieran el precio por token sobre tiers de cache-comprimido.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Apr 27-29 ay nagpapatong ng ebidensya: lumapag ang TurboQuant sa ICLR 2026, ang SGLang PR #21419 + fused-kernel rewrite #23134 ay umaabot ng 93-105% bf16 throughput, ang NVIDIA kvpress ay tumatanda, ang PolyKV ay nag-demo ng multi-agent shared-pool quantization, at umiikot ang community ports. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, bawat major inference stack ay maglalabas ng kv-cache-dtype flag at ang hyperscalers ay mag-tier ng per-token pricing sa compressed-cache tiers.

bridges.text: The standing three-way SGLang vs vLLM vs Cloudflare Infire production-serving Pareto split, with SGLang now commercially wrapped as RadixArk at ~$400M, tightens the substrate the KV-cache-compression-dtype prediction (Apr 29) names: inference-engine differentiation continues to converge on prefix-cache + disaggregation as first-class knobs.

text_locales.en: The standing three-way SGLang vs vLLM vs Cloudflare Infire production-serving Pareto split, with SGLang now commercially wrapped as RadixArk at ~$400M, tightens the substrate the KV-cache-compression-dtype prediction (Apr 29) names: inference-engine differentiation continues to converge on prefix-cache + disaggregation as first-class knobs.
text_locales.ja: 標準の3方向SGLang vs vLLM vs Cloudflare Infireプロダクション・サービング・パレート分裂は、SGLangが現在RadixArkとして約$400Mで商業的にラップされていることで、KVキャッシュ圧縮dtype予測(4月29日)が指摘する基盤を強化する: 推論エンジン差別化はprefix-cacheと分離をファースト・クラス・ノブとして収束し続けている。
text_locales.es: La división Pareto estándar de tres vías SGLang vs vLLM vs Cloudflare Infire de production-serving, con SGLang ahora envuelto comercialmente como RadixArk a ~$400M, tensa el sustrato que nombra la predicción de dtype de compresión KV-cache (29 abr): la diferenciación de motor de inferencia continúa convergiendo en prefix-cache + disaggregation como knobs first-class.
text_locales.fil: Ang standing three-way SGLang vs vLLM vs Cloudflare Infire production-serving Pareto split, kung saan ang SGLang ay commercially wrapped na bilang RadixArk sa ~$400M, ay nagpapahigpit sa substrate na pinapangalanan ng KV-cache-compression-dtype prediction (Abr 29): ang inference-engine differentiation ay patuloy na nagpapaconverge sa prefix-cache + disaggregation bilang first-class knobs.

bridges.text: Cloudflare's Infire engine entering global edge production with prefill/decode disaggregation and a 7%+ vLLM throughput edge adds a third inference-stack candidate alongside SGLang and vLLM. The expanding production-serving Pareto frontier is the substrate a unified KV-cache-compression dtype knob would expose, but no fresh kv-cache-dtype CLI flag ships in the window.

text_locales.en: Cloudflare's Infire engine entering global edge production with prefill/decode disaggregation and a 7%+ vLLM throughput edge adds a third inference-stack candidate alongside SGLang and vLLM. The expanding production-serving Pareto frontier is the substrate a unified KV-cache-compression dtype knob would expose, but no fresh kv-cache-dtype CLI flag ships in the window.
text_locales.ja: Cloudflareの Infireエンジンが、プリフィル/デコード分離と7%以上のvLLMスループット優位を伴ってグローバル・エッジ本番に参入することは、SGLangおよびvLLMと並んで第三の推論スタック候補を加える。拡張する本番サービングのパレート・フロンティアは、統一されたKVキャッシュ圧縮dtypeノブが公開する基盤だが、新たなkv-cache-dtype CLIフラグはウィンドウ内で出荷されない。
text_locales.es: El motor Infire de Cloudflare entrando en producción global edge con desagregación prefill/decode y un margen de throughput de 7%+ sobre vLLM agrega un tercer candidato de stack de inferencia junto a SGLang y vLLM. La frontera Pareto de production-serving en expansión es el sustrato que un knob unificado de compresión KV-cache-dtype expondría, pero ningún flag CLI fresco kv-cache-dtype se entrega en la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang Infire engine ng Cloudflare na pumapasok sa global edge production na may prefill/decode disaggregation at 7%+ vLLM throughput edge ay nagdaragdag ng third inference-stack candidate kasama ang SGLang at vLLM. Ang lumalawak na production-serving Pareto frontier ang substrate na ipalalantad ng unified KV-cache-compression dtype knob, ngunit walang sariwang kv-cache-dtype CLI flag na nagshi-ship sa window.

bridges.text: SGLang's measured 29% throughput lead and day-0 model coverage plus Unsloth's 70% VRAM-reduction baseline keep the precondition warm: the inference-stack consolidation around shared-prefix optimization is exactly the substrate a unified kv-cache-dtype knob would expose.

text_locales.en: SGLang's measured 29% throughput lead and day-0 model coverage plus Unsloth's 70% VRAM-reduction baseline keep the precondition warm: the inference-stack consolidation around shared-prefix optimization is exactly the substrate a unified kv-cache-dtype knob would expose.
text_locales.ja: SGLangの計測された29%スループット優位とday-0モデル・カバレッジ + UnslothのVRAM 70%削減ベースラインが前提条件を温存している: 共有プレフィックス最適化を中心とする推論スタック統合は、まさに統一されたkv-cache-dtypeノブが公開する基盤である。
text_locales.es: La ventaja de rendimiento medida del 29% de SGLang y la cobertura de modelo day-0 más la línea base de reducción del 70% de VRAM de Unsloth mantienen caliente la precondición: la consolidación de la pila de inferencia en torno a la optimización de prefijo compartido es exactamente el sustrato que un knob unificado de kv-cache-dtype expondría.
text_locales.fil: Ang sinukat na 29% throughput lead at day-0 model coverage ng SGLang plus ang 70% VRAM-reduction baseline ng Unsloth ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang precondition: ang inference-stack consolidation sa paligid ng shared-prefix optimization ang siyang substrate na ipalalantad ng unified kv-cache-dtype knob.

text_locales.en: SGLang's PR #21419 in-tree and #23134 hitting 93-105% bf16 throughput, llama.cpp's #20969 thread, NVIDIA kvpress, and the SideQuest / DepthKV / PolyKV / KVFundaBench arxiv wave compose the same multi-stack convergence the prediction needs. text_locales.ja: SGLangのPR #21419がインツリー、#23134がbf16スループット93-105%に到達、llama.cppの#20969スレッド、NVIDIA kvpress、SideQuest / DepthKV / PolyKV / KVFundaBenchのarxivウェーブが、予測が必要とするのと同じマルチスタック収束を構成する。dtype-as-knobロールアウトは4月27-29日シーケンスを通じて目に見える形で進行中で、5月3日まで広がり続けている。
text_locales.es: El PR #21419 in-tree de SGLang y #23134 alcanzando 93-105% de throughput bf16, el hilo #20969 de llama.cpp, NVIDIA kvpress, y la ola arxiv SideQuest / DepthKV / PolyKV / KVFundaBench componen la misma convergencia multi-stack que la predicción necesita. El despliegue de dtype-como-knob ahora está visiblemente en marcha a través de la secuencia del 27-29 de abril y sigue propagándose hasta el 3 de mayo.
text_locales.fil: Ang PR #21419 in-tree at #23134 ng SGLang na umaabot sa 93-105% bf16 throughput, ang #20969 thread ng llama.cpp, NVIDIA kvpress, at ang SideQuest / DepthKV / PolyKV / KVFundaBench arxiv wave ay bumubuo ng parehong multi-stack convergence na kailangan ng prediction. Ang dtype-as-knob rollout ay nakikitang isinasagawa na sa Apr 27-29 sequence at patuloy na kumakalat hanggang May 3.

text_locales.es: El kernel fused-Triton de SGLang alcanzando throughput de paridad, el hilo activo de la comunidad de llama.cpp, la madurez de NVIDIA kvpress, y la ola arxiv de cuatro papers de compresión juntos llenan la tubería de precondiciones que la predicción espera que converja en un flag de despliegue unificado.

detail.description: **By Q4 2026 KV-cache-compression dtype is exposed as a first-class deployment knob in every major inference stack — vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM all ship a `--kv-cache-dtype turboquant` (or equivalent) flag with TurboQuant + at least one alternative (KVTC / kvpress / TriAttention).** Apr 27-29 makes this a near-certainty: **TurboQuant lands at ICLR 2026 + Google Research blog**, **SGLang PR #21419 already in-tree** with a fused-kernel rewrite (#23134) hitting 93-105% bf16 throughput, **NVIDIA kvpress** at Decoding-Press maturity, **PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971)** demoing multi-agent shared-pool quantization, and **community MLX + Triton + vLLM ports** circulating before Google's official Python release lands in Q2 2026. The economic forcing function is the same Mag-7 capex tape the Apr 28 OpenAI-miss WSJ report just cracked: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that can move from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x. By Q4 2026 hyperscalers gate Bedrock/Azure/Vertex per-token pricing on opt-in compressed-cache tiers, and the hardware-cap-on-incremental-GPU-capex thesis from yesterday's report tightens via this lever rather than via fewer GPUs.
