nodes.description: **By H2 2026 every major local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) exposes a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + at least one alternative — and Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ships native TurboQuant integration tied to Windows ML / WinML execution providers as a Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 evidence: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite hitting 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool for multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress at Decoding-Press maturity; llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread active; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% faster. Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.

description.en: **By H2 2026 every major local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) exposes a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + at least one alternative — and Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ships native TurboQuant integration tied to Windows ML / WinML execution providers as a Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 evidence: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite hitting 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool for multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress at Decoding-Press maturity; llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread active; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% faster. Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.
description.ja: **2026年下半期までに、すべての主要なローカルLLMエコシステム(vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM、Foundry Local)が統一された圧縮KVキャッシュデプロイメントノブ — TurboQuant + 少なくとも1つの代替案 — を公開し、Foundry Local(Microsoft、4月9日GA)はWindows ML / WinML実行プロバイダに紐付いたネイティブTurboQuant統合をWindowsデフォルト最適化として出荷する。** 4月27-29日のエビデンス:SGLang PR #21419がインツリー化、SGLang #23134のfused-Triton-decodeカーネル書き換えがbf16スループットの93–105%に到達、vLLM v0.19.0(4月2日)はtorch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / 非同期スケジューラがデフォルト + Model Runner V2、PolyKV(arxiv 2604.24971、4月27日)はマルチエージェント推論向けの共有非対称KVプール、NVIDIA kvpressはDecoding-Press成熟度、llama.cpp #20969のTurboQuant議論スレッドがアクティブ、Unsloth 2026.4.8の推論が20-30%高速化。Foundry Localは欠けていたエンタープライズWindowsエントリポイントである — Microsoftはこれをハードウェア対応のWinML実行プロバイダで任意のアプリにローカルAIをバンドルする約20MBのネイティブライブラリとして出荷しており、2026年Q2の明らかな次の一歩はFoundry CatalogでTurboQuantフラグを公開することである。経済的な強制要因はMag 7 capexテープと同じである:FP16から3.5ビットに移行するメモリ帯域幅律速の長文脈ワークロードはすべてトークンあたりの実効コストを約5-6倍削減し、Foundry Localはその切替をエンドデベロッパーに対して不可視にする。
description.es: **Para H2 2026 cada ecosistema mayor de LLM local (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) expone un knob unificado de despliegue de KV-cache comprimido — TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa — y Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA 9 abr) lanza integración nativa de TurboQuant atada a los execution providers de Windows ML / WinML como optimización por defecto en Windows.** Evidencia del 27-29 abr: el PR #21419 de SGLang está in-tree; la rescritura de fused-Triton-decode kernel de SGLang #23134 alcanza 93–105% del throughput bf16; vLLM v0.19.0 (2 abr) trae torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler por defecto + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, 27 abr) es un pool compartido asimétrico de KV para inferencia multi-agente; NVIDIA kvpress alcanza madurez en Decoding-Press; el hilo #20969 de discusión de TurboQuant en llama.cpp está activo; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inferencia 20-30% más rápida. Foundry Local es el punto de entrada empresarial-Windows que faltaba — Microsoft lo envía como una librería nativa de ~20MB que empaqueta IA local en cualquier app con execution providers de WinML adaptados al hardware, y el siguiente paso obvio para Q2 2026 es exponer un flag de TurboQuant en el Foundry Catalog. La función forzante económica es el mismo tape de capex Mag 7: cada workload long-context limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pasa de FP16 a 3,5 bits recorta el costo efectivo por token unas 5-6x, y Foundry Local hace ese cambio invisible para los desarrolladores finales. description.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang bawat pangunahing local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) ay maglalantad ng unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + hindi bababa sa isang alternatibo — at ang Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ay magpapadala ng native TurboQuant integration na nakatali sa Windows ML / WinML execution providers bilang Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 ebidensiya: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite na umabot sa 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool para sa multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress sa Decoding-Press maturity; aktibo ang llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% mas mabilis. Ang Foundry Local ang nawawalang enterprise-Windows entry point — ipinapadala ito ng Microsoft bilang ~20MB native library na nagbubundle ng local AI sa anumang app na may hardware-matched WinML execution providers, at ang malinaw na susunod na hakbang para sa Q2 2026 ay ang paglalantad ng TurboQuant flag sa Foundry Catalog. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag 7 capex tape: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na lumilipat mula FP16 papuntang 3.5-bit ay nagbabawas ng effective per-token cost ng ~5-6x, at ginagawa ng Foundry Local na hindi nakikita ng end-developer ang switch na iyon.

detail.summary_short: Parallel work across SGLang, vLLM, llama.cpp, and Microsoft's Foundry Local plus TurboQuant + PolyKV + NVIDIA kvpress points to a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob across every major local-LLM stack by H2 2026, with Foundry Local shipping native TurboQuant tied to WinML execution providers.

summary_short_locales.en: Parallel work across SGLang, vLLM, llama.cpp, and Microsoft's Foundry Local plus TurboQuant + PolyKV + NVIDIA kvpress points to a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob across every major local-LLM stack by H2 2026, with Foundry Local shipping native TurboQuant tied to WinML execution providers.
summary_short_locales.ja: SGLang、vLLM、llama.cpp、MicrosoftのFoundry Local間の並行作業に加え、TurboQuant + PolyKV + NVIDIA kvpressが、2026年下半期までにすべての主要なローカルLLMスタック横断で統一された圧縮KVキャッシュデプロイメントノブを示唆し、Foundry LocalはWinML実行プロバイダに紐付いたネイティブTurboQuantを出荷する。
summary_short_locales.es: El trabajo paralelo en SGLang, vLLM, llama.cpp y Foundry Local de Microsoft junto con TurboQuant + PolyKV + NVIDIA kvpress apunta hacia un knob unificado de despliegue de KV-cache comprimido en cada stack mayor de LLM local para H2 2026, con Foundry Local lanzando TurboQuant nativo atado a los execution providers de WinML.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang parallel work sa SGLang, vLLM, llama.cpp, at Microsoft's Foundry Local kasama ang TurboQuant + PolyKV + NVIDIA kvpress ay tumuturo sa unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob sa bawat pangunahing local-LLM stack pagsapit ng H2 2026, na ang Foundry Local ay nagpapadala ng native TurboQuant na nakatali sa WinML execution providers.

bridges.text: The Unsloth Mistral-coordinated 3.5 fix plus the standing 2026 update wave (12x faster MoE training, full fine-tunes to GGUF, Qwen3.6-27B + Kimi K2.6 support) deepen the local-LLM training Pareto the unified-compressed-KV-cache-flag prediction (Apr 30) names. No unified flag ships across the local stacks today.

text_locales.en: The Unsloth Mistral-coordinated 3.5 fix plus the standing 2026 update wave (12x faster MoE training, full fine-tunes to GGUF, Qwen3.6-27B + Kimi K2.6 support) deepen the local-LLM training Pareto the unified-compressed-KV-cache-flag prediction (Apr 30) names. No unified flag ships across the local stacks today.
text_locales.ja: UnslothのMistralと協調した3.5フィックスと、標準2026アップデート・ウェーブ(12倍高速のMoE訓練、フル・ファインチューンのGGUFエクスポート、Qwen3.6-27B + Kimi K2.6サポート)は、統一圧縮KVキャッシュ・フラグ予測(4月30日)が指摘するローカルLLM訓練パレートを深化させる。本日ローカル・スタック横断の統一フラグは出荷されない。
text_locales.es: El fix coordinado Unsloth-Mistral 3.5 más la ola de updates 2026 estándar (entrenamiento MoE 12x más rápido, exportación full fine-tunes a GGUF, soporte Qwen3.6-27B + Kimi K2.6) profundizan el Pareto de entrenamiento Local-LLM que nombra la predicción flag KV-cache comprimido unificado (30 abr). Ningún flag unificado se entrega cross-stack-local hoy.
text_locales.fil: Ang Unsloth Mistral-coordinated 3.5 fix plus ang standing 2026 update wave (12x faster MoE training, full fine-tunes sa GGUF, Qwen3.6-27B + Kimi K2.6 support) ay lumalalim sa local-LLM training Pareto na pinapangalanan ng unified-compressed-KV-cache-flag prediction (Abr 30). Walang unified flag ang nag-ship sa local stacks ngayon.

bridges.text: SGLang's measured throughput lead and day-0 model coverage plus Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face joint engineering reinforce the precondition that the local-LLM ecosystem has the kernel-level performance maturity needed before a unified compressed-KV-cache knob lands across the stack.

text_locales.en: SGLang's measured throughput lead and day-0 model coverage plus Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face joint engineering reinforce the precondition that the local-LLM ecosystem has the kernel-level performance maturity needed before a unified compressed-KV-cache knob lands across the stack.
text_locales.ja: SGLangの計測されたスループット優位とday-0モデル・カバレッジ + Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face共同エンジニアリングが、ローカルLLMエコシステムが、統一された圧縮KVキャッシュ・ノブがスタック全体に着地する前に必要なカーネルレベルの性能成熟度を持つという前提条件を強化している。
text_locales.es: La ventaja de rendimiento medida de SGLang y la cobertura de modelo day-0 más la ingeniería conjunta Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face refuerzan la precondición de que el ecosistema local-LLM tiene la madurez de rendimiento a nivel de kernel necesaria antes de que un knob unificado de KV-cache comprimido aterrice en la pila.
text_locales.fil: Ang sinukat na throughput lead at day-0 model coverage ng SGLang plus Unsloth + NVIDIA DGX Spark + Hugging Face joint engineering ay nagpapatibay sa precondition na ang local-LLM ecosystem ay may kernel-level performance maturity na kailangan bago lumapag ang unified compressed-KV-cache knob sa buong stack.

The TurboQuant-plus-alternative pattern is now visible in code, papers, and Windows-default deployment substrate at once.

text_locales.en: SGLang's fused Triton kernels at parity with bf16, the active llama.cpp TurboQuant thread, Foundry Local at GA on Windows ML, and the SideQuest / DepthKV / PolyKV / KVFundaBench wave compose the same multi-stack convergence the prediction names. The TurboQuant-plus-alternative pattern is now visible in code, papers, and Windows-default deployment substrate at once.
text_locales.ja: SGLangのフューズドTriton kernelがbf16とパリティ、アクティブなllama.cpp TurboQuantスレッド、Foundry LocalがWindows MLでGA、SideQuest / DepthKV / PolyKV / KVFundaBenchウェーブが、予測が命名するのと同じマルチスタック収束を構成する。TurboQuantプラス代替パターンは今や、コード、論文、Windowsデフォルト展開基盤で同時に可視化されている。
text_locales.es: Los kernels Triton fusionados de SGLang en paridad con bf16, el hilo activo de TurboQuant de llama.cpp, Foundry Local en GA sobre Windows ML, y la ola SideQuest / DepthKV / PolyKV / KVFundaBench componen la misma convergencia multi-stack que la predicción nombra. El patrón TurboQuant-más-alternativa ahora es visible en código, papers, y sustrato de despliegue por defecto de Windows a la vez.
text_locales.fil: Ang fused Triton kernels ng SGLang sa parity ng bf16, ang aktibong llama.cpp TurboQuant thread, Foundry Local sa GA sa Windows ML, at ang SideQuest / DepthKV / PolyKV / KVFundaBench wave ay bumubuo ng parehong multi-stack convergence na pinapangalanan ng prediction. Ang TurboQuant-plus-alternative pattern ay nakikita na ngayon sa code, papers, at Windows-default deployment substrate nang sabay-sabay.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **By H2 2026 every major local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) exposes a unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + at least one alternative — and Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ships native TurboQuant integration tied to Windows ML / WinML execution providers as a Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 evidence: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite hitting 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool for multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress at Decoding-Press maturity; llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread active; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% faster. Foundry Local is the missing enterprise-Windows entry point — Microsoft ships it as a ~20MB native library that bundles local AI into any app with hardware-matched WinML execution providers, and the obvious next step for Q2 2026 is to surface a TurboQuant flag in the Foundry Catalog. The economic forcing function is the same Mag 7 capex tape: every memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload that moves from FP16 to 3.5-bit cuts effective per-token cost ~5-6x, and Foundry Local makes that switch invisible to end-developers.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年下半期までに、すべての主要なローカルLLMエコシステム(vLLM、SGLang、TGI、Ollama、llama.cpp、NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM、Foundry Local)が統一された圧縮KVキャッシュデプロイメントノブ — TurboQuant + 少なくとも1つの代替案 — を公開し、Foundry Local(Microsoft、4月9日GA)はWindows ML / WinML実行プロバイダに紐付いたネイティブTurboQuant統合をWindowsデフォルト最適化として出荷する。** 4月27-29日のエビデンス:SGLang PR #21419がインツリー化、SGLang #23134のfused-Triton-decodeカーネル書き換えがbf16スループットの93–105%に到達、vLLM v0.19.0(4月2日)はtorch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / 非同期スケジューラがデフォルト + Model Runner V2、PolyKV(arxiv 2604.24971、4月27日)はマルチエージェント推論向けの共有非対称KVプール、NVIDIA kvpressはDecoding-Press成熟度、llama.cpp #20969のTurboQuant議論スレッドがアクティブ、Unsloth 2026.4.8の推論が20-30%高速化。Foundry Localは欠けていたエンタープライズWindowsエントリポイントである — Microsoftはこれをハードウェア対応のWinML実行プロバイダで任意のアプリにローカルAIをバンドルする約20MBのネイティブライブラリとして出荷しており、2026年Q2の明らかな次の一歩はFoundry CatalogでTurboQuantフラグを公開することである。経済的な強制要因はMag 7 capexテープと同じである:FP16から3.5ビットに移行するメモリ帯域幅律速の長文脈ワークロードはすべてトークンあたりの実効コストを約5-6倍削減し、Foundry Localはその切替をエンドデベロッパーに対して不可視にする。
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para H2 2026 cada ecosistema mayor de LLM local (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) expone un knob unificado de despliegue de KV-cache comprimido — TurboQuant + al menos una alternativa — y Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA 9 abr) lanza integración nativa de TurboQuant atada a los execution providers de Windows ML / WinML como optimización por defecto en Windows.** Evidencia del 27-29 abr: el PR #21419 de SGLang está in-tree; la rescritura de fused-Triton-decode kernel de SGLang #23134 alcanza 93–105% del throughput bf16; vLLM v0.19.0 (2 abr) trae torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler por defecto + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, 27 abr) es un pool compartido asimétrico de KV para inferencia multi-agente; NVIDIA kvpress alcanza madurez en Decoding-Press; el hilo #20969 de discusión de TurboQuant en llama.cpp está activo; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inferencia 20-30% más rápida. Foundry Local es el punto de entrada empresarial-Windows que faltaba — Microsoft lo envía como una librería nativa de ~20MB que empaqueta IA local en cualquier app con execution providers de WinML adaptados al hardware, y el siguiente paso obvio para Q2 2026 es exponer un flag de TurboQuant en el Foundry Catalog. La función forzante económica es el mismo tape de capex Mag 7: cada workload long-context limitado por ancho de banda de memoria que pasa de FP16 a 3,5 bits recorta el costo efectivo por token unas 5-6x, y Foundry Local hace ese cambio invisible para los desarrolladores finales. prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang bawat pangunahing local-LLM ecosystem (vLLM, SGLang, TGI, Ollama, llama.cpp, NVIDIA TensorRT-LLM, Foundry Local) ay maglalantad ng unified compressed-KV-cache deployment knob — TurboQuant + hindi bababa sa isang alternatibo — at ang Foundry Local (Microsoft, GA Apr 9) ay magpapadala ng native TurboQuant integration na nakatali sa Windows ML / WinML execution providers bilang Windows-default optimization.** Apr 27-29 ebidensiya: SGLang PR #21419 in-tree; SGLang #23134 fused-Triton-decode kernel rewrite na umabot sa 93–105% bf16 throughput; vLLM v0.19.0 (Apr 2) torch 2.11 / Python 3.14 / async scheduler default + Model Runner V2; PolyKV (arxiv 2604.24971, Apr 27) shared asymmetric KV-pool para sa multi-agent inference; NVIDIA kvpress sa Decoding-Press maturity; aktibo ang llama.cpp #20969 TurboQuant discussion thread; Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference 20-30% mas mabilis. Ang Foundry Local ang nawawalang enterprise-Windows entry point — ipinapadala ito ng Microsoft bilang ~20MB native library na nagbubundle ng local AI sa anumang app na may hardware-matched WinML execution providers, at ang malinaw na susunod na hakbang para sa Q2 2026 ay ang paglalantad ng TurboQuant flag sa Foundry Catalog. Ang economic forcing function ay parehong Mag 7 capex tape: bawat memory-bandwidth-bound long-context workload na lumilipat mula FP16 papuntang 3.5-bit ay nagbabawas ng effective per-token cost ng ~5-6x, at ginagawa ng Foundry Local na hindi nakikita ng end-developer ang switch na iyon.

nodes.title: Microsoft Agent 365 GA forces Big-3 to ship default MCP policy by Q4 2026
nodes.description: **By Q4 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 GA ($15/user, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (Mar 23) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (Apr 29) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (Apr 28) stack converges into an enterprise agent-control-plane reference model — at least 2 of the Big-3 hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) ship policy-based MCP-server allow/block enforcement at the tenant level with audited tool-invocation logs as a default-on primitive; at least one independent control-plane vendor (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) publishes a Sec-Labels-style artifact attestation gate.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: Microsoft just put a per-user price tag ($15/user/mo) on the agent-control-plane category, which sets the pricing-anchor that AWS + Google must respond to with comparable disclosures; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + 7 sandbox providers pre-baked the runtime side, and the May 1 GA wires the policy side to an existing M365 admin surface (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Once the May 1 GA's Defender asset-context mapping (devices + MCP servers + identities + cloud resources per agent) ships in June 2026 it becomes the de-facto schema; the path of least resistance is for AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden to publish parallel schemas before Q4 to avoid losing the M365-installed-base anchor. CSAI's MITRE-CNA cadence will compress the disclosure side in parallel. In plain language: Microsoft put a price tag on controlling AI agents — other clouds will copy or lose customers. description.en: **By Q4 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 GA ($15/user, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (Mar 23) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (Apr 29) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (Apr 28) stack converges into an enterprise agent-control-plane reference model — at least 2 of the Big-3 hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) ship policy-based MCP-server allow/block enforcement at the tenant level with audited tool-invocation logs as a default-on primitive; at least one independent control-plane vendor (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) publishes a Sec-Labels-style artifact attestation gate.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: Microsoft just put a per-user price tag ($15/user/mo) on the agent-control-plane category, which sets the pricing-anchor that AWS + Google must respond to with comparable disclosures; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + 7 sandbox providers pre-baked the runtime side, and the May 1 GA wires the policy side to an existing M365 admin surface (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Once the May 1 GA's Defender asset-context mapping (devices + MCP servers + identities + cloud resources per agent) ships in June 2026 it becomes the de-facto schema; the path of least resistance is for AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden to publish parallel schemas before Q4 to avoid losing the M365-installed-base anchor. CSAI's MITRE-CNA cadence will compress the disclosure side in parallel. In plain language: Microsoft put a price tag on controlling AI agents — other clouds will copy or lose customers. In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **2026年Q4までに、Microsoft Agent 365 GA($15/ユーザー、M365 E7)+ Cisco DefenseClawオープンソース(3月23日)+ CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA(4月29日)+ AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness(4月28日)のスタックが収束し、エンタープライズ・エージェント制御プレーンの参照モデルとなる — Big-3ハイパースケーラー(AWS、Azure、GCP)のうち少なくとも2社が、テナントレベルでのポリシーベースMCPサーバーallow/block強制を、ツール呼び出しログの監査付きで、デフォルトオンのプリミティブとして実装する;少なくとも1つの独立した制御プレーンベンダー(Vanta、Zenity、OpenClawAI)がSec-Labelsスタイルのアーティファクト証明ゲートを公開する。** 強制要因はエンタープライズ調達:Microsoftはエージェント制御プレーン分野に1ユーザーあたりの価格タグ($15/ユーザー/月)を付け、AWSとGoogleが同等の開示で対応せざるを得ない価格アンカーを設定した;4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK + 7社のサンドボックスプロバイダーがランタイム側を事前に固め、5月1日のGAがポリシー側を既存のM365管理サーフェス(Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender)に接続した。5月1日GAのDefenderアセットコンテキストマッピング(エージェントごとのデバイス + MCPサーバー + ID + クラウドリソース)が2026年6月に出荷されると、それが事実上のスキーマとなる;最も抵抗の少ない経路は、AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent GardenがM365インストールベースのアンカーを失わないようQ4前に並行スキーマを公開することだ。CSAIのMITRE-CNAケイデンスが開示側を並行して圧縮する。In plain language: MicrosoftがAIエージェント制御に価格を付けた — 他のクラウドはコピーするか顧客を失う。In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para el Q4 2026, la pila formada por la GA de Microsoft Agent 365 ($15/usuario, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (23 mar) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (29 abr) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (28 abr) converge en un modelo de referencia de plano de control para agentes empresariales — al menos 2 de los 3 grandes hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) lanzarán la aplicación de políticas de permitir/bloquear servidores MCP a nivel de inquilino con registros auditados de invocación de herramientas como primitiva activada por defecto; al menos un proveedor independiente de plano de control (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) publicará una puerta de atestación de artefactos al estilo Sec-Labels.** La función forzante es la contratación empresarial: Microsoft acaba de poner una etiqueta de precio por usuario ($15/usuario/mes) a la categoría de plano de control de agentes, lo que establece el ancla de precios al que AWS + Google deben responder con divulgaciones comparables; el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr + 7 proveedores de sandbox prepararon el lado del runtime, y la GA del 1 mayo conecta el lado de las políticas con una superficie administrativa M365 existente (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Una vez que el mapeo de contexto-de-activos de Defender de la GA del 1 mayo (dispositivos + servidores MCP + identidades + recursos cloud por agente) se lance en junio 2026, se convierte en el esquema de facto; la ruta de menor resistencia es que AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden publiquen esquemas paralelos antes del Q4 para evitar perder el ancla de la base instalada de M365. La cadencia MITRE-CNA de CSAI comprimirá el lado de la divulgación en paralelo. En lenguaje claro: Microsoft ha puesto una etiqueta de precio al control de los agentes de IA — otras nubes copiarán o perderán clientes. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:
description.fil: **Sa Q4 2026 ang stack na Microsoft Agent 365 GA ($15/user, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (Mar 23) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (Apr 29) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (Apr 28) ay magtatagpo sa enterprise agent-control-plane reference model — hindi bababa sa 2 sa Big-3 hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) ay magpapadala ng policy-based MCP-server allow/block enforcement sa tenant level na may audited tool-invocation logs bilang default-on primitive; hindi bababa sa isang independent control-plane vendor (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) ay maglalathala ng Sec-Labels-style artifact attestation gate.** Ang forcing function ay enterprise procurement: kalalagay lang ng Microsoft ng per-user price tag ($15/user/mo) sa agent-control-plane category, na nagtatakda ng pricing-anchor na kailangang sagutin ng AWS + Google ng comparable disclosures; ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + 7 sandbox providers ay nag-pre-bake na sa runtime side, at ang May 1 GA ang nagwi-wire sa policy side patungo sa existing M365 admin surface (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Sa sandaling magpadala sa Hunyo 2026 ang Defender asset-context mapping ng May 1 GA (devices + MCP servers + identities + cloud resources kada agent), ito ay magiging de-facto schema; ang pinakamadaling daan ay para sa AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden na maglathala ng parallel schemas bago Q4 upang hindi mawalan sa M365-installed-base anchor. Ang CSAI MITRE-CNA cadence ay magpapasinop ng disclosure side parallel.

detail.summary_short: Microsoft Agent 365's May 1 GA at $15/user wires MCP-server allow/block enforcement to an existing M365 admin surface and sets the pricing anchor for AWS Bedrock AgentCore and Google Vertex. Combined with CSAI's MITRE-CNA cadence and the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK runtime substrate, ≥2 of the Big-3 ship default-on tenant-level enforcement with audited tool-invocation logs by Q4 2026, plus ≥1 independent attestation-gate vendor.

summary_short_locales.en: Microsoft Agent 365's May 1 GA at $15/user wires MCP-server allow/block enforcement to an existing M365 admin surface and sets the pricing anchor for AWS Bedrock AgentCore and Google Vertex. Combined with CSAI's MITRE-CNA cadence and the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK runtime substrate, ≥2 of the Big-3 ship default-on tenant-level enforcement with audited tool-invocation logs by Q4 2026, plus ≥1 independent attestation-gate vendor.
summary_short_locales.ja: Microsoft Agent 365の5月1日GA($15/ユーザー)が、MCPサーバーallow/block強制を既存のM365管理サーフェスに接続し、AWS Bedrock AgentCoreとGoogle Vertexの価格アンカーを設定した。CSAIのMITRE-CNAケイデンスと4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDKランタイム基盤と組み合わさり、2026年Q4までにBig-3のうち2社以上がツール呼び出しログ監査付きのデフォルトオン・テナントレベル強制を出荷し、1社以上の独立した証明ゲートベンダーも加わる。
summary_short_locales.es: La GA del 1 mayo de Microsoft Agent 365 a $15/usuario conecta la aplicación de permitir/bloquear servidores MCP a una superficie administrativa M365 existente y fija el ancla de precios para AWS Bedrock AgentCore y Google Vertex. Combinado con la cadencia MITRE-CNA de CSAI y el sustrato de runtime del OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr, ≥2 de los 3 grandes lanzarán la aplicación a nivel de inquilino activada por defecto con registros auditados de invocación de herramientas para el Q4 2026, más ≥1 proveedor independiente de puerta de atestación.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang May 1 GA ng Microsoft Agent 365 sa $15/user ay nagwi-wire ng MCP-server allow/block enforcement sa existing M365 admin surface at nagtatakda ng pricing anchor para sa AWS Bedrock AgentCore at Google Vertex. Kasama ng CSAI MITRE-CNA cadence at ng Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK runtime substrate, ≥2 sa Big-3 ay magpapadala ng default-on tenant-level enforcement na may audited tool-invocation logs pagsapit ng Q4 2026, kasama ng ≥1 independent attestation-gate vendor.

bridges.text: Microsoft Foundry Skill Catalog adds Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill interop in public preview; AWS Bedrock Agent Registry adds OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise interop in private preview for FedRAMP-Moderate; Google Vertex extends model-card schema for the IMDA / AISI reciprocity attestation field. Defender's MCP-server quarantine rate climbs to 24% within 30 minutes and Cisco-Astrix's identity gateway hits 740 enterprise-tenant deployments.

text_locales.en: Microsoft Foundry Skill Catalog adds Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill interop in public preview; AWS Bedrock Agent Registry adds OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise interop in private preview for FedRAMP-Moderate; Google Vertex extends model-card schema for the IMDA / AISI reciprocity attestation field. Defender's MCP-server quarantine rate climbs to 24% within 30 minutes and Cisco-Astrix's identity gateway hits 740 enterprise-tenant deployments.
text_locales.ja: Microsoft Foundry Skill CatalogはClaude Code 3.0サンドボックス化スキル相互運用をパブリック・プレビューで追加;AWS Bedrock Agent RegistryはOpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise相互運用をFedRAMP-Moderate向けプライベート・プレビューで追加;Google VertexはIMDA / AISI相互性アテステーション・フィールドのモデルカードスキーマを拡張する。DefenderのMCPサーバー隔離率は30分以内で24%に上昇し、Cisco-Astrixのアイデンティティ・ゲートウェイは740エンタープライズ・テナント・デプロイメントに到達。
text_locales.es: Microsoft Foundry Skill Catalog añade interop sandboxeado de Claude Code 3.0 en preview público; AWS Bedrock Agent Registry añade interop de OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise en preview privado para FedRAMP-Moderate; Google Vertex extiende el esquema model-card para el campo de atestación de reciprocidad IMDA / AISI. La tasa de cuarentena MCP-server de Defender sube al 24% dentro de 30 minutos y la pasarela de identidad de Cisco-Astrix alcanza 740 despliegues de tenant empresarial.
text_locales.fil: Nagdaragdag ang Microsoft Foundry Skill Catalog ng Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill interop sa public preview; nagdaragdag ang AWS Bedrock Agent Registry ng OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise interop sa private preview para sa FedRAMP-Moderate; pinapalawak ng Google Vertex ang model-card schema para sa IMDA / AISI reciprocity attestation field. Umakyat ang MCP-server quarantine rate ng Defender sa 24% sa loob ng 30 minuto at umabot ang identity gateway ng Cisco-Astrix sa 740 enterprise-tenant deployments.

Cisco Astrix's Defender XDR-integrated MCP gateway adds the data-plane control surface — the >=2 Big-3 default-on plus independent attestation shape is operative.

El gateway MCP de Cisco Astrix integrado con Defender XDR anade la superficie de control del data-plane — la forma >=2 Big-3 default-on mas independent attestation esta operativa.
text_locales.fil: Ang AWS Bedrock Agent Registry preview na may FedRAMP-Moderate inheritance at Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center na may per-tenant Mythos-class gating ay nagpapadala ng audited signed-skill provenance schemas kasama ang Skill Catalog ng Microsoft Azure AI Foundry. Ang Defender XDR-integrated MCP gateway ng Cisco Astrix ay nagdaragdag ng data-plane control surface — aktibo na ang >=2 Big-3 default-on plus independent attestation shape.

motivation_locales.fil: Ang cross-cloud enterprises ay nangangailangan ng third-party attestation layer dahil ang hyperscaler allow-lists lamang ay hindi makakaligtas sa multi-cloud audit, at ang CSAI MITRE-CNA cadence ay nagbibigay ng reporting cover para sa third-party gate.

detail.description: **By Q4 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 GA ($15/user, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (Mar 23) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (Apr 29) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (Apr 28) stack converges into an enterprise agent-control-plane reference model — at least 2 of the Big-3 hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) ship policy-based MCP-server allow/block enforcement at the tenant level with audited tool-invocation logs as a default-on primitive; at least one independent control-plane vendor (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) publishes a Sec-Labels-style artifact attestation gate.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: Microsoft just put a per-user price tag ($15/user/mo) on the agent-control-plane category, which sets the pricing-anchor that AWS + Google must respond to with comparable disclosures; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + 7 sandbox providers pre-baked the runtime side, and the May 1 GA wires the policy side to an existing M365 admin surface (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Once the May 1 GA's Defender asset-context mapping (devices + MCP servers + identities + cloud resources per agent) ships in June 2026 it becomes the de-facto schema; the path of least resistance is for AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden to publish parallel schemas before Q4 to avoid losing the M365-installed-base anchor. CSAI's MITRE-CNA cadence will compress the disclosure side in parallel. In plain language: Microsoft put a price tag on controlling AI agents — other clouds will copy or lose customers. prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para el Q4 2026, la pila formada por la GA de Microsoft Agent 365 ($15/usuario, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (23 mar) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (29 abr) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (28 abr) converge en un modelo de referencia de plano de control para agentes empresariales — al menos 2 de los 3 grandes hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) lanzarán la aplicación de políticas de permitir/bloquear servidores MCP a nivel de inquilino con registros auditados de invocación de herramientas como primitiva activada por defecto; al menos un proveedor independiente de plano de control (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) publicará una puerta de atestación de artefactos al estilo Sec-Labels.** La función forzante es la contratación empresarial: Microsoft acaba de poner una etiqueta de precio por usuario ($15/usuario/mes) a la categoría de plano de control de agentes, lo que establece el ancla de precios al que AWS + Google deben responder con divulgaciones comparables; el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr + 7 proveedores de sandbox prepararon el lado del runtime, y la GA del 1 mayo conecta el lado de las políticas con una superficie administrativa M365 existente (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Una vez que el mapeo de contexto-de-activos de Defender de la GA del 1 mayo (dispositivos + servidores MCP + identidades + recursos cloud por agente) se lance en junio 2026, se convierte en el esquema de facto; la ruta de menor resistencia es que AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden publiquen esquemas paralelos antes del Q4 para evitar perder el ancla de la base instalada de M365. La cadencia MITRE-CNA de CSAI comprimirá el lado de la divulgación en paralelo. En lenguaje claro: Microsoft ha puesto una etiqueta de precio al control de los agentes de IA — otras nubes copiarán o perderán clientes. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Sa Q4 2026 ang stack na Microsoft Agent 365 GA ($15/user, M365 E7) + Cisco DefenseClaw open-source (Mar 23) + CSAI Foundation MITRE-CNA (Apr 29) + AWS Bedrock AgentCore Managed Harness (Apr 28) ay magtatagpo sa enterprise agent-control-plane reference model — hindi bababa sa 2 sa Big-3 hyperscalers (AWS, Azure, GCP) ay magpapadala ng policy-based MCP-server allow/block enforcement sa tenant level na may audited tool-invocation logs bilang default-on primitive; hindi bababa sa isang independent control-plane vendor (Vanta, Zenity, OpenClawAI) ay maglalathala ng Sec-Labels-style artifact attestation gate.** Ang forcing function ay enterprise procurement: kalalagay lang ng Microsoft ng per-user price tag ($15/user/mo) sa agent-control-plane category, na nagtatakda ng pricing-anchor na kailangang sagutin ng AWS + Google ng comparable disclosures; ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + 7 sandbox providers ay nag-pre-bake na sa runtime side, at ang May 1 GA ang nagwi-wire sa policy side patungo sa existing M365 admin surface (Entra/Purview/Intune/Defender). Sa sandaling magpadala sa Hunyo 2026 ang Defender asset-context mapping ng May 1 GA (devices + MCP servers + identities + cloud resources kada agent), ito ay magiging de-facto schema; ang pinakamadaling daan ay para sa AWS Bedrock AgentCore + Google Vertex Agent Garden na maglathala ng parallel schemas bago Q4 upang hindi mawalan sa M365-installed-base anchor. Ang CSAI MITRE-CNA cadence ay magpapasinop ng disclosure side parallel.

nodes.description: **By H2 2026 the May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + the Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + the unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 trio makes "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" the dominant attacker pattern — at least one major IR firm publishes a public post-mortem of a real intrusion that pairs an LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE with a Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail or its successor) for full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, and at least one CSAI-CNA-issued advisory explicitly carves out the LLM-tooling + kernel chain as a named technique within ATT&CK v19's Defense Impairment.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 already names the agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); the May 1 Copy Fail wave gives attackers a universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); the LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent gives them the lateral-movement vector. CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization is the disclosure-issuance side; the path of least resistance for an IR firm Q3 incident report is one cloud-multi-tenant intrusion stitched together this exact way. In plain language: Hackers can chain an AI-tooling bug with a Linux-kernel bug to take over shared AI servers. In plain language: In plain language:

description.ja: **2026年下半期までに、5月1日のCopy Fail(CVE-2026-31431)BOD-22-01の14日期限 + 4月30日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208の26時間悪用ウィンドウ + 5月1日まで未パッチのSGLang CVE-2026-5760という3点セットが、「LLMツーリング層CVEのサプライチェーン武器化」を支配的な攻撃パターンにする — 少なくとも1つの大手IRファームが、LLMゲートウェイ/エージェントハーネス/推論ランタイムのCVEとLinuxカーネルLPE(Copy Failまたはその後継)を組み合わせて、マルチテナント推論基盤上でフルチェーンrootを取得した実際の侵入の公開ポストモーテムを発表する;少なくとも1つのCSAI-CNA発行のアドバイザリーが、ATT&CK v19のDefense Impairment内で、LLMツーリング+カーネル連鎖を名前付きテクニックとして明示的に切り出す。** 4月28日のATT&CK v19はすでにエージェント関連テクニック(コンテキストポイズニング、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェントデプロイ)を命名している;5月1日のCopy Failの波が、攻撃者にクラウドサービスプロバイダーへの実環境利用が確認された(Microsoft Security Blog開示による)汎用Linux LPEを与えた;LiteLLMのSQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keysの先例が、横展開ベクトルを与える。CSAIの4月29日CNA認可は開示発行側であり、IRファームのQ3インシデントレポートにとって最も抵抗の少ない経路は、まさにこの形で組み立てられた1件のクラウドマルチテナント侵入である。In plain language: ハッカーはAIツーリングのバグとLinuxカーネルのバグを連鎖させて、共有AIサーバーを乗っ取れる。In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para el H2 2026, el plazo de 14 días BOD-22-01 del Copy Fail del 1 mayo (CVE-2026-31431) + la ventana de explotación de 26 horas del LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 30 abr + el trío SGLang CVE-2026-5760 sin parchear hasta el 1 mayo convierte la "weaponización de la cadena de suministro de CVEs de la capa de tooling-LLM" en el patrón dominante de los atacantes — al menos una firma importante de respuesta a incidentes publicará un post-mortem público de una intrusión real que combine un CVE de gateway-LLM / agent-harness / inference-runtime con un LPE del kernel Linux (Copy Fail o su sucesor) para obtener root de cadena completa en inferencia multi-inquilino, y al menos un aviso emitido por CSAI-CNA destacará explícitamente la cadena tooling-LLM + kernel como técnica nombrada dentro del Defense Impairment de ATT&CK v19.** ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr ya nombra las técnicas agénticas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agente malicioso); la ola Copy Fail del 1 mayo da a los atacantes un LPE Linux universal con uso confirmado en el mundo real contra proveedores de servicios cloud (según divulgación del Microsoft Security Blog); el precedente de SQLi-fuga-de-claves-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock de LiteLLM les da el vector de movimiento lateral. La autorización CNA del 29 abr de CSAI es el lado de emisión de divulgaciones; la ruta de menor resistencia para un informe de incidentes Q3 de una firma IR es una intrusión cloud multi-inquilino unida exactamente de esta forma. En lenguaje claro: Los hackers pueden encadenar un bug de tooling de IA con un bug del kernel Linux para tomar el control de servidores de IA compartidos. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:
description.fil: **Sa H2 2026 ang trio ng May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + ang unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay magpapakahulugan sa "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" bilang dominanteng attacker pattern — hindi bababa sa isang major IR firm ang maglalathala ng pampublikong post-mortem ng totoong intrusion na pinagsasama ang LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE sa Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail o ang successor nito) para sa full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, at hindi bababa sa isang CSAI-CNA-issued advisory ang explicitly mag-cha-carve out sa LLM-tooling + kernel chain bilang named technique sa loob ng Defense Impairment ng ATT&CK v19.** Pinangalanan na ng Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ang agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang May 1 Copy Fail wave ay nagbibigay sa attackers ng universal-Linux LPE na may confirmed in-the-wild use laban sa cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); ang LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent ang nagbibigay sa kanila ng lateral-movement vector. Ang Apr 29 CSAI CNA authorization ay ang disclosure-issuance side; ang pinakamadaling daan para sa Q3 incident report ng IR firm ay isang cloud-multi-tenant intrusion na pinagsama-sama nang ganito.

detail.summary_short: May 1 Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with cloud-provider in-the-wild use, layered onto the Apr 30 LiteLLM 26-hour SQLi-key-leak and unpatched SGLang RCE, plus ATT&CK v19's agentic technique names and CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization, set up at least one IR-firm public post-mortem and one CSAI CNA advisory naming the LLM-tooling + kernel chain by H2 2026.

summary_short_locales.en: May 1 Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with cloud-provider in-the-wild use, layered onto the Apr 30 LiteLLM 26-hour SQLi-key-leak and unpatched SGLang RCE, plus ATT&CK v19's agentic technique names and CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization, set up at least one IR-firm public post-mortem and one CSAI CNA advisory naming the LLM-tooling + kernel chain by H2 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: 5月1日のCopy Failのクラウドプロバイダー実環境利用付き汎用Linux LPEが、4月30日のLiteLLM 26時間SQLi-key-leakと未パッチのSGLang RCEに重なり、さらにATT&CK v19のエージェント関連テクニック命名とCSAIの4月29日CNA認可が加わって、2026年下半期までに少なくとも1つのIRファーム公開ポストモーテムと、LLMツーリング+カーネル連鎖を命名する1つのCSAI CNAアドバイザリーが整う。
summary_short_locales.es: El LPE Linux universal del Copy Fail del 1 mayo con uso confirmado en proveedores cloud en el mundo real, sumado a la SQLi-fuga-de-claves de 26 horas de LiteLLM del 30 abr y al RCE sin parchear de SGLang, más los nombres de técnicas agénticas de ATT&CK v19 y la autorización CNA del 29 abr de CSAI, montan al menos un post-mortem público de firma IR y un aviso CNA de CSAI nombrando la cadena tooling-LLM + kernel para el H2 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang universal-Linux LPE ng May 1 Copy Fail na may cloud-provider in-the-wild use, na nilagyan ng layer ng Apr 30 LiteLLM 26-hour SQLi-key-leak at unpatched SGLang RCE, kasama ng ATT&CK v19 agentic technique names at ng Apr 29 CNA authorization ng CSAI, ay nagse-set up ng hindi bababa sa isang IR-firm pampublikong post-mortem at isang CSAI CNA advisory na nagpapangalan sa LLM-tooling + kernel chain pagsapit ng H2 2026.

bridges.text: The Wednesday CVE-2026-46198 in Claude Code 3.0 marks a second consecutive CISA-KEV listing of an agentic-AI tool prompt-injection CVE, with Sysdig pegging the median credential-extraction window at 3 minutes 40 seconds and the Trail of Bits taxonomy at thirteen instances. The LLM-gateway leg is hardening, but no fresh Linux-kernel CVE pairing lands today.

text_locales.en: The Wednesday CVE-2026-46198 in Claude Code 3.0 marks a second consecutive CISA-KEV listing of an agentic-AI tool prompt-injection CVE, with Sysdig pegging the median credential-extraction window at 3 minutes 40 seconds and the Trail of Bits taxonomy at thirteen instances. The LLM-gateway leg is hardening, but no fresh Linux-kernel CVE pairing lands today.
text_locales.ja: 水曜日のClaude Code 3.0のCVE-2026-46198は、エージェント型AIツールのプロンプト・インジェクションCVEに対する2件連続のCISA-KEV掲載を記し、Sysdigはクレデンシャル抽出ウィンドウの中央値を3分40秒で固定し、Trail of Bits分類体系は13件のインスタンスに立つ。LLMゲートウェイの脚は堅牢化しているが、新鮮なLinuxカーネル CVEのペアリングは本日着地しない。
text_locales.es: El CVE-2026-46198 del miércoles en Claude Code 3.0 marca una segunda inclusión consecutiva en CISA-KEV de un CVE de inyección de prompts en herramientas de IA agéntica, con Sysdig fijando la ventana mediana de extracción de credenciales en 3 minutos 40 segundos y la taxonomía de Trail of Bits en trece instancias. La pierna de LLM-gateway se está endureciendo, pero ninguna combinación fresca de CVE de Linux-kernel aterriza hoy.
text_locales.fil: Ang Miyerkules CVE-2026-46198 sa Claude Code 3.0 ay nagmamarka ng ikalawang magkasunod na CISA-KEV listing ng isang agentic-AI tool prompt-injection CVE, kasama ang Sysdig na sumusukat sa median credential-extraction window sa 3 minuto 40 segundo at ang Trail of Bits taxonomy sa labintatlong instance. text_locales.fil: Isinusulong ng Lunes ang LLM-tooling supply-chain weaponization theme na inasahan ng prediction na ito: inilathala ang CISA federal-civilian operational directive na nagdadala ng eleven-CVE Trail of Bits agent-loader taxonomy, tumakbo ang n8n CVE scan sa T-minus-three sa deadline, at hawak ng MCP-server credential-extraction ang isang 5-minutong median — ngunit walang post-mortem na nag-chain ng isang LLM-tooling CVE sa isang Linux-kernel local-privilege-escalation.

bridges.text: The component surfaces stay live — the n8n CVE remediation taper continues toward the May 21 deadline and the MCP-server credential-extraction window holds at five minutes for a sixth day — but the weekend surfaces no IR-firm post-mortem chaining an LLM-tooling CVE with a Linux-kernel privilege escalation. The specific full-chain attack thesis is not directly evidenced.

text_locales.en: The component surfaces stay live — the n8n CVE remediation taper continues toward the May 21 deadline and the MCP-server credential-extraction window holds at five minutes for a sixth day — but the weekend surfaces no IR-firm post-mortem chaining an LLM-tooling CVE with a Linux-kernel privilege escalation. The specific full-chain attack thesis is not directly evidenced.
text_locales.ja: 構成要素のサーフェスは生きている——n8nのCVE是正のテーパーは5月21日の期限に向けて続き、MCPサーバーの認証情報抜き取りのウィンドウは6日連続で5分に維持されている——が、週末にはLLMツールのCVEをLinuxカーネルの権限昇格と連鎖させるIR企業の事後分析は浮上していない。その特定のフルチェーン攻撃のテーゼは直接的には証拠付けられていない。
text_locales.es: Las superficies componentes siguen vivas —la disminución de la remediación del CVE de n8n continúa hacia el plazo del 21 de mayo y la ventana de extracción de credenciales de servidor MCP se mantiene en cinco minutos por sexto día— pero el fin de semana no aflora ningún análisis post mortem de una firma de respuesta a incidentes que encadene un CVE de herramientas LLM con una escalada de privilegios del kernel de Linux. La tesis específica del ataque de cadena completa no está directamente evidenciada.
text_locales.fil: Nananatiling buhay ang mga component surface — patuloy ang n8n CVE remediation taper patungo sa May 21 deadline at hawak ang MCP-server credential-extraction window sa limang minuto sa ikaanim na araw — ngunit walang IR-firm post-mortem na nagkakadena ng isang LLM-tooling CVE sa isang Linux-kernel privilege escalation na lumitaw sa katapusan ng linggo. Hindi direktang napatunayan ang tiyak na full-chain attack thesis.

bridges.text: The n8n RCE landing arbitrary commands on the underlying host plus Flowise prompt-injection-driven RCE plus LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency confirm exactly the precondition the LLM-tooling-Linux-kernel chain prediction (May 2) names: LLM-tooling vulnerabilities now reliably reach host OS execution within hours of disclosure. The kernel-CVE half of the chain has not yet been demonstrated.

text_locales.en: The n8n RCE landing arbitrary commands on the underlying host plus Flowise prompt-injection-driven RCE plus LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency confirm exactly the precondition the LLM-tooling-Linux-kernel chain prediction (May 2) names: LLM-tooling vulnerabilities now reliably reach host OS execution within hours of disclosure. The kernel-CVE half of the chain has not yet been demonstrated.
text_locales.ja: 基盤ホストへ任意コマンドを着地させるn8n RCEに加え、FlowiseのプロンプトインジェクションRCE、LMDeployの12時間31分の悪用レイテンシは、LLMツーリング・Linuxカーネル・チェーン予測(5月2日)が指摘する前提条件を確認する: LLMツーリング脆弱性は現在、開示から数時間以内に確実にホストOS実行に到達する。チェーンのカーネルCVE側はまだ実証されていない。
text_locales.es: La RCE de n8n aterrizando comandos arbitrarios en el host subyacente más la RCE impulsada por prompt-injection de Flowise más la latencia de 12h-31m de LMDeploy confirman exactamente la condición previa que nombra la predicción de cadena CVE LLM-tooling + Linux-kernel (2 may): las vulnerabilidades de tooling LLM ahora alcanzan de forma fiable ejecución en SO host en horas tras la divulgación. La mitad kernel-CVE de la cadena aún no se ha demostrado.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n RCE na naglalanding ng arbitrary commands sa underlying host plus ang Flowise prompt-injection-driven RCE plus ang LMDeploy 12h-31m exploitation latency ay nagkukumpirma sa eksaktong precondition na pinapangalanan ng LLM-tooling-Linux-kernel chain prediction (Mayo 2): ang LLM-tooling vulnerabilities ay reliably na nakaka-reach ng host OS execution sa loob ng oras pagkatapos ng disclosure. Hindi pa na-demonstrate ang kernel-CVE half ng chain.

bridges.text: The Stellar Cyber survey treating SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain as the operative late-2026 threat class extends the LLM-tooling-layer leg of the predicted chain; the kernel leg stays quiet today.

text_locales.en: The Stellar Cyber survey treating SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain as the operative late-2026 threat class extends the LLM-tooling-layer leg of the predicted chain; the kernel leg stays quiet today.
text_locales.ja: Stellar Cyber調査がSGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agentサイレント流出チェーンを運用上の2026年後半脅威クラスとして扱うことが、予測されたチェーンのLLMツール層レッグを延長する; カーネル・レッグは本日も静かなままである。
text_locales.es: La encuesta de Stellar Cyber tratando SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + cadena de exfiltración silenciosa Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent como la clase de amenaza operativa de finales de 2026 extiende la pierna de capa de herramientas LLM de la cadena predicha; la pierna de kernel permanece silenciosa hoy.
text_locales.fil: Ang Stellar Cyber survey na nagtatrato sa SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + Microsoft Excel + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain bilang operative late-2026 threat class ay nagpapahaba sa LLM-tooling-layer leg ng predicted chain; ang kernel leg ay nananatiling tahimik ngayon.

bridges.text: Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers stacked on the still-unpatched SGLang and LiteLLM key-leak SQLi gives attackers a complete LLM-tooling-plus-kernel template. The chain the prediction names is now visible across the May 1-3 advisory window.

text_locales.en: Copy Fail's universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers stacked on the still-unpatched SGLang and LiteLLM key-leak SQLi gives attackers a complete LLM-tooling-plus-kernel template. The chain the prediction names is now visible across the May 1-3 advisory window.
text_locales.ja: Copy Failのユニバーサル-Linux LPEがクラウドサービスプロバイダに対する野生での使用が確認され、未だ未パッチのSGLangとLiteLLM鍵漏洩SQLiと積層して、攻撃者に完全なLLMツーリングプラスカーネルテンプレートを与える。予測が命名するチェーンは今や5月1-3日のアドバイザリーウィンドウを通じて可視化されている。
text_locales.es: El LPE Linux universal de Copy Fail con uso confirmado in-the-wild contra proveedores de servicio de nube apilado sobre el SGLang aún sin parchar y LiteLLM key-leak SQLi da a los atacantes una plantilla LLM-tooling-más-kernel completa. La cadena que la predicción nombra ahora es visible a través de la ventana de avisos del 1-3 de mayo.
text_locales.fil: Ang universal-Linux LPE ng Copy Fail na may kumpirmadong in-the-wild use laban sa cloud service providers na nakapatong sa nananatiling unpatched na SGLang at LiteLLM key-leak SQLi ay nagbibigay sa attackers ng kumpletong LLM-tooling-plus-kernel template. Ang chain na pinapangalanan ng prediction ay nakikita na ngayon sa kabuuan ng May 1-3 advisory window.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **By H2 2026 the May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + the Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + the unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 trio makes "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" the dominant attacker pattern — at least one major IR firm publishes a public post-mortem of a real intrusion that pairs an LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE with a Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail or its successor) for full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, and at least one CSAI-CNA-issued advisory explicitly carves out the LLM-tooling + kernel chain as a named technique within ATT&CK v19's Defense Impairment.** Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 already names the agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); the May 1 Copy Fail wave gives attackers a universal-Linux LPE with confirmed in-the-wild use against cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); the LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent gives them the lateral-movement vector. CSAI's Apr 29 CNA authorization is the disclosure-issuance side; the path of least resistance for an IR firm Q3 incident report is one cloud-multi-tenant intrusion stitched together this exact way. In plain language: Hackers can chain an AI-tooling bug with a Linux-kernel bug to take over shared AI servers. In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年下半期までに、5月1日のCopy Fail(CVE-2026-31431)BOD-22-01の14日期限 + 4月30日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208の26時間悪用ウィンドウ + 5月1日まで未パッチのSGLang CVE-2026-5760という3点セットが、「LLMツーリング層CVEのサプライチェーン武器化」を支配的な攻撃パターンにする — 少なくとも1つの大手IRファームが、LLMゲートウェイ/エージェントハーネス/推論ランタイムのCVEとLinuxカーネルLPE(Copy Failまたはその後継)を組み合わせて、マルチテナント推論基盤上でフルチェーンrootを取得した実際の侵入の公開ポストモーテムを発表する;少なくとも1つのCSAI-CNA発行のアドバイザリーが、ATT&CK v19のDefense Impairment内で、LLMツーリング+カーネル連鎖を名前付きテクニックとして明示的に切り出す。** 4月28日のATT&CK v19はすでにエージェント関連テクニック(コンテキストポイズニング、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェントデプロイ)を命名している;5月1日のCopy Failの波が、攻撃者にクラウドサービスプロバイダーへの実環境利用が確認された(Microsoft Security Blog開示による)汎用Linux LPEを与えた;LiteLLMのSQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keysの先例が、横展開ベクトルを与える。CSAIの4月29日CNA認可は開示発行側であり、IRファームのQ3インシデントレポートにとって最も抵抗の少ない経路は、まさにこの形で組み立てられた1件のクラウドマルチテナント侵入である。In plain language: ハッカーはAIツーリングのバグとLinuxカーネルのバグを連鎖させて、共有AIサーバーを乗っ取れる。In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para el H2 2026, el plazo de 14 días BOD-22-01 del Copy Fail del 1 mayo (CVE-2026-31431) + la ventana de explotación de 26 horas del LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 30 abr + el trío SGLang CVE-2026-5760 sin parchear hasta el 1 mayo convierte la "weaponización de la cadena de suministro de CVEs de la capa de tooling-LLM" en el patrón dominante de los atacantes — al menos una firma importante de respuesta a incidentes publicará un post-mortem público de una intrusión real que combine un CVE de gateway-LLM / agent-harness / inference-runtime con un LPE del kernel Linux (Copy Fail o su sucesor) para obtener root de cadena completa en inferencia multi-inquilino, y al menos un aviso emitido por CSAI-CNA destacará explícitamente la cadena tooling-LLM + kernel como técnica nombrada dentro del Defense Impairment de ATT&CK v19.** ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr ya nombra las técnicas agénticas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agente malicioso); la ola Copy Fail del 1 mayo da a los atacantes un LPE Linux universal con uso confirmado en el mundo real contra proveedores de servicios cloud (según divulgación del Microsoft Security Blog); el precedente de SQLi-fuga-de-claves-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock de LiteLLM les da el vector de movimiento lateral. La autorización CNA del 29 abr de CSAI es el lado de emisión de divulgaciones; la ruta de menor resistencia para un informe de incidentes Q3 de una firma IR es una intrusión cloud multi-inquilino unida exactamente de esta forma. En lenguaje claro: Los hackers pueden encadenar un bug de tooling de IA con un bug del kernel Linux para tomar el control de servidores de IA compartidos. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Sa H2 2026 ang trio ng May 1 Copy Fail (CVE-2026-31431) BOD-22-01 14-day deadline + Apr 30 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 26-hour exploitation window + ang unpatched-into-May-1 SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay magpapakahulugan sa "supply-chain weaponization of LLM-tooling-layer CVEs" bilang dominanteng attacker pattern — hindi bababa sa isang major IR firm ang maglalathala ng pampublikong post-mortem ng totoong intrusion na pinagsasama ang LLM-gateway / agent-harness / inference-runtime CVE sa Linux-kernel LPE (Copy Fail o ang successor nito) para sa full-chain root-on-multi-tenant-inference, at hindi bababa sa isang CSAI-CNA-issued advisory ang explicitly mag-cha-carve out sa LLM-tooling + kernel chain bilang named technique sa loob ng Defense Impairment ng ATT&CK v19.** Pinangalanan na ng Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ang agentic techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang May 1 Copy Fail wave ay nagbibigay sa attackers ng universal-Linux LPE na may confirmed in-the-wild use laban sa cloud service providers (per Microsoft Security Blog disclosure); ang LiteLLM SQLi-row-leaks-OpenAI/Anthropic/Bedrock-keys precedent ang nagbibigay sa kanila ng lateral-movement vector. Ang Apr 29 CSAI CNA authorization ay ang disclosure-issuance side; ang pinakamadaling daan para sa Q3 incident report ng IR firm ay isang cloud-multi-tenant intrusion na pinagsama-sama nang ganito.

nodes.description: **The May 1 Pentagon-snubs-Anthropic + 7-vendor classified-network AI deal becomes the first US presidential-administration vs frontier-AI-lab autonomous-weapons-use line in the sand — by Q3 2026 at least two other frontier labs (Mistral, OpenAI, xAI, Google DeepMind, Inflection-2026, Cohere) explicitly publish a use-of-force / autonomous-weapons carve-out in their public ToS or DoD bid responses; Anthropic's federal-judge-blocked Trump-admin freeze (April CA ruling) becomes the operative procurement-law precedent; Q3 earnings calls add an "autonomous-weapons exposure" disclosure line for the cohort.** Forcing function is litigation precedent: the federal-judge block already exists, so any future DoD freeze action against a competing lab now has a court-tested predicate. Trump's "deal is possible" framing on Apr 17 + the May 1 contract signings are the carrot-and-stick choreography; once a deal-or-no-deal binary becomes visible to the buyside, capital-allocation pressure will force every frontier-lab board to formally adopt either the Anthropic posture (carve-out, accept exclusion) or the OpenAI/Microsoft/Google posture (no carve-out, accept full DoD use). The middle position becomes untenable as soon as Q3 earnings cycle starts. In plain language: Anthropic's Pentagon snub forces every other AI lab to pick: take the contract or refuse it. description.en: **The May 1 Pentagon-snubs-Anthropic + 7-vendor classified-network AI deal becomes the first US presidential-administration vs frontier-AI-lab autonomous-weapons-use line in the sand — by Q3 2026 at least two other frontier labs (Mistral, OpenAI, xAI, Google DeepMind, Inflection-2026, Cohere) explicitly publish a use-of-force / autonomous-weapons carve-out in their public ToS or DoD bid responses; Anthropic's federal-judge-blocked Trump-admin freeze (April CA ruling) becomes the operative procurement-law precedent; Q3 earnings calls add an "autonomous-weapons exposure" disclosure line for the cohort.** Forcing function is litigation precedent: the federal-judge block already exists, so any future DoD freeze action against a competing lab now has a court-tested predicate. Trump's "deal is possible" framing on Apr 17 + the May 1 contract signings are the carrot-and-stick choreography; once a deal-or-no-deal binary becomes visible to the buyside, capital-allocation pressure will force every frontier-lab board to formally adopt either the Anthropic posture (carve-out, accept exclusion) or the OpenAI/Microsoft/Google posture (no carve-out, accept full DoD use). The middle position becomes untenable as soon as Q3 earnings cycle starts. In plain language: Anthropic's Pentagon snub forces every other AI lab to pick: take the contract or refuse it. In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **5月1日のペンタゴン-Anthropic排除 + 7ベンダー機密ネットワークAI契約が、米大統領政権 vs フロンティアAIラボの自律兵器使用の最初のレッドラインとなる — 2026年Q3までに、少なくとも他の2つのフロンティアラボ(Mistral、OpenAI、xAI、Google DeepMind、Inflection-2026、Cohere)が、武力使用 / 自律兵器カーブアウトを公開ToSまたはDoD入札応答で明示的に公開する;Anthropicの連邦判事ブロックされたTrump政権凍結(4月のCA判決)が運用調達法の判例となる;Q3決算コールがコホートに「自律兵器エクスポージャー」開示行を追加する。** 強制要因は訴訟先例:連邦判事のブロックがすでに存在するため、競合ラボに対する将来のDoD凍結措置には法廷で検証された予測が成立する。Trumpの4月17日「取引は可能」フレーミング + 5月1日の契約調印が飴と鞭の振付であり、取引可否のバイナリーがバイサイドに見えるようになると、資本配分圧力が、すべてのフロンティアラボの取締役会にAnthropic姿勢(カーブアウト、排除を受け入れる)またはOpenAI/Microsoft/Google姿勢(カーブアウトなし、完全なDoD利用を受け入れる)のいずれかを正式採用させる。Q3決算サイクルが始まると同時に中間ポジションは維持できなくなる。In plain language: AnthropicのペンタゴンスナブによってAIラボはどれも選択を迫られる:契約を取るか拒否するか。In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **El desaire del Pentágono a Anthropic + el acuerdo de IA de red clasificada con 7 proveedores del 1 mayo se convierte en la primera línea en la arena entre la administración presidencial estadounidense y un laboratorio de IA frontera sobre el uso de armas autónomas — para el Q3 2026 al menos dos otros laboratorios frontera (Mistral, OpenAI, xAI, Google DeepMind, Inflection-2026, Cohere) publicarán explícitamente una exclusión de uso de la fuerza / armas autónomas en sus ToS públicos o respuestas a licitaciones del DoD; la suspensión de la administración Trump bloqueada por un juez federal (decisión de abril en CA) se convierte en el precedente operativo de derecho de contratación; las llamadas de resultados del Q3 añadirán una línea de divulgación de "exposición a armas autónomas" para la cohorte.** La función forzante es el precedente jurídico: el bloqueo del juez federal ya existe, así que cualquier futura acción de suspensión del DoD contra un laboratorio competidor tiene ahora un predicado probado en tribunales. El encuadre de Trump del 17 abr de "un acuerdo es posible" + las firmas de contratos del 1 mayo son la coreografía del palo y la zanahoria; una vez que un binario acuerdo-o-no-acuerdo se vuelva visible para el lado comprador, la presión de asignación de capital obligará a cada consejo de laboratorio frontera a adoptar formalmente o la postura de Anthropic (exclusión, aceptar exclusión) o la postura de OpenAI/Microsoft/Google (sin exclusión, aceptar uso completo del DoD). La posición intermedia se vuelve insostenible en cuanto comience el ciclo de resultados Q3. En lenguaje claro: El desaire del Pentágono a Anthropic obliga a cada otro laboratorio de IA a elegir: tomar el contrato o rechazarlo. En lenguaje claro: En lenguaje claro:
description.fil: **Ang May 1 Pentagon-snubs-Anthropic + 7-vendor classified-network AI deal ay nagiging unang US presidential-administration vs frontier-AI-lab autonomous-weapons-use line in the sand — pagsapit ng Q3 2026 hindi bababa sa dalawa pang frontier labs (Mistral, OpenAI, xAI, Google DeepMind, Inflection-2026, Cohere) ay hayagang maglalathala ng use-of-force / autonomous-weapons carve-out sa kanilang public ToS o DoD bid responses; ang federal-judge-blocked Trump-admin freeze ng Anthropic (April CA ruling) ay nagiging operative procurement-law precedent; ang Q3 earnings calls ay magdadagdag ng "autonomous-weapons exposure" disclosure line para sa cohort.** Ang forcing function ay litigation precedent: nariyan na ang federal-judge block, kaya anumang future DoD freeze action laban sa kakumpitensyang lab ay mayroon nang court-tested predicate. Ang "deal is possible" framing ni Trump noong Apr 17 + ang May 1 contract signings ay ang carrot-and-stick choreography; sa sandaling maging visible sa buyside ang deal-or-no-deal binary, ang capital-allocation pressure ay pipilit sa bawat frontier-lab board na pormal na tanggapin ang Anthropic posture (carve-out, tanggapin ang exclusion) o ang OpenAI/Microsoft/Google posture (no carve-out, tanggapin ang full DoD use). Ang middle position ay nagiging untenable sa sandaling magsimula ang Q3 earnings cycle.

detail.summary_short: The Pentagon's May 1 7-vendor classified-network AI deals plus Anthropic's explicit exclusion as a supply-chain risk, layered onto an April California federal-judge block of the Trump-admin freeze, force at least two other frontier labs to publish autonomous-weapons carve-outs in their ToS or DoD bid responses by Q3 2026, with cohort earnings calls adding an exposure-disclosure line.

summary_short_locales.en: The Pentagon's May 1 7-vendor classified-network AI deals plus Anthropic's explicit exclusion as a supply-chain risk, layered onto an April California federal-judge block of the Trump-admin freeze, force at least two other frontier labs to publish autonomous-weapons carve-outs in their ToS or DoD bid responses by Q3 2026, with cohort earnings calls adding an exposure-disclosure line.
summary_short_locales.ja: ペンタゴンの5月1日の7ベンダー機密ネットワークAI契約とAnthropicの明示的なサプライチェーンリスク除外が、4月のCalifornia連邦判事によるTrump政権凍結ブロックに重なり、2026年Q3までに少なくとも他の2つのフロンティアラボがToSまたはDoD入札応答で自律兵器カーブアウトを公開せざるを得なくなり、コホート決算コールがエクスポージャー開示行を追加する。
summary_short_locales.es: Los 7 acuerdos de IA de red clasificada del Pentágono del 1 mayo más la exclusión explícita de Anthropic como riesgo de cadena de suministro, sumados a un bloqueo federal de un juez de California en abril a la suspensión de la administración Trump, fuerzan a al menos dos laboratorios frontera más a publicar exclusiones de armas autónomas en sus ToS o respuestas a licitaciones del DoD para el Q3 2026, con llamadas de resultados de la cohorte añadiendo una línea de divulgación de exposición.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang May 1 7-vendor classified-network AI deals ng Pentagon kasama ang explicit na exclusion sa Anthropic bilang supply-chain risk, na nilagyan ng layer ng April California federal-judge block ng Trump-admin freeze, ay pumipilit sa hindi bababa sa dalawa pang frontier labs na maglathala ng autonomous-weapons carve-outs sa kanilang ToS o DoD bid responses pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kasama ng cohort earnings calls na nagdaragdag ng exposure-disclosure line.

bridges.text: The Anthropic Project Glasswing vetted-partner routing on Mythos plus the AISI Expert-tier cyber benchmark passing the 20-hour-exploit ceiling demonstrate the consequence the autonomous-weapons-carve-out prediction (May 2) names: capability-conditional access carve-outs are now operationally road-tested in cyber and provide the contractual template a parallel weapons carve-out would extend.

text_locales.en: The Anthropic Project Glasswing vetted-partner routing on Mythos plus the AISI Expert-tier cyber benchmark passing the 20-hour-exploit ceiling demonstrate the consequence the autonomous-weapons-carve-out prediction (May 2) names: capability-conditional access carve-outs are now operationally road-tested in cyber and provide the contractual template a parallel weapons carve-out would extend.
text_locales.ja: MythosでのAnthropic Project Glasswing審査済みパートナー・ルーティングと、AISIエキスパート層サイバー・ベンチマークが20時間エクスプロイト天井を超えたことは、自律兵器カーブアウト予測(5月2日)が指摘する帰結を実証する: 能力条件付きアクセス・カーブアウトは現在、サイバーで運用上実走テストされており、並行的な兵器カーブアウトが拡張するであろう契約テンプレートを提供する。
text_locales.es: El ruteo de partners evaluados de Anthropic Project Glasswing sobre Mythos más el benchmark cyber tier-Experto de AISI superando el techo de explotación de 20 horas demuestran la consecuencia que nombra la predicción carve-out de armas autónomas (2 may): los carve-outs de acceso condicionados por capacidad están ahora probados operacionalmente en cyber y proporcionan la plantilla contractual que un carve-out paralelo de armas extendería.
text_locales.fil: Ang Anthropic Project Glasswing vetted-partner routing sa Mythos plus ang AISI Expert-tier cyber benchmark na lumalampas sa 20-hour-exploit ceiling ay nagpapakita ng consequence na pinapangalanan ng autonomous-weapons-carve-out prediction (Mayo 2): ang capability-conditional access carve-outs ay operationally tested na sa cyber at nagbibigay ng contractual template na mag-eextend ng parallel weapons carve-out.

bridges.text: Anthropic's May 4 JV announcement cementing ethical constraints around warfare and surveillance as the operative framing extends the precondition the prediction names: the carve-out posture is now visible as part of investor-relations communication, raising the cost of the middle position for competing labs.

text_locales.ja: 戦争と監視に関する倫理的制約を運用フレーミングとして固めるAnthropicの5月4日 JV発表は、予測が指摘する前提条件を延長する: カーブアウト姿勢は現在IRコミュニケーションの一部として目に見え、競合ラボにとっての中間的立場のコストを引き上げる。
text_locales.es: El anuncio de la JV del 4 de mayo de Anthropic cementando las restricciones éticas en torno a la guerra y vigilancia como el framing operativo extiende la precondición que la predicción nombra: la postura de exclusión es ahora visible como parte de la comunicación de relaciones con inversionistas, elevando el costo de la posición intermedia para laboratorios competidores.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 4 JV announcement ng Anthropic na nag-cement sa ethical constraints sa paligid ng warfare at surveillance bilang operative framing ay nagpapahaba sa precondition na pinangalanan ng prediction: ang carve-out posture ay nakikita na ngayon bilang bahagi ng investor-relations communication, na nagtataas sa gastos ng middle position para sa kalabang labs.

The middle position becomes untenable as soon as Q3 earnings cycle starts. In plain language: Anthropic's Pentagon snub forces every other AI lab to pick: take the contract or refuse it. description.en: **By Q3 2026 the Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync with AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK ~97M monthly downloads + the parallel Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack converges into a published draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) that formalizes the cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema as a standard interop layer.** Forcing function is enterprise procurement: once Microsoft ships the registry-sync primitive at $15/user/mo with M365 admin-surface integration, AWS + Google must either expose parallel surfaces or be absorbed into the Microsoft schema; CSAI's Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) provide the threat-side standardization pressure; the Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA already standardize the build/runtime layer so the missing piece is the interop-protocol layer the registry-sync proves works; expect Microsoft + AWS + Google to triangulate on a public draft RFC because vendor-specific schemas would lose the M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. In plain language: Microsoft just made AI agent IDs work across Microsoft, Amazon, and Google clouds — soon a public spec will lock that in. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **2026年Q3までに、Microsoft Agent 365の5月1日GAでのAWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platformとのレジストリ同期、Anthropic MCP SDKの月間~97Mダウンロード、並行する4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCoreスタックが、クラウド横断のエージェントID + MCPサーバーインベントリ + ツール呼び出しログスキーマを標準的な相互運用層として形式化する公開ドラフトRFC(IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation作業部会)へと収斂する。** 強制力はエンタープライズ調達である。Microsoftが$15/user/moでM365管理画面統合を伴うレジストリ同期プリミティブを出荷すれば、AWS + Googleは並行する画面を露出するか、Microsoftスキーマに吸収されるかを迫られる。CSAIの4月29日のMITRE-CNA権限 + ATT&CK v19の命名済み手法(MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント配備)が脅威側の標準化圧力を提供する。4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GAは既にビルド/ランタイム層を標準化しているため、欠けているのはレジストリ同期が機能することを証明している相互運用プロトコル層だけだ。Microsoft + AWS + Googleが公開ドラフトRFCで三角測量することが期待される。なぜならベンダー固有のスキーマではM365 + Bedrock + Vertexのインストールベース錨点優位を失うからだ。平易な言葉で言えば: MicrosoftがAIエージェントIDをMicrosoft、Amazon、Googleクラウド間で動作させた — まもなく公開仕様がそれを固定化する。
description.es: **Para Q3 2026, la GA del 1 de mayo de Microsoft Agent 365 con Registry Sync hacia AWS Bedrock + la Plataforma de Agentes Empresariales Gemini de Google Cloud Vertex + el SDK MCP de Anthropic con ~97M de descargas mensuales + la convergencia paralela del 30 de abril del OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore se traduce en un borrador de RFC publicado (grupo de trabajo de IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation) que formaliza el esquema de identidad de agentes multi-nube + inventario de servidores MCP + registro de invocaciones de herramientas como una capa estándar de interoperabilidad.** La función forzante es la contratación empresarial: una vez que Microsoft entrega la primitiva de registry-sync a $15/usuario/mes con integración en la superficie de administración de M365, AWS + Google deben exponer superficies paralelas o ser absorbidos en el esquema de Microsoft; la autoridad MITRE-CNA del 29 de abril de CSAI + las técnicas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 (compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue malicioso de agente) aportan la presión estandarizadora del lado de las amenazas; el OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA del 30 de abril ya estandarizan la capa de build/runtime, así que la pieza faltante es la capa de protocolo de interoperabilidad que el registry-sync demuestra que funciona; se espera que Microsoft + AWS + Google triangulen sobre un borrador público de RFC porque los esquemas vendor-específicos perderían la ventaja del ancla de base instalada de M365 + Bedrock + Vertex. En lenguaje sencillo: Microsoft acaba de hacer que los IDs de agentes de IA funcionen entre las nubes de Microsoft, Amazon y Google — pronto una especificación pública lo afianzará.
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang Microsoft Agent 365 May 1 GA Registry Sync sa AWS Bedrock + Google Cloud Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform + Anthropic MCP SDK na may ~97M monthly downloads + ang parallel na Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK / Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA / AWS Bedrock AgentCore stack ay magsasama-sama sa isang inilathalang draft RFC (IETF / OpenID Foundation / CSAI Foundation working group) na nagbibigay ng pormal na anyo sa cross-cloud agent-identity + MCP-server inventory + tool-invocation log schema bilang standard interop layer.** Ang forcing function ay enterprise procurement: kapag inilabas na ng Microsoft ang registry-sync primitive sa $15/user/mo na may M365 admin-surface integration, kailangang ilabas ng AWS + Google ang katumbas na surfaces o masisipsip sila sa Microsoft schema; ang Apr 29 MITRE-CNA authority ng CSAI + ATT&CK v19 named-techniques (MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment) ang nagbibigay ng threat-side standardization pressure; ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK + Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 GA ay nagsa-standardize na sa build/runtime layer kaya ang nawawalang piraso ay ang interop-protocol layer na pinatunayan ng registry-sync na gumagana; inaasahang magta-triangulate ang Microsoft + AWS + Google sa isang pampublikong draft RFC dahil ang vendor-specific schemas ay mawawalan ng M365 + Bedrock + Vertex installed-base anchor advantage. Sa madaling salita: pinagana lang ng Microsoft ang AI agent IDs sa kabuuan ng Microsoft, Amazon, at Google clouds — malapit nang lumabas ang isang public spec na maglo-lock niyan.
