description.ja: 2026年Q3までに、5月4日〜5日のニューヨーク・タイムズ報道—トランプ政権がテック幹部+政府職員からなる連邦ワーキンググループを設置し新規AIモデルのリリース前審査プロセスを設計する大統領令を検討中、Anthropic + Google + OpenAIに先週シニア政権職員がプランを説明、AnthropicのMythos cyberモデル(4月7日発表、テンス・オブ・サウザンズの未公開ゼロデイを発見、27年物のOpenBSDバグも含む)が直接の引き金、AnthropicのCEO Dario Amodeiがcyber「moment of danger」を公に警告、英NHSはすでに数百のオープンソースGitHubリポジトリの遮断を技術リーダーに5月期限で命令(Mythos露出を理由)、5月1日のAISI cyber evalがGPT-5.5 + Claude Mythosを32-step「The Last Ones」企業ネットワーク攻撃レンジに乗せた(各々10回中2-3回をエンドツーエンドで完走、AISI推定の20人時の攻撃チェーンに対して)—がそろって、ホワイトハウスをして、定義されたcyber-capability閾値を超えるフロンティアモデルに対する構造化されたリリース前審査プロセスを命名する大統領令を、H2 2026のGPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5リリース・コホートに先立ち発出させる。形状はワーキンググループ型大統領令+開示+任意テスト・プロトコルの足場(2025年5月〜2026年1月のNIST AISI相当姿勢を踏襲)が最も可能性が高く、FDA型の事前承認規制ではない;構造的力学は、Mythos Discord-leak事件と英NHSのGitHubロックダウンが、連邦リリース前審査の不在を政治的に切迫したギャップに変えたこと。Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.comフレームワークがEOが公式化するデファクト・テンプレート;OpenAI + Googleは新たなワーキンググループ報告ケイデンス下で唯一のホールドアウトを避けるため一申請サイクル以内にサインオン。
description.es: Para el Q3 2026 la cobertura del 4-5 de mayo del New York Times indica que la administración Trump está sopesando una orden ejecutiva que crearía un grupo de trabajo federal de ejecutivos tecnológicos + funcionarios gubernamentales para diseñar un proceso de revisión previa al lanzamiento de nuevos modelos de IA — Anthropic, Google y OpenAI fueron informados por altos funcionarios la semana pasada, con el modelo cyber Mythos de Anthropic (anunciado el 7 de abril, identificando decenas de miles de vulnerabilidades zero-day incluyendo un bug de 27 años en OpenBSD) citado como catalizador inmediato, el CEO de Anthropic Dario Amodei enmarcando públicamente un "moment of danger" cyber, el NHS del Reino Unido ya ordenando a líderes tecnológicos aislar cientos de repositorios open-source de GitHub con plazo en mayo citando exposición a Mythos, y la evaluación cyber AISI del 1 de mayo colocando a GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos en el rango de ataque corporativo de 32 pasos "The Last Ones" (cada uno completándolo end-to-end en 2-3 de 10 intentos contra una cadena de exploits estimada por AISI en 20 horas humanas) — fuerzan en conjunto a la Casa Blanca a emitir una orden ejecutiva nombrando un proceso estructurado de revisión previa al lanzamiento para modelos frontera por encima de un umbral cyber-capability definido antes de la cohorte de lanzamientos H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5. La forma más probable es una EO de grupo de trabajo con andamiaje de divulgación + protocolo voluntario de pruebas (reflejando la postura equivalente NIST AISI de mayo 2025 - enero 2026), no un régimen de aprobación previa al mercado tipo FDA; la fuerza estructural es que el incidente Discord-leak de Mythos y el cierre NHS GitHub han hecho la ausencia de revisión federal previa al lanzamiento la brecha políticamente operativa. Anthropic Project Glasswing + el marco AISI red.anthropic.com es la plantilla de facto que la EO formaliza; OpenAI + Google se suman dentro de un ciclo de presentación para evitar ser el único holdout bajo la nueva cadencia de reporte del grupo de trabajo.
description.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026, ang ulat ng New York Times noong May 4-5 na pinag-iisipan ng administrasyong Trump ang isang executive order na lumilikha ng federal working group ng tech executives + government officials para magdisenyo ng pre-release vetting process para sa mga bagong AI models — Anthropic, Google, at OpenAI ay binriefing ng senior administration officials nakaraang linggo, na may Anthropic Mythos cyber model (inanunsyo Apr 7, naghahanap ng tens of thousands ng zero-day vulnerabilities kabilang ang isang 27-year-old OpenBSD bug) na binanggit bilang immediate catalyst, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei na pampublikong nag-frame ng cyber "moment of danger," ang UK NHS na nag-utos na sa tech leaders na isara ang daan-daang open-source GitHub repositories na may May deadline na tumutukoy sa Mythos exposure, at ang May 1 AISI cyber eval na naglagay sa GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos sa 32-step "The Last Ones" corporate-network attack range (bawat isa ay nakapag-complete nito end-to-end sa 2-3 ng 10 attempts laban sa AISI-estimated 20 human hours) — magkakasamang pumipilit sa White House na maglabas ng executive order na nagngangalan ng structured pre-release vetting process para sa frontier models sa itaas ng defined cyber-capability threshold bago ang H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5 release cohort. Ang shape ay malamang isang working-group EO na may disclosure + voluntary-test-protocol scaffolding (sumasalamin sa May 2025 - Jan 2026 NIST AISI-equivalent posture), hindi isang mahirap na FDA-style pre-market approval regime; ang structural force ay ang Mythos Discord-leak incident at ang NHS GitHub lockdown ay ginawa ang kawalan ng federal pre-release review ang politically operative gap. Ang Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.com framework ay ang de-facto template na pino-formalize ng EO; OpenAI + Google ay sasanib sa loob ng isang filing cycle upang maiwasang maging nag-iisang hold-out sa ilalim ng bagong working-group reporting cadence.

Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.com framework is the de-facto template the EO formalises; OpenAI + Google sign on within one filing cycle to avoid being the lone hold-out under the new working-group reporting cadence.

text_locales.ja: 上院サイバー小委員会スタッフが財務省OCCIP追加により証人候補を8名で固定したことで、5月15日機密閾値ブリーフィングはエネルギー・サイバー・金融インフラを跨ぐ被覆を獲得した。FTCおよびGAOの共同意見書は16組織連合に加わり、AISI 120日配置枠と新たなGAO独立監査経路に焦点を絞り込んでいる。下院エネルギー・商業の並行30日技術レビュー枠が共同決議起草に入ったこと、ならびにOSTPの「5月22日以前は署名なし」のフロアが、構造的要件群の輪郭を形成している。
text_locales.es: El personal del Subcomité Cibernético del Senado cierra el listado de testigos en ocho con la incorporación del OCCIP del Tesoro, dando al briefing de umbral clasificado del 15 de mayo cobertura de energía más cibernética más infraestructura financiera; el amicus conjunto de la FTC más la GAO se une a la coalición de dieciséis organizaciones estrechando hacia la ventana de colocación de 120 días de AISI más una nueva vía de auditoría independiente de la GAO; la ventana paralela de revisión técnica de 30 días del Comité de Energía y Comercio de la Cámara en redacción de resolución conjunta más la línea de la OSTP de no firmar antes del 22 de mayo enmarcan el conjunto de requisitos estructurales.
text_locales.fil: Ini-lock ng Senate Cyber Subcommittee staff ang witness slate sa walo kasama ang Treasury OCCIP addition na nagbibigay sa Mayo 15 classified threshold briefing ng energy-plus-cyber-plus-financial-infrastructure coverage; ang FTC kasama ang GAO joint amicus ay sumasali sa labing-anim na organization coalition na nagpapaikli sa AISI 120-day placement window kasama ang bagong GAO independent-audit pathway; ang House Energy and Commerce parallel 30-day technical review window na nasa joint-resolution drafting kasama ang OSTP no-signing-before-May-22 floor ay bumubuo sa structural requirement set.

text_locales.ja: 水曜、5月15日のS-407機密扱い閾値ブリーフィングまで営業日3日のカウントダウンに入り、証人名簿は6人(FCC PSHSB局長を追加)で固まった。ブレナン司法センターとスタンフォードCISが14団体連合に加わる共同アミカスを提出し、State Farm判例の記録要件と60日DPA第708条を主張。下院エネルギー・商業委員会委員長は並列30日技術レビュー期間を要請した。
text_locales.es: El miércoles entra en T-menos-3 antes del briefing clasificado de umbral S-407 del 15 de mayo con la lista de testigos consolidándose a seis (Jefe de la Oficina PSHSB de la FCC añadido); Brennan Center más Stanford CIS presentan un amicus conjunto uniéndose a la coalición de catorce organizaciones que presiona por el registro State Farm más 60 días de DPA Sección 708; el Presidente del Comité de Energía y Comercio de la Cámara solicita una ventana paralela de revisión técnica de 30 días.

text_locales.ja: 月曜はFMRB大統領令省庁間レビュー・トラックを、CISAディレクターをNIST、ODNI、NSA、Microsoft MSTICと並んで含む先鋭化された5月15日S-407機密閾値ブリーフィング証人スレートで開始;8グループ・アミカス連合はACLUとCDTを追加し、State Farm理由付き決定記録論証プラス60日国防生産法第708条パブリック・コメント・ウィンドウを推進。
text_locales.es: El lunes abre el track de revisión interagencial de orden ejecutiva FMRB con el panel de testigos del briefing clasificado de umbral del 15 de mayo en S-407 afilado para incluir al director de CISA junto a NIST, ODNI, NSA y Microsoft MSTIC; una coalición amicus de ocho grupos añade ACLU y CDT presionando un argumento del registro de decisión razonada State Farm más una ventana de comentarios públicos de 60 días bajo Defense Production Act Section 708.
text_locales.fil: Bumubukas ang Monday ng FMRB executive-order interagency-review track kasama ang May 15 S-407 classified threshold briefing witness slate na hinasa upang isama ang CISA Director kasama ang NIST, ODNI, NSA, at Microsoft MSTIC; isang eight-group amicus coalition ang nagdaragdag sa ACLU at CDT na pinipresyon ang State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument plus isang 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window.

bridges.text: Lawfare's Sunday long-read frames the State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument as the dispositive litigation vector if the executive order ships on the Defense Production Act Section 708 vehicle without notice-and-comment; Just Security argues the May 7-8 EU/UK and Singapore/Japan reciprocity instruments establish a customary-practice baseline; OSTP holds the draft in interagency review, pushing the operative window to late-May or early-June while the Q3 2026 frame still holds.

text_locales.en: Lawfare's Sunday long-read frames the State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument as the dispositive litigation vector if the executive order ships on the Defense Production Act Section 708 vehicle without notice-and-comment; Just Security argues the May 7-8 EU/UK and Singapore/Japan reciprocity instruments establish a customary-practice baseline; OSTP holds the draft in interagency review, pushing the operative window to late-May or early-June while the Q3 2026 frame still holds.
text_locales.ja: Lawfareの日曜ロング・リードは、大統領令が告示・パブリック・コメントなしに国防生産法第708条ビークルで出荷される場合の決定的訴訟ベクターとしてState Farm理由付き決定記録論証をフレームする;Just SecurityはEU/UKおよびシンガポール/日本5月7-8日相互性文書が慣習慣行ベースラインを確立する、と論じる;OSTPはドラフトを省庁間レビューで維持、作動ウィンドウを5月下旬または6月上旬まで押し出し、Q3 2026フレームは依然保持される。
text_locales.es: El long-read dominical de Lawfare enmarca el argumento del registro de decisión razonada State Farm como el vector de litigación dispositivo si la orden ejecutiva se envía sobre el vehículo Defense Production Act Section 708 sin notice-and-comment; Just Security argumenta que los instrumentos de reciprocidad EU/UK y Singapore/Japan del 7-8 de mayo establecen una base de práctica consuetudinaria; OSTP mantiene el borrador en revisión interagencial, empujando la ventana operativa a finales-de-mayo o principios-de-junio mientras el marco Q3 2026 se mantiene.
text_locales.fil: Ino-frame ng Sunday long-read ng Lawfare ang State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument bilang dispositive litigation vector kung mag-ship ang executive order sa Defense Production Act Section 708 vehicle nang walang notice-and-comment; nag-aargumento ang Just Security na ang Mayo 7-8 EU/UK at Singapore/Japan reciprocity instruments ay nag-eestablish ng customary-practice baseline; hawak ng OSTP ang draft sa interagency review, na itinutulak ang operative window patungo sa late-May o early-June habang hawak pa rin ang Q3 2026 frame.

bridges.text: Knight Institute and EFF join the May 8 civil-society amicus stack demanding a 60-day comment window, while Senators Warner, Young, and now Rosen lock the May 15 classified FMRB threshold briefing with NIST, ODNI, and CISA JCDC attending. OSTP confirms no signing window before May 22 — the political-operativeness condition hardens and the Q3 landing window holds.

text_locales.en: Knight Institute and EFF join the May 8 civil-society amicus stack demanding a 60-day comment window, while Senators Warner, Young, and now Rosen lock the May 15 classified FMRB threshold briefing with NIST, ODNI, and CISA JCDC attending. OSTP confirms no signing window before May 22 — the political-operativeness condition hardens and the Q3 landing window holds.
text_locales.ja: Knight InstituteとEFFが5月8日の市民社会意見書スタックに合流し60日間のコメント期間を要求、Warner、Young、そして今やRosen上院議員が5月15日の機密FMRB閾値ブリーフィングをNIST、ODNI、CISA JCDC出席で固める。OSTPは5月22日以前の署名ウィンドウはないと確認 — 政治的作動性条件が硬化し、Q3着地ウィンドウは保持される。
text_locales.es: Knight Institute y EFF se unen a la pila amicus de la sociedad civil del 8 de mayo exigiendo una ventana de comentarios de 60 días, mientras que los senadores Warner, Young y ahora Rosen bloquean el briefing clasificado de umbral FMRB del 15 de mayo con NIST, ODNI y CISA JCDC asistiendo. OSTP confirma que no hay ventana de firma antes del 22 de mayo — la condición de operatividad política se endurece y la ventana de aterrizaje Q3 se mantiene.
text_locales.fil: Sumasama ang Knight Institute at EFF sa Mayo 8 civil-society amicus stack na humihingi ng 60-day comment window, habang sina Senators Warner, Young, at ngayon ay si Rosen ay nag-lock sa Mayo 15 classified FMRB threshold briefing kasama sina NIST, ODNI, at CISA JCDC. Kinukumpirma ng OSTP na walang signing window bago ang Mayo 22 — tumitigas ang political-operativeness condition at hawak ang Q3 landing window.

bridges.text: AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, and Lawyers for Civil Justice file an open APA-challenge letter to OSTP within 24 hours of the May 7 FMRB EO interagency draft, while Senators Warner and Young request a NIST/ODNI threshold briefing on May 15. The civil-society and Senate pressure layer operationalizes the political-operativeness condition the prediction names.

text_locales.en: AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, and Lawyers for Civil Justice file an open APA-challenge letter to OSTP within 24 hours of the May 7 FMRB EO interagency draft, while Senators Warner and Young request a NIST/ODNI threshold briefing on May 15. The civil-society and Senate pressure layer operationalizes the political-operativeness condition the prediction names.
text_locales.ja: AI Policy Institute、R Street、Public Knowledge、Lawyers for Civil Justiceは、5月7日のFMRB EO省庁間ドラフト回覧から24時間以内にOSTPへAPA異議申立て書簡を共同提出し、Warner議員とYoung議員は5月15日にNIST/ODNIによる閾値ブリーフィングを要請する。市民社会と上院による圧力レイヤーが、予測の挙げる政治的可動性条件を実装する。
text_locales.es: AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge y Lawyers for Civil Justice presentan una carta conjunta de impugnacion APA a la OSTP dentro de las 24 horas posteriores al borrador interagencial de la EO FMRB del 7 de mayo, mientras los senadores Warner y Young solicitan un briefing de umbral de NIST/ODNI para el 15 de mayo. La capa de presion de la sociedad civil y el Senado operacionaliza la condicion de operatividad politica que nombra la prediccion.
text_locales.fil: Ang AI Policy Institute, R Street, Public Knowledge, at Lawyers for Civil Justice ay naghain ng pinagsamang APA-challenge letter sa OSTP sa loob ng 24 oras matapos ang May 7 FMRB EO interagency draft, habang sina Senators Warner at Young ay humihiling ng NIST/ODNI threshold briefing sa May 15. Ang pressure layer ng civil society at Senate ay nag-ooperationalize sa political-operativeness condition na pinapangalanan ng prediction.

bridges.text: The May 6-7 interagency draft circulating to OSTP, NSC, NIST, and Commerce — naming the FMRB structure, the DPA §708 vehicle, and the AISI 32-step threshold — converts the EO trail named by the frontier-model pre-release vetting prediction (May 6) from rumor into operational draft. Trans-Atlantic reciprocity and UK CNI freeze define the landing shape.

text_locales.en: The May 6-7 interagency draft circulating to OSTP, NSC, NIST, and Commerce — naming the FMRB structure, the DPA §708 vehicle, and the AISI 32-step threshold — converts the EO trail named by the frontier-model pre-release vetting prediction (May 6) from rumor into operational draft. Trans-Atlantic reciprocity and UK CNI freeze define the landing shape.
text_locales.ja: 5月6-7日にOSTP、NSC、NIST、商務省へ回付された省庁間ドラフトは、FMRB構造、DPA §708ビークル、AISI 32ステップ閾値を明示し、フロンティアモデル事前リリース審査予測(5月6日)が示した大統領令の道筋を噂から運用ドラフトへ転換した。大西洋越え相互主義と英国CNI凍結が着地形状を規定する。
text_locales.es: El borrador interagencial del 6-7 de mayo que circula en OSTP, NSC, NIST y Commerce — que nombra la estructura FMRB, el vehículo DPA §708 y el umbral AISI de 32 pasos — convierte el rastro de la EO nombrado por la predicción de evaluación previa al lanzamiento de modelos frontier (6 de mayo) de rumor en borrador operativo. La reciprocidad transatlántica y el congelamiento de CNI del Reino Unido definen la forma de aterrizaje.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mayo 6-7 interagency draft na nagpa-circulate sa OSTP, NSC, NIST, at Commerce — na nagpapangalan sa FMRB structure, sa DPA §708 vehicle, at sa AISI 32-step threshold — ay nagko-convert sa EO trail na pinapangalanan ng frontier-model pre-release vetting prediction (Mayo 6) mula tsismis tungo sa operational draft. Tinutukoy ng trans-Atlantic reciprocity at UK CNI freeze ang landing shape.

needs.actor: Anthropic + OpenAI + Google DeepMind frontier-lab government-affairs leads coordinating the voluntary pre-release vetting pilot
needs.job: co-design a voluntary pre-release vetting pilot with the OSTP working group that maps the AISI 32-step attack-range methodology onto each lab's red-team pipeline and that publishes a summary metric (Expert-tier offensive-cyber score + Last-Ones-class attack-range pass rate) before each H2 2026 model release.
needs.outcome: Joint pilot framework signed by Anthropic + OpenAI + Google with a published summary-metric template, an embedded AISI-equivalent red-team protocol, and a release-cycle reporting cadence aligned to the EO working-group cadence.
needs.motivation: Voluntary co-design of the pilot framework lets the labs shape the threshold metric and reporting cadence; absent a co-designed pilot, the EO working group writes a metric the labs cannot easily satisfy and the release cycle gates on a federal-process bottleneck.

needs.actor: Senate Commerce + House Energy and Commerce committee staff drafting the legislative companion to the executive order
needs.job: draft a bipartisan AI-safety-disclosure bill that codifies the EO working-group framework, gives NIST AISI-equivalent statutory authority over the cyber-capability threshold, and pre-empts the patchwork of state-level AI-disclosure regimes (CA SB 1047 follow-on, NY SHIELD-AI, Texas AI Act drafts) that emerged after the Jan 2025 Trump-EO rescission.
needs.outcome: Bipartisan AI-safety-disclosure bill introduced in both chambers with NIST AISI-equivalent statutory authority, federal-pre-emption language for state-level AI-disclosure regimes, and a defined cyber-capability threshold tied to AISI benchmarks.
needs.motivation: An EO can be rescinded by the next administration; statutory codification + federal pre-emption gives the framework durability and gives the frontier labs a single national reporting target rather than a 50-state patchwork.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: By Q3 2026 the May 4-5 New York Times reporting that the Trump administration is weighing an executive order creating a federal working group of tech executives + government officials to design a pre-release vetting process for new AI models — Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI briefed by senior administration officials last week, with Anthropic's Mythos cyber model (announced Apr 7, finding tens of thousands of zero-day vulnerabilities including a 27-year-old OpenBSD bug) cited as the immediate catalyst, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei publicly framing a cyber "moment of danger," the UK NHS already ordering tech leaders to wall off hundreds of open-source GitHub repositories with a May deadline citing Mythos exposure, and the May 1 AISI cyber eval placing GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos on the 32-step "The Last Ones" corporate-network attack range (each completing it end-to-end in 2-3 of 10 attempts against an AISI-estimated 20 human hours) — together force the White House to issue an executive order naming a structured pre-release vetting process for frontier models above a defined cyber-capability threshold ahead of the H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5 release cohort. The shape is most likely a working-group EO with disclosure + voluntary-test-protocol scaffolding (mirroring the May 2025 - Jan 2026 NIST AISI-equivalent posture) rather than a hard FDA-style pre-market approval regime; the structural force is that the Mythos Discord-leak incident and the NHS GitHub lockdown have made the absence of a federal pre-release review the politically operative gap. Anthropic Project Glasswing + AISI red.anthropic.com framework is the de-facto template the EO formalises; OpenAI + Google sign on within one filing cycle to avoid being the lone hold-out under the new working-group reporting cadence.

prediction_summary_locales.es: Para el Q3 2026 la cobertura del 4-5 de mayo del New York Times indica que la administración Trump está sopesando una orden ejecutiva que crearía un grupo de trabajo federal de ejecutivos tecnológicos + funcionarios gubernamentales para diseñar un proceso de revisión previa al lanzamiento de nuevos modelos de IA — Anthropic, Google y OpenAI fueron informados por altos funcionarios la semana pasada, con el modelo cyber Mythos de Anthropic (anunciado el 7 de abril, identificando decenas de miles de vulnerabilidades zero-day incluyendo un bug de 27 años en OpenBSD) citado como catalizador inmediato, el CEO de Anthropic Dario Amodei enmarcando públicamente un "moment of danger" cyber, el NHS del Reino Unido ya ordenando a líderes tecnológicos aislar cientos de repositorios open-source de GitHub con plazo en mayo citando exposición a Mythos, y la evaluación cyber AISI del 1 de mayo colocando a GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos en el rango de ataque corporativo de 32 pasos "The Last Ones" (cada uno completándolo end-to-end en 2-3 de 10 intentos contra una cadena de exploits estimada por AISI en 20 horas humanas) — fuerzan en conjunto a la Casa Blanca a emitir una orden ejecutiva nombrando un proceso estructurado de revisión previa al lanzamiento para modelos frontera por encima de un umbral cyber-capability definido antes de la cohorte de lanzamientos H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5. La forma más probable es una EO de grupo de trabajo con andamiaje de divulgación + protocolo voluntario de pruebas (reflejando la postura equivalente NIST AISI de mayo 2025 - enero 2026), no un régimen de aprobación previa al mercado tipo FDA; la fuerza estructural es que el incidente Discord-leak de Mythos y el cierre NHS GitHub han hecho la ausencia de revisión federal previa al lanzamiento la brecha políticamente operativa. Anthropic Project Glasswing + el marco AISI red.anthropic.com es la plantilla de facto que la EO formaliza; OpenAI + Google se suman dentro de un ciclo de presentación para evitar ser el único holdout bajo la nueva cadencia de reporte del grupo de trabajo.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026, ang ulat ng New York Times noong May 4-5 na pinag-iisipan ng administrasyong Trump ang isang executive order na lumilikha ng federal working group ng tech executives + government officials para magdisenyo ng pre-release vetting process para sa mga bagong AI models — Anthropic, Google, at OpenAI ay binriefing ng senior administration officials nakaraang linggo, na may Anthropic Mythos cyber model (inanunsyo Apr 7, naghahanap ng tens of thousands ng zero-day vulnerabilities kabilang ang isang 27-year-old OpenBSD bug) na binanggit bilang immediate catalyst, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei na pampublikong nag-frame ng cyber "moment of danger," ang UK NHS na nag-utos na sa tech leaders na isara ang daan-daang open-source GitHub repositories na may May deadline na tumutukoy sa Mythos exposure, at ang May 1 AISI cyber eval na naglagay sa GPT-5.5 + Claude Mythos sa 32-step "The Last Ones" corporate-network attack range (bawat isa ay nakapag-complete nito end-to-end sa 2-3 ng 10 attempts laban sa AISI-estimated 20 human hours) — magkakasamang pumipilit sa White House na maglabas ng executive order na nagngangalan ng structured pre-release vetting process para sa frontier models sa itaas ng defined cyber-capability threshold bago ang H2 2026 GPT-5.5 / Mythos / Opus 5 release cohort. Ang shape ay malamang isang working-group EO na may disclosure + voluntary-test-protocol scaffolding (sumasalamin sa May 2025 - Jan 2026 NIST AISI-equivalent posture), hindi isang mahirap na FDA-style pre-market approval regime; ang structural force ay ang Mythos Discord-leak incident at ang NHS GitHub lockdown ay ginawa ang kawalan ng federal pre-release review ang politically operative gap. nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 4 Cerebras Systems IPO launch — 28M shares at $115-$125 each to raise ~$3.5B at a $26.6B market cap at the high end (vs Series H $23B Feb 2026), $510M trailing revenue, OpenAI partnership disclosed at >$10B multi-year warrant + loan structure (Dec 2025 OpenAI $1B loan secured by warrants for >33M shares), angel roster including Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — combined with the standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape, the OpenAI / Anthropic frontier-lab supply-contract precedent now publicly priceable on the open market, and the Fleet Data Centers $4.6B Storey County secured-notes offering as the parallel debt-issuance signal forces a second AI-accelerator IPO at >$10B valuation within the same calendar window — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched the most-likely candidate cohort, with Groq the leading first-mover given its prior funding-round signaling and inference-tier API revenue. The forcing function is that Cerebras's IPO surfaces a public-market comparable for AI-accelerator-startup equity for the first time — buyside coverage now has a direct multiple to anchor against, so a sibling priced inside the same cycle reads as continuation rather than first-mover risk premium. The Cerebras pricing window itself acts as a forward-guide for sibling underwriters (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) who can syndicate the next deal at parallel terms. Bear case is Cerebras pricing below midpoint and forcing the cohort to wait two quarters; absent that, Q4 2026 lands the second deal.

description.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月4日のCerebras Systems IPOローンチ—28M株を$115-$125で価格決定、$3.5Bを調達しハイエンドで$26.6B時価総額(2026年2月のシリーズH $23B 対比)、$510Mトレーリング売上、OpenAIパートナーシップを$10B超のマルチイヤー・ワラント+ローン構造で開示(2025年12月にOpenAIがCerebrasに$1Bを貸付、33M+株のワラント担保)、エンジェル・ロスターはSam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angeloを含む—が、$700Bの2026 Big-Tech AI-capexテープ、OpenAI / Anthropicフロンティア・ラボ供給契約の前例が公開市場で価格付け可能になったこと、Fleet Data Centersの$4.6B Storey County担保ノート発行が並行する債券発行シグナルとして組み合わさり、同じカレンダー・ウィンドウ内で2件目のAIアクセラレータIPOを$10B超評価で強制する—Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etchedが最有力候補コホート、その先行資金調達ラウンドのシグナリングとインフェレンス層APIレベニューを考えるとGroqが先行ファースト・ムーバー候補。フォーシング・ファンクションはCerebrasのIPOがAIアクセラレータ・スタートアップ・エクイティの公開市場コンパラブルを初めて可視化することで、バイサイド・カバレッジが直接アンカーすべき倍率を持つことになり、同じサイクル内で価格付けされる兄弟案件はファースト・ムーバー・リスクプレミアムではなく継続として読まれる。Cerebrasの価格付けウィンドウ自体が兄弟引受人(Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi)に対するフォワードガイドとなり、次案件をパラレル条件で組成可能にする。ベアケースはCerebrasがミッドポイント以下で価格付けされコホートを2四半期待たせること;それがなければ2026年Q4が2件目を着地させる。
description.es: Para Q4 2026 el lanzamiento del IPO de Cerebras Systems del 4 de mayo — 28M acciones a $115-$125 cada una para recaudar ~$3.5B a una capitalización de mercado de $26.6B en el extremo alto (vs Series H $23B feb 2026), $510M en ingresos trailing, asociación OpenAI revelada en estructura warrant + préstamo multi-año >$10B (dic 2025 OpenAI prestó $1B a Cerebras garantizado por warrants para >33M acciones), roster de inversionistas ángel incluyendo Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — combinado con la cinta standing de $700B en AI-capex 2026 Big-Tech, el precedente de contratos de suministro frontier-lab de OpenAI / Anthropic ahora cotizable públicamente, y la oferta de notas garantizadas de Fleet Data Centers de $4.6B en Storey County como señal paralela de emisión de deuda obliga a un segundo IPO de acelerador AI a valoración >$10B dentro de la misma ventana calendario — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched la cohorte candidata más probable, con Groq el first-mover líder dado su signaling previo de rondas y revenue de API de capa de inferencia. La forcing function es que el IPO de Cerebras revela un comparable público para equity de startups de aceleradores AI por primera vez — la cobertura buyside ahora tiene un múltiplo directo para anclar, así que un hermano fijado dentro del mismo ciclo se lee como continuación en lugar de prima de riesgo first-mover. La ventana de fijación de Cerebras misma actúa como guía forward para underwriters hermanos (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) que pueden sindicar la siguiente operación en términos paralelos. Caso bajista es Cerebras fijando bajo el midpoint y forzando a la cohorte a esperar dos trimestres; sin eso, Q4 2026 aterriza la segunda operación.
description.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026 ang May 4 Cerebras Systems IPO launch — 28M shares sa $115-$125 bawat isa upang makakalap ng ~$3.5B sa $26.6B market cap sa high end (vs Series H $23B Feb 2026), $510M trailing revenue, OpenAI partnership na inilantad sa >$10B multi-year warrant + loan structure (Dec 2025 OpenAI $1B loan na sineguro ng warrants para sa >33M shares), angel roster kabilang Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — kasama ng standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape, ang OpenAI / Anthropic frontier-lab supply-contract precedent na ngayon ay publicly priceable sa open market, at ang Fleet Data Centers $4.6B Storey County secured-notes offering bilang parallel debt-issuance signal ay pumipilit ng pangalawang AI-accelerator IPO sa >$10B valuation sa loob ng parehong calendar window — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched ang most-likely candidate cohort, na may Groq bilang nangungunang first-mover dahil sa kanyang prior funding-round signaling at inference-tier API revenue. Ang forcing function ay nilalantad ng Cerebras IPO ang isang public-market comparable para sa AI-accelerator-startup equity sa unang pagkakataon — buyside coverage ngayon ay may direct multiple para mag-anchor laban sa, kaya ang isang sibling na napresyo sa loob ng parehong cycle ay binabasa bilang continuation sa halip na first-mover risk premium. Ang Cerebras pricing window mismo ay kumikilos bilang forward-guide para sa sibling underwriters (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) na maaaring mag-syndicate ng susunod na deal sa parallel terms. Ang bear case ay ang Cerebras na mag-presyo sa ibaba ng midpoint at pumilit sa cohort na maghintay ng dalawang quarters; kung wala iyon, ipupunta ng Q4 2026 ang pangalawang deal.

plain_language.es: Cerebras acaba de poner precio público a startups de chips de IA, así que en meses un rival como Groq saldrá a bolsa por más de diez mil millones de dólares.
plain_language.fil: Naglagay lang ang Cerebras ng publikong presyo sa AI chip startups, kaya sa loob ng buwan, isang karibal tulad ng Groq ay magko-IPO sa higit sampung bilyong dolyar.

title_locales.en: AI-accelerator IPO cohort prices a second deal at >$10B by Q4 2026
title_locales.ja: AIアクセラレータIPOコホートが2026年Q4までに2件目を$10B超で価格決定
title_locales.es: Cohorte de IPO de aceleradores AI tasa una segunda operación a >$10B para Q4 2026
title_locales.fil: AI-accelerator IPO cohort ay magpe-presyo ng pangalawang deal na higit sa $10B bago ang Q4 2026

detail.summary_short: Cerebras' May 4 IPO launch at $26.6B with a disclosed >$10B OpenAI deal sets the first public-market comparable for AI-accelerator startups. By Q4 2026 a second AI-accelerator IPO is expected to price at >$10B valuation in the same window — Groq the most-likely first-mover candidate.

summary_short_locales.en: Cerebras' May 4 IPO launch at $26.6B with a disclosed >$10B OpenAI deal sets the first public-market comparable for AI-accelerator startups. By Q4 2026 a second AI-accelerator IPO is expected to price at >$10B valuation in the same window — Groq the most-likely first-mover candidate.
summary_short_locales.ja: Cerebrasの5月4日IPOローンチ($26.6Bで$10B超のOpenAI取引開示)がAIアクセラレータ・スタートアップ初の公開市場コンパラブルをセット。2026年Q4までに2件目のAIアクセラレータIPOが同じウィンドウ内で$10B超評価で価格付けされる見込み—Groqが最有力ファースト・ムーバー候補。
summary_short_locales.es: Lanzamiento IPO Cerebras 4 mayo a $26.6B con acuerdo OpenAI >$10B revelado establece primer comparable público para startups aceleradoras AI. Para Q4 2026 segundo IPO acelerador AI fijaría >$10B en misma ventana — Groq candidato first-mover más probable.
summary_short_locales.fil: Cerebras May 4 IPO launch sa $26.6B na may inilantad na >$10B OpenAI deal ay nagtakda ng unang public-market comparable para sa AI-accelerator startups. Bago ang Q4 2026 inaasahang mag-presyo ang pangalawang AI-accelerator IPO sa >$10B valuation sa parehong window — Groq ang most-likely first-mover candidate.

bridges.text: Cerebras CBRS prints a third consecutive consolidation day at $197.10 with institutional-buyside float share rising to 35 percent and Jefferies initiating Outperform at $225; Tenstorrent's first-round Corp Fin acknowledgement lands at the 10-business-day mark; SambaNova locks a six-bookrunner roster ahead of late-June submission; Groq's Saudi PIF contingent-secondary closure narrows into the 14-30 day window.

text_locales.en: Cerebras CBRS prints a third consecutive consolidation day at $197.10 with institutional-buyside float share rising to 35 percent and Jefferies initiating Outperform at $225; Tenstorrent's first-round Corp Fin acknowledgement lands at the 10-business-day mark; SambaNova locks a six-bookrunner roster ahead of late-June submission; Groq's Saudi PIF contingent-secondary closure narrows into the 14-30 day window.
text_locales.ja: Cerebras CBRSは3日連続のコンソリデーション・デイを終値197.10ドルで刻み、機関投資家ロングサイドの浮動株シェアは35パーセントへ上昇、JefferiesがOutperformを225ドルで新規開始;Tenstorrentの第1ラウンドCorp Fin受領通知は10営業日マークで着地;SambaNovaは6月下旬提出に先駆けて6ブックランナー・ロスターを確定;GroqのSaudi PIF条件付きセカンダリのクロージングは14-30日ウィンドウへ絞り込まれる。
text_locales.es: Cerebras CBRS imprime un tercer día consecutivo de consolidación en 197,10 dólares, con la participación del comprador institucional en el float subiendo al 35 por ciento y Jefferies iniciando cobertura en Outperform con 225 dólares; el acuse de recibo de la primera ronda de Corp Fin de Tenstorrent llega en el día 10 hábil; SambaNova fija una lista de seis bookrunners de cara a la presentación de finales de junio; el cierre del secondary contingente de Groq con el PIF saudí se estrecha al rango de 14-30 días.
text_locales.fil: Ang Cerebras CBRS ay nag-print ng pangatlong sunod na consolidation day sa $197.10 na may institutional-buyside float share na umaakyat sa 35 porsyento at sinimulan ng Jefferies ang Outperform sa $225; ang first-round Corp Fin acknowledgement ng Tenstorrent ay dumating sa 10-business-day mark; nag-lock ang SambaNova ng six-bookrunner roster bago ang late-June submission; pinapaikli ng contingent-secondary closure ng Groq sa Saudi PIF ang 14-30 day window.

bridges.text: Wednesday Cerebras CBRS extends Tuesday's gap-up with $195.40 open, $197.60 intraday high, $4.8B trailing-five-session turnover, and a 3.6x call-skew (widest since IPO debut); Morgan Stanley adds best-ideas-list inclusion at $192; SEC Corp Fin formally opens Tenstorrent's 30-60 day review window; SambaNova adds Barclays Capital as fifth joint lead with late-June submission target intact.

text_locales.en: Wednesday Cerebras CBRS extends Tuesday's gap-up with $195.40 open, $197.60 intraday high, $4.8B trailing-five-session turnover, and a 3.6x call-skew (widest since IPO debut); Morgan Stanley adds best-ideas-list inclusion at $192; SEC Corp Fin formally opens Tenstorrent's 30-60 day review window; SambaNova adds Barclays Capital as fifth joint lead with late-June submission target intact.
text_locales.ja: 水曜Cerebras CBRSは火曜のギャップアップを延長し、195.40ドル始値、日中高値197.60ドル、直近5営業日売買代金48億ドル、3.6倍のコールスキュー(IPOデビュー以来最大)を記録。Morgan Stanleyが目標値192ドルでベストアイデアリスト入りを表明し、SEC Corp FinがTenstorrentの30~60日レビューを正式開始、SambaNovaはBarclays Capitalを5番目のジョイントリードに追加し、6月下旬提出目標は維持されている。
text_locales.es: El miércoles Cerebras CBRS extiende el salto al alza del martes con apertura en 195,40 dólares, máximo intradía de 197,60 dólares, volumen acumulado de cinco sesiones de 4.800 millones de dólares y un sesgo de calls de 3,6x (el más amplio desde el debut del IPO); Morgan Stanley añade inclusión en lista de mejores ideas con objetivo de 192 dólares; SEC Corp Fin abre formalmente la ventana de revisión de 30-60 días de Tenstorrent; SambaNova añade Barclays Capital como quinto co-líder principal con el objetivo de presentación de finales de junio intacto.
text_locales.fil: Pinapalawak ng Miyerkules Cerebras CBRS ang Martes gap-up kasama ang $195.40 open, $197.60 intraday high, $4.8B trailing-five-session turnover, at 3.6x call-skew (pinakamalawak simula nang ma-IPO debut); nagdaragdag ang Morgan Stanley ng best-ideas-list inclusion sa $192; pormal na binubuksan ng SEC Corp Fin ang Tenstorrent 30-60 day review window; nagdaragdag ang SambaNova ng Barclays Capital bilang ikalimang joint lead kasama ang hindi nagbabagong late-June submission target.

text_locales.ja: 火曜Cerebras CBRSは$193.20寄り付き、$197.10ザラ場高値、$4.8B 5セッション・ロウリング売買代金、4.1倍コール・スキュー(IPOデビュー以来最も広い)で月曜のギャップアップを延長する;Morgan Stanleyは$192でベスト・アイデア・リスト組み込みを追加;SEC Corp FinはTenstorrentの30-60日レビュー・ウィンドウを正式に開く;SambaNovaは6月下旬提出ターゲット維持で5番目のジョイントリードとしてBarclays Capitalを追加する。
text_locales.es: El martes Cerebras CBRS extiende el gap-up del lunes con apertura $193.20, máximo intraday $197.10, turnover de cinco-sesiones-trailing de $4.8B, y un call-skew 4.1x (el más amplio desde el debut IPO); Morgan Stanley añade inclusión en lista de mejores ideas en $192; SEC Corp Fin abre formalmente la ventana de revisión de 30-60 días de Tenstorrent; SambaNova añade a Barclays Capital como quinto joint lead con el objetivo de submission de finales-de-junio intacto.
text_locales.fil: Ina-extend ng Tuesday Cerebras CBRS ang Monday's gap-up kasama ng $193.20 open, $197.10 intraday high, $4.8B trailing-five-session turnover, at isang 4.1x call-skew (pinakamalapad mula nang IPO debut); nagdaragdag ang Morgan Stanley ng best-ideas-list inclusion sa $192; pormal na binubuksan ng SEC Corp Fin ang 30-60 day review window ng Tenstorrent; idinaragdag ng SambaNova ang Barclays Capital bilang ikalimang joint lead kasama ng late-June submission target na buo.

bridges.text: Cerebras CBRS opens its second trading week at $189.40 (+9.5 percent from Friday) on a 3.8x call-skew, validating the Morgan Stanley $192 and Goldman $185 buyside marks; Tenstorrent files Monday's S-1 pre-submission cover note at a $3.4B bridge valuation; SambaNova holds the late-June confidential-submission target at the $7-9B fully-diluted range, hardening the second-deal comparable stack.

text_locales.en: Cerebras CBRS opens its second trading week at $189.40 (+9.5 percent from Friday) on a 3.8x call-skew, validating the Morgan Stanley $192 and Goldman $185 buyside marks; Tenstorrent files Monday's S-1 pre-submission cover note at a $3.4B bridge valuation; SambaNova holds the late-June confidential-submission target at the $7-9B fully-diluted range, hardening the second-deal comparable stack.
text_locales.ja: Cerebras CBRSは2週目取引を$189.40(金曜から+9.5パーセント)、3.8倍コール・スキューで開始し、Morgan Stanley $192とGoldman $185のバイサイド・マークを妥当化;Tenstorrentは月曜のS-1事前提出カバー・ノートを$3.4Bブリッジ・バリュエーションで提出;SambaNovaは$7-9B完全希薄化レンジで6月下旬機密提出ターゲットを維持し、2番目のディール・コンパラブル・スタックを硬化させる。
text_locales.es: Cerebras CBRS abre su segunda semana de trading en $189.40 (+9.5 por ciento desde el viernes) sobre un call-skew 3.8x, validando los marcadores buyside Morgan Stanley $192 y Goldman $185; Tenstorrent presenta la nota cover de pre-submission S-1 del lunes en una valoración de puente $3.4B; SambaNova mantiene el objetivo de submission confidencial de finales-de-junio en el rango completamente diluido de $7-9B, endureciendo la pila de comparables del segundo trato.
text_locales.fil: Bumubukas ang Cerebras CBRS ng ikalawang trading week sa $189.40 (+9.5 percent mula sa Friday) sa isang 3.8x call-skew, nagva-validate sa Morgan Stanley $192 at Goldman $185 buyside marks; naghahain ang Tenstorrent ng Monday S-1 pre-submission cover note sa $3.4B bridge valuation; hawak ng SambaNova ang late-June confidential-submission target sa $7-9B fully-diluted range, na nagpapatibay sa second-deal comparable stack.

bridges.text: The Sunday CBRS buyside note season (Morgan Stanley raises target to $192, Jefferies initiates Buy at $178, Goldman holds $185 with a $220 upside scenario) supplies the public-market reference the second deal must clear; Tenstorrent's syndicate plus $3.4B fully-closed bridge tracks toward an August confidential S-1, while SambaNova's $7-9B range sits below the $10B threshold but inside negotiation distance and Groq's Saudi-PIF secondary discussion surfaces the contingent capital structure.

text_locales.en: The Sunday CBRS buyside note season (Morgan Stanley raises target to $192, Jefferies initiates Buy at $178, Goldman holds $185 with a $220 upside scenario) supplies the public-market reference the second deal must clear; Tenstorrent's syndicate plus $3.4B fully-closed bridge tracks toward an August confidential S-1, while SambaNova's $7-9B range sits below the $10B threshold but inside negotiation distance and Groq's Saudi-PIF secondary discussion surfaces the contingent capital structure.
text_locales.ja: 日曜CBRSバイサイドノート・シーズン(Morgan Stanleyは目標を$192へ引き上げ、Jefferiesは$178でBuyを開始、Goldmanは$220アップサイド・シナリオ付きで$185を維持)は、第二ディールがクリアすべきパブリック・マーケット・リファレンスを供給する;Tenstorrentのシンジケート + $3.4B完全クローズ・ブリッジは8月機密S-1へ向け追跡、一方でSambaNovaの$7-9Bレンジは$10B閾値を下回るが交渉距離内、Groqのサウジ-PIF二次議論は条件付き資本構造を浮上させる。
text_locales.es: La temporada de notas buyside dominicales de CBRS (Morgan Stanley sube objetivo a $192, Jefferies inicia Buy a $178, Goldman mantiene $185 con un escenario al alza de $220) suministra la referencia de mercado público que el segundo trato debe superar; el sindicato de Tenstorrent más el puente completamente cerrado de $3.4B trackea hacia un S-1 confidencial en agosto, mientras el rango $7-9B de SambaNova se sitúa por debajo del umbral $10B pero dentro de distancia de negociación y la discusión de secundario Saudi-PIF de Groq emerge la estructura de capital contingente.
text_locales.fil: Nagbibigay ang Sunday CBRS buyside note season (nagtataas ang Morgan Stanley ng target sa $192, nag-iinitiate ang Jefferies ng Buy sa $178, hawak ng Goldman ang $185 na may $220 upside scenario) ng public-market reference na dapat laktawan ng pangalawang deal; sumusubaybay ang syndicate plus lubusang isinarang $3.4B bridge ng Tenstorrent patungo sa isang August confidential S-1, habang ang $7-9B range ng SambaNova ay nakaupo sa ibaba ng $10B threshold pero nasa loob ng negotiation distance at pinapaibabaw ng Groq's Saudi-PIF secondary discussion ang contingent capital structure.

bridges.text: Tenstorrent files a confidential JOBS Act EGC S-1 with public window opening early August, retaining Hyundai and Samsung Foundry as $3.4B bridge co-anchors and adding Bain Capital Ventures and Fidelity. SambaNova names J.P. Morgan and Citi alongside Goldman for a late-June S-1 at a $7-9B range; Groq trails 30-60 days. The continuation-play precondition hardens.

text_locales.en: Tenstorrent files a confidential JOBS Act EGC S-1 with public window opening early August, retaining Hyundai and Samsung Foundry as $3.4B bridge co-anchors and adding Bain Capital Ventures and Fidelity. SambaNova names J.P. Morgan and Citi alongside Goldman for a late-June S-1 at a $7-9B range; Groq trails 30-60 days. The continuation-play precondition hardens.
text_locales.ja: TenstorrentはJOBS Act EGC機密S-1を提出、公開ウィンドウは8月上旬オープン、HyundaiとSamsung Foundryを$3.4Bブリッジ・コ・アンカーとして保持しBain Capital VenturesとFidelityを追加。SambaNovaはGoldmanと並んでJ.P. MorganとCitiを6月下旬S-1で$7-9Bレンジに指名;Groqは30-60日遅れる。継続プレイの前提条件が硬化する。
text_locales.es: Tenstorrent presenta un S-1 EGC JOBS Act confidencial con ventana pública abriendo a principios de agosto, reteniendo a Hyundai y Samsung Foundry como co-anclas de un puente de $3.4B y añadiendo Bain Capital Ventures y Fidelity. SambaNova nombra a J.P. Morgan y Citi junto con Goldman para un S-1 a finales de junio en un rango $7-9B; Groq trailing 30-60 días. La precondición de continuation-play se endurece.
text_locales.fil: Naghain ang Tenstorrent ng confidential JOBS Act EGC S-1 na ang public window ay magbubukas sa unang bahagi ng August, pinananatili ang Hyundai at Samsung Foundry bilang $3.4B bridge co-anchors at idinaragdag ang Bain Capital Ventures at Fidelity. Pinapangalanan ng SambaNova ang J.P. Morgan at Citi kasama ang Goldman para sa late-June S-1 sa $7-9B range; nakatalikod ng 30-60 araw ang Groq. Tumitigas ang continuation-play precondition.

bridges.text: Cerebras's $31.4B first-day cap plus the $4.9B OpenAI warrant paper gain reset the public-market comparable, and Tenstorrent confirms a $3.4B IPO bridge with Hyundai and Samsung Foundry as co-anchors targeting a July S-1 while shipping the Wormhole Galaxy rack to CoreWeave, Lambda, Crusoe, and Hyundai Robotics. The continuation-play precondition the prediction names is now operative.

text_locales.en: Cerebras's $31.4B first-day cap plus the $4.9B OpenAI warrant paper gain reset the public-market comparable, and Tenstorrent confirms a $3.4B IPO bridge with Hyundai and Samsung Foundry as co-anchors targeting a July S-1 while shipping the Wormhole Galaxy rack to CoreWeave, Lambda, Crusoe, and Hyundai Robotics. The continuation-play precondition the prediction names is now operative.
text_locales.ja: Cerebrasの初日$314億時価総額に加え、$49億のOpenAI warrantの含み益が公開市場のコンパラブルをリセットし、Tenstorrentは現代自動車とSamsung Foundryをcoアンカーとする$34億IPOブリッジを確認、7月のS-1を目標としつつWormhole GalaxyラックをCoreWeave、Lambda、Crusoe、Hyundai Roboticsへ出荷する。予測の挙げる継続プレイ前提条件が稼働状態に入る。
text_locales.es: El market cap de primer dia de $31.4B de Cerebras mas la ganancia en papel de $4.9B del warrant de OpenAI reinician la comparable del public-market, y Tenstorrent confirma un IPO bridge de $3.4B con Hyundai y Samsung Foundry como co-anchors apuntando a una S-1 en julio mientras envia el rack Wormhole Galaxy a CoreWeave, Lambda, Crusoe y Hyundai Robotics. La precondicion de continuation-play que nombra la prediccion ahora esta operativa.
text_locales.fil: Ang $31.4B first-day cap ng Cerebras kasama ang $4.9B paper gain sa OpenAI warrant ay nagre-reset sa public-market comparable, at kinukumpirma ng Tenstorrent ang $3.4B IPO bridge kasama ang Hyundai at Samsung Foundry bilang co-anchors na nakatutok sa July S-1 habang ipinapadala ang Wormhole Galaxy rack sa CoreWeave, Lambda, Crusoe, at Hyundai Robotics. Ngayon ay aktibo na ang continuation-play precondition na pinapangalanan ng prediction.

bridges.text: Cerebras pricing +2.4% above range at ~$27.2B with full green-shoe sets a concrete public-market floor that the second-deal-greater-than-$10B prediction (May 6) requires; SambaNova ($5.1B last-priced) and Groq ($2.8B + Saudi-anchored vehicle) accelerating S-1 confidential submissions to 60-90 days plus Tenstorrent's >$3B IPO bridge round move the cohort from watching to executing.

text_locales.en: Cerebras pricing +2.4% above range at ~$27.2B with full green-shoe sets a concrete public-market floor that the second-deal-greater-than-$10B prediction (May 6) requires; SambaNova ($5.1B last-priced) and Groq ($2.8B + Saudi-anchored vehicle) accelerating S-1 confidential submissions to 60-90 days plus Tenstorrent's >$3B IPO bridge round move the cohort from watching to executing.
text_locales.ja: Cerebrasがレンジ上限+2.4%の約272億ドル、グリーンシュー満額で値付けされ、第二案件>100億ドル予測(5月6日)が要する具体的な公開市場のフロアを設定した。SambaNova(直近51億ドル)とGroq(28億ドル+サウジ系ビークル)はS-1秘密提出を60-90日に加速、TenstorrentのIPO前ブリッジ>30億ドルもコホートを観望から実行へと動かしている。
text_locales.es: El precio de Cerebras +2,4% por encima del rango a ~$27,2B con green-shoe completo establece un piso concreto en el mercado público que la predicción de un segundo acuerdo mayor a $10B (6 de mayo) requiere; SambaNova ($5,1B última valoración) y Groq ($2,8B + vehículo anclado por Arabia Saudí) acelerando presentaciones confidenciales S-1 a 60-90 días, más la ronda puente IPO de Tenstorrent >$3B, mueven la cohorte de observar a ejecutar.
text_locales.fil: Ang Cerebras pricing na +2.4% sa itaas ng range sa ~$27.2B kasama ang full green-shoe ay nagtatakda ng konkretong public-market floor na kinakailangan ng second-deal-greater-than-$10B prediction (Mayo 6); ang SambaNova ($5.1B last-priced) at Groq ($2.8B + Saudi-anchored vehicle) na nagpapabilis ng S-1 confidential submissions sa 60-90 araw kasama ang >$3B IPO bridge round ng Tenstorrent ay naglilipat sa cohort mula sa pagmamasid tungo sa ehekusyon.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 4 Cerebras Systems IPO launch — 28M shares at $115-$125 each to raise ~$3.5B at a $26.6B market cap at the high end (vs Series H $23B Feb 2026), $510M trailing revenue, OpenAI partnership disclosed at >$10B multi-year warrant + loan structure (Dec 2025 OpenAI $1B loan secured by warrants for >33M shares), angel roster including Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo — combined with the standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape, the OpenAI / Anthropic frontier-lab supply-contract precedent now publicly priceable on the open market, and the Fleet Data Centers $4.6B Storey County secured-notes offering as the parallel debt-issuance signal forces a second AI-accelerator IPO at >$10B valuation within the same calendar window — Groq + SambaNova + Tenstorrent + Rebellions + Etched the most-likely candidate cohort, with Groq the leading first-mover given its prior funding-round signaling and inference-tier API revenue. The forcing function is that Cerebras's IPO surfaces a public-market comparable for AI-accelerator-startup equity for the first time — buyside coverage now has a direct multiple to anchor against, so a sibling priced inside the same cycle reads as continuation rather than first-mover risk premium. The Cerebras pricing window itself acts as a forward-guide for sibling underwriters (Goldman / Morgan Stanley / Citi) who can syndicate the next deal at parallel terms. Bear case is Cerebras pricing below midpoint and forcing the cohort to wait two quarters; absent that, Q4 2026 lands the second deal.

nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the cluster of LLM-workflow-platform CVEs landing in the same window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE via webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare by Cyera Research Labs, patched in 1.121.0, with Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security advisories), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE where a chatflow user coaxes the LLM into emitting attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (first exploited within 12 hours 31 minutes of disclosure per Sysdig honeypot fleet), the Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in March 2026 directly attributable to AI coding tools (with researchers estimating 5-10x undercount across the open-source ecosystem) — combined with the standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline forces CISA to publish a dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms by category and prescribing webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. The forcing function is that the Ni8mare CVSS-10 score on a no-code AI-workflow harness widely deployed in Tier-2 enterprises makes the existing CISA AI guidance (which targeted model providers and large-deployment-tier buyers) too narrow for the operational reality. The guide is most likely a CISA Cybersecurity Advisory or Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts co-sign within one cycle (the AL26-001 joint pattern from CCCS / ASD on n8n is the dispatch-shape precedent).

summary.es: Para Q3 2026 el cluster de CVEs de plataformas LLM-workflow aterrizando en la misma ventana — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 RCE no autenticado vía confusión content-type en webhook, codenombrado Ni8mare por Cyera Research Labs, parchado en 1.121.0, con avisos de Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (RCE driven por inyección de prompt donde un usuario chatflow induce al LLM a emitir Python controlado por atacante), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (primero explotado dentro de 12 horas 31 minutos de divulgación per flota honeypot Sysdig), el conteo Vibe Security Radar de Georgia Tech de 35 CVEs en marzo 2026 directamente atribuibles a herramientas AI coding (con investigadores estimando subconteo 5-10x a través del ecosistema open-source) — combinado con el parche standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + la baseline de ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet (~mitad sin autenticación) fuerza a CISA a publicar una guía dedicada de despliegue seguro de plataformas de workflow agentic-AI nombrando plataformas clase n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify por categoría y prescribiendo familias de control de validación content-type webhook + least-privilege consciente de inyección de prompts + audit-trail MCP-tool-call. La forcing function es que la puntuación CVSS-10 Ni8mare en un harness no-code de workflow AI ampliamente desplegado en empresas Tier-2 hace la guía CISA AI existente (que apuntaba a model providers y compradores de gran despliegue) demasiado estrecha para la realidad operacional. La guía es muy probablemente un Cybersecurity Advisory CISA o suplemento Secure-by-Design; FBI + NSA + contrapartes internacionales Five Eyes co-firman dentro de un ciclo (el patrón conjunto AL26-001 de CCCS / ASD en n8n es el precedente de forma de despacho).
summary.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026 ang cluster ng LLM-workflow-platform CVEs na lumalapag sa parehong window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE sa pamamagitan ng webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare ng Cyera Research Labs, na-patch sa 1.121.0, na may mga advisories mula sa Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE kung saan ang isang chatflow user ay umaakit sa LLM na maglabas ng attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (unang na-exploit sa loob ng 12 hours 31 minutes ng disclosure ayon sa Sysdig honeypot fleet), ang Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count na 35 CVEs noong March 2026 na direkta na maiuugnay sa AI coding tools (na may researchers na nag-eestima ng undercount na 5-10x sa buong open-source ecosystem) — kasama ng standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + ang ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline ay pumipilit sa CISA na maglabas ng dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide na nagngangalan ng n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms ayon sa kategorya at nagre-prescribe ng webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. Ang forcing function ay ang Ni8mare CVSS-10 score sa isang no-code AI-workflow harness na malawakang na-deploy sa Tier-2 enterprises ay ginagawa ang umiiral na CISA AI guidance (na nagta-target ng model providers at large-deployment-tier buyers) na masyadong makitid para sa operational reality. Ang guide ay malamang isang CISA Cybersecurity Advisory o Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts ay co-sign sa loob ng isang cycle (ang AL26-001 joint pattern mula CCCS / ASD sa n8n ay ang dispatch-shape precedent).

bridges.text: The CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft incorporating the ten-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy clears interagency review and enters the OMB publication queue; the KEV refresh tightens the May 21 deadline to T-minus-7; a four-vendor nine-framework C2 attribution baseline plus the Mistral matrix-tier interop deliverable assemble the reference-architecture inputs for a CISA secure-deployment artifact.

text_locales.en: The CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft incorporating the ten-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy clears interagency review and enters the OMB publication queue; the KEV refresh tightens the May 21 deadline to T-minus-7; a four-vendor nine-framework C2 attribution baseline plus the Mistral matrix-tier interop deliverable assemble the reference-architecture inputs for a CISA secure-deployment artifact.

text_locales.fil: Ang CISA federal-civilian operational-directive working draft na nag-iinkorporeyt sa sampung-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy ay nakapasa sa interagency review at pumasok sa OMB publication queue; pinahihigpit ng KEV refresh ang Mayo 21 deadline patungong T-minus-7; ang four-vendor nine-framework C2 attribution baseline kasama ang Mistral matrix-tier interop deliverable ay bumubuo sa reference-architecture inputs para sa CISA secure-deployment artifact.

text_locales.es: El domingo compone la ola de CVE de plataforma agéntica que ancla la predicción: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 deserialización de checkpoint) y Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 SSRF de plugin-manifest) extienden el stack de agente Microsoft; Trail of Bits nombra un patrón compartido de exposición checkpoint-y-manifest-loader; el día diez de Shadowserver baja n8n expuesto a ~5,700; CISA refresca KEV antes de la fecha límite del 21 de mayo.
text_locales.fil: Nagdadagdag ang Linggo sa agentic-platform CVE wave na nag-aanchor sa prediksyon: pinapalawig ng AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9 checkpoint deserialization) at Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4 plugin-manifest SSRF) ang Microsoft agent stack; pinapangalanan ng Trail of Bits ang shared checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; bumababa ang Shadowserver day-ten exposed n8n sa ~5,700; nire-refresh ng CISA ang KEV bago ang Mayo 21 deadline.

bridges.text: Shadowserver day-nine n8n exposed instances drop to ~6,800 (44% unpatched) ahead of the CISA May 21 federal-civilian deadline; NHS England's five-CVE blocklist now functions as the de-facto allied reference, and Sysdig's 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction puts a measurable cost on absent secure-deployment guidance — the exact predicate set a CISA guide would consolidate.

text_locales.en: Shadowserver day-nine n8n exposed instances drop to ~6,800 (44% unpatched) ahead of the CISA May 21 federal-civilian deadline; NHS England's five-CVE blocklist now functions as the de-facto allied reference, and Sysdig's 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction puts a measurable cost on absent secure-deployment guidance — the exact predicate set a CISA guide would consolidate.
text_locales.ja: Shadowserverの9日目n8n曝露インスタンスはCISAの5月21日連邦民間期限に先立ち~6,800まで低下(44%未パッチ);NHS Englandの5-CVEブロックリストは今や事実上の同盟参照として機能し、Sysdigの19分中央認証情報抽出時間は安全デプロイメント・ガイダンス不在に測定可能なコストを置く — CISAガイドが統合する正にプレディケート・セット。
text_locales.es: Las instancias n8n expuestas del día nueve de Shadowserver caen a ~6,800 (44% sin parchar) antes de la fecha límite federal-civil del 21 de mayo de CISA; la blocklist de cinco CVE de NHS England ahora funciona como la referencia aliada de facto, y el tiempo mediano de 19 minutos a extracción de credenciales de Sysdig pone un costo medible sobre la guía ausente de despliegue seguro — el set predicado exacto que una guía de CISA consolidaría.
text_locales.fil: Bumababa ang day-nine n8n exposed instances ng Shadowserver sa ~6,800 (44% unpatched) bago ang CISA Mayo 21 federal-civilian deadline; gumagana na ngayon ang five-CVE blocklist ng NHS England bilang de-facto allied reference, at inilalagay ng 19-minute median time-to-credential-extraction ng Sysdig ang measurable cost sa absent secure-deployment guidance — ang eksaktong predicate set na ico-consolidate ng CISA guide.

bridges.text: Day-eight n8n KEV scans drop exposed pre-1.121.0 instances 41.5% with a 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike on REST webhooks, while CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivoting to AWS metadata) land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM. NHS England names Ni8mare on its agentic-AI workflow blocklist, hardening the no-code harness forcing function.

text_locales.en: Day-eight n8n KEV scans drop exposed pre-1.121.0 instances 41.5% with a 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike on REST webhooks, while CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivoting to AWS metadata) land 24 hours after LangGraph plus LiteLLM. NHS England names Ni8mare on its agentic-AI workflow blocklist, hardening the no-code harness forcing function.
text_locales.ja: 8日目のn8n KEVスキャンは、公開済みpre-1.121.0インスタンスを41.5%減少させ、REST webhookで4.8倍の悪用試行スパイクを記録する。CrewAI CVE-2026-44352(CVSS 8.7のデシリアライゼーションRCE)とHaystack CVE-2026-44391(CVSS 9.4のpath-traversalでAWSメタデータへピボット)は、LangGraphとLiteLLMの24時間後に着地する。NHS EnglandはNi8mareをそのagentic-AIワークフローブロックリストに名指しし、ノーコードハーネスのforcing functionを硬化させる。
text_locales.es: Los escaneos del dia ocho de la KEV de n8n reducen las instancias pre-1.121.0 expuestas en 41.5% con un spike de 4.8x en intentos de explotacion en REST webhooks, mientras que CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserializacion RCE) y Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal pivotando a AWS metadata) aterrizan 24 horas despues de LangGraph mas LiteLLM. NHS England nombra a Ni8mare en su blocklist de workflow agentic-AI, endureciendo el forcing function del no-code harness.
text_locales.fil: Ibinaba ng day-eight n8n KEV scans ang exposed pre-1.121.0 instances ng 41.5% na may 4.8x exploitation-attempt spike sa REST webhooks, habang ang CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7 deserialization RCE) at Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4 path-traversal na pumapivot sa AWS metadata) ay lumalapag 24 oras matapos ang LangGraph plus LiteLLM. Pinapangalanan ng NHS England si Ni8mare sa kanilang agentic-AI workflow blocklist, pinatitigas ang no-code harness forcing function.

bridges.text: The n8n KEV addition with a May 21 federal deadline (first agentic-workflow CVE in the catalog), concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass with sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances 62% unpatched, and Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA crystallize exactly the operational case the CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (May 6) names — multi-vendor weekly cadence has displaced monthly.

text_locales.en: The n8n KEV addition with a May 21 federal deadline (first agentic-workflow CVE in the catalog), concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass with sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances 62% unpatched, and Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA crystallize exactly the operational case the CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (May 6) names — multi-vendor weekly cadence has displaced monthly.
text_locales.ja: n8nのKEV追加(カタログ初のエージェント型ワークフローCVE、5月21日連邦期限)、同時並行のLangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM認証バイパスで18時間未満のエクスプロイト発生、インターネット露出インスタンス約14,200(62%未パッチ)、Microsoft Defender MCPサーバー検出GAが、CISAセキュア配備ガイド予測(5月6日)が指す運用面の根拠を結晶化させた──マルチベンダー週次ケイデンスが月次を置き換えた。
text_locales.es: La adición de n8n al KEV con plazo federal del 21 de mayo (primer CVE de flujo de trabajo agéntico en el catálogo), el SSRF concurrente de LangGraph + bypass de autenticación de LiteLLM con explotación en menos de 18 horas, ~14.200 instancias expuestas a internet con 62% sin parchar, y la GA de detección de servidor MCP de Microsoft Defender cristalizan exactamente el caso operativo que la predicción de la guía de despliegue seguro de CISA (6 de mayo) nombra — la cadencia semanal multi-proveedor ha desplazado a la mensual.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n KEV addition na may Mayo 21 federal deadline (unang agentic-workflow CVE sa catalog), ang concurrent LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass na may sub-18-hour exploitation, ~14,200 internet-exposed instances na 62% unpatched, at ang Microsoft Defender MCP-server detection GA ay nagsa-crystallize ng eksaktong operational case na pinapangalanan ng CISA secure-deployment guide prediction (Mayo 6) — pinalitan na ng multi-vendor weekly cadence ang monthly.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: By Q3 2026 the cluster of LLM-workflow-platform CVEs landing in the same window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE via webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare by Cyera Research Labs, patched in 1.121.0, with Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security advisories), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE where a chatflow user coaxes the LLM into emitting attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (first exploited within 12 hours 31 minutes of disclosure per Sysdig honeypot fleet), the Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in March 2026 directly attributable to AI coding tools (with researchers estimating 5-10x undercount across the open-source ecosystem) — combined with the standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + the ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline forces CISA to publish a dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide naming n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms by category and prescribing webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. The forcing function is that the Ni8mare CVSS-10 score on a no-code AI-workflow harness widely deployed in Tier-2 enterprises makes the existing CISA AI guidance (which targeted model providers and large-deployment-tier buyers) too narrow for the operational reality. The guide is most likely a CISA Cybersecurity Advisory or Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts co-sign within one cycle (the AL26-001 joint pattern from CCCS / ASD on n8n is the dispatch-shape precedent).

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年Q3までに、同じウィンドウ内で着地したLLMワークフロー・プラットフォームCVEのクラスター—n8n CVE-2026-21858(CVSS 10.0、ウェブフックcontent-type混乱経由の未認証RCE、Cyera Research Labsが「Ni8mare」と命名、1.121.0でパッチ、カナダ・サイバーセキュリティセンター + 豪ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security全てがアドバイザリーを公表)、Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264(プロンプト・インジェクション駆動のRCEで、チャットフロー・ユーザーがLLMに攻撃者制御Pythonを発出させる)、LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF(Sysdigハニーポット艦隊で開示後12時間31分以内に最初のエクスプロイト試行)、Georgia Techの Vibe Security Radar count of 35 CVEs in 2026年3月にAIコーディング・ツール直接起因(オープンソース・エコシステム全体で5-10倍の真の数のアンダーカウントと研究者推定)—がSGLang CVE-2026-5760パッチと~7,000のインターネット露出MCPサーバー(約半数が未認証)のベースラインと組み合わさり、CISAをして、n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Difyクラス・プラットフォームをカテゴリーで命名し、ウェブフックcontent-type検証 + プロンプト・インジェクション認識最小権限 + MCP-tool-call audit-trailコントロール・ファミリーを規定する専用エージェンティックAIワークフロー・プラットフォーム・セキュア展開ガイドを発出させる。フォーシング・ファンクションは、Tier-2エンタープライズで広く展開されているノーコードAIワークフロー・ハーネスでのNi8mare CVSS-10スコアが、既存のCISA AIガイダンス(モデル・プロバイダーと大規模展開層バイヤーをターゲット)を運用上の現実に対して狭すぎるものにすること。ガイドはCISA Cybersecurity AdvisoryまたはSecure-by-Design補足が最も可能性高い;FBI + NSA + 国際Five Eyesカウンターパートがn8nに関するCCCS / ASDのAL26-001ジョイント・パターンをディスパッチ形状の前例として、一サイクル以内に共同署名する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q3 2026 el cluster de CVEs de plataformas LLM-workflow aterrizando en la misma ventana — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 RCE no autenticado vía confusión content-type en webhook, codenombrado Ni8mare por Cyera Research Labs, parchado en 1.121.0, con avisos de Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (RCE driven por inyección de prompt donde un usuario chatflow induce al LLM a emitir Python controlado por atacante), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (primero explotado dentro de 12 horas 31 minutos de divulgación per flota honeypot Sysdig), el conteo Vibe Security Radar de Georgia Tech de 35 CVEs en marzo 2026 directamente atribuibles a herramientas AI coding (con investigadores estimando subconteo 5-10x a través del ecosistema open-source) — combinado con el parche standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 + la baseline de ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet (~mitad sin autenticación) fuerza a CISA a publicar una guía dedicada de despliegue seguro de plataformas de workflow agentic-AI nombrando plataformas clase n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify por categoría y prescribiendo familias de control de validación content-type webhook + least-privilege consciente de inyección de prompts + audit-trail MCP-tool-call. La forcing function es que la puntuación CVSS-10 Ni8mare en un harness no-code de workflow AI ampliamente desplegado en empresas Tier-2 hace la guía CISA AI existente (que apuntaba a model providers y compradores de gran despliegue) demasiado estrecha para la realidad operacional. La guía es muy probablemente un Cybersecurity Advisory CISA o suplemento Secure-by-Design; FBI + NSA + contrapartes internacionales Five Eyes co-firman dentro de un ciclo (el patrón conjunto AL26-001 de CCCS / ASD en n8n es el precedente de forma de despacho).
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026 ang cluster ng LLM-workflow-platform CVEs na lumalapag sa parehong window — n8n CVE-2026-21858 (CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated RCE sa pamamagitan ng webhook content-type confusion, codenamed Ni8mare ng Cyera Research Labs, na-patch sa 1.121.0, na may mga advisories mula sa Canadian Centre for Cyber Security + Australian ASD ACSC + Censys + Orca Security), Flowise CSV Agent CVE-2026-41264 (prompt-injection-driven RCE kung saan ang isang chatflow user ay umaakit sa LLM na maglabas ng attacker-controlled Python), LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (unang na-exploit sa loob ng 12 hours 31 minutes ng disclosure ayon sa Sysdig honeypot fleet), ang Georgia Tech Vibe Security Radar count na 35 CVEs noong March 2026 na direkta na maiuugnay sa AI coding tools (na may researchers na nag-eestima ng undercount na 5-10x sa buong open-source ecosystem) — kasama ng standing SGLang CVE-2026-5760 patch + ang ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (~half unauthenticated) baseline ay pumipilit sa CISA na maglabas ng dedicated agentic-AI workflow-platform secure-deployment guide na nagngangalan ng n8n / Flowise / LangChain / LlamaIndex / Dify class platforms ayon sa kategorya at nagre-prescribe ng webhook-content-type-validation + prompt-injection-aware least-privilege + MCP-tool-call audit-trail control families. Ang forcing function ay ang Ni8mare CVSS-10 score sa isang no-code AI-workflow harness na malawakang na-deploy sa Tier-2 enterprises ay ginagawa ang umiiral na CISA AI guidance (na nagta-target ng model providers at large-deployment-tier buyers) na masyadong makitid para sa operational reality. Ang guide ay malamang isang CISA Cybersecurity Advisory o Secure-by-Design supplement; FBI + NSA + international Five Eyes counterparts ay co-sign sa loob ng isang cycle (ang AL26-001 joint pattern mula CCCS / ASD sa n8n ay ang dispatch-shape precedent).

nodes.description: By Q1 2027 the May 6-7 Cerebras Systems IPO above-range pricing print — $128 per share (vs $115-$125 disclosed range, +2.4% above the upper end), $3.58B raise lifted to ~$4.12B with the green-shoe exercised in full at a fully-diluted ~$27.2B market cap, OpenAI's December 2025 $1B warrant package (~33M shares, ~12% of float, struck at the Series H reference) marked publicly in-the-money on listing day, Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo angel positions all crystallized at a $26.6B-target → $27.2B-actual print — combined with the May 7 SambaNova + Groq accelerated S-1 confidential-submission timelines (60-90 days), the Tenstorrent Hyundai + Samsung Foundry IPO bridge round at >$3B, and a public-market multiple now sitting under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, force the next wave of S-1 filings (and existing AI-accelerator + frontier-lab 10-Q footnote schedules) to disclose frontier-lab chip-supply warrant and loan terms as a standard issuer-level itemized exhibit rather than buried among related-party narrative footnotes. The forcing function is that OpenAI's Cerebras warrant is the first publicly-priced data point linking a frontier lab's structured-equity supply contract to an open-market multiple; sell-side and SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters now have a quantitative comparable to press for, which converts what was bespoke disclosure into template language. The most likely shape is an itemized warrant-and-loan exhibit naming counterparty (frontier lab), strike reference (Series-letter peg), share count, coverage clause, and any minimum-revenue or capacity-take obligations; SambaNova's S-1 ships first given its ~$5.1B last-priced round and Aramco Digital + Meta API customer roster, Groq second on its Saudi-anchored vehicle and inference-tier API revenue, Tenstorrent third via its bridge-round disclosure. Bear case is that the SEC permits silence on coverage clauses pending a separate concept release; absent that, Q1 2027 lands the standardised exhibit shape across the cohort.

description.ja: 2027年Q1までに、5月6日〜7日のCerebras Systems IPOレンジ上抜け価格決定—1株$128(開示済みレンジ$115-$125に対し、上限を+2.4%上回る)、$3.58Bの調達がグリーンシュー全量行使で~$4.12Bに引き上げられ、フル希薄化後で~$27.2Bの時価総額、OpenAIの2025年12月の$1Bワラントパッケージ(~33M株、フロートの~12%、シリーズH参照ストライク)が上場日にイン・ザ・マネーで公にマーク、Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angeloのエンジェル・ポジションが$26.6Bターゲット→$27.2B実プリントで全て確定—が、5月7日のSambaNova + Groqの加速されたS-1機密提出タイムライン(60-90日)、TenstorrentのHyundai + Samsung FoundryとのIPOブリッジラウンド>$3B、開示済みAIアクセラレータ売上の下に位置する公開市場マルチプルと組み合わさり、次のS-1ファイリングの波(および既存のAIアクセラレータ + フロンティア・ラボの10-Q脚注スケジュール)に対し、フロンティア・ラボのチップ供給ワラントとローン条件を、関連当事者ナラティブ脚注に埋め込むのではなく発行体レベルの項目別エキシビットとして開示することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、OpenAIのCerebrasワラントが、フロンティア・ラボの構造化エクイティ供給契約を公開市場マルチプルにリンクする初の公的価格付けデータポイントであること;セルサイドとSEC Corp Finスタッフのコメントレターは現在、定量的なコンパラブルを要求できるようになり、これによりベスポーク開示がテンプレート言語へと変換される。最も可能性の高い形状は、カウンターパーティ(フロンティア・ラボ)、ストライク参照(シリーズ・レター・ペッグ)、株数、カバレッジ条項、最低売上または容量引取義務を命名する項目別ワラント・アンド・ローン・エキシビット;SambaNovaのS-1が~$5.1Bの直近価格付けラウンドとAramco Digital + Meta APIカスタマーのロスターから先行、Groqがサウジアラビアアンカーのビークルとインフェレンス層APIレベニューで2番目、Tenstorrentがブリッジラウンド開示で3番目。ベアケースはSECが別個のコンセプト・リリースを保留しカバレッジ条項の沈黙を許容すること;それがなければ2027年Q1にコホート全体で標準化されたエキシビット形状が着地する。
description.es: Para Q1 2027 el print de pricing por encima del rango del IPO de Cerebras Systems del 6-7 de mayo — $128 por acción (vs rango revelado $115-$125, +2.4% por encima del extremo superior), recaudación de $3.58B elevada a ~$4.12B con el green-shoe ejercido en su totalidad a una capitalización de mercado totalmente diluida de ~$27.2B, el paquete de warrants de OpenAI de diciembre de 2025 de $1B (~33M acciones, ~12% del float, fijado en la referencia Series H) marcado públicamente in-the-money el día del listing, las posiciones ángel de Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo todas cristalizadas a un objetivo de $26.6B → print real $27.2B — combinado con los cronogramas acelerados de presentación confidencial S-1 de SambaNova + Groq del 7 de mayo (60-90 días), la ronda puente IPO de Tenstorrent con Hyundai + Samsung Foundry a >$3B, y un múltiplo de mercado público que ahora se sitúa bajo los ingresos revelados de aceleradores AI, fuerzan a la siguiente ola de presentaciones S-1 (y a los cronogramas existentes de notas al pie 10-Q de aceleradores AI + laboratorios frontera) a revelar términos de warrants y préstamos de suministro de chips de laboratorios frontera como un anexo estándar itemizado a nivel de emisor en lugar de quedar enterrados en notas narrativas de partes relacionadas. La función forzante es que el warrant de OpenAI sobre Cerebras es el primer punto de datos con precio público que vincula un contrato estructurado de suministro de equity de un laboratorio frontera a un múltiplo de mercado abierto; las cartas de comentarios del personal sell-side y SEC Corp Fin ahora tienen un comparable cuantitativo que presionar, lo que convierte lo que era revelación a medida en lenguaje de plantilla. La forma más probable es un anexo itemizado de warrant-y-préstamo nombrando contraparte (laboratorio frontera), referencia de strike (peg de letra de Series), número de acciones, cláusula de cobertura y cualquier obligación de ingreso mínimo o toma de capacidad; el S-1 de SambaNova lanza primero dado su última ronda con precio de ~$5.1B y su roster de clientes API Aramco Digital + Meta, Groq segundo por su vehículo anclado en Arabia Saudita y sus ingresos API de capa de inferencia, Tenstorrent tercero vía la revelación de su ronda puente. El caso bajista es que la SEC permita silencio sobre cláusulas de cobertura pendiente de un release conceptual separado; sin eso, Q1 2027 aterriza la forma de anexo estandarizado a través de la cohorte.
description.fil: Bago ang Q1 2027, ang May 6-7 Cerebras Systems IPO above-range pricing print — $128 per share (vs $115-$125 disclosed range, +2.4% sa ibabaw ng upper end), $3.58B raise na itinaas sa ~$4.12B na may green-shoe na ginamit nang buo sa fully-diluted ~$27.2B market cap, ang December 2025 $1B warrant package ng OpenAI (~33M shares, ~12% ng float, struck sa Series H reference) na pampublikong namarkahan in-the-money sa listing day, ang angel positions nina Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo na lahat ay na-crystallize sa $26.6B-target → $27.2B-actual print — kasama ng May 7 SambaNova + Groq accelerated S-1 confidential-submission timelines (60-90 days), ang Tenstorrent Hyundai + Samsung Foundry IPO bridge round sa >$3B, at ang public-market multiple na ngayon ay nakaupo sa ilalim ng inilantad na AI-accelerator revenue, ay pumipilit sa susunod na wave ng S-1 filings (at umiiral na AI-accelerator + frontier-lab 10-Q footnote schedules) na ilantad ang frontier-lab chip-supply warrant at loan terms bilang standard issuer-level itemized exhibit sa halip na ibaon sa related-party narrative footnotes. Ang forcing function ay ang OpenAI Cerebras warrant ay ang unang publicly-priced data point na nag-uugnay sa structured-equity supply contract ng frontier lab sa open-market multiple; ang sell-side at SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters ay mayroon na ngayong quantitative comparable na maipipilit, na nag-co-convert sa kung ano ang dating bespoke disclosure into template language. Ang most likely shape ay isang itemized warrant-and-loan exhibit na nagngangalan ng counterparty (frontier lab), strike reference (Series-letter peg), share count, coverage clause, at anumang minimum-revenue o capacity-take obligations; mauuna ang SambaNova S-1 dahil sa kanyang ~$5.1B last-priced round at Aramco Digital + Meta API customer roster, susunod ang Groq sa kanyang Saudi-anchored vehicle at inference-tier API revenue, ikatlo ang Tenstorrent sa pamamagitan ng kanyang bridge-round disclosure. Ang bear case ay pinapayagan ng SEC ang katahimikan sa coverage clauses na naghihintay sa hiwalay na concept release; kung wala iyon, ang Q1 2027 ay lalapag sa standardised exhibit shape sa kabuuan ng cohort.
