summary.fil: Bago ang Q1 2027, ang May 6-7 Cerebras Systems IPO above-range pricing print — $128 per share (vs $115-$125 disclosed range, +2.4% sa ibabaw ng upper end), $3.58B raise na itinaas sa ~$4.12B na may green-shoe na ginamit nang buo sa fully-diluted ~$27.2B market cap, ang December 2025 $1B warrant package ng OpenAI (~33M shares, ~12% ng float, struck sa Series H reference) na pampublikong namarkahan in-the-money sa listing day, ang angel positions nina Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo na lahat ay na-crystallize sa $26.6B-target → $27.2B-actual print — kasama ng May 7 SambaNova + Groq accelerated S-1 confidential-submission timelines (60-90 days), ang Tenstorrent Hyundai + Samsung Foundry IPO bridge round sa >$3B, at ang public-market multiple na ngayon ay nakaupo sa ilalim ng inilantad na AI-accelerator revenue, ay pumipilit sa susunod na wave ng S-1 filings (at umiiral na AI-accelerator + frontier-lab 10-Q footnote schedules) na ilantad ang frontier-lab chip-supply warrant at loan terms bilang standard issuer-level itemized exhibit sa halip na ibaon sa related-party narrative footnotes. Ang forcing function ay ang OpenAI Cerebras warrant ay ang unang publicly-priced data point na nag-uugnay sa structured-equity supply contract ng frontier lab sa open-market multiple; ang sell-side at SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters ay mayroon na ngayong quantitative comparable na maipipilit, na nag-co-convert sa kung ano ang dating bespoke disclosure into template language. Ang most likely shape ay isang itemized warrant-and-loan exhibit na nagngangalan ng counterparty (frontier lab), strike reference (Series-letter peg), share count, coverage clause, at anumang minimum-revenue o capacity-take obligations; mauuna ang SambaNova S-1 dahil sa kanyang ~$5.1B last-priced round at Aramco Digital + Meta API customer roster, susunod ang Groq sa kanyang Saudi-anchored vehicle at inference-tier API revenue, ikatlo ang Tenstorrent sa pamamagitan ng kanyang bridge-round disclosure. Ang bear case ay pinapayagan ng SEC ang katahimikan sa coverage clauses na naghihintay sa hiwalay na concept release; kung wala iyon, ang Q1 2027 ay lalapag sa standardised exhibit shape sa kabuuan ng cohort.

bridges.text: Corp Fin's Thursday Securities Act Forms staff-guidance refresh on the hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity counterparty disclosure shape is the first formal staff artifact paired with the now-three-letter sample-comment-letter sequence specifically to address the warrant counterparty question; Cerebras's third-batch engineering-sample window opening to Mistral, Cohere, Stability AI cohort plus Nvidia's NVL576 third-batch shipments to Anthropic, Apple, Lambda Labs plus Saudi Aramco MoU close narrowing into late-Q2 jointly thicken the warrant-disclosure use-case set.

text_locales.en: Corp Fin's Thursday Securities Act Forms staff-guidance refresh on the hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity counterparty disclosure shape is the first formal staff artifact paired with the now-three-letter sample-comment-letter sequence specifically to address the warrant counterparty question; Cerebras's third-batch engineering-sample window opening to Mistral, Cohere, Stability AI cohort plus Nvidia's NVL576 third-batch shipments to Anthropic, Apple, Lambda Labs plus Saudi Aramco MoU close narrowing into late-Q2 jointly thicken the warrant-disclosure use-case set.
text_locales.ja: 企業財務部の木曜証券法フォーム・スタッフガイダンス改訂は、ハイパースケーラー・アンカーのワラント持分取引相手方開示の形状を扱った初の公式スタッフ成果物であり、現在3通となったサンプル・コメントレター系列と対をなしてワラント取引相手方の問いに正面から応えている。Cerebras社の第3バッチ・エンジニアリングサンプル供給枠がMistral、Cohere、Stability AI群へ開くこと、NVIDIA社のNVL576第3バッチがAnthropic、Apple、Lambda Labsへ出荷されたこと、そしてサウジアラムコMoU締結がQ2 2026後半へ絞り込まれていることが、ワラント開示の活用事例集を厚くしている。
text_locales.es: La actualización del jueves de la guía del personal de Corp Fin sobre las Formas de la Securities Act respecto a la forma de divulgación de la contraparte de warrant-equity ancla del hiperescalador es el primer artefacto formal del personal emparejado con la secuencia ahora-de-tres-cartas-modelo de comentarios específicamente para abordar la cuestión de la contraparte del warrant; la apertura de la tercera ventana de muestras de ingeniería de Cerebras al grupo de Mistral, Cohere y Stability AI más los envíos de tercer lote NVL576 de Nvidia a Anthropic, Apple y Lambda Labs más el cierre del MoU de Saudi Aramco estrechándose a finales del Q2 engrosan conjuntamente el conjunto de casos de uso de divulgación de warrants.
text_locales.fil: Ang Huwebes Securities Act Forms staff-guidance refresh ng Corp Fin sa hugis ng disclosure ng hyperscaler-anchor warrant-equity counterparty ang unang pormal na staff artifact na ipinares sa now-three-letter sample-comment-letter sequence partikular upang tugunan ang tanong sa warrant counterparty; ang pagbubukas ng third-batch engineering-sample window ng Cerebras sa Mistral, Cohere, Stability AI cohort kasama ang NVL576 third-batch shipments ng Nvidia sa Anthropic, Apple, Lambda Labs at ang pagiging makitid ng Saudi Aramco MoU close sa late-Q2 ay magkakasamang nagpapakapal sa warrant-disclosure use-case set.

text_locales.en: Cerebras CFO's Saturday Q&A locks the October 28 180-day lock-up on OpenAI's $1B warrant with no early-release waiver — the first explicit public-company warrant-tenor confirmation. bridges.text: OpenAI's $1B warrant package marks roughly $4.9B paper gain at first-day close, and SEC Corp Fin's sample comment letter explicitly cites the Cerebras-OpenAI warrant as a related-party-disclosure comparable for selected hyperscaler issuers. Cerebras's CS-4 announcement under a standing $10B OpenAI multi-year supply agreement extends the warrant template into a multi-deal cadence the SambaNova, Groq, and Tenstorrent S-1 cohort will inherit.

text_locales.es: El paquete de warrant de $1B de OpenAI marca aproximadamente $4.9B de ganancia en papel al cierre del primer dia, y la sample comment letter de SEC Corp Fin cita explicitamente el warrant Cerebras-OpenAI como comparable de related-party-disclosure para emisores hyperscaler seleccionados. El anuncio del CS-4 de Cerebras bajo un acuerdo de suministro multianual de $10B con OpenAI extiende la plantilla de warrant a una cadencia multi-deal que la cohorte S-1 de SambaNova, Groq y Tenstorrent heredara.
text_locales.fil: Ang $1B warrant package ng OpenAI ay nagma-mark ng humigit-kumulang $4.9B paper gain sa first-day close, at ang sample comment letter ng SEC Corp Fin ay tahasang bumabanggit sa Cerebras-OpenAI warrant bilang related-party-disclosure comparable para sa piling hyperscaler issuers. Ang CS-4 announcement ng Cerebras sa ilalim ng standing $10B OpenAI multi-year supply agreement ay nagpapalawig sa warrant template tungo sa multi-deal cadence na mamanahin ng SambaNova, Groq, at Tenstorrent S-1 cohort.

detail.description: By Q1 2027 the May 6-7 Cerebras Systems IPO above-range pricing print — $128 per share (vs $115-$125 disclosed range, +2.4% above the upper end), $3.58B raise lifted to ~$4.12B with the green-shoe exercised in full at a fully-diluted ~$27.2B market cap, OpenAI's December 2025 $1B warrant package (~33M shares, ~12% of float, struck at the Series H reference) marked publicly in-the-money on listing day, Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo angel positions all crystallized at a $26.6B-target → $27.2B-actual print — combined with the May 7 SambaNova + Groq accelerated S-1 confidential-submission timelines (60-90 days), the Tenstorrent Hyundai + Samsung Foundry IPO bridge round at >$3B, and a public-market multiple now sitting under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, force the next wave of S-1 filings (and existing AI-accelerator + frontier-lab 10-Q footnote schedules) to disclose frontier-lab chip-supply warrant and loan terms as a standard issuer-level itemized exhibit rather than buried among related-party narrative footnotes. The forcing function is that OpenAI's Cerebras warrant is the first publicly-priced data point linking a frontier lab's structured-equity supply contract to an open-market multiple; sell-side and SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters now have a quantitative comparable to press for, which converts what was bespoke disclosure into template language. The most likely shape is an itemized warrant-and-loan exhibit naming counterparty (frontier lab), strike reference (Series-letter peg), share count, coverage clause, and any minimum-revenue or capacity-take obligations; SambaNova's S-1 ships first given its ~$5.1B last-priced round and Aramco Digital + Meta API customer roster, Groq second on its Saudi-anchored vehicle and inference-tier API revenue, Tenstorrent third via its bridge-round disclosure. Bear case is that the SEC permits silence on coverage clauses pending a separate concept release; absent that, Q1 2027 lands the standardised exhibit shape across the cohort.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2027年Q1までに、5月6日〜7日のCerebras Systems IPOレンジ上抜け価格決定—1株$128(開示済みレンジ$115-$125に対し、上限を+2.4%上回る)、$3.58Bの調達がグリーンシュー全量行使で~$4.12Bに引き上げられ、フル希薄化後で~$27.2Bの時価総額、OpenAIの2025年12月の$1Bワラントパッケージ(~33M株、フロートの~12%、シリーズH参照ストライク)が上場日にイン・ザ・マネーで公にマーク、Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angeloのエンジェル・ポジションが$26.6Bターゲット→$27.2B実プリントで全て確定—が、5月7日のSambaNova + Groqの加速されたS-1機密提出タイムライン(60-90日)、TenstorrentのHyundai + Samsung FoundryとのIPOブリッジラウンド>$3B、開示済みAIアクセラレータ売上の下に位置する公開市場マルチプルと組み合わさり、次のS-1ファイリングの波(および既存のAIアクセラレータ + フロンティア・ラボの10-Q脚注スケジュール)に対し、フロンティア・ラボのチップ供給ワラントとローン条件を、関連当事者ナラティブ脚注に埋め込むのではなく発行体レベルの項目別エキシビットとして開示することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、OpenAIのCerebrasワラントが、フロンティア・ラボの構造化エクイティ供給契約を公開市場マルチプルにリンクする初の公的価格付けデータポイントであること;セルサイドとSEC Corp Finスタッフのコメントレターは現在、定量的なコンパラブルを要求できるようになり、これによりベスポーク開示がテンプレート言語へと変換される。最も可能性の高い形状は、カウンターパーティ(フロンティア・ラボ)、ストライク参照(シリーズ・レター・ペッグ)、株数、カバレッジ条項、最低売上または容量引取義務を命名する項目別ワラント・アンド・ローン・エキシビット;SambaNovaのS-1が~$5.1Bの直近価格付けラウンドとAramco Digital + Meta APIカスタマーのロスターから先行、Groqがサウジアラビアアンカーのビークルとインフェレンス層APIレベニューで2番目、Tenstorrentがブリッジラウンド開示で3番目。ベアケースはSECが別個のコンセプト・リリースを保留しカバレッジ条項の沈黙を許容すること;それがなければ2027年Q1にコホート全体で標準化されたエキシビット形状が着地する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q1 2027 el print de pricing por encima del rango del IPO de Cerebras Systems del 6-7 de mayo — $128 por acción (vs rango revelado $115-$125, +2.4% por encima del extremo superior), recaudación de $3.58B elevada a ~$4.12B con el green-shoe ejercido en su totalidad a una capitalización de mercado totalmente diluida de ~$27.2B, el paquete de warrants de OpenAI de diciembre de 2025 de $1B (~33M acciones, ~12% del float, fijado en la referencia Series H) marcado públicamente in-the-money el día del listing, las posiciones ángel de Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo todas cristalizadas a un objetivo de $26.6B → print real $27.2B — combinado con los cronogramas acelerados de presentación confidencial S-1 de SambaNova + Groq del 7 de mayo (60-90 días), la ronda puente IPO de Tenstorrent con Hyundai + Samsung Foundry a >$3B, y un múltiplo de mercado público que ahora se sitúa bajo los ingresos revelados de aceleradores AI, fuerzan a la siguiente ola de presentaciones S-1 (y a los cronogramas existentes de notas al pie 10-Q de aceleradores AI + laboratorios frontera) a revelar términos de warrants y préstamos de suministro de chips de laboratorios frontera como un anexo estándar itemizado a nivel de emisor en lugar de quedar enterrados en notas narrativas de partes relacionadas. La función forzante es que el warrant de OpenAI sobre Cerebras es el primer punto de datos con precio público que vincula un contrato estructurado de suministro de equity de un laboratorio frontera a un múltiplo de mercado abierto; las cartas de comentarios del personal sell-side y SEC Corp Fin ahora tienen un comparable cuantitativo que presionar, lo que convierte lo que era revelación a medida en lenguaje de plantilla. La forma más probable es un anexo itemizado de warrant-y-préstamo nombrando contraparte (laboratorio frontera), referencia de strike (peg de letra de Series), número de acciones, cláusula de cobertura y cualquier obligación de ingreso mínimo o toma de capacidad; el S-1 de SambaNova lanza primero dado su última ronda con precio de ~$5.1B y su roster de clientes API Aramco Digital + Meta, Groq segundo por su vehículo anclado en Arabia Saudita y sus ingresos API de capa de inferencia, Tenstorrent tercero vía la revelación de su ronda puente. El caso bajista es que la SEC permita silencio sobre cláusulas de cobertura pendiente de un release conceptual separado; sin eso, Q1 2027 aterriza la forma de anexo estandarizado a través de la cohorte.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q1 2027, ang May 6-7 Cerebras Systems IPO above-range pricing print — $128 per share (vs $115-$125 disclosed range, +2.4% sa ibabaw ng upper end), $3.58B raise na itinaas sa ~$4.12B na may green-shoe na ginamit nang buo sa fully-diluted ~$27.2B market cap, ang December 2025 $1B warrant package ng OpenAI (~33M shares, ~12% ng float, struck sa Series H reference) na pampublikong namarkahan in-the-money sa listing day, ang angel positions nina Sam Altman + Greg Brockman + Ilya Sutskever + Adam D'Angelo na lahat ay na-crystallize sa $26.6B-target → $27.2B-actual print — kasama ng May 7 SambaNova + Groq accelerated S-1 confidential-submission timelines (60-90 days), ang Tenstorrent Hyundai + Samsung Foundry IPO bridge round sa >$3B, at ang public-market multiple na ngayon ay nakaupo sa ilalim ng inilantad na AI-accelerator revenue, ay pumipilit sa susunod na wave ng S-1 filings (at umiiral na AI-accelerator + frontier-lab 10-Q footnote schedules) na ilantad ang frontier-lab chip-supply warrant at loan terms bilang standard issuer-level itemized exhibit sa halip na ibaon sa related-party narrative footnotes. Ang forcing function ay ang OpenAI Cerebras warrant ay ang unang publicly-priced data point na nag-uugnay sa structured-equity supply contract ng frontier lab sa open-market multiple; ang sell-side at SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters ay mayroon na ngayong quantitative comparable na maipipilit, na nag-co-convert sa kung ano ang dating bespoke disclosure into template language. Ang most likely shape ay isang itemized warrant-and-loan exhibit na nagngangalan ng counterparty (frontier lab), strike reference (Series-letter peg), share count, coverage clause, at anumang minimum-revenue o capacity-take obligations; mauuna ang SambaNova S-1 dahil sa kanyang ~$5.1B last-priced round at Aramco Digital + Meta API customer roster, susunod ang Groq sa kanyang Saudi-anchored vehicle at inference-tier API revenue, ikatlo ang Tenstorrent sa pamamagitan ng kanyang bridge-round disclosure. Ang bear case ay pinapayagan ng SEC ang katahimikan sa coverage clauses na naghihintay sa hiwalay na concept release; kung wala iyon, ang Q1 2027 ay lalapag sa standardised exhibit shape sa kabuuan ng cohort.

nodes.title: Router-only LoRA lands as default MoE fine-tuning recipe by Q4 2026
nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 8 router-only LoRA convergence — the Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint reporting 71-78% recovery of full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy at 8-13% of training-step time and 11-16% of peak VRAM across a four-model ablation (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), Unsloth's same-day production recipes for Llama 4 Behemoth single-node tuning, Kimi K2.6 on a 96GB workstation, and Mixtral 8x22B for sovereign-cloud customers, the parallel DeepMind preprint on router-aware advantage decomposition closing the long-context Reinforcement Learning stability gap that previously kept router-only mode out of ultra-long-context training, and Cerebras's CS-4 engineering-sample announcement explicitly naming Mixture-of-Experts router-only training plus ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning as the target workload — together force the router-only adaptation mode out of the Unsloth-specific category and into the default fine-tuning recipe shipped by every major training stack inside the same calendar window. The structural force is that the four-model ablation gives downstream framework maintainers a published parity baseline they can target without re-running the search, and the DeepMind stability proof removes the last operational reason to keep training all expert weights for a router-shaped objective. The most likely shape is a router-only adapter type added as a first-class option in Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Meta's torchtune, with default recipe templates targeting at least the Llama, Qwen, and Mixtral families; sovereign-cloud customers and on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers adopt it first because the VRAM reduction is the only path to single-node tuning of Behemoth-class MoE models. Bear case is a competing scaling-law preprint showing the accuracy gap widens past 200B parameters and forcing a hybrid mode; absent that, Q4 2026 lands router-only as the documented default across the cohort.

description.es: Para Q4 2026 la convergencia LoRA solo-router del 8 de mayo — el preprint conjunto en arxiv de Unsloth + Hugging Face reportando 71-78% de recuperación de la precisión de full-LoRA-en-expertos al 8-13% del tiempo de paso de entrenamiento y al 11-16% del VRAM pico a través de una ablación de cuatro modelos (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), las recetas de producción del mismo día de Unsloth para tuning de Llama 4 Behemoth en nodo único, Kimi K2.6 en una workstation de 96GB, y Mixtral 8x22B para clientes sovereign-cloud, el preprint paralelo de DeepMind sobre descomposición de ventaja consciente del router cerrando la brecha de estabilidad de Reinforcement Learning de contexto largo que previamente mantenía el modo solo-router fuera del entrenamiento de contexto ultra-largo, y el anuncio de muestra de ingeniería del CS-4 de Cerebras nombrando explícitamente el entrenamiento solo-router de Mixture-of-Experts más Reinforcement Learning de contexto ultra-largo como la carga de trabajo objetivo — juntos fuerzan al modo de adaptación solo-router fuera de la categoría específica de Unsloth y hacia la receta por defecto de fine-tuning enviada por cada stack importante de entrenamiento dentro de la misma ventana calendario. La fuerza estructural es que la ablación de cuatro modelos da a los mantenedores de frameworks downstream una línea base de paridad publicada que pueden apuntar sin re-ejecutar la búsqueda, y la prueba de estabilidad de DeepMind elimina la última razón operacional para mantener el entrenamiento de todos los pesos de expertos para un objetivo con forma de router. La forma más probable es un tipo de adaptador solo-router agregado como opción de primera clase en Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, y torchtune de Meta, con plantillas de receta por defecto apuntando al menos a las familias Llama, Qwen y Mixtral; los clientes sovereign-cloud y los compradores del nivel workstation on-prem RTX 6000 Ada lo adoptan primero porque la reducción de VRAM es la única ruta hacia tuning de nodo único de modelos MoE clase Behemoth. El caso bajista es un preprint de scaling-law competidor mostrando que la brecha de precisión se ensancha más allá de 200B parámetros y forzando un modo híbrido; sin eso, Q4 2026 aterriza solo-router como el por defecto documentado en toda la cohorte.
description.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026, ang May 8 router-only LoRA convergence — ang Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint na nag-uulat ng 71-78% recovery ng full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy sa 8-13% ng training-step time at 11-16% ng peak VRAM sa isang four-model ablation (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), ang same-day production recipes ng Unsloth para sa Llama 4 Behemoth single-node tuning, Kimi K2.6 sa isang 96GB workstation, at Mixtral 8x22B para sa sovereign-cloud customers, ang parallel DeepMind preprint sa router-aware advantage decomposition na nagsasara sa long-context Reinforcement Learning stability gap na dating naglalayo sa router-only mode mula sa ultra-long-context training, at ang CS-4 engineering-sample announcement ng Cerebras na hayagang pinapangalanan ang Mixture-of-Experts router-only training kasama ang ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning bilang target workload — ay magkasamang pumipilit sa router-only adaptation mode na lumabas sa Unsloth-specific category at pumasok bilang default fine-tuning recipe na ina-ship ng bawat major training stack sa loob ng parehong calendar window. Ang structural force ay ang four-model ablation ay nagbibigay sa downstream framework maintainers ng published parity baseline na pwedeng targetin nang hindi muling ina-i-rerun ang search, at ang DeepMind stability proof ay nag-aalis sa huling operational reason para i-train ang lahat ng expert weights para sa isang router-shaped objective. Ang most likely shape ay isang router-only adapter type na idinaragdag bilang first-class option sa Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, at Meta torchtune, na may default recipe templates na nakatutok man lamang sa Llama, Qwen, at Mixtral families; mauuna ang sovereign-cloud customers at on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers sa pag-adopt dahil ang VRAM reduction ay ang tanging path sa single-node tuning ng Behemoth-class MoE models. Ang bear case ay isang competing scaling-law preprint na nagpapakitang lumalawak ang accuracy gap lampas sa 200B parameters at pinipilit ang isang hybrid mode; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q4 2026 sa router-only bilang documented default sa kabuuan ng cohort.

summary.en: By Q4 2026 the May 8 router-only LoRA convergence — the Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint reporting 71-78% recovery of full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy at 8-13% of training-step time and 11-16% of peak VRAM across a four-model ablation (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), Unsloth's same-day production recipes for Llama 4 Behemoth single-node tuning, Kimi K2.6 on a 96GB workstation, and Mixtral 8x22B for sovereign-cloud customers, the parallel DeepMind preprint on router-aware advantage decomposition closing the long-context Reinforcement Learning stability gap that previously kept router-only mode out of ultra-long-context training, and Cerebras's CS-4 engineering-sample announcement explicitly naming Mixture-of-Experts router-only training plus ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning as the target workload — together force the router-only adaptation mode out of the Unsloth-specific category and into the default fine-tuning recipe shipped by every major training stack inside the same calendar window. The structural force is that the four-model ablation gives downstream framework maintainers a published parity baseline they can target without re-running the search, and the DeepMind stability proof removes the last operational reason to keep training all expert weights for a router-shaped objective. The most likely shape is a router-only adapter type added as a first-class option in Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Meta's torchtune, with default recipe templates targeting at least the Llama, Qwen, and Mixtral families; sovereign-cloud customers and on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers adopt it first because the VRAM reduction is the only path to single-node tuning of Behemoth-class MoE models. Bear case is a competing scaling-law preprint showing the accuracy gap widens past 200B parameters and forcing a hybrid mode; absent that, Q4 2026 lands router-only as the documented default across the cohort.

bridges.text: On the router-only LoRA default Mixture-of-Experts recipe prediction (May 8): Sunday's Hacker News write-up documents a successful Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA run on a dual RTX 5090 workstation at 64GB combined VRAM via NCCL, reporting 12 percent peak combined VRAM and 74 percent accuracy recovery on in-domain finance-news classification. Unsloth's Sunday changelog adds a multi-GPU NCCL backend for consumer dual-GPU workstation tiers, an ONNX inference export path, and a Triton kernel cutting router-attention latency by 22 percent on Llama 4 Behemoth and Kimi K2.6. DeepMind's v3 addendum (arxiv 2605.05844v3) closes the long-context RL stability gap on the same dual-5090 reference setup up to 96K tokens.

text_locales.en: On the router-only LoRA default Mixture-of-Experts recipe prediction (May 8): Sunday's Hacker News write-up documents a successful Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA run on a dual RTX 5090 workstation at 64GB combined VRAM via NCCL, reporting 12 percent peak combined VRAM and 74 percent accuracy recovery on in-domain finance-news classification. Unsloth's Sunday changelog adds a multi-GPU NCCL backend for consumer dual-GPU workstation tiers, an ONNX inference export path, and a Triton kernel cutting router-attention latency by 22 percent on Llama 4 Behemoth and Kimi K2.6. DeepMind's v3 addendum (arxiv 2605.05844v3) closes the long-context RL stability gap on the same dual-5090 reference setup up to 96K tokens.
text_locales.ja: ルーター・オンリーLoRAデフォルトMixture-of-Expertsレシピ予測(5月8日)について: 日曜のHacker NewsライトアップはNCCL経由64GB合算VRAMでのデュアル RTX 5090ワークステーション上のMixtral 8x22Bルーター・オンリーLoRA実行成功を文書化し、12パーセントピーク合算VRAMとドメイン内ファイナンス・ニュース分類上の74パーセント精度回復を報告。Unslothの日曜チェンジログはコンシューマー・デュアルGPUワークステーション・ティア向けマルチGPU NCCLバックエンド、ONNXインファレンス・エクスポート・パス、Llama 4 BehemothとKimi K2.6上でルーター・アテンション・レイテンシを22パーセント削減するTritonカーネルを追加。DeepMindのv3追補(arxiv 2605.05844v3)は同じデュアル-5090リファレンス・セットアップ上で96Kトークンまでロング・コンテキストRL安定性ギャップを閉じる。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción de router-only LoRA como receta default de Mixture-of-Experts (8 de mayo): el writeup dominical de Hacker News documenta una corrida exitosa de Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA en una workstation dual RTX 5090 a 64GB combinada de VRAM vía NCCL, reportando 12 por ciento de pico de VRAM combinada y 74 por ciento de recuperación de precisión en clasificación in-domain de noticias financieras. El changelog dominical de Unsloth añade un backend multi-GPU NCCL para tiers de workstation dual-GPU de consumidor, una ruta de exportación de inferencia ONNX, y un kernel Triton recortando la latencia router-attention en 22 por ciento en Llama 4 Behemoth y Kimi K2.6. El addendum v3 de DeepMind (arxiv 2605.05844v3) cierra la brecha de estabilidad RL de contexto largo en la misma configuración de referencia dual-5090 hasta 96K tokens.
text_locales.fil: Sa router-only LoRA default Mixture-of-Experts recipe prediction (Mayo 8): idinodokumento ng Sunday Hacker News write-up ang matagumpay na Mixtral 8x22B router-only LoRA run sa isang dual RTX 5090 workstation sa 64GB combined VRAM sa pamamagitan ng NCCL, na nag-uulat ng 12 porsiyento peak combined VRAM at 74 porsiyento accuracy recovery sa in-domain finance-news classification. Idinaragdag ng Sunday changelog ng Unsloth ang multi-GPU NCCL backend para sa consumer dual-GPU workstation tiers, isang ONNX inference export path, at isang Triton kernel na pinuputol ang router-attention latency ng 22 porsiyento sa Llama 4 Behemoth at Kimi K2.6. Isinasara ng DeepMind's v3 addendum (arxiv 2605.05844v3) ang long-context RL stability gap sa parehong dual-5090 reference setup hanggang 96K tokens.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 8 router-only LoRA convergence — the Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint reporting 71-78% recovery of full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy at 8-13% of training-step time and 11-16% of peak VRAM across a four-model ablation (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), Unsloth's same-day production recipes for Llama 4 Behemoth single-node tuning, Kimi K2.6 on a 96GB workstation, and Mixtral 8x22B for sovereign-cloud customers, the parallel DeepMind preprint on router-aware advantage decomposition closing the long-context Reinforcement Learning stability gap that previously kept router-only mode out of ultra-long-context training, and Cerebras's CS-4 engineering-sample announcement explicitly naming Mixture-of-Experts router-only training plus ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning as the target workload — together force the router-only adaptation mode out of the Unsloth-specific category and into the default fine-tuning recipe shipped by every major training stack inside the same calendar window. The structural force is that the four-model ablation gives downstream framework maintainers a published parity baseline they can target without re-running the search, and the DeepMind stability proof removes the last operational reason to keep training all expert weights for a router-shaped objective. The most likely shape is a router-only adapter type added as a first-class option in Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Meta's torchtune, with default recipe templates targeting at least the Llama, Qwen, and Mixtral families; sovereign-cloud customers and on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers adopt it first because the VRAM reduction is the only path to single-node tuning of Behemoth-class MoE models. Bear case is a competing scaling-law preprint showing the accuracy gap widens past 200B parameters and forcing a hybrid mode; absent that, Q4 2026 lands router-only as the documented default across the cohort.

prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q4 2026 la convergencia LoRA solo-router del 8 de mayo — el preprint conjunto en arxiv de Unsloth + Hugging Face reportando 71-78% de recuperación de la precisión de full-LoRA-en-expertos al 8-13% del tiempo de paso de entrenamiento y al 11-16% del VRAM pico a través de una ablación de cuatro modelos (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), las recetas de producción del mismo día de Unsloth para tuning de Llama 4 Behemoth en nodo único, Kimi K2.6 en una workstation de 96GB, y Mixtral 8x22B para clientes sovereign-cloud, el preprint paralelo de DeepMind sobre descomposición de ventaja consciente del router cerrando la brecha de estabilidad de Reinforcement Learning de contexto largo que previamente mantenía el modo solo-router fuera del entrenamiento de contexto ultra-largo, y el anuncio de muestra de ingeniería del CS-4 de Cerebras nombrando explícitamente el entrenamiento solo-router de Mixture-of-Experts más Reinforcement Learning de contexto ultra-largo como la carga de trabajo objetivo — juntos fuerzan al modo de adaptación solo-router fuera de la categoría específica de Unsloth y hacia la receta por defecto de fine-tuning enviada por cada stack importante de entrenamiento dentro de la misma ventana calendario. description.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月8日のデュアル・ファイリング—Nvidiaの8-KがVera Rubinサンプリングが上位10ハイパースケーラー・ネオクラウド口座のうち9社で本番ボリューム顧客コミットメントに到達したことと、現行Blackwell B200の~1,000 NVL72ラック/週生産ケイデンスでH1 2027 NVL576ラック売上のバックログが2027年Q3までカバー済みであることを開示、加えてAMDのCFOによる5月5日プリントへの8-K補足がMicrosoft Azure、Oracle、OpenAIの定常1GW初データセンター、Crusoe、CoreWeave、Lambda、さらに非開示だった0.8GW Tencent Cloudのアジア太平洋展開コミットメントを横断する6.2GW総Helios + MI450 H2 2026コミットメント・ブックを確認—に、同日のCerebras CS-4エンジニアリング・サンプル発表と開示済みOpenAI $10Bマルチイヤー第2データセンター・カバレッジ、Cerebras IPO後の公開市場マルチプルが開示済みAIアクセラレータ売上の下に置かれること、SEC Corp Finのサンプル・コメント・レター・サイクルがMag-7コホートに資本配分の帰属と顧客集中脚注で圧力をかけることが組み合わさり、AIアクセラレータ・ベンダー(Nvidia、AMD、Cerebrasに加え、その背後のSambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1コホート)に対し、決算リリースとは別の標準開示形状として、構造化された四半期途中のフォワード・サプライ8K事前プリント・ケイデンスを採用することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、ひとたびデュオポリーの2発行体が同日にカスタマー命名GW図付きデュアル・フォワード・サプライ8-Kを出荷すれば、セルサイドのカバレッジとSEC Corp Finスタッフがこのフォーマットをフォワード可視性開示の運用上のテンプレートとして扱うことであり、決算間の沈黙が規範ではなく異常事態となる。最も可能性の高い形状は、生産ケイデンス、顧客別GWまたはラック数コミットメント、重要な場合の地域別分割、フォワード売上カバレッジ・ウィンドウを命名する反復的な四半期途中の8-Kである。ベアケースはSEC Corp Finが選択的開示Reg FDガイダンスを発出してケイデンスを決算コール限定の領域へ押し戻すこと;それがなければ、2026年Q4のQ3プリント・サイクルではアクセラレータ発行体ごとに少なくとも2件の事前アナウンス8-Kが先行する形で着地する。
description.es: Para Q4 2026 la presentación dual del 8 de mayo — el 8-K de Nvidia revelando que el sampling de Vera Rubin ha alcanzado compromisos de cliente a volumen de producción para nueve de los diez principales hyperscalers y cuentas neocloud con el backlog de ingresos de racks NVL576 H1 2027 ahora cubierto hasta Q3 2027 a la cadencia actual de producción de Blackwell B200 de ~1,000 racks NVL72/semana, más el suplemento 8-K del CFO de AMD al print del 5 de mayo confirmando un libro de compromisos total de Helios + MI450 H2 2026 de 6.2GW a través de Microsoft Azure, Oracle, el primer data center 1GW pendiente de OpenAI, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, más un compromiso previamente no revelado de 0.8GW de Tencent Cloud para despliegue Asia-Pacífico — combinada con el anuncio del mismo día de muestra de ingeniería del CS-4 de Cerebras más la cobertura revelada de OpenAI de $10B multi-año del segundo data center, el múltiplo público post-IPO de Cerebras anclado bajo los ingresos revelados de aceleradores AI, y el ciclo de cartas de comentarios de muestra de SEC Corp Fin presionando a la cohorte Mag-7 sobre atribución de asignación de capital y notas al pie de concentración de clientes, fuerzan a los vendedores de aceleradores AI (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, más la cohorte S-1 de SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent detrás de ellos) a adoptar una cadencia estructurada de pre-impresión de 8-K de suministro a mitad de trimestre como la forma estándar de revelación, separada de los releases de earnings. La función forzante es que una vez que dos emisores duopolio envían 8-Ks duales del mismo día de suministro adelantado con cifras de compromiso de GW por cliente nombrado, la cobertura sell-side y el personal de SEC Corp Fin tratan el formato como la plantilla operativa para revelación de visibilidad adelantada — el silencio entre earnings se vuelve la anomalía en lugar de la norma. La forma más probable es un 8-K recurrente a mitad de trimestre nombrando cadencia de producción, compromisos de GW o conteo de racks por cliente, divisiones por región geográfica donde sean materiales, y ventanas de cobertura de ingresos adelantados. El caso bajista es que SEC Corp Fin emita guía Reg FD sobre revelación selectiva que empuje la cadencia de vuelta al territorio de solo-llamadas-de-earnings; sin eso, para Q4 2026 el ciclo del print Q3 aterriza con al menos dos 8-Ks de pre-anuncio previos por emisor de aceleradores.
description.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026, ang May 8 dual filing — ang 8-K ng Nvidia na naglalantad na ang Vera Rubin sampling ay umabot na sa production-volume customer commitments para sa siyam sa nangungunang sampung hyperscaler at neocloud accounts na may H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue na backlog-covered hanggang Q3 2027 sa kasalukuyang Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, kasama ang AMD CFO 8-K supplement sa May 5 print na nagkukumpirma ng 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book sa Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, kasama ang dating-undisclosed na 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment para sa Asia-Pacific deployment — kasama ng same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement at inilantad na OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, ang post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple na naka-anchor sa ilalim ng inilantad na AI-accelerator revenue, at ang SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle na pinipilit ang Mag-7 cohort sa capital-allocation attribution at customer-concentration footnotes, ay pumipilit sa AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, kasama ang SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort sa likuran nila) na mag-adopt ng structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence bilang standard disclosure shape, hiwalay sa earnings releases. Ang forcing function ay kapag dalawang duopoly issuers ay nag-ship na ng dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks na may named-customer commitment GW figures, itinuturing na ng sell-side coverage at SEC Corp Fin staff ang format bilang operative template para sa forward-visibility disclosure — ang katahimikan sa pagitan ng earnings ay nagiging anomaly imbis na norm. Ang most likely shape ay isang recurring mid-quarter 8-K na nagngangalan ng production cadence, customer-by-customer GW o rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits kung saan material, at forward-revenue-coverage windows. Ang bear case ay ang SEC Corp Fin na maglabas ng Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance na nagtutulak sa cadence pabalik sa earnings-call-only territory; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 print cycle bago ang Q4 2026 na may hindi bababa sa dalawang prior pre-announcement 8-Ks bawat accelerator issuer.

Bear case is SEC Corp Fin issuing Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance that pushes the cadence back into earnings-call-only territory; absent that, by Q4 2026 the Q3 print cycle lands with at least two prior pre-announcement 8-Ks per accelerator issuer.
summary.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月8日のデュアル・ファイリング—Nvidiaの8-KがVera Rubinサンプリングが上位10ハイパースケーラー・ネオクラウド口座のうち9社で本番ボリューム顧客コミットメントに到達したことと、現行Blackwell B200の~1,000 NVL72ラック/週生産ケイデンスでH1 2027 NVL576ラック売上のバックログが2027年Q3までカバー済みであることを開示、加えてAMDのCFOによる5月5日プリントへの8-K補足がMicrosoft Azure、Oracle、OpenAIの定常1GW初データセンター、Crusoe、CoreWeave、Lambda、さらに非開示だった0.8GW Tencent Cloudのアジア太平洋展開コミットメントを横断する6.2GW総Helios + MI450 H2 2026コミットメント・ブックを確認—に、同日のCerebras CS-4エンジニアリング・サンプル発表と開示済みOpenAI $10Bマルチイヤー第2データセンター・カバレッジ、Cerebras IPO後の公開市場マルチプルが開示済みAIアクセラレータ売上の下に置かれること、SEC Corp Finのサンプル・コメント・レター・サイクルがMag-7コホートに資本配分の帰属と顧客集中脚注で圧力をかけることが組み合わさり、AIアクセラレータ・ベンダー(Nvidia、AMD、Cerebrasに加え、その背後のSambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1コホート)に対し、決算リリースとは別の標準開示形状として、構造化された四半期途中のフォワード・サプライ8K事前プリント・ケイデンスを採用することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、ひとたびデュオポリーの2発行体が同日にカスタマー命名GW図付きデュアル・フォワード・サプライ8-Kを出荷すれば、セルサイドのカバレッジとSEC Corp Finスタッフがこのフォーマットをフォワード可視性開示の運用上のテンプレートとして扱うことであり、決算間の沈黙が規範ではなく異常事態となる。最も可能性の高い形状は、生産ケイデンス、顧客別GWまたはラック数コミットメント、重要な場合の地域別分割、フォワード売上カバレッジ・ウィンドウを命名する反復的な四半期途中の8-Kである。ベアケースはSEC Corp Finが選択的開示Reg FDガイダンスを発出してケイデンスを決算コール限定の領域へ押し戻すこと;それがなければ、2026年Q4のQ3プリント・サイクルではアクセラレータ発行体ごとに少なくとも2件の事前アナウンス8-Kが先行する形で着地する。
summary.es: Para Q4 2026 la presentación dual del 8 de mayo — el 8-K de Nvidia revelando que el sampling de Vera Rubin ha alcanzado compromisos de cliente a volumen de producción para nueve de los diez principales hyperscalers y cuentas neocloud con el backlog de ingresos de racks NVL576 H1 2027 ahora cubierto hasta Q3 2027 a la cadencia actual de producción de Blackwell B200 de ~1,000 racks NVL72/semana, más el suplemento 8-K del CFO de AMD al print del 5 de mayo confirmando un libro de compromisos total de Helios + MI450 H2 2026 de 6.2GW a través de Microsoft Azure, Oracle, el primer data center 1GW pendiente de OpenAI, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, más un compromiso previamente no revelado de 0.8GW de Tencent Cloud para despliegue Asia-Pacífico — combinada con el anuncio del mismo día de muestra de ingeniería del CS-4 de Cerebras más la cobertura revelada de OpenAI de $10B multi-año del segundo data center, el múltiplo público post-IPO de Cerebras anclado bajo los ingresos revelados de aceleradores AI, y el ciclo de cartas de comentarios de muestra de SEC Corp Fin presionando a la cohorte Mag-7 sobre atribución de asignación de capital y notas al pie de concentración de clientes, fuerzan a los vendedores de aceleradores AI (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, más la cohorte S-1 de SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent detrás de ellos) a adoptar una cadencia estructurada de pre-impresión de 8-K de suministro a mitad de trimestre como la forma estándar de revelación, separada de los releases de earnings. La función forzante es que una vez que dos emisores duopolio envían 8-Ks duales del mismo día de suministro adelantado con cifras de compromiso de GW por cliente nombrado, la cobertura sell-side y el personal de SEC Corp Fin tratan el formato como la plantilla operativa para revelación de visibilidad adelantada — el silencio entre earnings se vuelve la anomalía en lugar de la norma. La forma más probable es un 8-K recurrente a mitad de trimestre nombrando cadencia de producción, compromisos de GW o conteo de racks por cliente, divisiones por región geográfica donde sean materiales, y ventanas de cobertura de ingresos adelantados. El caso bajista es que SEC Corp Fin emita guía Reg FD sobre revelación selectiva que empuje la cadencia de vuelta al territorio de solo-llamadas-de-earnings; sin eso, para Q4 2026 el ciclo del print Q3 aterriza con al menos dos 8-Ks de pre-anuncio previos por emisor de aceleradores.
summary.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026, ang May 8 dual filing — ang 8-K ng Nvidia na naglalantad na ang Vera Rubin sampling ay umabot na sa production-volume customer commitments para sa siyam sa nangungunang sampung hyperscaler at neocloud accounts na may H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue na backlog-covered hanggang Q3 2027 sa kasalukuyang Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, kasama ang AMD CFO 8-K supplement sa May 5 print na nagkukumpirma ng 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book sa Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, kasama ang dating-undisclosed na 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment para sa Asia-Pacific deployment — kasama ng same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement at inilantad na OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, ang post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple na naka-anchor sa ilalim ng inilantad na AI-accelerator revenue, at ang SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle na pinipilit ang Mag-7 cohort sa capital-allocation attribution at customer-concentration footnotes, ay pumipilit sa AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, kasama ang SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort sa likuran nila) na mag-adopt ng structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence bilang standard disclosure shape, hiwalay sa earnings releases. Ang forcing function ay kapag dalawang duopoly issuers ay nag-ship na ng dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks na may named-customer commitment GW figures, itinuturing na ng sell-side coverage at SEC Corp Fin staff ang format bilang operative template para sa forward-visibility disclosure — ang katahimikan sa pagitan ng earnings ay nagiging anomaly imbis na norm. Ang most likely shape ay isang recurring mid-quarter 8-K na nagngangalan ng production cadence, customer-by-customer GW o rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits kung saan material, at forward-revenue-coverage windows. Ang bear case ay ang SEC Corp Fin na maglabas ng Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance na nagtutulak sa cadence pabalik sa earnings-call-only territory; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 print cycle bago ang Q4 2026 na may hindi bababa sa dalawang prior pre-announcement 8-Ks bawat accelerator issuer.

bridges.text: AMD's Helios/MI450 commitment book passes 8.7GW with SK Hynix Cheongju 0.5GW and Naver Cloud 0.2GW Wednesday additions, plus first production-rack samples shipping to Azure and Tencent Cloud; Cerebras's post-IPO call discloses a $4B Apple supply agreement with Q2 2027 allocation; Nvidia's Vera Rubin update places NVL576 first samples at Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, Oracle with second-batch slated for Q4 2026.

text_locales.en: AMD's Helios/MI450 commitment book passes 8.7GW with SK Hynix Cheongju 0.5GW and Naver Cloud 0.2GW Wednesday additions, plus first production-rack samples shipping to Azure and Tencent Cloud; Cerebras's post-IPO call discloses a $4B Apple supply agreement with Q2 2027 allocation; Nvidia's Vera Rubin update places NVL576 first samples at Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, Oracle with second-batch slated for Q4 2026.
text_locales.ja: AMDのHelios/MI450コミットメントブックは、水曜のSK Hynix Cheongju 0.5GWおよびナバークラウド0.2GWの追加で8.7GWを突破し、最初の量産ラックサンプルがAzureおよびTencent Cloudへ出荷された。CerebrasのIPO後の投資家向け説明では40億ドルのApple供給契約が開示され、2027年Q2への配分が明示された。NvidiaのVera Rubin更新ではNVL576初回サンプルがAzure、Google Cloud、AWS、Oracleへ届けられ、第二バッチが2026年Q4に予定されている。
text_locales.es: La cartera de compromisos Helios/MI450 de AMD supera los 8,7 GW con las adiciones del miércoles de SK Hynix Cheongju 0,5 GW y Naver Cloud 0,2 GW, además del envío de las primeras muestras de rack de producción a Azure y Tencent Cloud; la llamada post-IPO de Cerebras divulga un acuerdo de suministro de 4.000 millones de dólares con Apple con asignación para Q2 2027; la actualización de Vera Rubin de Nvidia coloca las primeras muestras de NVL576 en Azure, Google Cloud, AWS y Oracle, con la segunda tanda destinada al Q4 2026.
text_locales.fil: Tumatawid ang AMD's Helios/MI450 commitment book sa 8.7GW kasama ang SK Hynix Cheongju 0.5GW at Naver Cloud 0.2GW Miyerkules additions, plus unang production-rack samples na ipinapadala sa Azure at Tencent Cloud; inihayag ng post-IPO call ng Cerebras ang $4B Apple supply agreement na may Q2 2027 allocation; inilalagay ng Nvidia's Vera Rubin update ang NVL576 unang samples sa Azure, Google Cloud, AWS, Oracle kasama ang second-batch na nakatakda para sa Q4 2026.

detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 8 dual filing — Nvidia's 8-K disclosing that Vera Rubin sampling has reached production-volume customer commitments for nine of the top ten hyperscaler and neocloud accounts with H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue backlog-covered through Q3 2027 at the current Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, plus AMD's CFO 8-K supplement to the May 5 print confirming a 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book across Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI's standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, plus a previously-undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment for Asia-Pacific deployment — combined with the same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement plus disclosed OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, the post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple anchored under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, and the SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle pressing the Mag-7 cohort on capital-allocation attribution and customer-concentration footnotes, force AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, plus the SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort behind them) to adopt a structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence as the standard disclosure shape, separate from earnings releases. The forcing function is that once two duopoly issuers ship dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks with named-customer commitment GW figures, sell-side coverage and SEC Corp Fin staff treat the format as the operative template for forward-visibility disclosure — silence between earnings becomes the anomaly rather than the norm. The most likely shape is a recurring mid-quarter 8-K naming production cadence, customer-by-customer GW or rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits where material, and forward-revenue-coverage windows. Bear case is SEC Corp Fin issuing Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance that pushes the cadence back into earnings-call-only territory; absent that, by Q4 2026 the Q3 print cycle lands with at least two prior pre-announcement 8-Ks per accelerator issuer.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年Q4までに、5月8日のデュアル・ファイリング—Nvidiaの8-KがVera Rubinサンプリングが上位10ハイパースケーラー・ネオクラウド口座のうち9社で本番ボリューム顧客コミットメントに到達したことと、現行Blackwell B200の~1,000 NVL72ラック/週生産ケイデンスでH1 2027 NVL576ラック売上のバックログが2027年Q3までカバー済みであることを開示、加えてAMDのCFOによる5月5日プリントへの8-K補足がMicrosoft Azure、Oracle、OpenAIの定常1GW初データセンター、Crusoe、CoreWeave、Lambda、さらに非開示だった0.8GW Tencent Cloudのアジア太平洋展開コミットメントを横断する6.2GW総Helios + MI450 H2 2026コミットメント・ブックを確認—に、同日のCerebras CS-4エンジニアリング・サンプル発表と開示済みOpenAI $10Bマルチイヤー第2データセンター・カバレッジ、Cerebras IPO後の公開市場マルチプルが開示済みAIアクセラレータ売上の下に置かれること、SEC Corp Finのサンプル・コメント・レター・サイクルがMag-7コホートに資本配分の帰属と顧客集中脚注で圧力をかけることが組み合わさり、AIアクセラレータ・ベンダー(Nvidia、AMD、Cerebrasに加え、その背後のSambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1コホート)に対し、決算リリースとは別の標準開示形状として、構造化された四半期途中のフォワード・サプライ8K事前プリント・ケイデンスを採用することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、ひとたびデュオポリーの2発行体が同日にカスタマー命名GW図付きデュアル・フォワード・サプライ8-Kを出荷すれば、セルサイドのカバレッジとSEC Corp Finスタッフがこのフォーマットをフォワード可視性開示の運用上のテンプレートとして扱うことであり、決算間の沈黙が規範ではなく異常事態となる。最も可能性の高い形状は、生産ケイデンス、顧客別GWまたはラック数コミットメント、重要な場合の地域別分割、フォワード売上カバレッジ・ウィンドウを命名する反復的な四半期途中の8-Kである。ベアケースはSEC Corp Finが選択的開示Reg FDガイダンスを発出してケイデンスを決算コール限定の領域へ押し戻すこと;それがなければ、2026年Q4のQ3プリント・サイクルではアクセラレータ発行体ごとに少なくとも2件の事前アナウンス8-Kが先行する形で着地する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q4 2026 la presentación dual del 8 de mayo — el 8-K de Nvidia revelando que el sampling de Vera Rubin ha alcanzado compromisos de cliente a volumen de producción para nueve de los diez principales hyperscalers y cuentas neocloud con el backlog de ingresos de racks NVL576 H1 2027 ahora cubierto hasta Q3 2027 a la cadencia actual de producción de Blackwell B200 de ~1,000 racks NVL72/semana, más el suplemento 8-K del CFO de AMD al print del 5 de mayo confirmando un libro de compromisos total de Helios + MI450 H2 2026 de 6.2GW a través de Microsoft Azure, Oracle, el primer data center 1GW pendiente de OpenAI, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, más un compromiso previamente no revelado de 0.8GW de Tencent Cloud para despliegue Asia-Pacífico — combinada con el anuncio del mismo día de muestra de ingeniería del CS-4 de Cerebras más la cobertura revelada de OpenAI de $10B multi-año del segundo data center, el múltiplo público post-IPO de Cerebras anclado bajo los ingresos revelados de aceleradores AI, y el ciclo de cartas de comentarios de muestra de SEC Corp Fin presionando a la cohorte Mag-7 sobre atribución de asignación de capital y notas al pie de concentración de clientes, fuerzan a los vendedores de aceleradores AI (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, más la cohorte S-1 de SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent detrás de ellos) a adoptar una cadencia estructurada de pre-impresión de 8-K de suministro a mitad de trimestre como la forma estándar de revelación, separada de los releases de earnings. La función forzante es que una vez que dos emisores duopolio envían 8-Ks duales del mismo día de suministro adelantado con cifras de compromiso de GW por cliente nombrado, la cobertura sell-side y el personal de SEC Corp Fin tratan el formato como la plantilla operativa para revelación de visibilidad adelantada — el silencio entre earnings se vuelve la anomalía en lugar de la norma. La forma más probable es un 8-K recurrente a mitad de trimestre nombrando cadencia de producción, compromisos de GW o conteo de racks por cliente, divisiones por región geográfica donde sean materiales, y ventanas de cobertura de ingresos adelantados. El caso bajista es que SEC Corp Fin emita guía Reg FD sobre revelación selectiva que empuje la cadencia de vuelta al territorio de solo-llamadas-de-earnings; sin eso, para Q4 2026 el ciclo del print Q3 aterriza con al menos dos 8-Ks de pre-anuncio previos por emisor de aceleradores.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q4 2026, ang May 8 dual filing — ang 8-K ng Nvidia na naglalantad na ang Vera Rubin sampling ay umabot na sa production-volume customer commitments para sa siyam sa nangungunang sampung hyperscaler at neocloud accounts na may H1 2027 NVL576 rack revenue na backlog-covered hanggang Q3 2027 sa kasalukuyang Blackwell B200 ~1,000 NVL72 rack/week production cadence, kasama ang AMD CFO 8-K supplement sa May 5 print na nagkukumpirma ng 6.2GW total Helios + MI450 H2 2026 commitment book sa Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI standing 1GW first data center, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, kasama ang dating-undisclosed na 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment para sa Asia-Pacific deployment — kasama ng same-day Cerebras CS-4 engineering-sample announcement at inilantad na OpenAI $10B multi-year second-data-center coverage, ang post-Cerebras-IPO public-market multiple na naka-anchor sa ilalim ng inilantad na AI-accelerator revenue, at ang SEC Corp Fin sample comment letter cycle na pinipilit ang Mag-7 cohort sa capital-allocation attribution at customer-concentration footnotes, ay pumipilit sa AI-accelerator vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Cerebras, kasama ang SambaNova / Groq / Tenstorrent S-1 cohort sa likuran nila) na mag-adopt ng structured mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K pre-print cadence bilang standard disclosure shape, hiwalay sa earnings releases. Ang forcing function ay kapag dalawang duopoly issuers ay nag-ship na ng dual same-day forward-supply 8-Ks na may named-customer commitment GW figures, itinuturing na ng sell-side coverage at SEC Corp Fin staff ang format bilang operative template para sa forward-visibility disclosure — ang katahimikan sa pagitan ng earnings ay nagiging anomaly imbis na norm. Ang most likely shape ay isang recurring mid-quarter 8-K na nagngangalan ng production cadence, customer-by-customer GW o rack-count commitments, geographic-region splits kung saan material, at forward-revenue-coverage windows. Ang bear case ay ang SEC Corp Fin na maglabas ng Reg FD selective-disclosure guidance na nagtutulak sa cadence pabalik sa earnings-call-only territory; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 print cycle bago ang Q4 2026 na may hindi bababa sa dalawang prior pre-announcement 8-Ks bawat accelerator issuer.

nodes.title: AISI cyber-eval reciprocity locks in as allied procurement gate by Q3 2026
nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the May 8 reciprocity-perimeter expansion — Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI publishing a parallel memorandum-of-cooperation accepting AISI-administered TLO-range cyber-evaluation runs as satisfying their respective frontier-model voluntary-disclosure regimes (120-day placement window) inside 24 hours of the May 7 EU-UK joint memorandum, with Canada CCCS and Australia ASD ACSC pre-committing to mirror language by Q3 2026 and the Mythos + GPT-5.5 results cited as the operational threshold — combined with HM Treasury's same-day extension of the public-sector LLM-coding-assistant procurement pause to a 30-day formal review naming Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini Code Assist, and Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Government tenants in a temporarily-suspended-vendors annex pending Mythos-class capability disclosure under the AI Procurement Common Standard, force the AISI-administered cyber-evaluation regime to consolidate as the operative gating criterion for sovereign + allied public-sector AI procurement across at least six jurisdictions before Q3 2026 closes. The forcing function is that once Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI lift the EU-UK template into the Indo-Pacific within one news cycle and a Five Eyes member (UK) names the Big-4 frontier-lab + hyperscaler-coding-assistant cohort by vendor in a procurement-freeze annex, the absence of a parallel US recognition pathway converts the FMRB executive order draft from a domestic-disclosure question into a market-access question for US-based labs. The most likely shape is a six-or-seven-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter (UK + EU + Singapore + Japan + Canada + Australia, with New Zealand or South Korea as the seventh) treating an AISI-administered cyber-eval pass as a per-tenant Mythos-class capability disclosure, paired with a UK + EU + at-least-one-Indo-Pacific allied named-vendor procurement-gate annex tied to that pass. Bear case is that the FMRB EO ships first with §708-equivalent reciprocal recognition language and short-circuits the multilateral path; absent that, Q3 2026 lands the perimeter as the operative procurement gate.

description.ja: 2026年Q3までに、5月8日のレシプロシティ境界拡大—Singapore IMDAとJapan AISIが、5月7日のEU-UK共同覚書から24時間以内に、AISI管理下のTLOレンジ・サイバー評価ランがそれぞれのフロンティア・モデル任意開示レジームを満たすものとする並行した協力覚書を120日プレースメント・ウィンドウ付きで公表、Canada CCCSとAustralia ASD ACSCがオブザーバーとして調印し2026年Q3までにミラー言語をプリ・コミット、MythosとGPT-5.5の結果が運用上の閾値として引用される—が、HM Treasuryの同日延長による公的部門LLMコーディング・アシスタント調達一時停止の30日正式レビューへの拡張(AI Procurement Common Standardの下でのMythosクラス能力開示が条件の一時停止ベンダー附属書にAnthropic、OpenAI、Google Gemini Code Assist、Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Governmentテナントを命名)と組み合わさり、AISI管理下のサイバー評価レジームを少なくとも6管轄区域にまたがるソブリン + 同盟国の公的部門AI調達のための運用上のゲーティング基準として、2026年Q3が閉じる前に統合することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、ひとたびSingapore IMDAとJapan AISIがEU-UKテンプレートを1ニュース・サイクル以内にインド太平洋へ持ち上げ、Five Eyesメンバー(UK)が調達凍結附属書でBig-4フロンティア・ラボ + ハイパースケーラー・コーディング・アシスタント・コホートをベンダー名で命名すれば、並行する米国認知パスの不在がFMRB大統領令ドラフトを国内開示の問題から米国拠点ラボへの市場アクセス問題へと転換させることである。最も可能性の高い形状は6〜7管轄区域(UK + EU + Singapore + Japan + Canada + Australia、第7としてNew ZealandまたはSouth Korea)のレシプロシティ境界がAISI管理下のサイバー評価通過をテナントごとのMythosクラス能力開示として扱い、UK + EU + 少なくとも1つのインド太平洋同盟国によるベンダー名付き調達ゲート附属書がその通過に紐づく。ベアケースはFMRB大統領令が§708相当の相互認知言語を伴って先に出荷され、多国間パスを短絡させること;それがなければ、2026年Q3に当該境界が運用上の調達ゲートとして着地する。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 la expansión del perímetro de reciprocidad del 8 de mayo — Singapur IMDA + Japón AISI publicando un memorándum-de-cooperación paralelo aceptando ejecuciones de evaluación cyber de rango TLO administradas por AISI como satisfaciendo sus respectivos regímenes de revelación voluntaria de modelos frontera (ventana de colocación de 120 días) dentro de las 24 horas del memorándum conjunto EU-UK del 7 de mayo, con Canadá CCCS y Australia ASD ACSC pre-comprometiéndose a reflejar el lenguaje para Q3 2026 y los resultados de Mythos + GPT-5.5 citados como el umbral operacional — combinada con la extensión del mismo día de HM Treasury de la pausa de adquisición de asistentes de codificación LLM del sector público a una revisión formal de 30 días nombrando a Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini Code Assist, y Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Government tenants en un anexo de vendedores temporalmente suspendidos pendiente de revelación de capacidad clase Mythos bajo el AI Procurement Common Standard, fuerzan al régimen de evaluación cyber administrado por AISI a consolidarse como el criterio operativo de gating para adquisición soberana + aliada del sector público AI a través de al menos seis jurisdicciones antes de que cierre Q3 2026. La función forzante es que una vez que Singapur IMDA + Japón AISI elevan la plantilla EU-UK al Indo-Pacífico dentro de un ciclo de noticias y un miembro de Five Eyes (Reino Unido) nombra a la cohorte Big-4 de laboratorios frontera + asistente de codificación hyperscaler por vendedor en un anexo de congelación de adquisición, la ausencia de una ruta paralela de reconocimiento de EE.UU. convierte el borrador de orden ejecutiva del FMRB de una pregunta de revelación doméstica en una pregunta de acceso al mercado para los laboratorios con base en EE.UU. La forma más probable es un perímetro de reciprocidad de seis-o-siete jurisdicciones (Reino Unido + UE + Singapur + Japón + Canadá + Australia, con Nueva Zelanda o Corea del Sur como séptima) tratando una aprobación de eval cyber administrada por AISI como una revelación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant, emparejado con un anexo de puerta de adquisición de vendedor nombrado en Reino Unido + UE + al-menos-una jurisdicción aliada Indo-Pacífica atado a esa aprobación. El caso bajista es que el EO del FMRB se envíe primero con lenguaje de reconocimiento recíproco equivalente a §708 y haga corto-circuito en la senda multilateral; sin eso, Q3 2026 aterriza el perímetro como la puerta de adquisición operativa.
description.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026, ang May 8 reciprocity-perimeter expansion — ang Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI na naglalathala ng parallel memorandum-of-cooperation na tumatanggap sa AISI-administered TLO-range cyber-evaluation runs bilang sumasapat sa kani-kanilang frontier-model voluntary-disclosure regimes (120-day placement window) sa loob ng 24 oras ng May 7 EU-UK joint memorandum, kasama ang Canada CCCS at Australia ASD ACSC na pre-committing na i-mirror ang language bago ang Q3 2026 at ang Mythos + GPT-5.5 results na binanggit bilang operational threshold — kasama ng same-day extension ng HM Treasury sa public-sector LLM-coding-assistant procurement pause papuntang 30-day formal review na nagngangalan sa Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini Code Assist, at Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Government tenants sa isang temporarily-suspended-vendors annex pending Mythos-class capability disclosure sa ilalim ng AI Procurement Common Standard, ay pumipilit sa AISI-administered cyber-evaluation regime na mag-consolidate bilang operative gating criterion para sa sovereign + allied public-sector AI procurement sa hindi bababa sa anim na jurisdictions bago magsara ang Q3 2026. Ang forcing function ay kapag ang Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI ay itinaas ang EU-UK template sa Indo-Pacific sa loob ng isang news cycle at isang Five Eyes member (UK) ay nagngangalan sa Big-4 frontier-lab + hyperscaler-coding-assistant cohort by vendor sa isang procurement-freeze annex, ang kawalan ng parallel US recognition pathway ay nag-co-convert sa FMRB executive order draft mula sa domestic-disclosure question papuntang market-access question para sa US-based labs. Ang most likely shape ay isang anim-o-pitong jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter (UK + EU + Singapore + Japan + Canada + Australia, na may New Zealand o South Korea bilang ikapito) na itinuturing ang AISI-administered cyber-eval pass bilang per-tenant Mythos-class capability disclosure, na pinares sa UK + EU + at-least-one-Indo-Pacific allied named-vendor procurement-gate annex na nakatali sa pass na iyon. Ang bear case ay ang FMRB EO na unang ina-ship na may §708-equivalent reciprocal recognition language at nagpapaikli sa multilateral path; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 2026 sa perimeter bilang operative procurement gate.

text_locales.ja: タイのNCSAとデジタル経済社会省の水曜エントリーノートにより、インド太平洋コホートは指名11管轄圏(正式4、オブザーバー7)へ拡大し、チリとメキシコが初の半球横断延伸として加わった。OpenAIの組織単位エージェントレジストリはシンガポール・日本のソブリンクラウドでGA化され、相互承認属性フィールドが運用上のテナントポリシースキーマとして参照されており、米国の認知ギャップが調達ゲートの観点で広がっている。
text_locales.es: La nota de entrada del miércoles de la NCSA de Tailandia más el Ministerio de Economía Digital y Sociedad eleva la cohorte Indo-Pacífico a once jurisdicciones nombradas (cuatro formales, siete observadoras) más Chile y México como la primera extensión transhemisférica; la GA del registro de agentes por organización de OpenAI en la nube soberana de Singapur y Japón cita los campos de atestación de reciprocidad como esquema operativo de política de inquilino, ampliando la brecha de reconocimiento de EE. UU. sobre el marco de puerta de adquisición de la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Nag-aangat ang Miyerkules entry note ng NCSA ng Thailand plus Ministry of Digital Economy and Society ang Indo-Pacific cohort sa labing-isang named jurisdictions (apat pormal, pito observers) plus Chile at Mexico bilang unang cross-hemispheric extension; binabanggit ng OpenAI's per-org agent registry GA sa Singapore at Japan sovereign-cloud ang reciprocity-attestation fields bilang operative tenant-policy schema, na nagpapalawak sa US recognition gap sa procurement-gate frame ng prediksyon.

bridges.text: Thailand's NCSA plus Ministry of Digital Economy and Society Tuesday entry note lifts the Indo-Pacific cohort to eleven named jurisdictions (four formal, seven observers) plus Chile and Mexico as the first cross-hemispheric extension; OpenAI's per-org agent registry GA on Singapore and Japan sovereign-cloud cites reciprocity-attestation fields as operative tenant-policy schema, widening the US recognition gap on the prediction's procurement-gate frame.

text_locales.en: Thailand's NCSA plus Ministry of Digital Economy and Society Tuesday entry note lifts the Indo-Pacific cohort to eleven named jurisdictions (four formal, seven observers) plus Chile and Mexico as the first cross-hemispheric extension; OpenAI's per-org agent registry GA on Singapore and Japan sovereign-cloud cites reciprocity-attestation fields as operative tenant-policy schema, widening the US recognition gap on the prediction's procurement-gate frame.
text_locales.ja: ThailandのNCSAプラスMinistry of Digital Economy and Society火曜エントリー・ノートはインド太平洋コホートを11命名管轄区(4つ正式、7つオブザーバー)プラスChileとMexicoを初の半球横断拡張として持ち上げ;OpenAIのオルガニゼーション単位エージェント・レジストリGAは、SingaporeおよびJapan主権クラウド上で相互性アテステーション・フィールドを作動テナント・ポリシー・スキーマとして引用し、予測の調達ゲート・フレーム上の米国認識ギャップを広げる。
text_locales.es: La nota de entrada del martes de la NCSA de Thailand más el Ministerio de Economía Digital y Sociedad eleva la cohorte Indo-Pacífico a once jurisdicciones nombradas (cuatro formales, siete observadores) más Chile y México como la primera extensión cross-hemisférica; la GA del registro de agentes per-org de OpenAI en cloud-soberano Singapur y Japón cita los campos de atestación-de-reciprocidad como el esquema operativo de política de tenant, ampliando la brecha de reconocimiento de EE.UU. en el marco de procurement-gate de la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Inaangat ng Tuesday entry note ng Thailand's NCSA plus Ministry of Digital Economy and Society ang Indo-Pacific cohort patungo sa labing-isang pinangalanang jurisdictions (apat na formal, pitong observers) plus Chile at Mexico bilang unang cross-hemispheric extension; sinisipi ng OpenAI's per-org agent registry GA sa Singapore at Japan sovereign-cloud ang reciprocity-attestation fields bilang operative tenant-policy schema, na nagpapalawak ng US recognition gap sa procurement-gate frame ng prediksyon.

bridges.text: Indonesia BSSN/Kominfo's 150-day observer entry and Vietnam MIC's Track II entry lift the cohort to ten named candidates (four formal: Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand; six observers); Mythos plus GPT-5.5 hold as the threshold; OSTP confirms no FMRB signing window before May 22, widening the US recognition gap precisely as the prediction's procurement-gate frame requires.

text_locales.en: Indonesia BSSN/Kominfo's 150-day observer entry and Vietnam MIC's Track II entry lift the cohort to ten named candidates (four formal: Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand; six observers); Mythos plus GPT-5.5 hold as the threshold; OSTP confirms no FMRB signing window before May 22, widening the US recognition gap precisely as the prediction's procurement-gate frame requires.
text_locales.ja: Indonesia BSSN/Kominfoの150日オブザーバー入りとVietnam MICのTrack IIエントリは、コホートを10命名候補(Singapore、Japan、South Korea、New Zealandの4つが正式;6つがオブザーバー)に引き上げ;MythosプラスGPT-5.5は閾値として維持され;OSTPは5月22日以前にFMRB署名ウィンドウは開かないと確認し、まさに予測の調達ゲート・フレームが要求する通りに米国認識ギャップを広げる。
text_locales.es: La entrada de track de observador de 150 días de Indonesia BSSN/Kominfo y la entrada Track II de Vietnam MIC elevan la cohorte a diez candidatos nombrados (cuatro formales: Singapur, Japón, Corea del Sur, Nueva Zelanda; seis observadores); Mythos más GPT-5.5 se mantienen como el umbral; OSTP confirma sin ventana de firma FMRB antes del 22 de mayo, ampliando la brecha de reconocimiento de EE.UU. precisamente como requiere el marco de procurement-gate de la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Inaangat ng Indonesia BSSN/Kominfo's 150-day observer entry at Vietnam MIC's Track II entry ang cohort sa sampung named candidates (apat na formal: Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand; anim na observers); hawak ang Mythos plus GPT-5.5 bilang threshold; kinukumpirma ng OSTP ang walang FMRB signing window bago ang May 22, na nagpapalawak sa US recognition gap nang eksaktong ayon sa procurement-gate frame ng prediksyon.

bridges.text: India's MeitY plus CERT-In Sunday observer-track filing and Taiwan NICS's parallel Track II entry widen the reciprocity perimeter to eight named jurisdictions (UK, EU, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand formal; Canada, Australia, India, Taiwan observers); Mythos and GPT-5.5 hold as the operational threshold while OSTP confirms no FMRB signing window before May 22 — widening the US recognition gap that the prediction's procurement-gate frame requires.

text_locales.en: India's MeitY plus CERT-In Sunday observer-track filing and Taiwan NICS's parallel Track II entry widen the reciprocity perimeter to eight named jurisdictions (UK, EU, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand formal; Canada, Australia, India, Taiwan observers); Mythos and GPT-5.5 hold as the operational threshold while OSTP confirms no FMRB signing window before May 22 — widening the US recognition gap that the prediction's procurement-gate frame requires.
text_locales.ja: インドMeitYプラスCERT-Inの日曜オブザーバートラック提出と台湾NICSの並行Track IIエントリは、相互性ペリメーターを8つの命名管轄区(英国、EU、シンガポール、日本、韓国、ニュージーランドが正式;カナダ、オーストラリア、インド、台湾がオブザーバー)へ広げる;MythosとGPT-5.5は運用閾値として保持され、OSTPは5月22日以前にFMRB署名ウィンドウは開かないと確認 — 予測の調達ゲート・フレームが必要とする米国認識ギャップを拡大する。
text_locales.es: La presentación de track de observador dominical de India MeitY más CERT-In y la entrada paralela Track II de Taiwan NICS amplía el perímetro de reciprocidad a ocho jurisdicciones nombradas (UK, EU, Singapur, Japón, Corea del Sur, Nueva Zelanda formales; Canadá, Australia, India, Taiwán observadores); Mythos y GPT-5.5 se mantienen como el umbral operacional mientras OSTP confirma que no hay ventana de firma FMRB antes del 22 de mayo — ampliando la brecha de reconocimiento de EE.UU. que el marco de puerta-de-adquisición de la predicción requiere.
text_locales.fil: Pinapalawak ng India's MeitY plus CERT-In Sunday observer-track filing at ng parallel Track II entry ng Taiwan NICS ang reciprocity perimeter sa walong named jurisdictions (UK, EU, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, New Zealand pormal; Canada, Australia, India, Taiwan observers); hawak ang Mythos at GPT-5.5 bilang operational threshold habang kinukumpirma ng OSTP na walang FMRB signing window bago ang Mayo 22 — lumalawak ang US recognition gap na kinakailangan ng procurement-gate frame ng prediksyon.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 the May 8 reciprocity-perimeter expansion — Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI publishing a parallel memorandum-of-cooperation accepting AISI-administered TLO-range cyber-evaluation runs as satisfying their respective frontier-model voluntary-disclosure regimes (120-day placement window) inside 24 hours of the May 7 EU-UK joint memorandum, with Canada CCCS and Australia ASD ACSC pre-committing to mirror language by Q3 2026 and the Mythos + GPT-5.5 results cited as the operational threshold — combined with HM Treasury's same-day extension of the public-sector LLM-coding-assistant procurement pause to a 30-day formal review naming Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini Code Assist, and Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Government tenants in a temporarily-suspended-vendors annex pending Mythos-class capability disclosure under the AI Procurement Common Standard, force the AISI-administered cyber-evaluation regime to consolidate as the operative gating criterion for sovereign + allied public-sector AI procurement across at least six jurisdictions before Q3 2026 closes. The forcing function is that once Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI lift the EU-UK template into the Indo-Pacific within one news cycle and a Five Eyes member (UK) names the Big-4 frontier-lab + hyperscaler-coding-assistant cohort by vendor in a procurement-freeze annex, the absence of a parallel US recognition pathway converts the FMRB executive order draft from a domestic-disclosure question into a market-access question for US-based labs. The most likely shape is a six-or-seven-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter (UK + EU + Singapore + Japan + Canada + Australia, with New Zealand or South Korea as the seventh) treating an AISI-administered cyber-eval pass as a per-tenant Mythos-class capability disclosure, paired with a UK + EU + at-least-one-Indo-Pacific allied named-vendor procurement-gate annex tied to that pass. Bear case is that the FMRB EO ships first with §708-equivalent reciprocal recognition language and short-circuits the multilateral path; absent that, Q3 2026 lands the perimeter as the operative procurement gate.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年Q3までに、5月8日のレシプロシティ境界拡大—Singapore IMDAとJapan AISIが、5月7日のEU-UK共同覚書から24時間以内に、AISI管理下のTLOレンジ・サイバー評価ランがそれぞれのフロンティア・モデル任意開示レジームを満たすものとする並行した協力覚書を120日プレースメント・ウィンドウ付きで公表、Canada CCCSとAustralia ASD ACSCがオブザーバーとして調印し2026年Q3までにミラー言語をプリ・コミット、MythosとGPT-5.5の結果が運用上の閾値として引用される—が、HM Treasuryの同日延長による公的部門LLMコーディング・アシスタント調達一時停止の30日正式レビューへの拡張(AI Procurement Common Standardの下でのMythosクラス能力開示が条件の一時停止ベンダー附属書にAnthropic、OpenAI、Google Gemini Code Assist、Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Governmentテナントを命名)と組み合わさり、AISI管理下のサイバー評価レジームを少なくとも6管轄区域にまたがるソブリン + 同盟国の公的部門AI調達のための運用上のゲーティング基準として、2026年Q3が閉じる前に統合することを強制する。フォーシング・ファンクションは、ひとたびSingapore IMDAとJapan AISIがEU-UKテンプレートを1ニュース・サイクル以内にインド太平洋へ持ち上げ、Five Eyesメンバー(UK)が調達凍結附属書でBig-4フロンティア・ラボ + ハイパースケーラー・コーディング・アシスタント・コホートをベンダー名で命名すれば、並行する米国認知パスの不在がFMRB大統領令ドラフトを国内開示の問題から米国拠点ラボへの市場アクセス問題へと転換させることである。最も可能性の高い形状は6〜7管轄区域(UK + EU + Singapore + Japan + Canada + Australia、第7としてNew ZealandまたはSouth Korea)のレシプロシティ境界がAISI管理下のサイバー評価通過をテナントごとのMythosクラス能力開示として扱い、UK + EU + 少なくとも1つのインド太平洋同盟国によるベンダー名付き調達ゲート附属書がその通過に紐づく。ベアケースはFMRB大統領令が§708相当の相互認知言語を伴って先に出荷され、多国間パスを短絡させること;それがなければ、2026年Q3に当該境界が運用上の調達ゲートとして着地する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q3 2026 la expansión del perímetro de reciprocidad del 8 de mayo — Singapur IMDA + Japón AISI publicando un memorándum-de-cooperación paralelo aceptando ejecuciones de evaluación cyber de rango TLO administradas por AISI como satisfaciendo sus respectivos regímenes de revelación voluntaria de modelos frontera (ventana de colocación de 120 días) dentro de las 24 horas del memorándum conjunto EU-UK del 7 de mayo, con Canadá CCCS y Australia ASD ACSC pre-comprometiéndose a reflejar el lenguaje para Q3 2026 y los resultados de Mythos + GPT-5.5 citados como el umbral operacional — combinada con la extensión del mismo día de HM Treasury de la pausa de adquisición de asistentes de codificación LLM del sector público a una revisión formal de 30 días nombrando a Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini Code Assist, y Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Government tenants en un anexo de vendedores temporalmente suspendidos pendiente de revelación de capacidad clase Mythos bajo el AI Procurement Common Standard, fuerzan al régimen de evaluación cyber administrado por AISI a consolidarse como el criterio operativo de gating para adquisición soberana + aliada del sector público AI a través de al menos seis jurisdicciones antes de que cierre Q3 2026. La función forzante es que una vez que Singapur IMDA + Japón AISI elevan la plantilla EU-UK al Indo-Pacífico dentro de un ciclo de noticias y un miembro de Five Eyes (Reino Unido) nombra a la cohorte Big-4 de laboratorios frontera + asistente de codificación hyperscaler por vendedor en un anexo de congelación de adquisición, la ausencia de una ruta paralela de reconocimiento de EE.UU. convierte el borrador de orden ejecutiva del FMRB de una pregunta de revelación doméstica en una pregunta de acceso al mercado para los laboratorios con base en EE.UU. La forma más probable es un perímetro de reciprocidad de seis-o-siete jurisdicciones (Reino Unido + UE + Singapur + Japón + Canadá + Australia, con Nueva Zelanda o Corea del Sur como séptima) tratando una aprobación de eval cyber administrada por AISI como una revelación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant, emparejado con un anexo de puerta de adquisición de vendedor nombrado en Reino Unido + UE + al-menos-una jurisdicción aliada Indo-Pacífica atado a esa aprobación. El caso bajista es que el EO del FMRB se envíe primero con lenguaje de reconocimiento recíproco equivalente a §708 y haga corto-circuito en la senda multilateral; sin eso, Q3 2026 aterriza el perímetro como la puerta de adquisición operativa.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Bago ang Q3 2026, ang May 8 reciprocity-perimeter expansion — ang Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI na naglalathala ng parallel memorandum-of-cooperation na tumatanggap sa AISI-administered TLO-range cyber-evaluation runs bilang sumasapat sa kani-kanilang frontier-model voluntary-disclosure regimes (120-day placement window) sa loob ng 24 oras ng May 7 EU-UK joint memorandum, kasama ang Canada CCCS at Australia ASD ACSC na pre-committing na i-mirror ang language bago ang Q3 2026 at ang Mythos + GPT-5.5 results na binanggit bilang operational threshold — kasama ng same-day extension ng HM Treasury sa public-sector LLM-coding-assistant procurement pause papuntang 30-day formal review na nagngangalan sa Anthropic, OpenAI, Google Gemini Code Assist, at Microsoft GitHub Copilot for Government tenants sa isang temporarily-suspended-vendors annex pending Mythos-class capability disclosure sa ilalim ng AI Procurement Common Standard, ay pumipilit sa AISI-administered cyber-evaluation regime na mag-consolidate bilang operative gating criterion para sa sovereign + allied public-sector AI procurement sa hindi bababa sa anim na jurisdictions bago magsara ang Q3 2026. Ang forcing function ay kapag ang Singapore IMDA + Japan AISI ay itinaas ang EU-UK template sa Indo-Pacific sa loob ng isang news cycle at isang Five Eyes member (UK) ay nagngangalan sa Big-4 frontier-lab + hyperscaler-coding-assistant cohort by vendor sa isang procurement-freeze annex, ang kawalan ng parallel US recognition pathway ay nag-co-convert sa FMRB executive order draft mula sa domestic-disclosure question papuntang market-access question para sa US-based labs. Ang most likely shape ay isang anim-o-pitong jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter (UK + EU + Singapore + Japan + Canada + Australia, na may New Zealand o South Korea bilang ikapito) na itinuturing ang AISI-administered cyber-eval pass bilang per-tenant Mythos-class capability disclosure, na pinares sa UK + EU + at-least-one-Indo-Pacific allied named-vendor procurement-gate annex na nakatali sa pass na iyon. Ang bear case ay ang FMRB EO na unang ina-ship na may §708-equivalent reciprocal recognition language at nagpapaikli sa multilateral path; kung wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 2026 sa perimeter bilang operative procurement gate.

nodes.description: By Q4 2026 the May 9 disaggregated-prefill convergence forces prefill/decode disaggregation out of the Cloudflare-Infire-specific edge architecture and into the documented default serving mode shipped by vLLM and SGLang at the H100 and L40S tiers. The catalysts landing across a single weekend cycle are concrete and mutually reinforcing: vLLM v0.11.1 ships a disaggregated-prefill mode that, per Cloudflare Infire engineering's Saturday benchmark note, reaches parity with the production Infire edge architecture on prefill throughput at the H100 tier, with Infire retaining only a 1.4x advantage at the L40S edge tier on decode-side latency rather than the order-of-magnitude gap that previously kept disaggregation out of the open-source serving stack; the Yotta Labs benchmark refresh holds the canonical shared-prefix workload at approximately 14,650 tok/s on vLLM versus 17,300 tok/s on SGLang RadixArk, narrowing the throughput gap to a level where the architectural choice (monolithic vs disaggregated) dominates the remaining delta; SGLang RadixArk v0.5.4 ships a parallel architectural primitive in the form of RadixAttention-aware tool-result-cache reuse delivering a 2.1x speedup on tool-calling-heavy agentic workloads, demonstrating that the radix-tree cache substrate generalizes from prefix sharing to tool-call result sharing; and Trail of Bits's full red-team write-up on SGLang RadixArk CVE-2026-44567 (CVSS 8.1 authenticated server-side template injection) plus the v0.11.1 patch for the prefix-cache poisoning CVE-2026-44512 disclosed Friday convert the security narrative from a blocker to a documented disclosure-timeline pattern. The structural force is that once Cloudflare Infire engineering publishes a benchmark showing parity at the H100 tier between its production edge architecture and an open-source serving stack's disaggregated mode, downstream framework maintainers can cite the production-comparable benchmark rather than ship monolithic-mode defaults, and the SGLang radix-tree cache substrate gives a parallel architectural lineage that converges on the same shape. The most likely shape is a disaggregated-prefill/decode mode added as the documented default in the vLLM v0.12 and SGLang RadixArk v0.6 release lines, with per-tier deployment templates targeting H100 single-node and L40S edge-tier topology, plus a Yotta-style canonical benchmark harness gating the production-readiness claim. Sovereign-cloud and on-prem agentic-AI workloads adopt it first because the tool-result-cache reuse substrate compounds the latency win for long tool-call chains. Bear case is a competing serving-stack architecture refusing the disaggregation split and forking the benchmark methodology; absent that, Q4 2026 lands disaggregated prefill as the documented default across the open-source serving cohort.
