Combined with the Mag-7 print collision today + ~$700B aggregated 2026 capex + the Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), Wall Street is now **explicitly demanding tangible AI-economics disclosure, not narrative**. By Q3 2026 the SEC + analyst pressure produces (a) at least one foundation lab moving to a public monthly revenue / WAU dashboard cadence, and (b) at least one Big-3 cloud separating per-token AI-platform margin in the 10-Q footnotes. The "AGI" word goes from metaphysical to financial-instrument; "DAU/WAU" goes from product KPI to MD&A. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **OpenAIの4月28日WSJレポートが2026年「AI収益開示の書き換え」を始動させる — 2026年Q3までに、少なくとも1つのファウンデーション・ラボ(OpenAI、Anthropic、xAIのいずれか)が監査済み月次収益+WAU開示ケイデンスを出荷し、少なくとも1つのMag-7ハイパースケーラーがBedrock/Azure-OpenAI/Vertexのトークン単位マージン開示を生のクラウド収益から分離して公表する。** WSJ 4月28日は決定的だった: 単一の目標未達リークが、Oracleを4%、AMDを3%、Broadcomを4%、SoftBankを10%、1セッションで下落させ、これは**4月27日のOpenAI/Microsoft AGI条項のアンワインド**(これにより裁量的な「AGI宣言」のIP取消リスクはすでに除去済み)の上に乗った。本日のMag-7決算衝突 + 約7000億ドルの2026年集約capex + 5月中旬のCerebras IPO 220億〜250億ドル(G42 24% / MBZUAI 62%の収益集中)と組み合わさり、ウォール街は今や**ナラティブではなく具体的なAI経済性開示を明示的に要求している**。2026年Q3までに、SEC + アナリストの圧力により、(a) 少なくとも1つのファウンデーション・ラボが公開月次収益/WAUダッシュボードのケイデンスに移行し、(b) 少なくとも1つのBig-3クラウドが10-Qフットノートでトークン単位AIプラットフォームマージンを分離する。「AGI」という言葉が形而上学的なものから金融商品へと変わり、「DAU/WAU」が製品KPIからMD&Aへと変わる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **El reporte WSJ de OpenAI del 28 de abril inicia una "reescritura de divulgacion de ingresos de IA" en 2026 — para el Q3 2026 al menos un laboratorio fundacional (OpenAI, Anthropic, o xAI) envia una cadencia auditada de divulgacion mensual de ingresos + WAU, y al menos un hyperscaler Mag-7 publica una divulgacion de margen por token de Bedrock/Azure-OpenAI/Vertex separada de los ingresos crudos de nube.** El WSJ del 28 de abril fue decisivo: una sola filtracion fuera-de-objetivo bajo Oracle 4%, AMD 3%, Broadcom 4%, SoftBank 10% en una sola sesion, encima del **desmontaje de la clausula AGI OpenAI/Microsoft del 27 de abril** (que ya removio el riesgo discrecional de revocacion-de-IP por "declaracion de AGI"). Combinado con la colision de resultados Mag-7 hoy + ~$700B de capex 2026 agregado + la IPO de Cerebras a mediados de mayo a $22B-$25B (concentracion de ingresos 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI), Wall Street ahora esta **explicitamente exigiendo divulgacion tangible de economia-de-IA, no narrativa**. Para el Q3 2026 la presion de la SEC + analistas produce (a) al menos un laboratorio fundacional moviendose a una cadencia publica de dashboard de ingresos / WAU mensual, y (b) al menos una nube Big-3 separando el margen por token de la plataforma de IA en las notas al pie del 10-Q. La palabra "AGI" pasa de metafisica a instrumento financiero; "DAU/WAU" pasa de KPI de producto a MD&A. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang OpenAI Apr 28 WSJ report ay nagpapasimula ng 2026 "AI-revenue disclosure rewrite" — pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isang foundation lab (OpenAI, Anthropic, o xAI) ay maglalabas ng audited monthly-revenue + WAU disclosure cadence, at kahit isang Mag-7 hyperscaler ay maglalathala ng Bedrock/Azure-OpenAI/Vertex per-token-margin disclosure na hiwalay sa raw cloud revenue.** Ang WSJ Apr 28 ay mapagpasiya: isang off-target-leak ang nagpababa ng Oracle 4%, AMD 3%, Broadcom 4%, SoftBank 10% sa isang session, sa ibabaw ng **Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft AGI-clause unwind** (na inalis na ang discretionary "AGI declaration" IP-revocation risk). Kasama ang Mag-7 print collision ngayon + ~$700B aggregated 2026 capex + ang Cerebras IPO sa kalagitnaan ng Mayo sa $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), ang Wall Street ay ngayon **lantarang humihingi ng tangible AI-economics disclosure, hindi narrative**. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang SEC + analyst pressure ay magbubunga ng (a) kahit isang foundation lab na lumipat sa public monthly revenue / WAU dashboard cadence, at (b) kahit isang Big-3 cloud na maghihiwalay ng per-token AI-platform margin sa 10-Q footnotes. Ang salitang "AGI" ay magiging mula metaphysical patungo sa financial-instrument; ang "DAU/WAU" ay magiging mula product KPI patungo sa MD&A. plain_language.en: After a leak knocked AI stocks down hard, regulators and investors will soon force the biggest AI companies to publish real monthly revenue numbers, not just hype.

text_locales.ja: OpenAIの$25B年換算run rateと$100M広告パイロットの不透明性、Cerebras IPOの集中開示が、公開ファウンデーションラボ開示ケイデンスへの圧力を加え続ける一方、AAPLの自社株買いが$700B capexテープに積層して買い手側がそれを要求するレバレッジを与える。4月28日のWSJの足は、消えていくのではなく引き締まり続けている。
text_locales.es: El run rate anualizado de $25B de OpenAI más la opacidad del piloto de anuncios de $100M y las divulgaciones de concentración del IPO de Cerebras siguen añadiendo presión para una cadencia pública de divulgación de laboratorio fundacional, mientras que la recompra de AAPL sobre el tape de capex de $700B le da al lado comprador el apalancamiento para demandarla. La pierna del WSJ del 28 de abril sigue apretándose en lugar de desvanecerse.
text_locales.fil: Ang $25B annualized run rate ng OpenAI plus ang $100M ad-pilot opacity at ang Cerebras IPO concentration disclosures ay patuloy na nagdaragdag ng pressure para sa public foundation-lab disclosure cadence, habang ang buyback ng AAPL sa $700B capex tape ay nagbibigay sa buyside ng leverage upang hingin ito. Ang Apr 28 WSJ leg ay patuloy na humihigpit sa halip na maglaho.

text_locales.ja: AppleのAIサービスの内訳のない記録的なサービスラインに加え、7,000億ドルの2026年設備投資追跡数値は、予測が依拠する開示圧力セットアップにまさに着地するが、新鮮なファウンデーションラボ月次収益ケイデンスもトークンあたりマージン10-Qフットノートも本日出荷されなかった。構造的圧力は依然として2026年Q3予測ウィンドウに向けて構築されている。
text_locales.es: La línea récord de Services de Apple sin break de AI-services más el número de tracking de capex 2026 de $700B aterrizan exactamente en el setup de presión-de-disclosure sobre el cual depende la predicción, pero ningún cadencia fresca de revenue-mensual de foundation-lab o nota al pie de 10-Q por per-token-margin envió hoy. La presión estructural sigue construyéndose hacia la ventana de forecast Q3 2026.
text_locales.fil: Ang record Services line ng Apple nang walang AI-services break plus ang $700B 2026 capex tracking number ay umiimpok eksakto sa disclosure-pressure setup na pinanindigan ng prediction, ngunit walang sariwang foundation-lab monthly-revenue cadence o per-token-margin 10-Q footnote na nag-ship ngayon. Ang structural pressure ay tumitindi pa rin patungo sa Q3 2026 forecast window.

bridges.text: Microsoft's $37B run-rate is one structural step short of the per-token-margin 10-Q footnote the prediction calls for, and OpenAI's response cycle is the consumer-facing leg. Today the prediction is no longer forecast on the disclosure-pressure side — it is being absorbed into the disclosure cadence in real time.

text_locales.en: Microsoft's $37B run-rate is one structural step short of the per-token-margin 10-Q footnote the prediction calls for, and OpenAI's response cycle is the consumer-facing leg. Today the prediction is no longer forecast on the disclosure-pressure side — it is being absorbed into the disclosure cadence in real time.
text_locales.ja: Microsoftの$37Bランレートは、予測が求めるトークンあたりマージン10-Q脚注に構造的に1ステップ短く、OpenAIの対応サイクルは消費者向け脚である。本日、予測は開示圧力側ではもはや予測ではない — リアルタイムで開示頻度に吸収されつつある。
text_locales.es: El run-rate de $37B de Microsoft está un paso estructural corto frente a la nota al pie del 10-Q con margen por token que pide la predicción, y el ciclo de respuesta de OpenAI es la pata orientada al consumidor. Hoy la predicción ya no es pronóstico en el lado de la presión de disclosure — está siendo absorbida en la cadencia de disclosure en tiempo real.
text_locales.fil: Ang $37B run-rate ng Microsoft ay isang structural step kulang sa per-token-margin 10-Q footnote na hinihingi ng prediction, at ang response cycle ng OpenAI ay ang consumer-facing leg. Ngayon ang prediction ay hindi na forecast sa disclosure-pressure side — ito ay nasasama sa disclosure cadence sa real time.

detail.description: **The OpenAI Apr 28 WSJ report initiates a 2026 "AI-revenue disclosure rewrite" — by Q3 2026 at least one foundation lab (OpenAI, Anthropic, or xAI) ships an audited monthly-revenue + WAU disclosure cadence, and at least one Mag-7 hyperscaler publishes Bedrock/Azure-OpenAI/Vertex per-token-margin disclosure separated from raw cloud revenue.** WSJ Apr 28 was decisive: a single off-target-leak dropped Oracle 4%, AMD 3%, Broadcom 4%, SoftBank 10% in one session, on top of the **Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft AGI-clause unwind** (which already removed the discretionary "AGI declaration" IP-revocation risk). Combined with the Mag-7 print collision today + ~$700B aggregated 2026 capex + the Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), Wall Street is now **explicitly demanding tangible AI-economics disclosure, not narrative**. By Q3 2026 the SEC + analyst pressure produces (a) at least one foundation lab moving to a public monthly revenue / WAU dashboard cadence, and (b) at least one Big-3 cloud separating per-token AI-platform margin in the 10-Q footnotes. The "AGI" word goes from metaphysical to financial-instrument; "DAU/WAU" goes from product KPI to MD&A. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **OpenAIの4月28日WSJレポートが2026年「AI収益開示の書き換え」を始動させる — 2026年Q3までに、少なくとも1つのファウンデーション・ラボ(OpenAI、Anthropic、xAIのいずれか)が監査済み月次収益+WAU開示ケイデンスを出荷し、少なくとも1つのMag-7ハイパースケーラーがBedrock/Azure-OpenAI/Vertexのトークン単位マージン開示を生のクラウド収益から分離して公表する。** WSJ 4月28日は決定的だった: 単一の目標未達リークが、Oracleを4%、AMDを3%、Broadcomを4%、SoftBankを10%、1セッションで下落させ、これは**4月27日のOpenAI/Microsoft AGI条項のアンワインド**(これにより裁量的な「AGI宣言」のIP取消リスクはすでに除去済み)の上に乗った。本日のMag-7決算衝突 + 約7000億ドルの2026年集約capex + 5月中旬のCerebras IPO 220億〜250億ドル(G42 24% / MBZUAI 62%の収益集中)と組み合わさり、ウォール街は今や**ナラティブではなく具体的なAI経済性開示を明示的に要求している**。2026年Q3までに、SEC + アナリストの圧力により、(a) 少なくとも1つのファウンデーション・ラボが公開月次収益/WAUダッシュボードのケイデンスに移行し、(b) 少なくとも1つのBig-3クラウドが10-Qフットノートでトークン単位AIプラットフォームマージンを分離する。「AGI」という言葉が形而上学的なものから金融商品へと変わり、「DAU/WAU」が製品KPIからMD&Aへと変わる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **El reporte WSJ de OpenAI del 28 de abril inicia una "reescritura de divulgacion de ingresos de IA" en 2026 — para el Q3 2026 al menos un laboratorio fundacional (OpenAI, Anthropic, o xAI) envia una cadencia auditada de divulgacion mensual de ingresos + WAU, y al menos un hyperscaler Mag-7 publica una divulgacion de margen por token de Bedrock/Azure-OpenAI/Vertex separada de los ingresos crudos de nube.** El WSJ del 28 de abril fue decisivo: una sola filtracion fuera-de-objetivo bajo Oracle 4%, AMD 3%, Broadcom 4%, SoftBank 10% en una sola sesion, encima del **desmontaje de la clausula AGI OpenAI/Microsoft del 27 de abril** (que ya removio el riesgo discrecional de revocacion-de-IP por "declaracion de AGI"). Combinado con la colision de resultados Mag-7 hoy + ~$700B de capex 2026 agregado + la IPO de Cerebras a mediados de mayo a $22B-$25B (concentracion de ingresos 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI), Wall Street ahora esta **explicitamente exigiendo divulgacion tangible de economia-de-IA, no narrativa**. Para el Q3 2026 la presion de la SEC + analistas produce (a) al menos un laboratorio fundacional moviendose a una cadencia publica de dashboard de ingresos / WAU mensual, y (b) al menos una nube Big-3 separando el margen por token de la plataforma de IA en las notas al pie del 10-Q. La palabra "AGI" pasa de metafisica a instrumento financiero; "DAU/WAU" pasa de KPI de producto a MD&A. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang OpenAI Apr 28 WSJ report ay nagpapasimula ng 2026 "AI-revenue disclosure rewrite" — pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isang foundation lab (OpenAI, Anthropic, o xAI) ay maglalabas ng audited monthly-revenue + WAU disclosure cadence, at kahit isang Mag-7 hyperscaler ay maglalathala ng Bedrock/Azure-OpenAI/Vertex per-token-margin disclosure na hiwalay sa raw cloud revenue.** Ang WSJ Apr 28 ay mapagpasiya: isang off-target-leak ang nagpababa ng Oracle 4%, AMD 3%, Broadcom 4%, SoftBank 10% sa isang session, sa ibabaw ng **Apr 27 OpenAI/Microsoft AGI-clause unwind** (na inalis na ang discretionary "AGI declaration" IP-revocation risk). Kasama ang Mag-7 print collision ngayon + ~$700B aggregated 2026 capex + ang Cerebras IPO sa kalagitnaan ng Mayo sa $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), ang Wall Street ay ngayon **lantarang humihingi ng tangible AI-economics disclosure, hindi narrative**. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang SEC + analyst pressure ay magbubunga ng (a) kahit isang foundation lab na lumipat sa public monthly revenue / WAU dashboard cadence, at (b) kahit isang Big-3 cloud na maghihiwalay ng per-token AI-platform margin sa 10-Q footnotes. Ang salitang "AGI" ay magiging mula metaphysical patungo sa financial-instrument; ang "DAU/WAU" ay magiging mula product KPI patungo sa MD&A. description.es: **El reporte del WSJ del 28 abr sobre la falta de revenue de OpenAI + la colisión de prints Mag 7 del 29 abr dispara un push 2026 SEC + analistas para la reescritura de la disclosure de revenue de IA — para Q3 2026 al menos un foundation lab (OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI) lanza una cadencia auditada de disclosure mensual de revenue o WAU, y al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 separa el margen por token de Bedrock / Azure-OpenAI / Vertex en notas al pie del 10-Q frente al revenue cloud crudo.** El selloff del 28 abr (S&P -0,49%, Nasdaq -0,9%, Oracle -4%, AMD -3%, Broadcom -4%, SoftBank -10%) fue la primera grieta material en el tape de capex-IA-por-fe; los prints del 29 abr fueron un reset mixto (MSFT/GOOGL pegaron fuerte, META -7% AH); los prints del 30 abr de AAPL cierran el ciclo Mag 7. Microsoft ya citó un AI run rate de $37B (+123%) explícitamente — ese es el precedente de disclosure. Con el IPO de Cerebras a mediados de mayo a $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI concentración de revenue), la presión SEC + buyside por divulgación explícita de margen por token + WAU converge en torno a los ciclos de earnings Q2-Q3 2026. La elección de Powell de quedarse en la Junta como contrapeso a la investigación de la Fed por la administración Trump también eleva la prima de riesgo político sobre todo el tape de capex-IA; exigir números más duros es la palanca que tienen los mercados públicos. summary.es: **El reporte del WSJ del 28 abr sobre la falta de revenue de OpenAI + la colisión de prints Mag 7 del 29 abr dispara un push 2026 SEC + analistas para la reescritura de la disclosure de revenue de IA — para Q3 2026 al menos un foundation lab (OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI) lanza una cadencia auditada de disclosure mensual de revenue o WAU, y al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 separa el margen por token de Bedrock / Azure-OpenAI / Vertex en notas al pie del 10-Q frente al revenue cloud crudo.** El selloff del 28 abr (S&P -0,49%, Nasdaq -0,9%, Oracle -4%, AMD -3%, Broadcom -4%, SoftBank -10%) fue la primera grieta material en el tape de capex-IA-por-fe; los prints del 29 abr fueron un reset mixto (MSFT/GOOGL pegaron fuerte, META -7% AH); los prints del 30 abr de AAPL cierran el ciclo Mag 7. Microsoft ya citó un AI run rate de $37B (+123%) explícitamente — ese es el precedente de disclosure. Con el IPO de Cerebras a mediados de mayo a $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI concentración de revenue), la presión SEC + buyside por divulgación explícita de margen por token + WAU converge en torno a los ciclos de earnings Q2-Q3 2026. La elección de Powell de quedarse en la Junta como contrapeso a la investigación de la Fed por la administración Trump también eleva la prima de riesgo político sobre todo el tape de capex-IA; exigir números más duros es la palanca que tienen los mercados públicos. Tahasang binanggit na ng Microsoft ang $37B AI run rate (+123%) — iyan ang disclosure precedent. text_locales.fil: Hinahawakan ng Wednesday Mag-7 positioning note ang mas malawak na AI-revenue-disclosure-rewrite arc na inasahan ng dormant longshot na ito, ngunit ang ebidensiya ay dumarating sa quarterly 10-Q footnote disclosure (90 porsiyentong probabilidad para sa Q2 print ng Alphabet, sa unang pagkakataon na lumampas sa threshold) sa halip na ang audited monthly-revenue plus per-token-margin cadence na partikular na hinihingi ng prediction, kaya tumitigas ang disclosure-pressure thesis nang walang pagtawid sa partikular na reporting shape ng longshot.

text_locales.en: Monday's Mag-7 positioning note advances the AI-revenue-disclosure-pressure arc this prediction anticipated — the six-desk cohort holds the Alphabet Q2 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout at 88 percent with the fourth sample comment letter treated as settled precedent — but it lands on quarterly footnote disclosure, not the predicted audited monthly-revenue plus per-token-margin reporting.
text_locales.ja: 月曜の Mag-7 ポジショニングノートは、この予測が予期した AI 収益の開示圧力の流れを前進させる。6デスクの陣は Alphabet の第2四半期 AI Services の 10-Q 脚注内訳開示を88%で維持し4件目のサンプルコメントレターを確定した先例として扱っている。だがそれは四半期脚注の開示に合致するもので、予測された監査済み月次収益とトークンあたりマージンの報告ではない。
text_locales.es: La nota de posicionamiento de los Mag-7 del lunes avanza el arco de presión de divulgación de ingresos de IA que esta predicción anticipaba —el grupo de seis mesas mantiene el desglose en una nota a pie de página del 10-Q de AI Services del segundo trimestre de Alphabet en el 88 por ciento con la cuarta carta de comentarios de muestra tratada como precedente asentado—, pero aterriza sobre la divulgación en una nota a pie de página trimestral, no sobre la presentación de informes de ingresos mensuales auditados más margen por token predicha.
text_locales.fil: Isinusulong ng Monday Mag-7 positioning note ang AI-revenue-disclosure-pressure arc na inasahan ng prediction na ito — hawak ng six-desk cohort ang Alphabet Q2 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout sa 88 porsiyento na ang fourth sample comment letter ay itinuturing bilang settled precedent — ngunit dumarating ito sa quarterly footnote disclosure, hindi sa inilarawang audited monthly-revenue plus per-token-margin reporting.

bridges.text: AI-revenue-disclosure pressure is live and intensifying at the hyperscaler tier — the print-cycle cohort holds the Alphabet Q2 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout probability at 87 percent and treats the SEC Corp Fin comment letter on AI-services-revenue measurement as a settled input. But the evidence centers on Mag-7 segment footnotes, not the foundation-lab audited-monthly-revenue cadence the prediction specifically names.

text_locales.en: AI-revenue-disclosure pressure is live and intensifying at the hyperscaler tier — the print-cycle cohort holds the Alphabet Q2 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout probability at 87 percent and treats the SEC Corp Fin comment letter on AI-services-revenue measurement as a settled input. But the evidence centers on Mag-7 segment footnotes, not the foundation-lab audited-monthly-revenue cadence the prediction specifically names.
text_locales.ja: AI収益開示の圧力は、ハイパースケーラー階層で生きており強まっている——決算サイクルの集団は、AlphabetのQ2 AI Servicesの10-Q脚注切り出し確率を87パーセントに保ち、AIサービス収益測定に関するSEC企業金融部のコメントレターを確定した入力として扱う。しかし証拠は、予測が特に名指しする基盤ラボの監査済み月次収益の周期ではなく、Mag-7のセグメント脚注を中心としている。
text_locales.es: La presión de divulgación de ingresos de IA está viva e intensificándose en el nivel de los hiperescaladores —el grupo del ciclo de presentación mantiene la probabilidad de desglose de la nota a pie de página del 10-Q de AI Services del segundo trimestre de Alphabet en el 87 por ciento y trata la carta de comentarios del SEC Corp Fin sobre la medición de los ingresos de AI Services como un insumo asentado—. Pero la evidencia se centra en las notas a pie de página de segmento de los Mag-7, no en la cadencia de ingresos mensuales auditados de los laboratorios fundacionales que la predicción nombra específicamente.
text_locales.fil: Buhay at tumitindi sa hyperscaler na antas ang AI-revenue-disclosure na presyon — hawak ng print-cycle cohort ang Alphabet Q2 AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout probability sa 87 porsiyento at itinuturing ang SEC Corp Fin comment letter sa AI-services-revenue measurement bilang isang naayos na input. Ngunit nakasentro ang ebidensya sa Mag-7 segment footnotes, hindi sa foundation-lab audited-monthly-revenue na kadensa na tiyak na pinangalanan ng hula.

bridges.text: Cerebras's S-1 surfacing $510M trailing revenue and the >$10B OpenAI warrant + loan structure on the public market plus AMD's Q2 guide bundled-segment-line carry plus Anthropic's >$30B run-rate via journalist channels tighten the structural force the foundation-lab-audited-revenue prediction (Apr 30) names. No lab ships an audited monthly revenue + per-token-margin disclosure today.

text_locales.en: Cerebras's S-1 surfacing $510M trailing revenue and the >$10B OpenAI warrant + loan structure on the public market plus AMD's Q2 guide bundled-segment-line carry plus Anthropic's >$30B run-rate via journalist channels tighten the structural force the foundation-lab-audited-revenue prediction (Apr 30) names. No lab ships an audited monthly revenue + per-token-margin disclosure today.
text_locales.ja: CerebrasのS-1が$510Mの直近売上と$10B超のOpenAIワラント+ローン構造を公開市場で表面化、AMDのQ2ガイドが束ねられたセグメント・ライン・キャリ、Anthropicの$30B超ランレートがジャーナリスト・チャネル経由であることは、ファウンデーション・ラボ監査済み売上予測(4月30日)が指摘する構造的力を強化する。本日いかなるラボも監査済み月次売上 + トークンあたりマージン開示を出荷しない。
text_locales.es: El S-1 de Cerebras aflorando $510M de ingresos recientes y la estructura warrants + préstamo OpenAI >$10B en el mercado público más la traída del guidance Q2 de AMD con línea de segmento agrupada más el run-rate >$30B de Anthropic vía canales de periodistas tensan la fuerza estructural que nombra la predicción ingresos auditados de laboratorio fundacional (30 abr). Ningún laboratorio entrega cadencia de divulgación de ingresos mensuales auditados + margen por token hoy.
text_locales.fil: Ang Cerebras's S-1 na naglalantad ng $510M trailing revenue at ang >$10B OpenAI warrant + loan structure sa public market plus ang AMD's Q2 guide bundled-segment-line carry plus ang Anthropic's >$30B run-rate sa pamamagitan ng journalist channels ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng foundation-lab-audited-revenue prediction (Abr 30). Walang lab ang nag-ship ng audited monthly revenue + per-token-margin disclosure ngayon.

bridges.text: The May 4 parallel-JV equity-template launches plus AMD's pre-print disclosure-shape pressure tighten the structural force the prediction names: SEC + analyst pressure for audited AI-revenue cadence and per-token-margin disclosure now has an explicit equity-vehicle anchor sitting outside the foundation-lab balance sheet.

text_locales.en: The May 4 parallel-JV equity-template launches plus AMD's pre-print disclosure-shape pressure tighten the structural force the prediction names: SEC + analyst pressure for audited AI-revenue cadence and per-token-margin disclosure now has an explicit equity-vehicle anchor sitting outside the foundation-lab balance sheet.
text_locales.ja: 5月4日の並行JVエクイティ・テンプレート・ローンチ + AMDの決算前開示形状プレッシャーが、予測が指摘する構造的な強制力を引き締める: 監査済みAI売上ケイデンスとトークン単位マージン開示に対するSEC + アナリストの圧力は、現在ファウンデーション・ラボのバランスシートの外側に座る明示的なエクイティ・ビークル・アンカーを持つ。
text_locales.es: Los lanzamientos paralelos de plantilla de capital JV del 4 de mayo más la presión de divulgación previa a la impresión de AMD ajustan la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra: la presión de SEC + analistas para cadencia auditada de ingresos de IA y divulgación de margen por token ahora tiene un ancla explícita de vehículo de capital sentada fuera del balance del laboratorio de fundación.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 4 parallel-JV equity-template launches plus AMD's pre-print disclosure-shape pressure ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction: ang SEC + analyst pressure para sa audited AI-revenue cadence at per-token-margin disclosure ay mayroon na ngayong explicit equity-vehicle anchor na nakaupo sa labas ng foundation-lab balance sheet.

bridges.text: AAPL's $100B buyback layered on the $700B capex tape and MSFT's $37B run-rate disclosure reinforce the buyside-pressure-cracks-AI-revenue-opacity thesis the Apr 28 WSJ leg started. Cerebras IPO concentration disclosure adds the public-market stress-test piece into the same window.

text_locales.en: AAPL's $100B buyback layered on the $700B capex tape and MSFT's $37B run-rate disclosure reinforce the buyside-pressure-cracks-AI-revenue-opacity thesis the Apr 28 WSJ leg started. Cerebras IPO concentration disclosure adds the public-market stress-test piece into the same window.
text_locales.ja: AAPLの$100B自社株買いが$700B capexテープに積層され、MSFTの$37B run-rate開示が、4月28日のWSJの足が始めた買い手側圧力がAI収益不透明性を破るというテーゼを補強する。Cerebras IPO集中開示が同じウィンドウに公開市場ストレステストの一片を加える。
text_locales.es: La recompra de $100B de AAPL apilada sobre el tape de capex de $700B y la divulgación de run-rate de $37B de MSFT refuerzan la tesis de presión-del-comprador-quiebra-opacidad-de-ingresos-IA que inició la pierna del WSJ del 28 de abril. La divulgación de concentración del IPO de Cerebras añade la pieza de prueba de estrés del mercado público en la misma ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang $100B buyback ng AAPL na nakapatong sa $700B capex tape at ang $37B run-rate disclosure ng MSFT ay nagpapatibay sa buyside-pressure-cracks-AI-revenue-opacity thesis na sinimulan ng Apr 28 WSJ leg. Ang Cerebras IPO concentration disclosure ay nagdaragdag ng public-market stress-test piece sa parehong window.

bridges.text: Apple's clean print absorbing the WSJ OpenAI noise and the imminent Cerebras IPO with 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI concentration keep buyside demand for explicit per-token margin and audited revenue cadence intact.

text_locales.en: Apple's clean print absorbing the WSJ OpenAI noise and the imminent Cerebras IPO with 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI concentration keep buyside demand for explicit per-token margin and audited revenue cadence intact.
text_locales.ja: AppleのクリーンなWSJ OpenAIノイズ吸収決算と24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI集中を伴う差し迫ったCerebras IPOが、明示的なトークンあたりマージンと監査済み売上ケイデンスのバイサイド需要を維持する。
text_locales.es: La impresión limpia de Apple absorbiendo el ruido WSJ de OpenAI y la inminente IPO de Cerebras con concentración 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI mantienen intacta la demanda del lado comprador de un margen explícito por token y una cadencia auditada de ingresos.
text_locales.fil: Ang malinis na print ng Apple na sumisipsip sa WSJ OpenAI noise at ang nalalapit na Cerebras IPO na may 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI concentration ay nagpapanatili ng buyside demand para sa explicit per-token margin at audited revenue cadence.

bridges.text: Apple closing the Mag 7 super-week with no separate AI-services line in record Services revenue plus the $700B 2026 capex print plus Powell's Board-stay raising political-risk premium together compose the disclosure-pressure backdrop the prediction projects. The audited monthly-revenue / WAU and per-token-margin 10-Q footnote disclosure ships are still upstream of the Q3 2026 deadline.

text_locales.en: Apple closing the Mag 7 super-week with no separate AI-services line in record Services revenue plus the $700B 2026 capex print plus Powell's Board-stay raising political-risk premium together compose the disclosure-pressure backdrop the prediction projects. The audited monthly-revenue / WAU and per-token-margin 10-Q footnote disclosure ships are still upstream of the Q3 2026 deadline.
text_locales.ja: AppleがMag 7スーパーウィークを記録的なサービス収益に別個のAIサービスラインなしで締めくくり、加えて7,000億ドルの2026年設備投資プリントとPowellの理事会留任が政治的リスクプレミアムを引き上げることが、予測が投影する開示圧力背景を構成する。監査済み月次収益 / WAUとトークンあたりマージン10-Qフットノート開示の出荷は、依然として2026年Q3期限の上流。
text_locales.es: Apple cerrando la super-semana Mag 7 sin línea separada de AI-services en el revenue récord de Services más el print de capex 2026 de $700B más Powell-quedarse-en-Board elevando la prima de riesgo político componen juntos el telón de fondo de presión-de-disclosure que la predicción proyecta. Los lanzamientos de disclosure auditada de revenue-mensual / WAU y nota al pie de 10-Q por per-token-margin todavía están upstream del deadline Q3 2026.
text_locales.fil: Ang pag-close ng Apple sa Mag 7 super-week nang walang separate AI-services line sa record Services revenue plus ang $700B 2026 capex print plus ang Powell's Board-stay na nagpapataas ng political-risk premium ay magkakasamang bumubuo ng disclosure-pressure backdrop na ipina-project ng prediction. Ang audited monthly-revenue / WAU at per-token-margin 10-Q footnote disclosure ships ay nasa upstream pa rin ng Q3 2026 deadline.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **The Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss report + Apr 29 Mag 7 print collision triggers a 2026 SEC + analyst push for AI-revenue disclosure rewrite — by Q3 2026 at least one foundation lab (OpenAI / Anthropic / xAI) ships an audited monthly-revenue or WAU disclosure cadence, and at least one Big-3 hyperscaler separates Bedrock / Azure-OpenAI / Vertex per-token margin in 10-Q footnotes from raw cloud revenue.** Apr 28 selloff (S&P -0.49%, Nasdaq -0.9%, Oracle -4%, AMD -3%, Broadcom -4%, SoftBank -10%) was the first material crack in the AI-capex-on-faith tape; Apr 29 prints were a mixed reset (MSFT/GOOGL beat hard, META -7% AH); Apr 30 AAPL prints close the Mag 7 cycle. Microsoft already cited a $37B AI run rate (+123%) explicitly — that is the disclosure precedent. With the Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22B-$25B (24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration), the SEC + buyside pressure for explicit per-token margin + WAU disclosure converges around Q2-Q3 2026 earnings cycles. nodes.description: **Powell's Apr 29 decision to remain on the Board of Governors past his Chair-term expiration (May 15) reshapes 2026 monetary-policy market psychology — by Q4 2026 the FOMC reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2 dissenters) under Warsh as Chair, but Powell's continued Board presence becomes the marginal swing vote on the Fed-investigation governance question, not on rates.** Apr 29 was the highest-dissent FOMC since Oct-1992 (8-4); Miran wanted -25bp; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan opposed easing-bias inclusion. Warsh nomination advanced from Senate Banking same day. The 2026-2027 setup: Powell on Board through term-end 2028 with Warsh in the Chair seat; the dissent posture compresses on rate calls because the Chair sets the framing; Powell's marginal vote becomes a governance signal whenever the Trump-admin Fed-investigation outcome moves. Markets price a smaller forward-guidance volatility on rates but a larger institutional-risk premium on the Fed itself. The 1992-precedent comparison stops being a curiosity and starts being a structural reference point in financial-press explanations of the new Fed governance regime.

description.en: **Powell's Apr 29 decision to remain on the Board of Governors past his Chair-term expiration (May 15) reshapes 2026 monetary-policy market psychology — by Q4 2026 the FOMC reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2 dissenters) under Warsh as Chair, but Powell's continued Board presence becomes the marginal swing vote on the Fed-investigation governance question, not on rates.** Apr 29 was the highest-dissent FOMC since Oct-1992 (8-4); Miran wanted -25bp; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan opposed easing-bias inclusion. Warsh nomination advanced from Senate Banking same day. The 2026-2027 setup: Powell on Board through term-end 2028 with Warsh in the Chair seat; the dissent posture compresses on rate calls because the Chair sets the framing; Powell's marginal vote becomes a governance signal whenever the Trump-admin Fed-investigation outcome moves. Markets price a smaller forward-guidance volatility on rates but a larger institutional-risk premium on the Fed itself. The 1992-precedent comparison stops being a curiosity and starts being a structural reference point in financial-press explanations of the new Fed governance regime.
description.ja: **Powellの4月29日の決定 — 議長任期満了(5月15日)後も理事会に残る — が2026年の金融政策市場心理を再構築する — 2026年Q4までに、FOMCはWarsh議長の下でより小規模な反対(≤2人の反対者)規範に戻るが、Powellの理事会継続的存在は金利ではなくFRB調査ガバナンス問題に関する限界スイング票となる。** 4月29日は1992年10月以来最高の反対(8-4)のFOMCだった。Miranは-25bpを希望、Hammack/Kashkari/Loganは緩和バイアス採用に反対した。Warsh指名は同日上院銀行委員会から進展した。2026-2027年のセットアップ:Powellは2028年の任期末まで理事会、Warshは議長席に着席。議長がフレーミングを設定するため反対姿勢は金利関連で圧縮される。Powellの限界票は、トランプ政権のFRB調査結果が動くたびにガバナンスシグナルとなる。市場は金利に関するフォワードガイダンスのボラティリティの低下を織り込む一方、FRB自体への制度リスクプレミアムの上昇を織り込む。1992年先例の比較は珍奇なものではなくなり、新しいFRBガバナンス体制の金融プレス解説における構造的な参照点となり始める。
description.es: **La decisión de Powell del 29 abr de permanecer en la Board of Governors más allá de la expiración de su mandato como Chair (15 may) reconfigura la psicología de mercado de política monetaria 2026 — para Q4 2026 el FOMC revierte a una norma de menor disenso (≤2 disidentes) bajo Warsh como Chair, pero la presencia continua de Powell en la Junta se vuelve el voto bisagra marginal sobre la cuestión de gobernanza de la investigación a la Fed, no sobre tasas.** El 29 abr fue el FOMC con más disenso desde oct-1992 (8-4); Miran quería -25bp; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan se opusieron a incluir un sesgo flexibilizador. La nominación de Warsh avanzó desde el Senate Banking ese mismo día. La configuración 2026-2027: Powell en la Junta hasta el final de su mandato en 2028 con Warsh en el asiento de Chair; la postura de disenso se comprime en decisiones de tasas porque el Chair fija el encuadre; el voto marginal de Powell se vuelve una señal de gobernanza cada vez que se mueve el resultado de la investigación a la Fed por la administración Trump. Los mercados precian menor volatilidad de forward-guidance sobre tasas pero una prima de riesgo institucional mayor sobre la propia Fed. La comparación con el precedente de 1992 deja de ser una curiosidad y empieza a ser un punto de referencia estructural en las explicaciones de la prensa financiera del nuevo régimen de gobernanza de la Fed. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang desisyon ni Powell noong Apr 29 na manatili sa Board of Governors lampas sa pagtatapos ng kanyang Chair-term (May 15) ay nagbabago sa 2026 monetary-policy market psychology — pagsapit ng Q4 2026 ang FOMC ay babalik sa smaller-dissent norm (≤2 dissenters) sa ilalim ni Warsh bilang Chair, ngunit ang patuloy na presensya ni Powell sa Board ay nagiging marginal swing vote sa Fed-investigation governance question, hindi sa rates.** Apr 29 ang pinakamataas na dissent na FOMC mula noong Oct-1992 (8-4); gusto ni Miran ng -25bp; tumutol sina Hammack/Kashkari/Logan sa pagsasama ng easing-bias. Sumulong ang Warsh nomination mula sa Senate Banking sa parehong araw. Ang 2026-2027 setup: si Powell sa Board hanggang term-end 2028 kasama si Warsh sa Chair seat; ang dissent posture ay sumasaayos sa rate calls dahil itinatakda ng Chair ang framing; ang marginal vote ni Powell ay nagiging governance signal kapag ang Trump-admin Fed-investigation outcome ay gumagalaw. Ang mga merkado ay nagpe-presyo ng mas maliit na forward-guidance volatility sa rates ngunit mas malaking institutional-risk premium sa Fed mismo. Ang 1992-precedent comparison ay tumitigil sa pagiging curiosity at nagsisimulang maging structural reference point sa financial-press explanations ng bagong Fed governance regime.

detail.summary_short: Powell's choice to stay on the Board through 2028 alongside the highest-dissent FOMC since 1992 and Warsh's pending Chair confirmation produces a 2026-2027 regime where rate-call dissent compresses under Warsh while Powell's Board vote becomes the marginal signal on the Trump-admin Fed-investigation governance question.

summary_short_locales.en: Powell's choice to stay on the Board through 2028 alongside the highest-dissent FOMC since 1992 and Warsh's pending Chair confirmation produces a 2026-2027 regime where rate-call dissent compresses under Warsh while Powell's Board vote becomes the marginal signal on the Trump-admin Fed-investigation governance question.
summary_short_locales.ja: Powellが2028年まで理事会に残るという選択 + 1992年以来最高の反対のFOMC + 保留中のWarsh議長承認が、Warshの下で金利関連の反対が圧縮される一方、Powellの理事会票がトランプ政権のFRB調査ガバナンス問題に関する限界シグナルとなる2026-2027年体制を生み出す。
summary_short_locales.es: La elección de Powell de quedarse en la Junta hasta 2028 junto al FOMC con más disenso desde 1992 y la confirmación pendiente de Warsh como Chair produce un régimen 2026-2027 donde el disenso en decisiones de tasas se comprime bajo Warsh mientras el voto de Powell en la Junta se vuelve la señal marginal sobre la cuestión de gobernanza de la investigación a la Fed por la administración Trump.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang pagpili ni Powell na manatili sa Board hanggang 2028 kasabay ng pinakamataas na dissent na FOMC mula noong 1992 at ang nakabinbin na pagkumpirma ng Warsh bilang Chair ay nagluluwal ng 2026-2027 regime kung saan ang rate-call dissent ay sumasaayos sa ilalim ni Warsh habang ang Board vote ni Powell ay nagiging marginal signal sa Trump-admin Fed-investigation governance question.

bridges.text: Powell's stay-through-2028 plus Warsh's Senate Banking advance plus the May 8 Apr-jobs print into the May 15 Chair-handoff window are the institutional configuration the prediction's market-psychology shift depends on. The May 1 record tape adds the equity-side sensitivity that converts dissent posture into a governance-volatility premium.

text_locales.en: Powell's stay-through-2028 plus Warsh's Senate Banking advance plus the May 8 Apr-jobs print into the May 15 Chair-handoff window are the institutional configuration the prediction's market-psychology shift depends on. The May 1 record tape adds the equity-side sensitivity that converts dissent posture into a governance-volatility premium.
text_locales.ja: Powellの2028年までの残留、Warshの上院銀行委員会の進展、5月8日の4月雇用統計が5月15日の議長交代ウィンドウへ向かうことが、予測の市場心理シフトが依存する制度配置だ。5月1日の記録的テープは、反対姿勢をガバナンスボラティリティプレミアムに変換する株式側感応度を加える。
text_locales.es: La permanencia de Powell hasta 2028 más el avance de Senate Banking de Warsh más la impresión de empleos de abril del 8 de mayo hacia la ventana de transferencia de Presidencia del 15 de mayo son la configuración institucional de la que depende el cambio de psicología de mercado de la predicción. El tape récord del 1 de mayo añade la sensibilidad del lado de renta variable que convierte la postura de disenso en una prima de volatilidad de gobernanza.
text_locales.fil: Ang stay-through-2028 ni Powell plus ang Senate Banking advance ni Warsh plus ang May 8 Apr-jobs print papasok sa May 15 Chair-handoff window ang institutional configuration na inaasahan ng market-psychology shift ng prediction. Ang May 1 record tape ay nagdaragdag ng equity-side sensitivity na nag-co-convert ng dissent posture tungo sa governance-volatility premium.

bridges.text: Powell's stay-on-Board choice plus the Warsh confirmation runway plus a May 1 tape priced on rate-cut hopes match the structural-shift premise the prediction relies on for an institutional-volatility regime.

text_locales.en: Powell's stay-on-Board choice plus the Warsh confirmation runway plus a May 1 tape priced on rate-cut hopes match the structural-shift premise the prediction relies on for an institutional-volatility regime.
text_locales.ja: PowellのStay-on-Board選択、Warsh承認の滑走路、利下げ期待で価格付けされた5月1日のテープが、予測が制度的ボラティリティ体制に依拠する構造的シフト前提と一致する。
text_locales.es: La elección de Powell de quedarse-en-la-Junta más la pista de confirmación de Warsh más una cinta del 1 mayo cotizada sobre esperanzas de recorte de tasas coinciden con la premisa de cambio estructural de la que depende la predicción para un régimen de volatilidad institucional.
text_locales.fil: Ang stay-on-Board choice ni Powell kasama ang Warsh confirmation runway kasama ang May 1 tape na nagpepresyo sa rate-cut hopes ay tumutugma sa structural-shift premise na pinagbabasehan ng prediction para sa institutional-volatility regime.

bridges.text: The Apr 30 carry of Powell's 1948-precedent Board-stay plus the Warsh full-Senate vote scheduled before May 15 plus the May 1 Apr jobs print as the first weakening data into the handoff window land exactly the institutional-volatility setup the prediction depends on. Today's evidence operationalizes the prediction's premise rather than testing it.

text_locales.en: The Apr 30 carry of Powell's 1948-precedent Board-stay plus the Warsh full-Senate vote scheduled before May 15 plus the May 1 Apr jobs print as the first weakening data into the handoff window land exactly the institutional-volatility setup the prediction depends on. Today's evidence operationalizes the prediction's premise rather than testing it.
text_locales.ja: Powellの1948年前例の理事会留任の4月30日への持ち越しに加え、5月15日前に予定されているWarshの上院本会議投票、そして5月1日の4月雇用統計プリントが交代ウィンドウへの最初の弱含みデータとなることが、予測が依拠する制度的ボラティリティセットアップにまさに着地する。本日の証拠は予測の前提を検証するのではなく運用化している。
text_locales.es: El carry del 30 abr de la permanencia-en-Board de Powell con precedente de 1948 más el voto del Senado completo de Warsh programado antes del 15 may más el print de empleo de abril del 1 may como la primera data de debilitamiento dentro de la ventana de handoff aterrizan exactamente el setup de institutional-volatility sobre el cual depende la predicción. La evidencia de hoy operacionaliza la premisa de la predicción en lugar de probarla.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 30 carry ng 1948-precedent Board-stay ni Powell plus ang Warsh full-Senate vote na nakaiskedyul bago ang May 15 plus ang May 1 Apr jobs print bilang unang weakening data papasok sa handoff window ay umiimpok eksakto sa institutional-volatility setup na pinanindigan ng prediction. Ang evidence ngayon ay nag-o-operate ng premise ng prediction sa halip na subukan ito.

job_locales.en: Reset FOMC framing under the new Chair so the dissent posture compresses on rate calls while preserving Powell's marginal-vote signal on Fed-investigation governance.

job_locales.es: Resetear el encuadre del FOMC bajo el nuevo Chair para que la postura de disenso se comprima en decisiones de tasas mientras se preserva la señal del voto marginal de Powell sobre gobernanza de la investigación a la Fed.
job_locales.fil: I-reset ang FOMC framing sa ilalim ng bagong Chair upang ang dissent posture ay sumaayos sa rate calls habang pinananatili ang marginal-vote signal ni Powell sa Fed-investigation governance.

outcome_locales.en: First Warsh-led FOMC press conference + statement that re-anchors the dissent norm at ≤2 dissenters and explicitly separates rate framing from governance posture.
outcome_locales.ja: 反対規範を≤2人の反対者に再アンカリングし、金利の枠組みをガバナンス姿勢から明示的に分離する初のWarsh主導FOMC記者会見 + 声明。
outcome_locales.es: Primera press conference + statement del FOMC bajo Warsh que re-anclen la norma de disenso a ≤2 disidentes y separe explícitamente el encuadre de tasas de la postura de gobernanza.
outcome_locales.fil: Unang Warsh-led FOMC press conference + statement na muling nag-aanchor sa dissent norm sa ≤2 dissenters at tahasang naghihiwalay sa rate framing mula sa governance posture.

motivation_locales.en: The Apr 29 8-4 dissent (highest since Oct-1992) is unsustainable as a steady-state framing; the incoming Chair must compress rate-call dissent to restore forward-guidance volatility to a normal envelope.
motivation_locales.ja: 4月29日の8-4反対(1992年10月以来最高)は定常状態の枠組みとして持続不可能である。入る側議長は金利関連の反対を圧縮し、フォワードガイダンスのボラティリティを通常の範囲に戻さなければならない。
motivation_locales.es: El disenso 8-4 del 29 abr (mayor desde oct-1992) es insostenible como encuadre steady-state; el Chair entrante debe comprimir el disenso en decisiones de tasas para restaurar la volatilidad de forward-guidance a un envelope normal.
motivation_locales.fil: Ang Apr 29 8-4 dissent (highest since Oct-1992) ay hindi nasusustento bilang steady-state framing; ang papasok na Chair ay dapat sumaayos sa rate-call dissent upang ibalik ang forward-guidance volatility sa normal envelope.

detail.description: **Powell's Apr 29 decision to remain on the Board of Governors past his Chair-term expiration (May 15) reshapes 2026 monetary-policy market psychology — by Q4 2026 the FOMC reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2 dissenters) under Warsh as Chair, but Powell's continued Board presence becomes the marginal swing vote on the Fed-investigation governance question, not on rates.** Apr 29 was the highest-dissent FOMC since Oct-1992 (8-4); Miran wanted -25bp; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan opposed easing-bias inclusion. Warsh nomination advanced from Senate Banking same day. The 2026-2027 setup: Powell on Board through term-end 2028 with Warsh in the Chair seat; the dissent posture compresses on rate calls because the Chair sets the framing; Powell's marginal vote becomes a governance signal whenever the Trump-admin Fed-investigation outcome moves. Markets price a smaller forward-guidance volatility on rates but a larger institutional-risk premium on the Fed itself. The 1992-precedent comparison stops being a curiosity and starts being a structural reference point in financial-press explanations of the new Fed governance regime.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **Powellの4月29日の決定 — 議長任期満了(5月15日)後も理事会に残る — が2026年の金融政策市場心理を再構築する — 2026年Q4までに、FOMCはWarsh議長の下でより小規模な反対(≤2人の反対者)規範に戻るが、Powellの理事会継続的存在は金利ではなくFRB調査ガバナンス問題に関する限界スイング票となる。** 4月29日は1992年10月以来最高の反対(8-4)のFOMCだった。Miranは-25bpを希望、Hammack/Kashkari/Loganは緩和バイアス採用に反対した。Warsh指名は同日上院銀行委員会から進展した。2026-2027年のセットアップ:Powellは2028年の任期末まで理事会、Warshは議長席に着席。議長がフレーミングを設定するため反対姿勢は金利関連で圧縮される。Powellの限界票は、トランプ政権のFRB調査結果が動くたびにガバナンスシグナルとなる。市場は金利に関するフォワードガイダンスのボラティリティの低下を織り込む一方、FRB自体への制度リスクプレミアムの上昇を織り込む。1992年先例の比較は珍奇なものではなくなり、新しいFRBガバナンス体制の金融プレス解説における構造的な参照点となり始める。
prediction_summary_locales.es: **La decisión de Powell del 29 abr de permanecer en la Board of Governors más allá de la expiración de su mandato como Chair (15 may) reconfigura la psicología de mercado de política monetaria 2026 — para Q4 2026 el FOMC revierte a una norma de menor disenso (≤2 disidentes) bajo Warsh como Chair, pero la presencia continua de Powell en la Junta se vuelve el voto bisagra marginal sobre la cuestión de gobernanza de la investigación a la Fed, no sobre tasas.** El 29 abr fue el FOMC con más disenso desde oct-1992 (8-4); Miran quería -25bp; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan se opusieron a incluir un sesgo flexibilizador. La nominación de Warsh avanzó desde el Senate Banking ese mismo día. La configuración 2026-2027: Powell en la Junta hasta el final de su mandato en 2028 con Warsh en el asiento de Chair; la postura de disenso se comprime en decisiones de tasas porque el Chair fija el encuadre; el voto marginal de Powell se vuelve una señal de gobernanza cada vez que se mueve el resultado de la investigación a la Fed por la administración Trump. Los mercados precian menor volatilidad de forward-guidance sobre tasas pero una prima de riesgo institucional mayor sobre la propia Fed. La comparación con el precedente de 1992 deja de ser una curiosidad y empieza a ser un punto de referencia estructural en las explicaciones de la prensa financiera del nuevo régimen de gobernanza de la Fed. prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang desisyon ni Powell noong Apr 29 na manatili sa Board of Governors lampas sa pagtatapos ng kanyang Chair-term (May 15) ay nagbabago sa 2026 monetary-policy market psychology — pagsapit ng Q4 2026 ang FOMC ay babalik sa smaller-dissent norm (≤2 dissenters) sa ilalim ni Warsh bilang Chair, ngunit ang patuloy na presensya ni Powell sa Board ay nagiging marginal swing vote sa Fed-investigation governance question, hindi sa rates.** Apr 29 ang pinakamataas na dissent na FOMC mula noong Oct-1992 (8-4); gusto ni Miran ng -25bp; tumutol sina Hammack/Kashkari/Logan sa pagsasama ng easing-bias. Sumulong ang Warsh nomination mula sa Senate Banking sa parehong araw. Ang 2026-2027 setup: si Powell sa Board hanggang term-end 2028 kasama si Warsh sa Chair seat; ang dissent posture ay sumasaayos sa rate calls dahil itinatakda ng Chair ang framing; ang marginal vote ni Powell ay nagiging governance signal kapag ang Trump-admin Fed-investigation outcome ay gumagalaw. Ang mga merkado ay nagpe-presyo ng mas maliit na forward-guidance volatility sa rates ngunit mas malaking institutional-risk premium sa Fed mismo. Ang 1992-precedent comparison ay tumitigil sa pagiging curiosity at nagsisimulang maging structural reference point sa financial-press explanations ng bagong Fed governance regime.

nodes.description: The Mag 7 super-week + $700B-2026-AI-capex print + Apr 30 Apple +$100B-buyback / 4%-dividend-hike combination cements 2026 as the year AI-capex disclosure splits into two reporting cadences — by Q4 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler (most likely Microsoft, given the Apr 29 $37B AI run-rate precedent) publishes audited monthly AI-business KPIs (run-rate, paid seats, deployed agents) as a 10-Q footnote; the broader S&P AI cohort (Apple, Cerebras post-IPO, Broadcom) follows with quarterly per-AI-business margin disclosure. Apr 29 Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate (+123%) was the disclosure precedent; Apr 30 Apple's record Services $30.98B (+16%) included no separate AI-services line; Apr 30 Big Tech $130B+ Q1 capex (Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon) on the way to $700B 2026 capex is the buyside-pressure number; mid-May Cerebras IPO at $22-25B with 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration is the disclosure stress-test. Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss + Apr 29 Mag 7 mixed reset (META -7.5%, MSFT -3.8% on print day) shows public-market price discrimination is already operating on imprecise AI-revenue numbers; the path of least resistance is for the most-disclosing hyperscaler to set the precedent and force the cohort to follow. SEC will not need to act ahead of voluntary disclosure here — the buyside is the forcing function.

description.ja: Mag 7スーパーウィーク+7,000億ドル-2026年AI設備投資プリント+4月30日のApple +1,000億ドル-自社株買い／4%-配当増の組み合わせは、2026年をAI設備投資開示が2つの報告ケイデンスに分裂する年として確定する ― 2026年Q4までに、少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラー(4月29日の370億ドルAIランレート前例を踏まえると、Microsoftの可能性が最も高い)が監査済みの月次AIビジネスKPI(ランレート、有料席、展開済みエージェント)を10-Qフットノートとして公表し、より広範なS&P AIコホート(Apple、IPO後のCerebras、Broadcom)が四半期ごとのAIビジネス別マージン開示で追随する。4月29日のMicrosoftの370億ドルAIランレート(+123%)は開示の前例であり、4月30日のAppleの記録的なサービス収益309.8億ドル(+16%)はAIサービスの個別ラインを含まなかった。4月30日のビッグテックの1,300億ドル超のQ1設備投資(Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon)は2026年の7,000億ドル設備投資への道のりであり、買い手側の圧力数値である。5月中旬のCerebras IPOは220億～250億ドルの評価額で、収益集中度はG42 24%／MBZUAI 62%であり、開示のストレステストである。4月28日のWSJ OpenAI収益不振+4月29日のMag 7混合リセット(プリント当日にMETA -7.5%、MSFT -3.8%)は、公開市場の価格差別が既に不正確なAI収益数値で動いていることを示している。最も抵抗の少ないパスは、最も開示するハイパースケーラーが前例を作り、コホートに追随を強制することである。SECは自主開示に先立って行動する必要はない ― 買い手側がここで強制関数となる。
description.es: La super-semana Mag 7 + el print de capex-IA-2026 de $700B + la combinación recompra de +$100B / alza de dividendo del 4% de Apple del 30 abr cementan 2026 como el año en que la disclosure de capex IA se divide en dos cadencias de reporte — para Q4 2026, al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 (muy probablemente Microsoft, dado el precedente del run-rate IA de $37B del 29 abr) publica KPIs auditados mensuales de AI-business (run-rate, paid seats, deployed agents) como nota al pie del 10-Q; el cohorte S&P AI más amplio (Apple, Cerebras post-IPO, Broadcom) sigue con disclosure trimestral de margen por AI-business. El run-rate IA de $37B (+123%) de Microsoft del 29 abr fue el precedente de disclosure; el récord de Services de $30.98B (+16%) de Apple del 30 abr no incluyó línea separada de AI-services; el capex Q1 de Big Tech de $130B+ del 30 abr (Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon) en camino a $700B de capex 2026 es el número de presión buyside; el IPO de Cerebras a mediados de mayo a $22-25B con concentración de revenue 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI es el stress-test de disclosure. El miss de revenue de OpenAI del WSJ del 28 abr + el reset mixto Mag 7 del 29 abr (META -7,5%, MSFT -3,8% en día de print) muestra que la price discrimination de mercado público ya está operando sobre números imprecisos de revenue IA; el camino de menor resistencia es que el hyperscaler más-disclosing fije el precedente y fuerce al cohorte a seguir. La SEC no necesitará actuar antes de la disclosure voluntaria aquí — el buyside es la función forzante.
description.fil: Ang kombinasyon ng Mag 7 super-week + $700B-2026-AI-capex print + Apr 30 Apple +$100B-buyback / 4%-dividend-hike ay magpapatatag sa 2026 bilang taon kung kailan ang AI-capex disclosure ay mahahati sa dalawang reporting cadences — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler (malamang Microsoft, dahil sa Apr 29 $37B AI run-rate precedent) ang maglalathala ng audited monthly AI-business KPIs (run-rate, paid seats, deployed agents) bilang 10-Q footnote; susunod ang mas malawak na S&P AI cohort (Apple, Cerebras post-IPO, Broadcom) na may quarterly per-AI-business margin disclosure. Ang Apr 29 Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate (+123%) ang disclosure precedent; ang Apr 30 Apple's record Services $30.98B (+16%) ay hindi naglakip ng hiwalay na AI-services line; ang Apr 30 Big Tech $130B+ Q1 capex (Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon) papunta sa $700B 2026 capex ang buyside-pressure number; ang mid-May Cerebras IPO sa $22-25B na may 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration ay ang disclosure stress-test. Ang Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss + Apr 29 Mag 7 mixed reset (META -7.5%, MSFT -3.8% sa print day) ay nagpapakita na ang public-market price discrimination ay umaandar na sa imprecise AI-revenue numbers; ang path of least resistance ay para sa pinaka-disclosing hyperscaler na magtakda ng precedent at piliting sundin ng cohort. Hindi na kailangang mag-act ang SEC bago ang voluntary disclosure dito — ang buyside ang forcing function.

El miss de revenue de OpenAI del WSJ del 28 abr + el reset mixto Mag 7 del 29 abr (META -7,5%, MSFT -3,8% en día de print) muestra que la price discrimination de mercado público ya está operando sobre números imprecisos de revenue IA; el camino de menor resistencia es que el hyperscaler más-disclosing fije el precedente y fuerce al cohorte a seguir. La SEC no necesitará actuar antes de la disclosure voluntaria aquí — el buyside es la función forzante.
summary.fil: Ang kombinasyon ng Mag 7 super-week + $700B-2026-AI-capex print + Apr 30 Apple +$100B-buyback / 4%-dividend-hike ay magpapatatag sa 2026 bilang taon kung kailan ang AI-capex disclosure ay mahahati sa dalawang reporting cadences — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler (malamang Microsoft, dahil sa Apr 29 $37B AI run-rate precedent) ang maglalathala ng audited monthly AI-business KPIs (run-rate, paid seats, deployed agents) bilang 10-Q footnote; susunod ang mas malawak na S&P AI cohort (Apple, Cerebras post-IPO, Broadcom) na may quarterly per-AI-business margin disclosure. Ang Apr 29 Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate (+123%) ang disclosure precedent; ang Apr 30 Apple's record Services $30.98B (+16%) ay hindi naglakip ng hiwalay na AI-services line; ang Apr 30 Big Tech $130B+ Q1 capex (Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon) papunta sa $700B 2026 capex ang buyside-pressure number; ang mid-May Cerebras IPO sa $22-25B na may 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration ay ang disclosure stress-test. Ang Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss + Apr 29 Mag 7 mixed reset (META -7.5%, MSFT -3.8% sa print day) ay nagpapakita na ang public-market price discrimination ay umaandar na sa imprecise AI-revenue numbers; ang path of least resistance ay para sa pinaka-disclosing hyperscaler na magtakda ng precedent at piliting sundin ng cohort. Hindi na kailangang mag-act ang SEC bago ang voluntary disclosure dito — ang buyside ang forcing function.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: The Mag 7 super-week + $700B-2026-AI-capex print + Apr 30 Apple +$100B-buyback / 4%-dividend-hike combination cements 2026 as the year AI-capex disclosure splits into two reporting cadences — by Q4 2026, at least one Big-3 hyperscaler (most likely Microsoft, given the Apr 29 $37B AI run-rate precedent) publishes audited monthly AI-business KPIs (run-rate, paid seats, deployed agents) as a 10-Q footnote; the broader S&P AI cohort (Apple, Cerebras post-IPO, Broadcom) follows with quarterly per-AI-business margin disclosure. Apr 29 Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate (+123%) was the disclosure precedent; Apr 30 Apple's record Services $30.98B (+16%) included no separate AI-services line; Apr 30 Big Tech $130B+ Q1 capex (Alphabet+Meta+Microsoft+Amazon) on the way to $700B 2026 capex is the buyside-pressure number; mid-May Cerebras IPO at $22-25B with 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration is the disclosure stress-test. Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue-miss + Apr 29 Mag 7 mixed reset (META -7.5%, MSFT -3.8% on print day) shows public-market price discrimination is already operating on imprecise AI-revenue numbers; the path of least resistance is for the most-disclosing hyperscaler to set the precedent and force the cohort to follow. SEC will not need to act ahead of voluntary disclosure here — the buyside is the forcing function.

nodes.description: Powell's decision to stay on the Federal Reserve Board through 2028 + the Apr 29 8-4 dissent (highest since Oct-1992) + the May 1 Apr-jobs print at the front of the May 15 Chair handoff window shifts 2026 monetary-policy market psychology from rate-volatility to institutional-volatility — by Q4 2026 the FOMC under Warsh as Chair reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2) on rate calls but the Powell-Warsh disagreement on Fed-investigation governance becomes the marginal swing-vote on any Fed-independence question; equity-market AI-capex re-rating events become more sensitive to Fed-Board signaling than to FOMC statement language. Apr 29 was the first 4-dissenter FOMC since 1992; Powell-staying-on-Board is unprecedented since 1948; Warsh confirmed by Senate Banking on Apr 29 with full-Senate vote scheduled before May 15; Apr 30 Mag-7 monthly tape (best month since 2020) is partially priced on rate-cut hopes that the FOMC dissent posture has not yet validated; May 1 Apr jobs print at the consensus 135K (vs 178K Mar) is the first weakening data into the handoff window. The "Powell as shadow chair" framing was specifically rejected by Powell on Apr 29 ("I won't be a shadow chair") but the institutional reality of a 7-member Board with Powell as a dissenting governor under a Warsh chair creates exactly that dynamic on Fed-independence questions, even if not on rates. Markets will compress rate-volatility pricing and inflate institutional-risk pricing through 2026 H2.

description.en: Powell's decision to stay on the Federal Reserve Board through 2028 + the Apr 29 8-4 dissent (highest since Oct-1992) + the May 1 Apr-jobs print at the front of the May 15 Chair handoff window shifts 2026 monetary-policy market psychology from rate-volatility to institutional-volatility — by Q4 2026 the FOMC under Warsh as Chair reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2) on rate calls but the Powell-Warsh disagreement on Fed-investigation governance becomes the marginal swing-vote on any Fed-independence question; equity-market AI-capex re-rating events become more sensitive to Fed-Board signaling than to FOMC statement language. Apr 29 was the first 4-dissenter FOMC since 1992; Powell-staying-on-Board is unprecedented since 1948; Warsh confirmed by Senate Banking on Apr 29 with full-Senate vote scheduled before May 15; Apr 30 Mag-7 monthly tape (best month since 2020) is partially priced on rate-cut hopes that the FOMC dissent posture has not yet validated; May 1 Apr jobs print at the consensus 135K (vs 178K Mar) is the first weakening data into the handoff window. The "Powell as shadow chair" framing was specifically rejected by Powell on Apr 29 ("I won't be a shadow chair") but the institutional reality of a 7-member Board with Powell as a dissenting governor under a Warsh chair creates exactly that dynamic on Fed-independence questions, even if not on rates. Markets will compress rate-volatility pricing and inflate institutional-risk pricing through 2026 H2.
description.ja: Powellの2028年までの連邦準備制度理事会への留任決定+4月29日の8-4反対票(1992年10月以来最高)+5月15日の議長交代ウィンドウ前面の5月1日4月雇用統計プリントは、2026年の金融政策市場心理を金利ボラティリティから制度的ボラティリティへとシフトさせる ― 2026年Q4までにWarsh議長下のFOMCは金利決定で小規模な反対票標準(2票以下)に戻るが、Fed調査ガバナンスに関するPowell-Warshの不一致が連邦準備制度の独立性に関する問題での限界スイング票となり、株式市場のAI設備投資再評価イベントはFOMC声明の文言よりも理事会のシグナリングに敏感になる。4月29日は1992年以来初の4反対票FOMCであり、Powellの理事会留任は1948年以来前例がなく、Warshは4月29日に上院銀行委員会で承認され、5月15日前に上院本会議投票が予定されている。4月30日のMag-7月次テープ(2020年以来最高の月)はFOMC反対姿勢がまだ検証していない利下げ期待で部分的に価格設定されている。5月1日の4月雇用統計プリントはコンセンサス13.5万件(3月17.8万件比)で、交代ウィンドウへの最初の弱含みデータである。「シャドウ議長としてのPowell」フレーミングは4月29日にPowellによって明確に拒否された(「私はシャドウ議長にはならない」)が、Warsh議長下で反対票理事としてのPowellを伴う7名理事会の制度的現実は、金利ではないにせよ、Fed独立性の問題でまさにそのダイナミクスを生み出す。市場は2026年下半期を通じて金利ボラティリティ価格を圧縮し、制度的リスク価格を膨張させるだろう。
description.es: La decisión de Powell de quedarse en la Federal Reserve Board hasta 2028 + el disenso 8-4 del 29 abr (el más alto desde oct-1992) + el print de empleo de abril del 1 may al frente del ventana de handoff del Chair del 15 may desplaza la psicología de mercado de política monetaria 2026 de rate-volatility a institutional-volatility — para Q4 2026 el FOMC bajo Warsh como Chair revierte a una norma de menor disenso (≤2) en decisiones de tasas pero el desacuerdo Powell-Warsh sobre gobernanza de la investigación a la Fed se vuelve el voto bisagra marginal en cualquier cuestión de Fed-independence; los eventos de re-rating de capex IA del mercado equity se vuelven más sensibles al señaling de la Fed-Board que al lenguaje del statement del FOMC. El 29 abr fue el primer FOMC con 4 disidentes desde 1992; Powell-quedarse-en-Board no tiene precedente desde 1948; Warsh confirmado por Senate Banking el 29 abr con voto del Senado completo programado antes del 15 may; el tape mensual Mag-7 del 30 abr (mejor mes desde 2020) está parcialmente preciado sobre esperanzas de rate-cut que la postura de disenso del FOMC aún no ha validado; el print de empleo de abril del 1 may al consenso de 135K (vs 178K de marzo) es la primera data de debilitamiento dentro de la ventana de handoff. El framing de "Powell como shadow chair" fue específicamente rechazado por Powell el 29 abr ("No seré un shadow chair") pero la realidad institucional de una Board de 7 miembros con Powell como gobernador disidente bajo un Chair Warsh crea exactamente esa dinámica en cuestiones de Fed-independence, aunque no en tasas. Los mercados comprimirán el pricing de rate-volatility e inflarán el pricing de institutional-risk a través del H2 2026.
description.fil: Ang desisyon ni Powell na manatili sa Federal Reserve Board hanggang 2028 + ang Apr 29 8-4 dissent (pinakamataas mula Oct-1992) + ang May 1 Apr-jobs print sa harap ng May 15 Chair handoff window ay maglilipat ng 2026 monetary-policy market psychology mula rate-volatility patungo sa institutional-volatility — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang FOMC sa ilalim ni Warsh bilang Chair ay babalik sa smaller-dissent norm (≤2) sa rate calls ngunit ang Powell-Warsh disagreement sa Fed-investigation governance ay magiging marginal swing-vote sa anumang Fed-independence question; ang equity-market AI-capex re-rating events ay magiging mas sensitibo sa Fed-Board signaling kaysa sa FOMC statement language. Ang Apr 29 ang unang 4-dissenter FOMC mula 1992; ang Powell-staying-on-Board ay walang pang precedent mula 1948; kinumpirma si Warsh ng Senate Banking noong Apr 29 na may full-Senate vote na nakaiskedyul bago ang May 15; ang Apr 30 Mag-7 monthly tape (best month since 2020) ay bahagyang naka-price sa rate-cut hopes na hindi pa na-validate ng FOMC dissent posture; ang May 1 Apr jobs print sa consensus 135K (vs 178K Mar) ang unang weakening data papasok sa handoff window. Ang "Powell as shadow chair" framing ay partikular na tinanggihan ni Powell noong Apr 29 ("I won't be a shadow chair") ngunit ang institutional reality ng 7-member Board kasama si Powell bilang dissenting governor sa ilalim ng Warsh chair ay lumilikha mismo ng dynamic na iyon sa mga Fed-independence questions, kahit na hindi sa rates. Mag-co-compress ang markets ng rate-volatility pricing at mag-iinflate ng institutional-risk pricing hanggang 2026 H2.

detail.summary_short: Powell's choice to stay on the Board through 2028 plus the Apr 29 8-4 FOMC dissent, Warsh's pending Chair confirmation, and the May 1 Apr jobs print compress rate-volatility pricing while inflating institutional-risk pricing — by Q4 2026 FOMC dissent reverts to ≤2 on rates while Powell's Board vote becomes the marginal signal on Fed-independence questions.

summary_short_locales.en: Powell's choice to stay on the Board through 2028 plus the Apr 29 8-4 FOMC dissent, Warsh's pending Chair confirmation, and the May 1 Apr jobs print compress rate-volatility pricing while inflating institutional-risk pricing — by Q4 2026 FOMC dissent reverts to ≤2 on rates while Powell's Board vote becomes the marginal signal on Fed-independence questions.
summary_short_locales.ja: Powellの2028年までの理事会留任の選択に加え、4月29日の8-4 FOMC反対票、Warshの議長承認待ち、5月1日の4月雇用統計プリントは、金利ボラティリティ価格を圧縮しつつ制度的リスク価格を膨張させる ― 2026年Q4までにFOMC反対票は金利で2票以下に戻る一方で、Powellの理事会票はFed独立性の問題に関する限界シグナルとなる。
summary_short_locales.es: La elección de Powell de quedarse en la Board hasta 2028 más el disenso FOMC 8-4 del 29 abr, la confirmación pendiente de Warsh como Chair, y el print de empleo de abril del 1 may comprimen el pricing de rate-volatility mientras inflan el pricing de institutional-risk — para Q4 2026 el disenso del FOMC revierte a ≤2 en tasas mientras que el voto de Powell en la Board se vuelve la señal marginal en cuestiones de Fed-independence.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang pagpili ni Powell na manatili sa Board hanggang 2028 plus ang Apr 29 8-4 FOMC dissent, ang nakabinbing confirmation ni Warsh bilang Chair, at ang May 1 Apr jobs print ay nag-co-compress ng rate-volatility pricing habang nag-iinflate ng institutional-risk pricing — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang FOMC dissent ay babalik sa ≤2 sa rates habang ang Board vote ni Powell ang magiging marginal signal sa Fed-independence questions.

bridges.text: Powell's stay-through-2028 plus Warsh's pending full-Senate vote plus the May 1 jobs print into the Chair-handoff window are the institutional configuration the prediction's rate-to-institutional-volatility migration depends on. The May 1 record tape adds the equity sensitivity layer that turns Fed-Board signaling into a re-rating lever.

text_locales.en: Powell's stay-through-2028 plus Warsh's pending full-Senate vote plus the May 1 jobs print into the Chair-handoff window are the institutional configuration the prediction's rate-to-institutional-volatility migration depends on. The May 1 record tape adds the equity sensitivity layer that turns Fed-Board signaling into a re-rating lever.
text_locales.ja: Powellの2028年までの残留、Warshの保留中の全院投票、5月1日の雇用統計が議長交代ウィンドウに向かうことが、予測の金利から制度ボラティリティへの移行が依存する制度配置だ。5月1日の記録的テープは、連邦理事会シグナリングを再格付けレバーに変える株式感応度層を加える。
text_locales.es: La permanencia de Powell hasta 2028 más el voto pendiente del Senado completo de Warsh más la impresión de empleos del 1 de mayo hacia la ventana de transferencia de Presidencia son la configuración institucional de la que depende la migración de tasas a volatilidad institucional de la predicción. El tape récord del 1 de mayo añade la capa de sensibilidad de renta variable que convierte las señales de la Junta de la Fed en una palanca de re-rating.
text_locales.fil: Ang stay-through-2028 ni Powell plus ang nakabinbing full-Senate vote ni Warsh plus ang May 1 jobs print papasok sa Chair-handoff window ang institutional configuration na inaasahan ng rate-to-institutional-volatility migration ng prediction. Ang May 1 record tape ay nagdaragdag ng equity sensitivity layer na nagpapalit sa Fed-Board signaling tungo sa re-rating lever.

bridges.text: The BLS clarification that the Apr employment print actually lands May 8 shifts the original timing arc by one week; Powell's announced Board posture stays intact, so the institutional-volatility regime remains the structurally-favored landing.

text_locales.en: The BLS clarification that the Apr employment print actually lands May 8 shifts the original timing arc by one week; Powell's announced Board posture stays intact, so the institutional-volatility regime remains the structurally-favored landing.
text_locales.ja: 4月雇用統計が実際には5月8日に着地するというBLSの明確化が、当初のタイミングアークを1週間ずらす;Powellの発表されたBoard姿勢は無傷のままであり、制度的ボラティリティ体制は構造的に好まれる着地のままである。
text_locales.es: La aclaración del BLS de que la impresión de empleo de abril realmente aterriza el 8 mayo desplaza el arco de tiempo original en una semana; la postura de la Junta anunciada por Powell se mantiene intacta, así que el régimen de volatilidad institucional sigue siendo el aterrizaje estructuralmente favorecido.
text_locales.fil: Ang BLS clarification na ang Apr employment print ay aktwal na lumalapag noong May 8 ay naglilipat ng original timing arc nang isang linggo; nananatili ang inanunsyong Board posture ni Powell, kaya nananatili ang institutional-volatility regime bilang structurally-favored landing.

outcome_locales.en: First Warsh-led FOMC press conference + statement that re-anchors the dissent norm and explicitly separates rate framing from governance posture.

outcome_locales.es: Primera conferencia de prensa + statement del FOMC liderado por Warsh que re-ancla la norma de disenso y separa explícitamente el framing de tasas del de la postura de gobernanza.
outcome_locales.fil: Unang Warsh-led FOMC press conference + statement na nag-re-anchor ng dissent norm at explicit na naghihiwalay sa rate framing mula sa governance posture.

motivation_locales.en: The Apr 29 8-4 dissent (highest since Oct-1992) is unsustainable as a steady-state framing; the incoming Chair must compress rate-call dissent to restore forward-guidance volatility to a normal envelope before the May 1 jobs print and into Q3-Q4 2026.
motivation_locales.ja: 4月29日の8-4反対票(1992年10月以来最高)は定常状態フレーミングとして持続不可能である。新議長は、5月1日の雇用統計プリント前および2026年Q3-Q4にわたって、フォワードガイダンスボラティリティを通常範囲に戻すために金利決定の反対票を圧縮しなければならない。
motivation_locales.es: El disenso 8-4 del 29 abr (el más alto desde oct-1992) es insostenible como framing steady-state; el Chair entrante debe comprimir el disenso de decisiones de tasas para restaurar la volatilidad de forward-guidance a un envelope normal antes del print de empleo del 1 may y dentro de Q3-Q4 2026.
motivation_locales.fil: Ang Apr 29 8-4 dissent (pinakamataas mula Oct-1992) ay hindi sustainable bilang steady-state framing; ang incoming Chair ay dapat mag-compress ng rate-call dissent upang maibalik ang forward-guidance volatility sa normal envelope bago ang May 1 jobs print at papasok sa Q3-Q4 2026.

detail.description: Powell's decision to stay on the Federal Reserve Board through 2028 + the Apr 29 8-4 dissent (highest since Oct-1992) + the May 1 Apr-jobs print at the front of the May 15 Chair handoff window shifts 2026 monetary-policy market psychology from rate-volatility to institutional-volatility — by Q4 2026 the FOMC under Warsh as Chair reverts to a smaller-dissent norm (≤2) on rate calls but the Powell-Warsh disagreement on Fed-investigation governance becomes the marginal swing-vote on any Fed-independence question; equity-market AI-capex re-rating events become more sensitive to Fed-Board signaling than to FOMC statement language. Apr 29 was the first 4-dissenter FOMC since 1992; Powell-staying-on-Board is unprecedented since 1948; Warsh confirmed by Senate Banking on Apr 29 with full-Senate vote scheduled before May 15; Apr 30 Mag-7 monthly tape (best month since 2020) is partially priced on rate-cut hopes that the FOMC dissent posture has not yet validated; May 1 Apr jobs print at the consensus 135K (vs 178K Mar) is the first weakening data into the handoff window. The "Powell as shadow chair" framing was specifically rejected by Powell on Apr 29 ("I won't be a shadow chair") but the institutional reality of a 7-member Board with Powell as a dissenting governor under a Warsh chair creates exactly that dynamic on Fed-independence questions, even if not on rates. Markets will compress rate-volatility pricing and inflate institutional-risk pricing through 2026 H2.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: Powellの2028年までの連邦準備制度理事会への留任決定+4月29日の8-4反対票(1992年10月以来最高)+5月15日の議長交代ウィンドウ前面の5月1日4月雇用統計プリントは、2026年の金融政策市場心理を金利ボラティリティから制度的ボラティリティへとシフトさせる ― 2026年Q4までにWarsh議長下のFOMCは金利決定で小規模な反対票標準(2票以下)に戻るが、Fed調査ガバナンスに関するPowell-Warshの不一致が連邦準備制度の独立性に関する問題での限界スイング票となり、株式市場のAI設備投資再評価イベントはFOMC声明の文言よりも理事会のシグナリングに敏感になる。4月29日は1992年以来初の4反対票FOMCであり、Powellの理事会留任は1948年以来前例がなく、Warshは4月29日に上院銀行委員会で承認され、5月15日前に上院本会議投票が予定されている。4月30日のMag-7月次テープ(2020年以来最高の月)はFOMC反対姿勢がまだ検証していない利下げ期待で部分的に価格設定されている。5月1日の4月雇用統計プリントはコンセンサス13.5万件(3月17.8万件比)で、交代ウィンドウへの最初の弱含みデータである。「シャドウ議長としてのPowell」フレーミングは4月29日にPowellによって明確に拒否された(「私はシャドウ議長にはならない」)が、Warsh議長下で反対票理事としてのPowellを伴う7名理事会の制度的現実は、金利ではないにせよ、Fed独立性の問題でまさにそのダイナミクスを生み出す。市場は2026年下半期を通じて金利ボラティリティ価格を圧縮し、制度的リスク価格を膨張させるだろう。
prediction_summary_locales.es: La decisión de Powell de quedarse en la Federal Reserve Board hasta 2028 + el disenso 8-4 del 29 abr (el más alto desde oct-1992) + el print de empleo de abril del 1 may al frente del ventana de handoff del Chair del 15 may desplaza la psicología de mercado de política monetaria 2026 de rate-volatility a institutional-volatility — para Q4 2026 el FOMC bajo Warsh como Chair revierte a una norma de menor disenso (≤2) en decisiones de tasas pero el desacuerdo Powell-Warsh sobre gobernanza de la investigación a la Fed se vuelve el voto bisagra marginal en cualquier cuestión de Fed-independence; los eventos de re-rating de capex IA del mercado equity se vuelven más sensibles al señaling de la Fed-Board que al lenguaje del statement del FOMC. El 29 abr fue el primer FOMC con 4 disidentes desde 1992; Powell-quedarse-en-Board no tiene precedente desde 1948; Warsh confirmado por Senate Banking el 29 abr con voto del Senado completo programado antes del 15 may; el tape mensual Mag-7 del 30 abr (mejor mes desde 2020) está parcialmente preciado sobre esperanzas de rate-cut que la postura de disenso del FOMC aún no ha validado; el print de empleo de abril del 1 may al consenso de 135K (vs 178K de marzo) es la primera data de debilitamiento dentro de la ventana de handoff. El framing de "Powell como shadow chair" fue específicamente rechazado por Powell el 29 abr ("No seré un shadow chair") pero la realidad institucional de una Board de 7 miembros con Powell como gobernador disidente bajo un Chair Warsh crea exactamente esa dinámica en cuestiones de Fed-independence, aunque no en tasas. Los mercados comprimirán el pricing de rate-volatility e inflarán el pricing de institutional-risk a través del H2 2026.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Ang desisyon ni Powell na manatili sa Federal Reserve Board hanggang 2028 + ang Apr 29 8-4 dissent (pinakamataas mula Oct-1992) + ang May 1 Apr-jobs print sa harap ng May 15 Chair handoff window ay maglilipat ng 2026 monetary-policy market psychology mula rate-volatility patungo sa institutional-volatility — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang FOMC sa ilalim ni Warsh bilang Chair ay babalik sa smaller-dissent norm (≤2) sa rate calls ngunit ang Powell-Warsh disagreement sa Fed-investigation governance ay magiging marginal swing-vote sa anumang Fed-independence question; ang equity-market AI-capex re-rating events ay magiging mas sensitibo sa Fed-Board signaling kaysa sa FOMC statement language. Ang Apr 29 ang unang 4-dissenter FOMC mula 1992; ang Powell-staying-on-Board ay walang pang precedent mula 1948; kinumpirma si Warsh ng Senate Banking noong Apr 29 na may full-Senate vote na nakaiskedyul bago ang May 15; ang Apr 30 Mag-7 monthly tape (best month since 2020) ay bahagyang naka-price sa rate-cut hopes na hindi pa na-validate ng FOMC dissent posture; ang May 1 Apr jobs print sa consensus 135K (vs 178K Mar) ang unang weakening data papasok sa handoff window. Ang "Powell as shadow chair" framing ay partikular na tinanggihan ni Powell noong Apr 29 ("I won't be a shadow chair") ngunit ang institutional reality ng 7-member Board kasama si Powell bilang dissenting governor sa ilalim ng Warsh chair ay lumilikha mismo ng dynamic na iyon sa mga Fed-independence questions, kahit na hindi sa rates. Mag-co-compress ang markets ng rate-volatility pricing at mag-iinflate ng institutional-risk pricing hanggang 2026 H2.

detail.description: **The May 1 record S&P 7,230.12 + Nasdaq 25,114.44 + April best-month-since-2020 + AAPL +3.28% to $280.25 + $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape sets up the mid-May Cerebras IPO to price at or above the top of the $22-25B targeted range with a multi-day pop — the Apr 30 Apple +$100B buyback authorization + the Q3 guide (+14-17%) is the buyside ratification of the AI-capex-on-faith thesis, and the Cerebras roadshow lands into the cleanest single tape since 2020; pricing closer to the pre-IPO secondary $26-28B than the public S-1 $22-25B; first-day pop ≥30% with the underwriter syndicate (Morgan Stanley / Citi / Barclays / UBS) pulling allocation aggressively from the long-only side; the IPO becomes the cohort signal that the AI-infrastructure-build is fundable through public markets and not just private capex.** $510M 2025 revenue + $20B+/750MW OpenAI deal through 2028 + the 24% G42 / 62% MBZUAI revenue concentration is priced in already; the swing factor is the May 1 record-tape ratification of the AI-capex thesis, which the buyside has been waiting for since the Apr 28 OpenAI-revenue-miss WSJ. The mid-May window also avoids competing with the May 8 Apr Jobs print + the May 5 AMD print; pricing should land in the pre-Cerebras quiet-period sweet spot. In plain language: A clean record stock tape makes the next AI-chip IPO likely to price above expectations. In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.description: **By Q4 2026 the cohort buyside-pressure stack — Apr 30 AAPL Q3 guide +14-17% (vs 9.5% consensus) printed without a separate AI-services line + $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI capex tape + AAPL +$100B buyback authorization + Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item disclosure precedent + OpenAI $25B annualized + $2B/month run rate + 122M paid by 2026 with $8/month + ad pilot $100M-annualized opacity + Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22-25B targeted — forces the SEC to publish a concept release (Reg S-K amendment proposal) on audited AI-business KPI disclosure for hyperscalers and foundation labs filing public comparables; at least one Big-3 hyperscaler pre-emptively publishes an audited AI-business KPI segment in a 10-Q footnote, ahead of any rule finalization, to anchor the disclosure shape.** Forcing function is the disclosure-shape gap between the cohort's collective $700B capex commitment and the cohort's lack of audited AI-KPI footnote: the buyside is being asked to underwrite eight digits of AI capex per quarter without the separate-segment view the SEC already requires for cloud, gaming, and other reporting segments. In plain language: Investors are spending hundreds of billions on AI without seeing what they're getting back — the SEC will publish a draft rule asking companies to break it out.
