description.ja: **2026年Q4までに、コホート買い手側圧力スタック — 4月30日AAPL Q3ガイダンス+14-17%(コンセンサス9.5%対比)が別のAIサービスラインなしで印字、$700Bの2026年Big-Tech AI capexテープ、AAPL +$100Bの自社株買い承認、4月29日MSFTの$37B AI run-rate単一ライン項目開示前例、OpenAIの$25B年換算 + $2B/月のrun rate + 2026年までに$8/月で122M有料 + 広告パイロット$100M年換算の不透明性、5月中旬にCerebras IPOが$22-25B目標 — がSECに、ハイパースケーラーとファウンデーションラボの公開比較対象提出に対する、監査済みAI事業KPI開示についてのコンセプトリリース(Reg S-K改正提案)の公表を強いる。少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラーが、規則最終化に先立って、開示形を錨付けするために監査済みAI事業KPIセグメントを10-Q脚注に先制公表する。** 強制力はコホートの集合的$700B capexコミットメントとコホートの監査済みAI-KPI脚注の欠如との間の開示形ギャップだ。買い手側は、SECが既にクラウド、ゲーム、その他の報告セグメントに要求している別個セグメントビューなしで、四半期当たり8桁のAI capexを引き受けることを要求されている。5月1日のCerebras IPOロードショーと公開S-1開示、4月28日のWSJ OpenAI収益テープ、4月29日のMSFT $37B前例が運用上の錨信号だ。SECは既に4月28日のReg S-K近代化コメント期間(気候開示規則制定の伴侶)を通じて規制窓を開いており、AI収益開示は自然な次の追加だ。平易な言葉で言えば: 投資家は何が返ってくるかを見ずにAIに数千億ドルを使っている — SECは企業にそれを内訳開示するよう求めるドラフト規則を公表する。
description.es: **Para Q4 2026, la pila de presión del lado comprador del cohorte — la guía Q3 de AAPL del 30 de abril +14-17% (vs consenso del 9.5%) impresa sin una línea separada de servicios de IA + el tape de capex de IA de Big-Tech 2026 de $700B + la autorización de recompra de +$100B de AAPL + el precedente de divulgación de línea única del run-rate de IA de $37B de MSFT del 29 de abril + OpenAI con $25B anualizados + run rate de $2B/mes + 122M pagos para 2026 a $8/mes + opacidad del piloto de anuncios de $100M anualizados + Cerebras con IPO a mediados de mayo apuntando a $22-25B — fuerza a la SEC a publicar un concept release (propuesta de enmienda al Reg S-K) sobre divulgación auditada de KPIs de negocio de IA para hyperscalers y laboratorios fundacionales que presentan comparables públicos; al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 publica preventivamente un segmento auditado de KPI de negocio de IA en una nota al pie de un 10-Q, antes de cualquier finalización de regla, para anclar la forma de divulgación.** La función forzante es la brecha de forma de divulgación entre el compromiso colectivo de capex de $700B del cohorte y la falta de una nota al pie auditada de KPI de IA del cohorte: se le pide al lado comprador que asegure ocho dígitos de capex de IA por trimestre sin la vista de segmento separado que la SEC ya requiere para nube, gaming, y otros segmentos reportables. El roadshow del IPO de Cerebras del 1 de mayo con divulgación pública S-1 + el tape del WSJ del 28 de abril sobre ingresos de OpenAI + el precedente de $37B de MSFT del 29 de abril son las señales operativas de anclaje; la SEC ya ha abierto la ventana regulatoria vía el período de comentarios de modernización del Reg S-K del 28 de abril (compañero a la regulación de divulgación climática), y la divulgación de ingresos de IA es la siguiente adición natural. En lenguaje sencillo: Los inversores están gastando cientos de miles de millones en IA sin ver lo que están obteniendo de vuelta — la SEC publicará un borrador de regla pidiendo a las empresas que lo desglosen.
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang cohort buyside-pressure stack — ang Apr 30 AAPL Q3 guide na +14-17% (vs 9.5% consensus) na inilabas nang walang hiwalay na AI-services line + ang $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI capex tape + AAPL +$100B buyback authorization + ang Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item disclosure precedent + OpenAI $25B annualized + $2B/month run rate + 122M paid pagsapit ng 2026 sa $8/month + ad pilot $100M-annualized opacity + Cerebras IPO sa kalagitnaan ng Mayo na may target na $22-25B — ay magpipilit sa SEC na maglathala ng concept release (Reg S-K amendment proposal) tungkol sa audited AI-business KPI disclosure para sa hyperscalers at foundation labs na nagfa-file ng public comparables; hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler ang preemptive na maglalathala ng audited AI-business KPI segment sa 10-Q footnote, bago ang anumang rule finalization, upang i-anchor ang hugis ng disclosure.** Ang forcing function ay ang puwang sa hugis ng disclosure sa pagitan ng cohort's collective $700B capex commitment at ng kakulangan ng cohort sa audited AI-KPI footnote: hinihiling sa buyside na underwrite ang walong-digit na AI capex bawat quarter nang walang hiwalay na segment view na hinihingi na ng SEC para sa cloud, gaming, at iba pang reporting segments. Ang May 1 Cerebras IPO roadshow na may pampublikong S-1 disclosure + ang Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue tape + ang Apr 29 MSFT $37B precedent ay ang operative anchor signals; binuksan na ng SEC ang regulatory window sa pamamagitan ng Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization comment period (kasama ng climate-disclosure rulemaking), at ang AI-revenue disclosure ang likas na susunod na karagdagan. Sa madaling salita: gumagastos ang mga investor ng daan-daang bilyon sa AI nang hindi nakikita kung ano ang nakukuha nila pabalik — maglalathala ang SEC ng draft rule na hihiling sa mga kompanya na ihiwalay ito.

reasoning.given: Cerebras IPO S-1 disclosure mid-May, the Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue tape, and the Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization comment period open the regulatory window.
reasoning.so_that: The SEC issues a concept release on audited AI-business KPI disclosure and at least one Big-3 hyperscaler ships a pre-emptive 10-Q AI-segment footnote.
reasoning.landing: By Q4 2026; concept release plus one hyperscaler 10-Q AI-KPI footnote.
reasoning.plain_language: Hundreds of billions are flowing into AI with no separate line on the financials; the SEC will draft a rule that forces companies to break out what AI brings in.

because.en: AAPL Q3 guide +14-17% printed without an AI-services line, MSFT cited a $37B AI run-rate, and the cohort's 2026 capex tape ran to ~$700B.
because.ja: AAPL Q3ガイダンス+14-17%がAIサービスラインなしで印字、MSFTが$37B AI run-rateを引用、コホートの2026年capexテープが~$700Bに達した。
because.es: La guía Q3 de AAPL +14-17% se imprimió sin una línea de servicios de IA, MSFT citó un run-rate de IA de $37B, y el tape de capex 2026 del cohorte llegó a ~$700B.
because.fil: Ang AAPL Q3 guide na +14-17% ay inilabas nang walang AI-services line, binanggit ng MSFT ang $37B AI run-rate, at ang 2026 capex tape ng cohort ay umabot sa ~$700B.

given.en: Cerebras IPO S-1 disclosure mid-May, the Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue tape, and the Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization comment period open the regulatory window.
given.ja: 5月中旬のCerebras IPO S-1開示、4月28日のWSJ OpenAI収益テープ、4月28日のReg S-K近代化コメント期間が規制窓を開く。
given.es: Divulgación S-1 del IPO de Cerebras a mediados de mayo, el tape del WSJ del 28 de abril sobre ingresos de OpenAI, y el período de comentarios de modernización del Reg S-K del 28 de abril abren la ventana regulatoria.
given.fil: Ang Cerebras IPO S-1 disclosure sa kalagitnaan ng Mayo, ang Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue tape, at ang Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization comment period ay nagbubukas ng regulatory window.

so_that.en: The SEC issues a concept release on audited AI-business KPI disclosure and at least one Big-3 hyperscaler ships a pre-emptive 10-Q AI-segment footnote.
so_that.ja: SECが監査済みAI事業KPI開示についてのコンセプトリリースを発出し、少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラーが先制的に10-Q AIセグメント脚注を出荷する。
so_that.es: La SEC emita un concept release sobre divulgación auditada de KPIs de negocio de IA y al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 entregue una nota al pie preventiva de segmento de IA en un 10-Q.
so_that.fil: Magla-issue ang SEC ng concept release sa audited AI-business KPI disclosure at hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler ang maglalabas ng pre-emptive na 10-Q AI-segment footnote.

landing.en: By Q4 2026; concept release plus one hyperscaler 10-Q AI-KPI footnote.
landing.ja: 2026年Q4までに、コンセプトリリースと1つのハイパースケーラー10-Q AI-KPI脚注。
landing.es: Para Q4 2026; concept release más una nota al pie de KPI de IA en 10-Q de un hyperscaler.
landing.fil: Pagsapit ng Q4 2026; concept release plus isang hyperscaler 10-Q AI-KPI footnote.

plain_language.en: Hundreds of billions are flowing into AI with no separate line on the financials; the SEC will draft a rule that forces companies to break out what AI brings in.
plain_language.ja: 数千億ドルがAIに流れ込んでいるが財務諸表に別ラインがない。SECは企業にAIが何をもたらすかを内訳開示することを強制する規則をドラフトする。
plain_language.es: Cientos de miles de millones están fluyendo hacia la IA sin una línea separada en los estados financieros; la SEC redactará una regla que obligue a las empresas a desglosar lo que la IA aporta.
plain_language.fil: Daan-daang bilyon ang dumadaloy sa AI nang walang hiwalay na linya sa financials; magdadrap ang SEC ng panuntunan na magpipilit sa mga kompanya na ihiwalay kung ano ang dinadala ng AI.

detail.summary_short: AAPL's $700B-capex-cohort guide without an AI-services line, MSFT's $37B AI run-rate precedent, the Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI tape, and the Cerebras IPO S-1 sit on the Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization window. By Q4 2026 an SEC concept release is expected on audited AI-KPI disclosure with one Big-3 hyperscaler pre-emptively publishing an AI-segment footnote.

summary_short_locales.en: AAPL's $700B-capex-cohort guide without an AI-services line, MSFT's $37B AI run-rate precedent, the Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI tape, and the Cerebras IPO S-1 sit on the Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization window. By Q4 2026 an SEC concept release is expected on audited AI-KPI disclosure with one Big-3 hyperscaler pre-emptively publishing an AI-segment footnote.
summary_short_locales.ja: AAPLの$700B capexコホートガイダンスがAIサービスラインなし、MSFTの$37B AI run-rate前例、4月28日のWSJ OpenAIテープ、Cerebras IPOのS-1が、4月28日のReg S-K近代化窓に乗っている。2026年Q4までに、監査済みAI-KPI開示についてのSECコンセプトリリースが見込まれ、1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラーが先制的にAIセグメント脚注を公表する。
summary_short_locales.es: La guía del cohorte de capex de $700B de AAPL sin línea de servicios de IA, el precedente de run-rate de IA de $37B de MSFT, el tape del WSJ del 28 de abril, y el S-1 del IPO de Cerebras se sitúan sobre la ventana de modernización del Reg S-K del 28 de abril. Para Q4 2026 se espera un concept release de la SEC sobre divulgación auditada de KPI de IA con un hyperscaler Big-3 publicando preventivamente una nota al pie de segmento de IA.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang $700B-capex-cohort guide ng AAPL nang walang AI-services line, ang $37B AI run-rate precedent ng MSFT, ang Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI tape, at ang Cerebras IPO S-1 ay nakaupo sa Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization window. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, inaasahan ang isang SEC concept release sa audited AI-KPI disclosure kasama ang isang Big-3 hyperscaler na maglalathala ng pre-emptive AI-segment footnote.

bridges.text: Sunday Mag-7 previews name the May 21 Alphabet analyst day as the operative pricing event for the AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout, Wells Fargo Securities now expects Alphabet to ship a Q2 footnote mirroring Microsoft's fiscal Q1 2027 breakout, and Jefferies' CBRS coverage cites the SEC Corp Fin sample letter as removing the Reg FD selective-disclosure overhang.

text_locales.en: Sunday Mag-7 previews name the May 21 Alphabet analyst day as the operative pricing event for the AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout, Wells Fargo Securities now expects Alphabet to ship a Q2 footnote mirroring Microsoft's fiscal Q1 2027 breakout, and Jefferies' CBRS coverage cites the SEC Corp Fin sample letter as removing the Reg FD selective-disclosure overhang.
text_locales.ja: 日曜Mag-7プレビューは5月21日Alphabetアナリスト・デイをAIサービス10-Qフットノート・ブレイクアウトの作動価格決定イベントとして命名、Wells Fargo Securitiesは今やAlphabetにMicrosoftの会計Q1 2027ブレイクアウトをミラーするQ2フットノートを出荷することを期待する、そしてJefferiesのCBRSカバレッジはSEC Corp FinサンプルレターをReg FD選択的開示オーバーハング除去として引用する。
text_locales.es: Los previews Mag-7 dominicales nombran el día de analistas de Alphabet del 21 de mayo como el evento de pricing operativo para el desglose de footnote 10-Q AI Services, Wells Fargo Securities ahora espera que Alphabet envíe un footnote Q2 reflejando el desglose fiscal Q1 2027 de Microsoft, y la cobertura CBRS de Jefferies cita la carta muestra de SEC Corp Fin como eliminadora del overhang de divulgación selectiva Reg FD.
text_locales.fil: Pinapangalanan ng Sunday Mag-7 previews ang Mayo 21 Alphabet analyst day bilang operative pricing event para sa AI Services 10-Q footnote breakout, inaasahan na ngayon ng Wells Fargo Securities na mag-ship ang Alphabet ng Q2 footnote na sumasalamin sa fiscal Q1 2027 breakout ng Microsoft, at binabanggit ng Jefferies' CBRS coverage ang SEC Corp Fin sample letter bilang pag-aalis sa Reg FD selective-disclosure overhang.

bridges.text: AMD's May 5 Q1 print plus Q2 guide plus Anthropic run-rate >$30B published via journalist channels plus the May 4 FIS + parallel-JV launches plus NVIDIA Blackwell at ~1,000 NVL72 racks/week tighten the structural force the SEC AI-KPI prediction (May 3) names: buyside underwriting ~$700B 2026 capex against bundled accelerator lines and unaudited run-rate cadence creates a multi-vehicle anchor for a uniform AI-business KPI disclosure regime.

text_locales.en: AMD's May 5 Q1 print plus Q2 guide plus Anthropic run-rate >$30B published via journalist channels plus the May 4 FIS + parallel-JV launches plus NVIDIA Blackwell at ~1,000 NVL72 racks/week tighten the structural force the SEC AI-KPI prediction (May 3) names: buyside underwriting ~$700B 2026 capex against bundled accelerator lines and unaudited run-rate cadence creates a multi-vehicle anchor for a uniform AI-business KPI disclosure regime.
text_locales.ja: AMDの5月5日 Q1決算 + Q2ガイダンス + ジャーナリスト・チャネル経由で公表された $30B 超のAnthropicランレート + 5月4日のFIS + 並行JVローンチ + 週約1,000台NVL72ラックのNVIDIA Blackwellが、SEC AI-KPI予測(5月3日)が指摘する構造的な強制力を引き締める: バンドルされたアクセラレーター・ラインと監査されていないランレート・ケイデンスに対するバイサイドの約 $700B 2026年capex引き受けが、統一されたAI事業KPI開示体制のためのマルチビークル・アンカーを生み出している。
text_locales.es: La impresión Q1 del 5 de mayo de AMD más la guía Q2 más la tasa de ejecución de Anthropic >$30B publicada vía canales periodísticos más los lanzamientos FIS + JV paralelos del 4 de mayo más NVIDIA Blackwell a ~1,000 racks NVL72/semana ajustan la fuerza estructural que la predicción SEC AI-KPI (3 de mayo) nombra: el lado comprador suscribiendo ~$700B de capex 2026 contra líneas agrupadas de aceleradores y cadencia de tasa de ejecución no auditada crea un ancla multi-vehículo para un régimen uniforme de divulgación de KPIs de negocio de IA.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 5 Q1 print ng AMD plus Q2 guide plus Anthropic run-rate >$30B na inilathala sa pamamagitan ng journalist channels plus ang May 4 FIS + parallel-JV launches plus NVIDIA Blackwell sa ~1,000 NVL72 racks/week ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinangalanan ng SEC AI-KPI prediction (May 3): ang buyside na nag-uunderwrite ng ~$700B 2026 capex laban sa bundled accelerator lines at unaudited run-rate cadence ay lumilikha ng multi-vehicle anchor para sa uniform AI-business KPI disclosure regime.

bridges.text: The May 4 parallel-JV equity-template launches plus AMD's pre-print MI308 disclosure-shape pressure plus the AAPL Apr 30 guide without an AI-services line plus the MSFT $37B precedent tighten the structural force the prediction names: SEC pressure for an audited AI-business KPI disclosure regime now has a multi-vehicle anchor across foundation labs, hyperscalers, and chip vendors.

text_locales.en: The May 4 parallel-JV equity-template launches plus AMD's pre-print MI308 disclosure-shape pressure plus the AAPL Apr 30 guide without an AI-services line plus the MSFT $37B precedent tighten the structural force the prediction names: SEC pressure for an audited AI-business KPI disclosure regime now has a multi-vehicle anchor across foundation labs, hyperscalers, and chip vendors.
text_locales.ja: 5月4日の並行JVエクイティ・テンプレート・ローンチ + AMDの決算前MI308開示形状プレッシャー + AIサービスラインなしのAAPL 4月30日ガイド + MSFT $37B前例が、予測が指摘する構造的な強制力を引き締める: 監査済みAIビジネスKPI開示体制に対するSECの圧力は、現在ファウンデーション・ラボ、ハイパースケーラー、チップベンダーにわたるマルチビークル・アンカーを持つ。
text_locales.es: Los lanzamientos paralelos de plantilla de capital JV del 4 de mayo más la presión de divulgación previa a la impresión MI308 de AMD más la guía AAPL del 30 de abril sin una línea de servicios de IA más el precedente de $37B de MSFT ajustan la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra: la presión de SEC para un régimen auditado de divulgación de KPI de negocio de IA ahora tiene un ancla multi-vehículo a través de laboratorios de fundación, hyperscalers y proveedores de chips.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 4 parallel-JV equity-template launches plus AMD's pre-print MI308 disclosure-shape pressure plus ang AAPL Apr 30 guide nang walang AI-services line plus ang MSFT $37B precedent ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction: ang SEC pressure para sa audited AI-business KPI disclosure regime ay mayroon na ngayong multi-vehicle anchor sa buong foundation labs, hyperscalers, at chip vendors.

bridges.text: Apptronik's $520M at $5B valuation with Mercedes-Benz + GXO Logistics partnerships plus the Tesla Fremont 1M-units/year + Texas expansion carry plus the Figure 03 cadence keep the precondition warm: the physical-AI commercial-deployment trajectory now has a third commercial mover alongside Tesla and Figure.

text_locales.en: Apptronik's $520M at $5B valuation with Mercedes-Benz + GXO Logistics partnerships plus the Tesla Fremont 1M-units/year + Texas expansion carry plus the Figure 03 cadence keep the precondition warm: the physical-AI commercial-deployment trajectory now has a third commercial mover alongside Tesla and Figure.
text_locales.ja: Mercedes-Benz + GXO LogisticsとのパートナーシップでのApptronikの$5B評価で$520M + Tesla Fremontの年100万台 + Texas拡張キャリー + Figure 03ケイデンスが前提条件を温存する: physical-AI商業展開軌道は、現在TeslaとFigureに加えて第三の商業的なムーバーを持つ。
text_locales.es: Los $520M de Apptronik a valoración de $5B con asociaciones Mercedes-Benz + GXO Logistics más el acarreo Tesla Fremont 1M unidades/año + expansión Texas más la cadencia Figure 03 mantienen caliente la precondición: la trayectoria de despliegue comercial de IA física ahora tiene un tercer movedor comercial junto con Tesla y Figure.
text_locales.fil: Ang $520M ng Apptronik sa $5B valuation kasama ang Mercedes-Benz + GXO Logistics partnerships plus ang Tesla Fremont 1M-units/year + Texas expansion carry plus ang Figure 03 cadence ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang precondition: ang physical-AI commercial-deployment trajectory ay mayroon na ngayong third commercial mover kasama ng Tesla at Figure.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **By Q4 2026 the cohort buyside-pressure stack — Apr 30 AAPL Q3 guide +14-17% (vs 9.5% consensus) printed without a separate AI-services line + $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI capex tape + AAPL +$100B buyback authorization + Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item disclosure precedent + OpenAI $25B annualized + $2B/month run rate + 122M paid by 2026 with $8/month + ad pilot $100M-annualized opacity + Cerebras IPO mid-May at $22-25B targeted — forces the SEC to publish a concept release (Reg S-K amendment proposal) on audited AI-business KPI disclosure for hyperscalers and foundation labs filing public comparables; at least one Big-3 hyperscaler pre-emptively publishes an audited AI-business KPI segment in a 10-Q footnote, ahead of any rule finalization, to anchor the disclosure shape.** Forcing function is the disclosure-shape gap between the cohort's collective $700B capex commitment and the cohort's lack of audited AI-KPI footnote: the buyside is being asked to underwrite eight digits of AI capex per quarter without the separate-segment view the SEC already requires for cloud, gaming, and other reporting segments. The May 1 Cerebras IPO roadshow with public S-1 disclosure + the Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue tape + the Apr 29 MSFT $37B precedent are the operative anchor signals; SEC has already opened the regulatory window via the Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization comment period (companion to climate-disclosure rulemaking), and AI-revenue disclosure is the natural next addition. In plain language: Investors are spending hundreds of billions on AI without seeing what they're getting back — the SEC will publish a draft rule asking companies to break it out. prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年Q4までに、コホート買い手側圧力スタック — 4月30日AAPL Q3ガイダンス+14-17%(コンセンサス9.5%対比)が別のAIサービスラインなしで印字、$700Bの2026年Big-Tech AI capexテープ、AAPL +$100Bの自社株買い承認、4月29日MSFTの$37B AI run-rate単一ライン項目開示前例、OpenAIの$25B年換算 + $2B/月のrun rate + 2026年までに$8/月で122M有料 + 広告パイロット$100M年換算の不透明性、5月中旬にCerebras IPOが$22-25B目標 — がSECに、ハイパースケーラーとファウンデーションラボの公開比較対象提出に対する、監査済みAI事業KPI開示についてのコンセプトリリース(Reg S-K改正提案)の公表を強いる。少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラーが、規則最終化に先立って、開示形を錨付けするために監査済みAI事業KPIセグメントを10-Q脚注に先制公表する。** 強制力はコホートの集合的$700B capexコミットメントとコホートの監査済みAI-KPI脚注の欠如との間の開示形ギャップだ。買い手側は、SECが既にクラウド、ゲーム、その他の報告セグメントに要求している別個セグメントビューなしで、四半期当たり8桁のAI capexを引き受けることを要求されている。5月1日のCerebras IPOロードショーと公開S-1開示、4月28日のWSJ OpenAI収益テープ、4月29日のMSFT $37B前例が運用上の錨信号だ。SECは既に4月28日のReg S-K近代化コメント期間(気候開示規則制定の伴侶)を通じて規制窓を開いており、AI収益開示は自然な次の追加だ。平易な言葉で言えば: 投資家は何が返ってくるかを見ずにAIに数千億ドルを使っている — SECは企業にそれを内訳開示するよう求めるドラフト規則を公表する。
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para Q4 2026, la pila de presión del lado comprador del cohorte — la guía Q3 de AAPL del 30 de abril +14-17% (vs consenso del 9.5%) impresa sin una línea separada de servicios de IA + el tape de capex de IA de Big-Tech 2026 de $700B + la autorización de recompra de +$100B de AAPL + el precedente de divulgación de línea única del run-rate de IA de $37B de MSFT del 29 de abril + OpenAI con $25B anualizados + run rate de $2B/mes + 122M pagos para 2026 a $8/mes + opacidad del piloto de anuncios de $100M anualizados + Cerebras con IPO a mediados de mayo apuntando a $22-25B — fuerza a la SEC a publicar un concept release (propuesta de enmienda al Reg S-K) sobre divulgación auditada de KPIs de negocio de IA para hyperscalers y laboratorios fundacionales que presentan comparables públicos; al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 publica preventivamente un segmento auditado de KPI de negocio de IA en una nota al pie de un 10-Q, antes de cualquier finalización de regla, para anclar la forma de divulgación.** La función forzante es la brecha de forma de divulgación entre el compromiso colectivo de capex de $700B del cohorte y la falta de una nota al pie auditada de KPI de IA del cohorte: se le pide al lado comprador que asegure ocho dígitos de capex de IA por trimestre sin la vista de segmento separado que la SEC ya requiere para nube, gaming, y otros segmentos reportables. El roadshow del IPO de Cerebras del 1 de mayo con divulgación pública S-1 + el tape del WSJ del 28 de abril sobre ingresos de OpenAI + el precedente de $37B de MSFT del 29 de abril son las señales operativas de anclaje; la SEC ya ha abierto la ventana regulatoria vía el período de comentarios de modernización del Reg S-K del 28 de abril (compañero a la regulación de divulgación climática), y la divulgación de ingresos de IA es la siguiente adición natural. En lenguaje sencillo: Los inversores están gastando cientos de miles de millones en IA sin ver lo que están obteniendo de vuelta — la SEC publicará un borrador de regla pidiendo a las empresas que lo desglosen.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ang cohort buyside-pressure stack — ang Apr 30 AAPL Q3 guide na +14-17% (vs 9.5% consensus) na inilabas nang walang hiwalay na AI-services line + ang $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI capex tape + AAPL +$100B buyback authorization + ang Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item disclosure precedent + OpenAI $25B annualized + $2B/month run rate + 122M paid pagsapit ng 2026 sa $8/month + ad pilot $100M-annualized opacity + Cerebras IPO sa kalagitnaan ng Mayo na may target na $22-25B — ay magpipilit sa SEC na maglathala ng concept release (Reg S-K amendment proposal) tungkol sa audited AI-business KPI disclosure para sa hyperscalers at foundation labs na nagfa-file ng public comparables; hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler ang preemptive na maglalathala ng audited AI-business KPI segment sa 10-Q footnote, bago ang anumang rule finalization, upang i-anchor ang hugis ng disclosure.** Ang forcing function ay ang puwang sa hugis ng disclosure sa pagitan ng cohort's collective $700B capex commitment at ng kakulangan ng cohort sa audited AI-KPI footnote: hinihiling sa buyside na underwrite ang walong-digit na AI capex bawat quarter nang walang hiwalay na segment view na hinihingi na ng SEC para sa cloud, gaming, at iba pang reporting segments. Ang May 1 Cerebras IPO roadshow na may pampublikong S-1 disclosure + ang Apr 28 WSJ OpenAI-revenue tape + ang Apr 29 MSFT $37B precedent ay ang operative anchor signals; binuksan na ng SEC ang regulatory window sa pamamagitan ng Apr 28 Reg S-K modernization comment period (kasama ng climate-disclosure rulemaking), at ang AI-revenue disclosure ang likas na susunod na karagdagan. Sa madaling salita: gumagastos ang mga investor ng daan-daang bilyon sa AI nang hindi nakikita kung ano ang nakukuha nila pabalik — maglalathala ang SEC ng draft rule na hihiling sa mga kompanya na ihiwalay ito.

nodes.title: Tesla Optimus capex forces Mag-7 physical-AI 10-Q segment disclosure by H2 2026
nodes.description: **By H2 2026 the Tesla Q2 2026 Fremont Optimus production-line build-out (legacy Model S + Model X lines being phased out for a 1M-units/year first-generation robotics plant; Optimus 3 launches summer 2026 at $20K-$30K with hundreds of units in 2026 ramping to thousands then tens of thousands by 2027-2028) + the Apr 28 Apptronik + Jabil Apollo manufacturing partnership + Figure 03 production at 1/hour with overnight fully-autonomous runs + Tesla CFO commentary on capex-allocation between EV and robotics tape will force at least one Mag-7 (Tesla initially; ≥1 sibling — NVIDIA Isaac, Amazon Robotics, Microsoft) to publish physical-AI capex as a separate segment or footnote in a 10-Q ahead of any SEC mandate, mirroring how cloud-segment disclosure was first published voluntarily in 2014-2015 before the SEC formalized it.** Forcing function is the disclosure-precedent expansion: cloud capex segmentation became standard once the dollar amounts crossed a buyside-attention threshold; physical-AI capex at Tesla's 1M-units/year nameplate (~$25B-$35B annualized at the price target) crosses that threshold in a single facility, layered on Apptronik + Figure + Boston Dynamics commercial deployment trajectory. The Q2 production-line build-out plus the Optimus 3 summer launch mean Tesla 10-Q for the period ending Sept 30 2026 is the natural first disclosure venue; competitive pressure from a single Tesla footnote disclosure will pull in a sibling Mag-7 disclosure within one or two filing cycles. In plain language: Tesla is spending big to make a million robots a year — soon Wall Street will demand to see those costs broken out separately. description.ja: **2026年H2までに、Tesla Q2 2026のFremont Optimus生産ライン構築(レガシーModel S + Model Xラインが第1世代ロボティクス工場の1Mユニット/年向けに段階的に置き換えられる。Optimus 3が2026年夏に$20K-$30Kで発表され、2026年に数百ユニット、2027-2028年までに数千〜数万にランプアップ)、4月28日のApptronik + Jabil Apolloの製造パートナーシップ、Figure 03の1台/時間での生産と夜間完全自律稼働、TeslaのCFOによるEVとロボティクス間のcapex配分のコメンタリーテープが、少なくとも1つのMag-7(当初Tesla;1社以上の兄弟会社 — NVIDIA Isaac、Amazon Robotics、Microsoft)に、SEC命令に先立って物理AI capexを別個のセグメントまたは脚注として10-Qに公表することを強いる。これは2014-2015年にクラウドセグメント開示が最初に自発的に公表され、その後SECが正式化した経緯を反映している。** 強制力は開示前例の拡張だ。クラウドcapexのセグメンテーションは金額が買い手側注目閾値を超えたときに標準となった。Teslaの1Mユニット/年銘板出力での物理AI capex(価格目標で~$25B-$35B年換算)は単一施設でその閾値を越え、Apptronik + Figure + Boston Dynamicsの商業展開軌道の上に積層される。Q2生産ライン構築 + Optimus 3の夏発表により、2026年9月30日締め期間のTesla 10-Qが自然な最初の開示の場となる。単一のTesla脚注開示からの競争圧力が、1〜2回のファイリングサイクル以内に兄弟Mag-7の開示を引き寄せる。平易な言葉で言えば: Teslaは年間100万台のロボットを作るために大金を費やしている — まもなくウォール街はそれらのコストを別途内訳開示することを要求するだろう。
description.es: **Para H2 2026, la construcción de la línea de producción Optimus en Fremont de Tesla en Q2 2026 (las líneas heredadas Model S + Model X serán retiradas para una planta de robótica de primera generación con capacidad de 1M unidades/año; Optimus 3 se lanza en verano de 2026 a $20K-$30K con cientos de unidades en 2026 ascendiendo a miles y luego decenas de miles para 2027-2028) + la asociación de manufactura Apptronik + Jabil Apollo del 28 de abril + Figure 03 en producción a 1/hora con corridas nocturnas totalmente autónomas + el comentario del CFO de Tesla sobre la asignación de capex entre EV y robótica forzarán a al menos un Mag-7 (Tesla inicialmente; ≥1 hermano — NVIDIA Isaac, Amazon Robotics, Microsoft) a publicar el capex de IA física como un segmento separado o nota al pie en un 10-Q antes de cualquier mandato de la SEC, reflejando cómo la divulgación de segmento de nube se publicó voluntariamente por primera vez en 2014-2015 antes de que la SEC la formalizara.** La función forzante es la expansión del precedente de divulgación: la segmentación de capex de nube se volvió estándar una vez que los montos en dólares cruzaron un umbral de atención del lado comprador; el capex de IA física a la placa nominal de Tesla de 1M unidades/año (~$25B-$35B anualizados al precio objetivo) cruza ese umbral en una sola instalación, apilado sobre la trayectoria de despliegue comercial de Apptronik + Figure + Boston Dynamics. La construcción de la línea de producción Q2 más el lanzamiento de verano de Optimus 3 significa que el 10-Q de Tesla para el período que termina el 30 de septiembre de 2026 es el primer lugar natural de divulgación; la presión competitiva de una sola divulgación de nota al pie de Tesla atraerá una divulgación hermana de Mag-7 dentro de uno o dos ciclos de presentación. En lenguaje sencillo: Tesla está gastando mucho para fabricar un millón de robots al año — pronto Wall Street demandará ver esos costos desglosados por separado.
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang Tesla Q2 2026 Fremont Optimus production-line build-out (ang legacy Model S + Model X lines na pinapatay para sa 1M-units/year first-generation robotics plant; ilulunsad ang Optimus 3 sa tag-init ng 2026 sa $20K-$30K na may daan-daang units sa 2026 na lalaki sa libu-libo at sampung-libo pagsapit ng 2027-2028) + ang Apr 28 Apptronik + Jabil Apollo manufacturing partnership + Figure 03 production sa 1/oras na may overnight fully-autonomous runs + ang Tesla CFO commentary tungkol sa capex-allocation sa pagitan ng EV at robotics tape ay magpipilit sa hindi bababa sa isang Mag-7 (Tesla muna; ≥1 sibling — NVIDIA Isaac, Amazon Robotics, Microsoft) na maglathala ng physical-AI capex bilang hiwalay na segment o footnote sa 10-Q bago ang anumang SEC mandate, na sinasalamin kung paano unang inilathala nang boluntaryo ang cloud-segment disclosure noong 2014-2015 bago ito pormal na ginawa ng SEC.** Ang forcing function ay ang pagpapalawak ng disclosure-precedent: naging standard ang cloud capex segmentation kapag ang dollar amounts ay tumawid sa buyside-attention threshold; ang physical-AI capex sa 1M-units/year nameplate ng Tesla (~$25B-$35B annualized sa price target) ay tumatawid sa threshold na iyon sa isang facility, na nakatuon sa Apptronik + Figure + Boston Dynamics commercial deployment trajectory. Ang Q2 production-line build-out kasama ang Optimus 3 summer launch ay nangangahulugang ang Tesla 10-Q para sa panahong magtatapos sa Sept 30 2026 ay ang likas na unang disclosure venue; ang competitive pressure mula sa isang Tesla footnote disclosure ay magdadala ng sibling Mag-7 disclosure sa loob ng isa o dalawang filing cycles. Sa madaling salita: gumagastos ang Tesla nang malaki upang gumawa ng isang milyong robot bawat taon — malapit nang hingiin ng Wall Street na ihiwalay ang mga gastos na iyon.

The Q2 production-line build-out plus the Optimus 3 summer launch mean Tesla 10-Q for the period ending Sept 30 2026 is the natural first disclosure venue; competitive pressure from a single Tesla footnote disclosure will pull in a sibling Mag-7 disclosure within one or two filing cycles. detail.description: **By H2 2026 the Tesla Q2 2026 Fremont Optimus production-line build-out (legacy Model S + Model X lines being phased out for a 1M-units/year first-generation robotics plant; Optimus 3 launches summer 2026 at $20K-$30K with hundreds of units in 2026 ramping to thousands then tens of thousands by 2027-2028) + the Apr 28 Apptronik + Jabil Apollo manufacturing partnership + Figure 03 production at 1/hour with overnight fully-autonomous runs + Tesla CFO commentary on capex-allocation between EV and robotics tape will force at least one Mag-7 (Tesla initially; ≥1 sibling — NVIDIA Isaac, Amazon Robotics, Microsoft) to publish physical-AI capex as a separate segment or footnote in a 10-Q ahead of any SEC mandate, mirroring how cloud-segment disclosure was first published voluntarily in 2014-2015 before the SEC formalized it.** Forcing function is the disclosure-precedent expansion: cloud capex segmentation became standard once the dollar amounts crossed a buyside-attention threshold; physical-AI capex at Tesla's 1M-units/year nameplate (~$25B-$35B annualized at the price target) crosses that threshold in a single facility, layered on Apptronik + Figure + Boston Dynamics commercial deployment trajectory. The Q2 production-line build-out plus the Optimus 3 summer launch mean Tesla 10-Q for the period ending Sept 30 2026 is the natural first disclosure venue; competitive pressure from a single Tesla footnote disclosure will pull in a sibling Mag-7 disclosure within one or two filing cycles. In plain language: Tesla is spending big to make a million robots a year — soon Wall Street will demand to see those costs broken out separately. prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年H2までに、Tesla Q2 2026のFremont Optimus生産ライン構築(レガシーModel S + Model Xラインが第1世代ロボティクス工場の1Mユニット/年向けに段階的に置き換えられる。Optimus 3が2026年夏に$20K-$30Kで発表され、2026年に数百ユニット、2027-2028年までに数千〜数万にランプアップ)、4月28日のApptronik + Jabil Apolloの製造パートナーシップ、Figure 03の1台/時間での生産と夜間完全自律稼働、TeslaのCFOによるEVとロボティクス間のcapex配分のコメンタリーテープが、少なくとも1つのMag-7(当初Tesla;1社以上の兄弟会社 — NVIDIA Isaac、Amazon Robotics、Microsoft)に、SEC命令に先立って物理AI capexを別個のセグメントまたは脚注として10-Qに公表することを強いる。これは2014-2015年にクラウドセグメント開示が最初に自発的に公表され、その後SECが正式化した経緯を反映している。** 強制力は開示前例の拡張だ。クラウドcapexのセグメンテーションは金額が買い手側注目閾値を超えたときに標準となった。Teslaの1Mユニット/年銘板出力での物理AI capex(価格目標で~$25B-$35B年換算)は単一施設でその閾値を越え、Apptronik + Figure + Boston Dynamicsの商業展開軌道の上に積層される。Q2生産ライン構築 + Optimus 3の夏発表により、2026年9月30日締め期間のTesla 10-Qが自然な最初の開示の場となる。単一のTesla脚注開示からの競争圧力が、1〜2回のファイリングサイクル以内に兄弟Mag-7の開示を引き寄せる。平易な言葉で言えば: Teslaは年間100万台のロボットを作るために大金を費やしている — まもなくウォール街はそれらのコストを別途内訳開示することを要求するだろう。
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para H2 2026, la construcción de la línea de producción Optimus en Fremont de Tesla en Q2 2026 (las líneas heredadas Model S + Model X serán retiradas para una planta de robótica de primera generación con capacidad de 1M unidades/año; Optimus 3 se lanza en verano de 2026 a $20K-$30K con cientos de unidades en 2026 ascendiendo a miles y luego decenas de miles para 2027-2028) + la asociación de manufactura Apptronik + Jabil Apollo del 28 de abril + Figure 03 en producción a 1/hora con corridas nocturnas totalmente autónomas + el comentario del CFO de Tesla sobre la asignación de capex entre EV y robótica forzarán a al menos un Mag-7 (Tesla inicialmente; ≥1 hermano — NVIDIA Isaac, Amazon Robotics, Microsoft) a publicar el capex de IA física como un segmento separado o nota al pie en un 10-Q antes de cualquier mandato de la SEC, reflejando cómo la divulgación de segmento de nube se publicó voluntariamente por primera vez en 2014-2015 antes de que la SEC la formalizara.** La función forzante es la expansión del precedente de divulgación: la segmentación de capex de nube se volvió estándar una vez que los montos en dólares cruzaron un umbral de atención del lado comprador; el capex de IA física a la placa nominal de Tesla de 1M unidades/año (~$25B-$35B anualizados al precio objetivo) cruza ese umbral en una sola instalación, apilado sobre la trayectoria de despliegue comercial de Apptronik + Figure + Boston Dynamics. La construcción de la línea de producción Q2 más el lanzamiento de verano de Optimus 3 significa que el 10-Q de Tesla para el período que termina el 30 de septiembre de 2026 es el primer lugar natural de divulgación; la presión competitiva de una sola divulgación de nota al pie de Tesla atraerá una divulgación hermana de Mag-7 dentro de uno o dos ciclos de presentación. En lenguaje sencillo: Tesla está gastando mucho para fabricar un millón de robots al año — pronto Wall Street demandará ver esos costos desglosados por separado.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang Tesla Q2 2026 Fremont Optimus production-line build-out (ang legacy Model S + Model X lines na pinapatay para sa 1M-units/year first-generation robotics plant; ilulunsad ang Optimus 3 sa tag-init ng 2026 sa $20K-$30K na may daan-daang units sa 2026 na lalaki sa libu-libo at sampung-libo pagsapit ng 2027-2028) + ang Apr 28 Apptronik + Jabil Apollo manufacturing partnership + Figure 03 production sa 1/oras na may overnight fully-autonomous runs + ang Tesla CFO commentary tungkol sa capex-allocation sa pagitan ng EV at robotics tape ay magpipilit sa hindi bababa sa isang Mag-7 (Tesla muna; ≥1 sibling — NVIDIA Isaac, Amazon Robotics, Microsoft) na maglathala ng physical-AI capex bilang hiwalay na segment o footnote sa 10-Q bago ang anumang SEC mandate, na sinasalamin kung paano unang inilathala nang boluntaryo ang cloud-segment disclosure noong 2014-2015 bago ito pormal na ginawa ng SEC.** Ang forcing function ay ang pagpapalawak ng disclosure-precedent: naging standard ang cloud capex segmentation kapag ang dollar amounts ay tumawid sa buyside-attention threshold; ang physical-AI capex sa 1M-units/year nameplate ng Tesla (~$25B-$35B annualized sa price target) ay tumatawid sa threshold na iyon sa isang facility, na nakatuon sa Apptronik + Figure + Boston Dynamics commercial deployment trajectory. Ang Q2 production-line build-out kasama ang Optimus 3 summer launch ay nangangahulugang ang Tesla 10-Q para sa panahong magtatapos sa Sept 30 2026 ay ang likas na unang disclosure venue; ang competitive pressure mula sa isang Tesla footnote disclosure ay magdadala ng sibling Mag-7 disclosure sa loob ng isa o dalawang filing cycles. Sa madaling salita: gumagastos ang Tesla nang malaki upang gumawa ng isang milyong robot bawat taon — malapit nang hingiin ng Wall Street na ihiwalay ang mga gastos na iyon.

nodes.description: **By Q3 2026 the AMD May 5 Q1 2026 print — consensus EPS $1.28 / rev $9.88B (+33% YoY); guidance $9.8B (+/- $300M, +32% YoY); gross margin -2pp QoQ to 55% as the Q4 2025 +$360M MI308 inventory-reserve reversal evaporates; MI308 China revenue from ~$390M Q4 to ~$100M Q1 (-75% QoQ); MI400 Helios rack-scale + Ryzen AI 400 + OpenAI 6GW MI450 H2 2026 first deployment as the focal forward signals — combined with the Apr 30 AAPL Q3 +14-17% guide (vs 9.5% consensus) printed without a separate AI-services line + $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI capex tape + $100B AAPL buyback authorization + Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item precedent + the May 4 Anthropic + OpenAI parallel JV announcement that monetizes frontier-AI as a structured-equity wrapper forces at least one chip vendor (AMD as the most-likely first mover, given the China-cliff disclosure pressure; or NVIDIA / Broadcom as siblings) to publish AI-accelerator-only revenue as a 10-Q segment footnote ahead of any SEC mandate; expect the disclosure precedent to mirror the MSFT $37B AI run-rate footnote shape (single-line-item with optional supplementary breakout) rather than the more invasive cloud-segment disclosure regime.** Forcing function is the dual asymmetry: AMD's MI308 China collapse forces an export-control-revenue disclosure shape, while the AI-accelerator-revenue gap forces an AI-revenue disclosure shape; the cleanest investor-relations path is to ship both at once. The May 5 print is the natural anchor; AMD CFO commentary is the lead indicator. NVIDIA + Broadcom follow within one or two filing cycles via competitive-disclosure pressure. In plain language: AMD's China AI chip sales just dropped 75 percent in one quarter — Wall Street will demand chip companies break out their AI revenue as a separate line. description.ja: **2026年Q3までに、AMD 5月5日 Q1 2026決算 — コンセンサスEPS $1.28 / 売上 $9.88B(前年比+33%); ガイダンス $9.8B(±$300M、前年比+32%); 粗利率は前期比-2ppの55%へ(Q4 2025の+$360M MI308在庫引当戻入が消失); MI308中国売上はQ4 約$390MからQ1 約$100Mへ(前期比-75%); MI400 Helios rack-scale + Ryzen AI 400 + OpenAI 6GW MI450 2026年下半期初回展開が焦点となる前向きシグナル — に、4月30日のAAPL Q3 +14〜17%ガイド(コンセンサス9.5%対比)が別建てAIサービスラインなしで発表されたこと + $700Bの2026年Big-Tech AI capexテープ + $100B AAPL自社株買い権限 + 4月29日のMSFT $37B AIランレート単一ライン項目前例 + 5月4日のAnthropic + OpenAI並行JV発表(フロンティアAIを構造化エクイティラッパーで収益化)が組み合わさり、少なくとも1社のチップベンダー(中国断崖開示プレッシャーを考慮するとAMDが最有力先駆者; またはNVIDIA / Broadcomが同型として)に対し、SECの強制以前にAIアクセラレータ専用売上を10-Qセグメント脚注として公表することを強いる。開示前例は、より侵襲的なクラウドセグメント開示体制ではなく、MSFT $37B AIランレート脚注の形(任意の補足ブレイクアウトを伴う単一ライン項目)に倣うことが期待される。** 強制関数は二重の非対称性: AMDのMI308中国崩壊は輸出規制売上開示形状を強い、AIアクセラレータ売上ギャップはAI売上開示形状を強いる; 最もクリーンなIRパスは両者を同時に出荷することである。5月5日の決算が自然なアンカー; AMD CFOのコメンタリーが先行指標。NVIDIA + Broadcomは競争的開示プレッシャーにより1〜2回の決算サイクル以内で追随する。In plain language: AMDの中国向けAIチップ売上は1四半期で75%も落ちた — ウォール街はチップ企業に対しAI売上を別ラインとして分けて出すよう要求するだろう。In plain language: In plain language:

La impresión del 5 de mayo es el ancla natural; el comentario del CFO de AMD es el indicador líder. NVIDIA + Broadcom siguen dentro de uno o dos ciclos de presentación a través de presión de divulgación competitiva. text_locales.fil: Tumitigas ang parehong disclosure-pressure stack sa pamamagitan ng Saturday clarifying footnote ng SEC Corp Fin; inilalagay ng October 28 lock-up confirmation ng CFO ng Cerebras plus ang $172 single-counterparty concentration call ng Bernstein ang public-market multiple sa ilalim ng disclosed accelerator revenue, at hinihigpitan ng confidential S-1 ng Tenstorrent plus ng $7-9B range ng SambaNova ang cohort comparable na dapat lampasan ng AMD sa Q2 10-Q window nito.

text_locales.es: El commitment book de 6.2GW Helios mas MI450 de AMD, el deployment Asia-Pacific no divulgado de 0.8GW de Tencent Cloud que expone la asimetria de export-control disclosure que nombra la prediccion, la comparable de backlog del 8-K de Vera Rubin de Nvidia y el market cap de primer dia de $31.4B del IPO de Cerebras poniendo un multiplo de public-market debajo de los ingresos de accelerator divulgados, todos afilan el caso buyside para una linea de revenue accelerator-only mas ASP en el 10-Q del Q2.
text_locales.fil: Ang 6.2GW Helios plus MI450 commitment book ng AMD, ang undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud Asia-Pacific deployment na naghahayag ng export-control disclosure asymmetry na pinapangalanan ng prediction, ang Vera Rubin 8-K backlog comparable ng Nvidia, at ang $31.4B first-day market cap ng Cerebras IPO na naglalagay ng public-market multiple sa ilalim ng disclosed accelerator revenue ay nagpapatalas lahat sa buyside case para sa Q2 10-Q accelerator-only revenue plus ASP line.

text_locales.ja: AMD Q1決算は、AMD AIアクセラレータ脚注予測(5月4日)が指摘する束ねられた開示問題を取引日翌日も継続して運用中とし、HSBCの5月4日の+77%ラリーHold格下げは、Q2 10-Q提出ウィンドウに対するバイサイド開示プレッシャー・ケースを鋭くする最初のセルサイド警戒層を追加する。
text_locales.es: El print Q1 de AMD se traslada con el problema de divulgación agrupada que nombra la predicción AMD AI-accelerator footnote (4 may) aún operativo un día de cotización después, mientras que la bajada de HSBC del 4 de mayo a Hold tras +77% rally añade la primera capa de cautela sell-side que agudiza el caso buyside de presión por divulgación para la ventana de presentación 10-Q Q2.

text_locales.ja: AMDの5月5日 Q1決算は、AMD AIアクセラレーター脚注予測(5月4日)が指摘するバンドル開示問題そのものを着地させる: Data Center $5.78B が前年比 +57% で、EPYC CPUとInstinct GPUを混在させており、バイサイド・モデルはアクセラレーター単独のASPとユニットエコノミクスを三角測量できない。Lisa SuがData Centerを主要成長ドライバーとして命名したことで、アクセラレーター・セグメントの切り出しの前提条件は、現実の決算で運用化されている。
text_locales.es: La impresión Q1 del 5 de mayo de AMD entrega exactamente el problema de divulgación agrupada que la predicción de la nota al pie de aceleradores de IA de AMD (4 de mayo) nombra: Data Center $5.78B a +57% YoY mezcla CPUs EPYC con GPUs Instinct, dejando a los modelos buyside incapaces de triangular ASP solo de aceleradores y la economía unitaria. Con Lisa Su nombrando a Data Center como el motor principal de crecimiento, la precondición para una segmentación específica de aceleradores está ahora operativa en una impresión real.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 5 Q1 print ng AMD ay naghahatid ng eksaktong bundled-disclosure problem na pinangalanan ng AMD AI-accelerator footnote prediction (May 4): Data Center $5.78B sa +57% YoY ay naghahalo ng EPYC CPUs sa Instinct GPUs, na nag-iiwan sa buyside models na hindi makapag-triangulate ng accelerator-only ASP at unit economics. Sa Lisa Su na nagngangalan sa Data Center bilang primary growth driver, ang precondition para sa accelerator-segment carve-out ay aktibo na sa isang real print.

detail.description: **By Q3 2026 the AMD May 5 Q1 2026 print — consensus EPS $1.28 / rev $9.88B (+33% YoY); guidance $9.8B (+/- $300M, +32% YoY); gross margin -2pp QoQ to 55% as the Q4 2025 +$360M MI308 inventory-reserve reversal evaporates; MI308 China revenue from ~$390M Q4 to ~$100M Q1 (-75% QoQ); MI400 Helios rack-scale + Ryzen AI 400 + OpenAI 6GW MI450 H2 2026 first deployment as the focal forward signals — combined with the Apr 30 AAPL Q3 +14-17% guide (vs 9.5% consensus) printed without a separate AI-services line + $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI capex tape + $100B AAPL buyback authorization + Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item precedent + the May 4 Anthropic + OpenAI parallel JV announcement that monetizes frontier-AI as a structured-equity wrapper forces at least one chip vendor (AMD as the most-likely first mover, given the China-cliff disclosure pressure; or NVIDIA / Broadcom as siblings) to publish AI-accelerator-only revenue as a 10-Q segment footnote ahead of any SEC mandate; expect the disclosure precedent to mirror the MSFT $37B AI run-rate footnote shape (single-line-item with optional supplementary breakout) rather than the more invasive cloud-segment disclosure regime.** Forcing function is the dual asymmetry: AMD's MI308 China collapse forces an export-control-revenue disclosure shape, while the AI-accelerator-revenue gap forces an AI-revenue disclosure shape; the cleanest investor-relations path is to ship both at once. The May 5 print is the natural anchor; AMD CFO commentary is the lead indicator. NVIDIA + Broadcom follow within one or two filing cycles via competitive-disclosure pressure. In plain language: AMD's China AI chip sales just dropped 75 percent in one quarter — Wall Street will demand chip companies break out their AI revenue as a separate line. In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **2026年Q3までに、AMD 5月5日 Q1 2026決算 — コンセンサスEPS $1.28 / 売上 $9.88B(前年比+33%); ガイダンス $9.8B(±$300M、前年比+32%); 粗利率は前期比-2ppの55%へ(Q4 2025の+$360M MI308在庫引当戻入が消失); MI308中国売上はQ4 約$390MからQ1 約$100Mへ(前期比-75%); MI400 Helios rack-scale + Ryzen AI 400 + OpenAI 6GW MI450 2026年下半期初回展開が焦点となる前向きシグナル — に、4月30日のAAPL Q3 +14〜17%ガイド(コンセンサス9.5%対比)が別建てAIサービスラインなしで発表されたこと + $700Bの2026年Big-Tech AI capexテープ + $100B AAPL自社株買い権限 + 4月29日のMSFT $37B AIランレート単一ライン項目前例 + 5月4日のAnthropic + OpenAI並行JV発表(フロンティアAIを構造化エクイティラッパーで収益化)が組み合わさり、少なくとも1社のチップベンダー(中国断崖開示プレッシャーを考慮するとAMDが最有力先駆者; またはNVIDIA / Broadcomが同型として)に対し、SECの強制以前にAIアクセラレータ専用売上を10-Qセグメント脚注として公表することを強いる。開示前例は、より侵襲的なクラウドセグメント開示体制ではなく、MSFT $37B AIランレート脚注の形(任意の補足ブレイクアウトを伴う単一ライン項目)に倣うことが期待される。** 強制関数は二重の非対称性: AMDのMI308中国崩壊は輸出規制売上開示形状を強い、AIアクセラレータ売上ギャップはAI売上開示形状を強いる; 最もクリーンなIRパスは両者を同時に出荷することである。5月5日の決算が自然なアンカー; AMD CFOのコメンタリーが先行指標。NVIDIA + Broadcomは競争的開示プレッシャーにより1〜2回の決算サイクル以内で追随する。In plain language: AMDの中国向けAIチップ売上は1四半期で75%も落ちた — ウォール街はチップ企業に対しAI売上を別ラインとして分けて出すよう要求するだろう。In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para Q3 2026, la impresión Q1 2026 de AMD del 5 de mayo — consenso EPS $1.28 / ingresos $9.88B (+33% YoY); guía $9.8B (+/- $300M, +32% YoY); margen bruto -2pp QoQ a 55% mientras la reversión de la reserva de inventario MI308 de +$360M de Q4 2025 se evapora; ingresos MI308 de China de ~$390M en Q4 a ~$100M en Q1 (-75% QoQ); MI400 Helios rack-scale + Ryzen AI 400 + primer despliegue OpenAI 6GW MI450 H2 2026 como las señales focales de avance — combinado con la guía AAPL Q3 +14-17% del 30 de abril (vs consenso 9.5%) impresa sin una línea separada de servicios de IA + cinta de capex de IA Big-Tech 2026 de $700B + autorización de recompra AAPL de $100B + precedente de partida única de la tasa de ejecución de IA de $37B de MSFT del 29 de abril + el anuncio de la JV paralela Anthropic + OpenAI del 4 de mayo que monetiza la IA de frontera como un envoltorio de capital estructurado obliga a al menos un proveedor de chips (AMD como el más probable primer movedor, dada la presión de divulgación del precipicio de China; o NVIDIA / Broadcom como hermanos) a publicar los ingresos exclusivos de aceleradores de IA como una nota al pie de segmento 10-Q antes de cualquier mandato de la SEC; se espera que el precedente de divulgación refleje la forma de la nota al pie de la tasa de ejecución de IA de $37B de MSFT (partida única con desglose suplementario opcional) en lugar del régimen de divulgación de segmento de nube más invasivo.** La función forzante es la doble asimetría: el colapso de MI308 China de AMD obliga a una forma de divulgación de ingresos por control de exportaciones, mientras que la brecha de ingresos de aceleradores de IA obliga a una forma de divulgación de ingresos de IA; el camino más limpio para relaciones con inversionistas es entregar ambos a la vez. La impresión del 5 de mayo es el ancla natural; el comentario del CFO de AMD es el indicador líder. NVIDIA + Broadcom siguen dentro de uno o dos ciclos de presentación a través de presión de divulgación competitiva. In plain language: AMD's China AI chip sales just dropped 75 percent in one quarter — Wall Street will demand chip companies break out their AI revenue as a separate line. In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang AMD May 5 Q1 2026 print — consensus EPS $1.28 / rev $9.88B (+33% YoY); guidance $9.8B (+/- $300M, +32% YoY); gross margin -2pp QoQ to 55% habang nawawala ang Q4 2025 +$360M MI308 inventory-reserve reversal; MI308 China revenue mula ~$390M Q4 sa ~$100M Q1 (-75% QoQ); MI400 Helios rack-scale + Ryzen AI 400 + OpenAI 6GW MI450 H2 2026 first deployment bilang focal forward signals — pinagsama sa Apr 30 AAPL Q3 +14-17% guide (vs 9.5% consensus) na inilathala nang walang separate AI-services line + $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI capex tape + $100B AAPL buyback authorization + Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item precedent + ang May 4 Anthropic + OpenAI parallel JV announcement na nagmu-monetize ng frontier-AI bilang structured-equity wrapper ay pumipilit ng kahit isang chip vendor (AMD bilang pinakamalamang na first mover, dahil sa China-cliff disclosure pressure; o NVIDIA / Broadcom bilang siblings) na maglathala ng AI-accelerator-only revenue bilang 10-Q segment footnote bago ang anumang SEC mandate; inaasahan na ang disclosure precedent ay susunod sa MSFT $37B AI run-rate footnote shape (single-line-item na may opsyonal na supplementary breakout) sa halip na sa mas invasive na cloud-segment disclosure regime.** Ang forcing function ay ang dual asymmetry: pinipilit ng MI308 China collapse ng AMD ang export-control-revenue disclosure shape, habang pinipilit ng AI-accelerator-revenue gap ang AI-revenue disclosure shape; ang pinakamalinis na investor-relations path ay magpadala ng dalawa nang sabay. Ang May 5 print ang natural anchor; ang AMD CFO commentary ang lead indicator. Ang NVIDIA + Broadcom ay susunod sa loob ng isa o dalawang filing cycles sa pamamagitan ng competitive-disclosure pressure. In plain language: AMD's China AI chip sales just dropped 75 percent in one quarter — Wall Street will demand chip companies break out their AI revenue as a separate line. nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the AMD May 5 Q1 2026 print — Q1 revenue $10.25B (vs $9.85B consensus, +38% YoY), adjusted EPS $1.37 (vs $1.27 consensus, +9.6% beat), Data Center segment $5.78B at +57% YoY (consensus $5.56B / +51.5%), non-GAAP gross margin 55%, Q2 guide $11.2B +/- $300M (vs Street $10.52B, implying +50.6% YoY and +9.1% sequential), CEO Lisa Su declaring Data Center now the "primary driver of revenue and earnings growth," MI450 Series + Helios customer engagement "strengthening," AMD shares +4.4% after-hours — combined with the Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item precedent, the May 4 Anthropic + OpenAI parallel JV launches that monetize frontier-AI as a structured-equity wrapper, the May 5 Anthropic 10-agent financial-services launch with native Microsoft 365 + Moody's MCP integration, and the standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape forces AMD (or a NVIDIA / Broadcom sibling) to publish AI-accelerator-only revenue as a 10-Q segment footnote ahead of any SEC mandate. The disclosure precedent is most likely to mirror the MSFT $37B AI run-rate footnote shape — a single-line-item with optional supplementary breakout — rather than a more invasive cloud-segment-style disclosure regime. Forcing function is the asymmetric narrative pressure: Lisa Su has now publicly named Data Center the primary growth engine on the print itself, but the segment still bundles EPYC server CPUs with Instinct MI300/MI325 AI accelerators; buyside models cannot triangulate accelerator-only ASP and unit economics from the bundled line, and the May 5 Anthropic-finance-agent + FIS-AML stack makes the AI-accelerator-only sub-line the operative buyside disclosure ask. AMD CFO commentary on the next earnings call is the lead indicator; NVIDIA + Broadcom follow within one or two filing cycles via competitive-disclosure pressure.

description.ja: 2026年Q3までに、AMDの5月5日 Q1 2026決算 — Q1売上 $10.25B(コンセンサス $9.85B 対比、前年比+38%)、調整後EPS $1.37(コンセンサス $1.27 対比、+9.6%ビート)、データセンター・セグメント $5.78B 前年比+57%(コンセンサス $5.56B / +51.5%)、非GAAP粗利率55%、Q2ガイダンス $11.2B ±$300M(ストリート $10.52B 対比、前年比+50.6%、前期比+9.1%)、CEOのLisa Suがデータセンターを「売上と利益成長の主要ドライバー」と宣言、MI450 Series + Heliosの顧客エンゲージメントは「強化中」、AMD株価はアフターアワーズで+4.4% — に、4月29日のMSFT $37B AIランレート単一ライン項目前例、5月4日のAnthropic + OpenAIの並行JVローンチ(フロンティアAIを構造化エクイティラッパーとして収益化)、5月5日のAnthropic 10エージェント金融サービス・ローンチ(Microsoft 365 + Moody's MCPネイティブ統合)、そして$700Bの2026年Big-Tech AI capexテープが組み合わさり、AMD(あるいはNVIDIA / Broadcomの兄弟)に対し、SECの強制以前にAIアクセラレータ専用売上を10-Qセグメント脚注として公表することを強いる。開示前例は、より侵襲的なクラウドセグメント型開示体制ではなく、MSFT $37B AIランレート脚注の形(任意の補足ブレイクアウトを伴う単一ライン項目)を最も高い確率で踏襲する。強制関数は非対称的な物語プレッシャー: Lisa Suが現在データセンターを主要成長エンジンと公に決算自体で名指ししたが、セグメントは依然としてEPYCサーバーCPUとInstinct MI300/MI325 AIアクセラレータをバンドルしており、バイサイドのモデルではバンドル・ラインからアクセラレータ専用ASPとユニット・エコノミクスを三角測量できない。5月5日のAnthropic金融エージェント + FIS-AMLスタックは、AIアクセラレータ専用サブラインを実務上のバイサイド開示要求に押し上げる。次回決算電話でのAMD CFOコメンタリーが先行指標、NVIDIA + Broadcomは競争的開示プレッシャーを通じて1〜2回のファイリング・サイクル以内に追随する。
description.es: Para Q3 2026, el reporte Q1 2026 de AMD del 5 de mayo — ingresos Q1 de $10.25B (vs consenso de $9.85B, +38% YoY), EPS ajustado de $1.37 (vs consenso de $1.27, +9.6% de superación), segmento Data Center en $5.78B con +57% YoY (consenso de $5.56B / +51.5%), margen bruto no-GAAP del 55%, guía Q2 de $11.2B +/- $300M (vs Street $10.52B, lo que implica +50.6% YoY y +9.1% secuencial), la CEO Lisa Su declarando que Data Center es ahora el "motor principal del crecimiento de ingresos y ganancias", el engagement de clientes con MI450 Series + Helios "fortaleciéndose", las acciones de AMD +4.4% after-hours — combinado con el precedente del 29 de abril de la nota al pie de partida única de tasa de ejecución de IA de $37B de MSFT, los lanzamientos paralelos de JV de Anthropic + OpenAI del 4 de mayo que monetizan la IA de frontera como un envoltorio de capital estructurado, el lanzamiento del 5 de mayo de Anthropic con 10 agentes de servicios financieros con integración nativa de Microsoft 365 + MCP de Moody's, y la cinta permanente de capex de IA Big-Tech 2026 de $700B obliga a AMD (o a un hermano NVIDIA / Broadcom) a publicar ingresos exclusivos de aceleradores de IA como nota al pie de segmento del 10-Q antes de cualquier mandato de la SEC. El precedente de divulgación es más probable que refleje la forma de la nota al pie de tasa de ejecución de IA de $37B de MSFT — una partida única con desglose suplementario opcional — en lugar de un régimen de divulgación más invasivo al estilo de segmento de nube. La función forzante es la presión narrativa asimétrica: Lisa Su ahora ha nombrado públicamente a Data Center como el motor principal de crecimiento sobre el reporte mismo, pero el segmento aún agrupa CPUs servidor EPYC con aceleradores de IA Instinct MI300/MI325; los modelos del lado comprador no pueden triangular el ASP exclusivo de aceleradores ni la economía unitaria desde la línea agrupada, y el stack del 5 de mayo de agentes financieros de Anthropic + AML de FIS hace que la sub-línea exclusiva de aceleradores de IA sea la solicitud operativa de divulgación del lado comprador. El comentario del CFO de AMD en la próxima llamada de ganancias es el indicador líder; NVIDIA + Broadcom siguen dentro de uno o dos ciclos de presentación vía presión de divulgación competitiva.
description.fil: Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang AMD May 5 Q1 2026 print — Q1 revenue $10.25B (vs $9.85B consensus, +38% YoY), adjusted EPS $1.37 (vs $1.27 consensus, +9.6% beat), Data Center segment $5.78B sa +57% YoY (consensus $5.56B / +51.5%), non-GAAP gross margin 55%, Q2 guide $11.2B +/- $300M (vs Street $10.52B, na nagpapahiwatig ng +50.6% YoY at +9.1% sequential), idineklara ni CEO Lisa Su na ang Data Center na ngayon ang "primary driver of revenue and earnings growth," ang MI450 Series + Helios customer engagement ay "strengthening," tumaas ng 4.4% ang AMD shares after-hours — pinagsama sa Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item precedent, ang May 4 Anthropic + OpenAI parallel JV launches na nagmu-monetize ng frontier-AI bilang structured-equity wrapper, ang May 5 Anthropic 10-agent financial-services launch na may native Microsoft 365 + Moody's MCP integration, at ang nakatayong $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape ay pumipilit sa AMD (o sa NVIDIA / Broadcom sibling) na maglathala ng AI-accelerator-only revenue bilang 10-Q segment footnote bago ang anumang SEC mandate. Ang disclosure precedent ay pinakamalamang na susunod sa MSFT $37B AI run-rate footnote shape — single-line-item na may opsyonal na supplementary breakout — sa halip na sa mas invasive na cloud-segment-style disclosure regime. Ang forcing function ay ang asymmetric narrative pressure: tahasan nang pinangalanan ni Lisa Su ang Data Center bilang primary growth engine sa print mismo, ngunit ang segment ay bundling pa rin ang EPYC server CPUs sa Instinct MI300/MI325 AI accelerators; hindi ma-triangulate ng buyside models ang accelerator-only ASP at unit economics mula sa bundled line, at ang May 5 Anthropic-finance-agent + FIS-AML stack ang nagpapagawa sa AI-accelerator-only sub-line bilang operative buyside disclosure ask. Ang AMD CFO commentary sa susunod na earnings call ang lead indicator; susunod ang NVIDIA + Broadcom sa loob ng isa o dalawang filing cycles sa pamamagitan ng competitive-disclosure pressure.

summary_short_locales.ja: AMDの5月5日 Q1決算は$10.25B(前年比+38%)、データセンター$5.78B(前年比+57%)で着地し、Lisa Suがデータセンターを主要成長ドライバーと名指し、Q2ガイダンスは$11.2B。MSFT $37B AIランレート前例と組み合わさり、2026年Q3までにAMDがAIアクセラレータ専用売上を10-Qセグメント脚注として公表することが期待される。
summary_short_locales.es: El reporte Q1 de AMD del 5 de mayo superó expectativas ($10.25B, +38% YoY; Data Center $5.78B, +57% YoY) con Lisa Su nombrando a Data Center como el motor principal de crecimiento y guía Q2 de $11.2B. Combinado con el precedente de tasa de ejecución de IA de $37B de MSFT, para Q3 2026 se espera que AMD publique ingresos exclusivos de aceleradores de IA como nota al pie de segmento del 10-Q.
summary_short_locales.fil: Tinalo ng AMD May 5 Q1 print ang consensus ($10.25B, +38% YoY; Data Center $5.78B, +57% YoY) habang pinangalanan ni Lisa Su ang Data Center bilang primary growth driver at Q2 guide $11.2B. Pinagsama sa MSFT $37B AI run-rate precedent, pagsapit ng Q3 2026 inaasahang maglathala ang AMD ng AI-accelerator-only revenue bilang 10-Q segment footnote.

text_locales.ja: AMDのHeliosプラスMI450コミットメント・ブックは0.3GW Mercado Libreプラス0.2GW UAE G42 Cloud確認を経て9.7GWを突破;初の本番ラック・サンプルがNTT Data JapanプラスNaver Cloud Koreaへ出荷;Mag-7プレビュー・コホートがAlphabet Q2 AIサービス脚注確率を84パーセントへ引き上げ;Corp Finの第3サンプル・コメントレターがAMDのQ2 10-Q評価比較可能をアンカー。
text_locales.es: El libro de compromisos de Helios más MI450 de AMD supera los 9,7 GW tras una confirmación de 0,3 GW de Mercado Libre y de 0,2 GW de G42 Cloud de EAU; las primeras muestras de rack de producción se envían a NTT Data Japón y a Naver Cloud Corea; el cohorte de previa de las Mag-7 eleva al 84 por ciento la probabilidad de una nota de Servicios de IA de Alphabet en el segundo trimestre; la tercera comment-letter de muestra de Corp Fin ancla el comparable de valoración del 10-Q del segundo trimestre de AMD.
text_locales.fil: Lumampas sa 9.7GW ang Helios at MI450 commitment book ng AMD pagkatapos ng kumpirmasyon ng 0.3GW Mercado Libre at 0.2GW UAE G42 Cloud; ipinadala ang mga unang production-rack samples sa NTT Data Japan at Naver Cloud Korea; itinaas ng Mag-7 preview cohort ang Alphabet Q2 AI Services footnote probability sa 84 porsyento; nag-aanchor ang third sample comment letter ng Corp Fin sa Q2 10-Q valuation comparable ng AMD.

bridges.text: AMD's Helios plus MI450 commitment book passes 8.0GW on Monday's SoftBank Sakai, NTT Data, and Apple confirmations; Bernstein raises the Alphabet Q2 AI Services footnote probability to 65 percent (from 55 percent Friday) naming May 21 as the operative pricing event; Wells Fargo expects Meta and AWS to follow within one quarter; CBRS at $189.40 anchors the AI-accelerator-revenue multiple band.

text_locales.en: AMD's Helios plus MI450 commitment book passes 8.0GW on Monday's SoftBank Sakai, NTT Data, and Apple confirmations; Bernstein raises the Alphabet Q2 AI Services footnote probability to 65 percent (from 55 percent Friday) naming May 21 as the operative pricing event; Wells Fargo expects Meta and AWS to follow within one quarter; CBRS at $189.40 anchors the AI-accelerator-revenue multiple band.
text_locales.ja: AMDのHeliosプラスMI450コミットメント・ブックは月曜のSoftBank Sakai、NTT Data、Apple確認で8.0GWを突破;BernsteinはAlphabet Q2 AI Servicesフットノート確率を65パーセント(金曜の55パーセントから)に引き上げ、5月21日を作動価格決定イベントとして命名;Wells FargoはMetaとAWSが1四半期以内に追随することを期待;$189.40のCBRSはAIアクセラレータ売上倍率バンドをアンカーする。
text_locales.es: El libro de compromiso Helios más MI450 de AMD pasa 8.0GW con las confirmaciones del lunes de SoftBank Sakai, NTT Data y Apple; Bernstein eleva la probabilidad de footnote AI Services Q2 de Alphabet a 65 por ciento (desde 55 por ciento el viernes) nombrando el 21 de mayo como el evento de pricing operativo; Wells Fargo espera que Meta y AWS sigan dentro de un trimestre; CBRS en $189.40 ancla la banda de múltiplo de AI-accelerator-revenue.
text_locales.fil: Lumalampas sa 8.0GW ang AMD's Helios plus MI450 commitment book sa Monday's SoftBank Sakai, NTT Data, at Apple confirmations; itinataas ng Bernstein ang Alphabet Q2 AI Services footnote probability sa 65 percent (mula sa 55 percent Friday) na pinapangalanan ang May 21 bilang operative pricing event; umaasa ang Wells Fargo na ang Meta at AWS ay susunod sa loob ng isang quarter; ina-anchor ng CBRS sa $189.40 ang AI-accelerator-revenue multiple band.

bridges.text: The disclosure-pressure stack on AMD's Q2 10-Q window tightens Sunday: Helios plus MI450 commitment book passes 7.0GW after Tencent and Alibaba confirmations; AIwire reconciles a three-vendor sample-allocation table across ten named hyperscaler accounts; Wells Fargo expects an Alphabet Q2 AI Services footnote mirroring Microsoft's fiscal Q1 2027 breakout; May 21 Alphabet analyst day is the operative pricing event.

text_locales.en: The disclosure-pressure stack on AMD's Q2 10-Q window tightens Sunday: Helios plus MI450 commitment book passes 7.0GW after Tencent and Alibaba confirmations; AIwire reconciles a three-vendor sample-allocation table across ten named hyperscaler accounts; Wells Fargo expects an Alphabet Q2 AI Services footnote mirroring Microsoft's fiscal Q1 2027 breakout; May 21 Alphabet analyst day is the operative pricing event.
text_locales.ja: AMDのQ2 10-Qウィンドウ上の開示プレッシャー・スタックは日曜に引き締まる: TencentとAlibaba確認後にHeliosプラスMI450コミットメント・ブックが7.0GWを突破;AIwireは10の命名されたハイパースケーラー・アカウントにわたる3ベンダー・サンプル・アロケーション・テーブルを調整する;Wells FargoはMicrosoftの会計Q1 2027ブレイクアウトをミラーするAlphabet Q2 AIサービス・フットノートを期待する;5月21日Alphabetアナリスト・デイは作動価格決定イベント。
text_locales.es: La pila de presión de divulgación sobre la ventana 10-Q Q2 de AMD se aprieta el domingo: el libro de compromiso Helios más MI450 pasa 7.0GW tras las confirmaciones Tencent y Alibaba; AIwire reconcilia una tabla de sample-allocation de tres-vendors a través de diez cuentas hyperscaler nombradas; Wells Fargo espera un footnote AI Services Q2 de Alphabet reflejando el desglose Microsoft fiscal Q1 2027; el día de analistas de Alphabet del 21 de mayo es el evento de pricing operativo.
text_locales.fil: Humihigpit noong Linggo ang disclosure-pressure stack sa Q2 10-Q window ng AMD: lumalampas ang Helios plus MI450 commitment book sa 7.0GW matapos ang Tencent at Alibaba confirmations; pinapantay ng AIwire ang three-vendor sample-allocation table sa sampung named hyperscaler accounts; inaasahan ng Wells Fargo ang isang Alphabet Q2 AI Services footnote na sumasalamin sa fiscal Q1 2027 breakout ng Microsoft; ang Mayo 21 Alphabet analyst day ay ang operative pricing event.

bridges.text: SEC Corp Fin's Saturday clarifying footnote treats the May 8 Mag-7 sample comment letter as generally applicable AI-services-revenue measurement guidance; Bernstein, Wells Fargo, and Evercore lift the recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence probability into Q3-print territory for Nvidia and AMD, and AIwire's three-vendor roadmap reconciliation anchors the disclosed-capacity reference shape against AMD Helios MI450 H2 2026 ramp.

text_locales.en: SEC Corp Fin's Saturday clarifying footnote treats the May 8 Mag-7 sample comment letter as generally applicable AI-services-revenue measurement guidance; Bernstein, Wells Fargo, and Evercore lift the recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence probability into Q3-print territory for Nvidia and AMD, and AIwire's three-vendor roadmap reconciliation anchors the disclosed-capacity reference shape against AMD Helios MI450 H2 2026 ramp.
text_locales.ja: SEC Corp Finの土曜明確化フットノートは5月8日Mag-7サンプル・コメント・レターを一般適用AIサービス売上計測ガイダンスとして扱う;Bernstein、Wells Fargo、Evercoreは繰り返し中四半期フォワード供給8-KケイデンスをNvidiaとAMDについてQ3プリント領域へ確率引き上げ、AIwireの3ベンダー・ロードマップ調整はAMD Helios MI450 H2 2026ランプに対する開示キャパシティ参照シェイプをアンカーする。
text_locales.es: La nota aclaratoria del sábado de SEC Corp Fin trata la carta de comentario muestra Mag-7 del 8 de mayo como guía generalmente aplicable de medición de ingresos por servicios IA; Bernstein, Wells Fargo y Evercore elevan la probabilidad recurrente de cadencia de 8-K de suministro forward mid-quarter hacia territorio de print Q3 para Nvidia y AMD, y la reconciliación de roadmap de tres vendors de AIwire ancla la forma de referencia de capacidad divulgada contra la rampa AMD Helios MI450 H2 2026.
text_locales.fil: Tinatrato ng Saturday clarifying footnote ng SEC Corp Fin ang Mayo 8 Mag-7 sample comment letter bilang generally applicable AI-services-revenue measurement guidance; itinataas ng Bernstein, Wells Fargo, at Evercore ang recurring mid-quarter forward-supply 8-K cadence probability patungo sa Q3-print territory para sa Nvidia at AMD, at iniaangkla ng three-vendor roadmap reconciliation ng AIwire ang disclosed-capacity reference shape laban sa AMD Helios MI450 H2 2026 ramp.

bridges.text: AMD's 8-K confirms 6.2GW Helios plus MI450 H2 2026 commitments across Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI 1GW, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, plus an undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment. Nvidia's parallel 8-K on Vera Rubin production-volume commitments at nine of the top-ten hyperscalers tightens the comparable, while SEC Corp Fin's sample letter to Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta sharpens the Q2 10-Q bar.

text_locales.en: AMD's 8-K confirms 6.2GW Helios plus MI450 H2 2026 commitments across Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI 1GW, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, plus an undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment. Nvidia's parallel 8-K on Vera Rubin production-volume commitments at nine of the top-ten hyperscalers tightens the comparable, while SEC Corp Fin's sample letter to Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta sharpens the Q2 10-Q bar.
text_locales.ja: AMDの8-Kは、Microsoft Azure、Oracle、OpenAI 1GW、Crusoe、CoreWeave、Lambdaにわたる6.2GW Helios + MI450 H2 2026コミットメントに加え、未開示の0.8GW Tencent Cloudコミットメントを確認する。NvidiaのVera Rubin生産量コミットメントに関するパラレル8-Kは、トップ10ハイパースケーラのうち9社でコンパラブルを引き締め、SEC Corp FinによるMicrosoft、Alphabet、Amazon、Metaへのサンプルレターは、Q2 10-Qのバーをさらに鋭くする。
text_locales.es: El 8-K de AMD confirma 6.2GW de compromisos Helios mas MI450 H2 2026 a traves de Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI 1GW, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, mas un compromiso no divulgado de 0.8GW de Tencent Cloud. El 8-K paralelo de Nvidia sobre compromisos de production-volume de Vera Rubin en nueve de los top-ten hyperscalers ajusta la comparable, mientras que la sample letter de SEC Corp Fin a Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta afila la barra del 10-Q del Q2.
text_locales.fil: Kinukumpirma ng 8-K ng AMD ang 6.2GW Helios plus MI450 H2 2026 commitments sa Microsoft Azure, Oracle, OpenAI 1GW, Crusoe, CoreWeave, Lambda, plus undisclosed 0.8GW Tencent Cloud commitment. Ang parallel 8-K ng Nvidia sa Vera Rubin production-volume commitments sa siyam sa top-ten hyperscalers ay humihigpit sa comparable, habang ang sample letter ng SEC Corp Fin sa Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta ay nagpapatalas sa Q2 10-Q bar.

bridges.text: Microsoft analyst-day disclosure of Azure AI Services at $52B annualized run-rate with CFO-committed Q4 footnote breakout starting fiscal Q1-2027, plus the Cerebras IPO putting a public-market multiple under disclosed accelerator revenue, plus AMD's MI450 + Helios commitments across ~6 of the top-10 hyperscalers, deliver exactly the disclosure-pressure precondition the AMD accelerator-footnote prediction names for the Q2 10-Q window.

text_locales.en: Microsoft analyst-day disclosure of Azure AI Services at $52B annualized run-rate with CFO-committed Q4 footnote breakout starting fiscal Q1-2027, plus the Cerebras IPO putting a public-market multiple under disclosed accelerator revenue, plus AMD's MI450 + Helios commitments across ~6 of the top-10 hyperscalers, deliver exactly the disclosure-pressure precondition the AMD accelerator-footnote prediction names for the Q2 10-Q window.
text_locales.ja: Microsoftアナリストデーで開示されたAzure AI Servicesの年率換算売上520億ドル、CFOコミット済みQ4脚注分割が会計年度Q1-2027開始、Cerebras IPOが開示アクセラレータ売上に公開市場マルチプルを敷いたこと、AMDのMI450 + Helios上位10ハイパースケーラー約6社へのコミットメントが、Q2 10-Q窓口に向けてAMDアクセラレータ脚注予測が指す開示圧力前提条件を提供する。
text_locales.es: La divulgación del día del analista de Microsoft de Azure AI Services a $52B de tasa de ejecución anualizada con desglose de nota al pie comprometido por el CFO comenzando en el Q1 fiscal 2027, más el IPO de Cerebras poniendo un múltiplo de mercado público bajo los ingresos de aceleradores divulgados, más los compromisos MI450 + Helios de AMD a través de ~6 de los 10 principales hyperscalers, entregan exactamente la precondición de presión de divulgación que la predicción de nota al pie de aceleradores de AMD nombra para la ventana del 10-Q del Q2.
text_locales.fil: Ang Microsoft analyst-day disclosure ng Azure AI Services sa $52B annualized run-rate kasama ang CFO-committed Q4 footnote breakout simula sa fiscal Q1-2027, kasama ang Cerebras IPO na naglalagay ng public-market multiple sa ilalim ng disclosed accelerator revenue, kasama ang AMD MI450 + Helios commitments sa ~6 sa top-10 hyperscalers, ay nagdedeliver ng eksaktong disclosure-pressure precondition na pinapangalanan ng AMD accelerator-footnote prediction para sa Q2 10-Q window.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: By Q3 2026 the AMD May 5 Q1 2026 print — Q1 revenue $10.25B (vs $9.85B consensus, +38% YoY), adjusted EPS $1.37 (vs $1.27 consensus, +9.6% beat), Data Center segment $5.78B at +57% YoY (consensus $5.56B / +51.5%), non-GAAP gross margin 55%, Q2 guide $11.2B +/- $300M (vs Street $10.52B, implying +50.6% YoY and +9.1% sequential), CEO Lisa Su declaring Data Center now the "primary driver of revenue and earnings growth," MI450 Series + Helios customer engagement "strengthening," AMD shares +4.4% after-hours — combined with the Apr 29 MSFT $37B AI-run-rate single-line-item precedent, the May 4 Anthropic + OpenAI parallel JV launches that monetize frontier-AI as a structured-equity wrapper, the May 5 Anthropic 10-agent financial-services launch with native Microsoft 365 + Moody's MCP integration, and the standing $700B 2026 Big-Tech AI-capex tape forces AMD (or a NVIDIA / Broadcom sibling) to publish AI-accelerator-only revenue as a 10-Q segment footnote ahead of any SEC mandate. The disclosure precedent is most likely to mirror the MSFT $37B AI run-rate footnote shape — a single-line-item with optional supplementary breakout — rather than a more invasive cloud-segment-style disclosure regime. Forcing function is the asymmetric narrative pressure: Lisa Su has now publicly named Data Center the primary growth engine on the print itself, but the segment still bundles EPYC server CPUs with Instinct MI300/MI325 AI accelerators; buyside models cannot triangulate accelerator-only ASP and unit economics from the bundled line, and the May 5 Anthropic-finance-agent + FIS-AML stack makes the AI-accelerator-only sub-line the operative buyside disclosure ask. AMD CFO commentary on the next earnings call is the lead indicator; NVIDIA + Broadcom follow within one or two filing cycles via competitive-disclosure pressure.

nodes.description: By Q1 2027 the May 7 Mag-7 disclosure cohort tightening — Microsoft's post-earnings analyst-day disclosure of an Azure AI Services run-rate now at $52B annualized (vs $38B prior quarter) with CFO Amy Hood guiding to a Q4 "AI Services" 10-Q footnote breakout starting fiscal Q1-2027, Apple printing services revenue $28.4B (+14% YoY) with Apple Intelligence + Foundry Local cited as margin-accretive, Alphabet announcing $9B incremental capex for the Iowa Gemini training cluster (2026 capex guide $94B), and Meta's Llama 4 Maverick + Behemoth roadmap targeting frontier-cyber parity with Mythos by Q4 2026 — combined with the Cerebras IPO above-range pricing print that puts a public-market multiple under disclosed AI-accelerator revenue, force Alphabet, Amazon, and Meta to publish parallel AI-services revenue 10-Q footnote breakouts inside the same fiscal cycle. The structural force is that once one Mag-7 issuer ships a mid-2-digit-billions AI-segment disclosure with a committed footnote-breakout schedule, sell-side and SEC Corp Fin staff comment letters press the cohort for comparable line items; the AI-capex-vs-AI-revenue ROI question that Mag-7 Q1 prints left unresolved becomes politically untenable to leave to analyst-day commentary alone. The most likely shape is a quantitative AI Services revenue line + segment-level cost-of-revenue + capex-to-AI-services attribution narrative; Alphabet ships first given its $9B incremental Iowa capex needing an ROI denominator, Amazon follows on the AWS Bedrock + Trainium footnote, Meta last given its open-weights commercial model. The bear case is SEC Corp Fin issuing a concept release first and delaying voluntary disclosure beyond Q1 2027; absent that, the cohort lands by fiscal Q1-2027 prints.
