description.ja: 2026年8月初旬までにTenstorrent S-1が、二重に週末を経た二重にクリアされた規制背景に加えてSambaNovaの非公開提出を6月最終週へと、3社目の非公開提出を同じ第3四半期2026決算窓の内側へと押すGalaxyラックの83パーセント能力充足曲線に対してアンカーされた、公開提出する3社のAIアクセラレーターIPO比較対象セットの最初のものとして発効する。日曜の週末は、IPOトラックの非公開審査が二重に週末を経た落ち着いた状態に到達し、能力トラクションのアンカーがサイクルの最高の充足の読みへと進む状態で、3日間のメモリアルデー市場閉鎖をクローズする。日曜版HPCwire AIwireの週末ノートは、Tenstorrentの非公開SEC Corp Fin審査が週末2回目の稼働日を通じて金曜の15営業日マークをクリーンに維持し、第2ラウンドコメントレターがそのスタッフ審査期間の内側にあり、8月初旬の公開提出目標が今や二重にクリアされた規制環境に対して固められ、加えてSambaNovaのブックランナー陣容が6社で安定し、非公開提出の提出目標が6月最終週で変わらないと報じる。日曜版Datacenter Dynamicsのワイヤーは、Galaxyラックの上半期能力充足曲線が今や280ラック目標のおよそ83パーセントにあり——土曜の81パーセントから2ポイントの週末上昇で、曲線が担った最高の充足の読み——今や二重に週末を経た二重にクリアされた規制アンカー背景に対して公開提出が依拠すると見込まれる収益トラクションのアンカーとして引用され続け、メモリアルデー後の火曜日の業務再開へ向かっていると報じる。日曜版247 Wall Stの週末ふり返りは、Bernstein、Wells Fargo Securities、Evercore ISI、Citi Research、Jefferies、Goldman Sachs Equity Researchのプレビュー集団がMag-7内訳集団確率を週末2日連続で金曜の97パーセントの読みで維持していると報じ——サイクルが担ってきた最高の集団確率——集団が今や公開されたAlphabetアナリストデーデックに加えてその更新された投資家プレゼンテーション脚注を、AIアクセラレーターIPO引受人がパブリック・コンパラブル開示環境を値付けする対象の正準の二重に週末を経た開示先例文書セットとして扱っているとした。構造的な力は、非公開審査の15営業日マークが週末両日を通じてスタッフ審査内側の第2ラウンドCorp Finレターと共に二重に週末を経て維持され、Galaxyラックの能力充足曲線がサイクルの最高の読みである83パーセントへと進み、二重にクリアされたFMRB機密附属書8人中8人クローズに加えてCISA連邦民間機関指令の遵守監視モード下の3日目の稼働日が二重に週末を経た規制アンカー背景として落ち着き、Mag-7内訳集団確率が満場一致から1パーセントポイント以内の97パーセントを週末両日にわたって維持し、AMD HeliosプラスMI450コミットメントブックが二重に週末を経た需要側軌道アンカーとして11.1GWで維持される以上、供給側のAIアクセラレーターIPOカレンダーは、開いた引受の問いではなく決算サイクルへと圧縮される、という点にある。最も可能性の高い着地は、Tenstorrent S-1公開提出が固められた8月初旬の目標で2026年8月前半に着地し、SambaNovaの非公開提出が6月最終週に着地し2026年第3四半期の内側で公開提出へと変換し、3社目のパイプライン追加——おそらくGroqまたはLightmatterの非公開提出窓——が同じ第3四半期窓の内側で開き、Mag-7のセルサイドデスクに、AMD HeliosプラスMI450コミットメントブック軌道とCerebras CBRSの上半期再評価が需要側アンカーとして値付けする対象である新たな3社のパブリック・コンパラブルセットを与える、というものである。弱気シナリオは、次の2回の第2ラウンドCorp Finコメントレター交換のうち1つが、開いたばかりのFMRB署名窓に紐づく新たなリスクファクターサーフェスを提起し、8月の公開提出目標が9月初旬へ滑る；その滑りがなければ、2026年8月初旬にTenstorrentが2026年下半期内に発効する3つのAIアクセラレーターIPOの最初として着地する、というもの。
description.es: Para principios de agosto de 2026 el S-1 de Tenstorrent entra en vigor como el primero de un conjunto comparable de salida a bolsa de aceleradores de IA de tres nombres en presentar públicamente, anclado frente a un trasfondo regulatorio doblemente despejado doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana más la curva de cumplimiento de capacidad del rack Galaxy del 83 por ciento que empuja tanto la presentación confidencial de SambaNova a la última semana de junio como una presentación confidencial de un tercer nombre dentro de la misma ventana de publicación del Q3 2026. El fin de semana del domingo cierra el cierre del mercado del fin de semana de tres días del Memorial Day con la revisión confidencial de la vía de salida a bolsa alcanzando un estado asentado doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana y el ancla de tracción de capacidad avanzando a su lectura de cumplimiento más alta del ciclo. Una nota de fin de semana del domingo de HPCwire AIwire informa que la revisión confidencial de la Corp Fin de la SEC de Tenstorrent mantiene su marca de quince días hábiles del viernes limpiamente a lo largo del segundo día operativo de fin de semana con la carta de comentarios de segunda ronda dentro de su intervalo de revisión del personal y el objetivo de presentación pública de principios de agosto afianzado frente al ahora doblemente despejado entorno regulatorio, más el plantel de colocadores principales de SambaNova estable en seis con el objetivo de presentación confidencial sin cambios en la última semana de junio. Un cable de domingo de Datacenter Dynamics informa que la curva de cumplimiento de capacidad del primer semestre del rack Galaxy ahora en aproximadamente el 83 por ciento del objetivo de 280 racks — un avance de 2 puntos durante el fin de semana sobre el 81 por ciento del sábado y la lectura de cumplimiento más alta que ha llevado la curva — continúa siendo citada como el ancla de tracción de ingresos sobre la que se espera que se apoye la presentación pública frente al trasfondo de ancla regulatoria ahora doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana doblemente despejado de cara a la reanudación de negocios del martes posterior al Memorial Day. Una recapitulación de fin de semana del domingo de 247 Wall St informa que el grupo de adelanto de Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, Citi Research, Jefferies y Goldman Sachs Equity Research mantiene la probabilidad del grupo de desglose Mag-7 en la lectura del 97 por ciento del viernes por segundo día consecutivo de fin de semana en la probabilidad de grupo más alta que el ciclo ha llevado, con el grupo tratando la presentación del día del analista de Alphabet ahora publicada más las notas a pie de página actualizadas de su presentación a inversores como el conjunto de documentos canónico de precedente de divulgación doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana frente al que los suscriptores de salida a bolsa de aceleradores de IA cotizarán el entorno de divulgación de comparable público. description.fil: Pagsapit ng early August 2026, ang S-1 ng Tenstorrent ay magiging effective bilang ang unang ng isang three-name AI-accelerator IPO comparable set na public-file, nakaangkla laban sa isang doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop plus ang 83-porsiyento Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment curve na nagtutulak sa parehong SambaNova's confidential filing tungo sa huling linggo ng Hunyo at isang ikatlong pangalan na confidential submission sa loob ng parehong Q3 2026 print window. Isinasara ng Sunday weekend ang three-day Memorial Day market closure kasama ang IPO-track confidential review na umaabot sa isang doubly-weekend-aged settled state at ang capacity-traction anchor na sumusulong tungo sa kanyang pinakamataas na fulfillment reading ng cycle. Iniulat ng isang Sunday HPCwire AIwire weekend note ang Tenstorrent confidential SEC Corp Fin review na hawak ang Friday fifteen-business-day mark nito nang malinis sa pamamagitan ng ikalawang weekend operating day kasama ang second-round comment letter sa loob ng kanyang staff-review interval at ang early-August public-filing target na pinatatag laban sa now-doubly-cleared regulatory environment, plus ang SambaNova bookrunner roster na matatag sa anim kasama ang confidential-submission filing target na hindi nagbabago sa huling linggo ng Hunyo. Iniulat ng isang Sunday Datacenter Dynamics wire ang Galaxy-rack first-half capacity-fulfillment curve na nasa halos 83 porsiyento na ngayon ng 280-rack target - isang 2-point weekend uptick mula sa Saturday 81 porsiyento at ang pinakamataas na fulfillment reading na dinala ng curve - nagpapatuloy na banggitin bilang revenue-traction anchor na sasandalan ng pampublikong filing laban sa now-doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory-anchor backdrop papasok sa post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption. Iniulat ng isang Sunday 247 Wall St weekend recap ang Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, Citi Research, Jefferies, at Goldman Sachs Equity Research preview cohort na hawak ang Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability sa Friday 97 porsiyentong pagbasa sa ikalawang magkasunod na weekend day sa pinakamataas na cohort probability na dinala ng cycle, kasama ang cohort na itinuturing ang now-published Alphabet analyst-day deck plus ang updated investor-presentation footnotes nito bilang ang canonical doubly-weekend-aged disclosure-precedent document set laban sa kung saan ang AI-accelerator IPO underwriters ay magpepresyo sa public-comparable disclosure environment. Ang structural force ay na sa sandaling ang fifteen-business-day mark ng confidential review ay hawak nang doubly-weekend-aged sa pamamagitan ng parehong weekend days kasama ang second-round Corp Fin letter sa loob ng staff-review, ang Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment curve ay sumusulong tungo sa 83 porsiyento sa pinakamataas na pagbasa ng cycle, ang doubly-cleared FMRB classified-annex eight-of-eight close plus ang ikatlong operating day ng CISA federal-civilian directive sa ilalim ng compliance-monitoring mode ay umaayos bilang ang doubly-weekend-aged regulatory-anchor backdrop, hawak ang Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability sa 97 porsiyento sa loob ng isang percentage point ng unanimity sa kabuuan ng parehong weekend days, at hawak ng AMD Helios plus MI450 commitment book ang sarili sa 11.1GW bilang ang doubly-weekend-aged demand-side trajectory anchor, ang supply-side AI-accelerator IPO calendar ay siniksik tungo sa isang print sequence sa halip na isang open underwriting question. Ang pinakamalamang na landing ay ang Tenstorrent S-1 public filing na lalagay sa unang kalahati ng August 2026 sa pinatatag na early-August target, ang SambaNova confidential submission na lalagay sa huling linggo ng Hunyo at mako-convert sa public filing sa loob ng Q3 2026, at isang ikatlong pangalan na pipeline addition - malamang ang Groq o Lightmatter confidential-submission window - na bubukas sa loob ng parehong Q3 window, nagbibigay sa Mag-7 sell-side desks ng isang sariwang three-name public-comparable set laban sa kung saan ang AMD Helios plus MI450 commitment-book trajectory at ang Cerebras CBRS upper-band re-rating ay magpepresyo bilang demand-side anchors. summary.en: By early August 2026 Tenstorrent's S-1 goes effective as the first of a three-name AI-accelerator IPO comparable set to public-file, anchored against a doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop plus the 83-percent Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment curve that pushes both SambaNova's confidential filing into the final week of June and a third-name confidential submission inside the same Q3 2026 print window. The Sunday weekend closes the three-day Memorial Day market closure with the IPO-track confidential review reaching a doubly-weekend-aged settled state and the capacity-traction anchor stepping to its highest fulfillment reading of the cycle. A Sunday HPCwire AIwire weekend note reports Tenstorrent's confidential SEC Corp Fin review holding its Friday fifteen-business-day mark cleanly through the second weekend operating day with the second-round comment letter inside its staff-review interval and the early-August public-filing target firmed against the now-doubly-cleared regulatory environment, plus SambaNova's bookrunner roster steady at six with the confidential-submission filing target unchanged at the final week of June. A Sunday Datacenter Dynamics wire reports the Galaxy-rack first-half capacity-fulfillment curve now at roughly 83 percent of the 280-rack target — a 2-point weekend uptick from Saturday's 81 percent and the highest fulfillment reading the curve has carried — continuing to be cited as the revenue-traction anchor the public filing is expected to lean on against the now-doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory-anchor backdrop heading into the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption. A Sunday 247 Wall St weekend recap reports the Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, Citi Research, Jefferies, and Goldman Sachs Equity Research preview cohort holding the Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability at Friday's 97 percent reading for a second consecutive weekend day at the highest cohort probability the cycle has carried, with the cohort treating the now-published Alphabet analyst-day deck plus its updated investor-presentation footnotes as the canonical doubly-weekend-aged disclosure-precedent document set against which AI-accelerator IPO underwriters will price the public-comparable disclosure environment. The structural force is that once the confidential review's fifteen-business-day mark holds doubly-weekend-aged through both weekend days with the second-round Corp Fin letter inside staff-review, the Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment curve steps to 83 percent at the highest reading of the cycle, the doubly-cleared FMRB classified-annex eight-of-eight close plus the CISA federal-civilian directive's third operating day under compliance-monitoring mode settle as the doubly-weekend-aged regulatory-anchor backdrop, the Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability holds at 97 percent inside one percentage point of unanimity across both weekend days, and the AMD Helios plus MI450 commitment book holds at 11.1GW as the doubly-weekend-aged demand-side trajectory anchor, the supply-side AI-accelerator IPO calendar compresses to a print sequence rather than an open underwriting question. The most likely landing is Tenstorrent's S-1 public filing landing in the first half of August 2026 on the firmed early-August target, the SambaNova confidential submission landing in the final week of June and converting to public filing inside Q3 2026, and a third-name pipeline addition — likely the Groq or Lightmatter confidential-submission window — opening inside the same Q3 window, giving Mag-7 sell-side desks a fresh three-name public-comparable set the AMD Helios plus MI450 commitment-book trajectory and the Cerebras CBRS upper-band re-rating price against as demand-side anchors. Bear case is one of the next two second-round Corp Fin comment-letter exchanges raising a fresh risk-factor surface tied to the just-opened FMRB signing window and the August public-filing target slipping into early September; absent that slip, early August 2026 lands Tenstorrent first of three AI-accelerator IPOs going effective inside H2 2026.
summary.ja: 2026年8月初旬までにTenstorrent S-1が、二重に週末を経た二重にクリアされた規制背景に加えてSambaNovaの非公開提出を6月最終週へと、3社目の非公開提出を同じ第3四半期2026決算窓の内側へと押すGalaxyラックの83パーセント能力充足曲線に対してアンカーされた、公開提出する3社のAIアクセラレーターIPO比較対象セットの最初のものとして発効する。日曜の週末は、IPOトラックの非公開審査が二重に週末を経た落ち着いた状態に到達し、能力トラクションのアンカーがサイクルの最高の充足の読みへと進む状態で、3日間のメモリアルデー市場閉鎖をクローズする。日曜版HPCwire AIwireの週末ノートは、Tenstorrentの非公開SEC Corp Fin審査が週末2回目の稼働日を通じて金曜の15営業日マークをクリーンに維持し、第2ラウンドコメントレターがそのスタッフ審査期間の内側にあり、8月初旬の公開提出目標が今や二重にクリアされた規制環境に対して固められ、加えてSambaNovaのブックランナー陣容が6社で安定し、非公開提出の提出目標が6月最終週で変わらないと報じる。日曜版Datacenter Dynamicsのワイヤーは、Galaxyラックの上半期能力充足曲線が今や280ラック目標のおよそ83パーセントにあり——土曜の81パーセントから2ポイントの週末上昇で、曲線が担った最高の充足の読み——今や二重に週末を経た二重にクリアされた規制アンカー背景に対して公開提出が依拠すると見込まれる収益トラクションのアンカーとして引用され続け、メモリアルデー後の火曜日の業務再開へ向かっていると報じる。日曜版247 Wall Stの週末ふり返りは、Bernstein、Wells Fargo Securities、Evercore ISI、Citi Research、Jefferies、Goldman Sachs Equity Researchのプレビュー集団がMag-7内訳集団確率を週末2日連続で金曜の97パーセントの読みで維持していると報じ——サイクルが担ってきた最高の集団確率——集団が今や公開されたAlphabetアナリストデーデックに加えてその更新された投資家プレゼンテーション脚注を、AIアクセラレーターIPO引受人がパブリック・コンパラブル開示環境を値付けする対象の正準の二重に週末を経た開示先例文書セットとして扱っているとした。構造的な力は、非公開審査の15営業日マークが週末両日を通じてスタッフ審査内側の第2ラウンドCorp Finレターと共に二重に週末を経て維持され、Galaxyラックの能力充足曲線がサイクルの最高の読みである83パーセントへと進み、二重にクリアされたFMRB機密附属書8人中8人クローズに加えてCISA連邦民間機関指令の遵守監視モード下の3日目の稼働日が二重に週末を経た規制アンカー背景として落ち着き、Mag-7内訳集団確率が満場一致から1パーセントポイント以内の97パーセントを週末両日にわたって維持し、AMD HeliosプラスMI450コミットメントブックが二重に週末を経た需要側軌道アンカーとして11.1GWで維持される以上、供給側のAIアクセラレーターIPOカレンダーは、開いた引受の問いではなく決算サイクルへと圧縮される、という点にある。最も可能性の高い着地は、Tenstorrent S-1公開提出が固められた8月初旬の目標で2026年8月前半に着地し、SambaNovaの非公開提出が6月最終週に着地し2026年第3四半期の内側で公開提出へと変換し、3社目のパイプライン追加——おそらくGroqまたはLightmatterの非公開提出窓——が同じ第3四半期窓の内側で開き、Mag-7のセルサイドデスクに、AMD HeliosプラスMI450コミットメントブック軌道とCerebras CBRSの上半期再評価が需要側アンカーとして値付けする対象である新たな3社のパブリック・コンパラブルセットを与える、というものである。弱気シナリオは、次の2回の第2ラウンドCorp Finコメントレター交換のうち1つが、開いたばかりのFMRB署名窓に紐づく新たなリスクファクターサーフェスを提起し、8月の公開提出目標が9月初旬へ滑る；その滑りがなければ、2026年8月初旬にTenstorrentが2026年下半期内に発効する3つのAIアクセラレーターIPOの最初として着地する、というもの。

detail.summary_short: Sunday holds the Tenstorrent confidential review at a doubly-weekend-aged fifteen-business-day mark with the second-round Corp Fin letter in staff-review, and the Galaxy-rack capacity curve steps to 83 percent. By early August 2026 Tenstorrent S-1 public-files first of three.

summary_short_locales.en: Sunday holds the Tenstorrent confidential review at a doubly-weekend-aged fifteen-business-day mark with the second-round Corp Fin letter in staff-review, and the Galaxy-rack capacity curve steps to 83 percent. By early August 2026 Tenstorrent S-1 public-files first of three.
summary_short_locales.ja: 日曜日はTenstorrentの非公開審査を、スタッフ審査内側の第2ラウンドCorp Finレターと共に二重に週末を経た15営業日マークで維持し、Galaxyラック能力曲線が83パーセントへと進む。2026年8月初旬までにTenstorrent S-1が3社のうち最初として公開提出する。
summary_short_locales.es: El domingo mantiene la revisión confidencial de Tenstorrent en una marca de quince días hábiles doblemente envejecida por el fin de semana con la carta de comentarios de segunda ronda de la Corp Fin en revisión del personal, y la curva de capacidad del rack Galaxy avanza al 83 por ciento. Para principios de agosto de 2026 el S-1 de Tenstorrent presenta públicamente primero de tres.
summary_short_locales.fil: Hawak ng Sunday ang Tenstorrent confidential review sa isang doubly-weekend-aged fifteen-business-day mark kasama ang second-round Corp Fin letter sa staff-review, at ang Galaxy-rack capacity curve ay sumusulong tungo sa 83 porsiyento. Pagsapit ng early August 2026, ang Tenstorrent S-1 ay mauunang public-file sa tatlo.

text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción del conjunto de IPO de chip de IA de tres nombres ancla del S-1 de Tenstorrent (24 de mayo), las noticias de hoy giraron hacia hilos frescos (cohorte de inicio de Compra Goldman-Citi de Cerebras, CVE de Anthropic Claude Code, vLLM v0.11.5-rc1, arxiv de Reservoir Routing, despliegue Apptronik-Mercedes). La compra de Cerebras cruzando el 49,8 por ciento del float ajusta el carril de precios del conjunto comparable indirectamente, pero no apareció ningún movimiento de revisión de Corp Fin de Tenstorrent o presentación confidencial de SambaNova.

Ang Cerebras buyside na tumatawid sa 49.8 porsiyento ng float ay hinihigpitan ang comparable-set pricing lane nang patagilid, ngunit walang Tenstorrent Corp Fin review o SambaNova confidential-submission movement ang sumibol.

bridges.text: Monday's AIwire note holds Tenstorrent's Corp Fin review at the sixteen-business-day mark with the federal observance pausing the counter at Friday's fifteen, the second-round comment letter inside its staff-review interval, and the early-August target firmed against the triply-cleared regulatory environment — plus SambaNova's roster steady at six. The Datacenter Dynamics wire lifts Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment to roughly 84 percent — the highest reading the curve has carried — and the 247 Wall St recap holds the Mag-7 breakout probability at 97 percent for a third consecutive non-trading day.

text_locales.en: Monday's AIwire note holds Tenstorrent's Corp Fin review at the sixteen-business-day mark with the federal observance pausing the counter at Friday's fifteen, the second-round comment letter inside its staff-review interval, and the early-August target firmed against the triply-cleared regulatory environment — plus SambaNova's roster steady at six. The Datacenter Dynamics wire lifts Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment to roughly 84 percent — the highest reading the curve has carried — and the 247 Wall St recap holds the Mag-7 breakout probability at 97 percent for a third consecutive non-trading day.
text_locales.ja: 月曜日のAIwireノートは、TenstorrentのCorp Finレビューを、連邦観察が金曜日の15でカウンターを一時停止する状態で16営業日のマークで維持し、第2ラウンドのコメントレターがそのスタッフレビュー期間内に入り、8月初旬の目標が3重にクリアされた規制環境に対して固められ——加えてSambaNovaの陣が6社で安定して維持される。Datacenter Dynamicsの配信は、Galaxyラックの能力充足を、曲線がこれまで担った最も高い読みである約84パーセントへと押し上げ、247 Wall Stのまとめは、Mag-7切り出し確率を3日連続の非取引日にわたって97パーセントで維持する。
text_locales.es: La nota del lunes de AIwire mantiene la revisión de Corp Fin de Tenstorrent en la marca de dieciséis días hábiles con la observancia federal pausando el contador en los quince del viernes, la carta de comentarios de segunda ronda dentro de su intervalo de revisión por el personal, y el objetivo de comienzos de agosto firmado frente al entorno regulatorio triplemente despejado —más la lista de SambaNova estable en seis. El cable de Datacenter Dynamics eleva el cumplimiento de capacidad de bastidores Galaxy hasta aproximadamente el 84 por ciento —la lectura más alta que la curva ha llevado— y el resumen de 247 Wall St mantiene la probabilidad de desglose de los Mag-7 en el 97 por ciento por tercer día consecutivo no de cotización.
text_locales.fil: Hawak ng Monday AIwire note ang Tenstorrent Corp Fin review sa sixteen-business-day mark kasama ang federal observance na pinapahinto ang counter sa Friday fifteen, ang second-round comment letter sa loob ng staff-review interval nito, at ang early-August target na pinatibay laban sa triply-cleared regulatory environment — plus ang SambaNova roster na matatag sa anim. Inaangat ng Datacenter Dynamics wire ang Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment patungo sa tinatayang 84 porsiyento — ang pinakamataas na pagbabasa na dala ng curve — at hawak ng 247 Wall St recap ang Mag-7 breakout probability sa 97 porsiyento para sa ikatlong sunud-sunod na non-trading day.

motivation_locales.es: Cerrar el objetivo de 280 racks a tiempo es lo que convierte la curva de cumplimiento de capacidad de un punto de datos del fin de semana a evidencia auditable de tracción de ingresos que las presentaciones públicas pueden citar como sustanciación material.

outcome_locales.en: Tenstorrent's S-1 goes effective in the first half of August 2026 as the first AI-accelerator IPO of the three-name comparable set, anchored to the firmed early-August public-filing target.
outcome_locales.ja: Tenstorrent S-1が、固められた8月初旬の公開提出目標にアンカーされた、3社のAIアクセラレーターIPO比較対象セットの最初として2026年8月前半に発効する。
outcome_locales.es: El S-1 de Tenstorrent entra en vigor en la primera mitad de agosto de 2026 como la primera salida a bolsa de aceleradores de IA del conjunto comparable de tres nombres, anclado al objetivo de presentación pública firmado de principios de agosto.
outcome_locales.fil: Ang S-1 ng Tenstorrent ay magiging effective sa unang kalahati ng August 2026 bilang ang unang AI-accelerator IPO ng three-name comparable set, nakaangkla sa pinatatag na early-August public-filing target.

motivation_locales.en: Holding the firmed early-August target through the second-round comment-letter exchange protects the three-name sequencing the rest of the cohort prices against.
motivation_locales.ja: 固められた8月初旬の目標を第2ラウンドコメントレター交換を通じて維持することが、残りの集団が値付けする対象である3社の順序付けを保護する。
motivation_locales.es: Mantener el objetivo firmado de principios de agosto a través del intercambio de carta de comentarios de segunda ronda protege la secuenciación de tres nombres contra la que el resto del grupo cotiza.
motivation_locales.fil: Ang paghahawak sa pinatatag na early-August target sa pamamagitan ng ikalawang-round comment-letter exchange ay pinoprotektahan ang three-name sequencing na laban sa kung saan ay nagpepresyo ang natitirang cohort.

detail.description: By early August 2026 Tenstorrent's S-1 goes effective as the first of a three-name AI-accelerator IPO comparable set to public-file, anchored against a doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop plus the 83-percent Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment curve that pushes both SambaNova's confidential filing into the final week of June and a third-name confidential submission inside the same Q3 2026 print window. The Sunday weekend closes the three-day Memorial Day market closure with the IPO-track confidential review reaching a doubly-weekend-aged settled state and the capacity-traction anchor stepping to its highest fulfillment reading of the cycle. A Sunday HPCwire AIwire weekend note reports Tenstorrent's confidential SEC Corp Fin review holding its Friday fifteen-business-day mark cleanly through the second weekend operating day with the second-round comment letter inside its staff-review interval and the early-August public-filing target firmed against the now-doubly-cleared regulatory environment, plus SambaNova's bookrunner roster steady at six with the confidential-submission filing target unchanged at the final week of June. A Sunday Datacenter Dynamics wire reports the Galaxy-rack first-half capacity-fulfillment curve now at roughly 83 percent of the 280-rack target — a 2-point weekend uptick from Saturday's 81 percent and the highest fulfillment reading the curve has carried — continuing to be cited as the revenue-traction anchor the public filing is expected to lean on against the now-doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory-anchor backdrop heading into the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption. A Sunday 247 Wall St weekend recap reports the Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, Citi Research, Jefferies, and Goldman Sachs Equity Research preview cohort holding the Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability at Friday's 97 percent reading for a second consecutive weekend day at the highest cohort probability the cycle has carried, with the cohort treating the now-published Alphabet analyst-day deck plus its updated investor-presentation footnotes as the canonical doubly-weekend-aged disclosure-precedent document set against which AI-accelerator IPO underwriters will price the public-comparable disclosure environment. The structural force is that once the confidential review's fifteen-business-day mark holds doubly-weekend-aged through both weekend days with the second-round Corp Fin letter inside staff-review, the Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment curve steps to 83 percent at the highest reading of the cycle, the doubly-cleared FMRB classified-annex eight-of-eight close plus the CISA federal-civilian directive's third operating day under compliance-monitoring mode settle as the doubly-weekend-aged regulatory-anchor backdrop, the Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability holds at 97 percent inside one percentage point of unanimity across both weekend days, and the AMD Helios plus MI450 commitment book holds at 11.1GW as the doubly-weekend-aged demand-side trajectory anchor, the supply-side AI-accelerator IPO calendar compresses to a print sequence rather than an open underwriting question. The most likely landing is Tenstorrent's S-1 public filing landing in the first half of August 2026 on the firmed early-August target, the SambaNova confidential submission landing in the final week of June and converting to public filing inside Q3 2026, and a third-name pipeline addition — likely the Groq or Lightmatter confidential-submission window — opening inside the same Q3 window, giving Mag-7 sell-side desks a fresh three-name public-comparable set the AMD Helios plus MI450 commitment-book trajectory and the Cerebras CBRS upper-band re-rating price against as demand-side anchors. Bear case is one of the next two second-round Corp Fin comment-letter exchanges raising a fresh risk-factor surface tied to the just-opened FMRB signing window and the August public-filing target slipping into early September; absent that slip, early August 2026 lands Tenstorrent first of three AI-accelerator IPOs going effective inside H2 2026.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年8月初旬までにTenstorrent S-1が、二重に週末を経た二重にクリアされた規制背景に加えてSambaNovaの非公開提出を6月最終週へと、3社目の非公開提出を同じ第3四半期2026決算窓の内側へと押すGalaxyラックの83パーセント能力充足曲線に対してアンカーされた、公開提出する3社のAIアクセラレーターIPO比較対象セットの最初のものとして発効する。日曜の週末は、IPOトラックの非公開審査が二重に週末を経た落ち着いた状態に到達し、能力トラクションのアンカーがサイクルの最高の充足の読みへと進む状態で、3日間のメモリアルデー市場閉鎖をクローズする。日曜版HPCwire AIwireの週末ノートは、Tenstorrentの非公開SEC Corp Fin審査が週末2回目の稼働日を通じて金曜の15営業日マークをクリーンに維持し、第2ラウンドコメントレターがそのスタッフ審査期間の内側にあり、8月初旬の公開提出目標が今や二重にクリアされた規制環境に対して固められ、加えてSambaNovaのブックランナー陣容が6社で安定し、非公開提出の提出目標が6月最終週で変わらないと報じる。日曜版Datacenter Dynamicsのワイヤーは、Galaxyラックの上半期能力充足曲線が今や280ラック目標のおよそ83パーセントにあり——土曜の81パーセントから2ポイントの週末上昇で、曲線が担った最高の充足の読み——今や二重に週末を経た二重にクリアされた規制アンカー背景に対して公開提出が依拠すると見込まれる収益トラクションのアンカーとして引用され続け、メモリアルデー後の火曜日の業務再開へ向かっていると報じる。日曜版247 Wall Stの週末ふり返りは、Bernstein、Wells Fargo Securities、Evercore ISI、Citi Research、Jefferies、Goldman Sachs Equity Researchのプレビュー集団がMag-7内訳集団確率を週末2日連続で金曜の97パーセントの読みで維持していると報じ——サイクルが担ってきた最高の集団確率——集団が今や公開されたAlphabetアナリストデーデックに加えてその更新された投資家プレゼンテーション脚注を、AIアクセラレーターIPO引受人がパブリック・コンパラブル開示環境を値付けする対象の正準の二重に週末を経た開示先例文書セットとして扱っているとした。構造的な力は、非公開審査の15営業日マークが週末両日を通じてスタッフ審査内側の第2ラウンドCorp Finレターと共に二重に週末を経て維持され、Galaxyラックの能力充足曲線がサイクルの最高の読みである83パーセントへと進み、二重にクリアされたFMRB機密附属書8人中8人クローズに加えてCISA連邦民間機関指令の遵守監視モード下の3日目の稼働日が二重に週末を経た規制アンカー背景として落ち着き、Mag-7内訳集団確率が満場一致から1パーセントポイント以内の97パーセントを週末両日にわたって維持し、AMD HeliosプラスMI450コミットメントブックが二重に週末を経た需要側軌道アンカーとして11.1GWで維持される以上、供給側のAIアクセラレーターIPOカレンダーは、開いた引受の問いではなく決算サイクルへと圧縮される、という点にある。最も可能性の高い着地は、Tenstorrent S-1公開提出が固められた8月初旬の目標で2026年8月前半に着地し、SambaNovaの非公開提出が6月最終週に着地し2026年第3四半期の内側で公開提出へと変換し、3社目のパイプライン追加——おそらくGroqまたはLightmatterの非公開提出窓——が同じ第3四半期窓の内側で開き、Mag-7のセルサイドデスクに、AMD HeliosプラスMI450コミットメントブック軌道とCerebras CBRSの上半期再評価が需要側アンカーとして値付けする対象である新たな3社のパブリック・コンパラブルセットを与える、というものである。弱気シナリオは、次の2回の第2ラウンドCorp Finコメントレター交換のうち1つが、開いたばかりのFMRB署名窓に紐づく新たなリスクファクターサーフェスを提起し、8月の公開提出目標が9月初旬へ滑る；その滑りがなければ、2026年8月初旬にTenstorrentが2026年下半期内に発効する3つのAIアクセラレーターIPOの最初として着地する、というもの。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para principios de agosto de 2026 el S-1 de Tenstorrent entra en vigor como el primero de un conjunto comparable de salida a bolsa de aceleradores de IA de tres nombres en presentar públicamente, anclado frente a un trasfondo regulatorio doblemente despejado doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana más la curva de cumplimiento de capacidad del rack Galaxy del 83 por ciento que empuja tanto la presentación confidencial de SambaNova a la última semana de junio como una presentación confidencial de un tercer nombre dentro de la misma ventana de publicación del Q3 2026. El fin de semana del domingo cierra el cierre del mercado del fin de semana de tres días del Memorial Day con la revisión confidencial de la vía de salida a bolsa alcanzando un estado asentado doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana y el ancla de tracción de capacidad avanzando a su lectura de cumplimiento más alta del ciclo. Una nota de fin de semana del domingo de HPCwire AIwire informa que la revisión confidencial de la Corp Fin de la SEC de Tenstorrent mantiene su marca de quince días hábiles del viernes limpiamente a lo largo del segundo día operativo de fin de semana con la carta de comentarios de segunda ronda dentro de su intervalo de revisión del personal y el objetivo de presentación pública de principios de agosto afianzado frente al ahora doblemente despejado entorno regulatorio, más el plantel de colocadores principales de SambaNova estable en seis con el objetivo de presentación confidencial sin cambios en la última semana de junio. Un cable de domingo de Datacenter Dynamics informa que la curva de cumplimiento de capacidad del primer semestre del rack Galaxy ahora en aproximadamente el 83 por ciento del objetivo de 280 racks — un avance de 2 puntos durante el fin de semana sobre el 81 por ciento del sábado y la lectura de cumplimiento más alta que ha llevado la curva — continúa siendo citada como el ancla de tracción de ingresos sobre la que se espera que se apoye la presentación pública frente al trasfondo de ancla regulatoria ahora doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana doblemente despejado de cara a la reanudación de negocios del martes posterior al Memorial Day. Una recapitulación de fin de semana del domingo de 247 Wall St informa que el grupo de adelanto de Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, Citi Research, Jefferies y Goldman Sachs Equity Research mantiene la probabilidad del grupo de desglose Mag-7 en la lectura del 97 por ciento del viernes por segundo día consecutivo de fin de semana en la probabilidad de grupo más alta que el ciclo ha llevado, con el grupo tratando la presentación del día del analista de Alphabet ahora publicada más las notas a pie de página actualizadas de su presentación a inversores como el conjunto de documentos canónico de precedente de divulgación doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana frente al que los suscriptores de salida a bolsa de aceleradores de IA cotizarán el entorno de divulgación de comparable público. La fuerza estructural es que una vez que la marca de quince días hábiles de la revisión confidencial se mantiene doblemente envejecida por el fin de semana a lo largo de los dos días del fin de semana con la carta de comentarios de segunda ronda de la Corp Fin dentro de revisión del personal, la curva de cumplimiento de capacidad del rack Galaxy avanza al 83 por ciento en la lectura más alta del ciclo, el cierre de ocho-de-ocho del anexo clasificado del FMRB doblemente despejado más el tercer día operativo bajo modo de seguimiento del cumplimiento de la directiva civil-federal de CISA se asientan como el trasfondo de ancla regulatoria doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana, la probabilidad del grupo de desglose Mag-7 se mantiene en el 97 por ciento dentro de un punto porcentual de la unanimidad a lo largo de los dos días del fin de semana, y el libro de compromisos de AMD Helios más MI450 se mantiene en 11,1 GW como el ancla de trayectoria del lado de la demanda doblemente envejecida por el fin de semana, el calendario de salida a bolsa de aceleradores de IA del lado de la oferta se comprime a una secuencia de publicaciones en lugar de una pregunta de suscripción abierta. El desenlace más probable es la presentación pública del S-1 de Tenstorrent aterrizando en la primera mitad de agosto de 2026 en el objetivo firmado de principios de agosto, la presentación confidencial de SambaNova aterrizando en la última semana de junio y convirtiéndose en presentación pública dentro del Q3 2026, y una incorporación de canalización de un tercer nombre — probablemente la ventana de presentación confidencial de Groq o Lightmatter — abriéndose dentro de la misma ventana del Q3, dando a las mesas del lado vendedor de las Mag-7 un nuevo conjunto comparable público de tres nombres contra el que la trayectoria del libro de compromisos de AMD Helios más MI450 y la revaloración de la banda superior de Cerebras CBRS cotizan como anclas del lado de la demanda. El caso bajista es que uno de los próximos dos intercambios de cartas de comentarios de segunda ronda de la Corp Fin plantee una superficie fresca de factor de riesgo vinculada a la ventana de firma del FMRB recién abierta y el objetivo de presentación pública de agosto se deslice a principios de septiembre; sin ese deslizamiento, principios de agosto de 2026 aterriza Tenstorrent primero de tres salidas a bolsa de aceleradores de IA entrando en vigor dentro del H2 2026.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Pagsapit ng early August 2026, ang S-1 ng Tenstorrent ay magiging effective bilang ang unang ng isang three-name AI-accelerator IPO comparable set na public-file, nakaangkla laban sa isang doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop plus ang 83-porsiyento Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment curve na nagtutulak sa parehong SambaNova's confidential filing tungo sa huling linggo ng Hunyo at isang ikatlong pangalan na confidential submission sa loob ng parehong Q3 2026 print window. Isinasara ng Sunday weekend ang three-day Memorial Day market closure kasama ang IPO-track confidential review na umaabot sa isang doubly-weekend-aged settled state at ang capacity-traction anchor na sumusulong tungo sa kanyang pinakamataas na fulfillment reading ng cycle. Iniulat ng isang Sunday HPCwire AIwire weekend note ang Tenstorrent confidential SEC Corp Fin review na hawak ang Friday fifteen-business-day mark nito nang malinis sa pamamagitan ng ikalawang weekend operating day kasama ang second-round comment letter sa loob ng kanyang staff-review interval at ang early-August public-filing target na pinatatag laban sa now-doubly-cleared regulatory environment, plus ang SambaNova bookrunner roster na matatag sa anim kasama ang confidential-submission filing target na hindi nagbabago sa huling linggo ng Hunyo. Iniulat ng isang Sunday Datacenter Dynamics wire ang Galaxy-rack first-half capacity-fulfillment curve na nasa halos 83 porsiyento na ngayon ng 280-rack target - isang 2-point weekend uptick mula sa Saturday 81 porsiyento at ang pinakamataas na fulfillment reading na dinala ng curve - nagpapatuloy na banggitin bilang revenue-traction anchor na sasandalan ng pampublikong filing laban sa now-doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory-anchor backdrop papasok sa post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption. Iniulat ng isang Sunday 247 Wall St weekend recap ang Bernstein, Wells Fargo Securities, Evercore ISI, Citi Research, Jefferies, at Goldman Sachs Equity Research preview cohort na hawak ang Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability sa Friday 97 porsiyentong pagbasa sa ikalawang magkasunod na weekend day sa pinakamataas na cohort probability na dinala ng cycle, kasama ang cohort na itinuturing ang now-published Alphabet analyst-day deck plus ang updated investor-presentation footnotes nito bilang ang canonical doubly-weekend-aged disclosure-precedent document set laban sa kung saan ang AI-accelerator IPO underwriters ay magpepresyo sa public-comparable disclosure environment. Ang structural force ay na sa sandaling ang fifteen-business-day mark ng confidential review ay hawak nang doubly-weekend-aged sa pamamagitan ng parehong weekend days kasama ang second-round Corp Fin letter sa loob ng staff-review, ang Galaxy-rack capacity-fulfillment curve ay sumusulong tungo sa 83 porsiyento sa pinakamataas na pagbasa ng cycle, ang doubly-cleared FMRB classified-annex eight-of-eight close plus ang ikatlong operating day ng CISA federal-civilian directive sa ilalim ng compliance-monitoring mode ay umaayos bilang ang doubly-weekend-aged regulatory-anchor backdrop, hawak ang Mag-7 breakout-cohort probability sa 97 porsiyento sa loob ng isang percentage point ng unanimity sa kabuuan ng parehong weekend days, at hawak ng AMD Helios plus MI450 commitment book ang sarili sa 11.1GW bilang ang doubly-weekend-aged demand-side trajectory anchor, ang supply-side AI-accelerator IPO calendar ay siniksik tungo sa isang print sequence sa halip na isang open underwriting question. Ang pinakamalamang na landing ay ang Tenstorrent S-1 public filing na lalagay sa unang kalahati ng August 2026 sa pinatatag na early-August target, ang SambaNova confidential submission na lalagay sa huling linggo ng Hunyo at mako-convert sa public filing sa loob ng Q3 2026, at isang ikatlong pangalan na pipeline addition - malamang ang Groq o Lightmatter confidential-submission window - na bubukas sa loob ng parehong Q3 window, nagbibigay sa Mag-7 sell-side desks ng isang sariwang three-name public-comparable set laban sa kung saan ang AMD Helios plus MI450 commitment-book trajectory at ang Cerebras CBRS upper-band re-rating ay magpepresyo bilang demand-side anchors. Ang bear case ay isa sa mga susunod na dalawang second-round Corp Fin comment-letter exchanges ay magtataas ng isang sariwang risk-factor surface na nakatali sa just-opened FMRB signing window at ang August public-filing target ay mag-iipit tungo sa early September; kung wala ang slip na iyon, daratnan ng early August 2026 ang Tenstorrent na unang sa tatlong AI-accelerator IPOs na magiging effective sa loob ng H2 2026.

nodes.description: By the close of the OECD GENAI June 2-6 plenary the sixteen-jurisdiction cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter formally admits the United States as the seventeenth named jurisdiction in the plenary's closing session itself, with the admission landing in the same five-day window as the now-signed Frontier Model Review Board executive order and with tenant-policy attestation schemas across the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix carrying the seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter as the default reciprocity surface from general availability in the same first week of June. A Sunday andrew.ooo procedural note reports the OECD GENAI working-group secretariat publishing a Sunday weekend reading observing that the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight Senate classified-annex close on the United States side now sits as a fully settled regulatory-anchor input that all sixteen named-candidate delegations have circulated unchanged through both weekend days with no further movement expected before the post-Memorial-Day resumption — making the plenary's June 2-6 horizon a confirmed nine-calendar-day arithmetic with no fresh weekend variance. A Sunday Decoder weekend note reports the named-candidate count holding at sixteen with Qatar's 270-day national-consultation window now into the closing third of its third week, still no third Gulf Cooperation Council member signalling, and the cohort treating Sunday as the closing pre-Memorial-Day weekend-hold checkpoint between Friday's cleared classified-annex close and the plenary working-procedure review's resumption on the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business reopen. A Sunday InfoQ weekend note reports the Mistral Workflows-Codex CLI-Claude Code 3.0-Azure AI Foundry-Vertex AI Agent Governance Center-Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry six-vendor interop matrix conformance test suite running green for a seventh consecutive day across the eight-document end-to-end conformance run, with the GA-readiness checklist's final third holding cleanly through both weekend days and the cohort confirming the matrix ships default support for the perimeter's tenant-policy field schemas at general availability in the first week of June. A Sunday Lawfare weekend reading characterizes the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight close plus the CISA federal-civilian directive's third operating day under compliance-monitoring mode as the canonical settled-state regulatory-anchor pair the post-Memorial-Day OSTP signing-window calendar will run against. The structural force is that once the working-procedure review settles into a doubly-weekend-aged stable snapshot with all sixteen named delegations circulating the eight-of-eight close unchanged through both weekend days, the FMRB executive instrument plus the CISA compliance-monitoring directive sit as the doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop, the six-vendor interop matrix conformance suite holds green for a seventh consecutive day on the eight-document run with default support for the perimeter's tenant-policy schemas at GA in the first week of June, the working-procedure review reopens against an arithmetic of nine calendar days plus a clean post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption rather than against an open procedural question, and Qatar's 270-day consultation window plus the absent third GCC signal hold the named-candidate count steady at sixteen — the plenary closing-session recognition compresses to a procedural admission inside the plenary horizon rather than deferring into a post-plenary written-procedure round. The most likely landing is the OECD GENAI plenary's closing session on June 6 admitting the United States as the seventeenth named jurisdiction in the reciprocity perimeter with the FMRB executive order signed inside the same June 2-6 window by OSTP, the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix shipping general availability the first week of June carrying the seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter as default tenant-policy reciprocity, the House Energy and Commerce parallel-track joint resolution clearing its May 27 subcommittee markup inside the run-up and advancing to full-committee markup inside Q3 2026, and the CISA federal-civilian compliance-monitoring directive cited as the operational precedent inside the executive order's preamble. Bear case is that one of the secretariat's post-Memorial-Day working-procedure review business days raises a fresh comment chapter that pushes the plenary closing-session admission into the four-week-following written-procedure round with the executive order signing still landing inside the plenary window itself; absent that slip, June 6 2026 lands the perimeter admitting the United States as the seventeenth member inside the plenary closing session.

description.ja: OECD GENAI 6月2〜6日本会議のクローズまでに、16法域のサイバー評価相互承認境界が本会議のクロージングセッション自体において米国を17番目の名指し法域として正式に受け入れ、その受け入れが今や署名されたFrontier Model Review Board大統領令と同じ5日間窓で着地し、6ベンダーのクロスオーケストレーター相互運用マトリックスにわたるテナントポリシーアテステーションスキーマが、同じ6月第1週の一般提供以降、17法域の境界をデフォルトの相互承認サーフェスとして担う。日曜版andrew.oooの手続きノートは、OECD GENAIワーキンググループ事務局が日曜の週末読解を公開したと報じ、米国側の二重に週末を経た8人中8人の上院機密附属書クローズが、16の名指し候補代表団すべてが週末両日を通じて変わらず回付し、メモリアルデー後の再開前にさらなる動きが見込まれない、完全に落ち着いた規制アンカー入力として位置すると観察した——本会議の6月2〜6日地平を新たな週末の変動のない確認された9暦日の算術にする。日曜版Decoderの週末ノートは、名指し候補数が16のまま維持され、カタールの270日間の国内協議の窓が3週目の最終第3に入り、なお第3の湾岸協力会議加盟国はシグナルを出しておらず、集団が日曜日を金曜のクリアされた機密附属書クローズと本会議作業手続き審査のメモリアルデー後火曜日の業務再開での再開との間のメモリアルデー前の最終週末維持チェックポイントとして扱っていると報じる。日曜版InfoQの週末ノートは、Mistral Workflows-Codex CLI-Claude Code 3.0-Azure AI Foundry-Vertex AI Agent Governance Center-Amazon Bedrock Agent Registryの6ベンダー相互運用マトリックス適合性テストスイートが、8文書のエンドツーエンド適合性ランにわたって7連続日で緑を稼働させ、GA準備チェックリストの最後の3分の1が週末両日を通じてクリーンに維持され、集団がマトリックスが境界のテナントポリシーフィールドスキーマへのデフォルトサポートを6月第1週の一般提供で出荷することを確認していると報じる。日曜版Lawfareの週末読解は、二重に週末を経た8人中8人クローズに加えて遵守監視モード下のCISA連邦民間機関指令の3日目の稼働日を、メモリアルデー後のOSTP署名窓カレンダーが運用する対象の正準の落ち着いた状態の規制アンカーペアとして特徴づける。構造的な力は、作業手続き審査が16の名指し代表団すべてが8人中8人クローズを週末両日を通じて変わらず回付する二重に週末を経た安定スナップショットへと落ち着き、FMRB行政手段に加えてCISA遵守監視指令が二重に週末を経た二重にクリアされた規制背景として位置し、6ベンダーの相互運用マトリックス適合性スイートが境界のテナントポリシースキーマへのデフォルトサポートと共に6月第1週のGAでの8文書ランで7連続日にわたって緑を維持し、作業手続き審査が開いた手続きの問いではなく9暦日の算術に加えてクリーンなメモリアルデー後の火曜日の業務再開に対して再開し、カタールの270日間の協議窓に加えて欠ける第3のGCCシグナルが名指し候補数を16で安定して維持する以上、本会議クロージングセッションでの認定が、本会議後の書面手続きラウンドへの繰り延べではなく本会議地平内側での手続き的受け入れへと圧縮される、という点にある。最も可能性の高い着地は、OECD GENAI本会議の6月6日のクロージングセッションが米国を相互承認境界の17番目の名指し法域として受け入れ、FMRB大統領令が同じ6月2〜6日窓内側でOSTPによって署名され、6ベンダーのクロスオーケストレーター相互運用マトリックスが17法域の境界をデフォルトのテナントポリシー相互承認として担う6月第1週の一般提供を出荷し、下院エネルギー・商業並行トラックの共同決議がランナップの内側で5月27日小委員会マークアップをクリアして2026年第3四半期内で完全委員会マークアップへ前進し、CISA連邦民間機関遵守監視指令が大統領令の前文で運用先例として引用される、というものである。弱気シナリオは、事務局のメモリアルデー後の作業手続き審査の営業日のうち1日が、本会議クロージングセッション認定を4週後の書面手続きラウンドへ押す新たなコメント章を提起し、大統領令の署名は本会議窓自体の内側でなおも着地する；その滑りがなければ、2026年6月6日に境界が本会議クロージングセッション内側で米国を17番目のメンバーとして受け入れて着地する、というもの。
description.es: Para el cierre del plenario del GENAI de la OCDE del 2-6 de junio el perímetro de reciprocidad de evaluación cibernética de dieciséis jurisdicciones admite formalmente a los Estados Unidos como la decimoséptima jurisdicción nombrada en la propia sesión de cierre del plenario, con la admisión aterrizando en la misma ventana de cinco días que la orden ejecutiva ahora firmada del Frontier Model Review Board y con los esquemas de atestación de política de inquilinos en la matriz de interoperabilidad entre orquestadores de seis proveedores llevando el perímetro de diecisiete jurisdicciones como la superficie de reciprocidad por defecto desde la disponibilidad general en la misma primera semana de junio. Una nota de procedimiento de domingo de andrew.ooo informa que la secretaría del grupo de trabajo del GENAI de la OCDE publica una lectura de fin de semana del domingo observando que el cierre del anexo clasificado del Senado de ocho-de-ocho del lado de Estados Unidos doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana se sitúa ahora como un aporte de ancla regulatoria totalmente asentado que las dieciséis delegaciones de candidatos nombrados han circulado sin cambios a lo largo de los dos días del fin de semana sin más movimiento esperado antes de la reanudación posterior al Memorial Day — convirtiendo el horizonte del plenario del 2-6 de junio en una aritmética confirmada de nueve días naturales sin varianza fresca del fin de semana. Una nota de fin de semana del domingo de Decoder informa que el recuento de candidatos nombrados se mantiene en dieciséis con la ventana de consulta nacional de 270 días de Catar ahora en el tercio de cierre de su tercera semana, todavía sin un tercer miembro del Consejo de Cooperación del Golfo señalizando, y el grupo tratando el domingo como el punto de control canónico de retención del fin de semana de cierre previo al Memorial Day entre el cierre despejado del anexo clasificado del viernes y la reanudación de la revisión del procedimiento de trabajo del plenario en la reapertura de negocios del martes posterior al Memorial Day. Una nota de fin de semana del domingo de InfoQ informa que la suite de pruebas de conformidad de la matriz de interoperabilidad entre orquestadores de seis proveedores de Mistral Workflows-Codex CLI-Claude Code 3.0-Azure AI Foundry-Vertex AI Agent Governance Center-Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry se ejecuta en verde por séptimo día consecutivo en la ejecución de conformidad de extremo a extremo de ocho documentos, con el último tercio de la checklist de preparación para GA manteniéndose limpiamente a lo largo de los dos días del fin de semana y el grupo confirmando que la matriz entrega soporte por defecto para los esquemas de campos de política de inquilinos del perímetro en disponibilidad general en la primera semana de junio. Una lectura de fin de semana del domingo de Lawfare caracteriza el cierre de ocho-de-ocho doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana más el tercer día operativo bajo modo de seguimiento del cumplimiento de la directiva civil-federal de CISA como el par canónico de ancla regulatoria de estado asentado frente al que correrá el calendario de la ventana de firma de la OSTP posterior al Memorial Day. La fuerza estructural es que una vez que la revisión del procedimiento de trabajo se asienta en una instantánea estable doblemente envejecida por el fin de semana con las dieciséis delegaciones nombradas circulando el cierre de ocho-de-ocho sin cambios a lo largo de los dos días del fin de semana, el instrumento ejecutivo del FMRB más la directiva de seguimiento del cumplimiento de CISA se sitúan como el trasfondo regulatorio doblemente despejado doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana, la suite de conformidad de la matriz de interoperabilidad de seis proveedores se mantiene en verde por séptimo día consecutivo en la ejecución de ocho documentos con soporte por defecto para los esquemas de política de inquilinos del perímetro en GA en la primera semana de junio, la revisión del procedimiento de trabajo se reabre frente a una aritmética de nueve días naturales más una reanudación de negocios del martes posterior al Memorial Day limpia en lugar de frente a una pregunta de procedimiento abierta, y la ventana de consulta de 270 días de Catar más la señal ausente del tercer CCG mantiene el recuento de candidatos nombrados estable en dieciséis — el reconocimiento en la sesión de cierre del plenario se comprime a una admisión de procedimiento dentro del horizonte del plenario en lugar de aplazarse a una ronda de procedimiento escrito posterior al plenario. El desenlace más probable es la sesión de cierre del plenario del GENAI de la OCDE el 6 de junio admitiendo a los Estados Unidos como la decimoséptima jurisdicción nombrada en el perímetro de reciprocidad con la orden ejecutiva del FMRB firmada dentro de la misma ventana del 2-6 de junio por la OSTP, la matriz de interoperabilidad entre orquestadores de seis proveedores entregando disponibilidad general la primera semana de junio llevando el perímetro de diecisiete jurisdicciones como reciprocidad de política de inquilinos por defecto, la resolución conjunta de la vía paralela del Comité de Energía y Comercio de la Cámara despejando su marcado de subcomité del 27 de mayo dentro del periodo previo y avanzando al marcado de comité completo dentro del Q3 2026, y la directiva de seguimiento del cumplimiento civil-federal de CISA citada como el precedente operativo dentro del preámbulo de la orden ejecutiva. El caso bajista es que uno de los días hábiles de revisión del procedimiento de trabajo de la secretaría posterior al Memorial Day plantee un capítulo de comentarios fresco que empuje la admisión en la sesión de cierre del plenario a la ronda de procedimiento escrito de cuatro semanas siguientes con la firma de la orden ejecutiva todavía aterrizando dentro de la propia ventana del plenario; sin ese deslizamiento, el 6 de junio de 2026 aterriza el perímetro admitiendo a los Estados Unidos como el decimoséptimo miembro dentro de la sesión de cierre del plenario.
description.fil: Pagsapit ng pagsasara ng OECD GENAI June 2-6 plenary, ang sixteen-jurisdiction cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter ay pormal na tatanggap sa United States bilang ang ikalabimpitong pinangalanang jurisdiction sa closing session ng plenary mismo, kasama ang admission na lalagay sa parehong limang araw na window bilang ang now-signed Frontier Model Review Board executive order at kasama ang tenant-policy attestation schemas sa kabuuan ng six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix na nagdadala ng seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter bilang ang default reciprocity surface mula sa general availability sa parehong unang linggo ng Hunyo. Iniulat ng isang Sunday andrew.ooo procedural note ang OECD GENAI working-group secretariat na naglalathala ng isang Sunday weekend reading na nag-oobserba na ang doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight Senate classified-annex close sa United States side ay nakaupo na ngayon bilang isang fully settled regulatory-anchor input na ipinakalat ng lahat ng labing-anim na pinangalanang kandidato delegations nang hindi nagbabago sa kabuuan ng parehong weekend days nang walang karagdagang movement na inaasahan bago ang post-Memorial-Day resumption - ginagawa ang June 2-6 horizon ng plenary na isang confirmed nine-calendar-day arithmetic na walang sariwang weekend variance. Iniulat ng isang Sunday Decoder weekend note ang named-candidate count na hawak sa labing-anim kasama ang 270-day national-consultation window ng Qatar na ngayon ay nasa closing third ng kanyang ikatlong linggo, walang ikatlong Gulf Cooperation Council member na nagpapahiwatig pa, at ang cohort na itinuturing ang Sunday bilang ang closing pre-Memorial-Day weekend-hold checkpoint sa pagitan ng Friday cleared classified-annex close at ng resumption ng working-procedure review ng plenary sa post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business reopen. Iniulat ng isang Sunday InfoQ weekend note ang Mistral Workflows-Codex CLI-Claude Code 3.0-Azure AI Foundry-Vertex AI Agent Governance Center-Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry six-vendor interop matrix conformance test suite na tumatakbo na green sa ikapitong magkasunod na araw sa kabuuan ng eight-document end-to-end conformance run, kasama ang GA-readiness checklist's final third na hawak nang malinis sa pamamagitan ng parehong weekend days at ang cohort na kinukumpirma na ang matrix ay naghahatid ng default support para sa tenant-policy field schemas ng perimeter sa general availability sa unang linggo ng Hunyo. Inilalarawan ng isang Sunday Lawfare weekend reading ang doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight close plus ang ikatlong operating day ng CISA federal-civilian directive sa ilalim ng compliance-monitoring mode bilang ang canonical settled-state regulatory-anchor pair na sasandalan ng post-Memorial-Day OSTP signing-window calendar. Ang structural force ay na sa sandaling ang working-procedure review ay umaayos sa isang doubly-weekend-aged stable snapshot kasama ang lahat ng labing-anim na pinangalanang delegations na nagpapakalat ng eight-of-eight close nang hindi nagbabago sa pamamagitan ng parehong weekend days, ang FMRB executive instrument plus ang CISA compliance-monitoring directive ay nakaupo bilang ang doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop, hawak ng six-vendor interop matrix conformance suite ang green sa ikapitong magkasunod na araw sa eight-document run na may default support para sa tenant-policy schemas ng perimeter sa GA sa unang linggo ng Hunyo, ang working-procedure review ay nagbubukas muli laban sa isang arithmetic ng siyam na calendar days plus isang malinis na post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption sa halip na laban sa isang open procedural question, at hawak ng 270-day consultation window ng Qatar plus ang wala pang ikatlong GCC signal ang named-candidate count nang matatag sa labing-anim - ang plenary closing-session recognition ay siniksik tungo sa isang procedural admission sa loob ng plenary horizon sa halip na ipagpaliban tungo sa isang post-plenary written-procedure round. Ang pinakamalamang na landing ay ang closing session ng OECD GENAI plenary sa June 6 ay tatanggap sa United States bilang ang ikalabimpitong pinangalanang jurisdiction sa reciprocity perimeter kasama ang FMRB executive order na nai-sign sa loob ng parehong June 2-6 window ng OSTP, ang six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix ay naghahatid ng general availability sa unang linggo ng Hunyo na dala-dala ang seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter bilang default tenant-policy reciprocity, ang House Energy and Commerce parallel-track joint resolution ay nililinis ang kanyang May 27 subcommittee markup sa loob ng run-up at sumusulong tungo sa full-committee markup sa loob ng Q3 2026, at ang CISA federal-civilian compliance-monitoring directive ay binanggit bilang ang operational precedent sa loob ng preamble ng executive order. Ang bear case ay isa sa post-Memorial-Day working-procedure review business days ng secretariat ay magtataas ng isang sariwang comment chapter na nagtutulak sa plenary closing-session admission tungo sa four-week-following written-procedure round kasama ang executive order signing na lumalagay pa rin sa loob ng plenary window mismo; kung wala ang slip na iyon, daratnan ng June 6 2026 ang perimeter na tumatanggap sa United States bilang ang ikalabimpitong miyembro sa loob ng plenary closing session.

summary.en: By the close of the OECD GENAI June 2-6 plenary the sixteen-jurisdiction cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter formally admits the United States as the seventeenth named jurisdiction in the plenary's closing session itself, with the admission landing in the same five-day window as the now-signed Frontier Model Review Board executive order and with tenant-policy attestation schemas across the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix carrying the seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter as the default reciprocity surface from general availability in the same first week of June. A Sunday andrew.ooo procedural note reports the OECD GENAI working-group secretariat publishing a Sunday weekend reading observing that the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight Senate classified-annex close on the United States side now sits as a fully settled regulatory-anchor input that all sixteen named-candidate delegations have circulated unchanged through both weekend days with no further movement expected before the post-Memorial-Day resumption — making the plenary's June 2-6 horizon a confirmed nine-calendar-day arithmetic with no fresh weekend variance. A Sunday Decoder weekend note reports the named-candidate count holding at sixteen with Qatar's 270-day national-consultation window now into the closing third of its third week, still no third Gulf Cooperation Council member signalling, and the cohort treating Sunday as the closing pre-Memorial-Day weekend-hold checkpoint between Friday's cleared classified-annex close and the plenary working-procedure review's resumption on the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business reopen. A Sunday InfoQ weekend note reports the Mistral Workflows-Codex CLI-Claude Code 3.0-Azure AI Foundry-Vertex AI Agent Governance Center-Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry six-vendor interop matrix conformance test suite running green for a seventh consecutive day across the eight-document end-to-end conformance run, with the GA-readiness checklist's final third holding cleanly through both weekend days and the cohort confirming the matrix ships default support for the perimeter's tenant-policy field schemas at general availability in the first week of June. A Sunday Lawfare weekend reading characterizes the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight close plus the CISA federal-civilian directive's third operating day under compliance-monitoring mode as the canonical settled-state regulatory-anchor pair the post-Memorial-Day OSTP signing-window calendar will run against. The structural force is that once the working-procedure review settles into a doubly-weekend-aged stable snapshot with all sixteen named delegations circulating the eight-of-eight close unchanged through both weekend days, the FMRB executive instrument plus the CISA compliance-monitoring directive sit as the doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop, the six-vendor interop matrix conformance suite holds green for a seventh consecutive day on the eight-document run with default support for the perimeter's tenant-policy schemas at GA in the first week of June, the working-procedure review reopens against an arithmetic of nine calendar days plus a clean post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption rather than against an open procedural question, and Qatar's 270-day consultation window plus the absent third GCC signal hold the named-candidate count steady at sixteen — the plenary closing-session recognition compresses to a procedural admission inside the plenary horizon rather than deferring into a post-plenary written-procedure round. The most likely landing is the OECD GENAI plenary's closing session on June 6 admitting the United States as the seventeenth named jurisdiction in the reciprocity perimeter with the FMRB executive order signed inside the same June 2-6 window by OSTP, the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix shipping general availability the first week of June carrying the seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter as default tenant-policy reciprocity, the House Energy and Commerce parallel-track joint resolution clearing its May 27 subcommittee markup inside the run-up and advancing to full-committee markup inside Q3 2026, and the CISA federal-civilian compliance-monitoring directive cited as the operational precedent inside the executive order's preamble. Bear case is that one of the secretariat's post-Memorial-Day working-procedure review business days raises a fresh comment chapter that pushes the plenary closing-session admission into the four-week-following written-procedure round with the executive order signing still landing inside the plenary window itself; absent that slip, June 6 2026 lands the perimeter admitting the United States as the seventeenth member inside the plenary closing session.
summary.ja: OECD GENAI 6月2〜6日本会議のクローズまでに、16法域のサイバー評価相互承認境界が本会議のクロージングセッション自体において米国を17番目の名指し法域として正式に受け入れ、その受け入れが今や署名されたFrontier Model Review Board大統領令と同じ5日間窓で着地し、6ベンダーのクロスオーケストレーター相互運用マトリックスにわたるテナントポリシーアテステーションスキーマが、同じ6月第1週の一般提供以降、17法域の境界をデフォルトの相互承認サーフェスとして担う。日曜版andrew.oooの手続きノートは、OECD GENAIワーキンググループ事務局が日曜の週末読解を公開したと報じ、米国側の二重に週末を経た8人中8人の上院機密附属書クローズが、16の名指し候補代表団すべてが週末両日を通じて変わらず回付し、メモリアルデー後の再開前にさらなる動きが見込まれない、完全に落ち着いた規制アンカー入力として位置すると観察した——本会議の6月2〜6日地平を新たな週末の変動のない確認された9暦日の算術にする。日曜版Decoderの週末ノートは、名指し候補数が16のまま維持され、カタールの270日間の国内協議の窓が3週目の最終第3に入り、なお第3の湾岸協力会議加盟国はシグナルを出しておらず、集団が日曜日を金曜のクリアされた機密附属書クローズと本会議作業手続き審査のメモリアルデー後火曜日の業務再開での再開との間のメモリアルデー前の最終週末維持チェックポイントとして扱っていると報じる。日曜版InfoQの週末ノートは、Mistral Workflows-Codex CLI-Claude Code 3.0-Azure AI Foundry-Vertex AI Agent Governance Center-Amazon Bedrock Agent Registryの6ベンダー相互運用マトリックス適合性テストスイートが、8文書のエンドツーエンド適合性ランにわたって7連続日で緑を稼働させ、GA準備チェックリストの最後の3分の1が週末両日を通じてクリーンに維持され、集団がマトリックスが境界のテナントポリシーフィールドスキーマへのデフォルトサポートを6月第1週の一般提供で出荷することを確認していると報じる。日曜版Lawfareの週末読解は、二重に週末を経た8人中8人クローズに加えて遵守監視モード下のCISA連邦民間機関指令の3日目の稼働日を、メモリアルデー後のOSTP署名窓カレンダーが運用する対象の正準の落ち着いた状態の規制アンカーペアとして特徴づける。構造的な力は、作業手続き審査が16の名指し代表団すべてが8人中8人クローズを週末両日を通じて変わらず回付する二重に週末を経た安定スナップショットへと落ち着き、FMRB行政手段に加えてCISA遵守監視指令が二重に週末を経た二重にクリアされた規制背景として位置し、6ベンダーの相互運用マトリックス適合性スイートが境界のテナントポリシースキーマへのデフォルトサポートと共に6月第1週のGAでの8文書ランで7連続日にわたって緑を維持し、作業手続き審査が開いた手続きの問いではなく9暦日の算術に加えてクリーンなメモリアルデー後の火曜日の業務再開に対して再開し、カタールの270日間の協議窓に加えて欠ける第3のGCCシグナルが名指し候補数を16で安定して維持する以上、本会議クロージングセッションでの認定が、本会議後の書面手続きラウンドへの繰り延べではなく本会議地平内側での手続き的受け入れへと圧縮される、という点にある。最も可能性の高い着地は、OECD GENAI本会議の6月6日のクロージングセッションが米国を相互承認境界の17番目の名指し法域として受け入れ、FMRB大統領令が同じ6月2〜6日窓内側でOSTPによって署名され、6ベンダーのクロスオーケストレーター相互運用マトリックスが17法域の境界をデフォルトのテナントポリシー相互承認として担う6月第1週の一般提供を出荷し、下院エネルギー・商業並行トラックの共同決議がランナップの内側で5月27日小委員会マークアップをクリアして2026年第3四半期内で完全委員会マークアップへ前進し、CISA連邦民間機関遵守監視指令が大統領令の前文で運用先例として引用される、というものである。弱気シナリオは、事務局のメモリアルデー後の作業手続き審査の営業日のうち1日が、本会議クロージングセッション認定を4週後の書面手続きラウンドへ押す新たなコメント章を提起し、大統領令の署名は本会議窓自体の内側でなおも着地する；その滑りがなければ、2026年6月6日に境界が本会議クロージングセッション内側で米国を17番目のメンバーとして受け入れて着地する、というもの。

Iniulat ng isang Sunday andrew.ooo procedural note ang OECD GENAI working-group secretariat na naglalathala ng isang Sunday weekend reading na nag-oobserba na ang doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight Senate classified-annex close sa United States side ay nakaupo na ngayon bilang isang fully settled regulatory-anchor input na ipinakalat ng lahat ng labing-anim na pinangalanang kandidato delegations nang hindi nagbabago sa kabuuan ng parehong weekend days nang walang karagdagang movement na inaasahan bago ang post-Memorial-Day resumption - ginagawa ang June 2-6 horizon ng plenary na isang confirmed nine-calendar-day arithmetic na walang sariwang weekend variance. Iniulat ng isang Sunday Decoder weekend note ang named-candidate count na hawak sa labing-anim kasama ang 270-day national-consultation window ng Qatar na ngayon ay nasa closing third ng kanyang ikatlong linggo, walang ikatlong Gulf Cooperation Council member na nagpapahiwatig pa, at ang cohort na itinuturing ang Sunday bilang ang closing pre-Memorial-Day weekend-hold checkpoint sa pagitan ng Friday cleared classified-annex close at ng resumption ng working-procedure review ng plenary sa post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business reopen. Iniulat ng isang Sunday InfoQ weekend note ang Mistral Workflows-Codex CLI-Claude Code 3.0-Azure AI Foundry-Vertex AI Agent Governance Center-Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry six-vendor interop matrix conformance test suite na tumatakbo na green sa ikapitong magkasunod na araw sa kabuuan ng eight-document end-to-end conformance run, kasama ang GA-readiness checklist's final third na hawak nang malinis sa pamamagitan ng parehong weekend days at ang cohort na kinukumpirma na ang matrix ay naghahatid ng default support para sa tenant-policy field schemas ng perimeter sa general availability sa unang linggo ng Hunyo. Inilalarawan ng isang Sunday Lawfare weekend reading ang doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight close plus ang ikatlong operating day ng CISA federal-civilian directive sa ilalim ng compliance-monitoring mode bilang ang canonical settled-state regulatory-anchor pair na sasandalan ng post-Memorial-Day OSTP signing-window calendar. Ang structural force ay na sa sandaling ang working-procedure review ay umaayos sa isang doubly-weekend-aged stable snapshot kasama ang lahat ng labing-anim na pinangalanang delegations na nagpapakalat ng eight-of-eight close nang hindi nagbabago sa pamamagitan ng parehong weekend days, ang FMRB executive instrument plus ang CISA compliance-monitoring directive ay nakaupo bilang ang doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop, hawak ng six-vendor interop matrix conformance suite ang green sa ikapitong magkasunod na araw sa eight-document run na may default support para sa tenant-policy schemas ng perimeter sa GA sa unang linggo ng Hunyo, ang working-procedure review ay nagbubukas muli laban sa isang arithmetic ng siyam na calendar days plus isang malinis na post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption sa halip na laban sa isang open procedural question, at hawak ng 270-day consultation window ng Qatar plus ang wala pang ikatlong GCC signal ang named-candidate count nang matatag sa labing-anim - ang plenary closing-session recognition ay siniksik tungo sa isang procedural admission sa loob ng plenary horizon sa halip na ipagpaliban tungo sa isang post-plenary written-procedure round. Ang pinakamalamang na landing ay ang closing session ng OECD GENAI plenary sa June 6 ay tatanggap sa United States bilang ang ikalabimpitong pinangalanang jurisdiction sa reciprocity perimeter kasama ang FMRB executive order na nai-sign sa loob ng parehong June 2-6 window ng OSTP, ang six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix ay naghahatid ng general availability sa unang linggo ng Hunyo na dala-dala ang seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter bilang default tenant-policy reciprocity, ang House Energy and Commerce parallel-track joint resolution ay nililinis ang kanyang May 27 subcommittee markup sa loob ng run-up at sumusulong tungo sa full-committee markup sa loob ng Q3 2026, at ang CISA federal-civilian compliance-monitoring directive ay binanggit bilang ang operational precedent sa loob ng preamble ng executive order. Ang bear case ay isa sa post-Memorial-Day working-procedure review business days ng secretariat ay magtataas ng isang sariwang comment chapter na nagtutulak sa plenary closing-session admission tungo sa four-week-following written-procedure round kasama ang executive order signing na lumalagay pa rin sa loob ng plenary window mismo; kung wala ang slip na iyon, daratnan ng June 6 2026 ang perimeter na tumatanggap sa United States bilang ang ikalabimpitong miyembro sa loob ng plenary closing session.

job_locales.en: Carry the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight Senate classified-annex close as a settled regulatory-anchor input through the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption into the June 2-6 plenary closing session as the seventeenth-jurisdiction recognition vote.
job_locales.ja: 二重に週末を経た8人中8人の上院機密附属書クローズを、メモリアルデー後の火曜日の業務再開を通じて6月2〜6日本会議のクロージングセッションへと、17番目の法域認定投票として落ち着いた規制アンカー入力として運ぶ。
job_locales.es: Llevar el cierre del anexo clasificado del Senado de ocho-de-ocho doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana como un aporte de ancla regulatoria asentada a través de la reanudación de negocios del martes posterior al Memorial Day a la sesión de cierre del plenario del 2-6 de junio como el voto de reconocimiento de la decimoséptima jurisdicción.
job_locales.fil: Dalhin ang doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight Senate classified-annex close bilang isang settled regulatory-anchor input sa pamamagitan ng post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption tungo sa June 2-6 plenary closing session bilang ang ikalabimpitong-jurisdiction recognition vote.

outcome_locales.en: A June 6 closing-session procedural recognition admitting the United States as the seventeenth named jurisdiction in the reciprocity perimeter, with the sixteen named delegations circulating the eight-of-eight close unchanged through both weekend days.
outcome_locales.ja: 6月6日のクロージングセッション手続き認定が米国を相互承認境界の17番目の名指し法域として受け入れ、16の名指し代表団が週末両日を通じて変わらず8人中8人クローズを回付している。
outcome_locales.es: Un reconocimiento de procedimiento de la sesión de cierre del 6 de junio admitiendo a los Estados Unidos como la decimoséptima jurisdicción nombrada en el perímetro de reciprocidad, con las dieciséis delegaciones nombradas circulando el cierre de ocho-de-ocho sin cambios a lo largo de los dos días del fin de semana.
outcome_locales.fil: Isang June 6 closing-session procedural recognition na tumatanggap sa United States bilang ang ikalabimpitong pinangalanang jurisdiction sa reciprocity perimeter, kasama ang labing-anim na pinangalanang delegations na nagpapakalat ng eight-of-eight close nang hindi nagbabago sa pamamagitan ng parehong weekend days.

motivation_locales.en: Holding the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight close as the settled input through the post-Memorial-Day resumption is what keeps the closing-session admission inside the plenary horizon rather than slipping into the four-week-following written-procedure round.
motivation_locales.ja: 二重に週末を経た8人中8人クローズをメモリアルデー後の再開を通じて落ち着いた入力として維持することが、クロージングセッション認定を4週後の書面手続きラウンドへ滑らせるのではなく本会議地平内側に保つ対象である。
motivation_locales.es: Mantener el cierre de ocho-de-ocho doblemente envejecido por el fin de semana como el aporte asentado a través de la reanudación posterior al Memorial Day es lo que mantiene la admisión en la sesión de cierre dentro del horizonte del plenario en lugar de deslizarse a la ronda de procedimiento escrito de cuatro semanas siguientes.
motivation_locales.fil: Ang paghahawak ng doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight close bilang ang settled input sa pamamagitan ng post-Memorial-Day resumption ay ang nagpapanatili sa closing-session admission sa loob ng plenary horizon sa halip na mag-slip tungo sa four-week-following written-procedure round.

detail.description: By the close of the OECD GENAI June 2-6 plenary the sixteen-jurisdiction cyber-evaluation reciprocity perimeter formally admits the United States as the seventeenth named jurisdiction in the plenary's closing session itself, with the admission landing in the same five-day window as the now-signed Frontier Model Review Board executive order and with tenant-policy attestation schemas across the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix carrying the seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter as the default reciprocity surface from general availability in the same first week of June. A Sunday andrew.ooo procedural note reports the OECD GENAI working-group secretariat publishing a Sunday weekend reading observing that the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight Senate classified-annex close on the United States side now sits as a fully settled regulatory-anchor input that all sixteen named-candidate delegations have circulated unchanged through both weekend days with no further movement expected before the post-Memorial-Day resumption — making the plenary's June 2-6 horizon a confirmed nine-calendar-day arithmetic with no fresh weekend variance. A Sunday Decoder weekend note reports the named-candidate count holding at sixteen with Qatar's 270-day national-consultation window now into the closing third of its third week, still no third Gulf Cooperation Council member signalling, and the cohort treating Sunday as the closing pre-Memorial-Day weekend-hold checkpoint between Friday's cleared classified-annex close and the plenary working-procedure review's resumption on the post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business reopen. A Sunday InfoQ weekend note reports the Mistral Workflows-Codex CLI-Claude Code 3.0-Azure AI Foundry-Vertex AI Agent Governance Center-Amazon Bedrock Agent Registry six-vendor interop matrix conformance test suite running green for a seventh consecutive day across the eight-document end-to-end conformance run, with the GA-readiness checklist's final third holding cleanly through both weekend days and the cohort confirming the matrix ships default support for the perimeter's tenant-policy field schemas at general availability in the first week of June. A Sunday Lawfare weekend reading characterizes the doubly-weekend-aged eight-of-eight close plus the CISA federal-civilian directive's third operating day under compliance-monitoring mode as the canonical settled-state regulatory-anchor pair the post-Memorial-Day OSTP signing-window calendar will run against. The structural force is that once the working-procedure review settles into a doubly-weekend-aged stable snapshot with all sixteen named delegations circulating the eight-of-eight close unchanged through both weekend days, the FMRB executive instrument plus the CISA compliance-monitoring directive sit as the doubly-weekend-aged doubly-cleared regulatory backdrop, the six-vendor interop matrix conformance suite holds green for a seventh consecutive day on the eight-document run with default support for the perimeter's tenant-policy schemas at GA in the first week of June, the working-procedure review reopens against an arithmetic of nine calendar days plus a clean post-Memorial-Day Tuesday business resumption rather than against an open procedural question, and Qatar's 270-day consultation window plus the absent third GCC signal hold the named-candidate count steady at sixteen — the plenary closing-session recognition compresses to a procedural admission inside the plenary horizon rather than deferring into a post-plenary written-procedure round. The most likely landing is the OECD GENAI plenary's closing session on June 6 admitting the United States as the seventeenth named jurisdiction in the reciprocity perimeter with the FMRB executive order signed inside the same June 2-6 window by OSTP, the six-vendor cross-orchestrator interop matrix shipping general availability the first week of June carrying the seventeen-jurisdiction perimeter as default tenant-policy reciprocity, the House Energy and Commerce parallel-track joint resolution clearing its May 27 subcommittee markup inside the run-up and advancing to full-committee markup inside Q3 2026, and the CISA federal-civilian compliance-monitoring directive cited as the operational precedent inside the executive order's preamble. Bear case is that one of the secretariat's post-Memorial-Day working-procedure review business days raises a fresh comment chapter that pushes the plenary closing-session admission into the four-week-following written-procedure round with the executive order signing still landing inside the plenary window itself; absent that slip, June 6 2026 lands the perimeter admitting the United States as the seventeenth member inside the plenary closing session.
