text_locales.en: The Wednesday CVE-2026-46198 sits in the same MCP-server tool-call deserialization JSON-Schema validation gap class Trail of Bits surfaced in OpenAI Codex CLI on Tuesday. Anthropic’s patched v3.0.14 ships strict schema validation plus a runtime tool-call audit log matching the manifest-fetcher signature-verification surface, and the 48-hour force-roll establishes the binary operator posture the signed-by-default landing depends on.
text_locales.ja: 水曜日のCVE-2026-46198は、Trail of Bitsが火曜日にOpenAI Codex CLIで浮上させたのと同じMCPサーバー・ツール呼び出し逆シリアル化JSON-Schema検証ギャップ・クラスに座る。Anthropicのパッチ済みv3.0.14は、マニフェスト・フェッチャー署名検証表面と一致する厳格なスキーマ検証加えてランタイムのツール呼び出し監査ログを出荷し、48時間強制ロールは、デフォルト署名済み着地が依存するバイナリーの運用者スタンスを確立する。
text_locales.es: El CVE-2026-46198 del miércoles se sitúa en la misma clase de brecha de validación JSON-Schema de deserialización de llamadas a herramientas del servidor MCP que Trail of Bits expuso en OpenAI Codex CLI el martes. El v3.0.14 parcheado de Anthropic envía validación estricta de esquema más un registro de auditoría de llamadas a herramientas en tiempo de ejecución que coincide con la superficie de verificación de firma del recuperador de manifiestos, y el force-roll de 48 horas establece la postura binaria de operador de la que depende el aterrizaje firmado-por-defecto.
text_locales.fil: Ang Miyerkules CVE-2026-46198 ay nakaupo sa parehong MCP-server tool-call deserialization JSON-Schema validation gap class na ibinunyag ng Trail of Bits sa OpenAI Codex CLI ng Martes. Nagpapadala ang patched v3.0.14 ng Anthropic ng strict schema validation kasama ang runtime tool-call audit log na tumutugma sa manifest-fetcher signature-verification surface, at itinatatag ng 48-hour force-roll ang binary operator posture kung saan susunod ang signed-by-default landing.

bridges.text: OpenAI's v3.1.10 patch — strict schema validation plus a runtime tool-call audit log shipped to close CVE-2026-46127 — is the exact corrective surface the agent-framework loaders signed-checkpoint plus manifest mode prediction (May 11) anticipated, and the NIST agent-loader subcategory reclassification gives the cohort a regulatory category to standardize on.

text_locales.en: OpenAI's v3.1.10 patch — strict schema validation plus a runtime tool-call audit log shipped to close CVE-2026-46127 — is the exact corrective surface the agent-framework loaders signed-checkpoint plus manifest mode prediction (May 11) anticipated, and the NIST agent-loader subcategory reclassification gives the cohort a regulatory category to standardize on.
text_locales.ja: OpenAIのv3.1.10パッチ——CVE-2026-46127を閉鎖するために出荷された厳格なスキーマ検証とランタイムのツール呼び出し監査ログ——は、エージェント・フレームワーク・ローダーの署名付きチェックポイント加えてマニフェスト・モード予想(5月11日)が予期していたコーレクティブなサーフェスそのものであり、NISTのエージェント・ローダー・サブカテゴリ再分類は、集団が標準化する規制上のカテゴリを与える。
text_locales.es: El parche v3.1.10 de OpenAI - validacion de esquema estricta mas un registro de auditoria de llamadas a herramienta en tiempo de ejecucion enviado para cerrar CVE-2026-46127 - es la superficie correctiva exacta que la prediccion de loaders de framework de agente envian modo checkpoint-firmado mas manifest (11 de mayo) anticipo, y la reclasificacion bajo la subcategoria agent-loader de NIST da a la cohorte una categoria regulatoria sobre la cual estandarizar.
text_locales.fil: Ang v3.1.10 patch ng OpenAI — strict schema validation plus isang runtime tool-call audit log na ipinadala upang isara ang CVE-2026-46127 — ay ang eksaktong corrective surface na inaasahan ng prediksyon ukol sa agent-framework loaders signed-checkpoint plus manifest mode (May 11), at ang reclassification ng NIST agent-loader subcategory ay nagbibigay sa cohort ng isang regulatory category na pwedeng pagbabasehan.

bridges.text: The LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI maintainer cohort held its coordinated mid-June default-shipment commitment covering load-time signed-checkpoint and manifest-allowlist with no weekend revision, and the DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic-Microsoft author group froze its consolidated reference-implementation index ahead of those releases. This is exactly the signed-checkpoint-and-manifest default the prediction names becoming the documented loader mode.

text_locales.en: The LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI maintainer cohort held its coordinated mid-June default-shipment commitment covering load-time signed-checkpoint and manifest-allowlist with no weekend revision, and the DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic-Microsoft author group froze its consolidated reference-implementation index ahead of those releases. This is exactly the signed-checkpoint-and-manifest default the prediction names becoming the documented loader mode.
text_locales.ja: LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI、Haystack、Pydantic AIのメンテナー集団は、ロード時の署名済みチェックポイントとマニフェスト許可リストをカバーする協調的な6月中旬のデフォルト出荷コミットメントを週末の改定なしで保ち、DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic-Microsoftの著者グループは、それらのリリースに先立って統合された参照実装インデックスを凍結した。これはまさに、予測が名指しする署名済みチェックポイントとマニフェストのデフォルトが文書化されたローダーモードになることである。
text_locales.es: El grupo de mantenedores de LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack y Pydantic AI mantuvo su compromiso coordinado de entrega por defecto de mediados de junio que cubre el checkpoint firmado en tiempo de carga y la lista de permitidos de manifiesto sin revisión durante el fin de semana, y el grupo de autores de DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic-Microsoft congeló su índice de implementación de referencia consolidado antes de esas publicaciones. Esto es exactamente el valor por defecto de checkpoint firmado y manifiesto que la predicción nombra convirtiéndose en el modo de cargador documentado.
text_locales.fil: Hawak ng LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, at Pydantic AI maintainer cohort ang koordinadong mid-June default-shipment commitment nito na sumasaklaw sa load-time signed-checkpoint at manifest-allowlist na walang pagrerebisa sa katapusan ng linggo, at na-freeze ng DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic-Microsoft author group ang konsolidadong reference-implementation index nito bago ang mga release na iyon. Ito mismo ang signed-checkpoint-and-manifest default na pinangalanan ng hula na nagiging documented loader mode.

text_locales.ja: Simon Willisonの土曜日のノートは、テナントごとのアテステーションログ監査証跡が、ゲート付き64テナントすべてにわたり55秒未満のテナント横断の構成的安全性チェックを伴って決定論的に再現することを示し、新たなarxiv論文が検証可能なテナントごとの能力アテステーションのラインを拡張する——企業顧問弁護士がマスターサービス契約のライダーを固定する、引用可能な安全性定理の基盤である。
text_locales.es: La nota del sábado de Simon Willison muestra el rastro de auditoría de registro de atestación por inquilino reproduciéndose de forma determinista a través de los 64 inquilinos restringidos con verificaciones de seguridad composicional entre inquilinos en menos de 55 segundos, y un nuevo artículo de arxiv extiende la línea de Verifiable Per-Tenant Capability Attestation — el sustrato de teoremas de seguridad citable al que el asesor jurídico corporativo anclaría una cláusula adicional de contrato marco de servicios.
text_locales.fil: Ipinapakita ng Saturday note ni Simon Willison na ang per-tenant attestation-log audit trail ay deterministikong muling lumilikha sa lahat ng 64 gated tenant na may cross-tenant compositional safety checks sa loob ng wala pang 55 segundo, at pinapalawig ng isang bagong arxiv paper ang Verifiable Per-Tenant Capability Attestation line — ang nababanggit na safety-theorem substrate na pag-aanchoran ng corporate counsel sa isang master-services-agreement rider.

bridges.text: Anthropic's operations summary lifted the Mythos-Preview gated cohort to 64 enterprise tenants as Leonardo, Hensoldt, Kongsberg, and Patria signed the ethics-and-misuse rider, extending its reach across the Continental and Nordic defense base. The verification harness produced a repeatable per-tenant attestation audit trail at three-continent scale, strengthening the conditions the prediction rests on.

text_locales.en: Anthropic's operations summary lifted the Mythos-Preview gated cohort to 64 enterprise tenants as Leonardo, Hensoldt, Kongsberg, and Patria signed the ethics-and-misuse rider, extending its reach across the Continental and Nordic defense base. The verification harness produced a repeatable per-tenant attestation audit trail at three-continent scale, strengthening the conditions the prediction rests on.
text_locales.ja: Anthropicの運用サマリーは、Leonardo、Hensoldt、Kongsberg、Patriaが倫理・誤用ライダーに署名するなか、Mythos-Previewのゲート対象群を64企業テナントへと引き上げ、その及ぶ範囲を欧州大陸および北欧の防衛基盤へと拡張した。検証ハーネスは3大陸規模で再現可能なテナント別アテステーション監査証跡を生成し、予測が依拠する条件を強化した。
text_locales.es: El resumen de operaciones de Anthropic elevó el grupo restringido Mythos-Preview a 64 inquilinos empresariales cuando Leonardo, Hensoldt, Kongsberg y Patria firmaron la cláusula de ética y uso indebido, extendiendo su alcance a la base de defensa continental y nórdica. El arnés de verificación produjo un rastro de auditoría de atestación por inquilino repetible a escala de tres continentes, reforzando las condiciones sobre las que se apoya la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Inangat ng operations summary ng Anthropic ang Mythos-Preview gated cohort tungo sa 64 enterprise tenants habang pumirma ang Leonardo, Hensoldt, Kongsberg, at Patria sa ethics-and-misuse rider, na nagpapalawig sa abot nito sa buong Continental at Nordic defense base. Gumawa ang verification harness ng isang nauulit na per-tenant attestation audit trail sa three-continent scale, na nagpapatibay sa mga kondisyong pinagbabatayan ng prediction.

bridges.text: LangChain CVE-2026-44967 lands as the tenth agent-loader CVE with a same-day v0.3.7 patch plus paired backport advisories the NHS England blocklist references, while Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, and AutoGen maintainer teams publish coordinated Thursday commitments extending the mid-June default-shipment target to cover the paired four-surface delivery; the v3 joint preprint addendum from DeepMind, Meta AI, Anthropic, and Microsoft ships reference implementations in Python and Rust covering all ten CVE-pattern instances.

text_locales.en: LangChain CVE-2026-44967 lands as the tenth agent-loader CVE with a same-day v0.3.7 patch plus paired backport advisories the NHS England blocklist references, while Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, and AutoGen maintainer teams publish coordinated Thursday commitments extending the mid-June default-shipment target to cover the paired four-surface delivery; the v3 joint preprint addendum from DeepMind, Meta AI, Anthropic, and Microsoft ships reference implementations in Python and Rust covering all ten CVE-pattern instances.
text_locales.ja: LangChain CVE-2026-44967は、エージェントローダの10件目のCVEとして着地し、同日中のv0.3.7パッチとNHS Englandのブロックリストが参照するバックポート勧告を伴って公表された。Microsoft、LangChain、CrewAI、Pydantic AI、AutoGenの各メンテナーチームは木曜日に協調コミットメントを発表し、6月中旬の既定出荷目標を4サーフェス連動納入をカバーする範囲へ拡張した。DeepMind、Meta AI、Anthropic、Microsoftによるv3合同プレプリント追補は、PythonとRustの参照実装で10件のCVEパターン全インスタンスをカバーする実装を提供している。
text_locales.es: La extensión de tercera ola hacia GA del jueves por parte de OpenAI triplica la cobertura de nube soberana en Indo-Pacífico, de cuatro a seis regiones, en Azure más AWS Bedrock más Vertex de manera simultánea, citándose como esquema operativo de política de inquilinos los campos de atestación de reciprocidad de MeitY de India y BSSN de Indonesia; Codex CLI v3.1.2 se distribuye con la mitigación correspondiente de canonicalización del serializador de estado intermedio, y la matriz de interoperabilidad cruzada entre orquestadores de cinco proveedores de Mistral Workflows alcanza vista previa pública con los esquemas de campos de política de inquilinos en las trece jurisdicciones.
text_locales.fil: Lumalapag ang LangChain CVE-2026-44967 bilang ikasampung agent-loader CVE kasama ang same-day v0.3.7 patch plus paired backport advisories na tinutukoy ng NHS England blocklist, habang naglalathala ang Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, at AutoGen maintainer teams ng coordinated Thursday commitments na nag-extend sa mid-June default-shipment target upang sakupin ang paired four-surface delivery; nag-ship ang v3 joint preprint addendum mula sa DeepMind, Meta AI, Anthropic, at Microsoft ng reference implementations sa Python at Rust na sumasaklaw sa lahat ng sampung CVE-pattern instances.

bridges.text: AutoGen CVE-2026-44918 (CVSS 8.6) extends the wave from eight to nine CVEs at the workflow-state path tier with AutoGen shipping v0.6.4 plus v0.5.x and v0.4.x backports same-day; Trail of Bits reaffirms the signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist plus workflow-state three-tier common-mitigation pattern; arxiv 2605.06712v2 adds a workflow-state integration pattern; SGLang plus TGI default the signed-checkpoint loader same Wednesday; Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, AutoGen maintainers commit to three-tier mitigation default in next-minor releases at mid-June.

text_locales.en: AutoGen CVE-2026-44918 (CVSS 8.6) extends the wave from eight to nine CVEs at the workflow-state path tier with AutoGen shipping v0.6.4 plus v0.5.x and v0.4.x backports same-day; Trail of Bits reaffirms the signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist plus workflow-state three-tier common-mitigation pattern; arxiv 2605.06712v2 adds a workflow-state integration pattern; SGLang plus TGI default the signed-checkpoint loader same Wednesday; Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, AutoGen maintainers commit to three-tier mitigation default in next-minor releases at mid-June.
text_locales.ja: AutoGen CVE-2026-44918(CVSS 8.6)は当該波をワークフロー状態パス層で8件から9件のCVEへと押し上げ、AutoGenは同日にv0.6.4とv0.5.x・v0.4.xバックポートを出荷した。Trail of Bitsは署名済みチェックポイント+マニフェスト許可リスト+ワークフロー状態の三層共通緩和パターンを再確認、arxiv 2605.06712v2はワークフロー状態統合パターンを追加。SGLangとTGIは同日に署名済みチェックポイントローダを既定化し、Microsoft、LangChain、CrewAI、Pydantic AI、AutoGenの各メンテナは6月中旬の次期マイナーリリースで三層緩和策をデフォルト出荷することをコミットした。
text_locales.es: El CVE-2026-44918 de AutoGen (CVSS 8.6) extiende la oleada de ocho a nueve CVEs en el nivel de ruta de estado de workflow, con AutoGen lanzando v0.6.4 más backports a v0.5.x y v0.4.x el mismo día; Trail of Bits reafirma el patrón de mitigación común de tres niveles (checkpoint firmado, lista blanca de manifiesto y estado de workflow); arxiv 2605.06712v2 añade un patrón de integración de estado de workflow; SGLang y TGI establecen por defecto el cargador de checkpoints firmados el mismo miércoles; Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI y los maintainers de AutoGen se comprometen a la mitigación de tres niveles por defecto en los próximos lanzamientos menores a mediados de junio.
text_locales.fil: Pinapalawak ng AutoGen CVE-2026-44918 (CVSS 8.6) ang wave mula sa walo hanggang siyam na CVE sa workflow-state path tier kasama ang AutoGen na nagpapadala ng v0.6.4 plus v0.5.x at v0.4.x backports sa parehong araw; muling pinatutunayan ng Trail of Bits ang signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist plus workflow-state three-tier common-mitigation pattern; nagdaragdag ang arxiv 2605.06712v2 ng workflow-state integration pattern; ina-default ng SGLang plus TGI ang signed-checkpoint loader sa parehong Miyerkules; nagko-commit ang Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, Pydantic AI, AutoGen maintainers na magpadala ng three-tier mitigation bilang default sa next-minor releases sa mid-June.

bridges.text: Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) extends the agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader wave from seven to eight CVEs at the inference-routing tier with Pydantic shipping v0.4.7 plus a v0.3.x and v0.2.x backport same-day; Trail of Bits reaffirms the signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist common-mitigation taxonomy; arxiv 2605.06712 adds a runtime-verifier integration pattern; Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, and Pydantic AI maintainers commit Tuesday to ship both tiers as default in next-minor releases at the coordinated mid-June window.

text_locales.en: Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) extends the agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader wave from seven to eight CVEs at the inference-routing tier with Pydantic shipping v0.4.7 plus a v0.3.x and v0.2.x backport same-day; Trail of Bits reaffirms the signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist common-mitigation taxonomy; arxiv 2605.06712 adds a runtime-verifier integration pattern; Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, and Pydantic AI maintainers commit Tuesday to ship both tiers as default in next-minor releases at the coordinated mid-June window.
text_locales.ja: Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892(CVSS 8.4)は、推論ルーティング・ティアでエージェント・チェックポイント・アンド・マニフェスト・ローダー波を7から8つのCVEへと拡張、Pydanticは当日中にv0.4.7プラスv0.3.xおよびv0.2.xバックポートを出荷;Trail of Bitsは署名済みチェックポイント・プラス・マニフェスト許可リスト共通緩和分類学を再確認;arxiv 2605.06712はランタイム検証器統合パターンを追加;Microsoft、LangChain、CrewAI、Pydantic AIメインテナーは火曜、協調された6月中旬ウィンドウで次回マイナー・リリースで両ティアをデフォルトとして出荷することにコミットする。
text_locales.es: Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) extiende la ola de agent-checkpoint-y-manifest-loader de siete a ocho CVEs en el tier de inference-routing con Pydantic enviando v0.4.7 más un backport para v0.3.x y v0.2.x el mismo día; Trail of Bits reafirma la taxonomía de mitigación común signed-checkpoint más manifest-allowlist; arxiv 2605.06712 añade un patrón de integración runtime-verifier; Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI y los maintainers de Pydantic AI se comprometen el martes a enviar ambos tiers como default en releases de próxima-versión-menor en la ventana coordinada de mediados-de-junio.
text_locales.fil: Ina-extend ng Pydantic AI CVE-2026-44892 (CVSS 8.4) ang agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader wave mula pito patungong walong CVEs sa inference-routing tier kasama ng Pydantic na nag-ship ng v0.4.7 plus isang v0.3.x at v0.2.x backport same-day; muling kinukumpirma ng Trail of Bits ang signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist common-mitigation taxonomy; idinaragdag ng arxiv 2605.06712 ang isang runtime-verifier integration pattern; nagko-commit ang Microsoft, LangChain, CrewAI, at Pydantic AI maintainers ngayong Tuesday na mag-ship ng parehong tiers bilang default sa next-minor releases sa coordinated mid-June window.

bridges.text: On the agent-framework signed-checkpoint and manifest mode prediction (May 11): LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) closes the seven-CVE agent-loader wave Monday-morning Pacific, Trail of Bits taxonomizes the wave into a single signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist common-mitigation pattern, and a DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic joint preprint (arxiv 2605.06342) plus parallel Microsoft, LangChain, and CrewAI maintainer commitments commit to ship the common format and schema as default in the next minor-version release with a coordinated mid-June target window, collapsing the prediction's Q4 2026 landing.

text_locales.en: On the agent-framework signed-checkpoint and manifest mode prediction (May 11): LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) closes the seven-CVE agent-loader wave Monday-morning Pacific, Trail of Bits taxonomizes the wave into a single signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist common-mitigation pattern, and a DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic joint preprint (arxiv 2605.06342) plus parallel Microsoft, LangChain, and CrewAI maintainer commitments commit to ship the common format and schema as default in the next minor-version release with a coordinated mid-June target window, collapsing the prediction's Q4 2026 landing.
text_locales.ja: エージェント・フレームワーク署名済みチェックポイント・アンド・マニフェスト・モード予測(5月11日)について: LangChain CVE-2026-44712(CVSS 8.7)が月曜朝の太平洋時間に7-CVEエージェント・ローダー波を完結し、Trail of Bitsが波を単一の署名済みチェックポイント・プラス・マニフェスト許可リスト共通緩和パターンに分類学化し、DeepMind-Meta-Anthropicジョイント・プレプリント(arxiv 2605.06342)プラス並行するMicrosoft、LangChain、CrewAIメインテナー・コミットメントが、協調された6月中旬ターゲット・ウィンドウで次回マイナー・バージョン・リリースのデフォルトとして共通フォーマットとスキーマを出荷することにコミットし、予測のQ4 2026着地を崩壊させる。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción de modo signed-checkpoint y manifest de agent-framework (11 de mayo): LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) cierra la ola de siete CVE de agent-loader el lunes por la mañana hora del Pacífico, Trail of Bits taxonomiza la ola en un único patrón de mitigación común signed-checkpoint más manifest-allowlist, y un preprint conjunto DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic (arxiv 2605.06342) más compromisos paralelos de maintainers de Microsoft, LangChain y CrewAI comprometen enviar el formato y esquema común como default en la próxima versión menor con una ventana objetivo coordinada de mediados-de-junio, colapsando el aterrizaje Q4 2026 de la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Sa agent-framework signed-checkpoint at manifest mode prediction (Mayo 11): tinatapos ng LangChain CVE-2026-44712 (CVSS 8.7) ang seven-CVE agent-loader wave ng Monday-morning Pacific, nag-ta-taxonomize ang Trail of Bits sa wave bilang isang signed-checkpoint plus manifest-allowlist common-mitigation pattern, at ang DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic joint preprint (arxiv 2605.06342) plus parallel Microsoft, LangChain, at CrewAI maintainer commitments ay nag-co-commit na mag-ship ng common format at schema bilang default sa susunod na minor-version release na may coordinated mid-June target window, na nag-co-collapse sa Q4 2026 landing ng prediksyon.

job_locales.es: Extender el write-up conjunto del domingo enmarcando el par AutoGen más Semantic Kernel como el mismo patrón de exposición de cargador de agent-checkpoint-y-manifest que el survey del 8 de mayo de CrewAI más Haystack en un catálogo sostenido cross-marco de clase-de-exposición que nombra LangGraph, LiteLLM, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, y Haystack como una cohorte de seis-marcos exhibiendo un defecto estructural, proporcionando la referencia canónica que los mantenedores de marcos y los gates de adquisición de CISA más NHS citan cuando bloquean el contrato de cargador firmado-por-defecto.

outcome_locales.en: Trail of Bits publishes a documented cross-framework agent-loader exposure-class catalog by Q3 2026 covering the six-framework cohort with a recommended signed-checkpoint plus manifest-fetcher signature-chain remediation pattern, cited in framework release notes plus NHS England CVE blocklist procurement guidance plus CISA KEV agent-loader entries, locking the signed-by-default shape as the canonical mitigation.
outcome_locales.ja: Q3 2026までにTrail of Bitsが、推奨された署名済みチェックポイント + マニフェスト・フェッチャー署名チェーン緩和パターンを伴う6フレームワーク・コホートをカバーする文書化されたクロスフレームワーク・エージェント・ローダー露出クラス・カタログを公表し、フレームワーク・リリース・ノート、NHS England CVEブロックリスト調達ガイダンス、CISA KEVエージェント・ローダー・エントリで引用され、署名・バイ・デフォルト形状を正準緩和としてロックする。
outcome_locales.es: Trail of Bits publica un catálogo documentado cross-marco de clase-de-exposición de cargador-de-agentes para Q3 2026 cubriendo la cohorte de seis-marcos con un patrón recomendado de remediación de checkpoint firmado más cadena-de-firma de fetcher-de-manifest, citado en notas de release de marcos más guía de adquisición de la lista de bloqueo de CVE de NHS England más entradas KEV de cargador-de-agentes de CISA, bloqueando la forma firmado-por-defecto como la mitigación canónica.
outcome_locales.fil: Naglalathala ang Trail of Bits ng documented cross-framework agent-loader exposure-class catalog sa Q3 2026 na sumasaklaw sa six-framework cohort kasama ng inirerekomendang signed-checkpoint plus manifest-fetcher signature-chain remediation pattern, na binabanggit sa framework release notes plus NHS England CVE blocklist procurement guidance plus CISA KEV agent-loader entries, na nila-lock ang signed-by-default shape bilang canonical mitigation.

motivation_locales.en: Without a sustained cross-framework exposure-class catalog, individual CVE patches read as point fixes and framework maintainers can credibly ship sandbox-only mitigations or opt-in signature flags; converting the pattern into a documented exposure class is what forces the loader contract to invert from voluntary to signed-by-default with a deliberate opt-out.
motivation_locales.ja: 持続的クロスフレームワーク露出クラス・カタログがなければ、個々のCVEパッチはポイント修正として読まれ、フレームワーク・メンテナーはサンドボックス・オンリー緩和またはオプトイン署名フラグを信頼性をもって出荷できる;パターンを文書化された露出クラスに変換することは、ローダー契約を任意から、意図的なオプトアウトを伴う署名・バイ・デフォルトへ反転させる強制力となる。
motivation_locales.es: Sin un catálogo sostenido cross-marco de clase-de-exposición, los parches individuales de CVE se leen como fixes puntuales y los mantenedores de marcos pueden enviar creíblemente mitigaciones solo-sandbox o flags opt-in de firma; convertir el patrón en una clase de exposición documentada es lo que fuerza al contrato del cargador a invertirse de voluntario a firmado-por-defecto con un opt-out deliberado.
motivation_locales.fil: Kung walang sustained cross-framework exposure-class catalog, binabasa ang individual CVE patches bilang point fixes at credibly nag-ship ang framework maintainers ng sandbox-only mitigations o opt-in signature flags; ang pag-co-convert ng pattern papasok sa documented exposure class ang nagpipilit sa loader contract na mag-invert mula sa voluntary sa signed-by-default kasama ng deliberate opt-out.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: By Q4 2026 the May 10 agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE pair forces open-source agent frameworks to ship signature-verified checkpoint deserialization plus signature-verified plugin-manifest fetching as the documented default loader mode across the AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, CrewAI, Haystack, and LiteLLM cohort. The catalysts that land in a single Sunday-evening Pacific cycle are concrete and mutually reinforcing: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9) is an arbitrary-code-execution checkpoint-deserialization vulnerability in the agent-state-replay path, exploitable through a malicious checkpoint uploaded via a connected message broker, patched same-day in AutoGen v0.5.18; Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4) is an authenticated server-side request forgery in the plugin-manifest fetcher allowing pivot to internal cloud-metadata endpoints, patched in Semantic Kernel v1.36.0 with an out-of-band dotnet packaging advisory; Trail of Bits publishes a joint Sunday write-up cataloging both as the same agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern previously documented in the May 8 CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 plus Haystack CVE-2026-44391 survey; the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist already names LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 as disallowed pre-patch versions on NHS-tenant deployments, with the AutoGen plus Semantic Kernel pair expected to join inside the CISA May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline window. The structural force is that once Trail of Bits catalogs four-then-six CVEs across the open-source agent-framework cohort as one exposure class, framework maintainers can no longer ship checkpoint-deserialization and plugin-manifest-fetcher paths as opt-in trust surfaces; the security posture inverts from voluntary signature checking to signed-by-default with a deliberate opt-out for sandboxed test fixtures. The most likely shape is a signed-checkpoint primitive added as a first-class object across the framework cohort with deterministic Sigstore-or-cosign-compatible signature verification at load time plus a manifest-fetcher policy schema that allowlists URL prefixes and enforces a fetched-manifest signature chain anchored to the framework distribution. Sovereign-cloud and FedRAMP-Moderate tenants adopt it first because the NHS England plus France DGFiP plus Germany Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit sovereign-cloud cohort treats per-CVE remediation status as paired procurement-eligibility evidence and the Anthropic per-tenant attestation log (arxiv 2605.05933 plus 2605.06012 compositional safety theorems) is becoming the canonical compliance shape. Bear case is a framework forking the loader contract and refusing the signature-verification default in favor of a sandbox-only mitigation; absent that, Q4 2026 lands signed-checkpoint and manifest mode as the documented default across the cohort.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: Q4 2026までに、5月10日のエージェンティックAIツーリング・スタックCVEペアは、オープンソースのエージェント・フレームワークに対し、署名検証済みチェックポイント・デシリアライゼーションと署名検証済みプラグイン・マニフェスト・フェッチを、AutoGen、Semantic Kernel、LangGraph、CrewAI、Haystack、LiteLLMコホート全体の文書化されたデフォルト・ローダー・モードとして出荷することを強制する。単一の日曜夕方の太平洋サイクルで着地する触媒は具体的かつ相互強化的である: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612(CVSS 8.9)は、エージェント状態リプレイ経路における任意コード実行可能なチェックポイント・デシリアライゼーション脆弱性で、接続されたメッセージ・ブローカー経由でアップロードされた悪意あるチェックポイントを介して悪用可能、AutoGen v0.5.18で同日パッチ済み;Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638(CVSS 8.4)は、内部クラウド・メタデータ・エンドポイントへのピボットを可能にするプラグイン・マニフェスト・フェッチャーにおける認証済みサーバーサイド・リクエスト・フォージェリで、Semantic Kernel v1.36.0でパッチ済み、アウト・オブ・バンドのdotnetパッケージング・アドバイザリを伴う;Trail of Bitsは日曜共同ライトアップを公表し、両方を5月8日のCrewAI CVE-2026-44352およびHaystack CVE-2026-44391サーベイで以前に文書化された同一のエージェント・チェックポイント・アンド・マニフェスト・ローダー露出パターンとしてカタログ化する;NHS Englandのエージェンティック AIワークフロー・プラットフォームCVEブロックリストは既にLangGraph CVE-2026-44012、LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188、CrewAI CVE-2026-44352、Haystack CVE-2026-44391をNHSテナント展開での非許可プリパッチ・バージョンとして指名しており、AutoGenおよびSemantic Kernelペアは5月21日CISA連邦民政部門修復期限ウィンドウ内に加わることが見込まれる。構造的な力は、Trail of Bitsがオープンソース・エージェント・フレームワーク・コホート全体で4件から6件のCVEを単一の露出クラスとしてカタログ化するや否や、フレームワーク・メンテナーはチェックポイント・デシリアライゼーションとプラグイン・マニフェスト・フェッチャー経路をオプトイン信頼面として出荷することができなくなることである;セキュリティ・ポスチャーは任意の署名チェックから署名・バイ・デフォルト(サンドボックス化されたテスト・フィクスチャ向けの意図的なオプトアウトを伴う)へ反転する。最も可能性の高い形状は、ロード時の決定論的なSigstore互換またはcosign互換の署名検証と、URLプレフィックスをアローリストしフレームワーク・ディストリビューションにアンカーされた取得済みマニフェスト署名チェーンを強制するマニフェスト・フェッチャー・ポリシー・スキーマを備えた、フレームワーク・コホート全体の第一級オブジェクトとして追加される署名済みチェックポイント・プリミティブである。ソブリン・クラウドとFedRAMP-Moderateテナントが最初に採用するのは、NHS England + France DGFiP + Germany Bundesagentur für Arbeitソブリン・クラウド・コホートがCVEごとの修復ステータスをペアの調達適格性証拠として扱い、Anthropicテナントごとのアテステーション・ログ(arxiv 2605.05933と2605.06012コンポジショナル・セーフティ定理)が正準コンプライアンス形状になりつつあるためである。ベア・ケースはフレームワークがローダー契約をフォークし、サンドボックス・オンリーの緩和を支持して署名検証デフォルトを拒否する;それ以外の場合、Q4 2026はコホート全体で署名済みチェックポイントとマニフェスト・モードを文書化されたデフォルトとして着地させる。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q4 2026 el par de CVEs del stack de herramientas agentic-AI del 10 de mayo fuerza a los marcos de agentes open-source a enviar deserialización de checkpoint con verificación-de-firma más obtención de plugin-manifest con verificación-de-firma como el modo de cargador predeterminado documentado a través de la cohorte AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, CrewAI, Haystack, y LiteLLM. Los catalizadores que aterrizan en un solo ciclo de domingo por la noche, hora del Pacífico, son concretos y mutuamente reforzantes: AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9) es una vulnerabilidad de deserialización de checkpoint de ejecución de código arbitraria en la ruta de agent-state-replay, explotable a través de un checkpoint malicioso subido vía un broker de mensajes conectado, parchado el mismo día en AutoGen v0.5.18; Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4) es una falsificación de petición server-side autenticada en el fetcher de plugin-manifest que permite pivotar a endpoints internos de cloud-metadata, parchada en Semantic Kernel v1.36.0 con un aviso out-of-band para el empaquetado dotnet; Trail of Bits publica un write-up conjunto del domingo catalogando ambos como el mismo patrón de exposición de cargador de agent-checkpoint-y-manifest previamente documentado en el survey del 8 de mayo de CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 más Haystack CVE-2026-44391; la lista de bloqueo de CVE de plataforma de workflow agentic-AI de NHS England ya nombra LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, y Haystack CVE-2026-44391 como versiones pre-parche no permitidas en despliegues NHS-tenant, con el par AutoGen más Semantic Kernel esperado para sumarse dentro de la ventana de fecha límite de remediación federal-civil de CISA del 21 de mayo. La fuerza estructural es que una vez que Trail of Bits cataloga cuatro-luego-seis CVEs a través de la cohorte de marcos de agentes open-source como una clase de exposición, los mantenedores de marcos ya no pueden enviar rutas de deserialización de checkpoint y fetcher de plugin-manifest como superficies de confianza opt-in; la postura de seguridad se invierte de verificación-de-firma voluntaria a firmado-por-defecto con un opt-out deliberado para fixtures de prueba sandboxed. La forma más probable es una primitiva de checkpoint firmado agregada como un objeto de primera clase a través de la cohorte de marcos con verificación-de-firma determinística compatible con Sigstore-o-cosign en tiempo de carga más un esquema de política de fetcher-de-manifest que ponga en allowlist prefijos URL y haga cumplir una cadena-de-firma de manifest-obtenido anclada a la distribución del marco. Los tenants sovereign-cloud y FedRAMP-Moderate lo adoptan primero porque la cohorte sovereign-cloud NHS England más France DGFiP más Germany Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit trata el estatus de remediación por-CVE como evidencia emparejada de elegibilidad-de-adquisición y el log de atestación por tenant de Anthropic (arxiv 2605.05933 más teoremas de seguridad composicional 2605.06012) se está convirtiendo en la forma canónica de cumplimiento. El caso bajista es un marco bifurcando el contrato del cargador y rechazando el predeterminado de verificación-de-firma a favor de una mitigación solo-sandbox; en ausencia de eso, Q4 2026 aterriza el modo de checkpoint firmado y manifest como el predeterminado documentado a través de la cohorte.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Sa Q4 2026 ang May 10 agentic-AI tooling-stack CVE pair ay pumipilit sa open-source agent frameworks na mag-ship ng signature-verified checkpoint deserialization plus signature-verified plugin-manifest fetching bilang documented default loader mode sa buong AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, CrewAI, Haystack, at LiteLLM cohort. Ang mga catalysts na lumapag sa isang Sunday-evening Pacific cycle ay konkreto at mutually reinforcing: ang AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 (CVSS 8.9) ay isang arbitrary-code-execution checkpoint-deserialization vulnerability sa agent-state-replay path, na exploitable sa pamamagitan ng malicious checkpoint na ina-upload sa pamamagitan ng connected message broker, pina-patch sa parehong araw sa AutoGen v0.5.18; ang Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 (CVSS 8.4) ay authenticated server-side request forgery sa plugin-manifest fetcher na nagpapahintulot ng pivot papasok sa internal cloud-metadata endpoints, pina-patch sa Semantic Kernel v1.36.0 kasama ng out-of-band dotnet packaging advisory; naglathala ang Trail of Bits ng joint Sunday write-up na nagka-catalog sa pareho bilang parehong agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern na nakatala dati sa May 8 CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 plus Haystack CVE-2026-44391 survey; ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist ay pinangalanan na ang LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, at Haystack CVE-2026-44391 bilang disallowed pre-patch versions sa NHS-tenant deployments, kasama ang AutoGen plus Semantic Kernel pair na inaasahang sasali sa loob ng CISA May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline window. Ang structural force ay na sa sandaling ang Trail of Bits ay magka-catalog ng apat-na-pagkatapos-anim na CVEs sa buong open-source agent-framework cohort bilang isang exposure class, ang framework maintainers ay hindi na pwedeng mag-ship ng checkpoint-deserialization at plugin-manifest-fetcher paths bilang opt-in trust surfaces; ang security posture ay nagba-invert mula sa voluntary signature checking papasok sa signed-by-default kasama ng deliberate opt-out para sa sandboxed test fixtures. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang signed-checkpoint primitive na idinaragdag bilang first-class object sa buong framework cohort kasama ng deterministic Sigstore-or-cosign-compatible signature verification sa load time plus isang manifest-fetcher policy schema na nag-aallowlist ng URL prefixes at nagpapatupad ng fetched-manifest signature chain na naka-anchor sa framework distribution. Ang sovereign-cloud at FedRAMP-Moderate tenants ang unang nag-aadopt nito dahil tinatrato ng NHS England plus France DGFiP plus Germany Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit sovereign-cloud cohort ang per-CVE remediation status bilang paired procurement-eligibility evidence at ang Anthropic per-tenant attestation log (arxiv 2605.05933 plus 2605.06012 compositional safety theorems) ay nagiging canonical compliance shape. Ang bear case ay isang framework na nag-fo-fork ng loader contract at tumatangging tanggapin ang signature-verification default pabor sa sandbox-only mitigation; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q4 2026 sa signed-checkpoint at manifest mode bilang documented default sa buong cohort.

summary_short_locales.en: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B's 73.4% on SWE-bench Verified and Bonsai 1.7B's 674 tok/s on CUDA push edge coding agents into practical territory. By Q3 2026, individual and SMB coding-agent stacks are expected to standardize on local-by-default execution, with cloud reserved for overflow.
summary_short_locales.ja: Qwen3.6-35B-A3BがSWE-bench Verifiedで73.4%、Bonsai 1.7BがCUDA上で674 tok/sを達成し、エッジ向けコーディングエージェントが実用領域へ進入した。2026年Q3までに、個人および中小企業向けコーディングエージェントスタックは、ローカルをデフォルト、クラウドはオーバーフローという構成に標準化されると見込まれる。
summary_short_locales.es: El 73,4% de Qwen3.6-35B-A3B en SWE-bench Verified y los 674 tok/s de Bonsai 1.7B en CUDA llevan a los agentes de codificación en el borde a un terreno práctico. Para el Q3 2026, se espera que las pilas de agentes de codificación individuales y de pymes se estandaricen en la ejecución local por defecto, reservando la nube para el desbordamiento.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang 73.4% ng Qwen3.6-35B-A3B sa SWE-bench Verified at ang 674 tok/s ng Bonsai 1.7B sa CUDA ay nagtutulak sa edge coding agents papasok sa praktikal na teritoryo. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang individual at SMB coding-agent stacks ay inaasahang magiging standard sa local-by-default execution, na ang cloud ay nakareserba para sa overflow.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4 cost-collapse, mature Qwen3.6 family coverage, and on-device Bonsai performance all push the local default deeper into reach — the structural force the prediction relies on is hardening through Apr 25-27, with practitioner reads consolidating around it.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4 cost-collapse, mature Qwen3.6 family coverage, and on-device Bonsai performance all push the local default deeper into reach — the structural force the prediction relies on is hardening through Apr 25-27, with practitioner reads consolidating around it.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4 のコスト崩壊、成熟した Qwen3.6 ファミリのカバレッジ、そしてオンデバイスでの Bonsai 性能はいずれも、ローカルデフォルトの射程を一段と深く押し広げている — 予測が依拠する構造的な力は 4/25-27 を通じて硬化しており、実務者の読みもそれを軸に集約しつつある。
text_locales.es: El colapso de costos de DeepSeek V4, la cobertura madura de la familia Qwen3.6 y el rendimiento on-device de Bonsai empujan el default local más profundo al alcance — la fuerza estructural de la que depende la predicción se está endureciendo del 25 al 27 de abril, con las lecturas de los profesionales consolidándose en torno a ella.
text_locales.fil: Ang DeepSeek V4 cost-collapse, mature Qwen3.6 family coverage, at ang on-device Bonsai performance ay lahat nagtutulak sa local default na maging mas malalim na maaabot — ang structural force na inaasa ng prediction ay tumitigas sa kabuuan ng Apr 25-27, kasama ang practitioner reads na nagkokonsolida sa paligid nito.

bridges.text: Qwen3.6-27B's dense Apache 2.0 release beating 397B-A17B MoE on SWE-bench Verified at 40 tok/s on a single RTX 3090, DeepSeek V4-Pro's ~7x cost gap with Opus 4.7 alongside Huawei Ascend tuning, and NVIDIA's Apr 26 open-source LLM speedups on RTX PCs together materialize the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar at consumer-tier cost.

text_locales.en: Qwen3.6-27B's dense Apache 2.0 release beating 397B-A17B MoE on SWE-bench Verified at 40 tok/s on a single RTX 3090, DeepSeek V4-Pro's ~7x cost gap with Opus 4.7 alongside Huawei Ascend tuning, and NVIDIA's Apr 26 open-source LLM speedups on RTX PCs together materialize the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar at consumer-tier cost.
text_locales.ja: Qwen3.6-27Bの密Apache 2.0リリースが単一RTX 3090上40 tok/sでSWE-bench Verifiedの397B-A17B MoEを上回ること、DeepSeek V4-ProのOpus 4.7との~7xのコスト差とファーウェイ・アセンドのチューニング、NVIDIAの4月26日のRTX PC上のオープンソースLLMの高速化が共に、コンシューマ層のコストでローカルモデルがエージェント品質バーをクリアするという前提条件を実体化する。
text_locales.es: El lanzamiento denso Apache 2.0 de Qwen3.6-27B superando a 397B-A17B MoE en SWE-bench Verified a 40 tok/s en una sola RTX 3090, la brecha de costo de ~7x de DeepSeek V4-Pro con Opus 4.7 junto al ajuste para Huawei Ascend, y las aceleraciones LLM de código abierto del 26 de abril de NVIDIA en RTX PCs juntas materializan la precondición de que los modelos locales superen el listón de calidad de agente al costo de nivel de consumo.
text_locales.fil: Ang Qwen3.6-27B's dense Apache 2.0 release na lumalampas sa 397B-A17B MoE sa SWE-bench Verified sa 40 tok/s sa isang RTX 3090, ang DeepSeek V4-Pro's ~7x cost gap sa Opus 4.7 katuwang ng Huawei Ascend tuning, at ang NVIDIA's Apr 26 open-source LLM speedups sa RTX PCs ay magkasamang nagma-materialize sa precondition na ang local models ay nakapasa sa agent quality bar sa consumer-tier cost.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4-Pro's IMOAnswerBench 89.8 above Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1-Pro and close to GPT-5.4, plus OfficeChai's $1.74 / $3.48 per M tokens pricing one-seventh of Opus and UCStrategies' 7x-cheaper open-weight 1M-context framing, materialize the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar at frontier-adjacent cost.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4-Pro's IMOAnswerBench 89.8 above Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 3.1-Pro and close to GPT-5.4, plus OfficeChai's $1.74 / $3.48 per M tokens pricing one-seventh of Opus and UCStrategies' 7x-cheaper open-weight 1M-context framing, materialize the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar at frontier-adjacent cost.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4-ProのIMOAnswerBench 89.8がClaude Opus 4.7とGemini 3.1-Proを上回りGPT-5.4に近いこと、OfficeChaiの$1.74 / $3.48 per MトークンというOpusの7分の1の価格設定、UCStrategiesの7倍安価なオープンウェイト1Mコンテキストの枠組みが、ローカル・モデルがフロンティア近接コストでエージェント品質バーをクリアするという前提条件を物質化する。
text_locales.es: El IMOAnswerBench 89.8 de DeepSeek V4-Pro por encima de Claude Opus 4.7 y Gemini 3.1-Pro y cerca de GPT-5.4, más el precio de OfficeChai de $1.74 / $3.48 por M tokens un séptimo de Opus, y el encuadre de UCStrategies de 7x más barato con pesos abiertos y contexto 1M, materializan la precondición de que los modelos locales superan la barra de calidad de agente a un costo adyacente a la frontera.
text_locales.fil: Ang IMOAnswerBench 89.8 ng DeepSeek V4-Pro sa itaas ng Claude Opus 4.7 at Gemini 3.1-Pro at malapit sa GPT-5.4, kasama ang $1.74 / $3.48 per M tokens pricing ng OfficeChai na one-seventh ng Opus at ang 7x-cheaper open-weight 1M-context framing ng UCStrategies, ay nagpapamateryalisa sa precondition na ang local models ay nakapasa sa agent quality bar sa frontier-adjacent cost.

bridges.text: DeepSeek V4 dropping as open weights with native 1M context and Hybrid Attention slashing 1M-context FLOPs to 27% / KV cache to 10%, alongside Qwen3.6-27B's downloadable Claude-Code-grade coding and Ollama v0.21.2's bundled OpenClaw + web search across all desktops, directly materializes the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar with frontier-adjacent capability.

text_locales.en: DeepSeek V4 dropping as open weights with native 1M context and Hybrid Attention slashing 1M-context FLOPs to 27% / KV cache to 10%, alongside Qwen3.6-27B's downloadable Claude-Code-grade coding and Ollama v0.21.2's bundled OpenClaw + web search across all desktops, directly materializes the precondition that local models clear the agent quality bar with frontier-adjacent capability.
text_locales.ja: DeepSeek V4がネイティブ1Mコンテキストとハイブリッド・アテンションでオープンウェイトとして登場し、1MコンテキストFLOPsを27% / KVキャッシュを10%まで削減したこと、加えてQwen3.6-27Bのダウンロード可能なClaude-Codeグレードのコーディングと、Ollama v0.21.2が全デスクトップにOpenClaw + ウェブ検索をバンドルしたことが、ローカルモデルがフロンティア近接の能力でエージェント品質バーをクリアするという前提条件を直接物質化する。
text_locales.es: DeepSeek V4 cayendo como pesos abiertos con contexto de 1M nativo y Hybrid Attention recortando los FLOPs de contexto de 1M al 27% / caché KV al 10%, junto con la codificación de grado Claude-Code descargable de Qwen3.6-27B y los plugins OpenClaw + búsqueda web incluidos de Ollama v0.21.2 en todos los desktops, materializan directamente la precondición de que los modelos locales superan la barra de calidad de agente con capacidad adyacente a la frontera.
text_locales.fil: Ang pagbagsak ng DeepSeek V4 bilang open weights na may native 1M context at Hybrid Attention na nagbabawas ng 1M-context FLOPs sa 27% / KV cache sa 10%, kasabay ng downloadable Claude-Code-grade coding ng Qwen3.6-27B at ang bundled OpenClaw + web search ng Ollama v0.21.2 sa lahat ng desktops, ay direktang nagma-materialize sa precondition na ang local models ay umaabot sa agent quality bar na may frontier-adjacent capability.

bridges.text: Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 hitting SWE-bench Verified 77.2% on a single RTX 4090 at ~18 GB Q4_K_M, with Simon Willison ranking it flagship-grade coding and GIGAZINE noting Claude Opus 4.5-class performance is now locally downloadable, directly materializes the precondition that local-runnable models clear the agent quality bar.

text_locales.en: Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 hitting SWE-bench Verified 77.2% on a single RTX 4090 at ~18 GB Q4_K_M, with Simon Willison ranking it flagship-grade coding and GIGAZINE noting Claude Opus 4.5-class performance is now locally downloadable, directly materializes the precondition that local-runnable models clear the agent quality bar.
text_locales.ja: Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0が単一のRTX 4090上で約18 GBのQ4_K_MでSWE-bench Verified 77.2%に到達し、Simon Willisonがフラッグシップ級コーディングと評価し、GIGAZINEはClaude Opus 4.5級の性能が今やローカルでダウンロード可能だと述べていることは、ローカル実行可能なモデルがエージェントの品質基準をクリアするという前提条件を直接実現している。
text_locales.es: Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 alcanzando SWE-bench Verified 77.2% en una sola RTX 4090 con ~18 GB Q4_K_M, con Simon Willison clasificándolo como codificación de grado insignia y GIGAZINE señalando que el rendimiento de clase Claude Opus 4.5 ahora se puede descargar localmente, materializa directamente la precondición de que los modelos ejecutables localmente superan la barra de calidad del agente.
text_locales.fil: Ang Qwen3.6-27B Apache 2.0 na umaabot sa SWE-bench Verified 77.2% sa iisang RTX 4090 sa ~18 GB Q4_K_M, kasama si Simon Willison na nagrarank dito bilang flagship-grade coding at ang GIGAZINE na nagsasabi na ang Claude Opus 4.5-class performance ay locally-downloadable na ngayon, ay tahasang inaaktwal ang precondition na ang local-runnable models ay pumapasa sa agent quality bar.

bridges.text: ml-intern lifting Qwen3-1.7B GPQA from 8.5% to 32% in under 10 hours and overtaking Claude Code's 22.99% is direct evidence that local post-training now produces credible coding-agent quality, reinforcing the precondition that edge models match useful agent quality bars.

text_locales.en: ml-intern lifting Qwen3-1.7B GPQA from 8.5% to 32% in under 10 hours and overtaking Claude Code's 22.99% is direct evidence that local post-training now produces credible coding-agent quality, reinforcing the precondition that edge models match useful agent quality bars.
text_locales.ja: ml-internが10時間未満でQwen3-1.7BのGPQAを8.5%から32%まで引き上げ、Claude Codeの22.99%を上回ったことは、ローカルなポストトレーニングが信頼できるコーディングエージェント品質を生み出すことの直接的な証拠であり、エッジモデルが実用的なエージェント品質基準に到達するという前提を補強する。
text_locales.es: ml-intern elevando GPQA de Qwen3-1.7B del 8.5% al 32% en menos de 10 horas y superando el 22.99% de Claude Code es evidencia directa de que el post-entrenamiento local ahora produce calidad creible de agente de codificacion, reforzando la precondicion de que los modelos edge igualan los listones utiles de calidad de agente.
text_locales.fil: Ang pagtataas ng ml-intern sa Qwen3-1.7B GPQA mula 8.5% papuntang 32% sa loob ng wala pang 10 oras at ang paglampas sa 22.99% ng Claude Code ay direktang ebidensya na ang local post-training ay nakakagawa na ngayon ng credible coding-agent quality, na nagpapatibay sa precondition na ang edge models ay umaabot sa useful agent quality bars.

description.en: **"Training-vs-inference SKU split" becomes the standard for custom AI silicon.** Google's TPU 8t / 8i split extends the Trainium-vs-Inferentia line and locks in **hyperscaler in-house silicon as architecturally separate for training vs inference**. In H2 2026 / H1 2027, expect Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA to adopt the same dual-track SKU strategy — opposing NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin's "single architecture, both workloads." Inference-tuned SKUs assume native FP4 / MXFP4 and drive **$/query competition** to a peak in Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「学習用 vs 推論用のSKU分割」がカスタムAIシリコンの標準仕様になる。** GoogleのTPU 8t / 8i分割は、Trainium-Inferentiaのラインを延伸し、**ハイパースケーラの内製シリコンを学習用と推論用でアーキテクチャ的に分離**することを定着させる。2026年H2 / 2027年H1にかけて、Microsoft MAIAとMeta MTIAも同様のデュアルトラックSKU戦略を採用すると見込まれる — NVIDIA BlackwellやVera Rubinの「単一アーキテクチャで両ワークロード」路線と対立する形になる。推論向けにチューニングされたSKUはネイティブFP4 / MXFP4を前提とし、**$/queryの競争**を2026年Q3にピークへ押し上げる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La "separacion de SKU entrenamiento-vs-inferencia" se convierte en el estandar para silicio AI personalizado.** La division TPU 8t / 8i de Google extiende la linea Trainium-vs-Inferentia y consolida el **silicio interno de los hyperscalers como arquitectonicamente separado para entrenamiento vs inferencia**. En H2 2026 / H1 2027, se espera que Microsoft MAIA y Meta MTIA adopten la misma estrategia de SKU dual — oponiendose a la "arquitectura unica, ambas cargas de trabajo" de NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. Los SKU optimizados para inferencia asumen FP4 / MXFP4 nativo e impulsan la **competencia de $/consulta** a un pico en Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "Training-vs-inference SKU split" ay nagiging pamantayan para sa custom AI silicon.** Ang TPU 8t / 8i split ng Google ay nag-eextend sa Trainium-vs-Inferentia line at nag-lo-lock in sa **hyperscaler in-house silicon bilang architecturally separate para sa training vs inference**. Sa H2 2026 / H1 2027, asahan na ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA ay magtitibay ng parehong dual-track SKU strategy — laban sa "single architecture, both workloads" ng NVIDIA Blackwell / Vera Rubin. Ang inference-tuned SKUs ay nag-aassume ng native FP4 / MXFP4 at nagtutulak ng **$/query competition** sa peak sa Q3 2026. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

detail.summary_short: Google's TPU 8t / 8i announcement extends the Trainium-vs-Inferentia split and codifies hyperscaler in-house silicon as architecturally separate for training vs inference. By H2 2026 / H1 2027, Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA are expected to adopt the same dual-track SKU strategy, with inference SKUs driving $/query competition to a peak.

summary_short_locales.en: Google's TPU 8t / 8i announcement extends the Trainium-vs-Inferentia split and codifies hyperscaler in-house silicon as architecturally separate for training vs inference. By H2 2026 / H1 2027, Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA are expected to adopt the same dual-track SKU strategy, with inference SKUs driving $/query competition to a peak.
summary_short_locales.ja: GoogleのTPU 8t / 8i発表はTrainium-Inferentia型の分割を延伸し、ハイパースケーラの内製シリコンを学習用と推論用でアーキテクチャ的に分離することを定式化する。2026年H2 / 2027年H1までに、Microsoft MAIAとMeta MTIAも同じデュアルトラックSKU戦略を採用すると見込まれ、推論SKUが$/query競争をピークへ押し上げる。
summary_short_locales.es: El anuncio TPU 8t / 8i de Google extiende la division Trainium-vs-Inferentia y codifica el silicio interno de los hyperscalers como arquitectonicamente separado para entrenamiento vs inferencia. Para H2 2026 / H1 2027, se espera que Microsoft MAIA y Meta MTIA adopten la misma estrategia de SKU dual, con SKU de inferencia llevando la competencia de $/consulta a un pico.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang anunsyo ng TPU 8t / 8i ng Google ay nag-eextend sa Trainium-vs-Inferentia split at nag-cocodify ng hyperscaler in-house silicon bilang architecturally separate para sa training vs inference. Sa pamamagitan ng H2 2026 / H1 2027, ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA ay inaasahang magtitibay ng parehong dual-track SKU strategy, kung saan ang inference SKUs ay nagtutulak ng $/query competition sa peak.

bridges.text: AWS's Apr 27 roundup deepens the Trainium silicon-level co-engineering with Anthropic and Meta-Graviton CPU at scale, reinforcing that hyperscalers continue to architect inference-class silicon distinct from training-class accelerators. The precondition that custom AI silicon splits cleanly along workload lines holds with fresh partnership detail rather than a new tape-out.

text_locales.en: AWS's Apr 27 roundup deepens the Trainium silicon-level co-engineering with Anthropic and Meta-Graviton CPU at scale, reinforcing that hyperscalers continue to architect inference-class silicon distinct from training-class accelerators. The precondition that custom AI silicon splits cleanly along workload lines holds with fresh partnership detail rather than a new tape-out.
text_locales.ja: AWSの4月27日ラウンドアップは、AnthropicとのTrainiumシリコンレベル協調エンジニアリングとMeta-Gravitonの大規模CPUを深化させ、ハイパースケーラーがトレーニング級アクセラレータとは別個に推論級シリコンを設計し続けていることを補強している。カスタムAIシリコンがワークロード・ラインに沿って明確に分かれるという前提条件は、新しいテープアウトではなく新鮮なパートナーシップの詳細とともに維持されている。
text_locales.es: El roundup del 27 de abril de AWS profundiza la co-ingenieria a nivel de silicio Trainium con Anthropic y Meta-Graviton CPU a escala, reforzando que los hyperscalers continuan arquitecturando silicio inference-class distinto de aceleradores training-class. La precondicion de que el silicio personalizado de IA se divide limpiamente por lineas de workload se mantiene con detalle fresco de partnership en lugar de un nuevo tape-out.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 27 roundup ng AWS ay pinapalalim ang Trainium silicon-level co-engineering kasama ang Anthropic at Meta-Graviton CPU sa scale, na nagpapatibay na ang hyperscalers ay patuloy na nag-aarchitect ng inference-class silicon na hiwalay sa training-class accelerators. Ang precondition na ang custom AI silicon ay naghahati nang malinis sa workload lines ay nananatili na may sariwang partnership detail sa halip na bagong tape-out.

bridges.text: AWS doubling down on Trainium for training and Graviton for CPU-heavy agentic workloads reinforces the structural force the prediction names — hyperscaler in-house silicon is the differentiation layer, with workload-specialized SKUs increasingly the operative shape.

text_locales.en: AWS doubling down on Trainium for training and Graviton for CPU-heavy agentic workloads reinforces the structural force the prediction names — hyperscaler in-house silicon is the differentiation layer, with workload-specialized SKUs increasingly the operative shape.
text_locales.ja: AWS がトレーニングに Trainium、CPU 重めのエージェンティック ワークロードに Graviton を二重に賭けていくことは、予測が指す構造的力を補強する — ハイパースケーラの自社シリコンが差別化レイヤーであり、ワークロード特化型 SKU が次第にその作動的形状となっている。
text_locales.es: AWS redoblando con Trainium para entrenamiento y Graviton para cargas agentic intensivas en CPU refuerza la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra — el silicio interno del hyperscaler es la capa de diferenciación, con SKUs especializados por carga de trabajo cada vez más como la forma operativa.
text_locales.fil: Ang AWS na nagdo-doble down sa Trainium para sa training at Graviton para sa CPU-heavy agentic workloads ay pinatatatag ang structural force na pinangalanan ng prediction — ang in-house silicon ng hyperscaler ang differentiation layer, kasama ang workload-specialized SKUs na lalong nagiging operative shape.

text_locales.es: La presentación de IPO de Cerebras habla de la especialización de nivel inferencia pero no toca directamente la división de SKU training-vs-inference dentro del roadmap de silicio in-house de hyperscaler que concierne a la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Ang IPO filing ng Cerebras ay tumutukoy sa inference-tier specialization ngunit hindi direktang humihipo sa training-vs-inference SKU split sa loob ng hyperscaler in-house silicon roadmap na sinasaklaw ng prediction.

bridges.text: GPT-5.5's API pricing 2x GPT-5.4 with Codex's 40% output-token reduction sharpens the inference $/query axis, while Anthropic-AWS's 5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3 simultaneous-run shape locks the training-side dual-track silicon, keeping the structural split intact even as Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA dual-SKU announcements remain pending.

text_locales.en: GPT-5.5's API pricing 2x GPT-5.4 with Codex's 40% output-token reduction sharpens the inference $/query axis, while Anthropic-AWS's 5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3 simultaneous-run shape locks the training-side dual-track silicon, keeping the structural split intact even as Microsoft MAIA and Meta MTIA dual-SKU announcements remain pending.
text_locales.ja: GPT-5.5のAPI価格がGPT-5.4の2倍となりCodexの40%出力トークン削減で推論$/クエリ軸が鋭くなる一方、Anthropic-AWSの5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3同時稼働の形が学習側のデュアルトラック・シリコンをロックし、Microsoft MAIAとMeta MTIAのデュアルSKU発表が保留中であっても構造的分割が無傷のままである。
text_locales.es: El precio API de GPT-5.5 a 2x GPT-5.4 con la reducción del 40% de tokens de output de Codex agudiza el eje $/consulta de inferencia, mientras la forma de corrida simultánea de Anthropic-AWS de 5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3 bloquea el silicio de doble pista del lado de entrenamiento, manteniendo la división estructural intacta incluso mientras los anuncios de doble SKU de Microsoft MAIA y Meta MTIA permanecen pendientes.
text_locales.fil: Ang API pricing ng GPT-5.5 na 2x GPT-5.4 kasama ang 40% output-token reduction ng Codex ay nagpapatibay sa inference $/query axis, habang ang 5GW Trainium + 1GW Trainium2/3 simultaneous-run shape ng Anthropic-AWS ay nagla-lock sa training-side dual-track silicon, na pinananatiling buo ang structural split kahit pa nakabinbin pa ang Microsoft MAIA at Meta MTIA dual-SKU announcements.

text_locales.ja: Google Cloud Next '26のDay 3がTPU 8iの推論最適化(1,152 TPU、SRAM 3倍)を強調することがデュアルトラックSKU分裂を補強し、NVIDIA Vera Rubinの6チップ + Groq 3 LPUシングル・アーキテクチャ・スタックが量産入りすることが構造的対比をシャープにし、MAIA / MTIAのデュアルSKU発表が保留中であっても、根底にある市場分裂は無傷のまま保たれている。
text_locales.es: Google Cloud Next '26 Día 3 enfatizando la optimización de inferencia TPU 8i (1,152 TPUs, SRAM 3x) refuerza la división dual-track SKU, mientras que el stack de 6 chips + Groq 3 LPU de arquitectura única de NVIDIA Vera Rubin alcanzando producción en masa agudiza el contraste estructural, manteniendo intacta la división subyacente del mercado incluso mientras los anuncios de SKU dual MAIA / MTIA permanecen pendientes.
text_locales.fil: Ang Google Cloud Next '26 Day 3 na nagdidiin sa TPU 8i inference-optimization (1,152 TPUs, 3x SRAM) ay nagpapatibay sa dual-track SKU split, habang ang NVIDIA Vera Rubin's 6-chip + Groq 3 LPU single-architecture stack na umaabot sa mass production ay pinatatalas ang structural contrast, na pinapanatili ang underlying market split kahit ang MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements ay nananatiling pending.

bridges.text: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform shipping a 7-chip single-architecture stack into mass production sharpens the structural contrast that the prediction draws — hyperscaler dual-track SKU on one side, NVIDIA single-architecture on the other — while keeping the underlying market split intact, even as MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements remain pending.

text_locales.en: NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform shipping a 7-chip single-architecture stack into mass production sharpens the structural contrast that the prediction draws — hyperscaler dual-track SKU on one side, NVIDIA single-architecture on the other — while keeping the underlying market split intact, even as MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements remain pending.
text_locales.ja: NVIDIAのVera Rubinプラットフォームが7チップ単一アーキテクチャスタックを量産にリリースしていることは、予測が描く構造的対比を鮮明にしている ― 一方ではハイパースケーラーのデュアルトラックSKU、他方ではNVIDIAの単一アーキテクチャ ― MAIA / MTIAデュアルSKUの発表が保留中であっても、根本的な市場分裂は維持されている。
text_locales.es: La plataforma Vera Rubin de NVIDIA enviando un stack de 7 chips de arquitectura única a producción en masa agudiza el contraste estructural que dibuja la predicción — SKU dual-track de hyperscaler en un lado, arquitectura única de NVIDIA en el otro — manteniendo intacta la división subyacente del mercado, incluso mientras los anuncios de SKU dual MAIA / MTIA permanecen pendientes.
text_locales.fil: Ang Vera Rubin platform ng NVIDIA na nagpapadala ng 7-chip single-architecture stack sa mass production ay nagpapatalas sa structural contrast na binubuod ng prediction — hyperscaler dual-track SKU sa isang panig, NVIDIA single-architecture sa kabilang panig — habang pinapanatili ang underlying market split, kahit na ang MAIA / MTIA dual-SKU announcements ay nakabinbin pa.

bridges.text: Thursday lands the procedural placement the end-Q2 2026 timeline depends on. Lawfare advances the classified-annex response clock to its sixth calendar day with the CISA Deputy Director and DARPA Director filing substantive submissions during the Thursday morning window, lifting the witness count to five of eight against a T-minus-one business day to the Friday May 22 deadline. Just Security calls five-of-eight at the third-quarter mark the steepest reading of the response curve to date and confirms OSTP holding the line that the order remains in interagency review with no signing window before May 22. The House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee converts Wednesday's formal markup notice into a posted Thursday-morning calendar item locking the parallel 30-day technical-review joint-resolution markup slot for the Wednesday May 27 morning session with the amendment-in-the-nature-of-a-substitute now circulated, and CSO Online confirms the CISA federal-civilian operational directive cleanly cleared its 12:00 ET remediation deadline.

text_locales.en: Thursday lands the procedural placement the end-Q2 2026 timeline depends on. Lawfare advances the classified-annex response clock to its sixth calendar day with the CISA Deputy Director and DARPA Director filing substantive submissions during the Thursday morning window, lifting the witness count to five of eight against a T-minus-one business day to the Friday May 22 deadline. Just Security calls five-of-eight at the third-quarter mark the steepest reading of the response curve to date and confirms OSTP holding the line that the order remains in interagency review with no signing window before May 22. The House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee converts Wednesday's formal markup notice into a posted Thursday-morning calendar item locking the parallel 30-day technical-review joint-resolution markup slot for the Wednesday May 27 morning session with the amendment-in-the-nature-of-a-substitute now circulated, and CSO Online confirms the CISA federal-civilian operational directive cleanly cleared its 12:00 ET remediation deadline.
text_locales.ja: 木曜日は、2026年第2四半期末までのタイムラインが依拠する手続き上の配置を着地させる。Lawfareは、機密附属書の回答の時計を6暦日目に進め、CISA副長官とDARPA長官が木曜日朝のウィンドウ内に実質的提出を行い、証人カウントを8人中5人へと押し上げ、金曜日5月22日期限まで営業日1日前にある。Just Securityは、第3四半期マークでの8人中5人を、これまでの回答曲線の最も急な読みと呼び、OSTPが命令を省庁間レビューにとどめ、5月22日以前は署名ウィンドウを開かない立場を維持していることを確認する。下院エネルギー・商業小委員会は、水曜日の正式マークアップ通知を、並行する30日間の技術審査の共同決議のマークアップ枠を、いまや回覧された代替性質修正条項とともに水曜日5月27日朝のセッションに固定する木曜日朝の掲示カレンダー項目へと変換し、CSO Onlineは、CISA連邦民間運用指令が12:00 ETの是正期限を無傷でクリアしたことを確認する。
text_locales.es: El jueves aterriza la colocación procedimental de la que depende la cronología de finales del segundo trimestre de 2026. Lawfare avanza el reloj de respuesta del anexo clasificado a su sexto día natural con el director adjunto de CISA y el director de DARPA presentando contribuciones sustantivas durante la ventana de la mañana del jueves, elevando el recuento de testigos a cinco de ocho frente a un T menos un día hábil del plazo del viernes 22 de mayo. Just Security llama a cinco de ocho en la marca de tres cuartos la lectura más pronunciada de la curva de respuesta hasta la fecha y confirma a la OSTP manteniéndose en que la orden permanece en revisión interagencial sin ninguna ventana de firma antes del 22 de mayo. El House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee convierte la notificación formal de marcado del miércoles en una entrada de calendario publicada el jueves por la mañana bloqueando la franja de marcado paralela de resolución conjunta de revisión técnica de 30 días para la sesión de la mañana del miércoles 27 de mayo con la enmienda en el carácter de un sustituto ahora circulada, y CSO Online confirma que la directiva operativa del ámbito civil federal de CISA despejó limpiamente su plazo de remediación de las 12:00 ET.
text_locales.fil: Inilalapag ng Huwebes ang procedural placement na kinabibilangan ng end-Q2 2026 timeline. Isinusulong ng Lawfare ang classified-annex response clock patungo sa ikaanim na calendar day nito kasama ang CISA Deputy Director at DARPA Director na naghahain ng substantibong submissions sa Thursday morning window, na nag-aangat sa witness count patungo sa lima sa walo laban sa isang T-minus-one business day sa Friday May 22 deadline. Tinatawag ng Just Security ang lima-sa-walo sa third-quarter mark bilang ang pinakamatarik na pagbabasa ng response curve hanggang ngayon at kinukumpirma na hawak ng OSTP ang linya na ang order ay nananatili sa interagency review nang walang signing window bago ang May 22. Kino-convert ng House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee ang Wednesday formal markup notice patungo sa isang nai-post na Thursday-morning calendar item na nag-lo-lock sa parallel 30-day technical-review joint-resolution markup slot para sa Wednesday May 27 morning session kasama ang amendment-in-the-nature-of-a-substitute na ngayon ay ipinakalat, at kinukumpirma ng CSO Online na malinis na natapos ng CISA federal-civilian operational directive ang 12:00 ET remediation deadline nito.

text_locales.ja: 水曜日は、2026年第2四半期末までのタイムラインが依拠する手続き上の配置を着地させた。機密附属書の回答の時計は5暦日目に進み、国家情報長官の事務所が、火曜日のCISA長官と月曜日のNIST Locascio提出に重ねて3件目の実質的提出を行い、金曜日5月22日の期限はいまや1営業日前にある。Just Securityは、附属書質問群を手続き上の最後の未解決ゲートとして改めて述べ、ペースの中点で8人の証人のうち3人が、見通しより急な側で記録されたと観察し、下院エネルギー・商業小委員会は、火曜日のカレンダー項目を、並行する30日間の技術審査の共同決議への水曜日朝のマークアップ正式通知に変換し、マークアップの枠が来週後半に固まる。
text_locales.es: El miércoles aterriza la colocación procedimental de la que depende la cronología de finales del segundo trimestre de 2026: el reloj de respuesta del anexo clasificado avanza hacia su quinto día natural con la oficina del director de Inteligencia Nacional presentando la tercera contribución sustantiva sobre las presentaciones del director de CISA del martes y del director del NIST, Locascio, del lunes, el plazo del viernes 22 de mayo ahora a T menos un día hábil. Just Security reafirma el conjunto de preguntas del anexo como el último bloqueo procedimental abierto con tres de ocho testigos en el expediente en el punto medio de la cadencia sobre el lado más pronunciado de lo proyectado, y el House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee convierte la entrada de calendario del martes en una notificación formal de marcado del miércoles por la mañana para la resolución conjunta paralela de revisión técnica de 30 días con la franja de marcado firmada para la segunda mitad de la próxima semana.
text_locales.fil: Inihahatid ng Miyerkules ang procedural placement na pinagbabatayan ng end-Q2 2026 timeline: sumusulong ang classified-annex response clock sa ikalimang calendar day nito kasama ang Office of the Director of National Intelligence na naghahain ng ikatlong substantibong submission sa ibabaw ng CISA Director submission ng Martes at ang NIST Locascio submission ng Lunes, ang Friday May 22 deadline ay nasa T-minus-one business day na ngayon. Muling sinasabi ng Just Security na ang annex question set ay ang huling bukas na procedural gate kasama ang tatlo sa walong saksi na nasa record sa kalagitnaan ng cadence sa mas matarik na panig ng projection, at kino-convert ng House Energy and Commerce Subcommittee ang Tuesday calendar entry patungo sa isang formal Wednesday-morning notice of markup para sa kahanay na 30-day technical-review joint resolution kasama ang markup slot na inilatag para sa ikalawang kalahati ng susunod na linggo.
