bridges.text: Friday hardens the schema-and-perimeter side without yet flipping a hyperscaler enforcement gate: the per-org agent registry GA footprint extends to a thirteenth Indo-Pacific region with Brunei the sole named-candidate remaining outside, the OECD GENAI working-group secretariat enters the second business day of the working-procedure review on the draft Recommendation text with all sixteen candidates plus the originating UK and EU in active delegation review at T-minus-eleven calendar days, and Mistral's six-vendor interop matrix confirms sixteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schema support at the early-June GA target.

text_locales.en: Friday hardens the schema-and-perimeter side without yet flipping a hyperscaler enforcement gate: the per-org agent registry GA footprint extends to a thirteenth Indo-Pacific region with Brunei the sole named-candidate remaining outside, the OECD GENAI working-group secretariat enters the second business day of the working-procedure review on the draft Recommendation text with all sixteen candidates plus the originating UK and EU in active delegation review at T-minus-eleven calendar days, and Mistral's six-vendor interop matrix confirms sixteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schema support at the early-June GA target.
text_locales.ja: 金曜日は、ハイパースケーラーのエンフォースメント・ゲートをまだ反転させずに、スキーマと境界の側を強固にする:org単位エージェント・レジストリのGAフットプリントが、ブルネイがフットプリント外に残る唯一の名指しされた候補となる状態で13番目のインド太平洋地域へと拡張し、OECD GENAIワーキンググループ事務局は、16の候補すべてに加えて発案元の英国とEUがT-マイナス-暦日11日前で積極的な代表団レビュー中の状態で、勧告草案テキストに対する作業手続きレビューの第2業務日へと入り、Mistralの6ベンダー相互運用マトリクスが、6月初旬のGA目標で16法域のテナントポリシー・スキーマのサポートを確認する。
text_locales.es: El viernes endurece el lado del esquema y del perímetro sin cambiar todavía una puerta de aplicación del hiperescalador: la huella de GA del registro de agente por organización se extiende a una decimotercera región del Indo-Pacífico con Brunéi como el único candidato nominado restante fuera, la secretaría del grupo de trabajo GENAI de la OCDE entra en el segundo día hábil de la revisión de procedimiento de trabajo sobre el borrador del texto de la Recomendación con los dieciséis candidatos más el Reino Unido y la UE de origen en revisión activa de delegación a T menos once días naturales, y la matriz de interoperabilidad de seis proveedores de Mistral confirma soporte de esquema de políticas de inquilino de dieciséis jurisdicciones en el objetivo de GA de comienzos de junio.
text_locales.fil: Pinapatatag ng Biyernes ang schema-and-perimeter side nang hindi pa nagfla-flip ng isang hyperscaler enforcement gate: pinapalawak ng per-org agent registry GA footprint patungo sa isang ikalabintatlong Indo-Pacific region kasama ang Brunei bilang nag-iisang named-candidate na nananatili sa labas, pumapasok ang OECD GENAI working-group secretariat sa ikalawang business day ng working-procedure review sa draft Recommendation text kasama ang lahat ng labing-anim na kandidato plus ang nagmumulang UK at EU sa active delegation review sa T-minus-eleven calendar days, at kinukumpirma ng Mistral six-vendor interop matrix ang sixteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schema support sa early-June GA target.

bridges.text: Thursday advances the schema-and-perimeter side: OpenAI's per-org agent registry extends GA to a twelfth Indo-Pacific region with the Hong Kong cloud region on Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex, the footprint continues tracking the sixteen-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter with Brunei the sole named-candidate remaining outside the GA footprint, OECD schema-comment submissions reach every named candidate eight days ahead of the May 29 close, and Mistral's six-vendor interop matrix confirms sixteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schema support at early-June GA.

text_locales.en: Thursday advances the schema-and-perimeter side: OpenAI's per-org agent registry extends GA to a twelfth Indo-Pacific region with the Hong Kong cloud region on Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex, the footprint continues tracking the sixteen-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter with Brunei the sole named-candidate remaining outside the GA footprint, OECD schema-comment submissions reach every named candidate eight days ahead of the May 29 close, and Mistral's six-vendor interop matrix confirms sixteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schema support at early-June GA.
text_locales.ja: 木曜日はスキーマと境界の側を前進させる:OpenAIのorg単位エージェント・レジストリは、Azure、AWS Bedrock、Google Cloud Vertexに香港クラウド地域を加えて12番目のインド太平洋地域へGAを拡張し、フットプリントは16法域の相互承認境界の追跡を続け、ブルネイがGAフットプリント外に残る唯一の名指しされた候補となり、OECDのスキーマコメント提出は5月29日のクローズまで8日前にすべての名指しされた候補に到達し、Mistralの6ベンダー相互運用マトリクスが、6月初旬のGAで16法域のテナントポリシー・スキーマのサポートを確認する。
text_locales.es: El jueves avanza el lado del esquema y el perímetro: el registro de agente por organización de OpenAI extiende su GA a una duodécima región del Indo-Pacífico con la región de la nube de Hong Kong en Azure, AWS Bedrock y Google Cloud Vertex, la huella sigue rastreando el perímetro de reciprocidad de dieciséis jurisdicciones con Brunei el único candidato nominado restante fuera de la huella de GA, las presentaciones de comentarios sobre el esquema de la OCDE alcanzan a todos los candidatos nominados ocho días por delante del cierre del 29 de mayo, y la matriz de interoperabilidad de seis proveedores de Mistral confirma soporte para esquemas de políticas de inquilino de dieciséis jurisdicciones en GA de comienzos de junio.
text_locales.fil: Isinusulong ng Huwebes ang schema-and-perimeter side: pinapalawak ng OpenAI per-org agent registry ang GA patungo sa isang ikalabindalawang Indo-Pacific region kasama ang Hong Kong cloud region sa Azure, AWS Bedrock, at Google Cloud Vertex, ang footprint ay patuloy na sumusubaybay sa sixteen-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter kasama ang Brunei bilang ang tanging named-candidate na nananatili sa labas ng GA footprint, umaabot ang OECD schema-comment submissions sa bawat named na kandidato walong araw nang mas maaga sa May 29 close, at kinukumpirma ng six-vendor interop matrix ng Mistral ang sixteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schema support sa early-June GA.

bridges.text: Wednesday advances the schema-and-perimeter side: OpenAI's per-org agent registry GA extends to an eleventh Indo-Pacific region with the Philippines on Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex and the footprint still tracking the now-sixteen-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter, the OECD schema-comment cohort crosses four-fifths of named candidates with the plenary at T-minus-thirteen days, and Mistral's six-vendor interop matrix confirms support for all sixteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schemas at early-June GA.

text_locales.en: Wednesday advances the schema-and-perimeter side: OpenAI's per-org agent registry GA extends to an eleventh Indo-Pacific region with the Philippines on Azure, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex and the footprint still tracking the now-sixteen-jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter, the OECD schema-comment cohort crosses four-fifths of named candidates with the plenary at T-minus-thirteen days, and Mistral's six-vendor interop matrix confirms support for all sixteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schemas at early-June GA.
text_locales.ja: 水曜日はスキーマ・境界側を前進させる。OpenAIの組織別エージェントレジストリのGAは、Azure、AWS Bedrock、Google Cloud Vertex上のフィリピンとともに、フットプリントが依然として、いまや16法域となった相互承認境界を追跡している状態で、インド太平洋の11番目のリージョンへと拡張し、OECDのスキーマコメント集団は、総会が暦日13日前にある状態で名指しされた候補の5分の4を越え、Mistralの6ベンダー相互運用マトリクスは、6月初旬のGAで16法域すべてのテナントポリシー・スキーマのサポートを確認している。
text_locales.es: El miércoles avanza el lado del esquema y el perímetro: la disponibilidad general del registro de agentes por organización de OpenAI se extiende a una undécima región del Indo-Pacífico con Filipinas en Azure, AWS Bedrock y Google Cloud Vertex y la huella todavía rastreando el perímetro de reciprocidad de ahora dieciséis jurisdicciones, el grupo de comentarios del esquema de la OCDE cruza cuatro quintos de los candidatos nominados con el plenario a T menos trece días, y la matriz de interoperabilidad de seis proveedores de Mistral confirma soporte para todos los esquemas de políticas de inquilino de dieciséis jurisdicciones en la disponibilidad general de comienzos de junio.
text_locales.fil: Sumusulong ang Miyerkules sa schema-and-perimeter na panig: pinalawak ng per-org agent registry GA ng OpenAI patungo sa isang ikalabing-isang Indo-Pacific region kasama ang Pilipinas sa Azure, AWS Bedrock, at Google Cloud Vertex at ang footprint ay patuloy pa rin na sumusubaybay sa ngayon-ay-labing-anim na jurisdiction reciprocity perimeter, lumampas ang OECD schema-comment cohort sa apat-na-kalimang ng named candidates kasama ang plenary sa T-minus-thirteen days, at kinukumpirma ng six-vendor interop matrix ng Mistral ang suporta para sa lahat ng labing-anim-jurisdiction tenant-policy schemas sa early-June GA.

bridges.text: Tuesday advances the schema-and-perimeter side of the prediction without yet showing a hyperscaler provisioning-time enforcement gate: OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry extended its general-availability footprint to a tenth Indo-Pacific region with Thailand, the cohort reads the footprint as still tracking the fifteen-jurisdiction perimeter rather than expanding ahead of it, the OECD GENAI attestation field schema submissions passed three-quarters of the candidate cohort on schedule for the June 2-6 plenary, and Mistral's interop matrix confirms shipping support for all fifteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schemas at its early-June GA target.

text_locales.en: Tuesday advances the schema-and-perimeter side of the prediction without yet showing a hyperscaler provisioning-time enforcement gate: OpenAI's ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry extended its general-availability footprint to a tenth Indo-Pacific region with Thailand, the cohort reads the footprint as still tracking the fifteen-jurisdiction perimeter rather than expanding ahead of it, the OECD GENAI attestation field schema submissions passed three-quarters of the candidate cohort on schedule for the June 2-6 plenary, and Mistral's interop matrix confirms shipping support for all fifteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schemas at its early-June GA target.
text_locales.ja: 火曜日は、ハイパースケーラーのプロビジョニング時の実施ゲートをまだ示すことなく、予想のスキーマ・境界側を前進させる。OpenAIのChatGPT Enterpriseの組織別エージェントレジストリは、その一般提供フットプリントをタイで10番目のインド太平洋リージョンへと拡張し、集団は、フットプリントが依然として15法域の境界に先んじるのではなく追跡していると読み、OECD GENAIの証明フィールドスキーマの提出は、6月2~6日総会に予定どおりで候補集団の4分の3を超え、Mistralの相互運用マトリクスは、6月初旬のGA目標で15法域のテナントポリシー・スキーマすべてをサポートで出荷することを確認している。
text_locales.es: El martes avanza el lado del esquema y el perímetro de la predicción sin mostrar aún un bloqueo de aplicación en tiempo de aprovisionamiento por parte de un hyperscaler: el registro de agentes por organización de ChatGPT Enterprise de OpenAI extendió su huella de disponibilidad general a una décima región del Indo-Pacífico con Tailandia, el grupo lee la huella como todavía rastreando el perímetro de quince jurisdicciones en lugar de expandirse por delante de él, las presentaciones del esquema de campos de atestación de la GENAI de la OCDE superaron los tres cuartos del grupo de candidatos según lo previsto para el plenario del 2 al 6 de junio, y la matriz de interoperabilidad de Mistral confirma el envío de soporte para todos los esquemas de políticas de inquilino de quince jurisdicciones en su objetivo de disponibilidad general de comienzos de junio.
text_locales.fil: Sumusulong ang Martes sa schema-and-perimeter na panig ng prediction nang hindi pa ipinapakita ang isang hyperscaler provisioning-time enforcement gate: pinalawig ng ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry ng OpenAI ang general-availability footprint nito sa isang ikasampung Indo-Pacific region kasama ang Thailand, binabasa ng cohort ang footprint bilang patuloy na sumusubaybay sa fifteen-jurisdiction perimeter sa halip na lumawak nang mas maaga rito, lumampas ang OECD GENAI attestation field schema submissions sa tatlong-kapat ng candidate cohort ayon sa iskedyul para sa June 2-6 plenary, at kinukumpirma ng interop matrix ng Mistral ang paglalabas ng suporta para sa lahat ng fifteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schemas sa early-June GA target nito.

bridges.text: Monday advances the schema-and-perimeter side: the OECD attestation field schema stays in member-state circulation for the June 2-6 plenary, and OpenAI's ninth-region agent registry plus Mistral's matrix both cite the fifteen-jurisdiction schema. But the registry footprint is described as tracking the perimeter, not enforcing a provisioning-time tenant gate.

text_locales.en: Monday advances the schema-and-perimeter side: the OECD attestation field schema stays in member-state circulation for the June 2-6 plenary, and OpenAI's ninth-region agent registry plus Mistral's matrix both cite the fifteen-jurisdiction schema. But the registry footprint is described as tracking the perimeter, not enforcing a provisioning-time tenant gate.
text_locales.ja: 月曜はスキーマと範囲の側面を前進させる。OECD のアテステーション・フィールドスキーマは6月2～6日の総会に向けて加盟国の回覧にとどまり、OpenAI の9番目のリージョンのエージェントレジストリと Mistral のマトリクスはいずれも15法域のスキーマを引用している。だがレジストリのフットプリントは、範囲を追従しているものであり、プロビジョニング時のテナントゲートを強制しているとは説明されていない。
text_locales.es: El lunes avanza el lado del esquema y el perímetro: el esquema de campos de atestación de la OCDE permanece en circulación entre los Estados miembros para el plenario del 2 al 6 de junio, y tanto el registro de agentes de novena región de OpenAI como la matriz de Mistral citan el esquema de quince jurisdicciones. Pero la huella del registro se describe como rastreando el perímetro, no aplicando un bloqueo de inquilino en tiempo de aprovisionamiento.
text_locales.fil: Isinusulong ng Lunes ang schema-and-perimeter na panig: nananatili ang OECD attestation field schema sa member-state circulation para sa June 2-6 plenary, at parehong binabanggit ng ninth-region agent registry ng OpenAI at ng matrix ng Mistral ang fifteen-jurisdiction schema. Ngunit ang registry footprint ay inilalarawan bilang sumusubaybay sa perimeter, hindi nagpapatupad ng isang provisioning-time tenant gate.

bridges.text: The OECD GENAI secretariat's finalized cyber-evaluation reciprocity attestation field schema circulates on schedule for the June 2-6 plenary, with member-state comment submissions past the halfway mark and the perimeter at fifteen named candidates. Mistral's five-vendor interop matrix already supports all fifteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schemas as an operative procurement primitive.

text_locales.en: The OECD GENAI secretariat's finalized cyber-evaluation reciprocity attestation field schema circulates on schedule for the June 2-6 plenary, with member-state comment submissions past the halfway mark and the perimeter at fifteen named candidates. Mistral's five-vendor interop matrix already supports all fifteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schemas as an operative procurement primitive.
text_locales.ja: OECDのGENAI事務局が確定したサイバー評価相互承認の証明フィールドスキーマは、6月2~6日の本会議に向けて予定通り回覧され、加盟国の意見提出は半分を過ぎ、範囲は15の指名候補にある。Mistralの5ベンダーの相互運用マトリックスは、運用上の調達の基本要素として、すでに15法域すべてのテナントポリシースキーマをサポートしている。
text_locales.es: El esquema de campos de atestación de reciprocidad de la evaluación cibernética finalizado por la secretaría de la GENAI de la OCDE circula según lo previsto para el plenario del 2 al 6 de junio, con las presentaciones de comentarios de los Estados miembros pasado el punto medio y el perímetro en quince candidatos nombrados. La matriz de interoperabilidad de cinco proveedores de Mistral ya soporta todos los esquemas de política de inquilinos de las quince jurisdicciones como una primitiva de adquisición operativa.
text_locales.fil: Umiikot ang finalized cyber-evaluation reciprocity attestation field schema ng OECD GENAI secretariat ayon sa iskedyul para sa June 2-6 plenary, na ang member-state comment submissions ay lampas na sa kalahatian at ang perimeter ay nasa labinlimang named candidate. Sumusuporta na ang five-vendor interop matrix ng Mistral sa lahat ng fifteen-jurisdiction tenant-policy schemas bilang isang operative procurement primitive.

bridges.text: Qatar's formal exploratory entry lifts the reciprocity perimeter to fifteen jurisdictions, the OECD GENAI attestation field schema is circulating for June plenary adoption, and OpenAI's per-org registry plus Mistral's interop matrix already cite those fields as their operative tenant-policy schema — the preconditions for a hyperscaler GA gate hold.

text_locales.en: Qatar's formal exploratory entry lifts the reciprocity perimeter to fifteen jurisdictions, the OECD GENAI attestation field schema is circulating for June plenary adoption, and OpenAI's per-org registry plus Mistral's interop matrix already cite those fields as their operative tenant-policy schema — the preconditions for a hyperscaler GA gate hold.
text_locales.ja: カタールの正式な探索的参加は相互承認の境界を15管轄区域へと引き上げ、OECD GENAIのアテステーション・フィールド・スキーマは6月総会での採択に向けて回覧されており、OpenAIの組織ごとレジストリとMistralの相互運用マトリクスはすでにそれらのフィールドを実効的なテナントポリシー・スキーマとして引用している——ハイパースケーラーのGAゲートの前提条件は維持されている。
text_locales.es: La incorporación formal de observador exploratorio de Catar eleva el perímetro de reciprocidad a quince jurisdicciones, el esquema de campos de atestación GENAI de la OCDE circula para su adopción en el plenario de junio, y el registro por organización de OpenAI más la matriz de interoperabilidad de Mistral ya citan esos campos como su esquema operativo de política de inquilinos — las precondiciones para un control de GA de los hiperescaladores se mantienen.
text_locales.fil: Itinataas ng pormal na exploratory entry ng Qatar ang reciprocity perimeter sa labinlimang hurisdiksiyon, umiikot ang OECD GENAI attestation field schema para sa June plenary adoption, at binabanggit na ng per-org registry ng OpenAI plus ng interop matrix ng Mistral ang mga field na iyon bilang kanilang operative tenant-policy schema — humahawak ang mga prekondisyon para sa isang hyperscaler GA gate.

bridges.text: The Codex CLI MCP-server-response prompt-injection-to-unsandboxed-shell-exec chain with Mandiant-confirmed Fortune 500 in-the-wild exploitation is the exact indirect-prompt-injection-to-secret-exfiltration pattern the Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration tops CIS/OWASP risk lists prediction (April 20) flagged as the precipitating exemplar — semantic match without yet a CIS or OWASP categorical announcement.

text_locales.en: The Codex CLI MCP-server-response prompt-injection-to-unsandboxed-shell-exec chain with Mandiant-confirmed Fortune 500 in-the-wild exploitation is the exact indirect-prompt-injection-to-secret-exfiltration pattern the Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration tops CIS/OWASP risk lists prediction (April 20) flagged as the precipitating exemplar — semantic match without yet a CIS or OWASP categorical announcement.
text_locales.ja: Codex CLIのMCPサーバー応答プロンプト・インジェクションからサンドボックス外shell-execへのチェーンは、MandiantがFortune 500の野生での悪用を確認した状態で、Agent-in-the-Loop Secret ExfiltrationがCIS/OWASPリスクリストの最上位を占める予想(4月20日)が先行例としてフラグ立てした、まさにその間接プロンプト・インジェクションからシークレット流出へのパターンである——CISもしくはOWASPのカテゴリ別発表をまだ伴わない意味的マッチ。
text_locales.es: La cadena de inyeccion-de-prompt-de-respuesta-de-servidor-MCP-a-shell-exec-sin-sandbox del Codex CLI con explotacion Fortune 500 en estado salvaje confirmada por Mandiant es el patron exacto de inyeccion-indirecta-de-prompt-a-exfiltracion-de-secretos que la prediccion de Exfiltracion de Secretos Agent-in-the-Loop encabeza listas de riesgo CIS/OWASP (20 de abril) senalo como el exemplar precipitante - coincidencia semantica sin aun un anuncio categorico de CIS u OWASP.
text_locales.fil: Ang Codex CLI MCP-server-response prompt-injection-to-unsandboxed-shell-exec chain kasama ng Mandiant-confirmed Fortune 500 in-the-wild exploitation ay ang eksaktong indirect-prompt-injection-to-secret-exfiltration pattern na flinag ng prediksyon ukol sa Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration tops CIS/OWASP risk lists (April 20) bilang ang precipitating exemplar — semantic match nang walang isang CIS o OWASP categorical announcement pa.

bridges.text: The agentic-AI credential-extraction surface stays a live, measured category — Sysdig holds the unprotected MCP-server extraction window at five minutes against a 67x protected gap, and Defender-for-Cloud quarantines tick to 47 percent of net-new servers. But the weekend surfaces no CIS or OWASP risk-list movement, so the top-of-list codification the prediction names is not evidenced.

text_locales.en: The agentic-AI credential-extraction surface stays a live, measured category — Sysdig holds the unprotected MCP-server extraction window at five minutes against a 67x protected gap, and Defender-for-Cloud quarantines tick to 47 percent of net-new servers. But the weekend surfaces no CIS or OWASP risk-list movement, so the top-of-list codification the prediction names is not evidenced.
text_locales.ja: エージェント型AIの認証情報抜き取りのサーフェスは、生きた測定されたカテゴリーとして維持されている——Sysdigは無防備なMCPサーバーの抜き取りのウィンドウを67倍の保護のギャップに対し5分に保ち、Defender for Cloudの隔離は新規サーバーの47パーセントに上昇している。しかし週末にはCISやOWASPのリスクリストの動きは浮上しておらず、予測が名指しするリスト最上位の成文化は証拠付けられていない。
text_locales.es: La superficie de extracción de credenciales de IA agéntica sigue siendo una categoría viva y medida —Sysdig mantiene la ventana de extracción de servidores MCP no protegidos en cinco minutos frente a una brecha protegida de 67x, y las cuarentenas de Defender for Cloud suben al 47 por ciento de los servidores de nueva incorporación—. Pero el fin de semana no aflora ningún movimiento en las listas de riesgo de CIS u OWASP, por lo que la codificación como primero de la lista que la predicción nombra no está evidenciada.
text_locales.fil: Nananatiling isang buhay, nasusukat na kategorya ang agentic-AI credential-extraction surface — hawak ng Sysdig ang unprotected MCP-server extraction window sa limang minuto laban sa isang 67x na protected gap, at umaakyat ang Defender-for-Cloud quarantines sa 47 porsiyento ng net-new servers. Ngunit walang CIS o OWASP risk-list na paggalaw na lumitaw sa katapusan ng linggo, kaya hindi napatunayan ang top-of-list codification na pinangalanan ng hula.

text_locales.es: El escape de sandbox de Antigravity y la creciente prevalencia de prompt-injection indirecto son exactamente las primitivas de causa subyacente para que aflore una clase de Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration — la evidencia de apoyo es buena pero aún no muestra movimiento en OWASP.
text_locales.fil: Ang Antigravity sandbox-escape at ang tumataas na indirect-prompt-injection prevalence ay eksaktong underlying-cause primitives para sa Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration class na lumitaw — ang supporting evidence ay maganda ngunit hindi pa nagpapakita ng OWASP movement.

text_locales.en: Pillar Security's Antigravity walkthrough showing the `find_by_name -X` flag insertion bypassing Secure Mode, CSO Online's framing of the same path as file-search-to-RCE, and the Cloud Security Alliance research note on agentic-IDE sandbox escape together confirm a third agentic-CI vendor exposed to the comment-style class, but no OWASP / CIS top-list category named for the pattern lands inside the window.
text_locales.ja: Pillar SecurityのAntigravityウォークスルー(`find_by_name -X`フラグ挿入によるSecure Modeバイパス)、CSO Onlineの同じパスをファイル検索からRCEへとフレーミング、Cloud Security Allianceのエージェンティック・IDEサンドボックス・エスケープに関するリサーチノートが共に、コメント・スタイルクラスにさらされる第3のエージェンティックCIベンダーを確認するが、パターンを名指しするOWASP / CIS上位リストカテゴリーはウィンドウ内に着地しない。
text_locales.es: El walkthrough de Antigravity de Pillar Security mostrando la inserción del flag `find_by_name -X` evadiendo Secure Mode, el encuadre de CSO Online de la misma vía como búsqueda-de-archivos-a-RCE, y la nota de investigación de Cloud Security Alliance sobre el escape de sandbox en IDE agéntico juntos confirman un tercer vendor de CI agéntico expuesto a la clase de estilo comentario, pero ninguna categoría top-list de OWASP / CIS nombrada para el patrón llega dentro de la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang Pillar Security's Antigravity walkthrough na nagpapakita ng `find_by_name -X` flag insertion na nilalampasan ang Secure Mode, ang CSO Online's framing ng parehong path bilang file-search-to-RCE, at ang Cloud Security Alliance research note sa agentic-IDE sandbox escape ay magkasamang nagkukumpirma ng pangatlong agentic-CI vendor na na-expose sa comment-style class, ngunit walang OWASP / CIS top-list category na pinangalanan para sa pattern ang lumapag sa loob ng window.

text_locales.en: The Hacker News' Nginx UI MCPwn writeup confirming a 2-request takeover via an empty default IP allowlist exposing 12 unauthenticated MCP tool calls reinforces the agent-credential-reachable precondition, but no OWASP / CIS top-list entry naming Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration as a category lands inside the window.
text_locales.ja: The Hacker NewsのNginx UI MCPwn分析が、12個の認証なしMCPツール・コールを公開する空のデフォルトIPアロウリスト経由の2リクエスト乗っ取りを確認し、エージェント認証情報到達可能の前提条件を補強しているが、ウィンドウ内ではAgent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltrationをカテゴリとして名指しするOWASP / CISトップリスト・エントリは登場していない。
text_locales.es: El writeup MCPwn de Nginx UI de The Hacker News confirmando una toma de control de 2 solicitudes vía una lista de IPs permitidas vacía por defecto exponiendo 12 llamadas a herramientas MCP no autenticadas refuerza la precondición agent-credential-reachable, pero ninguna entrada de top-list OWASP / CIS que nombre Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration como categoría aterriza dentro de la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang Nginx UI MCPwn writeup ng The Hacker News na nagpapatunay ng 2-request takeover sa pamamagitan ng empty default IP allowlist na naglalantad ng 12 unauthenticated MCP tool calls ay nagpapatibay sa agent-credential-reachable precondition, ngunit walang OWASP / CIS top-list entry na nagpapangalan sa Agent-in-the-Loop Secret Exfiltration bilang category na lumilitaw sa loob ng window.

bridges.text: Proofpoint's Mercor-to-Mythos connection — 4TB of credentials, biometrics, and API keys leaked through LiteLLM CI/CD becoming the entry path for a frontier-lab breach — plus Exabeam's ABA extension covering all 10 OWASP Agentic Top 10 categories and the formalized AI Insider Threat category across ChatGPT / Copilot / Gemini directly materialize the agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil precondition.

text_locales.en: Proofpoint's Mercor-to-Mythos connection — 4TB of credentials, biometrics, and API keys leaked through LiteLLM CI/CD becoming the entry path for a frontier-lab breach — plus Exabeam's ABA extension covering all 10 OWASP Agentic Top 10 categories and the formalized AI Insider Threat category across ChatGPT / Copilot / Gemini directly materialize the agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil precondition.
text_locales.ja: ProofpointのMercor-Mythos接続 ― LiteLLM CI/CDを通じて流出した4TBのクレデンシャル、バイオメトリクス、APIキーがフロンティア・ラボ侵害の侵入経路となった ― さらにOWASP Agentic Top 10の10カテゴリ全てをカバーするExabeamのABA拡張、ChatGPT / Copilot / Gemini横断で正式化されたAI Insider Threatカテゴリが、エージェント・イン・ザ・ループのクレデンシャル流出の前提条件を直接物質化する。
text_locales.es: La conexión Mercor-a-Mythos de Proofpoint — 4TB de credenciales, biometría y claves API filtrados a través del CI/CD de LiteLLM convirtiéndose en la ruta de entrada para una brecha de laboratorio de frontera — más la extensión de ABA de Exabeam cubriendo las 10 categorías del OWASP Agentic Top 10 y la categoría formalizada de AI Insider Threat en ChatGPT / Copilot / Gemini materializan directamente la precondición de exfil de credenciales agent-in-the-loop.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mercor-to-Mythos connection ng Proofpoint — 4TB ng credentials, biometrics, at API keys na nakaleak sa pamamagitan ng LiteLLM CI/CD na naging entry path para sa frontier-lab breach — kasama ang ABA extension ng Exabeam na sumasaklaw sa lahat ng 10 OWASP Agentic Top 10 categories at ang pormal na AI Insider Threat category sa ChatGPT / Copilot / Gemini ay direktang nagma-materialize sa agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil precondition.

bridges.text: The Mythos Preview day-one breach via contractor credentials + Mercor leak + naming reconstruction, alongside OAuth2 Proxy CVE-2026-40575's X-Forwarded-Uri auth bypass, both materialize the agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil shape with concrete real-world incidents reinforcing the precondition.

text_locales.en: The Mythos Preview day-one breach via contractor credentials + Mercor leak + naming reconstruction, alongside OAuth2 Proxy CVE-2026-40575's X-Forwarded-Uri auth bypass, both materialize the agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil shape with concrete real-world incidents reinforcing the precondition.
text_locales.ja: 契約者の認証情報 + Mercorのリーク + 命名再構築によるMythos Previewの初日侵害と、OAuth2 Proxy CVE-2026-40575のX-Forwarded-Uri認証バイパスは、いずれもエージェント・イン・ザ・ループの認証情報窃取の形を、前提条件を強化する具体的な実世界のインシデントで実現している。
text_locales.es: La brecha del día uno de Mythos Preview vía credenciales de contratista + filtración de Mercor + reconstrucción de nomenclatura, junto con el bypass de autenticación X-Forwarded-Uri de OAuth2 Proxy CVE-2026-40575, ambos materializan la forma de exfiltración de credenciales agent-in-the-loop con incidentes concretos del mundo real reforzando la precondición.
text_locales.fil: Ang day-one breach ng Mythos Preview sa pamamagitan ng contractor credentials + Mercor leak + naming reconstruction, kasama ang X-Forwarded-Uri auth bypass ng OAuth2 Proxy CVE-2026-40575, ay parehong nag-aaktwal sa agent-in-the-loop credential-exfil shape gamit ang konkretong real-world incidents na nagpapatibay sa precondition.

bridges.text: Vercel's confirmed supply-chain breach via Context.ai OAuth tokens — with the CEO pointing to AI-assisted attacker speed — and Antigravity's prompt-injection-to-RCE both materialize the agent-in-the-loop exfil shape, putting concrete real-world breaches behind the precondition that ties CI / agents to leaked secrets.

text_locales.en: Vercel's confirmed supply-chain breach via Context.ai OAuth tokens — with the CEO pointing to AI-assisted attacker speed — and Antigravity's prompt-injection-to-RCE both materialize the agent-in-the-loop exfil shape, putting concrete real-world breaches behind the precondition that ties CI / agents to leaked secrets.
text_locales.ja: Context.aiのOAuthトークン経由でVercelが確認したサプライチェーン侵害 — CEOがAI支援による攻撃者の速度を指摘 — と、AntigravityのプロンプトインジェクションからRCEへの転化のいずれもがagent-in-the-loop型の窃取形を実体化させ、CI / エージェントを漏洩した認証情報に結び付ける前提に具体的な現実世界の侵害事例を与えている。
text_locales.es: La brecha confirmada de cadena de suministro de Vercel via tokens OAuth de Context.ai — con el CEO senalando velocidad de atacante asistida por AI — y la RCE por inyeccion de prompt de Antigravity ambas materializan la forma de exfiltracion agente-en-el-loop, poniendo brechas reales concretas detras de la precondicion que ata CI / agentes a secretos filtrados.
text_locales.fil: Ang confirmed supply-chain breach ng Vercel sa pamamagitan ng Context.ai OAuth tokens — kung saan ang CEO ay tumuturo sa AI-assisted attacker speed — at ang prompt-injection-to-RCE ng Antigravity ay parehong nagma-materialize ng agent-in-the-loop exfil shape, naglalagay ng kongkretong real-world breaches sa likod ng precondition na nag-uugnay sa CI / agents sa leaked secrets.

nodes.description: **The "consumer-GPU coding agent" displaces the cloud-only coding API for ≥30% of dev workloads by Q3 2026.** Apr 22's Qwen3.6-27B (dense, beats 397B-A17B on SWE-bench Verified, **40 tok/s on RTX 3090 at Q4_K_M ~16.8 GB**) + Apr 23 Ollama MLX preview (1.57x prefill / 1.93x decode on M5 Max for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) + DeepSeek V4-Pro 75%-off API (**effectively ~28x cheaper than Claude Opus 4.7**) compose a **3-corner squeeze** on the proprietary frontier-API SaaS model. By Q3 2026, **enterprise dev tools default to a hybrid harness** — local Qwen 3.6-class for "coding, refactor, lint, test" + remote frontier API only for "long-horizon planning / multi-tool reasoning" — and all Big-3 IDEs (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) ship a **local-first toggle** by default. "Cloud-only coding agent" becomes a 2024-era artifact. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

By Q3 2026, **enterprise dev tools default to a hybrid harness** — local Qwen 3.6-class for "coding, refactor, lint, test" + remote frontier API only for "long-horizon planning / multi-tool reasoning" — and all Big-3 IDEs (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) ship a **local-first toggle** by default. "Cloud-only coding agent" becomes a 2024-era artifact. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「コンシューマGPUコーディング・エージェント」がQ3 2026までに開発者ワークロードの30%以上でクラウド専用コーディングAPIを置き換える。** 4月22日のQwen3.6-27B(密、SWE-bench Verifiedで397B-A17Bに勝利、**RTX 3090上Q4_K_M ~16.8 GBで40 tok/s**) + 4月23日のOllama MLXプレビュー(M5 Max上でQwen3.5-35B-A3Bが1.57x プリフィル / 1.93x デコード) + DeepSeek V4-Pro 75%オフAPI(**実質的にClaude Opus 4.7より~28x安い**)が、プロプライエタリ・フロンティアAPIのSaaSモデルに対する**3角圧搾**を構成する。Q3 2026までに、**企業の開発ツールはハイブリッド・ハーネスをデフォルトとする** ― 「コーディング、リファクタ、リント、テスト」にはローカルのQwen 3.6クラスを、「長期計画 / 多ツール推論」にはリモート・フロンティアAPIのみ ― そしてビッグ3 IDE(Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power)はすべて**ローカル・ファースト・トグル**をデフォルトで出荷する。「クラウド専用コーディング・エージェント」は2024年代の遺物となる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **El "agente de codificación con GPU de consumo" desplaza a la API de codificación solo en la nube para ≥30% de las cargas de desarrollo para Q3 2026.** Qwen3.6-27B del 22 de abril (denso, supera a 397B-A17B en SWE-bench Verified, **40 tok/s en RTX 3090 a Q4_K_M ~16.8 GB**) + el preview de Ollama MLX del 23 de abril (1.57x prefill / 1.93x decode en M5 Max para Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) + DeepSeek V4-Pro con API 75% de descuento (**efectivamente ~28x más barato que Claude Opus 4.7**) componen un **apretón de 3 esquinas** sobre el modelo SaaS de API de frontera propietaria. Para Q3 2026, **las herramientas de desarrollo empresariales adoptan por defecto un harness híbrido** — Qwen 3.6-class local para "codificación, refactor, lint, test" + API de frontera remota solo para "planificación de largo horizonte / razonamiento multi-herramienta" — y todos los IDE Big-3 (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) lanzan un **conmutador local-first** por defecto. "Agente de codificación solo en la nube" se convierte en un artefacto de la era de 2024. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

Ang "Cloud-only coding agent" ay nagiging 2024-era artifact. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference parity and Bonsai-8B at 1.15 GB keep the on-device side of the hybrid harness moving in step with the price compression.

text_locales.en: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite at $0.25 per million tokens stacks with DeepSeek V4 Pro and Qwen 3.6 to keep the three-corner cost squeeze on cloud-only coding APIs alive into May. Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference parity and Bonsai-8B at 1.15 GB keep the on-device side of the hybrid harness moving in step with the price compression.
text_locales.ja: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Liteの$0.25/百万トークンが、DeepSeek V4 ProとQwen 3.6と積層して、5月までクラウド専用コーディングAPIへの三角コスト圧迫を維持する。Unsloth 2026.4.8の推論パリティとBonsai-8Bの1.15 GBが、価格圧縮と歩調を合わせてハイブリッドハーネスのオンデバイス側を動かし続ける。
text_locales.es: Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite a $0.25 por millón de tokens se apila con DeepSeek V4 Pro y Qwen 3.6 para mantener vivo el apretón de costos de tres esquinas sobre las APIs de coding solo-nube hasta mayo. La paridad de inferencia de Unsloth 2026.4.8 y Bonsai-8B a 1.15 GB mantienen el lado on-device del harness híbrido moviéndose en sincronía con la compresión de precios.
text_locales.fil: Ang Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite sa $0.25 kada milyong tokens ay pinapatong sa DeepSeek V4 Pro at Qwen 3.6 upang panatilihin ang three-corner cost squeeze sa cloud-only coding APIs hanggang Mayo. Ang Unsloth 2026.4.8 inference parity at Bonsai-8B sa 1.15 GB ay nagpapanatili sa on-device side ng hybrid harness na kasabay ng price compression.

bridges.text: Foundry Local's Windows-native runtime, Unsloth's 20-30% inference speedup, and the Chinese open-weight stack together keep the consumer-GPU coding ceiling rising fast enough to ratify the predicted hybrid-harness shift inside enterprise IDEs.

text_locales.en: Foundry Local's Windows-native runtime, Unsloth's 20-30% inference speedup, and the Chinese open-weight stack together keep the consumer-GPU coding ceiling rising fast enough to ratify the predicted hybrid-harness shift inside enterprise IDEs.
text_locales.ja: Foundry LocalのWindowsネイティブランタイム、Unslothの20-30%推論高速化、中国のオープンウェイトスタックが、エンタープライズIDE内で予測されたハイブリッドハーネスシフトを批准するのに十分な速度でコンシューマーGPUコーディング天井を上げ続けている。
text_locales.es: El runtime nativo de Windows de Foundry Local, la aceleración de inferencia 20-30% de Unsloth, y la pila open-weight china juntos mantienen el techo de codificación de GPU de consumidor subiendo lo bastante rápido para ratificar el cambio predicho de harness híbrido dentro de los IDE empresariales.
text_locales.fil: Ang Windows-native runtime ng Foundry Local, ang 20-30% inference speedup ng Unsloth, at ang Chinese open-weight stack ay magkakasamang nagpapanatili ng pataas na consumer-GPU coding ceiling nang sapat na bilis upang i-ratify ang hinulang hybrid-harness shift sa loob ng enterprise IDEs.

bridges.text: Bonsai-8B at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's WinML execution-provider integration sustains the consumer-GPU-coding-agent thesis on the local side, while Codex CLI 0.128.0's model-provider-owned discovery pulls in the opposite direction by binding tooling more tightly to cloud accounts. Mixed signal — the local stack is densifying but the cloud stack is also defending.

text_locales.en: Bonsai-8B at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's WinML execution-provider integration sustains the consumer-GPU-coding-agent thesis on the local side, while Codex CLI 0.128.0's model-provider-owned discovery pulls in the opposite direction by binding tooling more tightly to cloud accounts. Mixed signal — the local stack is densifying but the cloud stack is also defending.
text_locales.ja: Bonsai-8BのiPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090スループットに加え、Foundry LocalのWinML実行プロバイダー統合は、ローカル側でコンシューマーGPUコーディングエージェントテーゼを支えるが、Codex CLI 0.128.0のモデルプロバイダー所有のディスカバリーは、ツールをクラウドアカウントにより緊密に結合することで反対方向に引っ張る。混合シグナル ― ローカルスタックは高密度化しているが、クラウドスタックも防衛している。
text_locales.es: Bonsai-8B con throughput en iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 más la integración del execution-provider WinML de Foundry Local sostiene la tesis de consumer-GPU-coding-agent en el lado local, mientras que el discovery model-provider-owned de Codex CLI 0.128.0 tira en dirección opuesta atando el tooling más fuertemente a las cuentas cloud. Señal mixta — el stack local se está densificando pero el stack cloud también se está defendiendo.
text_locales.fil: Ang Bonsai-8B sa iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus ang WinML execution-provider integration ng Foundry Local ay sumusuporta sa consumer-GPU-coding-agent thesis sa local side, habang ang model-provider-owned discovery ng Codex CLI 0.128.0 ay humahatak sa kabilang direksyon sa pamamagitan ng pagbubuklod ng tooling nang mas mahigpit sa cloud accounts. Mixed signal — ang local stack ay tumitindi ngunit ang cloud stack ay nagde-defend din.

bridges.text: Bonsai-8B 1-bit at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's ~20MB native library on WinML execution providers and vLLM v0.19.0 land the consumer-GPU coding-agent stack densely enough to support the 30%-displacement framing the prediction calls for. The cost-per-token squeeze is real and Windows-default integration is now in reach.

text_locales.en: Bonsai-8B 1-bit at iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput plus Foundry Local's ~20MB native library on WinML execution providers and vLLM v0.19.0 land the consumer-GPU coding-agent stack densely enough to support the 30%-displacement framing the prediction calls for. The cost-per-token squeeze is real and Windows-default integration is now in reach.
text_locales.ja: iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090スループットでのBonsai-8B 1ビットに加え、WinML実行プロバイダ上のFoundry Localの約20MBネイティブライブラリとvLLM v0.19.0は、予測が求める30%置換枠組みを支えるのに十分密に消費者向けGPUコーディングエージェントスタックを着地させる。トークンあたりコストの圧縮は本物であり、Windowsデフォルト統合は今や手の届く範囲にある。
text_locales.es: Bonsai-8B 1-bit a throughput de iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 más la librería nativa de ~20MB de Foundry Local sobre execution providers de WinML y vLLM v0.19.0 aterrizan el stack de coding-agent en GPU-de-consumidor lo suficientemente densamente como para soportar el encuadre de 30%-de-desplazamiento que pide la predicción. La compresión de costo-por-token es real y la integración por defecto en Windows está ahora al alcance.
text_locales.fil: Ang Bonsai-8B 1-bit sa iPhone / M4 Pro / RTX 4090 throughput kasama ang ~20MB native library ng Foundry Local sa WinML execution providers at ang vLLM v0.19.0 ay naglalapag ng consumer-GPU coding-agent stack na sapat ang lapot upang suportahan ang 30%-displacement framing na hinihingi ng prediction. Tunay ang cost-per-token squeeze at ang Windows-default integration ay malapit na.

text_locales.es: El despliegue de archivo-unico de 1.15 GB de Bonsai-8B a 368 tok/s en RTX 4090, el path de entrenamiento Gemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAM de Unsloth, y el orchestrator vendor-neutral de Multica v0.2.18 profundizan el stack de coding-agent on-device que la prediccion une. La presion de 3-esquinas sobre las APIs de codificacion solo-nube continua materializandose en hardware consumer.
text_locales.fil: Ang 1.15 GB single-file deployment ng Bonsai-8B sa 368 tok/s sa RTX 4090, ang Gemma-4-E2B 8 GB VRAM training path ng Unsloth, at ang vendor-neutral orchestrator ng Multica v0.2.18 ay nagpapalalim sa on-device coding-agent stack na pinagsasama-sama ng hula. Ang 3-corner squeeze sa cloud-only coding APIs ay patuloy na nag-mamaterialize sa consumer hardware.

detail.description: **The "consumer-GPU coding agent" displaces the cloud-only coding API for ≥30% of dev workloads by Q3 2026.** Apr 22's Qwen3.6-27B (dense, beats 397B-A17B on SWE-bench Verified, **40 tok/s on RTX 3090 at Q4_K_M ~16.8 GB**) + Apr 23 Ollama MLX preview (1.57x prefill / 1.93x decode on M5 Max for Qwen3.5-35B-A3B) + DeepSeek V4-Pro 75%-off API (**effectively ~28x cheaper than Claude Opus 4.7**) compose a **3-corner squeeze** on the proprietary frontier-API SaaS model. By Q3 2026, **enterprise dev tools default to a hybrid harness** — local Qwen 3.6-class for "coding, refactor, lint, test" + remote frontier API only for "long-horizon planning / multi-tool reasoning" — and all Big-3 IDEs (Cursor / Windsurf / Kiro Power) ship a **local-first toggle** by default. "Cloud-only coding agent" becomes a 2024-era artifact. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

nodes.title: Multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave breaks by H2 2026
nodes.description: By H2 2026 the OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock + Microsoft-license-non-exclusive reset triggers a multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave — at least one Big-3 hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) publishes per-model latency / throughput / availability SLAs as a single comparable disclosure, and at least one non-OpenAI foundation lab (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) ships a mirror "frontier on every cloud" deal with parallel SLA disclosure. Apr 27 Microsoft–OpenAI partnership reset removed the cloud-exclusivity clause; Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock (limited preview) is the first cross-cloud frontier-model deployment in the post-exclusivity world; Apr 30 Codex CLI 0.128.0 model-provider-owned discovery + AWS Bedrock account-state exposure is the developer-side primitive; Apr 28 AWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview is the orchestration substrate; Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA + Toolbox preview is the parallel non-Bedrock path. The forcing function is enterprise procurement — once frontier models cross-deploy, the buyer's first comparison stops being "model" and starts being "model+SLA on cloud-of-record". The first SLA-standardization mover is most likely AWS Bedrock (because Bedrock has the broadest model selection and the strongest enterprise compliance posture); the first non-OpenAI mirror is most likely Anthropic given the Apr 27 Microsoft non-exclusive language explicitly applies to "OpenAI products" and creates white-space for parallel deals.

description.en: By H2 2026 the OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock + Microsoft-license-non-exclusive reset triggers a multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave — at least one Big-3 hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) publishes per-model latency / throughput / availability SLAs as a single comparable disclosure, and at least one non-OpenAI foundation lab (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) ships a mirror "frontier on every cloud" deal with parallel SLA disclosure. Apr 27 Microsoft–OpenAI partnership reset removed the cloud-exclusivity clause; Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock (limited preview) is the first cross-cloud frontier-model deployment in the post-exclusivity world; Apr 30 Codex CLI 0.128.0 model-provider-owned discovery + AWS Bedrock account-state exposure is the developer-side primitive; Apr 28 AWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview is the orchestration substrate; Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA + Toolbox preview is the parallel non-Bedrock path. The forcing function is enterprise procurement — once frontier models cross-deploy, the buyer's first comparison stops being "model" and starts being "model+SLA on cloud-of-record". The first SLA-standardization mover is most likely AWS Bedrock (because Bedrock has the broadest model selection and the strongest enterprise compliance posture); the first non-OpenAI mirror is most likely Anthropic given the Apr 27 Microsoft non-exclusive language explicitly applies to "OpenAI products" and creates white-space for parallel deals.
description.ja: 2026年下半期までに、OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock+Microsoftライセンス非排他リセットがマルチクラウドのフロンティアモデルSLA標準化の波を引き起こす ― 少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラー(AWS、Azure、GCP)がモデル別のレイテンシ／スループット／可用性SLAを単一の比較可能な開示として公表し、少なくとも1つの非OpenAIファウンデーションラボ(Anthropic、Google DeepMind、xAI)が並行するSLA開示を伴う「すべてのクラウド上のフロンティア」のミラー契約を出荷する。4月27日のMicrosoft–OpenAIパートナーシップリセットはクラウド排他性条項を取り除き、4月28日のOpenAI-on-Bedrock(限定プレビュー)はポスト排他性世界における最初のクロスクラウドフロンティアモデル展開となり、4月30日のCodex CLI 0.128.0のモデルプロバイダー所有のディスカバリー+AWS Bedrockアカウント状態の公開は開発者側のプリミティブであり、4月28日のAWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js+AgentCore CLI 14リージョンGA+Managed Harness 4リージョンプレビューはオーケストレーション基盤であり、4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA+Toolboxプレビューは並行する非Bedrockのパスである。強制関数は企業調達である ― フロンティアモデルがクロスデプロイされると、買い手の最初の比較は「モデル」ではなく「記録対象クラウド上のモデル+SLA」になる。最初のSLA標準化の動きはAWS Bedrockの可能性が最も高い(Bedrockは最も広範なモデル選択と最強のエンタープライズコンプライアンス姿勢を持つため)。最初の非OpenAIミラーは、4月27日のMicrosoftの非排他言語が明示的に「OpenAI製品」に適用され、並行契約のためのホワイトスペースを作り出していることから、Anthropicの可能性が最も高い。
description.es: Para H2 2026 el reset OpenAI-en-AWS-Bedrock + licencia-no-exclusiva de Microsoft dispara una ola de estandarización de SLA multi-cloud para modelos frontera — al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 (AWS, Azure, GCP) publica SLAs por modelo de latencia / throughput / disponibilidad como una sola disclosure comparable, y al menos un foundation lab no-OpenAI (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) lanza un deal espejo de "frontera en cada cloud" con disclosure paralelo de SLA. El reset de partnership Microsoft–OpenAI del 27 abr removió la cláusula de cloud-exclusivity; OpenAI-en-Bedrock del 28 abr (preview limitado) es el primer despliegue cross-cloud de modelo frontera en el mundo post-exclusividad; el discovery model-provider-owned de Codex CLI 0.128.0 del 30 abr + la exposición de account-state de AWS Bedrock es la primitiva del lado developer; AgentCore Node.js de AWS Bedrock del 28 abr + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview es el sustrato de orquestación; Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA del 30 abr + Toolbox preview es la ruta paralela no-Bedrock. La función forzante es la procurement empresarial — una vez que los modelos frontera cross-deploy, la primera comparación del comprador deja de ser "modelo" y empieza a ser "modelo+SLA en cloud-of-record". El primer mover de estandarización de SLA es muy probablemente AWS Bedrock (porque Bedrock tiene la selección de modelos más amplia y la postura de compliance empresarial más fuerte); el primer espejo no-OpenAI es muy probablemente Anthropic dado que el lenguaje no-exclusivo de Microsoft del 27 abr aplica explícitamente a "productos OpenAI" y crea white-space para deals paralelos.
description.fil: Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock + Microsoft-license-non-exclusive reset ay magti-trigger ng multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave — hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) ang maglalathala ng per-model latency / throughput / availability SLAs bilang single comparable disclosure, at hindi bababa sa isang non-OpenAI foundation lab (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) ang maglulunsad ng mirror "frontier on every cloud" deal na may parallel SLA disclosure. Ang Apr 27 Microsoft–OpenAI partnership reset ang nag-alis ng cloud-exclusivity clause; ang Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock (limited preview) ang unang cross-cloud frontier-model deployment sa post-exclusivity world; ang Apr 30 Codex CLI 0.128.0 model-provider-owned discovery + AWS Bedrock account-state exposure ang developer-side primitive; ang Apr 28 AWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview ang orchestration substrate; ang Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA + Toolbox preview ang parallel non-Bedrock path. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise procurement — kapag nag-cross-deploy na ang frontier models, ang unang paghahambing ng buyer ay hindi na "model" lang kundi "model+SLA on cloud-of-record". Ang unang SLA-standardization mover ay malamang AWS Bedrock (dahil ang Bedrock ang may pinakamalawak na model selection at pinakamalakas na enterprise compliance posture); ang unang non-OpenAI mirror ay malamang Anthropic dahil ang Apr 27 Microsoft non-exclusive language ay explicit na nag-aapply sa "OpenAI products" at lumilikha ng white-space para sa parallel deals.

summary.ja: 2026年下半期までに、OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock+Microsoftライセンス非排他リセットがマルチクラウドのフロンティアモデルSLA標準化の波を引き起こす ― 少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラー(AWS、Azure、GCP)がモデル別のレイテンシ／スループット／可用性SLAを単一の比較可能な開示として公表し、少なくとも1つの非OpenAIファウンデーションラボ(Anthropic、Google DeepMind、xAI)が並行するSLA開示を伴う「すべてのクラウド上のフロンティア」のミラー契約を出荷する。4月27日のMicrosoft–OpenAIパートナーシップリセットはクラウド排他性条項を取り除き、4月28日のOpenAI-on-Bedrock(限定プレビュー)はポスト排他性世界における最初のクロスクラウドフロンティアモデル展開となり、4月30日のCodex CLI 0.128.0のモデルプロバイダー所有のディスカバリー+AWS Bedrockアカウント状態の公開は開発者側のプリミティブであり、4月28日のAWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js+AgentCore CLI 14リージョンGA+Managed Harness 4リージョンプレビューはオーケストレーション基盤であり、4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA+Toolboxプレビューは並行する非Bedrockのパスである。強制関数は企業調達である ― フロンティアモデルがクロスデプロイされると、買い手の最初の比較は「モデル」ではなく「記録対象クラウド上のモデル+SLA」になる。最初のSLA標準化の動きはAWS Bedrockの可能性が最も高い(Bedrockは最も広範なモデル選択と最強のエンタープライズコンプライアンス姿勢を持つため)。最初の非OpenAIミラーは、4月27日のMicrosoftの非排他言語が明示的に「OpenAI製品」に適用され、並行契約のためのホワイトスペースを作り出していることから、Anthropicの可能性が最も高い。
summary.es: Para H2 2026 el reset OpenAI-en-AWS-Bedrock + licencia-no-exclusiva de Microsoft dispara una ola de estandarización de SLA multi-cloud para modelos frontera — al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 (AWS, Azure, GCP) publica SLAs por modelo de latencia / throughput / disponibilidad como una sola disclosure comparable, y al menos un foundation lab no-OpenAI (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) lanza un deal espejo de "frontera en cada cloud" con disclosure paralelo de SLA. El reset de partnership Microsoft–OpenAI del 27 abr removió la cláusula de cloud-exclusivity; OpenAI-en-Bedrock del 28 abr (preview limitado) es el primer despliegue cross-cloud de modelo frontera en el mundo post-exclusividad; el discovery model-provider-owned de Codex CLI 0.128.0 del 30 abr + la exposición de account-state de AWS Bedrock es la primitiva del lado developer; AgentCore Node.js de AWS Bedrock del 28 abr + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview es el sustrato de orquestación; Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA del 30 abr + Toolbox preview es la ruta paralela no-Bedrock. La función forzante es la procurement empresarial — una vez que los modelos frontera cross-deploy, la primera comparación del comprador deja de ser "modelo" y empieza a ser "modelo+SLA en cloud-of-record". El primer mover de estandarización de SLA es muy probablemente AWS Bedrock (porque Bedrock tiene la selección de modelos más amplia y la postura de compliance empresarial más fuerte); el primer espejo no-OpenAI es muy probablemente Anthropic dado que el lenguaje no-exclusivo de Microsoft del 27 abr aplica explícitamente a "productos OpenAI" y crea white-space para deals paralelos.
summary.fil: Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock + Microsoft-license-non-exclusive reset ay magti-trigger ng multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave — hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) ang maglalathala ng per-model latency / throughput / availability SLAs bilang single comparable disclosure, at hindi bababa sa isang non-OpenAI foundation lab (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) ang maglulunsad ng mirror "frontier on every cloud" deal na may parallel SLA disclosure. Ang Apr 27 Microsoft–OpenAI partnership reset ang nag-alis ng cloud-exclusivity clause; ang Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock (limited preview) ang unang cross-cloud frontier-model deployment sa post-exclusivity world; ang Apr 30 Codex CLI 0.128.0 model-provider-owned discovery + AWS Bedrock account-state exposure ang developer-side primitive; ang Apr 28 AWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview ang orchestration substrate; ang Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA + Toolbox preview ang parallel non-Bedrock path. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise procurement — kapag nag-cross-deploy na ang frontier models, ang unang paghahambing ng buyer ay hindi na "model" lang kundi "model+SLA on cloud-of-record". Ang unang SLA-standardization mover ay malamang AWS Bedrock (dahil ang Bedrock ang may pinakamalawak na model selection at pinakamalakas na enterprise compliance posture); ang unang non-OpenAI mirror ay malamang Anthropic dahil ang Apr 27 Microsoft non-exclusive language ay explicit na nag-aapply sa "OpenAI products" at lumilikha ng white-space para sa parallel deals.

detail.description: By H2 2026 the OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock + Microsoft-license-non-exclusive reset triggers a multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave — at least one Big-3 hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) publishes per-model latency / throughput / availability SLAs as a single comparable disclosure, and at least one non-OpenAI foundation lab (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) ships a mirror "frontier on every cloud" deal with parallel SLA disclosure. Apr 27 Microsoft–OpenAI partnership reset removed the cloud-exclusivity clause; Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock (limited preview) is the first cross-cloud frontier-model deployment in the post-exclusivity world; Apr 30 Codex CLI 0.128.0 model-provider-owned discovery + AWS Bedrock account-state exposure is the developer-side primitive; Apr 28 AWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview is the orchestration substrate; Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA + Toolbox preview is the parallel non-Bedrock path. The forcing function is enterprise procurement — once frontier models cross-deploy, the buyer's first comparison stops being "model" and starts being "model+SLA on cloud-of-record". The first SLA-standardization mover is most likely AWS Bedrock (because Bedrock has the broadest model selection and the strongest enterprise compliance posture); the first non-OpenAI mirror is most likely Anthropic given the Apr 27 Microsoft non-exclusive language explicitly applies to "OpenAI products" and creates white-space for parallel deals.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年下半期までに、OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock+Microsoftライセンス非排他リセットがマルチクラウドのフロンティアモデルSLA標準化の波を引き起こす ― 少なくとも1つのBig-3ハイパースケーラー(AWS、Azure、GCP)がモデル別のレイテンシ／スループット／可用性SLAを単一の比較可能な開示として公表し、少なくとも1つの非OpenAIファウンデーションラボ(Anthropic、Google DeepMind、xAI)が並行するSLA開示を伴う「すべてのクラウド上のフロンティア」のミラー契約を出荷する。4月27日のMicrosoft–OpenAIパートナーシップリセットはクラウド排他性条項を取り除き、4月28日のOpenAI-on-Bedrock(限定プレビュー)はポスト排他性世界における最初のクロスクラウドフロンティアモデル展開となり、4月30日のCodex CLI 0.128.0のモデルプロバイダー所有のディスカバリー+AWS Bedrockアカウント状態の公開は開発者側のプリミティブであり、4月28日のAWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js+AgentCore CLI 14リージョンGA+Managed Harness 4リージョンプレビューはオーケストレーション基盤であり、4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA+Toolboxプレビューは並行する非Bedrockのパスである。強制関数は企業調達である ― フロンティアモデルがクロスデプロイされると、買い手の最初の比較は「モデル」ではなく「記録対象クラウド上のモデル+SLA」になる。最初のSLA標準化の動きはAWS Bedrockの可能性が最も高い(Bedrockは最も広範なモデル選択と最強のエンタープライズコンプライアンス姿勢を持つため)。最初の非OpenAIミラーは、4月27日のMicrosoftの非排他言語が明示的に「OpenAI製品」に適用され、並行契約のためのホワイトスペースを作り出していることから、Anthropicの可能性が最も高い。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para H2 2026 el reset OpenAI-en-AWS-Bedrock + licencia-no-exclusiva de Microsoft dispara una ola de estandarización de SLA multi-cloud para modelos frontera — al menos un hyperscaler Big-3 (AWS, Azure, GCP) publica SLAs por modelo de latencia / throughput / disponibilidad como una sola disclosure comparable, y al menos un foundation lab no-OpenAI (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) lanza un deal espejo de "frontera en cada cloud" con disclosure paralelo de SLA. El reset de partnership Microsoft–OpenAI del 27 abr removió la cláusula de cloud-exclusivity; OpenAI-en-Bedrock del 28 abr (preview limitado) es el primer despliegue cross-cloud de modelo frontera en el mundo post-exclusividad; el discovery model-provider-owned de Codex CLI 0.128.0 del 30 abr + la exposición de account-state de AWS Bedrock es la primitiva del lado developer; AgentCore Node.js de AWS Bedrock del 28 abr + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview es el sustrato de orquestación; Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA del 30 abr + Toolbox preview es la ruta paralela no-Bedrock. La función forzante es la procurement empresarial — una vez que los modelos frontera cross-deploy, la primera comparación del comprador deja de ser "modelo" y empieza a ser "modelo+SLA en cloud-of-record". El primer mover de estandarización de SLA es muy probablemente AWS Bedrock (porque Bedrock tiene la selección de modelos más amplia y la postura de compliance empresarial más fuerte); el primer espejo no-OpenAI es muy probablemente Anthropic dado que el lenguaje no-exclusivo de Microsoft del 27 abr aplica explícitamente a "productos OpenAI" y crea white-space para deals paralelos.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang OpenAI-on-AWS-Bedrock + Microsoft-license-non-exclusive reset ay magti-trigger ng multi-cloud frontier-model SLA standardization wave — hindi bababa sa isang Big-3 hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, GCP) ang maglalathala ng per-model latency / throughput / availability SLAs bilang single comparable disclosure, at hindi bababa sa isang non-OpenAI foundation lab (Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI) ang maglulunsad ng mirror "frontier on every cloud" deal na may parallel SLA disclosure. Ang Apr 27 Microsoft–OpenAI partnership reset ang nag-alis ng cloud-exclusivity clause; ang Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock (limited preview) ang unang cross-cloud frontier-model deployment sa post-exclusivity world; ang Apr 30 Codex CLI 0.128.0 model-provider-owned discovery + AWS Bedrock account-state exposure ang developer-side primitive; ang Apr 28 AWS Bedrock AgentCore Node.js + AgentCore CLI 14-region GA + Managed Harness 4-region preview ang orchestration substrate; ang Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework 1.0 GA + Toolbox preview ang parallel non-Bedrock path. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise procurement — kapag nag-cross-deploy na ang frontier models, ang unang paghahambing ng buyer ay hindi na "model" lang kundi "model+SLA on cloud-of-record". Ang unang SLA-standardization mover ay malamang AWS Bedrock (dahil ang Bedrock ang may pinakamalawak na model selection at pinakamalakas na enterprise compliance posture); ang unang non-OpenAI mirror ay malamang Anthropic dahil ang Apr 27 Microsoft non-exclusive language ay explicit na nag-aapply sa "OpenAI products" at lumilikha ng white-space para sa parallel deals.

bridges.text: Saturday consolidates the full mitigation as a fine-tuning default: Unsloth carries the six-surface agent-loader mitigation and now executes the canonical three-paper conformance reference run as a ninth validation pass on every training-driver invocation, the three contributed 60B-class MoE ports hold green across the reproduction cycle, and the DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe draws a fourteenth Hacker News reproduction.

text_locales.en: Saturday consolidates the full mitigation as a fine-tuning default: Unsloth carries the six-surface agent-loader mitigation and now executes the canonical three-paper conformance reference run as a ninth validation pass on every training-driver invocation, the three contributed 60B-class MoE ports hold green across the reproduction cycle, and the DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe draws a fourteenth Hacker News reproduction.
text_locales.ja: 土曜日は、ファインチューニング・デフォルトとして完全緩和を統合する:Unslothは6サーフェスのエージェント・ローダー緩和を担い、いまや標準的な3論文の適合性リファレンスランを、学習ドライバーの呼び出しごとに9番目の検証パスとして実行し、3件の寄稿された60BクラスのMoEポートは再現サイクルにわたってグリーンを保ち、DeepSeek R3-Pro 38Bレシピは14回目のHacker News再現を引き出す。
text_locales.es: El sábado consolida la mitigación completa como un por defecto de ajuste fino: Unsloth lleva la mitigación de cargadores de agentes de seis superficies y ejecuta ahora la ejecución de la referencia canónica de conformidad de tres artículos como una novena pasada de validación en cada invocación del controlador de entrenamiento, los tres ports contribuidos de clase 60B de MoE se mantienen en verde a lo largo del ciclo de reproducción, y la receta DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B atrae una decimocuarta reproducción de Hacker News.
text_locales.fil: Pinagsasama ng Sabado ang buong mitigation bilang isang fine-tuning default: dinadala ng Unsloth ang six-surface agent-loader mitigation at ngayon ay nagpapatakbo ng canonical three-paper conformance reference run bilang isang ikasiyam na validation pass sa bawat training-driver invocation, humahawak ang tatlong contributed 60B-class MoE ports ng green sa kabuuan ng reproduction cycle, at umaakit ang DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe ng isang ikalabing-apat na Hacker News reproduction.

bridges.text: Friday's Unsloth changelog wires full client-side support for the arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment companion into the router-only LoRA training driver, carries the full six-surface mitigation coverage, and runs the canonical two-paper reference as an eighth validation pass on every training-driver invocation; a thirteenth Hacker News reproduction lands and the Mixtral-Next 70B MoE port merges stable.

text_locales.en: Friday's Unsloth changelog wires full client-side support for the arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment companion into the router-only LoRA training driver, carries the full six-surface mitigation coverage, and runs the canonical two-paper reference as an eighth validation pass on every training-driver invocation; a thirteenth Hacker News reproduction lands and the Mixtral-Next 70B MoE port merges stable.
text_locales.ja: 金曜日のUnslothのチェンジログは、arxiv 2605.08019応用展開コンパニオンへの完全なクライアント側サポートをルーターのみのLoRA学習ドライバーへ配線し、フルな6サーフェスの緩和カバレッジを担い、学習ドライバーの呼び出しごとに標準的な2文書のリファレンスを8番目の検証パスとして実行する。13回目のHacker News再現が着地し、Mixtral-Next 70B MoEポートが安定としてマージされる。
text_locales.es: El registro de cambios del viernes de Unsloth cablea soporte completo del lado del cliente para el complemento de despliegue aplicado arxiv 2605.08019 en el controlador de entrenamiento LoRA solo de enrutador, lleva la cobertura completa de mitigación de seis superficies, y ejecuta la referencia canónica de dos artículos como una octava pasada de validación en cada invocación del controlador de entrenamiento; aterriza una decimotercera reproducción de Hacker News y el port de Mixtral-Next 70B MoE se fusiona estable.
text_locales.fil: Ina-wire ng Friday Unsloth changelog ang ganap na client-side support para sa arxiv 2605.08019 applied-deployment companion sa router-only LoRA training driver, dinadala ang buong six-surface mitigation coverage, at nagpapatakbo ng canonical two-paper reference bilang isang ikawalong validation pass sa bawat training-driver invocation; lumalapag ang isang ikalabintatlong Hacker News reproduction at nagme-merge ang Mixtral-Next 70B MoE port bilang stable.

bridges.text: Thursday's Unsloth changelog adds a roughly 0.3 percent further peak combined VRAM reduction on the DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B MoE recipe via a layer-norm bucket-fusion micro-pass on top of Wednesday's router-attention fusion, carries the full five-surface coverage plus the optional sixth tenant-policy-attestation manifest, and now runs the consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run as a seventh validation pass; a twelfth Hacker News reproduction lands and a fourth contributor merges the OLMo-2 60B MoE port as a stable recipe.

text_locales.en: Thursday's Unsloth changelog adds a roughly 0.3 percent further peak combined VRAM reduction on the DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B MoE recipe via a layer-norm bucket-fusion micro-pass on top of Wednesday's router-attention fusion, carries the full five-surface coverage plus the optional sixth tenant-policy-attestation manifest, and now runs the consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run as a seventh validation pass; a twelfth Hacker News reproduction lands and a fourth contributor merges the OLMo-2 60B MoE port as a stable recipe.
text_locales.ja: 木曜日のUnslothのチェンジログは、水曜日のルーターアテンション融合の上のレイヤーノルム・バケット融合マイクロパスを介して、DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B MoEレシピでピーク合計VRAMの約0.3パーセントのさらなる削減を加え、5サーフェスのフルカバレッジに加えてオプションの6番目のテナントポリシー証明マニフェストを担い、いまや、統合サーベイのエンドツーエンドの適合性ランを7番目の検証パスとして実行する。12回目のHacker News再現が着地し、4人目の貢献者がOLMo-2 60B MoEポートを安定したレシピとしてマージする。
text_locales.es: El registro de cambios de Unsloth del jueves añade una reducción adicional de aproximadamente el 0,3 por ciento del VRAM combinado pico sobre la receta DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B MoE a través de una pasada micro de fusión de buckets de capa norm sobre la fusión de atención de enrutador del miércoles, lleva la cobertura completa de cinco superficies más el manifiesto de atestación de políticas de inquilino opcional sexto, y ejecuta ahora la ejecución de conformidad de extremo a extremo de la revisión de consolidación como una séptima pasada de validación; una duodécima reproducción de Hacker News aterriza y un cuarto colaborador fusiona el port OLMo-2 60B MoE como una receta estable.
text_locales.fil: Nagdadagdag ang Thursday Unsloth changelog ng tinatayang 0.3 porsiyentong karagdagang peak combined VRAM reduction sa DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B MoE recipe sa pamamagitan ng isang layer-norm bucket-fusion micro-pass sa ibabaw ng router-attention fusion ng Miyerkules, dinadala ang full five-surface coverage plus ang opsyonal na ikaanim na tenant-policy-attestation manifest, at ngayon ay nagpapatakbo ng consolidation-survey end-to-end conformance run bilang isang ikapitong validation pass; lumapag ang isang ikalabindalawang Hacker News reproduction at nagme-merge ang isang ikaapat na contributor sa OLMo-2 60B MoE port bilang isang stable recipe.

bridges.text: Wednesday's Unsloth changelog adds a roughly 0.4 percent further peak combined VRAM reduction on the DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B Mixture-of-Experts recipe via a router-attention bucket-fusion pass on top of Tuesday's all-reduce schedule refinement, confirms the full five-surface agent-loader mitigation coverage continues to ship, and wires the optional tenant-policy-attestation manifest verification step as the sixth surface alongside Tuesday's training-surface checkpoint-provenance step; the community recipe drew an eleventh Hacker News reproduction on a hybrid RTX 5090 plus RTX 4090 consumer workstation and a third contributor merged the Qwen3 MoE 60B port as a stable contributed recipe, with a Wednesday Hugging Face Blog post logging the refined router-only path plus the manifest verification step stable across the full single-node multi-GPU tier.

text_locales.en: Wednesday's Unsloth changelog adds a roughly 0.4 percent further peak combined VRAM reduction on the DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B Mixture-of-Experts recipe via a router-attention bucket-fusion pass on top of Tuesday's all-reduce schedule refinement, confirms the full five-surface agent-loader mitigation coverage continues to ship, and wires the optional tenant-policy-attestation manifest verification step as the sixth surface alongside Tuesday's training-surface checkpoint-provenance step; the community recipe drew an eleventh Hacker News reproduction on a hybrid RTX 5090 plus RTX 4090 consumer workstation and a third contributor merged the Qwen3 MoE 60B port as a stable contributed recipe, with a Wednesday Hugging Face Blog post logging the refined router-only path plus the manifest verification step stable across the full single-node multi-GPU tier.
text_locales.ja: 水曜日のUnslothのチェンジログは、火曜日のall-reduceスケジュール精緻化の上にルーターアテンションのバケット融合パスを経由してDeepSeek R3-Pro 38B Mixture-of-ExpertsのレシピでピークVRAMをさらに約0.4パーセント削減し、5サーフェスのエージェント・ローダー緩和のフルカバレッジを引き続き担うことを明示的に確認し、いまや、火曜日の学習サーフェスのチェックポイント来歴ステップとともにオプションのテナントポリシー証明マニフェスト検証ステップを6番目のサーフェスとして配線している。コミュニティのレシピは、ハイブリッドRTX 5090プラスRTX 4090のコンシューマー・ワークステーションで11回目のHacker News再現を引き出し、3人目の貢献者がQwen3 MoE 60Bポートを安定した寄稿レシピとしてマージし、水曜日のHugging Face Blog投稿は、精緻化されたルーターのみの経路とマニフェスト検証ステップが、シングルノードのマルチGPU階層全体にわたって安定として記録されている。
text_locales.es: El registro de cambios del miércoles de Unsloth añade una reducción adicional de aproximadamente el 0,4 por ciento del VRAM combinado pico sobre la receta DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B de Mixture-of-Experts a través de una pasada de fusión de buckets de atención de enrutador sobre el refinamiento del programa all-reduce del martes, confirma que sigue ofreciendo la cobertura completa de mitigación de cargadores de agentes de cinco superficies, y cablea el paso opcional de verificación del manifiesto de atestación de políticas de inquilino como la sexta superficie junto al paso de procedencia de checkpoints de la superficie de entrenamiento del martes; la receta comunitaria atrajo una undécima reproducción de Hacker News en una estación de trabajo de consumidor híbrida con RTX 5090 más RTX 4090 y un tercer colaborador fusionó el port de Qwen3 MoE 60B como una receta contribuida estable, con una publicación del miércoles del blog de Hugging Face registrando la ruta refinada solo de enrutador más el paso de verificación del manifiesto como estables a lo largo del nivel completo de un solo nodo multi-GPU.
text_locales.fil: Nagdadagdag ang Wednesday Unsloth changelog ng tinatayang 0.4 porsiyento pang karagdagang peak combined VRAM reduction sa DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B Mixture-of-Experts recipe sa pamamagitan ng isang router-attention bucket-fusion pass sa ibabaw ng all-reduce schedule refinement ng Martes, kinukumpirma na patuloy na nagpapadala ng buong five-surface agent-loader mitigation coverage, at ina-wire ang opsyonal na tenant-policy-attestation manifest verification step bilang ang ikaanim na surface kasama ang Tuesday training-surface checkpoint-provenance step; ang community recipe ay umaakit ng ikalabing-isang Hacker News reproduction sa isang hybrid RTX 5090 plus RTX 4090 consumer workstation at isang ikatlong contributor ay nagmerge sa Qwen3 MoE 60B port bilang isang stable contributed recipe, kasama ang isang Wednesday Hugging Face Blog post na nag-lo-log sa pinino na router-only path plus ang manifest verification step bilang stable sa buong single-node multi-GPU tier.

bridges.text: Tuesday's Unsloth changelog tightens the MoE router-only LoRA path a further 0.6 percent on the DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe while explicitly continuing to carry the full five-surface agent-loader mitigation coverage, and is now wiring the optional training-surface checkpoint-provenance verification step from arxiv 2605.07588 directly into its router-only training driver — extending coverage beyond the five-surface bundle ahead of the LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, and Pydantic AI cohort's coordinated mid-June default. The community DeepSeek recipe drew a tenth Hacker News reproduction at roughly 5.0 percent peak combined VRAM, and Hugging Face logs the refined path stable across the full single-node multi-GPU tier.

The community DeepSeek recipe drew a tenth Hacker News reproduction at roughly 5.0 percent peak combined VRAM, and Hugging Face logs the refined path stable across the full single-node multi-GPU tier.
text_locales.ja: 火曜日のUnslothのチェンジログは、DeepSeek R3-Pro 38BレシピでMoEルーターのみのLoRA経路をさらに0.6パーセント引き締めつつ、5サーフェスのエージェント・ローダー緩和のフルカバレッジを引き続き担うことを明示的に確認し、いまやarxiv 2605.07588からのオプションの学習サーフェスのチェックポイント来歴検証ステップをルーターのみの学習ドライバーに直接配線し、LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI、Haystack、Pydantic AI集団の協調的な6月中旬のデフォルトに先んじて、5サーフェスバンドルを超えてカバレッジを拡張している。コミュニティのDeepSeekレシピは、ピーク合計VRAMで約5.0パーセントで10回目のHacker News再現を引き出し、Hugging Faceは精緻化された経路がシングルノードのマルチGPU階層の全幅にわたって安定であることを記録している。
text_locales.es: El registro de cambios del martes de Unsloth ajusta la ruta LoRA solo de enrutador de MoE un 0,6 por ciento adicional en la receta DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B mientras continúa explícitamente ofreciendo la cobertura completa de mitigación de cargadores de agentes de cinco superficies, y está ahora cableando el paso opcional de verificación de procedencia de checkpoints de la superficie de entrenamiento del arxiv 2605.07588 directamente en su controlador de entrenamiento solo de enrutador —extendiendo la cobertura más allá del paquete de cinco superficies por delante del valor por defecto coordinado de mediados de junio del grupo de LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack y Pydantic AI. La receta comunitaria DeepSeek atrajo una décima reproducción de Hacker News a aproximadamente el 5,0 por ciento del VRAM combinado pico, y Hugging Face registra la ruta refinada como estable a lo largo del nivel completo de un solo nodo multi-GPU.
text_locales.fil: Hinihigpitan ng Tuesday Unsloth changelog ang MoE router-only LoRA path nang karagdagang 0.6 porsiyento sa DeepSeek R3-Pro 38B recipe habang tahasang patuloy na dinadala ang buong five-surface agent-loader mitigation coverage, at ngayon ay ina-wire ang opsyonal na training-surface checkpoint-provenance verification step mula sa arxiv 2605.07588 nang direkta sa router-only training driver nito — na pinapalawig ang coverage lampas sa five-surface bundle bago ang coordinated mid-June default ng LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, Haystack, at Pydantic AI cohort. Ang community DeepSeek recipe ay umakit ng ikasampung Hacker News reproduction sa tinatayang 5.0 porsiyentong peak combined VRAM, at nilo-log ng Hugging Face ang pinino na path bilang stable sa buong single-node multi-GPU tier.
