title_locales.en: Hyperscaler-AI-lab capital coupling hardens into compute lock-in by Q3 2026
title_locales.ja: ハイパースケーラーとAIラボの資本連結が硬直化し、Q3 2026までにコンピュート・ロックインへ至る
title_locales.es: El acoplamiento de capital entre hyperscalers y laboratorios de IA se consolida en bloqueo de cómputo para Q3 2026
title_locales.fil: Tumitigas ang capital coupling ng hyperscaler-AI-lab tungo sa compute lock-in pagsapit ng Q3 2026

detail.summary_short: Google's Apr 24 $40B + 5GW commitment to Anthropic, Amazon's $25B + 5GW Trainium2/3 deal, and Microsoft's $13B+ to OpenAI mean each top-3 frontier lab has a hyperscaler underwriter paid in compute. By Q3 2026, model serving topology is expected to track funding origin and enterprise multi-cloud strategy is expected to shift from multi-runtime to multi-frontier-vendor.

summary_short_locales.en: Google's Apr 24 $40B + 5GW commitment to Anthropic, Amazon's $25B + 5GW Trainium2/3 deal, and Microsoft's $13B+ to OpenAI mean each top-3 frontier lab has a hyperscaler underwriter paid in compute. By Q3 2026, model serving topology is expected to track funding origin and enterprise multi-cloud strategy is expected to shift from multi-runtime to multi-frontier-vendor.
summary_short_locales.ja: Googleの4月24日のAnthropicへの$40B + 5GWコミット、Amazonの$25B + 5GW Trainium2/3取引、MicrosoftのOpenAI向け$13B+により、トップ3フロンティアラボのそれぞれにコンピュートで支払われるハイパースケーラーの引受先がつく。Q3 2026までに、モデル・サービング・トポロジーは資金源を追跡し、企業のマルチクラウド戦略はマルチランタイムからマルチ・フロンティア・ベンダーへのシフトが予想される。
summary_short_locales.es: El compromiso de $40B + 5GW de Google del 24 de abril con Anthropic, el acuerdo de $25B + 5GW Trainium2/3 de Amazon y los más de $13B de Microsoft a OpenAI significan que cada uno de los 3 principales laboratorios de frontera tiene un asegurador hyperscaler pagado en cómputo. Para Q3 2026, se espera que la topología de servicio de modelos rastree el origen de financiación y que la estrategia multi-cloud empresarial pase de multi-runtime a multi-vendor de frontera.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Apr 24 $40B + 5GW commitment ng Google sa Anthropic, ang $25B + 5GW Trainium2/3 deal ng Amazon, at ang $13B+ ng Microsoft sa OpenAI ay nangangahulugang bawat top-3 frontier lab ay may hyperscaler underwriter na bayad sa compute. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, inaasahan na ang model serving topology ay susunod sa funding origin at ang enterprise multi-cloud strategy ay inaasahang lilipat mula multi-runtime patungong multi-frontier-vendor.

bridges.text: Pentagon's May 1-3 8-vendor classified-network deal with Anthropic excluded as a supply-chain risk locks in the structural force the prediction names: once procurement freezes one frontier lab, the cohort recouples around the remaining vendors and serving topology tracks funding origin. Microsoft Agent 365 Registry Sync extends the same coupling into cross-cloud agent identity.

text_locales.en: Pentagon's May 1-3 8-vendor classified-network deal with Anthropic excluded as a supply-chain risk locks in the structural force the prediction names: once procurement freezes one frontier lab, the cohort recouples around the remaining vendors and serving topology tracks funding origin. Microsoft Agent 365 Registry Sync extends the same coupling into cross-cloud agent identity.
text_locales.ja: Pentagonの5月1-3日の8ベンダー機密ネットワーク契約でAnthropicがサプライチェーンリスクとして除外されたことは、予測が命名する構造的力をロックインする。調達が1つのフロンティアラボを凍結すれば、コホートは残りのベンダーを中心に再カップリングし、サービングトポロジーは資金提供元を追跡する。Microsoft Agent 365のレジストリ同期は同じカップリングをクラウド横断のエージェントIDへと拡張する。
text_locales.es: El acuerdo del Pentágono del 1-3 de mayo con 8 proveedores en la red clasificada con Anthropic excluido como riesgo de cadena de suministro fija la fuerza estructural que la predicción nombra: una vez que la contratación congela un laboratorio frontera, el cohorte se reacopla en torno a los proveedores restantes y la topología de servicio sigue el origen del financiamiento. Microsoft Agent 365 Registry Sync extiende el mismo acoplamiento hacia la identidad de agentes multi-nube.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 1-3 8-vendor classified-network deal ng Pentagon na inalis ang Anthropic bilang supply-chain risk ay nag-lo-lock in sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng prediction: kapag pinatigil ng procurement ang isang frontier lab, nagre-recouple ang cohort sa natitirang vendors at sumusunod ang serving topology sa funding origin. Pinapalawak ng Microsoft Agent 365 Registry Sync ang parehong coupling tungo sa cross-cloud agent identity.

bridges.text: OpenAI on Bedrock plus Anthropic's Trainium-native Opus 4.7 path are the operative compute-stack-lock-in primitives the prediction expects, and the Pentagon split adds a federal-procurement lever that further pins each lab to its underwriter cloud.

text_locales.en: OpenAI on Bedrock plus Anthropic's Trainium-native Opus 4.7 path are the operative compute-stack-lock-in primitives the prediction expects, and the Pentagon split adds a federal-procurement lever that further pins each lab to its underwriter cloud.
text_locales.ja: OpenAI on BedrockとAnthropicのTrainiumネイティブOpus 4.7経路は、予測が期待するコンピュートスタックロックインの運用上のプリミティブであり、ペンタゴンの分割は、各ラボを引受クラウドにさらに固定する連邦調達レバーを追加する。
text_locales.es: OpenAI en Bedrock más la ruta Opus 4.7 nativa de Trainium de Anthropic son las primitivas operativas de bloqueo de pila de cómputo que la predicción espera, y la división del Pentágono añade una palanca de contratación federal que fija aún más a cada laboratorio a su nube patrocinadora.
text_locales.fil: Ang OpenAI sa Bedrock kasama ang Trainium-native Opus 4.7 path ng Anthropic ay ang operative compute-stack-lock-in primitives na inaasahan ng prediction, at ang Pentagon split ay nagdaragdag ng federal-procurement lever na lalong nagpipinta sa bawat lab sa underwriter cloud nito.

bridges.text: The Apr 27 partnership reset and Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock launch shift the OpenAI-side relationship from exclusive Azure to multi-cloud, which is closer to multi-runtime than the multi-frontier-vendor lock-in shape the prediction projected. The structural premise is still intact through Anthropic-AWS-Trainium and Google-Anthropic, but today's tape pulls in the opposite direction on the OpenAI leg. Weak signal.

text_locales.en: The Apr 27 partnership reset and Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock launch shift the OpenAI-side relationship from exclusive Azure to multi-cloud, which is closer to multi-runtime than the multi-frontier-vendor lock-in shape the prediction projected. The structural premise is still intact through Anthropic-AWS-Trainium and Google-Anthropic, but today's tape pulls in the opposite direction on the OpenAI leg. Weak signal.
text_locales.ja: 4月27日のパートナーシップリセットと4月28日のOpenAI-on-Bedrockローンチは、OpenAI側の関係を排他的Azureからマルチクラウドへとシフトさせ、これは予測が投影したマルチフロンティアベンダーロックイン形状よりもマルチランタイムに近い。構造的前提はAnthropic-AWS-TrainiumとGoogle-Anthropicを通じて依然として無傷だが、本日のテープはOpenAI脚で反対方向に引っ張る。弱いシグナル。
text_locales.es: El reset de partnership del 27 abr y el lanzamiento OpenAI-en-Bedrock del 28 abr desplazan la relación del lado OpenAI de Azure exclusiva a multi-cloud, lo cual está más cerca de multi-runtime que de la forma de multi-frontier-vendor lock-in que la predicción proyectó. La premisa estructural sigue intacta a través de Anthropic-AWS-Trainium y Google-Anthropic, pero el tape de hoy tira en dirección opuesta en el leg de OpenAI. Señal débil.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 27 partnership reset at Apr 28 OpenAI-on-Bedrock launch ay naglilipat ng OpenAI-side relationship mula exclusive Azure sa multi-cloud, na mas malapit sa multi-runtime kaysa sa multi-frontier-vendor lock-in shape na ipina-project ng prediction. Ang structural premise ay buo pa rin sa pamamagitan ng Anthropic-AWS-Trainium at Google-Anthropic, ngunit ang tape ng araw na ito ay humahatak sa kabilang direksyon sa OpenAI leg. Weak signal.

bridges.text: Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate disclosure is the first per-AI-business single-line item from a hyperscaler — direct precedent for the compute-stack-lock-in disclosure leg. The Apr 27 AGI-clause-unwind retrospective combined with Anthropic-AWS Trainium + Graviton co-engineering reinforces the multi-frontier-vendor enterprise-strategy framing.

text_locales.en: Microsoft's $37B AI run-rate disclosure is the first per-AI-business single-line item from a hyperscaler — direct precedent for the compute-stack-lock-in disclosure leg. The Apr 27 AGI-clause-unwind retrospective combined with Anthropic-AWS Trainium + Graviton co-engineering reinforces the multi-frontier-vendor enterprise-strategy framing.
text_locales.ja: Microsoftの$37B AIランレート開示は、ハイパースケーラからのAI事業ごと初の単一行項目である — コンピューティングスタックロックイン開示脚の直接的な先例。4月27日のAGI条項巻き戻し振り返りに加え、Anthropic-AWS Trainium + Graviton共同エンジニアリングが、マルチフロンティアベンダーのエンタープライズ戦略枠組みを強化する。
text_locales.es: La disclosure del AI run-rate de $37B de Microsoft es el primer ítem de una sola línea por-AI-business desde un hyperscaler — precedente directo para la pata de disclosure de compute-stack-lock-in. El retrospectivo del unwind de la cláusula AGI del 27 abr combinado con la co-ingeniería Anthropic-AWS Trainium + Graviton refuerza el encuadre de estrategia empresarial multi-frontier-vendor.
text_locales.fil: Ang $37B AI run-rate disclosure ng Microsoft ay ang unang per-AI-business single-line item mula sa hyperscaler — direktang precedent para sa compute-stack-lock-in disclosure leg. Ang Apr 27 AGI-clause-unwind retrospective na pinagsama sa Anthropic-AWS Trainium + Graviton co-engineering ay nagpapatibay sa multi-frontier-vendor enterprise-strategy framing.

bridges.text: AWS's Apr 27 roundup binds Anthropic Opus 4.7 to Trainium and Bedrock + AgentCore Managed Harness while WSJ's Apr 28 selloff prices in the funding-origin coupling for OpenAI-linked names. The structural force the prediction names - frontier-model serving topology dictated by funding origin - is now actively pricing into the tape, with portability quietly receding.

text_locales.en: AWS's Apr 27 roundup binds Anthropic Opus 4.7 to Trainium and Bedrock + AgentCore Managed Harness while WSJ's Apr 28 selloff prices in the funding-origin coupling for OpenAI-linked names. The structural force the prediction names - frontier-model serving topology dictated by funding origin - is now actively pricing into the tape, with portability quietly receding.
text_locales.ja: AWSの4月27日ラウンドアップがAnthropic Opus 4.7をTrainiumとBedrock + AgentCore Managed Harnessに結びつける一方、WSJの4月28日売却はOpenAI関連銘柄の資金調達源結合をプライスインさせる。予測が指摘する構造的な力 - 資金調達源によって決定されるフロンティア・モデルのサービング・トポロジー - は今やテープに積極的にプライスインされており、ポータビリティは静かに後退している。
text_locales.es: El roundup del 27 de abril de AWS ata Anthropic Opus 4.7 a Trainium y Bedrock + AgentCore Managed Harness mientras el selloff del 28 de abril del WSJ pricea el acoplamiento funding-origin para nombres ligados a OpenAI. La fuerza estructural que la prediccion nombra - topologia de serving de modelo frontier dictada por funding origin - ahora esta priceandose activamente en la cinta, con la portabilidad retrocediendo silenciosamente.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 27 roundup ng AWS ay nagbubuklod ng Anthropic Opus 4.7 sa Trainium at Bedrock + AgentCore Managed Harness habang ang Apr 28 selloff ng WSJ ay nagpe-presyo sa funding-origin coupling para sa OpenAI-linked names. Ang structural force na pinapangalanan ng hula - frontier-model serving topology na idinidikta ng funding origin - ay ngayon aktibong nagpe-presyo sa tape, kasama ang portability na tahimik na umuurong.

bridges.text: Anthropic training on Trainium and Cowork running inside Bedrock are the compute-stack lock-in signature the prediction names; the OpenAI/Microsoft rewrite then multi-cloud-distributes its product line, recasting enterprise selection toward multi-frontier-vendor on shared silicon.

text_locales.en: Anthropic training on Trainium and Cowork running inside Bedrock are the compute-stack lock-in signature the prediction names; the OpenAI/Microsoft rewrite then multi-cloud-distributes its product line, recasting enterprise selection toward multi-frontier-vendor on shared silicon.
text_locales.ja: Anthropic が Trainium 上でトレーニングし Cowork が Bedrock 内部で動くことは、予測が指す計算スタック ロックインの署名そのものだ; その後 OpenAI / Microsoft 書き換えが製品ラインをマルチクラウド配信し、エンタープライズの選定を共有シリコン上のマルチフロンティアベンダーへと再キャストする。
text_locales.es: Anthropic entrenando en Trainium y Cowork ejecutándose dentro de Bedrock son la firma del compute-stack lock-in que nombra la predicción; la reescritura OpenAI/Microsoft luego distribuye multi-cloud su línea de productos, recasting la selección empresarial hacia multi-frontier-vendor sobre silicio compartido.
text_locales.fil: Ang Anthropic na nag-tre-train sa Trainium at ang Cowork na tumatakbo sa loob ng Bedrock ay ang compute-stack lock-in signature na pinangalanan ng prediction; ang OpenAI/Microsoft rewrite ay multi-cloud-distribute sa product line nito, ini-recast ang enterprise selection patungo sa multi-frontier-vendor sa shared silicon.

bridges.text: Today's news touches Glasswing partnerships and Hermes Agent's Bedrock integration, but neither is a new finance-pact-to-compute-stack signal — Apr 24's Google $40B / Anthropic remains the most recent capacity datum.

text_locales.en: Today's news touches Glasswing partnerships and Hermes Agent's Bedrock integration, but neither is a new finance-pact-to-compute-stack signal — Apr 24's Google $40B / Anthropic remains the most recent capacity datum.
text_locales.ja: 本日のニュースは Glasswing パートナーシップと Hermes Agent の Bedrock 統合に触れているが、いずれも新たな金融協定 → 計算スタック シグナルではない — 4/24 の Google $40B / Anthropic が依然として最新のキャパシティ データだ。
text_locales.es: Las noticias de hoy tocan las asociaciones de Glasswing y la integración de Bedrock de Hermes Agent, pero ninguna es una nueva señal de pacto-financiero-a-stack-de-cómputo — Google $40B / Anthropic del 24 de abril sigue siendo el dato de capacidad más reciente.
text_locales.fil: Ang balita ngayon ay humihipo sa Glasswing partnerships at sa Bedrock integration ng Hermes Agent, ngunit walang isa man sa mga ito ang bagong finance-pact-to-compute-stack signal — ang Apr 24 Google $40B / Anthropic ay nananatiling pinakahuling capacity datum.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **"Hyperscaler-AI-lab capital coupling" graduates from finance pact to compute-stack lock-in by Q3 2026.** Apr 24's Google **$40B + 5GW** to Anthropic + the prior Amazon **$25B + 5GW Trainium2/3** + Microsoft's existing $13B+ to OpenAI mean the **top 3 frontier labs each have a hyperscaler underwriter — paid partly in compute capacity, not cash**. By Q3 2026, **frontier-model serving topology becomes dictated by funding origin**: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 / 4.8 ships natively on Trainium2 + TPU v8 (Amazon + Google paths), OpenAI GPT-5.5 / 6 stays Azure-first, and Chinese frontier labs (DeepSeek V4 / Qwen 3.6-3.7) double down on Huawei Ascend (per the Apr 26 Bloomberg-CCTV piece). The "model-portability promise" of 2024-2025 quietly ends; **enterprise multi-cloud LLM strategy shifts from "multi-runtime" to "multi-frontier-vendor."** In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.es: **El "acoplamiento de capital entre hyperscalers y laboratorios de IA" pasa de pacto financiero a bloqueo de pila de cómputo para Q3 2026.** Los **$40B + 5GW** de Google a Anthropic del 24 de abril + los previos **$25B + 5GW Trainium2/3** de Amazon + los más de $13B existentes de Microsoft a OpenAI significan que **cada uno de los 3 principales laboratorios de frontera tiene un asegurador hyperscaler — pagado en parte en capacidad de cómputo, no en efectivo**. Para Q3 2026, **la topología de servicio de modelos de frontera queda dictada por el origen de financiación**: Anthropic Claude Opus 4.7 / 4.8 se desplegará nativamente en Trainium2 + TPU v8 (vías de Amazon + Google), OpenAI GPT-5.5 / 6 se mantendrá en Azure primero, y los laboratorios de frontera chinos (DeepSeek V4 / Qwen 3.6-3.7) doblarán la apuesta por Huawei Ascend (según la pieza de Bloomberg-CCTV del 26 de abril). bridges.text: The agentic-AI CVE class is consolidating into a recognized category: eleven catalogued tooling-stack instances now sit under a Trail of Bits four-tier taxonomy, a unified five-surface formal-verification model landed in arxiv 2605.07241, and the CISA federal-civilian directive incorporating that taxonomy is queued to publish. A DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic-Microsoft reference index covers all eleven patterns.

text_locales.en: The agentic-AI CVE class is consolidating into a recognized category: eleven catalogued tooling-stack instances now sit under a Trail of Bits four-tier taxonomy, a unified five-surface formal-verification model landed in arxiv 2605.07241, and the CISA federal-civilian directive incorporating that taxonomy is queued to publish. A DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic-Microsoft reference index covers all eleven patterns.
text_locales.ja: エージェント型AIのCVEクラスは、認知されたカテゴリへと統合されつつある。11件のカタログ化されたツールスタックのインスタンスがいまやTrail of Bitsの4階層の分類体系の下に置かれ、統合された5表面の形式検証モデルがarxiv 2605.07241に着地し、その分類体系を組み込んだCISAの連邦民間機関向け指令が公表待ちである。DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic-Microsoftの参照インデックスが11件のパターンすべてを網羅する。
text_locales.es: La clase de CVE de IA agéntica se está consolidando en una categoría reconocida: once instancias catalogadas de la pila de herramientas se sitúan ahora bajo una taxonomía de cuatro niveles de Trail of Bits, un modelo unificado de verificación formal de cinco superficies aterrizó en el arxiv 2605.07241, y la directiva civil-federal de la CISA que incorpora esa taxonomía está en cola para publicarse. Un índice de referencia de DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic-Microsoft cubre las once patrones.
text_locales.fil: Pinagsasama ang agentic-AI CVE class tungo sa isang kinikilalang kategorya: labing-isang nakatalang tooling-stack instance ang nasa ilalim na ngayon ng isang Trail of Bits four-tier taxonomy, isang pinag-isang five-surface formal-verification model ang bumagsak sa arxiv 2605.07241, at naka-iskedyul ang CISA federal-civilian directive na nagsasama sa taxonomy na iyon para ilathala. Isang DeepMind-Meta-Anthropic-Microsoft reference index ang sumasaklaw sa lahat ng labing-isang pattern.

bridges.text: An eleventh agentic-AI tooling CVE, Haystack CVE-2026-45013, lands and Trail of Bits expands its taxonomy to eleven checkpoint-and-manifest-loader instances, with a DeepMind, Meta, Anthropic, and Microsoft joint v4 addendum proving compositional safety and a CISA directive clearing the OMB queue. CVSS 8.0-plus LLM-integration CVEs are now a recurring fixture.

text_locales.en: An eleventh agentic-AI tooling CVE, Haystack CVE-2026-45013, lands and Trail of Bits expands its taxonomy to eleven checkpoint-and-manifest-loader instances, with a DeepMind, Meta, Anthropic, and Microsoft joint v4 addendum proving compositional safety and a CISA directive clearing the OMB queue. CVSS 8.0-plus LLM-integration CVEs are now a recurring fixture.
text_locales.ja: 11番目のエージェントAIツールのCVEであるHaystack CVE-2026-45013が着地し、Trail of Bitsはその分類体系を11件のチェックポイントおよびマニフェストローダーの事例へと拡張し、DeepMind、Meta、Anthropic、Microsoftの共同v4アデンダムが合成安全性を証明し、CISAの指令がOMBキューを通過する。CVSS 8.0超のLLM統合CVEは今や繰り返し現れる定番となっている。
text_locales.es: Un undécimo CVE de herramientas de IA agéntica, Haystack CVE-2026-45013, aterriza y Trail of Bits amplía su taxonomía a once instancias de cargadores de checkpoints y manifiestos, con un anexo conjunto v4 de DeepMind, Meta, Anthropic y Microsoft demostrando la seguridad composicional y una directiva de la CISA superando la cola de la OMB. Los CVE de integración de LLM con CVSS 8,0 o superior son ahora un elemento recurrente.
text_locales.fil: Isang ikalabing-isang agentic-AI tooling CVE, ang Haystack CVE-2026-45013, ang lumitaw at pinalawak ng Trail of Bits ang taxonomy nito tungo sa labing-isang checkpoint-and-manifest-loader instance, kasama ang isang DeepMind, Meta, Anthropic, at Microsoft joint v4 addendum na nagpapatunay ng compositional safety at isang CISA directive na nalampasan ang OMB queue. Ang CVSS 8.0-pataas na LLM-integration CVEs ay isa nang umuulit na fixture.

text_locales.es: CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7) donde los archivos checkpoint controlados por el atacante atraviesan la frontera de tool-call del agente via storage RAG conectado es el patron textbook adyacente a indirect-injection, emparejado con Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4), el par LangGraph mas LiteLLM y el escaneo del dia ocho de la KEV de n8n publicando -41.5% de instancias expuestas. Ambos nuevos CVEs anaden al OWASP GenAI Exploit feed, endureciendo la cadencia Patch-Tuesday que nombra la prediccion.
text_locales.fil: Ang CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 (CVSS 8.7) kung saan ang attacker-controlled checkpoint files ay tumatawid sa tool-call boundary ng agent sa pamamagitan ng connected RAG storage ay ang textbook indirect-injection-adjacent pattern, kasabay ng Haystack CVE-2026-44391 (CVSS 9.4), ang LangGraph plus LiteLLM pair, at ang n8n KEV day-eight scan na nagpo-post ng -41.5% exposed instances. Ang parehong bagong CVEs ay nadaragdag sa OWASP GenAI Exploit feed, pinatitigas ang Patch-Tuesday cadence na pinapangalanan ng prediction.

description.en: **OAuth trust between AI SaaS becomes the top enterprise risk.** The Vercel-Context.ai case shows how an employee's personal AI Office SaaS connection can turn into the breach path for the company's whole Google Workspace. By Q3 2026, major SSO providers (Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace) will **carve out an "AI extension" OAuth scope category**, letting administrators block "Allow All" defaults wholesale. CASB / SSPM vendors will report "data volume read by AI integrations" as an independent metric. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **AI SaaS間のOAuth信頼関係がエンタープライズ最大のリスクになる。** Vercel-Context.aiの事例は、従業員個人によるAIオフィスSaaS接続が、いかにして企業全体のGoogle Workspaceへの侵入経路へと変わり得るかを示している。2026年Q3までに、主要なSSOプロバイダー(Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace)は**「AI拡張」OAuthスコープのカテゴリを切り出す**ようになり、管理者が「Allow All」のデフォルトを一括で遮断できるようになる。CASB / SSPMベンダーは「AI連携によって読み取られたデータ量」を独立した指標として報告するようになる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La confianza OAuth entre AI SaaS se convierte en el principal riesgo empresarial.** El caso Vercel-Context.ai muestra como la conexion personal AI Office SaaS de un empleado puede convertirse en la ruta de brecha hacia todo el Google Workspace de la empresa. Para Q3 2026, los principales proveedores de SSO (Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace) **delimitaran una categoria de scope OAuth de "extension AI"**, permitiendo a los administradores bloquear masivamente los predeterminados "Permitir Todo". Los proveedores CASB / SSPM reportaran "volumen de datos leidos por integraciones AI" como una metrica independiente. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang OAuth trust sa pagitan ng AI SaaS ay nagiging top enterprise risk.** Ipinapakita ng Vercel-Context.ai case kung paano ang personal AI Office SaaS connection ng isang empleyado ay maaaring maging breach path sa buong Google Workspace ng kumpanya. Sa pamamagitan ng Q3 2026, ang malalaking SSO providers (Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace) ay **mag-cacarve out ng "AI extension" OAuth scope category**, na nagpapahintulot sa administrators na i-block ang "Allow All" defaults nang wholesale. Ang CASB / SSPM vendors ay magrereport ng "data volume read by AI integrations" bilang independent metric. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

By Q3 2026, SSO providers Okta, Entra ID, and Google Workspace are expected to carve out an AI-extension OAuth scope category, and CASB / SSPM vendors will report AI-integration read volume as an independent metric.

summary_short_locales.en: The Vercel-Context.ai breach demonstrates how an employee's personal AI SaaS OAuth connection turns into a path into the company's whole Google Workspace. By Q3 2026, SSO providers Okta, Entra ID, and Google Workspace are expected to carve out an AI-extension OAuth scope category, and CASB / SSPM vendors will report AI-integration read volume as an independent metric.
summary_short_locales.ja: Vercel-Context.aiの侵害は、従業員個人のAI SaaSへのOAuth接続が、企業全体のGoogle Workspaceへの侵入経路に転化する仕組みを実証している。2026年Q3までに、SSOプロバイダーであるOkta、Entra ID、Google WorkspaceはAI拡張用のOAuthスコープカテゴリを切り出すと見込まれ、CASB / SSPMベンダーはAI連携の読み取り量を独立した指標として報告するようになる。
summary_short_locales.es: La brecha Vercel-Context.ai demuestra como la conexion OAuth personal AI SaaS de un empleado se convierte en una ruta hacia todo el Google Workspace de la empresa. Para Q3 2026, se espera que los proveedores SSO Okta, Entra ID, y Google Workspace delimiten una categoria de scope OAuth de extension AI, y los proveedores CASB / SSPM reportaran el volumen de lectura de integraciones AI como una metrica independiente.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Vercel-Context.ai breach ay nagpapakita kung paano ang personal AI SaaS OAuth connection ng isang empleyado ay nagiging path papasok sa buong Google Workspace ng kumpanya. Sa pamamagitan ng Q3 2026, ang SSO providers na Okta, Entra ID, at Google Workspace ay inaasahang mag-cacarve out ng AI-extension OAuth scope category, at ang CASB / SSPM vendors ay magrereport ng AI-integration read volume bilang independent metric.

bridges.text: Airia's prompt-injection retrospective keeps the lethal-trifecta narrative warm, but today's evidence does not surface an SSO admin-console AI-extension scope category or a CASB / SSPM AI-integration read-volume metric, leaving the prediction neither pushed forward nor refuted.

text_locales.en: Airia's prompt-injection retrospective keeps the lethal-trifecta narrative warm, but today's evidence does not surface an SSO admin-console AI-extension scope category or a CASB / SSPM AI-integration read-volume metric, leaving the prediction neither pushed forward nor refuted.
text_locales.ja: Airiaのプロンプト・インジェクション・レトロスペクティブはlethal-trifectaのナラティブを温め続けているが、本日の証拠はSSO管理コンソールのAI拡張スコープ・カテゴリやCASB / SSPMのAI統合読み取り量メトリクスを浮上させておらず、予測は前進も反証もされていない。
text_locales.es: El retrospectivo de prompt-injection de Airia mantiene caliente la narrativa lethal-trifecta, pero la evidencia de hoy no surface una categoria de scope de extension-IA en consola de admin SSO ni una metrica de volumen-de-lectura de integracion-IA en CASB / SSPM, dejando la prediccion ni avanzada ni refutada.
text_locales.fil: Ang prompt-injection retrospective ng Airia ay pinananatiling mainit ang lethal-trifecta narrative, ngunit ang ebidensya ngayon ay hindi naglalabas ng SSO admin-console AI-extension scope category o CASB / SSPM AI-integration read-volume metric, na iniwan ang hula nang hindi naitulak pasulong o naitanggi.

detail.description: **OAuth trust between AI SaaS becomes the top enterprise risk.** The Vercel-Context.ai case shows how an employee's personal AI Office SaaS connection can turn into the breach path for the company's whole Google Workspace. By Q3 2026, major SSO providers (Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace) will **carve out an "AI extension" OAuth scope category**, letting administrators block "Allow All" defaults wholesale. CASB / SSPM vendors will report "data volume read by AI integrations" as an independent metric. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **AI SaaS間のOAuth信頼関係がエンタープライズ最大のリスクになる。** Vercel-Context.aiの事例は、従業員個人によるAIオフィスSaaS接続が、いかにして企業全体のGoogle Workspaceへの侵入経路へと変わり得るかを示している。2026年Q3までに、主要なSSOプロバイダー(Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace)は**「AI拡張」OAuthスコープのカテゴリを切り出す**ようになり、管理者が「Allow All」のデフォルトを一括で遮断できるようになる。CASB / SSPMベンダーは「AI連携によって読み取られたデータ量」を独立した指標として報告するようになる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **La confianza OAuth entre AI SaaS se convierte en el principal riesgo empresarial.** El caso Vercel-Context.ai muestra como la conexion personal AI Office SaaS de un empleado puede convertirse en la ruta de brecha hacia todo el Google Workspace de la empresa. Para Q3 2026, los principales proveedores de SSO (Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace) **delimitaran una categoria de scope OAuth de "extension AI"**, permitiendo a los administradores bloquear masivamente los predeterminados "Permitir Todo". Los proveedores CASB / SSPM reportaran "volumen de datos leidos por integraciones AI" como una metrica independiente. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang OAuth trust sa pagitan ng AI SaaS ay nagiging top enterprise risk.** Ipinapakita ng Vercel-Context.ai case kung paano ang personal AI Office SaaS connection ng isang empleyado ay maaaring maging breach path sa buong Google Workspace ng kumpanya. Sa pamamagitan ng Q3 2026, ang malalaking SSO providers (Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace) ay **mag-cacarve out ng "AI extension" OAuth scope category**, na nagpapahintulot sa administrators na i-block ang "Allow All" defaults nang wholesale. Ang CASB / SSPM vendors ay magrereport ng "data volume read by AI integrations" bilang independent metric. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.en: **The "Agent Control Plane" becomes the new battleground in hyperscaler competition.** Google's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, AWS Bedrock AgentCore's new Managed Harness / CLI / skills, and OpenAI's Workspace Agents all converge on the same strategy: **bind the agent lifecycle, audit, and governance into a single control plane.** By Q3 2026, Okta / Microsoft Entra ID / Google Workspace SSO layers will treat agent identifiers as first-class objects alongside humans and service accounts. CASB / SSPM vendors will measure "API calls touched by AI agents" with a separate SLO / risk score from human-user baselines. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **「エージェント・コントロールプレーン」がハイパースケーラー競争の新たな主戦場となる。** GoogleのGemini Enterprise Agent Platform、AWS Bedrock AgentCoreの新Managed Harness / CLI / skills、そしてOpenAIのWorkspace Agentsはすべて同じ戦略に収斂している。**エージェントのライフサイクル、監査、ガバナンスを単一のコントロールプレーンに統合する**ことだ。2026年Q3までに、Okta / Microsoft Entra ID / Google Workspace SSOレイヤーは、エージェント識別子を人間やサービスアカウントと並ぶファーストクラスのオブジェクトとして扱うようになる。CASB / SSPMベンダーは「AIエージェントが触れたAPIコール」を、人間ユーザーのベースラインとは別のSLO / リスクスコアで測定するようになる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **El "Plano de Control de Agentes" se convierte en el nuevo campo de batalla en la competencia entre hyperscalers.** Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform de Google, el nuevo Managed Harness / CLI / skills de AWS Bedrock AgentCore y Workspace Agents de OpenAI convergen todos en la misma estrategia: **integrar el ciclo de vida del agente, la auditoría y la gobernanza en un único plano de control.** Para el Q3 2026, las capas de SSO de Okta / Microsoft Entra ID / Google Workspace tratarán los identificadores de agente como objetos de primera clase junto con humanos y cuentas de servicio. Los proveedores de CASB / SSPM medirán las "llamadas a API tocadas por agentes de IA" con un SLO / puntuación de riesgo separado de las líneas base de usuarios humanos. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "Agent Control Plane" ay nagiging bagong larangan ng laban sa kompetisyon ng mga hyperscaler.** Ang Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform ng Google, ang bagong Managed Harness / CLI / skills ng AWS Bedrock AgentCore, at ang Workspace Agents ng OpenAI ay lahat nag-uumpisang nagsasama-sama sa parehong estratehiya: **i-bind ang agent lifecycle, audit, at governance sa iisang control plane.** Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang mga SSO layer ng Okta / Microsoft Entra ID / Google Workspace ay ituturing ang mga agent identifier bilang first-class object kasabay ng mga tao at service account. Ang mga vendor ng CASB / SSPM ay susukatin ang "API calls touched by AI agents" gamit ang hiwalay na SLO / risk score mula sa baseline ng human-user. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

because.es: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform de Google, AWS Bedrock AgentCore y Workspace Agents de OpenAI aterrizan en la misma ventana con una sola forma de plano de control.
because.fil: Ang Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, at OpenAI Workspace Agents ay sabay-sabay na bumagsak sa parehong window na may iisang hugis ng control-plane.

given.en: Enterprises need a single place to govern agent lifecycle, audit, and identity as agents proliferate across SaaS and infrastructure.
given.ja: エージェントがSaaSとインフラ全体に拡散する中、企業はエージェントのライフサイクル、監査、アイデンティティを統治する単一の場所を必要としている。
given.es: Las empresas necesitan un único lugar para gobernar el ciclo de vida del agente, la auditoría y la identidad a medida que los agentes proliferan en SaaS e infraestructura.
given.fil: Kailangan ng mga enterprise ng iisang lugar para pamahalaan ang agent lifecycle, audit, at identity habang dumadami ang mga agent sa kabuuan ng SaaS at infrastructure.

so_that.en: SSO providers treat agent IDs as first-class principals and CASB / SSPM vendors track AI-agent API calls under a separate risk score.
so_that.ja: SSOプロバイダがエージェントIDをファーストクラスのプリンシパルとして扱い、CASB / SSPMベンダーがAIエージェントのAPIコールを別のリスクスコアで追跡するようになる。
so_that.es: Los proveedores de SSO tratan los IDs de agentes como principales de primera clase y los proveedores de CASB / SSPM rastrean las llamadas a API de agentes de IA bajo una puntuación de riesgo separada.
so_that.fil: Ituturing ng mga SSO provider ang agent IDs bilang first-class principals at susubaybayan ng mga vendor ng CASB / SSPM ang AI-agent API calls sa ilalim ng hiwalay na risk score.

landing.en: By Q3 2026; Okta / Entra ID / Workspace agent-ID category + CASB / SSPM AI-agent metric live.
landing.ja: 2026年Q3までに、Okta / Entra ID / WorkspaceのエージェントIDカテゴリ + CASB / SSPMのAIエージェント指標が稼働する。
landing.es: Para el Q3 2026; categoría de agent-ID en Okta / Entra ID / Workspace + métrica de agente de IA en CASB / SSPM activa.
landing.fil: Pagsapit ng Q3 2026; live na ang Okta / Entra ID / Workspace agent-ID category + CASB / SSPM AI-agent metric.

plain_language.en: Three big clouds all built one place to manage AI agents this week. Soon login systems will treat agents like users with their own permissions.
plain_language.ja: 今週、3大クラウドがすべてAIエージェントを管理する場所を構築した。まもなくログインシステムはエージェントを独自の権限を持つユーザーのように扱うようになる。
plain_language.es: Tres grandes nubes construyeron esta semana un lugar para gestionar agentes de IA. Pronto los sistemas de inicio de sesión tratarán a los agentes como usuarios con sus propios permisos.
plain_language.fil: Tatlong malalaking cloud ang gumawa ng iisang lugar para pamahalaan ang AI agents ngayong linggo. Hindi magtatagal, ituturing ng mga login system ang mga agent na parang gumagamit na may sariling permission.

detail.summary_short: Google's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, and OpenAI Workspace Agents converge on a single agent-lifecycle control plane. By Q3 2026, Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace are expected to treat agent IDs as first-class principals while CASB / SSPM vendors carve out a separate risk metric for AI-agent API calls.

summary_short_locales.en: Google's Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, and OpenAI Workspace Agents converge on a single agent-lifecycle control plane. By Q3 2026, Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace are expected to treat agent IDs as first-class principals while CASB / SSPM vendors carve out a separate risk metric for AI-agent API calls.
summary_short_locales.ja: GoogleのGemini Enterprise Agent Platform、AWS Bedrock AgentCore、OpenAI Workspace Agentsが、単一のエージェントライフサイクル・コントロールプレーンに収斂した。2026年Q3までに、Okta / Entra ID / Google WorkspaceがエージェントIDをファーストクラスのプリンシパルとして扱い、CASB / SSPMベンダーがAIエージェントのAPIコールに対して別のリスク指標を切り出すと予想される。
summary_short_locales.es: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform de Google, AWS Bedrock AgentCore y Workspace Agents de OpenAI convergen en un único plano de control de ciclo de vida de agentes. Para el Q3 2026, se espera que Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace traten los IDs de agentes como principales de primera clase mientras los proveedores de CASB / SSPM destacan una métrica de riesgo separada para las llamadas a API de agentes de IA.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform ng Google, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, at OpenAI Workspace Agents ay nagsasama-sama sa iisang agent-lifecycle control plane. Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, inaasahang ituturing ng Okta / Entra ID / Google Workspace ang agent IDs bilang first-class principals habang ang mga vendor ng CASB / SSPM ay maglilihis ng hiwalay na risk metric para sa AI-agent API calls.

bridges.text: Today's parallel shipments — Novita Sandbox, Bedrock AgentCore Runtime Node.js, and Oracle's SuiteCloud Agent Skills — all reinforce the structural premise that the agent-runtime layer is hardening into a single control plane category. The signal is moderate: vendors are shipping mitigation and packaging primitives, but the SSO-treats-agents-as-first-class step the prediction calls for is not yet visible in any identity provider's release notes.

text_locales.en: Today's parallel shipments — Novita Sandbox, Bedrock AgentCore Runtime Node.js, and Oracle's SuiteCloud Agent Skills — all reinforce the structural premise that the agent-runtime layer is hardening into a single control plane category. The signal is moderate: vendors are shipping mitigation and packaging primitives, but the SSO-treats-agents-as-first-class step the prediction calls for is not yet visible in any identity provider's release notes.
text_locales.ja: 本日の並行出荷 — Novita Sandbox、Bedrock AgentCore Runtime Node.js、OracleのSuiteCloud Agent Skills — はすべて、エージェントランタイムレイヤーが単一のコントロールプレーンカテゴリーへと硬化しているという構造的前提を強化する。シグナルは中程度である:ベンダーは緩和とパッケージングのプリミティブを出荷しているが、予測が求めるSSOがエージェントを第一級として扱うステップは、まだどのIDプロバイダのリリースノートにも見られない。
text_locales.es: Los lanzamientos paralelos de hoy — Novita Sandbox, Bedrock AgentCore Runtime Node.js y SuiteCloud Agent Skills de Oracle — refuerzan la premisa estructural de que la capa de runtime de agentes se está consolidando en una sola categoría de control plane. La señal es moderada: los vendors están enviando primitivas de mitigación y empaquetado, pero el paso de SSO-trata-agentes-como-primera-clase que pide la predicción aún no es visible en las release notes de ningún proveedor de identidad.
text_locales.fil: Ang magkakatabing shipment ngayon — Novita Sandbox, Bedrock AgentCore Runtime Node.js, at SuiteCloud Agent Skills ng Oracle — ay lahat nagpapatibay sa structural premise na ang agent-runtime layer ay tumitigas tungo sa isang control plane category. Katamtaman ang signal: nagpapadala ang vendors ng mitigation at packaging primitives, ngunit ang SSO-treats-agents-as-first-class na hakbang na hinihingi ng prediction ay hindi pa nakikita sa anumang release notes ng identity provider.

text_locales.en: AgentCore Managed Harness + CLI + Skills on Kiro Power, Multica v0.2.18, and Apr 28's Novita Sandbox land in a single window: three independent agent-runtime tracks all converging on lifecycle, audit, and governance as a single control plane. That directly materializes the consequence the prediction projects, with Novita explicitly aiming at the marketplace-grade governance gap.
text_locales.ja: Kiro Power上のAgentCore Managed Harness + CLI + Skills、Multica v0.2.18、4月28日のNovita Sandboxが単一ウィンドウに上陸: 3つの独立したエージェント・ランタイム・トラックが、ライフサイクル、監査、ガバナンスを単一のコントロールプレーンとして収束させている。これは予測が投影する結果を直接物質化させ、Novitaは特にマーケットプレイス級ガバナンス・ギャップを明示的に狙っている。
text_locales.es: AgentCore Managed Harness + CLI + Skills en Kiro Power, Multica v0.2.18, y el Novita Sandbox del 28 de abril aterrizan en una sola ventana: tres tracks independientes de agent-runtime convergiendo en lifecycle, audit, y gobernanza como un solo control plane. Eso materializa directamente la consecuencia que la prediccion proyecta, con Novita apuntando explicitamente a la brecha de gobernanza de grado-mercado.
text_locales.fil: Ang AgentCore Managed Harness + CLI + Skills sa Kiro Power, Multica v0.2.18, at ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox ay lumalapag sa iisang window: tatlong independent agent-runtime tracks na lahat ay nagsasama-sama sa lifecycle, audit, at governance bilang iisang control plane. Iyon ay direktang nagma-materialize sa konsekwensyang ipino-project ng hula, kasama ang Novita na tahasang nakatuon sa marketplace-grade governance gap.

description.en: **Inference servers become the new "primitive supply chain" — Q3 2026 sees the first AI Infra-specific CVE class (LLM-INFRA-CWE) with mandatory NVD tagging.** The Apr 19-26 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m exploited)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) Jinja2 SSTI RCE** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + the Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain across Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot — composes a clear "inference-runtime + agentic-CI" attack-surface category. By Q3 2026, NIST/NVD adds a dedicated **"AI-Infra"** tag to its CVE schema, OWASP's LLM Top 10 v2026 promotes **"Inference Server Template / Loader RCE"** to a top-3 entry, and supply-chain SBOM tooling (Snyk / Wiz / Pillar / Lasso / Lakera) ships **per-engine signature feeds for vLLM / SGLang / LMDeploy / Triton / Ollama** as standard SKUs. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **推論サーバーが新たな「プリミティブ・サプライチェーン」となる ― Q3 2026に最初のAIインフラ専用CVEクラス(LLM-INFRA-CWE)がNVD強制タグ付きで登場する。** 4月19-26日のシーケンス ― **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF(12時間31分で悪用)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760(CVSS 9.8) Jinja2 SSTI RCE** + **PillarのAntigravityサンドボックス・エスケープ via `find_by_name -X`** + 4月21日のClaude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot横断のComment-and-Controlプロンプト・インジェクション・チェーン ― が、明確な「推論ランタイム + エージェンティックCI」の攻撃面カテゴリーを構成する。Q3 2026までに、NIST/NVDがCVEスキーマに専用の**「AI-Infra」**タグを追加し、OWASPのLLM Top 10 v2026が**「Inference Server Template / Loader RCE」**をトップ3エントリーに格上げし、サプライチェーンSBOMツール(Snyk / Wiz / Pillar / Lasso / Lakera)が**vLLM / SGLang / LMDeploy / Triton / Ollamaのエンジン別シグネチャ・フィード**を標準SKUとして出荷する。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Los servidores de inferencia se convierten en la nueva "cadena de suministro primitiva" — Q3 2026 ve la primera clase de CVE específica de infraestructura de IA (LLM-INFRA-CWE) con etiquetado obligatorio en NVD.** La secuencia del 19-26 de abril — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m explotado)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) Jinja2 SSTI RCE** + **escape de sandbox de Antigravity de Pillar mediante `find_by_name -X`** + la cadena Comment-and-Control de inyección de prompts del 21 de abril a través de Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot — compone una clara categoría de superficie de ataque "runtime de inferencia + CI agéntico". Para Q3 2026, NIST/NVD añade una etiqueta dedicada **"AI-Infra"** a su esquema CVE, el OWASP LLM Top 10 v2026 promueve **"RCE en Plantilla / Cargador de Servidor de Inferencia"** a una entrada top-3, y las herramientas SBOM de cadena de suministro (Snyk / Wiz / Pillar / Lasso / Lakera) lanzan **feeds de firmas por motor para vLLM / SGLang / LMDeploy / Triton / Ollama** como SKUs estándar. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

text_locales.en: The CISA operational directive folding the eleven-CVE agent-loader taxonomy into a near-term publication is the regulatory crystallization of the inference-runtime-plus-agentic-tooling attack-surface category the prediction names, and vLLM v0.11.4-rc2, SGLang RadixArk, and Hugging Face TGI each now carry the full five-surface mitigation set — the per-engine signed-load posture anticipated as a standard inference-server primitive.
text_locales.ja: 11件のCVEのエージェント・ローダー分類体系を近い将来の公表に折り込むCISAの運用指令は、予測が名指しする推論ランタイムとエージェント型ツールの攻撃サーフェスのカテゴリーの規制上の結晶化であり、vLLM v0.11.4-rc2、SGLang RadixArk、Hugging Face TGIはそれぞれいまや5サーフェスの緩和セット全体を担っている——標準的な推論サーバーの基本要素として予期されたエンジンごとの署名付きロードの体勢である。
text_locales.es: La directiva operativa de CISA que pliega la taxonomía de cargadores de agentes de once CVE en una publicación a corto plazo es la cristalización regulatoria de la categoría de superficie de ataque del runtime de inferencia más herramientas agénticas que la predicción nombra, y vLLM v0.11.4-rc2, SGLang RadixArk y Hugging Face TGI cada uno incorpora ahora el conjunto completo de mitigación de cinco superficies: la postura de carga firmada por motor anticipada como una primitiva estándar de los servidores de inferencia.
text_locales.fil: Ang CISA operational directive na nagtitipon sa eleven-CVE agent-loader taxonomy patungo sa isang near-term publication ay ang regulatory na pagkikristal ng inference-runtime-plus-agentic-tooling attack-surface na kategoryang pinangalanan ng hula, at bawat isa sa vLLM v0.11.4-rc2, SGLang RadixArk, at Hugging Face TGI ay dinadala na ngayon ang buong five-surface mitigation set — ang per-engine signed-load na posisyon na inaasahan bilang isang standard inference-server primitive.

text_locales.ja: SGLang CVE-2026-5760が14日間未パッチで滞留、LiteLLM鍵漏洩SQLi、5月1日のCopy Failカーネル LPEが、AI-Infra CVEクラス主張を動機付けた元々の4月19-26日チェーンに加わる。前提条件は強化を続けている。各新規アドバイザリーが同じテンプレートに見え、これは正に専用NVDタグが捕捉することを意図したクラスタだ。
text_locales.es: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 sin parchar a 14 días, el SQLi de fuga de claves de LiteLLM, y el LPE de kernel Copy Fail del 1 de mayo se suman a la cadena original del 19-26 de abril que motivó la afirmación sobre la clase CVE de AI-Infra. La precondición sigue fortaleciéndose: cada nuevo aviso parece la misma plantilla, que es exactamente el cluster que un tag dedicado del NVD pretende capturar.
text_locales.fil: Ang SGLang CVE-2026-5760 na nakaupong unpatched sa 14 araw, LiteLLM key-leak SQLi, at ang May 1 Copy Fail kernel LPE ay nagdaragdag sa orihinal na Apr 19-26 chain na nag-udyok sa AI-Infra CVE class claim. Patuloy na lumalakas ang precondition: ang bawat bagong advisory ay parang parehong template, na siyang eksaktong cluster na hinahangad ng dedicated NVD tag.

text_locales.es: SGLang aún sin parchear más las adiciones del 1 mayo de IBM Langflow y UTT HiPER y la actualización KEV del kernel Linux de CISA dan a la clase CVE de AI-Infra tres puntos de datos más en el mundo real — la cadencia de precondiciones que la predicción espera que un tag NVD de AI-Infra absorba.
text_locales.fil: Ang SGLang na unpatched pa rin kasama ang May 1 IBM Langflow at UTT HiPER additions at ang Linux-kernel KEV update ng CISA ay nagbibigay sa AI-Infra CVE class ng tatlo pang in-the-wild data points — ang precondition cadence na inaasahan ng prediction na sasaluhin ng AI-Infra NVD tag.

text_locales.en: LiteLLM is now the canonical 2026 LLM-gateway-as-blast-radius case — one row leak compromises OpenAI org keys, Anthropic admin tokens, and AWS Bedrock IAM credentials simultaneously, which is the same model-tooling-layer-injection shape SGLang and Spring AI exposed. The CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the disclosure-regime side of the same primitive-supply-chain thesis. Moderate-to-strong signal across both legs.
text_locales.ja: LiteLLMは現在、典型的な2026年LLMゲートウェイ・アズ・ブラスト・ラディウスケースとなった ― 1行のリークがOpenAI組織キー、Anthropic管理者トークン、AWS Bedrock IAM認証情報を同時に侵害する。これはSGLangとSpring AIが露呈したのと同じモデルツールレイヤー注入形状である。CSAIのMITRE-CNA認定は、同じプリミティブサプライチェーンテーゼの開示体制側である。両側で中程度から強いシグナル。
text_locales.es: LiteLLM es ahora el caso canónico 2026 de LLM-gateway-as-blast-radius — la fuga de una fila compromete claves de org de OpenAI, tokens admin de Anthropic, y credenciales IAM de AWS Bedrock simultáneamente, que es la misma forma de inyección en la capa model-tooling que SGLang y Spring AI expusieron. La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI es el lado régimen-de-disclosure de la misma tesis de primitive-supply-chain. Señal moderada-a-fuerte en ambos legs.
text_locales.fil: Ang LiteLLM ay ngayon ang canonical 2026 LLM-gateway-as-blast-radius case — isang row leak ay nag-co-compromise ng OpenAI org keys, Anthropic admin tokens, at AWS Bedrock IAM credentials nang sabay-sabay, na siyang parehong model-tooling-layer-injection shape na inilantad ng SGLang at Spring AI. Ang CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization ay ang disclosure-regime side ng parehong primitive-supply-chain thesis. Moderate-to-strong signal sa magkabilang leg.

text_locales.en: The Spring AI FilterExpressionConverter CVE is the first 2026 LLM-tooling-supply-chain CVE at the RAG query plane, and the same Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment shape that produced SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (still unpatched) is now confirmed across vLLM and LMDeploy. Five distinct inference-stack-injection CVEs in a 14-day window is exactly the cluster the prediction projected.
text_locales.ja: Spring AI FilterExpressionConverter CVEは、RAGクエリプレーンでの初の2026年LLMツーリングサプライチェーンCVEであり、SGLang CVE-2026-5760(まだ未パッチ)を生じさせたのと同じJinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironmentの形がvLLMとLMDeployにわたって確認されている。14日間の窓内で5つの異なる推論スタックインジェクションCVEは、まさに予測が投影したクラスタである。
text_locales.es: El CVE FilterExpressionConverter de Spring AI es el primer CVE 2026 de cadena de suministro de LLM-tooling en el plano de query de RAG, y la misma forma Jinja2-sin-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment que produjo SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (todavía sin parche) se confirma ahora a través de vLLM y LMDeploy. Cinco CVEs distintos de inyección en stack de inferencia en una ventana de 14 días son exactamente el clúster que proyectaba la predicción.
text_locales.fil: Ang Spring AI FilterExpressionConverter CVE ay ang unang 2026 LLM-tooling-supply-chain CVE sa RAG query plane, at ang parehong Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment shape na nagluwal ng SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (still unpatched) ay kumpirmado na ngayon sa vLLM at LMDeploy. Limang magkakaibang inference-stack-injection CVEs sa 14-day window ay eksaktong cluster na inaasahan ng prediction.

text_locales.ja: SGLang CVE-2026-5760の10日間未パッチ持続性(公開PoCあり)、CISAの4月28日KEV追加(5月12日連邦期限)、Milesight + Totolink 9.8クラスタが、推論ランタイム + agentic CIコードパスがPatch-Tuesday級重大度に持続的なケイデンスで到達しているという前提条件を直接物質化する。CVEクラス・カテゴリは現場で結晶化し続けている。
text_locales.es: La persistencia de 10-dias-sin-parchear de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 con PoC publico, los KEV adds del 28 de abril de CISA con deadline federal del 12 de mayo, y el cluster Milesight + Totolink 9.8 extienden directamente la precondicion de que los codepaths inference-runtime + agentic-CI estan alcanzando severidad de Patch-Tuesday-grade a una cadencia sostenida. La categoria de clase-CVE continua cristalizando en el terreno.
text_locales.fil: Ang 10-araw-unpatched persistence ng SGLang CVE-2026-5760 kasama ang public PoC, ang Apr 28 CISA KEV adds na may May-12 federal deadline, at ang Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster ay direktang nag-mamaterialize ng precondition na ang inference-runtime + agentic-CI codepaths ay umaabot sa Patch-Tuesday-grade severity sa sustained cadence. Ang CVE-class category ay patuloy na nag-cri-crystallize sa lupa.

text_locales.en: The unpatched SGLang RCE plus the Totolink quad and the in-the-wild indirect-injection ramp continue to compose the inference-runtime-plus-agentic-CI primitive the prediction names — the underlying premise that this is one supply-chain category is loading further this week.
text_locales.ja: 未パッチの SGLang RCE に Totolink 4 連発と野生の間接インジェクション ランプが加わることで、予測が指す推論ランタイム + エージェンティック CI のプリミティブを構成し続ける — これがひとつのサプライチェーン カテゴリだという根底前提は今週さらに積み上がっている。
text_locales.es: El RCE SGLang sin parchear más el cuádruple Totolink y la rampa de inyección indirecta in-the-wild continúan componiendo la primitiva inference-runtime-más-agentic-CI que nombra la predicción — la premisa subyacente de que esta es una categoría de supply-chain está cargándose más esta semana.
text_locales.fil: Ang unpatched SGLang RCE plus ang Totolink quad at ang in-the-wild indirect-injection ramp ay patuloy na bumubuo sa inference-runtime-plus-agentic-CI primitive na pinangalanan ng prediction — ang underlying premise na ito ay isang supply-chain category ay lalong tumitindi linggong ito.

bridges.text: Unpatched SGLang plus simple-git RCE in the foundational CI dep plus the cross-vendor copy-paste-vulnerability framing all reinforce the underlying premise that inference-runtime + agentic-CI is one supply-chain category.

text_locales.en: Unpatched SGLang plus simple-git RCE in the foundational CI dep plus the cross-vendor copy-paste-vulnerability framing all reinforce the underlying premise that inference-runtime + agentic-CI is one supply-chain category.
text_locales.ja: 未パッチの SGLang、基盤的な CI 依存性での simple-git RCE、ベンダーをまたぐコピーアンドペースト脆弱性のフレーミングは、いずれも推論ランタイム + エージェンティック CI が一つのサプライチェーン カテゴリであるという根底前提を補強している。
text_locales.es: SGLang sin parchear más el RCE de simple-git en la dependencia fundacional CI más el encuadre de copy-paste-vulnerability cross-vendor refuerzan todos la premisa subyacente de que inference-runtime + agentic-CI son una sola categoría de cadena de suministro.
text_locales.fil: Ang hindi na-patch na SGLang kasama ang simple-git RCE sa foundational CI dep at ang cross-vendor copy-paste-vulnerability framing ay lahat nagpapatibay sa underlying premise na ang inference-runtime + agentic-CI ay isang supply-chain category.

detail.description: **Inference servers become the new "primitive supply chain" — Q3 2026 sees the first AI Infra-specific CVE class (LLM-INFRA-CWE) with mandatory NVD tagging.** The Apr 19-26 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m exploited)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) Jinja2 SSTI RCE** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + the Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain across Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot — composes a clear "inference-runtime + agentic-CI" attack-surface category. By Q3 2026, NIST/NVD adds a dedicated **"AI-Infra"** tag to its CVE schema, OWASP's LLM Top 10 v2026 promotes **"Inference Server Template / Loader RCE"** to a top-3 entry, and supply-chain SBOM tooling (Snyk / Wiz / Pillar / Lasso / Lakera) ships **per-engine signature feeds for vLLM / SGLang / LMDeploy / Triton / Ollama** as standard SKUs. description.ja: **「AI インフラ CVE クラス」が規制プリミティブへ昇格する — Q4 2026 までに CISA / NIST が KEV とは別の、推論サーバ + エージェンティック CI ランタイム向けサブカタログを公表する。** 4/19-27 のシーケンス — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12 時間 31 分)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (依然として未パッチ)** + **Pillar による Antigravity の `find_by_name -X` 経由サンドボックス エスケープ** + **基盤的な CI/CD 依存性における simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE** + **4/21 の Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot をまたぐ Comment-and-Control プロンプトインジェクション連鎖** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 サンドボックス回避** — はもはや「カテゴリーが立ち現れている」段階ではない。NIST の 4 月運用アップデート (CVE 公表数の記録的増加、AI 駆動の評価サポート) と Google の **野生の間接プロンプトインジェクション 32% 前年比増** が CISA / NVD に対し、Q4 2026 までに **SBOM タグ付け必須化を伴う、推論サーバ + エージェンティックツール専用の CVE サブカタログ**を出荷するよう迫る。OWASP の LLM Top 10 v2026 は「Inference Server Template / Loader RCE」をトップ 3 へ格上げする。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La "clase CVE de AI-Infra" se gradúa como primitiva regulatoria — el Q4 2026 ve a CISA / NIST publicar un sub-catálogo para runtimes de inference-server + agentic-CI, separado de KEV.** La secuencia del 19-27 de abril — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (todavía sin parchear)** + **escape de sandbox de Pillar Antigravity vía `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE en una dependencia fundacional de CI/CD** + **cadena de prompt-injection Comment-and-Control del 21 de abril a través de Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **bypass de sandbox OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329** — ya no es una "categoría emergente". La actualización ops de NIST de abril (crecimiento récord de publicación de CVE, soporte de evaluación impulsado por IA) más el **aumento del 32% interanual de prompt-injection indirecto en la naturaleza** de Google fuerzan a CISA/NVD a entregar un **sub-catálogo CVE dedicado a inference-server + agentic-tool** con etiquetado SBOM obligatorio para el Q4 2026. El OWASP LLM Top 10 v2026 promueve "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" al top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang "AI-Infra CVE class" ay magiging regulatory primitive — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ilalathala ng CISA / NIST ang sub-catalog para sa inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, hiwalay sa KEV.** Ang Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (hindi pa rin na-patch)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape sa pamamagitan ng `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE sa foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain sa Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — ay hindi na isang "category emerging." Ang Apr ops update ng NIST (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) kasama ang **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise sa wild ng Google** ay pumipilit sa CISA/NVD na magpadala ng **dedikadong inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** na may mandatory SBOM tagging pagsapit ng Q4 2026. Ang LLM Top 10 v2026 ng OWASP ay mag-aangat sa "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" sa top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

summary_short_locales.ja: 4/19-27 の 6 件の推論サーバおよびエージェンティック CI 攻撃 (LMDeploy SSRF、未パッチの SGLang SSTI、Antigravity サンドボックス エスケープ、simple-git RCE、マルチエージェント プロンプトインジェクション、OpenClaw 回避) と Google の間接プロンプトインジェクション 32% 増が、CISA / NVD に対し Q4 2026 までに SBOM タグ付け必須化を伴う AI インフラ専用 CVE サブカタログを公表させる。
summary_short_locales.es: Seis exploits del 19-27 de abril en inference-server y agentic-CI (SSRF de LMDeploy, SSTI sin parchear de SGLang, escape de sandbox de Antigravity, RCE de simple-git, prompt-injection multi-agente, bypass de OpenClaw) más el aumento del 32% de prompt-injection indirecto de Google fuerzan a CISA/NVD a publicar un sub-catálogo CVE dedicado a AI-Infra con etiquetado SBOM obligatorio para el Q4 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Anim na Apr 19-27 inference-server at agentic-CI exploits (LMDeploy SSRF, SGLang SSTI hindi na-patch, Antigravity sandbox-escape, simple-git RCE, multi-agent prompt-injection, OpenClaw bypass) kasama ang 32% indirect-prompt-injection rise ng Google ay pumipilit sa CISA/NVD na maglathala ng dedikadong AI-Infra CVE sub-catalog na may mandatory SBOM tagging pagsapit ng Q4 2026.

bridges.text: The CISA federal-civilian operational directive incorporating the eleven-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy, now consolidated into a single four-tier reference and heading for near-term publication, advances the structured agentic-tooling CVE catalogue shape the prediction anticipates. The directional match is strong, but it is a CISA operational directive rather than the predicted joint CISA-NIST sub-catalog separate from KEV.

text_locales.en: The CISA federal-civilian operational directive incorporating the eleven-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy, now consolidated into a single four-tier reference and heading for near-term publication, advances the structured agentic-tooling CVE catalogue shape the prediction anticipates. The directional match is strong, but it is a CISA operational directive rather than the predicted joint CISA-NIST sub-catalog separate from KEV.
text_locales.ja: 11件のCVEのTrail of Bits分類体系を組み込んだCISAの連邦民間運用指令は、いまや単一の4階層の参照に統合され近い将来の公表に向かい、予測が予期する構造化されたエージェント型ツールのCVEカタログの形を前進させる。方向性の一致は強いが、それは予測されたKEVとは別個の共同CISA-NISTサブカタログではなく、CISA運用指令である。
text_locales.es: La directiva operativa del ámbito civil federal de CISA que incorpora la taxonomía de once CVE de Trail of Bits, ahora consolidada en una sola referencia de cuatro niveles y encaminada hacia su publicación a corto plazo, avanza la forma de catálogo de CVE de herramientas agénticas estructurado que la predicción anticipa. La coincidencia direccional es fuerte, pero es una directiva operativa de CISA en lugar del subcatálogo conjunto CISA-NIST predicho separado del KEV.
text_locales.fil: Ang CISA federal-civilian operational directive na nagsasama ng eleven-CVE Trail of Bits taxonomy, na ngayon ay tinipon sa isang nag-iisang four-tier reference at patungo sa near-term publication, ay sumusulong sa structured agentic-tooling CVE na catalogue na hugis na inaasahan ng hula. Malakas ang directional na tugma, ngunit ito ay isang CISA operational directive sa halip na ang inihulang joint CISA-NIST sub-catalog na hiwalay sa KEV.

text_locales.ja: SGLang CVE-2026-5760の4月24日修正が本日NVD詳細で確認されたことは、最長稼働の2026年LLMツーリング脆弱性を閉じる一方、約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバーおよび2026年AI-CVE予測の2,800〜3,600件(+31〜69% YoY)が前提条件を温存している: 推論サーバー + エージェンティック・ツールCVEは現在、独自のサブコーパスとして運用上区別可能である。
text_locales.es: El fix del 24 de abril de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 confirmado en el detalle NVD hoy cierra la vulnerabilidad de herramientas LLM más larga corriendo de 2026, mientras que los ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet y el pronóstico AI-CVE 2,800-3,600 para 2026 (31-69% YoY) mantienen caliente la precondición: los CVEs de servidor de inferencia + herramienta agéntica ahora son operativamente distinguibles como su propio sub-corpus.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 24 fix ng SGLang CVE-2026-5760 na kinumpirma sa NVD detail ngayon ay nagsasara sa pinakamatagal na 2026 LLM-tooling vulnerability, habang ang ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers at ang 2,800-3,600 AI-CVE forecast para sa 2026 (31-69% YoY) ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang precondition: ang inference-server + agentic-tool CVEs ay operationally distinguishable na ngayon bilang sariling sub-corpus.

bridges.text: The 15-day SGLang CVE-2026-5760 carry plus the Microsoft Excel XSS + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain keep the precondition warm: AI-infra-tooling vulnerabilities now persist long enough and span enough host-app surfaces to merit their own regulatory sub-catalog rather than continued KEV-pool aggregation.

text_locales.en: The 15-day SGLang CVE-2026-5760 carry plus the Microsoft Excel XSS + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain keep the precondition warm: AI-infra-tooling vulnerabilities now persist long enough and span enough host-app surfaces to merit their own regulatory sub-catalog rather than continued KEV-pool aggregation.
text_locales.ja: SGLang CVE-2026-5760の15日間キャリー + Microsoft Excel XSS + Copilot Agentサイレント流出チェーンが前提条件を温存している: AI-infraツールの脆弱性は、KEVプール集約の継続ではなく独自の規制サブカタログを要するに足るほど長く存続し、十分なホストアプリ・サーフェスにまたがるようになっている。
text_locales.es: El acarreo de 15 días de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 más la cadena de exfiltración silenciosa de Microsoft Excel XSS + Copilot Agent mantienen caliente la precondición: las vulnerabilidades de herramientas de infra-IA ahora persisten lo suficiente y abarcan suficientes superficies de aplicaciones host como para merecer su propio subcatálogo regulatorio en lugar de continuar agregándose al pool KEV.
text_locales.fil: Ang 15-day SGLang CVE-2026-5760 carry plus ang Microsoft Excel XSS + Copilot Agent silent-exfil chain ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang precondition: ang AI-infra-tooling vulnerabilities ay nagpapatuloy nang sapat na haba at sumasaklaw sa sapat na host-app surfaces upang karapat-dapat sa kanilang sariling regulatory sub-catalog sa halip na patuloy na KEV-pool aggregation.

bridges.text: CSAI Foundation's MITRE-CNA authority plus ATT&CK v19's named agentic techniques now sit alongside the CISA May 1 KEV cadence and the still-unpatched SGLang CVE, which is exactly the institutional configuration the prediction said would force CISA / NIST to ship an inference-server plus agentic-CI sub-catalog distinct from KEV.

text_locales.en: CSAI Foundation's MITRE-CNA authority plus ATT&CK v19's named agentic techniques now sit alongside the CISA May 1 KEV cadence and the still-unpatched SGLang CVE, which is exactly the institutional configuration the prediction said would force CISA / NIST to ship an inference-server plus agentic-CI sub-catalog distinct from KEV.
text_locales.ja: CSAI FoundationのMITRE-CNA権限とATT&CK v19の命名済みエージェント手法が、CISA 5月1日KEVケイデンスと未だ未パッチのSGLang CVEと並んで位置している。これは予測が、CISA / NISTにKEVとは別個の推論サーバーとエージェントCIサブカタログの出荷を強制すると述べた制度配置そのものだ。
text_locales.es: La autoridad MITRE-CNA de CSAI Foundation más las técnicas agénticas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 ahora se sitúan junto con la cadencia del KEV de CISA del 1 de mayo y el SGLang CVE aún sin parchar, que es exactamente la configuración institucional que la predicción dijo que forzaría a CISA / NIST a entregar un sub-catálogo de servidor de inferencia más CI agéntica distinto del KEV.
text_locales.fil: Ang MITRE-CNA authority ng CSAI Foundation plus ang named agentic techniques ng ATT&CK v19 ay ngayon ay nakaupo kasabay ng CISA May 1 KEV cadence at ng nananatiling unpatched na SGLang CVE, na siyang eksaktong institutional configuration na sinabi ng prediction na magpipilit sa CISA / NIST na maglabas ng inference-server plus agentic-CI sub-catalog na hiwalay sa KEV.

bridges.text: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authorization, ATT&CK v19's named techniques, and CISA's continuing KEV cadence keep the institutional scaffolding aligned with the predicted AI-Infra sub-catalog, even though no separate regulatory primitive has been published yet.

text_locales.en: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authorization, ATT&CK v19's named techniques, and CISA's continuing KEV cadence keep the institutional scaffolding aligned with the predicted AI-Infra sub-catalog, even though no separate regulatory primitive has been published yet.
text_locales.ja: CSAIのMITRE-CNA認可、ATT&CK v19の命名されたテクニック、CISAの継続的なKEVケイデンスが、別個の規制プリミティブはまだ公開されていないものの、予測されたAIインフラサブカタログと制度的足場を整合させ続けている。
text_locales.es: La autorización MITRE-CNA de CSAI, las técnicas nombradas de ATT&CK v19, y la cadencia continua de KEV de CISA mantienen el andamiaje institucional alineado con el sub-catálogo AI-Infra predicho, aunque ninguna primitiva regulatoria separada se haya publicado todavía.
text_locales.fil: Ang MITRE-CNA authorization ng CSAI, ang named techniques ng ATT&CK v19, at ang patuloy na KEV cadence ng CISA ay nagpapanatili ng institutional scaffolding na nakahanay sa hinulang AI-Infra sub-catalog, kahit walang separate regulatory primitive ang nailalathala pa.

bridges.text: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authorization is the cleanest possible institutional confirmation that the AI-Infra CVE class is graduating into a regulatory primitive on the timeline the prediction projects. Pair that with the Apr 30 CISA KEV add and the LiteLLM + SGLang + Spring AI cluster spanning gateway / RAG / inference, and the substrate for a dedicated Q4 2026 sub-catalog is materializing on schedule. Strong signal.

text_locales.es: La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI es la confirmación institucional más limpia posible de que la clase de CVE de AI-Infra está graduándose hacia primitiva regulatoria sobre el timeline que la predicción proyecta. Combina eso con la adición CISA KEV del 30 abr y el cluster LiteLLM + SGLang + Spring AI que abarca gateway / RAG / inferencia, y el sustrato para un sub-catálogo dedicado en Q4 2026 se está materializando en el cronograma. Señal fuerte.
text_locales.fil: Ang MITRE-CNA authorization ng CSAI ay ang pinaka-malinis na posibleng institutional confirmation na ang AI-Infra CVE class ay umaakyat sa regulatory primitive sa timeline na ipina-project ng prediction. Pagsamahin iyan sa Apr 30 CISA KEV add at sa LiteLLM + SGLang + Spring AI cluster na sumasaklaw sa gateway / RAG / inference, at ang substrate para sa dedikadong Q4 2026 sub-catalog ay nagma-materialize sa schedule. Strong signal.

text_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's named-techniques wave plus the Apr 28 CISA KEV add and SGLang's still-unpatched CVSS 9.8 are the regulator-side and runtime-side pressure the prediction projected. The structural substrate for a dedicated AI-Infra sub-catalog is converging on schedule for the Q4 2026 forecast.
text_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の命名された技法の波に加え、4月28日のCISA KEV追加とSGLangの依然未パッチのCVSS 9.8が、予測が投影した規制側とランタイム側の圧力である。専用のAI-Infraサブカタログのための構造的基盤が2026年Q4予測のスケジュールどおりに収束している。
text_locales.es: La ola de técnicas-nombradas de ATT&CK v19 más el agregado al KEV de CISA del 28 abr y el CVSS 9.8 todavía sin parche de SGLang son la presión del lado regulador y del lado runtime que proyectaba la predicción. El sustrato estructural para un sub-catálogo dedicado de AI-Infra está convergiendo en agenda para el pronóstico de Q4 2026.
text_locales.fil: Ang named-techniques wave ng ATT&CK v19 kasama ang Apr 28 CISA KEV add at ang still-unpatched CVSS 9.8 ng SGLang ay ang regulator-side at runtime-side pressure na inaasahan ng prediction. Ang structural substrate para sa nakatuon na AI-Infra sub-catalog ay nagsasama-sama nang nasa iskedyul para sa Q4 2026 forecast.

bridges.text: Apr 28's CISA KEV adds with May-12 federal deadline plus the SGLang 10+ day unpatched window and the Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster reinforce the precondition that the AI-Infra CVE class is reaching the cadence that historically forces a CISA / NIST sub-catalog. The regulatory pull is intensifying without yet producing the dedicated sub-catalog.

The regulatory pull is intensifying without yet producing the dedicated sub-catalog.
text_locales.ja: 4月28日のCISA KEV追加(5月12日連邦期限)に加えてSGLangの10日以上の未パッチ・ウィンドウとMilesight + Totolinkの9.8クラスタが、AI-Infra CVEクラスが歴史的にCISA / NISTサブカタログを強制したケイデンスに到達しているという前提条件を補強する。専用サブカタログをまだ生み出していなくても、規制のプルが強まっている。
text_locales.es: Los KEV adds del 28 de abril de CISA con deadline federal del 12 de mayo mas la ventana de 10+ dias sin parchear de SGLang y el cluster Milesight + Totolink 9.8 refuerzan la precondicion de que la clase CVE de AI-Infra esta alcanzando la cadencia que historicamente fuerza un sub-catalogo CISA / NIST. El pull regulatorio se intensifica sin todavia producir el sub-catalogo dedicado.
text_locales.fil: Ang Apr 28 CISA KEV adds na may May-12 federal deadline kasama ang SGLang 10+ araw unpatched window at ang Milesight + Totolink 9.8-cluster ay nagpapatibay sa precondition na ang AI-Infra CVE class ay umaabot sa cadence na historically nagpilit ng CISA / NIST sub-catalog. Ang regulatory pull ay tumitindi nang hindi pa nagbubunga ng dedicated sub-catalog.

bridges.text: The unpatched SGLang RCE plus the Totolink quad, Cisco ISE advisory, and rising indirect-injection prevalence continue to stack the underlying-cause primitives the prediction expects to force a dedicated sub-catalog separate from the existing KEV pipeline.

text_locales.en: The unpatched SGLang RCE plus the Totolink quad, Cisco ISE advisory, and rising indirect-injection prevalence continue to stack the underlying-cause primitives the prediction expects to force a dedicated sub-catalog separate from the existing KEV pipeline.
text_locales.ja: 未パッチの SGLang RCE に Totolink 4 連発、Cisco ISE アドバイザリ、間接インジェクション蔓延の上昇が加わって積み上がり続けることは、予測が既存の KEV パイプラインから分離した専用サブカタログを強要すると見込む根底原因のプリミティブそのものだ。
text_locales.es: El RCE SGLang sin parchear más el cuádruple Totolink, el aviso de Cisco ISE, y la creciente prevalencia de inyección indirecta continúan apilando las primitivas de causa subyacente que la predicción espera fuercen un sub-catálogo dedicado separado del pipeline KEV existente.
text_locales.fil: Ang unpatched SGLang RCE plus ang Totolink quad, Cisco ISE advisory, at tumataas na indirect-injection prevalence ay patuloy na nagsasalansan ng underlying-cause primitives na inaasahan ng prediction na magpipilit sa dedikadong sub-catalog na hiwalay sa kasalukuyang KEV pipeline.

detail.description: **The "AI-Infra CVE class" graduates into a regulatory primitive — Q4 2026 sees CISA / NIST publish a sub-catalog for inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, separate from KEV.** The Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (still unpatched)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain across Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — is no longer a "category emerging." NIST's Apr ops update (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) plus Google's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise in the wild** force CISA/NVD to ship a **dedicated inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging by Q4 2026. OWASP's LLM Top 10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

prediction_summary_locales.ja: **「AI インフラ CVE クラス」が規制プリミティブへ昇格する — Q4 2026 までに CISA / NIST が KEV とは別の、推論サーバ + エージェンティック CI ランタイム向けサブカタログを公表する。** 4/19-27 のシーケンス — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12 時間 31 分)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (依然として未パッチ)** + **Pillar による Antigravity の `find_by_name -X` 経由サンドボックス エスケープ** + **基盤的な CI/CD 依存性における simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE** + **4/21 の Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot をまたぐ Comment-and-Control プロンプトインジェクション連鎖** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 サンドボックス回避** — はもはや「カテゴリーが立ち現れている」段階ではない。NIST の 4 月運用アップデート (CVE 公表数の記録的増加、AI 駆動の評価サポート) と Google の **野生の間接プロンプトインジェクション 32% 前年比増** が CISA / NVD に対し、Q4 2026 までに **SBOM タグ付け必須化を伴う、推論サーバ + エージェンティックツール専用の CVE サブカタログ**を出荷するよう迫る。OWASP の LLM Top 10 v2026 は「Inference Server Template / Loader RCE」をトップ 3 へ格上げする。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.es: **La "clase CVE de AI-Infra" se gradúa como primitiva regulatoria — el Q4 2026 ve a CISA / NIST publicar un sub-catálogo para runtimes de inference-server + agentic-CI, separado de KEV.** La secuencia del 19-27 de abril — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (todavía sin parchear)** + **escape de sandbox de Pillar Antigravity vía `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE en una dependencia fundacional de CI/CD** + **cadena de prompt-injection Comment-and-Control del 21 de abril a través de Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **bypass de sandbox OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329** — ya no es una "categoría emergente". La actualización ops de NIST de abril (crecimiento récord de publicación de CVE, soporte de evaluación impulsado por IA) más el **aumento del 32% interanual de prompt-injection indirecto en la naturaleza** de Google fuerzan a CISA/NVD a entregar un **sub-catálogo CVE dedicado a inference-server + agentic-tool** con etiquetado SBOM obligatorio para el Q4 2026. El OWASP LLM Top 10 v2026 promueve "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" al top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Ang "AI-Infra CVE class" ay magiging regulatory primitive — pagsapit ng Q4 2026, ilalathala ng CISA / NIST ang sub-catalog para sa inference-server + agentic-CI runtimes, hiwalay sa KEV.** Ang Apr 19-27 sequence — **LMDeploy CVE-2026-33626 SSRF (12h31m)** + **SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (hindi pa rin na-patch)** + **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape sa pamamagitan ng `find_by_name -X`** + **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE sa foundational CI/CD dep** + **Apr 21 Comment-and-Control prompt-injection chain sa Claude Code / Gemini CLI / Copilot** + **OpenClaw CVE-2026-41329 sandbox bypass** — ay hindi na isang "category emerging." Ang Apr ops update ng NIST (record CVE-publication growth, AI-driven evaluation support) kasama ang **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise sa wild ng Google** ay pumipilit sa CISA/NVD na magpadala ng **dedikadong inference-server + agentic-tool CVE sub-catalog** na may mandatory SBOM tagging pagsapit ng Q4 2026. Ang LLM Top 10 v2026 ng OWASP ay mag-aangat sa "Inference Server Template / Loader RCE" sa top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.en: **Public-opinion blowback against AI converts into binding agent-governance rules — by Q3 2026 at least one US state ships a "Statutory Identity for Autonomous Agents" Act mirroring Okta's Agent Discovery + Agent Gateway pattern.** Apr 16 attacks on Altman's home + the Apr 15 CNBC datacenter-blowback piece + Apr 26 Salt Security data ("48.9% of orgs cannot monitor AI-agent traffic") + Okta for AI Agents GA on **Apr 30** (with Agent Discovery, Agent Gateway, virtual-MCP-server registry, credential vaulting + auto-rotation, universal logout) compose a regulatory pull-forward. A US state (CA, NY, or TX likely) ships a statute by Q3 2026 mandating **agent-as-first-class-identity registration, MCP-call-chain logging, and per-action consent**, mirroring Cross App Access protocol semantics. EU AI Act Article 26 enforcement triggers in parallel. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **AI への世論の反発が拘束力のあるエージェント・ガバナンス・ルールへ転化する — Q3 2026 までに、米国少なくとも 1 州が Okta の Agent Discovery + Agent Gateway パターンを反映した「自律エージェントの法定アイデンティティ」法を出荷する。** 4/16 の Altman 自宅への襲撃 + 4/15 の CNBC データセンター反発記事 + 4/26 の Salt Security データ (「組織の 48.9% が AI エージェントトラフィックを監視できない」) + **4/30** の Okta for AI Agents GA (Agent Discovery、Agent Gateway、仮想 MCP サーバレジストリ、認証情報の保管庫化 + 自動ローテーション、ユニバーサルログアウトを搭載) が、規制の前倒しを構成する。米国の 1 州 (CA、NY もしくは TX が有力) が Q3 2026 までに **エージェントをファーストクラスのアイデンティティとして登録すること、MCP コールチェーンのロギング、アクション単位の同意**を義務付ける法令を、Cross App Access プロトコルのセマンティクスを反映する形で出荷する。EU AI 法第 26 条の執行が並行して始動する。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **La reacción de la opinión pública contra la IA se convierte en reglas vinculantes de gobernanza de agentes — para el Q3 2026 al menos un estado de EE.UU. entrega una Ley de "Identidad Estatutaria para Agentes Autónomos" reflejando el patrón Agent Discovery + Agent Gateway de Okta.** Los ataques del 16 de abril a la casa de Altman + la pieza del 15 de abril de CNBC sobre la reacción contra los datacenters + los datos de Salt Security del 26 de abril ("48.9% de las organizaciones no pueden monitorear el tráfico de AI-agent") + Okta for AI Agents GA el **30 de abril** (con Agent Discovery, Agent Gateway, registro virtual-MCP-server, vaulting de credenciales + auto-rotación, logout universal) componen un adelanto regulatorio. Un estado de EE.UU. (CA, NY o TX probable) entrega un estatuto para el Q3 2026 que obliga **el registro de agente como identidad de primera clase, el logging de la cadena de llamadas MCP y el consentimiento por acción**, reflejando la semántica del protocolo Cross App Access. La aplicación del Artículo 26 del EU AI Act se activa en paralelo. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang public-opinion blowback laban sa AI ay magiging binding agent-governance rules — pagsapit ng Q3 2026, kahit isang US state ay magpapadala ng "Statutory Identity for Autonomous Agents" Act na sumasalamin sa Agent Discovery + Agent Gateway pattern ng Okta.** Ang Apr 16 attacks sa bahay ni Altman + ang Apr 15 CNBC datacenter-blowback piece + Apr 26 Salt Security data ("48.9% ng orgs ay hindi makakapag-monitor ng AI-agent traffic") + Okta for AI Agents GA noong **Apr 30** (kasama ang Agent Discovery, Agent Gateway, virtual-MCP-server registry, credential vaulting + auto-rotation, universal logout) ay bumubuo ng regulatory pull-forward. Isang US state (CA, NY, o TX malamang) ay magpapadala ng statute pagsapit ng Q3 2026 na nag-uutos ng **agent-as-first-class-identity registration, MCP-call-chain logging, at per-action consent**, na sumasalamin sa Cross App Access protocol semantics. Ang EU AI Act Article 26 enforcement ay magti-trigger nang parallel. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
