summary_short_locales.en: Apr 15 CNBC public-opinion data, Apr 16 attacks on Altman's home, Apr 26 Salt Security finding 48.9% of orgs cannot monitor AI-agent traffic, and Apr 30 Okta for AI Agents GA together push at least one US state (CA, NY, or TX) to ship a Statutory Identity for Autonomous Agents Act by Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: 4/15 の CNBC 世論データ、4/16 の Altman 自宅への襲撃、4/26 の Salt Security による「組織の 48.9% が AI エージェントトラフィックを監視できない」との所見、そして 4/30 の Okta for AI Agents GA が一体となり、米国少なくとも 1 州 (CA、NY もしくは TX) を Q3 2026 までに「自律エージェントの法定アイデンティティ」法を出荷する方向へ押し出す。
summary_short_locales.es: Los datos de opinión pública del 15 de abril de CNBC, los ataques del 16 de abril a la casa de Altman, el hallazgo del 26 de abril de Salt Security de que el 48.9% de las organizaciones no pueden monitorear el tráfico de AI-agent, y el GA de Okta for AI Agents del 30 de abril empujan juntos a al menos un estado de EE.UU. (CA, NY o TX) a entregar una Ley de Identidad Estatutaria para Agentes Autónomos para el Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang Apr 15 CNBC public-opinion data, Apr 16 attacks sa bahay ni Altman, Apr 26 Salt Security finding na 48.9% ng orgs ay hindi makakapag-monitor ng AI-agent traffic, at Apr 30 Okta for AI Agents GA ay magkakasamang magtutulak sa kahit isang US state (CA, NY, o TX) na magpadala ng Statutory Identity for Autonomous Agents Act pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: The RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence on agent-as-first-class-identity strengthens the structural force a state-level statute would codify, but no California, New York, or Texas legislative draft surfaces in the window.

text_locales.en: The RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence on agent-as-first-class-identity strengthens the structural force a state-level statute would codify, but no California, New York, or Texas legislative draft surfaces in the window.
text_locales.ja: RSACウィークのMicrosoft + Cisco + CSAのエージェントをファーストクラス・アイデンティティとして扱うことへの収斂は、州レベル法案が成文化するであろう構造的な強制力を強化するが、California、New York、Texasの立法草案はウィンドウ内で浮上しない。
text_locales.es: La convergencia de Microsoft + Cisco + CSA durante la semana de RSAC sobre agente-como-identidad-de-primera-clase fortalece la fuerza estructural que un estatuto a nivel estatal codificaría, pero ningún borrador legislativo de California, Nueva York o Texas aparece en la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang RSAC-week Microsoft + Cisco + CSA convergence sa agent-as-first-class-identity ay nagpapatibay sa structural force na ko-codify-pin ng state-level statute, ngunit walang California, New York, o Texas legislative draft na lumilitaw sa window.

bridges.text: Microsoft's Agent 365 GA and the CSA Identity-in-AI piece show the agent-as-first-class-identity primitive landing on the commercial side at $15/user/mo, which is the operational schema a state statute would point to. The structural force of the prediction holds, but the legislative-pull remains industry-led rather than state-codified for now.

text_locales.es: La GA de Agent 365 de Microsoft y la pieza CSA Identity-in-AI muestran la primitiva de agente-como-identidad-de-primera-clase aterrizando del lado comercial a $15/usuario/mes, que es el esquema operacional al que apuntaría un estatuto estatal. La fuerza estructural de la predicción se sostiene, pero la presión legislativa permanece liderada por la industria en lugar de codificada por el estado por ahora.
text_locales.fil: Ipinapakita ng Agent 365 GA ng Microsoft at ng CSA Identity-in-AI piece na ang agent-as-first-class-identity primitive ay dumarating sa commercial side sa $15/user/mo, na siyang operational schema na tutukuyin ng isang state statute. Ang structural force ng prediction ay nananatili, ngunit ang legislative-pull ay nananatiling industry-led sa halip na state-codified sa kasalukuyan.

bridges.text: CSA's identity reframing plus Agent 365's tenant-level policy primitives give a future state statute the implementation surface the prediction assumes, even though no California, New York, or Texas bill has yet been introduced.

text_locales.fil: Ang identity reframing ng CSA kasama ang tenant-level policy primitives ng Agent 365 ay nagbibigay sa future state statute ng implementation surface na ipinapalagay ng prediction, kahit walang California, New York, o Texas bill ang naipakilala pa.

The legislative side has not yet shipped but the substrate is in place for a CA / NY / TX move.

text_locales.en: Cloud Security Alliance's zero-trust-for-AI-agents framing and Okta for AI Agents Apr 30 GA with Agent Discovery + virtual MCP server registry + credential vaulting + universal logout extend the structural force the prediction names: agent-as-first-class-identity is becoming the assumed baseline. The legislative branch has not moved in the window.
text_locales.ja: Cloud Security AllianceのAIエージェント向けゼロトラスト・フレーミングと、Okta for AI Agents 4月30日GA(Agent Discovery + 仮想MCPサーバー・レジストリ + 認証情報保管 + ユニバーサル・ログアウト)が、予測が指摘する構造的な力を拡大する: ファーストクラスID としてのエージェントが想定ベースラインになりつつある。立法府はウィンドウ内で動いていない。
text_locales.es: El framing zero-trust-para-AI-agents de Cloud Security Alliance y el Okta for AI Agents GA del 30 de abril con Agent Discovery + virtual MCP server registry + credential vaulting + universal logout extienden la fuerza estructural que la prediccion nombra: agent-as-first-class-identity se esta convirtiendo en el baseline asumido. La rama legislativa no se ha movido en la ventana.
text_locales.fil: Ang zero-trust-for-AI-agents framing ng Cloud Security Alliance at ang Okta for AI Agents Apr 30 GA na may Agent Discovery + virtual MCP server registry + credential vaulting + universal logout ay nagpapalawak ng structural force na pinapangalanan ng hula: ang agent-as-first-class-identity ay nagiging assumed baseline. Ang legislative branch ay hindi gumalaw sa window.

bridges.text: Okta's imminent GA stabilizes the reference implementation the prediction expects a state statute to cite, while the broader zero-trust-for-agents consensus keeps the underlying-cause pressure on legislators visible — the cause side is loading even though the legislative artefact is still ahead.

text_locales.en: Okta's imminent GA stabilizes the reference implementation the prediction expects a state statute to cite, while the broader zero-trust-for-agents consensus keeps the underlying-cause pressure on legislators visible — the cause side is loading even though the legislative artefact is still ahead.
text_locales.ja: Okta の差し迫った GA は、予測が州法令が引用すると見込むリファレンス実装を安定化させ、より広いゼロトラスト for エージェントの合意が立法者への根底原因の圧力を可視に保つ — 原因側はロードしているが、立法アーティファクトはまだ先だ。
text_locales.es: El inminente GA de Okta estabiliza la implementación de referencia que la predicción espera que un estatuto estatal cite, mientras el consenso más amplio zero-trust-for-agents mantiene visible la presión de causa subyacente sobre los legisladores — el lado de causa se está cargando aunque el artefacto legislativo aún esté por delante.
text_locales.fil: Ang papalapit na GA ng Okta ay pinapatatag ang reference implementation na inaasahan ng prediction na ici-cite ng state statute, habang ang mas malawak na zero-trust-for-agents consensus ay pinapanatili ang underlying-cause pressure sa mga legislators na visible — naglo-load ang cause side kahit pa nasa unahan pa rin ang legislative artefact.

detail.subtitle: Prediction · Business
detail.description: **Public-opinion blowback against AI converts into binding agent-governance rules — by Q3 2026 at least one US state ships a "Statutory Identity for Autonomous Agents" Act mirroring Okta's Agent Discovery + Agent Gateway pattern.** Apr 16 attacks on Altman's home + the Apr 15 CNBC datacenter-blowback piece + Apr 26 Salt Security data ("48.9% of orgs cannot monitor AI-agent traffic") + Okta for AI Agents GA on **Apr 30** (with Agent Discovery, Agent Gateway, virtual-MCP-server registry, credential vaulting + auto-rotation, universal logout) compose a regulatory pull-forward. A US state (CA, NY, or TX likely) ships a statute by Q3 2026 mandating **agent-as-first-class-identity registration, MCP-call-chain logging, and per-action consent**, mirroring Cross App Access protocol semantics. EU AI Act Article 26 enforcement triggers in parallel. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

Un estado de EE.UU. (CA, NY o TX probable) entrega un estatuto para el Q3 2026 que obliga **el registro de agente como identidad de primera clase, el logging de la cadena de llamadas MCP y el consentimiento por acción**, reflejando la semántica del protocolo Cross App Access. nodes.title: CISA ships AI-Infra KEV sub-catalog with inference-server SBOM by Q3 2026
nodes.description: **Inference-server SSTI graduates from one-off CVE to OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry; CISA ships an "AI-Infra KEV" sub-catalog by Q3 2026.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) **remains unpatched into Apr 28** (10+ days post-disclosure), with a public PoC and the same Jinja2-without-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` shape now flagged as a copy-paste class spanning vLLM, LMDeploy, and adjacent inference servers. Combined with the **Apr 27-28 Totolink CVE quad (7153/7154/7156/7202, all 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in CI/CD**, **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`**, and Google/Forcepoint's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise** with 10 in-the-wild payloads — pressure on NIST/CISA crystallizes. **By Q3 2026 CISA ships a dedicated "AI-Infra" KEV sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging on inference servers (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) and agentic-CI runtimes (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template/Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

description.en: **Inference-server SSTI graduates from one-off CVE to OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry; CISA ships an "AI-Infra KEV" sub-catalog by Q3 2026.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) **remains unpatched into Apr 28** (10+ days post-disclosure), with a public PoC and the same Jinja2-without-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` shape now flagged as a copy-paste class spanning vLLM, LMDeploy, and adjacent inference servers. Combined with the **Apr 27-28 Totolink CVE quad (7153/7154/7156/7202, all 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE in CI/CD**, **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape via `find_by_name -X`**, and Google/Forcepoint's **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise** with 10 in-the-wild payloads — pressure on NIST/CISA crystallizes. **By Q3 2026 CISA ships a dedicated "AI-Infra" KEV sub-catalog** with mandatory SBOM tagging on inference servers (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) and agentic-CI runtimes (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 promotes "Inference Server Template/Loader RCE" to top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **推論サーバ SSTI が単発の CVE から OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 のエントリへ昇格する。CISA は Q3 2026 までに「AI インフラ KEV」サブカタログを出荷する。** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) は **4/28 時点で依然として未パッチ** (公表後 10 日以上)、公開 PoC が出回っており、`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` を伴わない同じ Jinja2 形状は今や vLLM、LMDeploy、隣接する推論サーバを横断するコピペ的クラスとしてフラグされている。**4/27-28 の Totolink CVE 4 連発 (7153 / 7154 / 7156 / 7202、いずれも 9.8)**、**Cisco ISE の認証なし RCE**、**CI/CD における simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE**、**Pillar による Antigravity の `find_by_name -X` 経由のサンドボックス エスケープ**、そして Google / Forcepoint の **野生における間接プロンプトインジェクション 32% 前年比増** と 10 件の野生のペイロードが組み合わさり — NIST / CISA への圧力が結晶化する。**Q3 2026 までに CISA は専用の「AI インフラ」KEV サブカタログを出荷する**。推論サーバ (vLLM / SGLang / Ollama / llama.cpp / LMDeploy) とエージェンティック CI ランタイム (Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / OpenClaw) に対する SBOM タグ付けが必須化される。OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 は「Inference Server Template / Loader RCE」をトップ 3 へ格上げする。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **El SSTI de inference-server pasa de CVE puntual a entrada del OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026; CISA publica un sub-catálogo "AI-Infra KEV" para Q3 2026.** SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) **permanece sin parchear hasta el 28 de abril** (más de 10 días después de la divulgación), con un PoC público y la misma forma de Jinja2-sin-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` ahora marcada como una clase de copy-paste que abarca vLLM, LMDeploy, y servidores de inferencia adyacentes. Combinado con el **cuádruple Totolink CVE del 27-28 de abril (7153/7154/7156/7202, todos 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE en CI/CD**, **escape de sandbox de Pillar's Antigravity vía `find_by_name -X`**, y el aumento del 32% interanual de prompt-injection indirecta de Google/Forcepoint con 10 payloads in-the-wild — la presión sobre NIST/CISA cristaliza. **Para Q3 2026 CISA publica un sub-catálogo "AI-Infra" KEV dedicado** con etiquetado SBOM obligatorio en servidores de inferencia (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) y runtimes agentic-CI (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 promueve "Inference Server Template/Loader RCE" al top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Ang inference-server SSTI ay magta-graduate mula one-off CVE patungo sa OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry; magpapadala ang CISA ng "AI-Infra KEV" sub-catalog pagsapit ng Q3 2026.** Ang SGLang CVE-2026-5760 (CVSS 9.8) ay **nananatiling unpatched hanggang Apr 28** (10+ araw post-disclosure), na may pampublikong PoC at ang parehong Jinja2-without-`ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment` shape na ngayon ay nakaflag bilang copy-paste class na sumasaklaw sa vLLM, LMDeploy, at mga karatig na inference servers. Pinagsama sa **Apr 27-28 Totolink CVE quad (7153/7154/7156/7202, lahat 9.8)**, **Cisco ISE unauth-RCE**, **simple-git CVE-2026-6951 RCE sa CI/CD**, **Pillar's Antigravity sandbox-escape sa pamamagitan ng `find_by_name -X`**, at ang **32% YoY indirect-prompt-injection rise** ng Google/Forcepoint na may 10 in-the-wild payloads — ang pressure sa NIST/CISA ay nagkri-crystallize. **Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, magpapadala ang CISA ng dedikadong "AI-Infra" KEV sub-catalog** na may mandatory SBOM tagging sa inference servers (vLLM/SGLang/Ollama/llama.cpp/LMDeploy) at agentic-CI runtimes (Claude Code/Codex/Antigravity/OpenClaw). Ina-promote ng OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 ang "Inference Server Template/Loader RCE" sa top-3. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

detail.summary_short: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 stays unpatched with a public PoC while the same Jinja2-SSTI shape spans vLLM, LMDeploy, and adjacent servers; layered onto the Apr 27-28 Totolink quad, Cisco ISE unauth-RCE, simple-git RCE, Antigravity sandbox-escape, and a 32% IPI rise, CISA ships an AI-Infra KEV sub-catalog by Q3 2026.

summary_short_locales.en: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 stays unpatched with a public PoC while the same Jinja2-SSTI shape spans vLLM, LMDeploy, and adjacent servers; layered onto the Apr 27-28 Totolink quad, Cisco ISE unauth-RCE, simple-git RCE, Antigravity sandbox-escape, and a 32% IPI rise, CISA ships an AI-Infra KEV sub-catalog by Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 は公開 PoC とともに未パッチのままであり、同じ Jinja2-SSTI 形状は vLLM、LMDeploy、隣接サーバを横断する。4/27-28 の Totolink 4 連発、Cisco ISE の認証なし RCE、simple-git RCE、Antigravity サンドボックス エスケープ、IPI 32% 増の上に積み上がり、CISA は Q3 2026 までに AI インフラ KEV サブカタログを出荷する。
summary_short_locales.es: SGLang CVE-2026-5760 permanece sin parchear con un PoC público mientras la misma forma Jinja2-SSTI abarca vLLM, LMDeploy, y servidores adyacentes; superpuesto al cuádruple Totolink del 27-28 de abril, Cisco ISE unauth-RCE, simple-git RCE, escape de sandbox de Antigravity, y un aumento del 32% IPI, CISA publica un sub-catálogo AI-Infra KEV para Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay nananatiling unpatched na may pampublikong PoC habang ang parehong Jinja2-SSTI shape ay sumasaklaw sa vLLM, LMDeploy, at mga karatig na servers; nakapatong sa Apr 27-28 Totolink quad, Cisco ISE unauth-RCE, simple-git RCE, Antigravity sandbox-escape, at 32% IPI rise, magpapadala ang CISA ng AI-Infra KEV sub-catalog pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: The May 5 NVD-confirmed SGLang CVE-2026-5760 fix closes the longest-running 2026 LLM-tooling RCE, but the supply-chain GGUF vector and ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (roughly half unauthenticated) plus a 31-69% YoY AI-CVE forecast keep the inference-server / template-loader threat-class warm enough to merit a dedicated KEV sub-catalog with SBOM coverage.

text_locales.en: The May 5 NVD-confirmed SGLang CVE-2026-5760 fix closes the longest-running 2026 LLM-tooling RCE, but the supply-chain GGUF vector and ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (roughly half unauthenticated) plus a 31-69% YoY AI-CVE forecast keep the inference-server / template-loader threat-class warm enough to merit a dedicated KEV sub-catalog with SBOM coverage.
text_locales.ja: 5月5日のNVD確認のSGLang CVE-2026-5760修正は、最長稼働の2026年LLMツーリングRCEを閉じるが、サプライチェーンGGUFベクトル、約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバー(およそ半数が未認証)、+31〜69% YoYのAI-CVE予測が、推論サーバー / テンプレートローダー脅威クラスをSBOMカバレッジを伴う専用KEVサブカタログに値するほど温存している。
text_locales.es: El fix de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 confirmado por NVD del 5 de mayo cierra el RCE LLM-tooling más largo corriendo de 2026, pero el vector GGUF de cadena de suministro y los ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet (aproximadamente la mitad sin autenticación) más un pronóstico AI-CVE de 31-69% YoY mantienen la clase de amenaza servidor-de-inferencia / cargador-de-plantillas suficientemente caliente como para merecer un sub-catálogo KEV dedicado con cobertura SBOM.
text_locales.fil: Ang May 5 NVD-confirmed SGLang CVE-2026-5760 fix ay nagsasara sa pinakamatagal na 2026 LLM-tooling RCE, ngunit ang supply-chain GGUF vector at ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers (humigit-kumulang kalahati ay walang authentication) plus ang 31-69% YoY AI-CVE forecast ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang inference-server / template-loader threat-class na sapat upang maging karapat-dapat sa dedicated KEV sub-catalog na may SBOM coverage.

text_locales.es: El runway de 14 días sin parchar de SGLang, el agregado al KEV de Copy Fail del 1 de mayo, y la autoridad MITRE-CNA de CSAI componen la misma cadena SSTI-más-kernel que la predicción describió. La forma Jinja2-sin-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment ahora se lee como una clase copy-paste a través de vLLM, LMDeploy, y servidores adyacentes, que es el driver de promoción OWASP.

Ang Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment shape ay nababasa na ngayon bilang copy-paste class sa kabuuan ng vLLM, LMDeploy, at adjacent servers, na siyang OWASP-promotion driver.

text_locales.ja: LiteLLMの事前認証SQLiは、SGLangが露呈したJinja2 without ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI形状の最もクリーンな拡張であり、マルチベンダーキーブラスト半径でゲートウェイ層に適用されている。CVEテレメトリは予測が述べた通りに収束しているが、OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026エントリーとCISA AI-Infra KEVサブカタログは依然として2026年Q3期限の上流にある。
text_locales.es: El SQLi pre-auth de LiteLLM es la extensión más limpia hasta ahora de la forma SSTI Jinja2-sin-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment que SGLang expuso, aplicada al tier gateway con blast radius de claves multi-vendor. La telemetría de CVE está convergiendo exactamente donde la predicción dijo, pero la entrada OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 y el sub-catálogo CISA AI-Infra KEV todavía están upstream del deadline Q3 2026.
text_locales.fil: Ang pre-auth SQLi ng LiteLLM ay ang pinaka-malinis na extension hanggang ngayon ng Jinja2-without-ImmutableSandboxedEnvironment SSTI shape na inilantad ng SGLang, na inilapat sa gateway tier na may multi-vendor key blast radius. Ang CVE telemetry ay nagko-converge eksaktong kung saan sinabi ng prediction, ngunit ang OWASP LLM Top-10 v2026 entry at CISA AI-Infra KEV sub-catalogue ay nasa upstream pa rin ng Q3 2026 deadline.

text_locales.es: La ventana de 10+ dias sin parchear de SGLang con v0.5.10 explotable enviada, la clase SSTI cross-server copy-paste spanning vLLM y LMDeploy, y los KEV adds del 28 de abril de CISA mas el cluster Milesight + Totolink 9.8 extienden directamente la precondicion que la prediccion nombra. nodes.description: **By H2 2026 the agent-skills attack surface lands its own MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ships an enforced signing + provenance gate.** ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills + Cisco's **36% prompt-injection rate across the OpenClaw skill marketplace** is no longer a one-off — Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. With Corpus2Skill making **"skills as a navigable artifact"** mainstream and the Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) calling skills/harness/protocol the dominant 2026 design layer, the attack surface is now **first-class infrastructure**, not a side-channel. By H2 2026 we see (a) a published agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style or NIST-led) covering skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, and (b) at least one major marketplace mandating signed-and-provenance-attested skills before publish — with Anthropic's 17-skill repo, ClawHub, Multica's marketplace, and Hugging Face's agent-trace surface as the first candidates. description.en: **By H2 2026 the agent-skills attack surface lands its own MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ships an enforced signing + provenance gate.** ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills + Cisco's **36% prompt-injection rate across the OpenClaw skill marketplace** is no longer a one-off — Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. With Corpus2Skill making **"skills as a navigable artifact"** mainstream and the Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) calling skills/harness/protocol the dominant 2026 design layer, the attack surface is now **first-class infrastructure**, not a side-channel. By H2 2026 we see (a) a published agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style or NIST-led) covering skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, and (b) at least one major marketplace mandating signed-and-provenance-attested skills before publish — with Anthropic's 17-skill repo, ClawHub, Multica's marketplace, and Hugging Face's agent-trace surface as the first candidates. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.ja: **2026年H2までに、エージェント・スキルの攻撃面が独自のMITRE-ATT&CK様式のサブマトリクスを獲得し、少なくとも1つの主要スキル・マーケットプレイス(Anthropicの公式スキル、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Faceスキル/エージェント・トレース)が強制署名+来歴ゲートを出荷する。** ClawHavocの1,184の悪意あるClawHubスキル + Ciscoの**OpenClawスキル・マーケットプレイス全体での36%のプロンプト・インジェクション率**は、もはや単発ではない — 4月28日のNovita Sandboxは、OpenClaw + Hermes + 自律エージェント・ランタイム向けに構築された最初の商用緩和製品だ。Corpus2Skillが**「ナビゲート可能な成果物としてのスキル」**を主流化し、Externalization-in-LLM-Agentsサーベイ(arxiv 2604.08224)がスキル/ハーネス/プロトコルを2026年の支配的な設計レイヤーと呼ぶことで、攻撃面は今や**サイドチャネルではなくファーストクラスのインフラ**となった。2026年H2までに、(a) スキル・ポイズニング + スキル経由の間接プロンプト・インジェクション + クロススキル特権チェーンをカバーする公開エージェント・スキル脅威マトリクス(MITRE様式またはNIST主導)、および (b) 公開前に署名済みかつ来歴認証済みのスキルを義務付ける少なくとも1つの主要マーケットプレイス — Anthropicの17スキル・リポジトリ、ClawHub、Multicaのマーケットプレイス、Hugging Faceのエージェント・トレース面が最初の候補となる。In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.es: **Para el H2 2026 la superficie de ataque de agent-skills aterriza su propia sub-matriz estilo MITRE-ATT&CK y al menos un mercado de skills importante (skills oficiales de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face / trazas de agente) envia una puerta de firma + procedencia obligatoria.** Las 1,184 skills maliciosas de ClawHub de ClawHavoc + el **36% de tasa de prompt-injection a traves del mercado de skills de OpenClaw** de Cisco ya no es algo aislado — el Novita Sandbox del 28 de abril es el primer producto comercial de mitigacion construido a proposito para runtimes OpenClaw + Hermes + agente-autonomo. Con Corpus2Skill haciendo mainstream **"skills como artefacto navegable"** y el survey Externalization-in-LLM-Agents (arxiv 2604.08224) llamando skills/harness/protocol la capa de diseno dominante de 2026, la superficie de ataque ahora es **infraestructura de primera clase**, no un canal lateral. Para el H2 2026 vemos (a) una matriz de amenazas de agent-skills publicada (estilo MITRE o liderada por NIST) cubriendo envenenamiento de skills + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cadenas de privilegio entre-skills, y (b) al menos un mercado importante mandando skills firmadas-y-con-procedencia-atestada antes de publicar — con el repo de 17-skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, el mercado de Multica, y la superficie de trazas de agente de Hugging Face como los primeros candidatos. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:
description.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang agent-skills attack surface ay magkakaroon ng sariling MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix at kahit isang major skill marketplace (opisyal na skills ng Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ay maglalabas ng enforced signing + provenance gate.** Ang 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills ng ClawHavoc + ang **36% prompt-injection rate ng Cisco sa kabuuan ng OpenClaw skill marketplace** ay hindi na one-off — ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox ang unang commercial mitigation product na purpose-built para sa OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. Sa Corpus2Skill na ginagawang **"skills bilang navigable artifact"** mainstream at ang Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) na tumatawag sa skills/harness/protocol bilang dominant 2026 design layer, ang attack surface ay ngayon **first-class infrastructure**, hindi side-channel. Pagsapit ng H2 2026, makikita natin ang (a) inilathalang agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style o NIST-led) na sumasaklaw sa skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, at (b) kahit isang major marketplace na nag-mamandato ng signed-and-provenance-attested skills bago mag-publish — kasama ang 17-skill repo ng Anthropic, ClawHub, marketplace ng Multica, at agent-trace surface ng Hugging Face bilang unang mga kandidato. In plain language: In plain language: In plain language: In plain language:

plain_language.ja: 悪意ある行為者が1,000を超える汚染されたAIプラグインをアップロードしたため、まもなく主要なプラグイン・ストアは、新しいものを取り入れる前に署名済み・追跡可能なコードを要求するようになる。
plain_language.es: Los actores maliciosos subieron mas de mil plugins de IA envenenados, asi que pronto las grandes tiendas de plugins requeriran codigo firmado y rastreable antes de aceptar nada nuevo.
plain_language.fil: Ang mga bad actor ay nag-upload ng higit sa isang libong poisoned AI plugins, kaya malapit na ang malalaking plugin stores ay magrerequire ng signed at traceable code bago papasukin ang anumang bago.

detail.summary_short: ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills + Cisco's 36% prompt-injection finding + Apr 28 Novita Sandbox launch + Corpus2Skill + the Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey turn the agent-skills attack surface into first-class infrastructure. By H2 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix (MITRE / NIST) lands and at least one major skill marketplace mandates signed-and-provenance-attested skills before publish.

summary_short_locales.en: ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills + Cisco's 36% prompt-injection finding + Apr 28 Novita Sandbox launch + Corpus2Skill + the Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey turn the agent-skills attack surface into first-class infrastructure. By H2 2026 a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix (MITRE / NIST) lands and at least one major skill marketplace mandates signed-and-provenance-attested skills before publish.
summary_short_locales.ja: ClawHavocの1,184の悪意あるClawHubスキル + Ciscoの36%プロンプト・インジェクション発見 + 4月28日のNovita Sandboxローンチ + Corpus2Skill + Externalization-in-LLM-Agentsサーベイが、エージェント・スキルの攻撃面をファーストクラスのインフラへと変える。2026年H2までに、公表されたエージェント・スキル脅威サブマトリクス(MITRE / NIST)が登場し、少なくとも1つの主要スキル・マーケットプレイスが、公開前に署名済みかつ来歴認証済みのスキルを義務付ける。
summary_short_locales.es: Las 1,184 skills maliciosas de ClawHub de ClawHavoc + el hallazgo de prompt-injection del 36% de Cisco + el lanzamiento del Novita Sandbox del 28 de abril + Corpus2Skill + el survey Externalization-in-LLM-Agents convierten la superficie de ataque de agent-skills en infraestructura de primera clase. Para el H2 2026 aterriza una sub-matriz de amenazas de agent-skills publicada (MITRE / NIST) y al menos un mercado de skills importante manda skills firmadas-y-con-procedencia-atestada antes de publicar.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills ng ClawHavoc + ang 36% prompt-injection finding ng Cisco + Apr 28 Novita Sandbox launch + Corpus2Skill + ang Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey ay ginagawa ang agent-skills attack surface na first-class infrastructure. Pagsapit ng H2 2026, lalabas ang inilathalang agent-skills threat sub-matrix (MITRE / NIST) at kahit isang major skill marketplace ay magmamandato ng signed-and-provenance-attested skills bago mag-publish.

bridges.text: The May 4-6 cluster of n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVEs across webhook abuse, prompt-injection-driven RCE, and inference-engine SSRF tightens the structural force the agent-skills threat-sub-matrix prediction (Apr 29) names: agentic-AI tool-call abuse is now empirically distinguishable across vendors and platforms. The taxonomy work itself remains the missing artifact.

text_locales.en: The May 4-6 cluster of n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVEs across webhook abuse, prompt-injection-driven RCE, and inference-engine SSRF tightens the structural force the agent-skills threat-sub-matrix prediction (Apr 29) names: agentic-AI tool-call abuse is now empirically distinguishable across vendors and platforms. The taxonomy work itself remains the missing artifact.
text_locales.ja: n8n + Flowise + LMDeployの5月4〜6日のCVEクラスタ(webhook乱用、プロンプトインジェクション駆動RCE、推論エンジンSSRF)は、エージェントスキル脅威サブマトリクス予測(4月29日)が指摘する構造的力を強化する: エージェンティックAIのツールコール乱用は、現在ベンダーとプラットフォームをまたいで経験的に区別可能。タクソノミー作業自体が依然として欠落している成果物である。
text_locales.es: El cluster del 4-6 de mayo de CVEs de n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy a través de abuso de webhook, RCE impulsada por prompt-injection y SSRF en motor de inferencia tensa la fuerza estructural que nombra la predicción agent-skills threat sub-matrix (29 abr): el abuso de tool-calls de IA agéntica es ahora empíricamente distinguible entre vendors y plataformas. El trabajo de taxonomía sigue siendo el artefacto faltante.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mayo 4-6 cluster ng n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVEs sa webhook abuse, prompt-injection-driven RCE, at inference-engine SSRF ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng agent-skills threat-sub-matrix prediction (Abr 29): ang agentic-AI tool-call abuse ay empirically distinguishable na sa mga vendor at platform. Ang taxonomy work mismo ang natitirang missing artifact.

bridges.text: The Microsoft + Cisco + CSA RSAC convergence on agent-as-first-class-identity plus Stellar Cyber's operative survey treatment keep the precondition warm for a published threat sub-matrix; the platform-side scaffolding is in place even though the marketplace gate is not yet shipped.

text_locales.en: The Microsoft + Cisco + CSA RSAC convergence on agent-as-first-class-identity plus Stellar Cyber's operative survey treatment keep the precondition warm for a published threat sub-matrix; the platform-side scaffolding is in place even though the marketplace gate is not yet shipped.
text_locales.ja: Microsoft + Cisco + CSAのRSACでのエージェントをファーストクラス・アイデンティティとして扱うことへの収斂 + Stellar Cyberの運用上の調査扱いが、公表された脅威サブマトリックスのための前提条件を温存している; マーケットプレイス・ゲートはまだ出荷されていないが、プラットフォーム側の足場は整っている。
text_locales.es: La convergencia RSAC de Microsoft + Cisco + CSA sobre agente-como-identidad-de-primera-clase más el tratamiento operativo de la encuesta de Stellar Cyber mantienen caliente la precondición para una sub-matriz de amenazas publicada; el andamiaje del lado plataforma está en su lugar aunque la puerta de marketplace aún no esté entregada.
text_locales.fil: Ang Microsoft + Cisco + CSA RSAC convergence sa agent-as-first-class-identity plus ang Stellar Cyber's operative survey treatment ay nagpapanatiling mainit ang precondition para sa nailathalang threat sub-matrix; ang platform-side scaffolding ay nakalagay kahit hindi pa nagpapadala ang marketplace gate.

bridges.text: ATT&CK v19's named agentic techniques and CSAI's MITRE-CNA authority sit alongside Microsoft Agent 365's allow/block primitive at $15/user/mo, which is the attack-surface formalization plus marketplace-policy combination the prediction's structural force depends on. The institutional substrate for a published sub-matrix is now in place.

text_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's named agentic techniques and CSAI's MITRE-CNA authority sit alongside Microsoft Agent 365's allow/block primitive at $15/user/mo, which is the attack-surface formalization plus marketplace-policy combination the prediction's structural force depends on. The institutional substrate for a published sub-matrix is now in place.
text_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の命名済みエージェント手法とCSAIのMITRE-CNA権限が、Microsoft Agent 365の$15/user/moでの許可/ブロックプリミティブと並んで位置している。これは予測の構造的力が依存する攻撃面形式化とマーケットプレイスポリシーの組み合わせだ。公開サブマトリクスのための制度基盤は今や整っている。
text_locales.es: Las técnicas agénticas nombradas de ATT&CK v19 y la autoridad MITRE-CNA de CSAI se sitúan junto con la primitiva allow/block de Microsoft Agent 365 a $15/usuario/mes, que es la combinación de formalización de superficie de ataque más política de marketplace de la que depende la fuerza estructural de la predicción. El sustrato institucional para una sub-matriz publicada está ahora en su lugar.
text_locales.fil: Ang named agentic techniques ng ATT&CK v19 at ang MITRE-CNA authority ng CSAI ay nakaupo kasabay ng allow/block primitive ng Microsoft Agent 365 sa $15/user/mo, na siyang attack-surface formalization plus marketplace-policy combination na inaasahan ng structural force ng prediction. Ang institutional substrate para sa isang inilathalang sub-matrix ay nakapuwesto na ngayon.

bridges.text: ATT&CK v19's named techniques, CSAI's MITRE-CNA lane, Agent 365's tenant-level skills inventory, and BenchGuard's auditing scaffolding all line up tightly with the precondition arc the prediction expects to produce a sub-matrix and a marketplace signing gate.

text_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's named techniques, CSAI's MITRE-CNA lane, Agent 365's tenant-level skills inventory, and BenchGuard's auditing scaffolding all line up tightly with the precondition arc the prediction expects to produce a sub-matrix and a marketplace signing gate.
text_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の命名されたテクニック、CSAIのMITRE-CNAレーン、Agent 365のテナントレベルスキルインベントリ、BenchGuardの監査基盤がすべて、予測がサブマトリックスとマーケットプレイスの署名ゲートを生み出すと期待する前提条件アークと密接に整合している。
text_locales.es: Las técnicas nombradas de ATT&CK v19, el carril MITRE-CNA de CSAI, el inventario de skills a nivel de inquilino de Agent 365 y el andamiaje de auditoría de BenchGuard se alinean estrechamente con el arco de precondiciones que la predicción espera que produzca una sub-matriz y una puerta de firma de marketplace.
text_locales.fil: Ang named techniques ng ATT&CK v19, ang MITRE-CNA lane ng CSAI, ang tenant-level skills inventory ng Agent 365, at ang auditing scaffolding ng BenchGuard ay magkakahanay nang masinsin sa precondition arc na inaasahan ng prediction na magpoproduce ng sub-matrix at marketplace signing gate.

bridges.text: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authorization plus ATT&CK v19's named-techniques wave plus OpenAI Agents SDK shipping sandbox-as-default across 7 providers compose the institutional + product layers the threat-matrix thesis depends on. The first half of the prediction (sub-matrix) is converging through CSAI + ATT&CK v19 even as the marketplace-signing-gate half remains open. Strong signal on substrate, partial on enforcement.

text_locales.en: CSAI's MITRE-CNA authorization plus ATT&CK v19's named-techniques wave plus OpenAI Agents SDK shipping sandbox-as-default across 7 providers compose the institutional + product layers the threat-matrix thesis depends on. The first half of the prediction (sub-matrix) is converging through CSAI + ATT&CK v19 even as the marketplace-signing-gate half remains open. Strong signal on substrate, partial on enforcement.
text_locales.ja: CSAIのMITRE-CNA認定に加え、ATT&CK v19の命名技法の波、OpenAI Agents SDKが7プロバイダー全体でサンドボックスをデフォルトとして出荷することは、脅威マトリックステーゼが依拠する制度+製品レイヤーを構成する。予測の前半(サブマトリックス)はCSAI+ATT&CK v19を通じて収束しているが、マーケットプレイス署名ゲートの後半は依然として開いている。基盤に強いシグナル、執行に部分的。
text_locales.es: La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI más la ola de técnicas-nombradas de ATT&CK v19 más el OpenAI Agents SDK enviando sandbox-as-default a través de 7 proveedores componen las capas institucionales + producto sobre las que depende la tesis de threat-matrix. La primera mitad de la predicción (sub-matriz) está convergiendo a través de CSAI + ATT&CK v19 incluso mientras la mitad del marketplace-signing-gate permanece abierta. Señal fuerte sobre sustrato, parcial sobre enforcement.
text_locales.fil: Ang MITRE-CNA authorization ng CSAI plus ang named-techniques wave ng ATT&CK v19 plus ang OpenAI Agents SDK na naglulunsad ng sandbox-as-default sa 7 providers ay bumubuo sa institutional + product layers na pinanindigan ng threat-matrix thesis. Ang unang kalahati ng prediction (sub-matrix) ay nagko-converge sa pamamagitan ng CSAI + ATT&CK v19 kahit na ang marketplace-signing-gate kalahati ay bukas pa. Strong signal sa substrate, partial sa enforcement.

bridges.text: ATT&CK v19's named-techniques addition is the structural confirmation the prediction's threat-matrix thesis rests on, and SuiteCloud Agent Skills is the first non-foundation-lab vendor publishing skills with signed-distribution. The two halves of the prediction (sub-matrix + marketplace-signing gate) are partially materializing within 24 hours of the forecast.

text_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's named-techniques addition is the structural confirmation the prediction's threat-matrix thesis rests on, and SuiteCloud Agent Skills is the first non-foundation-lab vendor publishing skills with signed-distribution. The two halves of the prediction (sub-matrix + marketplace-signing gate) are partially materializing within 24 hours of the forecast.
text_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の命名された技法の追加は、予測の脅威マトリクステーゼが依拠する構造的確認であり、SuiteCloud Agent Skillsは署名配布付きでスキルを公開する初の非基盤研究所ベンダーである。予測の2つの半分(サブマトリクス + マーケットプレイス署名ゲート)は予測の24時間以内に部分的に具現化している。
text_locales.es: La adición de técnicas-nombradas de ATT&CK v19 es la confirmación estructural sobre la que descansa la tesis de matriz-de-amenazas de la predicción, y SuiteCloud Agent Skills es el primer vendor no-foundation-lab publicando skills con distribución firmada. Las dos mitades de la predicción (sub-matriz + gate de firma de marketplace) se materializan parcialmente dentro de las 24 horas del pronóstico.
text_locales.fil: Ang named-techniques addition ng ATT&CK v19 ay ang structural confirmation kung saan nakasalalay ang threat-matrix thesis ng prediction, at ang SuiteCloud Agent Skills ay ang unang non-foundation-lab vendor na naglalathala ng skills na may signed-distribution. Ang dalawang kalahati ng prediction (sub-matrix + marketplace-signing gate) ay bahagyang nagpapakita sa loob ng 24 hours ng forecast.

detail.description: **By H2 2026 the agent-skills attack surface lands its own MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic's official skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ships an enforced signing + provenance gate.** ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills + Cisco's **36% prompt-injection rate across the OpenClaw skill marketplace** is no longer a one-off — Apr 28 Novita Sandbox is the first commercial mitigation product purpose-built for OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. With Corpus2Skill making **"skills as a navigable artifact"** mainstream and the Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) calling skills/harness/protocol the dominant 2026 design layer, the attack surface is now **first-class infrastructure**, not a side-channel. By H2 2026 we see (a) a published agent-skills threat-matrix (MITRE-style or NIST-led) covering skill poisoning + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cross-skill privilege chains, and (b) at least one major marketplace mandating signed-and-provenance-attested skills before publish — with Anthropic's 17-skill repo, ClawHub, Multica's marketplace, and Hugging Face's agent-trace surface as the first candidates. prediction_summary_locales.es: **Para el H2 2026 la superficie de ataque de agent-skills aterriza su propia sub-matriz estilo MITRE-ATT&CK y al menos un mercado de skills importante (skills oficiales de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face / trazas de agente) envia una puerta de firma + procedencia obligatoria.** Las 1,184 skills maliciosas de ClawHub de ClawHavoc + el **36% de tasa de prompt-injection a traves del mercado de skills de OpenClaw** de Cisco ya no es algo aislado — el Novita Sandbox del 28 de abril es el primer producto comercial de mitigacion construido a proposito para runtimes OpenClaw + Hermes + agente-autonomo. Con Corpus2Skill haciendo mainstream **"skills como artefacto navegable"** y el survey Externalization-in-LLM-Agents (arxiv 2604.08224) llamando skills/harness/protocol la capa de diseno dominante de 2026, la superficie de ataque ahora es **infraestructura de primera clase**, no un canal lateral. Para el H2 2026 vemos (a) una matriz de amenazas de agent-skills publicada (estilo MITRE o liderada por NIST) cubriendo envenenamiento de skills + indirect-prompt-injection-via-skill + cadenas de privilegio entre-skills, y (b) al menos un mercado importante mandando skills firmadas-y-con-procedencia-atestada antes de publicar — con el repo de 17-skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, el mercado de Multica, y la superficie de trazas de agente de Hugging Face como los primeros candidatos. prediction_summary_locales.fil: **Pagsapit ng H2 2026, ang agent-skills attack surface ay magkakaroon ng sariling MITRE-ATT&CK-style sub-matrix at kahit isang major skill marketplace (opisyal na skills ng Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills/agent traces) ay maglalabas ng enforced signing + provenance gate.** Ang 1,184 malicious ClawHub skills ng ClawHavoc + ang **36% prompt-injection rate ng Cisco sa kabuuan ng OpenClaw skill marketplace** ay hindi na one-off — ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox ang unang commercial mitigation product na purpose-built para sa OpenClaw + Hermes + autonomous-agent runtimes. Sa Corpus2Skill na ginagawang **"skills bilang navigable artifact"** mainstream at ang Externalization-in-LLM-Agents survey (arxiv 2604.08224) na tumatawag sa skills/harness/protocol bilang dominant 2026 design layer, ang attack surface ay ngayon **first-class infrastructure**, hindi side-channel. detail.summary_short: ATT&CK v19's named techniques (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) plus ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills, Cisco's 36% prompt-injection rate, and a +32% IPI uptick force a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix and an enforced signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate by Q3 2026.

summary_short_locales.en: ATT&CK v19's named techniques (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) plus ClawHavoc's 1,184 malicious skills, Cisco's 36% prompt-injection rate, and a +32% IPI uptick force a published agent-skills threat sub-matrix and an enforced signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate by Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.ja: ATT&CK v19の命名された技法(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出しの濫用、MCP侵害、悪意あるエージェントのデプロイ)に加え、ClawHavocの1,184の悪意あるスキル、Ciscoの36%プロンプトインジェクション率、+32%のIPI急増が、2026年Q3までに公開されたエージェントスキル脅威サブマトリクスと強制的な署名+来歴認証マーケットプレイスゲートを強制する。
summary_short_locales.es: Las técnicas nombradas en ATT&CK v19 (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos) más los 1.184 skills maliciosos de ClawHavoc, la tasa del 36% de prompt-injection de Cisco y un alza del +32% en IPI fuerzan una sub-matriz publicada de amenazas de agent-skills y un gate obligatorio de firma + provenance en marketplaces para Q3 2026.
summary_short_locales.fil: Ang mga pinangalanang technique ng ATT&CK v19 (context poisoning, tool-invocation abuse, MCP compromise, malicious agent deployment) kasama ang 1,184 malicious skills ng ClawHavoc, 36% prompt-injection rate ng Cisco, at +32% IPI uptick ay pumipilit ng nailathalang agent-skills threat sub-matrix at ipinatutupad na signed + provenance-attested marketplace gate pagsapit ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: The May 7 wave — n8n KEV plus LangGraph SSRF (control-plane to cloud-metadata pivot) plus LiteLLM identity-impersonation plus MCP-server exposure telemetry plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — delivers ~5x the empirical corpus the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) baseline assumed, spanning webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, and identity-impersonation in 24 hours.

text_locales.en: The May 7 wave — n8n KEV plus LangGraph SSRF (control-plane to cloud-metadata pivot) plus LiteLLM identity-impersonation plus MCP-server exposure telemetry plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — delivers ~5x the empirical corpus the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) baseline assumed, spanning webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, and identity-impersonation in 24 hours.
text_locales.ja: 5月7日の波──n8n KEV、LangGraph SSRF(コントロールプレーンからクラウドメタデータへのピボット)、LiteLLMアイデンティティ偽装、MCPサーバー露出テレメトリ、Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP検出GA──は、エージェントスキルMITRE/NIST拡張予測(4月30日)のベースライン想定の約5倍の経験的コーパスを24時間以内に提供し、Webhook濫用、コントロールプレーンSSRF、アイデンティティ偽装に及んでいる。
text_locales.es: La oleada del 7 de mayo — n8n KEV más SSRF de LangGraph (pivote de plano de control a metadatos en la nube) más suplantación de identidad de LiteLLM más telemetría de exposición de servidor MCP más GA de detección MCP de Microsoft Defender for Cloud — entrega ~5x el corpus empírico que la base de la predicción de extensión MITRE/NIST de habilidades de agente (30 de abril) asumió, abarcando abuso de webhook, SSRF de plano de control y suplantación de identidad en 24 horas.
text_locales.fil: Ang Mayo 7 wave — n8n KEV kasama ang LangGraph SSRF (control-plane sa cloud-metadata pivot) kasama ang LiteLLM identity-impersonation kasama ang MCP-server exposure telemetry kasama ang Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP detection GA — ay nagdedeliver ng ~5x ng empirical corpus na inakala ng agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Abr 30) baseline, sumasaklaw sa webhook abuse, control-plane SSRF, at identity-impersonation sa loob ng 24 oras.

bridges.text: The n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus the standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline tighten the structural force the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) names: the LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus is now ~5x richer than the prediction baseline assumed, hardening the empirical case for a curated standards-body extension.

text_locales.en: The n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus the standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline tighten the structural force the agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Apr 30) names: the LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus is now ~5x richer than the prediction baseline assumed, hardening the empirical case for a curated standards-body extension.
text_locales.ja: n8n + Flowise + LMDeployのCVEウェーブと、標準のSGLang jinja2 SSTIベースラインは、エージェントスキルMITRE/NIST拡張予測(4月30日)が指摘する構造的力を強化する: LLMプラットフォーム固有の攻撃パターン・コーパスは、予測のベースラインが想定したよりも約5倍リッチであり、キュレートされた標準化団体拡張への経験的ケースを硬化させている。
text_locales.es: La ola de CVEs n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy más la línea base estándar SGLang jinja2 SSTI tensan la fuerza estructural que nombra la predicción de extensión agent-skills MITRE/NIST (30 abr): el corpus de patrones de ataque específicos de plataforma LLM es ~5x más rico de lo que asumió la línea base, endureciendo el caso empírico para una extensión curada de cuerpo de estándares.
text_locales.fil: Ang n8n + Flowise + LMDeploy CVE wave plus ang standing SGLang jinja2 SSTI baseline ay nagpapahigpit sa structural force na pinapangalanan ng agent-skills MITRE/NIST extension prediction (Abr 30): ang LLM-platform-specific attack-pattern corpus ay ~5x richer kaysa sa inakala ng prediction baseline, na nagpapatibay ng empirical case para sa curated standards-body extension.

text_locales.es: La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI es el precursor institucional más limpio posible a la tesis de extensión-de-ATT&CK / apéndice-de-AI-RMF de la predicción, con la ola de técnicas-nombradas de ATT&CK v19 ya poblando los slots de técnicas. description.ja: 2026年Q3までにエージェント型AIのCVEクラスが独立した第一級のCNA発行サブコーパスとなり、CSAIのMITRE認定CNAの下でエージェント／スキル／ハーネス／サンドボックス固有のCVEが50件以上公表され、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic skills、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Face skills)が公開前に署名済み+来歴証明済みの必須ゲートを実装する。4月29日のCSAI MITRE-CNA認定は制度的な火種であり、4月28日のATT&CK v19は技術名(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント展開)を命名し、4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDKは7つのサンドボックスプロバイダー(Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel)全体でデフォルトのプリミティブとしてネイティブサンドボックス実行を出荷し、4月28日のNovita Sandbox+4月28日のAWS Bedrock Managed Agents+4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry hosted agentsはベンダー側の対応を形成し、4月26日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208(単一のSQLi行がOpenAI+Anthropic+Bedrockキーを漏洩)+4月28日のSpring AI CVE-2026-40967+繰り越しのSGLang CVE-2026-5760はモデルツールレイヤー注入の影響半径を実証している。強制関数は企業のリスク移転である ― 明示的なAIエージェント任務を持つCNAが存在すれば、開示ケイデンスはランダムパブリッシャーから調整発行者主導へと圧縮され、スキルマーケットプレイスはエンタープライズ顧客を失わずに署名なしデフォルトを維持できなくなる。CSAIの最初のフルクォーター(2026年Q3)が閾値を超える最も可能性の高い着地点である。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 la clase de CVE de IA-agéntica se convierte en su propio sub-corpus de primera clase emitido por una CNA, con ≥50 CVEs específicas de agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox publicadas bajo la CNA autorizada por MITRE de CSAI, y al menos un marketplace mayor de skills (skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face) lanza un gate obligatorio de firma + atestación de provenance antes de publicar. La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr es la chispa institucional; ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr nombra las técnicas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos); el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr lanza ejecución sandbox nativa como primitiva por defecto a través de 7 proveedores sandbox (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Novita Sandbox del 28 abr + AWS Bedrock Managed Agents del 28 abr + agentes hospedados de Microsoft Foundry del 30 abr forman la contraparte del lado vendor; LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 26 abr (una sola fila SQLi filtra claves OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock) + Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 del 28 abr + el carry-forward de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demuestran el blast radius de la inyección en la capa model-tooling. La función forzante es la transferencia de riesgo empresarial — una vez que existe una CNA con el mandato explícito de IA-agente, la cadencia de divulgación se comprimirá de publisher-aleatorio a coordinated-issuer-driven, y los marketplaces de skills no podrán permanecer unsigned-by-default sin perder clientes empresariales. El primer trimestre de pull de CSAI (Q3 2026) es la zona de aterrizaje más probable para que se cruce el umbral.

La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr es la chispa institucional; ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr nombra las técnicas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos); el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr lanza ejecución sandbox nativa como primitiva por defecto a través de 7 proveedores sandbox (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Novita Sandbox del 28 abr + AWS Bedrock Managed Agents del 28 abr + agentes hospedados de Microsoft Foundry del 30 abr forman la contraparte del lado vendor; LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 26 abr (una sola fila SQLi filtra claves OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock) + Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 del 28 abr + el carry-forward de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demuestran el blast radius de la inyección en la capa model-tooling. La función forzante es la transferencia de riesgo empresarial — una vez que existe una CNA con el mandato explícito de IA-agente, la cadencia de divulgación se comprimirá de publisher-aleatorio a coordinated-issuer-driven, y los marketplaces de skills no podrán permanecer unsigned-by-default sin perder clientes empresariales. El primer trimestre de pull de CSAI (Q3 2026) es la zona de aterrizaje más probable para que se cruce el umbral.
summary.fil: Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang agentic-AI CVE class ay magiging sariling first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, na may ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs na inilathala sa ilalim ng MITRE-authorized CNA ng CSAI, at hindi bababa sa isang malaking skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ay maglulunsad ng mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate bago mag-publish. Ang Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization ang institutional spark; ang Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ay nagpangalan sa mga technique (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ay naglulunsad ng native sandbox execution bilang default primitive sa 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents ang bumubuo ng vendor-side counterpart; ang Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row na naglalabas ng OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay nagpapakita ng model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise risk transfer — kapag may CNA na may explicit AI-agent mandate, mag-co-compress ang disclosure cadence mula random-publisher patungo sa coordinated-issuer-driven, at hindi makakaiwas ang skill marketplaces na manatiling unsigned-by-default nang hindi nawawalan ng enterprise customers. Ang first-pull-quarter ng CSAI (Q3 2026) ay ang pinaka-malamang na landing zone para malagpasan ang threshold.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI CVE class becomes its own first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, with ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs published under CSAI's MITRE-authorized CNA, and at least one major skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ships a mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate before publish. Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization is the institutional spark; Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 names the techniques (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ships native sandbox execution as a default primitive across 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents form the vendor-side counterpart; Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row leaks OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demonstrate the model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. The forcing function is enterprise risk transfer — once a CNA exists with the explicit AI-agent mandate, the disclosure cadence will compress from random-publisher to coordinated-issuer-driven, and skill marketplaces will not be able to remain unsigned-by-default without losing enterprise customers. CSAI's first-pull-quarter (Q3 2026) is the most-likely landing zone for the threshold to be crossed.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: 2026年Q3までにエージェント型AIのCVEクラスが独立した第一級のCNA発行サブコーパスとなり、CSAIのMITRE認定CNAの下でエージェント／スキル／ハーネス／サンドボックス固有のCVEが50件以上公表され、少なくとも1つの主要なスキルマーケットプレイス(Anthropic skills、ClawHub、Multica、Hermes、Hugging Face skills)が公開前に署名済み+来歴証明済みの必須ゲートを実装する。4月29日のCSAI MITRE-CNA認定は制度的な火種であり、4月28日のATT&CK v19は技術名(コンテキスト汚染、ツール呼び出し悪用、MCPサーバー侵害、悪意あるエージェント展開)を命名し、4月30日のOpenAI Agents SDKは7つのサンドボックスプロバイダー(Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel)全体でデフォルトのプリミティブとしてネイティブサンドボックス実行を出荷し、4月28日のNovita Sandbox+4月28日のAWS Bedrock Managed Agents+4月30日のMicrosoft Foundry hosted agentsはベンダー側の対応を形成し、4月26日のLiteLLM CVE-2026-42208(単一のSQLi行がOpenAI+Anthropic+Bedrockキーを漏洩)+4月28日のSpring AI CVE-2026-40967+繰り越しのSGLang CVE-2026-5760はモデルツールレイヤー注入の影響半径を実証している。強制関数は企業のリスク移転である ― 明示的なAIエージェント任務を持つCNAが存在すれば、開示ケイデンスはランダムパブリッシャーから調整発行者主導へと圧縮され、スキルマーケットプレイスはエンタープライズ顧客を失わずに署名なしデフォルトを維持できなくなる。CSAIの最初のフルクォーター(2026年Q3)が閾値を超える最も可能性の高い着地点である。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q3 2026 la clase de CVE de IA-agéntica se convierte en su propio sub-corpus de primera clase emitido por una CNA, con ≥50 CVEs específicas de agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox publicadas bajo la CNA autorizada por MITRE de CSAI, y al menos un marketplace mayor de skills (skills de Anthropic, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, skills de Hugging Face) lanza un gate obligatorio de firma + atestación de provenance antes de publicar. La autorización CNA-MITRE de CSAI del 29 abr es la chispa institucional; ATT&CK v19 del 28 abr nombra las técnicas (envenenamiento de contexto, abuso de invocación de herramientas, compromiso de servidor MCP, despliegue de agentes maliciosos); el OpenAI Agents SDK del 30 abr lanza ejecución sandbox nativa como primitiva por defecto a través de 7 proveedores sandbox (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); Novita Sandbox del 28 abr + AWS Bedrock Managed Agents del 28 abr + agentes hospedados de Microsoft Foundry del 30 abr forman la contraparte del lado vendor; LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 del 26 abr (una sola fila SQLi filtra claves OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock) + Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 del 28 abr + el carry-forward de SGLang CVE-2026-5760 demuestran el blast radius de la inyección en la capa model-tooling. La función forzante es la transferencia de riesgo empresarial — una vez que existe una CNA con el mandato explícito de IA-agente, la cadencia de divulgación se comprimirá de publisher-aleatorio a coordinated-issuer-driven, y los marketplaces de skills no podrán permanecer unsigned-by-default sin perder clientes empresariales. El primer trimestre de pull de CSAI (Q3 2026) es la zona de aterrizaje más probable para que se cruce el umbral.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Pagsapit ng Q3 2026, ang agentic-AI CVE class ay magiging sariling first-class CNA-issued sub-corpus, na may ≥50 agent-/skill-/harness-/sandbox-specific CVEs na inilathala sa ilalim ng MITRE-authorized CNA ng CSAI, at hindi bababa sa isang malaking skill marketplace (Anthropic skills, ClawHub, Multica, Hermes, Hugging Face skills) ay maglulunsad ng mandatory signed-+-provenance-attested gate bago mag-publish. Ang Apr 29 CSAI MITRE-CNA authorization ang institutional spark; ang Apr 28 ATT&CK v19 ay nagpangalan sa mga technique (context poisoning, tool invocation abuse, MCP server compromise, malicious agent deployment); ang Apr 30 OpenAI Agents SDK ay naglulunsad ng native sandbox execution bilang default primitive sa 7 sandbox providers (Blaxel/Cloudflare/Daytona/E2B/Modal/Runloop/Vercel); ang Apr 28 Novita Sandbox + Apr 28 AWS Bedrock Managed Agents + Apr 30 Microsoft Foundry hosted agents ang bumubuo ng vendor-side counterpart; ang Apr 26 LiteLLM CVE-2026-42208 (single SQLi row na naglalabas ng OpenAI + Anthropic + Bedrock keys) + Apr 28 Spring AI CVE-2026-40967 + carry-forward SGLang CVE-2026-5760 ay nagpapakita ng model-tooling-layer-injection blast radius. Ang forcing function ay ang enterprise risk transfer — kapag may CNA na may explicit AI-agent mandate, mag-co-compress ang disclosure cadence mula random-publisher patungo sa coordinated-issuer-driven, at hindi makakaiwas ang skill marketplaces na manatiling unsigned-by-default nang hindi nawawalan ng enterprise customers. Ang first-pull-quarter ng CSAI (Q3 2026) ay ang pinaka-malamang na landing zone para malagpasan ang threshold.

nodes.description: Cisco's May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition makes non-human-identity (NHI) governance an explicit M&A-tier primitive on the same week as Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU with per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) and the May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting that names identity as Zero Trust's first pillar in the agentic-AI era. The structural backdrop is severe: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers as of early 2026 with roughly half operating with no authorization controls, AI agents and other non-human identities now outnumber human users ~100:1 in major enterprises (per Cisco's customer survey), and MCP itself ships with no built-in identity, no least-privilege enforcement, and no audit trail. Cisco's planned integration of Astrix into Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converges with Microsoft's per-agent identity model into a de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — but the procurement tier above (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) requires a published-standard reference, not a vendor-specific architecture diagram. By Q4 2026 NIST is expected to publish a dedicated NHI control profile (most likely as a SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement or an SP 800-53 control-family overlay) treating machine identities, agent identities, and service-account identities as a distinct compliance category with discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, and audit-trail control families. CISA agentic-AI guidance and SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary follow within one quarter via the same forcing function — the $400M Astrix M&A price tag is itself a regulator-readable signal that the category has crossed into balance-sheet materiality.

description.ja: 5月4日のCiscoによる$400MのAstrix Security買収は、5月1日のMicrosoft Agent 365 GA($15/ユーザー/月のM365 E7 SKU、エージェント単位のDefenderリレーションシップマップ + Entra ID + Purview + Intune)、そしてエージェントAI時代のZero Trust第一の柱としてアイデンティティを名指しした5月1日のCloud Security Alliance投稿と同じ週に、非人間アイデンティティ(NHI)ガバナンスを明示的なM&A階層のプリミティブにする。構造的な背景は深刻だ: 2026年初頭時点で約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバーがあり、その約半数が認可コントロールなしで稼働、AIエージェントその他の非人間アイデンティティが大手企業内で人間ユーザーを約100:1で上回る(Ciscoの顧客調査)、そしてMCP自体は組み込みアイデンティティ、最小権限、監査証跡を一切備えていない。CiscoによるAstrixのCisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAMへの統合計画は、Microsoftのエージェント単位アイデンティティ・モデルと収斂してデファクトの2ベンダーNHIコントロール・プレーン・プリミティブを形成する — しかしその上の調達階層(連邦CISOオフィス、銀行規制当局、HIPAAスコープのヘルスケア・バイヤー)は、ベンダー固有のアーキテクチャ図ではなく公表標準のリファレンスを要求する。2026年Q4までに、NISTは専用のNHIコントロール・プロファイルを公表することが期待される(SP 800-207系のZero Trust補遺、もしくはSP 800-53コントロール・ファミリー・オーバーレイの形が最有力)。マシン・アイデンティティ、エージェント・アイデンティティ、サービス・アカウント・アイデンティティを、発見、ライフサイクル、最小権限、監査証跡のコントロール・ファミリーを伴う独立したコンプライアンス・カテゴリとして扱う。CISAのエージェントAIガイダンスとSECのサイバー開示ルール・コメンタリーは同じ強制関数で1四半期以内に追随する — $400MのAstrix M&A価格自体が、カテゴリがバランスシート重要性に達したことを示す規制当局可読のシグナルである。
description.es: La adquisición del 4 de mayo de Astrix Security por $400M de Cisco hace de la gobernanza de identidad no-humana (NHI) un primitivo explícito de nivel M&A en la misma semana que la GA de Microsoft Agent 365 (1 de mayo, SKU M365 E7 a $15/user/mo con mapa de relaciones por agente de Defender + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) y la publicación del 1 de mayo de Cloud Security Alliance que nombra a la identidad como el primer pilar de Zero Trust en la era de la IA agéntica. El telón de fondo estructural es severo: ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet a comienzos de 2026 con aproximadamente la mitad operando sin controles de autorización, los agentes de IA y otras identidades no-humanas ahora superan en número a los usuarios humanos ~100:1 en empresas grandes (según la encuesta de clientes de Cisco), y MCP mismo se entrega sin identidad incorporada, sin aplicación de mínimo privilegio y sin pista de auditoría. La integración planeada de Astrix por Cisco en Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converge con el modelo de identidad por agente de Microsoft hacia un primitivo de plano de control de NHI de facto de dos vendors — pero el nivel de adquisición superior (oficinas federales de CISO, reguladores bancarios, compradores con alcance HIPAA en salud) requiere una referencia de estándar publicado, no un diagrama de arquitectura específico de vendor. Para Q4 2026 se espera que NIST publique un perfil de control de NHI dedicado (más probablemente como un suplemento de la serie SP 800-207 de Zero Trust o una superposición de familia de controles de SP 800-53) tratando las identidades de máquina, identidades de agente e identidades de cuentas de servicio como una categoría de cumplimiento distinta con familias de controles de descubrimiento, ciclo de vida, mínimo privilegio y pista de auditoría. La guía de IA agéntica de CISA y el comentario de la regla de divulgación cibernética de la SEC siguen dentro de un trimestre vía la misma función forzante — el precio de M&A de Astrix de $400M es en sí mismo una señal legible para reguladores de que la categoría ha cruzado a materialidad de balance.
description.fil: Ang May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition ng Cisco ay ginagawang explicit M&A-tier primitive ang non-human-identity (NHI) governance sa parehong linggo ng Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU na may per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) at ng May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting na nagngangalan sa identity bilang unang pillar ng Zero Trust sa agentic-AI era. Malala ang structural backdrop: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers noong unang bahagi ng 2026 na halos kalahati ay tumatakbo nang walang authorization controls, ang AI agents at ibang non-human identities ay ngayon mas marami kaysa sa human users sa ratio na ~100:1 sa mga major enterprises (ayon sa Cisco customer survey), at ang MCP mismo ay nag-ship nang walang built-in identity, walang least-privilege enforcement, at walang audit trail. Ang planned integration ng Cisco ng Astrix sa Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM ay nag-co-converge sa per-agent identity model ng Microsoft papasok sa de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — ngunit ang procurement tier sa itaas (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) ay nangangailangan ng nailathalang-pamantayang reference, hindi vendor-specific architecture diagram. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, inaasahan na maglathala ang NIST ng nakatuong NHI control profile (pinakamalamang bilang SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement o SP 800-53 control-family overlay) na tinatrato ang machine identities, agent identities, at service-account identities bilang natatanging compliance category na may discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, at audit-trail control families. Susunod ang CISA agentic-AI guidance at SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary sa loob ng isang quarter sa pamamagitan ng parehong forcing function — ang $400M Astrix M&A price tag mismo ay regulator-readable signal na ang category ay tumawid na sa balance-sheet materiality.

summary.ja: 5月4日のCiscoによる$400MのAstrix Security買収は、5月1日のMicrosoft Agent 365 GA($15/ユーザー/月のM365 E7 SKU、エージェント単位のDefenderリレーションシップマップ + Entra ID + Purview + Intune)、そしてエージェントAI時代のZero Trust第一の柱としてアイデンティティを名指しした5月1日のCloud Security Alliance投稿と同じ週に、非人間アイデンティティ(NHI)ガバナンスを明示的なM&A階層のプリミティブにする。構造的な背景は深刻だ: 2026年初頭時点で約7,000のインターネット公開MCPサーバーがあり、その約半数が認可コントロールなしで稼働、AIエージェントその他の非人間アイデンティティが大手企業内で人間ユーザーを約100:1で上回る(Ciscoの顧客調査)、そしてMCP自体は組み込みアイデンティティ、最小権限、監査証跡を一切備えていない。CiscoによるAstrixのCisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAMへの統合計画は、Microsoftのエージェント単位アイデンティティ・モデルと収斂してデファクトの2ベンダーNHIコントロール・プレーン・プリミティブを形成する — しかしその上の調達階層(連邦CISOオフィス、銀行規制当局、HIPAAスコープのヘルスケア・バイヤー)は、ベンダー固有のアーキテクチャ図ではなく公表標準のリファレンスを要求する。2026年Q4までに、NISTは専用のNHIコントロール・プロファイルを公表することが期待される(SP 800-207系のZero Trust補遺、もしくはSP 800-53コントロール・ファミリー・オーバーレイの形が最有力)。マシン・アイデンティティ、エージェント・アイデンティティ、サービス・アカウント・アイデンティティを、発見、ライフサイクル、最小権限、監査証跡のコントロール・ファミリーを伴う独立したコンプライアンス・カテゴリとして扱う。CISAのエージェントAIガイダンスとSECのサイバー開示ルール・コメンタリーは同じ強制関数で1四半期以内に追随する — $400MのAstrix M&A価格自体が、カテゴリがバランスシート重要性に達したことを示す規制当局可読のシグナルである。
summary.es: La adquisición del 4 de mayo de Astrix Security por $400M de Cisco hace de la gobernanza de identidad no-humana (NHI) un primitivo explícito de nivel M&A en la misma semana que la GA de Microsoft Agent 365 (1 de mayo, SKU M365 E7 a $15/user/mo con mapa de relaciones por agente de Defender + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) y la publicación del 1 de mayo de Cloud Security Alliance que nombra a la identidad como el primer pilar de Zero Trust en la era de la IA agéntica. El telón de fondo estructural es severo: ~7,000 servidores MCP expuestos a internet a comienzos de 2026 con aproximadamente la mitad operando sin controles de autorización, los agentes de IA y otras identidades no-humanas ahora superan en número a los usuarios humanos ~100:1 en empresas grandes (según la encuesta de clientes de Cisco), y MCP mismo se entrega sin identidad incorporada, sin aplicación de mínimo privilegio y sin pista de auditoría. La integración planeada de Astrix por Cisco en Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM converge con el modelo de identidad por agente de Microsoft hacia un primitivo de plano de control de NHI de facto de dos vendors — pero el nivel de adquisición superior (oficinas federales de CISO, reguladores bancarios, compradores con alcance HIPAA en salud) requiere una referencia de estándar publicado, no un diagrama de arquitectura específico de vendor. Para Q4 2026 se espera que NIST publique un perfil de control de NHI dedicado (más probablemente como un suplemento de la serie SP 800-207 de Zero Trust o una superposición de familia de controles de SP 800-53) tratando las identidades de máquina, identidades de agente e identidades de cuentas de servicio como una categoría de cumplimiento distinta con familias de controles de descubrimiento, ciclo de vida, mínimo privilegio y pista de auditoría. La guía de IA agéntica de CISA y el comentario de la regla de divulgación cibernética de la SEC siguen dentro de un trimestre vía la misma función forzante — el precio de M&A de Astrix de $400M es en sí mismo una señal legible para reguladores de que la categoría ha cruzado a materialidad de balance.
summary.fil: Ang May 4 $400M Astrix Security acquisition ng Cisco ay ginagawang explicit M&A-tier primitive ang non-human-identity (NHI) governance sa parehong linggo ng Microsoft Agent 365 GA (May 1, $15/user/mo M365 E7 SKU na may per-agent Defender relationship map + Entra ID + Purview + Intune) at ng May 1 Cloud Security Alliance posting na nagngangalan sa identity bilang unang pillar ng Zero Trust sa agentic-AI era. Malala ang structural backdrop: ~7,000 internet-exposed MCP servers noong unang bahagi ng 2026 na halos kalahati ay tumatakbo nang walang authorization controls, ang AI agents at ibang non-human identities ay ngayon mas marami kaysa sa human users sa ratio na ~100:1 sa mga major enterprises (ayon sa Cisco customer survey), at ang MCP mismo ay nag-ship nang walang built-in identity, walang least-privilege enforcement, at walang audit trail. Ang planned integration ng Cisco ng Astrix sa Cisco Identity Intelligence + Secure Access + Duo IAM ay nag-co-converge sa per-agent identity model ng Microsoft papasok sa de-facto two-vendor NHI control-plane primitive — ngunit ang procurement tier sa itaas (federal CISO offices, banking regulators, healthcare HIPAA-scoped buyers) ay nangangailangan ng nailathalang-pamantayang reference, hindi vendor-specific architecture diagram. Pagsapit ng Q4 2026, inaasahan na maglathala ang NIST ng nakatuong NHI control profile (pinakamalamang bilang SP 800-207-series Zero Trust supplement o SP 800-53 control-family overlay) na tinatrato ang machine identities, agent identities, at service-account identities bilang natatanging compliance category na may discovery, lifecycle, least-privilege, at audit-trail control families. Susunod ang CISA agentic-AI guidance at SEC cyber-disclosure-rule commentary sa loob ng isang quarter sa pamamagitan ng parehong forcing function — ang $400M Astrix M&A price tag mismo ay regulator-readable signal na ang category ay tumawid na sa balance-sheet materiality.

text_locales.en: The Saturday arxiv 2605.05933 (MIT CSAIL + ETH Zurich + Anthropic) provides a citable formal-verification framework for per-tenant capability attestation; Defender quarantines climb to 24% of net-new MCP servers, Sysdig logs 19-minute median credential-extraction on unprotected estates, and the 41-enterprise gated cohort delivers exactly the cross-vendor empirical baseline a NIST profile would consolidate.
text_locales.ja: 土曜arxiv 2605.05933(MIT CSAIL + ETH Zurich + Anthropic)はテナント単位能力アテステーションのための引用可能な形式検証フレームワークを提供;Defender隔離はネットニューMCPサーバーの24%へ上昇、Sysdigは保護されていないエステートで19分中央認証情報抽出をログ、41エンタープライズ・ゲーティング・コホートはNISTプロファイルが統合する正にクロスベンダー経験的ベースラインを提供する。
text_locales.es: El arxiv del sábado 2605.05933 (MIT CSAIL + ETH Zurich + Anthropic) provee un marco citable de verificación formal para atestación de capacidad por tenant; las cuarentenas de Defender suben al 24% de los nuevos servidores MCP netos, Sysdig registra extracción mediana de credenciales de 19 minutos en patrimonios desprotegidos, y la cohorte gateada de 41 empresas entrega exactamente la línea base empírica cross-vendor que un perfil NIST consolidaría.
text_locales.fil: Ang Saturday arxiv 2605.05933 (MIT CSAIL + ETH Zurich + Anthropic) ay nagbibigay ng citable formal-verification framework para sa per-tenant capability attestation; umaakyat ang Defender quarantines sa 24% ng net-new MCP servers, nagla-log ang Sysdig ng 19-minute median credential-extraction sa unprotected estates, at naghahatid ang 41-enterprise gated cohort ng eksaktong cross-vendor empirical baseline na ico-consolidate ng NIST profile.

bridges.text: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI ship managed signed-skill registries with per-tenant gating in parallel; Cisco Astrix's MCP-server identity gateway integrating Defender XDR plus Microsoft Agent 365 audit ledger lands as the first cross-vendor control-plane stack with visibility on >60% of new MCP-server provisioning events.

text_locales.en: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, and Google Cloud Vertex AI ship managed signed-skill registries with per-tenant gating in parallel; Cisco Astrix's MCP-server identity gateway integrating Defender XDR plus Microsoft Agent 365 audit ledger lands as the first cross-vendor control-plane stack with visibility on >60% of new MCP-server provisioning events.
text_locales.ja: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry、AWS Bedrock、Google Cloud Vertex AIはper-tenant gating付きのmanaged署名スキルレジストリを並行して出荷する。Cisco AstrixのMCPサーバ・アイデンティティ・ゲートウェイがDefender XDRおよびMicrosoft Agent 365監査台帳と統合され、新規MCPサーバプロビジョニングイベントの>60%に可視性を持つ最初のクロスベンダーcontrol-planeスタックとして着地する。
text_locales.es: Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock y Google Cloud Vertex AI envian managed signed-skill registries con per-tenant gating en paralelo; el MCP-server identity gateway de Cisco Astrix integrando Defender XDR mas el audit ledger de Microsoft Agent 365 aterriza como el primer stack cross-vendor de control-plane con visibilidad sobre >60% de eventos de provisioning de nuevos MCP-servers.
text_locales.fil: Ang Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, at Google Cloud Vertex AI ay nagpapadala ng managed signed-skill registries na may per-tenant gating nang paralelo; ang MCP-server identity gateway ng Cisco Astrix na nagsasama ng Defender XDR plus Microsoft Agent 365 audit ledger ay lumalapag bilang unang cross-vendor control-plane stack na may visibility sa >60% ng new MCP-server provisioning events.

bridges.text: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0's signed sandboxed-skill registry plus OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry GA with FedRAMP-Moderate plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection GA, layered against ~9,400 exposed MCP servers (~58% no-auth), tighten the cross-vendor agent-identity baseline a NIST non-human-identity control profile would consolidate. The taxonomy work itself is still missing.

text_locales.en: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0's signed sandboxed-skill registry plus OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise per-org agent registry GA with FedRAMP-Moderate plus Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection GA, layered against ~9,400 exposed MCP servers (~58% no-auth), tighten the cross-vendor agent-identity baseline a NIST non-human-identity control profile would consolidate. The taxonomy work itself is still missing.
text_locales.ja: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0の署名サンドボックス・スキルレジストリ、OpenAI ChatGPT Enterpriseの組織別エージェントレジストリFedRAMP-Moderate GA、Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCPサーバー脅威検出GAが、約9,400露出MCPサーバー(約58%が認証なし)を背景に、NIST非人間アイデンティティ管理プロファイルが統合するであろうクロスベンダー・エージェント・アイデンティティ基盤を強化する。タクソノミー作業自体は依然欠落している。
text_locales.es: El registro de habilidades sandbox firmado de Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 más la GA del registro de agentes por organización de OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise con FedRAMP-Moderate más la GA de detección de amenazas de servidor MCP de Microsoft Defender for Cloud, en capas contra ~9.400 servidores MCP expuestos (~58% sin autenticación), tensan la línea base de identidad de agente entre proveedores que un perfil de control de identidad no humana de NIST consolidaría. El trabajo de taxonomía en sí sigue faltando.
text_locales.fil: Ang signed sandboxed-skill registry ng Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 kasama ang per-org agent registry GA ng OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise na may FedRAMP-Moderate kasama ang MCP-server threat-detection GA ng Microsoft Defender for Cloud, na nakapatong sa ~9,400 exposed MCP servers (~58% no-auth), ay naghihigpit sa cross-vendor agent-identity baseline na iko-consolidate ng NIST non-human-identity control profile. Ang taxonomy work mismo ay nawawala pa rin.

needs.actor: Fortune-500 financial-services CISO commenting on the NIST initial public draft
needs.job: submit substantive public-comment feedback that ties the proposed NHI control families back to concrete operational findings — MCP-server inventory gaps, service-account proliferation, and agentic-AI lateral-movement scenarios already observed inside the bank's own Microsoft Agent 365 and Anthropic-finance-agent deployments.
needs.outcome: Filed public comment (and an industry-coalition joint comment with FS-ISAC peers) that shapes the final control profile to include audit-trail attribution requirements compatible with SR 11-7 model-risk and SEC cyber-disclosure reporting.
needs.motivation: Avoid being forced into a control profile that mismatches existing model-risk and cyber-disclosure controls — better to invest comment cycles upfront than retrofit a published standard against bank-specific operational reality.

outcome_locales.en: Filed public comment (and an industry-coalition joint comment with FS-ISAC peers) that shapes the final control profile to include audit-trail attribution requirements compatible with SR 11-7 model-risk and SEC cyber-disclosure reporting.
