summary.ja: Q4 2026までに、土曜公表のNHS Englandエージェンティック AIワークフロー・プラットフォームCVEブロックリスト — Ni8mare(n8n CVE-2026-21858)、LangGraph CVE-2026-44012、LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188、CrewAI CVE-2026-44352、Haystack CVE-2026-44391をNHSテナント展開上での非許可プリパッチ・バージョンとして指名 — に、MistralのDGFiP中央税務行政Workflows選定(LangGraphセルフホスト + Anthropic Claude Code 3.0レジストリに対するコントロール・プレーン分離 + ソブリン・クラウド実行ワーカー形状を引用)、および韓国PIPCとニュージーランドGCSBの週末によるSingapore IMDA / Japan AISIサイバー評価レシプロシティ境界拡張が組み合わさり、少なくとも4つの同盟国公的部門調達レジーム(UK NHS + France DGFiP + 少なくとも1つのインド太平洋シグナトリ + 1つのEU加盟国フレームワーク・アグリーメント)に採用される名指しCVEペッグ・ソブリン調達ゲートへ硬化する。強制機能は、NHS Englandが現在、連邦民政部門KEVミラーリング期限(CISA 5月21日)に紐付けられた公表可能なCVEごとブロックリストを実証したこと、Mistralがそのブロックリスト上に明示的に名指しされたLangGraphセルフホスト代替に対してフラッグシップ中央政府資産でソブリン・クラウド・コントロール・プレーン分離が勝つことを実証したこと、インド太平洋レシプロシティ境界がAISI管理サイバー評価結果を同盟国コホート全体の運用閾値として現在拘束していることである。UKフロントラインNHSトラスト + フランス中央税務行政資産がコンコーダントなCVEペッグ・テナンシー条件を公表し、Anthropicのテナントごとのアテステーション・ログ・プリミティブ(Simon Willisonが土曜に持続的監査トレイル・レビューに耐える初のベンダーサイド・ガバナンス形状として称賛)が正準コンプライアンス証拠となるや否や、ゲートは任意ブロックリストから調達マンデート言語へ合成する。最も可能性の高い形状は4管轄区域(UK + France + Singapore-or-Japan + Germany-or-Netherlands BSI同等)のCVEペッグ・アネックスで、CVEごとのレメディエーション・ステータス + テナントごとのMythosクラス能力アテステーションをペアの調達適格性証拠として扱い、運用レビュー・ケイデンスはAISIサイバー評価レシプロシティ120日プレースメント・ウィンドウに整合する。ベア・ケースはCISAが同盟国境界を先取りするエージェンティックAIワークフローKEVバンドル拘束力ある運用指令をファストトラックする;それ以外の場合、Q4 2026は名指しCVE調達ゲートを着地させる。
summary.es: Para Q4 2026 la lista de bloqueo de CVE de plataforma de workflow agentic-AI de NHS England publicada el sábado — nombrando Ni8mare (n8n CVE-2026-21858), LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, y Haystack CVE-2026-44391 como versiones pre-parche no permitidas en despliegues NHS-tenant — combinada con la selección de Workflows de Mistral por DGFiP central-tax-administration (citando separación del plano-de-control + forma de execution-worker sovereign-cloud sobre LangGraph autoalojado más el registro de Anthropic Claude Code 3.0) y las extensiones de fin de semana de South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB del perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI, se endurecerán en un gate de adquisición soberana fijado-a-CVE-nombrado adoptado a través de al menos cuatro regímenes de adquisición público-sector aliados (UK NHS + France DGFiP + al menos un signatario Indo-Pacífico + un acuerdo marco de un estado-miembro EU). La función forzante es que NHS England ha demostrado ahora una lista de bloqueo publicable por-CVE atada a una fecha límite de federal-civilian-KEV-mirroring (CISA 21 de mayo), Mistral ha demostrado que la separación del plano-de-control sovereign-cloud gana una propiedad de gobierno central insignia contra la alternativa LangGraph autoalojada explícitamente nombrada en esa lista de bloqueo, y el perímetro de reciprocidad Indo-Pacífico ahora ata los resultados de eval cyber administrados por AISI como el umbral operativo a través de la cohorte aliada. Una vez que un trust frontline NHS del UK + una propiedad central-tax-administration francesa publican términos de tenancy fijados-a-CVE concordantes y la primitiva de log-de-atestación por tenant de Anthropic (elogiada por Simon Willison el sábado como la primera forma de gobernanza del lado-vendedor que soporta una revisión sostenida de pista-de-auditoría) se convierte en la evidencia de cumplimiento canónica, el gate se compone de lista de bloqueo voluntaria a lenguaje de mandato-de-adquisición. La forma más probable es un anexo fijado-a-CVE de cuatro-jurisdicciones (UK + France + Singapore-o-Japan + Germany-o-Netherlands BSI-equivalente) tratando el estado de remediación por-CVE más la atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant como evidencia emparejada de elegibilidad-de-adquisición, con la cadencia de revisión operativa alineada con la ventana de colocación de 120 días de la reciprocidad de eval cyber AISI. El caso bajista es que CISA acelera una Binding Operational Directive de bundle KEV de workflow agentic-AI que se anticipa al perímetro aliado; en ausencia de eso, Q4 2026 aterriza el gate de adquisición de CVE-nombrado.
summary.fil: Sa Q4 2026 ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist na inilathala nitong Saturday — na nagngangalan sa Ni8mare (n8n CVE-2026-21858), LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, at Haystack CVE-2026-44391 bilang disallowed pre-patch versions sa NHS-tenant deployments — kasama ng DGFiP central-tax-administration Workflows selection ng Mistral (binanggit ang control-plane separation + sovereign-cloud execution-worker shape laban sa LangGraph self-hosted plus ang Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry) at ang South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB weekend extensions ng Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter, ay matitigas sa named-CVE-pegged sovereign-procurement gate na adopted sa hindi bababa sa apat na allied public-sector procurement regimes (UK NHS + France DGFiP + hindi bababa sa isang Indo-Pacific signatory + isang EU member-state framework agreement). Ang forcing function ay na ang NHS England ay nagpakita na ngayon ng publishable per-CVE blocklist na nakatali sa federal-civilian KEV-mirroring deadline (CISA May 21), ipinakita ng Mistral na ang sovereign-cloud control-plane separation ay nananalo ng flagship central-government estate laban sa LangGraph self-hosted alternative na hayagang pinangalanan sa blocklist na iyon, at ang Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter ay binubuklod na ngayon ang AISI-administered cyber-eval results bilang operative threshold sa allied cohort. Sa sandaling isang UK frontline NHS trust + isang French central-tax-administration estate ay maglalathala ng concordant CVE-pegged tenancy terms at ang per-tenant attestation-log primitive ng Anthropic (pinuri ni Simon Willison nitong Saturday bilang unang vendor-side governance shape na nakakayanan ang sustained audit-trail review) ay magiging canonical compliance evidence, ang gate ay nagco-compose mula sa voluntary blocklist papasok sa procurement-mandate language. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang four-jurisdiction CVE-pegged annex (UK + France + Singapore-or-Japan + Germany-or-Netherlands BSI-equivalent) na tinatrato ang per-CVE remediation status plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation bilang paired procurement-eligibility evidence, na ang operative review cadence ay nakaayon sa AISI cyber-eval reciprocity 120-day placement window. Bear case ay na ang CISA ay nag-fast-track ng agentic-AI workflow KEV-bundle Binding Operational Directive na nag-pre-empt sa allied perimeter; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q4 2026 sa named-CVE procurement gate.

text_locales.es: El aterrizaje del día once de HMRC VAT-fraud-detection de Mistral añade una tercera referencia de gobierno central dentro de 72 horas tras DGFiP y Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit; la blocklist de CVE nombrada de NHS England se mantiene mientras LangChain CVE-2026-44712 completa la ola de siete CVE de agent-loader; el conteo de instancias expuestas de n8n de Shadowserver cae 13.7 por ciento y CISA refresca su catálogo KEV antes de la fecha límite federal-civil del 21 de mayo.
text_locales.fil: Nagdaragdag ang Mistral's day-eleven HMRC VAT-fraud-detection landing ng ikatlong central-government reference sa loob ng 72 oras matapos ang DGFiP at Bundesagentur fuer Arbeit; hawak ang NHS England's named-CVE blocklist habang tinatapos ng LangChain CVE-2026-44712 ang seven-CVE agent-loader wave; bumababa ang Shadowserver n8n exposed-instance count ng 13.7 percent at ire-refresh ng CISA ang KEV catalog nito bago ang May 21 federal-civilian deadline.

bridges.text: On the allied CVE blocklist procurement-gate prediction (May 9): Mistral's day-ten Bundesagentur sovereign-cloud landing supplies a second central-government reference inside 48 hours after DGFiP, citing control-plane separation as decider against the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform blocklist's named-CVE disallowed pre-patch versions (LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, Ni8mare). Shadowserver's day-ten n8n exposed-instance count falls to approximately 5,700 with unpatched residual share at 38 percent; CISA refreshes the KEV catalog with the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline reminder; Trail of Bits extends the agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern across AutoGen and Semantic Kernel; the Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter widens to eight named jurisdictions.

text_locales.en: On the allied CVE blocklist procurement-gate prediction (May 9): Mistral's day-ten Bundesagentur sovereign-cloud landing supplies a second central-government reference inside 48 hours after DGFiP, citing control-plane separation as decider against the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform blocklist's named-CVE disallowed pre-patch versions (LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, Ni8mare). Shadowserver's day-ten n8n exposed-instance count falls to approximately 5,700 with unpatched residual share at 38 percent; CISA refreshes the KEV catalog with the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline reminder; Trail of Bits extends the agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern across AutoGen and Semantic Kernel; the Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter widens to eight named jurisdictions.
text_locales.ja: 同盟CVEブロックリスト調達ゲート予測(5月9日)について: Mistralの10日目Bundesagentur主権クラウド着地は、DGFiP後48時間以内に2つ目の中央政府リファレンスを供給し、NHS Englandエージェンティック・ワークフロー・プラットフォーム・ブロックリストの命名CVE許可されていないpre-patchバージョン(LangGraph、LiteLLM、CrewAI、Haystack、Ni8mare)に対する決定要因としてコントロール・プレーン分離を引用。Shadowserverの10日目n8n曝露インスタンス・カウントは約5,700まで低下し、未パッチ残余シェアは38パーセント;CISAは5月21日連邦民間修復期限のリマインダーでKEVカタログをリフレッシュ;Trail of BitsはAutoGenとSemantic Kernelにわたるエージェント・チェックポイント・アンド・マニフェスト・ローダー曝露パターンを拡張;インド太平洋相互性ペリメーターは8つの命名管轄区へ広がる。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción de blocklist de CVE aliada como puerta de adquisición (9 de mayo): el aterrizaje del día diez de Mistral en la Bundesagentur soberano-cloud suministra una segunda referencia de gobierno central dentro de 48 horas tras DGFiP, citando la separación de plano de control como decisor contra las versiones pre-parche no permitidas con CVE nombrado de la blocklist de plataforma de workflow IA agéntica de NHS England (LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, Ni8mare). El conteo de instancias expuestas de n8n del día diez de Shadowserver cae a aproximadamente 5,700 con la cuota residual sin parche en 38 por ciento; CISA refresca el catálogo KEV con el recordatorio de fecha límite de remediación federal-civil del 21 de mayo; Trail of Bits extiende el patrón de exposición de agent-checkpoint-y-manifest-loader a través de AutoGen y Semantic Kernel; el perímetro de reciprocidad Indo-Pacífico se amplía a ocho jurisdicciones nombradas.
text_locales.fil: Sa allied CVE blocklist procurement-gate prediction (Mayo 9): nagbibigay ang Mistral's day-ten Bundesagentur sovereign-cloud landing ng pangalawang central-government reference sa loob ng 48 oras matapos ang DGFiP, na binabanggit ang control-plane separation bilang decider laban sa NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform blocklist's named-CVE disallowed pre-patch versions (LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, Ni8mare). Bumababa ang Shadowserver's day-ten n8n exposed-instance count sa humigit-kumulang 5,700 na ang unpatched residual share ay nasa 38 porsiyento; ni-refresh ng CISA ang KEV catalog kasama ang Mayo 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline reminder; pinapalawig ng Trail of Bits ang agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern sa AutoGen at Semantic Kernel; lumalawak ang Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter sa walong named jurisdictions.

bridges.text: Published today, the prediction is anchored by NHS England's Saturday agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) tied to the CISA May 21 KEV-mirroring deadline, Mistral's DGFiP central-tax-administration win lifting Workflows tenancy to 296, plus South Korea PIPC and New Zealand GCSB joining the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI reciprocity perimeter the same weekend.

text_locales.en: Published today, the prediction is anchored by NHS England's Saturday agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) tied to the CISA May 21 KEV-mirroring deadline, Mistral's DGFiP central-tax-administration win lifting Workflows tenancy to 296, plus South Korea PIPC and New Zealand GCSB joining the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI reciprocity perimeter the same weekend.
text_locales.ja: 本日公表、予測はNHS Englandの土曜エージェンティックAIワークフロー・プラットフォームCVEブロックリスト(Ni8mare、LangGraph、LiteLLM、CrewAI、Haystack)がCISA 5月21日KEVミラーリング期限に紐付けられ、MistralのDGFiP中央税務行政勝利がWorkflowsテナンシーを296に引き上げ、加えて韓国PIPCとニュージーランドGCSBが同じ週末にSingapore IMDA / Japan AISI相互性ペリメーターに合流することでアンカーされる。
text_locales.es: Publicada hoy, la predicción está anclada por la blocklist de CVE de plataforma de workflow IA agéntica del sábado de NHS England (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) atada a la fecha límite KEV-mirroring del 21 de mayo de CISA, la victoria DGFiP de central-tax-administration de Mistral elevando la tenancy de Workflows a 296, más la PIPC de Corea del Sur y el GCSB de Nueva Zelanda uniéndose al perímetro de reciprocidad Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI el mismo fin de semana.
text_locales.fil: Inilathala ngayon, ang prediction ay naka-anchor sa Saturday agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist ng NHS England (Ni8mare, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack) na nakatali sa CISA Mayo 21 KEV-mirroring deadline, sa panalo ng Mistral DGFiP central-tax-administration na nagtataas ng Workflows tenancy sa 296, plus sa pagsama ng PIPC ng South Korea at GCSB ng New Zealand sa Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI reciprocity perimeter sa parehong weekend.

detail.description: By Q4 2026 the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist published Saturday — naming Ni8mare (n8n CVE-2026-21858), LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, and Haystack CVE-2026-44391 as disallowed pre-patch versions on NHS-tenant deployments — combined with Mistral's DGFiP central-tax-administration Workflows selection (cited control-plane separation + sovereign-cloud execution-worker shape over LangGraph self-hosted plus the Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry) and the South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB weekend extensions of the Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter, will harden into a named-CVE-pegged sovereign-procurement gate adopted across at least four allied public-sector procurement regimes (UK NHS + France DGFiP + at least one Indo-Pacific signatory + one EU member-state framework agreement). The forcing function is that NHS England has now demonstrated a publishable per-CVE blocklist tied to a federal-civilian KEV-mirroring deadline (CISA May 21), Mistral has demonstrated that sovereign-cloud control-plane separation wins a flagship central-government estate against the LangGraph self-hosted alternative explicitly named on that blocklist, and the Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter now binds AISI-administered cyber-eval results as the operative threshold across the allied cohort. Once a UK frontline NHS trust + a French central-tax-administration estate publish concordant CVE-pegged tenancy terms and Anthropic's per-tenant attestation-log primitive (praised by Simon Willison Saturday as the first vendor-side governance shape that holds up to sustained audit-trail review) becomes the canonical compliance evidence, the gate composes from voluntary blocklist into procurement-mandate language. The most likely shape is a four-jurisdiction CVE-pegged annex (UK + France + Singapore-or-Japan + Germany-or-Netherlands BSI-equivalent) treating per-CVE remediation status plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation as paired procurement-eligibility evidence, with the operative review cadence aligned to the AISI cyber-eval reciprocity 120-day placement window. Bear case is that CISA fast-tracks an agentic-AI workflow KEV-bundle Binding Operational Directive that pre-empts the allied perimeter; absent that, Q4 2026 lands the named-CVE procurement gate.

prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q4 2026 la lista de bloqueo de CVE de plataforma de workflow agentic-AI de NHS England publicada el sábado — nombrando Ni8mare (n8n CVE-2026-21858), LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, y Haystack CVE-2026-44391 como versiones pre-parche no permitidas en despliegues NHS-tenant — combinada con la selección de Workflows de Mistral por DGFiP central-tax-administration (citando separación del plano-de-control + forma de execution-worker sovereign-cloud sobre LangGraph autoalojado más el registro de Anthropic Claude Code 3.0) y las extensiones de fin de semana de South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB del perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI, se endurecerán en un gate de adquisición soberana fijado-a-CVE-nombrado adoptado a través de al menos cuatro regímenes de adquisición público-sector aliados (UK NHS + France DGFiP + al menos un signatario Indo-Pacífico + un acuerdo marco de un estado-miembro EU). La función forzante es que NHS England ha demostrado ahora una lista de bloqueo publicable por-CVE atada a una fecha límite de federal-civilian-KEV-mirroring (CISA 21 de mayo), Mistral ha demostrado que la separación del plano-de-control sovereign-cloud gana una propiedad de gobierno central insignia contra la alternativa LangGraph autoalojada explícitamente nombrada en esa lista de bloqueo, y el perímetro de reciprocidad Indo-Pacífico ahora ata los resultados de eval cyber administrados por AISI como el umbral operativo a través de la cohorte aliada. Una vez que un trust frontline NHS del UK + una propiedad central-tax-administration francesa publican términos de tenancy fijados-a-CVE concordantes y la primitiva de log-de-atestación por tenant de Anthropic (elogiada por Simon Willison el sábado como la primera forma de gobernanza del lado-vendedor que soporta una revisión sostenida de pista-de-auditoría) se convierte en la evidencia de cumplimiento canónica, el gate se compone de lista de bloqueo voluntaria a lenguaje de mandato-de-adquisición. La forma más probable es un anexo fijado-a-CVE de cuatro-jurisdicciones (UK + France + Singapore-o-Japan + Germany-o-Netherlands BSI-equivalente) tratando el estado de remediación por-CVE más la atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant como evidencia emparejada de elegibilidad-de-adquisición, con la cadencia de revisión operativa alineada con la ventana de colocación de 120 días de la reciprocidad de eval cyber AISI. El caso bajista es que CISA acelera una Binding Operational Directive de bundle KEV de workflow agentic-AI que se anticipa al perímetro aliado; en ausencia de eso, Q4 2026 aterriza el gate de adquisición de CVE-nombrado.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Sa Q4 2026 ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist na inilathala nitong Saturday — na nagngangalan sa Ni8mare (n8n CVE-2026-21858), LangGraph CVE-2026-44012, LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188, CrewAI CVE-2026-44352, at Haystack CVE-2026-44391 bilang disallowed pre-patch versions sa NHS-tenant deployments — kasama ng DGFiP central-tax-administration Workflows selection ng Mistral (binanggit ang control-plane separation + sovereign-cloud execution-worker shape laban sa LangGraph self-hosted plus ang Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 registry) at ang South Korea PIPC + New Zealand GCSB weekend extensions ng Singapore IMDA / Japan AISI cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter, ay matitigas sa named-CVE-pegged sovereign-procurement gate na adopted sa hindi bababa sa apat na allied public-sector procurement regimes (UK NHS + France DGFiP + hindi bababa sa isang Indo-Pacific signatory + isang EU member-state framework agreement). Ang forcing function ay na ang NHS England ay nagpakita na ngayon ng publishable per-CVE blocklist na nakatali sa federal-civilian KEV-mirroring deadline (CISA May 21), ipinakita ng Mistral na ang sovereign-cloud control-plane separation ay nananalo ng flagship central-government estate laban sa LangGraph self-hosted alternative na hayagang pinangalanan sa blocklist na iyon, at ang Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter ay binubuklod na ngayon ang AISI-administered cyber-eval results bilang operative threshold sa allied cohort. Sa sandaling isang UK frontline NHS trust + isang French central-tax-administration estate ay maglalathala ng concordant CVE-pegged tenancy terms at ang per-tenant attestation-log primitive ng Anthropic (pinuri ni Simon Willison nitong Saturday bilang unang vendor-side governance shape na nakakayanan ang sustained audit-trail review) ay magiging canonical compliance evidence, ang gate ay nagco-compose mula sa voluntary blocklist papasok sa procurement-mandate language. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang four-jurisdiction CVE-pegged annex (UK + France + Singapore-or-Japan + Germany-or-Netherlands BSI-equivalent) na tinatrato ang per-CVE remediation status plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation bilang paired procurement-eligibility evidence, na ang operative review cadence ay nakaayon sa AISI cyber-eval reciprocity 120-day placement window. nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the White House Frontier Model Review Board executive-order draft now circulating in interagency review (OSTP press-pool confirmation that no signing window opens before May 22, May 15 14:00 EDT S-407 classified threshold briefing with NIST Director Locascio, the ODNI cyber lead, and a CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative representative attending, AI Policy Institute plus R Street plus Public Knowledge plus Lawyers for Civil Justice plus the Knight First Amendment Institute plus EFF coalition pressing a documented State Farm reasoned-decision record and a 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window) combined with the weekend extension of the Indo-Pacific cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter (South Korea PIPC plus Ministry of Science and ICT formal-mirror signal, New Zealand GCSB observer commitment with Q3 2026 mirror, layered on the May 7 EU AI Office plus UK AISI memorandum-of-cooperation and the May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI parallel MoC with Canada CCCS plus Australia ASD ACSC observers) forces the signed FMRB executive order to incorporate an allied cyber-evaluation reciprocity ladder naming the EU AI Act Section 51 regime, the UK AISI voluntary frontier-model program, and the Indo-Pacific Singapore plus Japan plus South Korea cohort as the operative satisfying surface for the FMRB's 30-day pre-release notification requirement, with AISI-administered TLO-range runs treated as reciprocal evidence inside a 120-day placement window and per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs (the May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof plus Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive) named as the compliance-evidence shape. The forcing function is that the litigation-vector that AI Policy Institute and the Knight-EFF amicus letter have crystallized cannot be answered with DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language alone; the EO drafters need a multilateral reciprocity anchor that gives the comment-window response a procedural floor and the State Farm record an evidentiary baseline, and the EU-UK-Indo-Pacific cohort is already operationally aligned around AISI's 32-step The Last Ones range. The likely shape is a named-jurisdiction reciprocity annex to the EO with the four already-signed regimes plus the South Korea mirror plus the New Zealand observer ladder, tied to the May 21 CISA federal-civilian KEV-mirroring cadence as the operative review tick. Bear case is the EO ships unilateral first and bolts on reciprocity via OSTP letter exchange; absent that, the signed EO lands the ladder inside Q3 2026.

description.ja: Q3 2026までに、現在省庁間レビューで回付されているWhite House Frontier Model Review Board大統領令ドラフト(OSTPプレスプール確認による5月22日以前に署名ウィンドウは開かない見通し、5月15日14:00 EDTのS-407機密閾値ブリーフィングにNIST DirectorのLocascio、ODNIサイバーリード、CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative代表が出席、AI Policy InstituteにR Street、Public Knowledge、Lawyers for Civil Justice、Knight First Amendment Institute、EFFが合流した連合が文書化されたState Farm準拠の理由付き決定記録と60日のDefense Production Act Section 708パブリック・コメント・ウィンドウを要求)と、インド太平洋サイバー評価レシプロシティ境界の週末拡張(韓国PIPCと科学技術情報通信部の正式ミラー・シグナル、ニュージーランドGCSBがQ3 2026のミラー・コミットメントを伴うオブザーバー、5月7日のEU AI Office + UK AISI協力覚書および5月8日のSingapore IMDA + Japan AISIパラレルMoCにCanada CCCSとAustralia ASD ACSCのオブザーバーが重なる)が組み合わさり、署名済みFMRB大統領令は同盟国サイバー評価レシプロシティ・ラダーを組み込むことを強制される。これはEU AI Act第51条レジーム、UK AISI任意フロンティアモデル・プログラム、およびインド太平洋のSingapore + Japan + 韓国コホートをFMRB 30日事前リリース通知要件の運用上の充足面として指名し、AISI管理のTLOレンジ・ランを120日の配置ウィンドウ内のレシプロカル証拠として扱い、テナントごとのMythosクラス能力アテステーション・ログ(5月9日のarxiv 2605.05933リーケージ・フリーダム証明 + Anthropic Project Glasswingプリミティブ)をコンプライアンス証拠の形として指名する。強制機能は、AI Policy InstituteとKnight-EFFアミカス書簡が結晶化した訴訟ベクトルが、DPA Section 708の任意情報共有言語のみでは答えられないことである;EOドラフターは、コメント・ウィンドウ対応に手続き的フロアを与えStat Farm記録に証拠的ベースラインを与える多国間レシプロシティ・アンカーを必要とし、EU-UK-インド太平洋コホートはAISIの32ステップThe Last Onesレンジを中心に既に運用上整合している。可能性の高い形状はEOに対する名指し管轄レシプロシティ・アネックスで、既に署名済みの4レジーム + 韓国ミラー + ニュージーランド・オブザーバー・ラダーが、5月21日のCISA連邦民政部門KEVミラーリング・ケイデンスに紐付く運用レビュー・ティックとして結ばれる。ベア・ケースはEOが先に単独で出荷され、OSTPレター交換経由でレシプロシティを後付けする;それ以外の場合、署名済みEOはQ3 2026内にラダーを着地させる。
description.es: Para Q3 2026 el borrador de la orden ejecutiva del Frontier Model Review Board de la Casa Blanca ahora circulando en revisión interagencial (confirmación del press-pool de OSTP de que no se abre ventana de firma antes del 22 de mayo, briefing clasificado de umbral S-407 del 15 de mayo 14:00 EDT con la directora de NIST Locascio, el responsable cyber de ODNI, y un representante del Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative de CISA asistiendo, la coalición AI Policy Institute más R Street más Public Knowledge más Lawyers for Civil Justice más el Knight First Amendment Institute más EFF presionando un registro documentado de decisión razonada según State Farm y una ventana de comentarios públicos de la Defense Production Act Sección 708 de 60 días) combinado con la extensión de fin de semana del perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber Indo-Pacífico (señal de reflejo formal de South Korea PIPC más Ministry of Science and ICT, compromiso de observador de New Zealand GCSB con reflejo Q3 2026, superpuesto al memorándum-de-cooperación EU AI Office más UK AISI del 7 de mayo y el MoC paralelo Singapore IMDA más Japan AISI del 8 de mayo con observadores Canada CCCS más Australia ASD ACSC) fuerza a la orden ejecutiva firmada del FMRB a incorporar una escalera de reciprocidad de evaluación-cyber aliada nombrando el régimen de la Sección 51 del EU AI Act, el programa voluntario de modelos-frontera de UK AISI, y la cohorte Indo-Pacífico Singapur más Japón más South Korea como la superficie operativa de satisfacción para el requisito de notificación pre-lanzamiento de 30 días del FMRB, con corridas de rango TLO administradas por AISI tratadas como evidencia recíproca dentro de una ventana de colocación de 120 días y logs de atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant (la prueba de libertad-de-fuga de arxiv 2605.05933 del 9 de mayo más la primitiva Anthropic Project Glasswing) nombrados como la forma de evidencia-de-cumplimiento. La función forzante es que el vector de litigio que AI Policy Institute y la carta amicus Knight-EFF han cristalizado no puede ser respondido con lenguaje voluntario de intercambio-de-información de la DPA Sección 708 solo; los redactores de la EO necesitan un ancla multilateral de reciprocidad que dé a la respuesta de la ventana de comentarios un piso procesal y al registro State Farm una línea base evidenciaria, y la cohorte EU-UK-Indo-Pacífico ya está operacionalmente alineada alrededor del rango The Last Ones de 32 pasos de AISI. La forma probable es un anexo de reciprocidad de jurisdicción-nombrada a la EO con los cuatro regímenes ya firmados más el reflejo de South Korea más la escalera de observador de New Zealand, atado a la cadencia de KEV-mirroring federal-civil de CISA del 21 de mayo como el tick operativo de revisión. El caso bajista es que la EO se envíe unilateral primero y agregue la reciprocidad vía intercambio de cartas de OSTP; en ausencia de eso, la EO firmada aterriza la escalera dentro de Q3 2026.
description.fil: Sa Q3 2026 ang White House Frontier Model Review Board executive-order draft na umiikot ngayon sa interagency review (OSTP press-pool confirmation na walang signing window na bubukas bago ang May 22, ang May 15 14:00 EDT S-407 classified threshold briefing kasama ang NIST Director Locascio, ang ODNI cyber lead, at isang CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative representative na dadalo, ang AI Policy Institute plus R Street plus Public Knowledge plus Lawyers for Civil Justice plus ang Knight First Amendment Institute plus EFF coalition na nagtutulak sa documented State Farm reasoned-decision record at sa 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window) kasama ng weekend extension ng Indo-Pacific cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter (South Korea PIPC plus Ministry of Science and ICT formal-mirror signal, New Zealand GCSB observer commitment na may Q3 2026 mirror, na nakapatong sa May 7 EU AI Office plus UK AISI memorandum-of-cooperation at sa May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI parallel MoC na may Canada CCCS plus Australia ASD ACSC observers) ay pumipilit sa signed FMRB executive order na isama ang allied cyber-evaluation reciprocity ladder na nagngangalan sa EU AI Act Section 51 regime, sa UK AISI voluntary frontier-model program, at sa Indo-Pacific Singapore plus Japan plus South Korea cohort bilang operative satisfying surface para sa 30-day pre-release notification requirement ng FMRB, na ang AISI-administered TLO-range runs ay tinatrato bilang reciprocal evidence sa loob ng 120-day placement window at ang per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs (ang May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof plus Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive) ay pinangalanan bilang compliance-evidence shape. Ang forcing function ay na ang litigation-vector na pinabalakubak ng AI Policy Institute at ng Knight-EFF amicus letter ay hindi masasagot ng DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language lamang; ang EO drafters ay nangangailangan ng multilateral reciprocity anchor na nagbibigay sa comment-window response ng procedural floor at sa State Farm record ng evidentiary baseline, at ang EU-UK-Indo-Pacific cohort ay nasa operationally aligned na sa paligid ng AISI's 32-step The Last Ones range. Ang malamang na shape ay isang named-jurisdiction reciprocity annex sa EO na may apat na already-signed regimes plus ang South Korea mirror plus ang New Zealand observer ladder, na nakatali sa May 21 CISA federal-civilian KEV-mirroring cadence bilang operative review tick. Ang bear case ay ang EO ay nag-ship ng unilateral muna at bina-bolt ang reciprocity sa pamamagitan ng OSTP letter exchange; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang signed EO sa ladder sa loob ng Q3 2026.

summary.fil: Sa Q3 2026 ang White House Frontier Model Review Board executive-order draft na umiikot ngayon sa interagency review (OSTP press-pool confirmation na walang signing window na bubukas bago ang May 22, ang May 15 14:00 EDT S-407 classified threshold briefing kasama ang NIST Director Locascio, ang ODNI cyber lead, at isang CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative representative na dadalo, ang AI Policy Institute plus R Street plus Public Knowledge plus Lawyers for Civil Justice plus ang Knight First Amendment Institute plus EFF coalition na nagtutulak sa documented State Farm reasoned-decision record at sa 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window) kasama ng weekend extension ng Indo-Pacific cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter (South Korea PIPC plus Ministry of Science and ICT formal-mirror signal, New Zealand GCSB observer commitment na may Q3 2026 mirror, na nakapatong sa May 7 EU AI Office plus UK AISI memorandum-of-cooperation at sa May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI parallel MoC na may Canada CCCS plus Australia ASD ACSC observers) ay pumipilit sa signed FMRB executive order na isama ang allied cyber-evaluation reciprocity ladder na nagngangalan sa EU AI Act Section 51 regime, sa UK AISI voluntary frontier-model program, at sa Indo-Pacific Singapore plus Japan plus South Korea cohort bilang operative satisfying surface para sa 30-day pre-release notification requirement ng FMRB, na ang AISI-administered TLO-range runs ay tinatrato bilang reciprocal evidence sa loob ng 120-day placement window at ang per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs (ang May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof plus Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive) ay pinangalanan bilang compliance-evidence shape. Ang forcing function ay na ang litigation-vector na pinabalakubak ng AI Policy Institute at ng Knight-EFF amicus letter ay hindi masasagot ng DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language lamang; ang EO drafters ay nangangailangan ng multilateral reciprocity anchor na nagbibigay sa comment-window response ng procedural floor at sa State Farm record ng evidentiary baseline, at ang EU-UK-Indo-Pacific cohort ay nasa operationally aligned na sa paligid ng AISI's 32-step The Last Ones range. Ang malamang na shape ay isang named-jurisdiction reciprocity annex sa EO na may apat na already-signed regimes plus ang South Korea mirror plus ang New Zealand observer ladder, na nakatali sa May 21 CISA federal-civilian KEV-mirroring cadence bilang operative review tick. Ang bear case ay ang EO ay nag-ship ng unilateral muna at bina-bolt ang reciprocity sa pamamagitan ng OSTP letter exchange; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang signed EO sa ladder sa loob ng Q3 2026.

bridges.text: On the FMRB allied reciprocity ladder prediction (May 10): Lawfare's Sunday long-read sharpens the State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument as the dispositive litigation vector if the executive order ships on Defense Production Act Section 708 without notice-and-comment; Just Security argues the EU-UK plus Singapore-Japan MoCs establish a customary-international-practice baseline a US-side regime should mirror to avoid an outlier posture. Senator Warner adds NSA Cybersecurity Directorate plus Microsoft MSTIC witnesses to the May 15 S-407 classified briefing; the Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter widens to eight named jurisdictions with India MeitY/CERT-In and Taiwan NICS joining as observers; OSTP holds the no-signing-before-May-22 floor.

text_locales.en: On the FMRB allied reciprocity ladder prediction (May 10): Lawfare's Sunday long-read sharpens the State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument as the dispositive litigation vector if the executive order ships on Defense Production Act Section 708 without notice-and-comment; Just Security argues the EU-UK plus Singapore-Japan MoCs establish a customary-international-practice baseline a US-side regime should mirror to avoid an outlier posture. Senator Warner adds NSA Cybersecurity Directorate plus Microsoft MSTIC witnesses to the May 15 S-407 classified briefing; the Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter widens to eight named jurisdictions with India MeitY/CERT-In and Taiwan NICS joining as observers; OSTP holds the no-signing-before-May-22 floor.
text_locales.ja: FMRB同盟相互性ラダー予測(5月10日)について: Lawfareの日曜ロング・リードは、大統領令が告示・パブリック・コメントなしに国防生産法第708条で出荷される場合の決定的訴訟ベクターとしてState Farm理由付き決定記録論証を先鋭化する;Just SecurityはEU-UKプラスシンガポール-日本MoCsがUS側レジームが外れ値ポスチャーを避けるためにミラーすべき慣習国際慣行ベースラインを確立する、と論じる。Warner上院議員は5月15日S-407機密ブリーフィングにNSAサイバーセキュリティ・ディレクトレートとMicrosoft MSTIC証人を追加;インド太平洋相互性ペリメーターはインドMeitY / CERT-Inと台湾NICSがオブザーバーとして合流し8つの命名管轄区へ広がる;OSTPは5月22日以前不署名フロアを維持する。
text_locales.es: Sobre la predicción de escalera de reciprocidad aliada FMRB (10 de mayo): el long-read dominical de Lawfare afila el argumento del registro de decisión razonada State Farm como el vector de litigación dispositivo si la orden ejecutiva se envía sobre el vehículo Defense Production Act Section 708 sin notice-and-comment; Just Security argumenta que los MoCs EU-UK más Singapore-Japan establecen una base de práctica internacional consuetudinaria que un régimen del lado estadounidense debería reflejar para evitar una postura outlier. El senador Warner añade testigos de NSA Cybersecurity Directorate más Microsoft MSTIC al briefing clasificado del 15 de mayo en S-407; el perímetro de reciprocidad Indo-Pacífico se amplía a ocho jurisdicciones nombradas con India MeitY/CERT-In y Taiwan NICS uniéndose como observadores; OSTP mantiene el piso de no-firma-antes-del-22-de-mayo.
text_locales.fil: Sa FMRB allied reciprocity ladder prediction (Mayo 10): hinahasa ng Sunday long-read ng Lawfare ang State Farm reasoned-decision-record argument bilang dispositive litigation vector kung mag-ship ang executive order sa Defense Production Act Section 708 nang walang notice-and-comment; nag-aargumento ang Just Security na ang EU-UK plus Singapore-Japan MoCs ay nag-eestablish ng customary-international-practice baseline na dapat i-mirror ng US-side regime para maiwasan ang outlier posture. Idinaragdag ni Senator Warner ang NSA Cybersecurity Directorate plus Microsoft MSTIC witnesses sa Mayo 15 S-407 classified briefing; lumalawak ang Indo-Pacific reciprocity perimeter sa walong named jurisdictions sa pagsasama ng India MeitY/CERT-In at Taiwan NICS bilang observers; hawak ng OSTP ang no-signing-before-Mayo-22 floor.

job_locales.en: wire the May 21 CISA federal-civilian Known Exploited Vulnerabilities mirroring cadence into the FMRB reciprocity-ladder 120-day placement-window review tick — building the technical infrastructure that lets AISI-administered TLO-range runs and per-tenant Mythos-class attestation logs flow from allied regulators into the FMRB compliance-evidence pipeline on a documented review cadence that procurement officers and audit committees can rely on.
job_locales.ja: 5月21日のCISA連邦民政部門Known Exploited Vulnerabilitiesミラーリング・ケイデンスをFMRBレシプロシティ・ラダー120日配置ウィンドウ・レビュー・ティックに配線する — AISI管理のTLOレンジ・ランとテナントごとのMythosクラス・アテステーション・ログが同盟規制当局からFMRBコンプライアンス証拠パイプラインへ、調達担当者や監査委員会が頼れる文書化されたレビュー・ケイデンスで流れることを可能にする技術的インフラを構築する。
job_locales.es: cablear la cadencia de mirroring de Known Exploited Vulnerabilities federal-civil de CISA del 21 de mayo en el tick operativo de revisión de la ventana de colocación de 120 días de la escalera-de-reciprocidad del FMRB — construyendo la infraestructura técnica que permita que las corridas del rango TLO administradas por AISI y los logs de atestación clase Mythos por tenant fluyan de los reguladores aliados al pipeline de evidencia-de-cumplimiento del FMRB en una cadencia documentada de revisión en la que los oficiales de adquisición y los comités de auditoría puedan confiar.
job_locales.fil: i-wire ang May 21 CISA federal-civilian Known Exploited Vulnerabilities mirroring cadence papasok sa FMRB reciprocity-ladder 120-day placement-window review tick — bina-build ang technical infrastructure na nagpapahintulot sa AISI-administered TLO-range runs at per-tenant Mythos-class attestation logs na dumaloy mula sa allied regulators papasok sa FMRB compliance-evidence pipeline sa documented review cadence na maaasahan ng procurement officers at audit committees.

outcome_locales.en: CISA KEV-mirroring cadence wired to a 120-day FMRB reciprocity-ladder placement-window review tick plus NIST-published evaluation-program guidance documenting per-tenant Mythos attestation-log artifact ingestion from the six allied regulators, with ODNI cyber-lead sign-off on the classified-threshold briefing record for the S-407 cohort.
outcome_locales.ja: CISA KEVミラーリング・ケイデンスが120日のFMRBレシプロシティ・ラダー配置ウィンドウ・レビュー・ティックに配線され、6つの同盟規制当局からのテナントごとのMythosアテステーション・ログ・アーティファクトの取り込みを文書化したNIST公表評価プログラム・ガイダンスと、S-407コホート向けの機密閾値ブリーフィング記録に対するODNIサイバー・リードのサインオフを伴う。
outcome_locales.es: Cadencia de KEV-mirroring de CISA cableada a un tick operativo de revisión de la ventana de colocación de 120 días de la escalera-de-reciprocidad del FMRB más guía de programa-de-evaluación publicada por NIST documentando ingestión de artefactos de log-de-atestación Mythos por tenant de los seis reguladores aliados, con firma del líder cyber de ODNI en el registro del briefing clasificado de umbral para la cohorte S-407.
outcome_locales.fil: CISA KEV-mirroring cadence na naka-wire sa 120-day FMRB reciprocity-ladder placement-window review tick plus NIST-published evaluation-program guidance na dinodokumento ang per-tenant Mythos attestation-log artifact ingestion mula sa anim na allied regulators, kasama ang ODNI cyber-lead sign-off sa classified-threshold briefing record para sa S-407 cohort.

motivation_locales.en: CISA plus NIST plus ODNI need an operative review tick that synchronizes the six-regulator reciprocity perimeter with the federal-civilian vulnerability-mirroring cadence already in production; without that technical wiring, procurement officers and audit committees cannot rely on the reciprocity ladder as a procurement-grade compliance surface and the EO ships without operational teeth.
motivation_locales.ja: CISA + NIST + ODNIは、既に本番運用中の連邦民政部門脆弱性ミラーリング・ケイデンスと6規制当局レシプロシティ境界を同期させる運用レビュー・ティックを必要とする;その技術的配線がなければ、調達担当者と監査委員会は調達グレードのコンプライアンス面としてレシプロシティ・ラダーに頼ることができず、EOは運用上の歯がない状態で出荷される。
motivation_locales.es: CISA más NIST más ODNI necesitan un tick operativo de revisión que sincronice el perímetro de reciprocidad de seis-reguladores con la cadencia federal-civil de mirroring de vulnerabilidad ya en producción; sin ese cableado técnico, los oficiales de adquisición y los comités de auditoría no pueden confiar en la escalera de reciprocidad como una superficie de cumplimiento de grado-adquisición y la EO se envía sin dientes operativos.
motivation_locales.fil: Ang CISA plus NIST plus ODNI ay nangangailangan ng operative review tick na nag-sy-synchronize sa six-regulator reciprocity perimeter kasama ang federal-civilian vulnerability-mirroring cadence na nasa production na; kung walang technical wiring na iyon, ang procurement officers at audit committees ay hindi makakaasa sa reciprocity ladder bilang procurement-grade compliance surface at ang EO ay nag-ship nang walang operational teeth.

needs.actor: Federal civilian procurement plus FedRAMP-Moderate authorization owners plus enterprise audit-committee leads converting the six-jurisdiction reciprocity ladder into operative RFP-template and supplier-attestation requirements

needs.outcome: Federal civilian procurement RFP templates plus FedRAMP-Moderate authorization checklists plus enterprise audit-committee supplier-attestation requirements all citing the FMRB six-jurisdiction reciprocity-ladder annex plus AISI TLO-range run plus per-tenant Mythos-class attestation-log evidence shape as the operative gating surface for frontier-model vendor selection.
needs.motivation: Procurement officials plus FedRAMP authorization owners plus audit-committee leads need a single named compliance surface to gate frontier-model vendors against; the FMRB six-jurisdiction reciprocity ladder converts an otherwise fragmented allied-evaluation landscape into one citable surface that simplifies RFP drafting and audit-committee questioning while shielding procurement officers from later litigation over arbitrary-and-capricious vendor selection.

job_locales.ja: AISIの32ステップThe Last Onesレンジとテナントごとのアテステーション・ログ証拠の形を、6管轄区域境界全体にわたるレシプロカルな事前リリース通知アーティファクトとして運用化する — TLOレンジ閾値コホート、120日の配置ウィンドウ、テナントごとのMythosアテステーション・プリミティブを各規制当局の評価パイプラインにロックし、任意の1つのレジーム下で実施されたAISI管理のTLOレンジ・ランが6つすべての下でコンプライアンス証拠としてカウントされるようにする。
job_locales.es: operacionalizar el rango The Last Ones de 32 pasos de AISI más la forma de evidencia de log-de-atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant como artefactos recíprocos de notificación pre-lanzamiento a través del perímetro de seis-jurisdicciones — bloqueando la cohorte de umbral del rango TLO, la ventana de colocación de 120 días, y la primitiva de atestación Mythos por tenant en el pipeline de evaluación de cada regulador para que una corrida del rango TLO administrada por AISI producida bajo un régimen cualquiera cuente como evidencia de cumplimiento bajo los seis.
job_locales.fil: i-operationalize ang AISI 32-step The Last Ones range plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation-log evidence shape bilang reciprocal pre-release notification artifacts sa buong six-jurisdiction perimeter — nililok ang TLO-range threshold cohort, ang 120-day placement window, at ang per-tenant Mythos attestation primitive sa bawat evaluation pipeline ng regulator para isang AISI-administered TLO-range run na ginawa sa ilalim ng anumang isang regime ay maituring na compliance evidence sa ilalim ng lahat ng anim.

outcome_locales.en: Six allied regulators (UK AISI, EU AI Office, Japan AISI, Singapore IMDA, South Korea PIPC, New Zealand GCSB) each running operational reciprocal TLO-range evaluations with documented per-tenant Mythos-class attestation-log artifacts, the May 7 EU-UK MoC and May 8 Singapore-Japan MoC extended to South Korea and New Zealand by Q3 2026 with formal-mirror plus observer ladder commitments.
outcome_locales.ja: 6つの同盟規制当局(UK AISI、EU AI Office、Japan AISI、Singapore IMDA、韓国PIPC、ニュージーランドGCSB)がそれぞれ運用上のレシプロカルTLOレンジ評価を実施し、テナントごとのMythosクラス・アテステーション・ログ・アーティファクトを文書化し、5月7日のEU-UK MoCと5月8日のSingapore-Japan MoCをQ3 2026までに正式ミラー + オブザーバー・ラダー・コミットメントで韓国とニュージーランドへ拡張する。
outcome_locales.es: Seis reguladores aliados (UK AISI, EU AI Office, Japan AISI, Singapore IMDA, South Korea PIPC, New Zealand GCSB) cada uno ejecutando evaluaciones recíprocas operativas del rango TLO con artefactos documentados de log-de-atestación clase Mythos por tenant, el MoC EU-UK del 7 de mayo y el MoC Singapur-Japón del 8 de mayo extendidos a South Korea y New Zealand para Q3 2026 con compromisos de reflejo formal más escalera de observador.
outcome_locales.fil: Anim na allied regulators (UK AISI, EU AI Office, Japan AISI, Singapore IMDA, South Korea PIPC, New Zealand GCSB) na bawat isa ay nagpapatakbo ng operational reciprocal TLO-range evaluations na may documented per-tenant Mythos-class attestation-log artifacts, ang May 7 EU-UK MoC at May 8 Singapore-Japan MoC ay pinalawak sa South Korea at New Zealand sa Q3 2026 kasama ang formal-mirror plus observer ladder commitments.

motivation_locales.en: Reciprocity prestige plus avoidance of duplicated frontier-model evaluation cost makes allied AISI counterparts push reciprocal TLO-range operationalization forward; the May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof gives them a citable safety theorem for per-tenant Mythos attestation as the compliance-evidence shape, and the May 21 CISA KEV-mirroring cadence supplies the operative review tick that synchronizes the six-regulator cohort.
motivation_locales.ja: レシプロシティの威信と重複するフロンティアモデル評価コストの回避は、同盟AISIカウンターパートにレシプロカルTLOレンジ運用化を前進させる;5月9日のarxiv 2605.05933リーケージ・フリーダム証明は、テナントごとのMythosアテステーションをコンプライアンス証拠の形として引用可能な安全定理を与え、5月21日のCISA KEVミラーリング・ケイデンスは6規制当局コホートを同期させる運用レビュー・ティックを供給する。
motivation_locales.es: El prestigio de reciprocidad más la evitación de costo duplicado de evaluación de modelos-frontera hace que las contrapartes aliadas de AISI empujen adelante la operacionalización recíproca del rango TLO; la prueba de libertad-de-fuga del arxiv 2605.05933 del 9 de mayo les da un teorema de seguridad citable para la atestación Mythos por tenant como la forma de evidencia-de-cumplimiento, y la cadencia CISA KEV-mirroring del 21 de mayo suministra el tick operativo de revisión que sincroniza la cohorte de seis-reguladores.
motivation_locales.fil: Reciprocity prestige plus pag-iwas sa duplicated frontier-model evaluation cost ay nagpipilit sa allied AISI counterparts na itulak ang reciprocal TLO-range operationalization pasulong; ang May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof ay nagbibigay sa kanila ng citable safety theorem para sa per-tenant Mythos attestation bilang compliance-evidence shape, at ang May 21 CISA KEV-mirroring cadence ay nagbibigay ng operative review tick na nag-sy-synchronize sa six-regulator cohort.

outcome_locales.fil: Signed FMRB executive order na nagsho-ship ng named-jurisdiction reciprocity annex na sumasaklaw sa anim na allied regimes na nakatali sa AISI TLO-range runs at per-tenant Mythos-class attestation logs, na may procedural floor na sumasagot sa AI Policy Institute plus Knight-EFF amicus litigation vector at State Farm reasoned-decision evidentiary baseline.

motivation_locales.en: The EO drafters cannot answer the Knight-EFF plus AI Policy Institute amicus litigation vector with DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language alone; the EU-UK-Indo-Pacific cohort is already operationally aligned around the AISI 32-step The Last Ones range, so a multilateral reciprocity anchor is the lowest-cost path to a defensible State Farm record before the 60-day public-comment window closes.

motivation_locales.fil: Ang EO drafters ay hindi masasagot ang Knight-EFF plus AI Policy Institute amicus litigation vector sa DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language lamang; ang EU-UK-Indo-Pacific cohort ay nasa operationally aligned na sa paligid ng AISI 32-step The Last Ones range, kaya ang multilateral reciprocity anchor ay pinakamababang-gastos na landas papasok sa defensible State Farm record bago magsara ang 60-day public-comment window.

detail.description: By Q3 2026 the White House Frontier Model Review Board executive-order draft now circulating in interagency review (OSTP press-pool confirmation that no signing window opens before May 22, May 15 14:00 EDT S-407 classified threshold briefing with NIST Director Locascio, the ODNI cyber lead, and a CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative representative attending, AI Policy Institute plus R Street plus Public Knowledge plus Lawyers for Civil Justice plus the Knight First Amendment Institute plus EFF coalition pressing a documented State Farm reasoned-decision record and a 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window) combined with the weekend extension of the Indo-Pacific cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter (South Korea PIPC plus Ministry of Science and ICT formal-mirror signal, New Zealand GCSB observer commitment with Q3 2026 mirror, layered on the May 7 EU AI Office plus UK AISI memorandum-of-cooperation and the May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI parallel MoC with Canada CCCS plus Australia ASD ACSC observers) forces the signed FMRB executive order to incorporate an allied cyber-evaluation reciprocity ladder naming the EU AI Act Section 51 regime, the UK AISI voluntary frontier-model program, and the Indo-Pacific Singapore plus Japan plus South Korea cohort as the operative satisfying surface for the FMRB's 30-day pre-release notification requirement, with AISI-administered TLO-range runs treated as reciprocal evidence inside a 120-day placement window and per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs (the May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof plus Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive) named as the compliance-evidence shape. The forcing function is that the litigation-vector that AI Policy Institute and the Knight-EFF amicus letter have crystallized cannot be answered with DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language alone; the EO drafters need a multilateral reciprocity anchor that gives the comment-window response a procedural floor and the State Farm record an evidentiary baseline, and the EU-UK-Indo-Pacific cohort is already operationally aligned around AISI's 32-step The Last Ones range. The likely shape is a named-jurisdiction reciprocity annex to the EO with the four already-signed regimes plus the South Korea mirror plus the New Zealand observer ladder, tied to the May 21 CISA federal-civilian KEV-mirroring cadence as the operative review tick. Bear case is the EO ships unilateral first and bolts on reciprocity via OSTP letter exchange; absent that, the signed EO lands the ladder inside Q3 2026.

prediction_summary_locales.ja: Q3 2026までに、現在省庁間レビューで回付されているWhite House Frontier Model Review Board大統領令ドラフト(OSTPプレスプール確認による5月22日以前に署名ウィンドウは開かない見通し、5月15日14:00 EDTのS-407機密閾値ブリーフィングにNIST DirectorのLocascio、ODNIサイバーリード、CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative代表が出席、AI Policy InstituteにR Street、Public Knowledge、Lawyers for Civil Justice、Knight First Amendment Institute、EFFが合流した連合が文書化されたState Farm準拠の理由付き決定記録と60日のDefense Production Act Section 708パブリック・コメント・ウィンドウを要求)と、インド太平洋サイバー評価レシプロシティ境界の週末拡張(韓国PIPCと科学技術情報通信部の正式ミラー・シグナル、ニュージーランドGCSBがQ3 2026のミラー・コミットメントを伴うオブザーバー、5月7日のEU AI Office + UK AISI協力覚書および5月8日のSingapore IMDA + Japan AISIパラレルMoCにCanada CCCSとAustralia ASD ACSCのオブザーバーが重なる)が組み合わさり、署名済みFMRB大統領令は同盟国サイバー評価レシプロシティ・ラダーを組み込むことを強制される。これはEU AI Act第51条レジーム、UK AISI任意フロンティアモデル・プログラム、およびインド太平洋のSingapore + Japan + 韓国コホートをFMRB 30日事前リリース通知要件の運用上の充足面として指名し、AISI管理のTLOレンジ・ランを120日の配置ウィンドウ内のレシプロカル証拠として扱い、テナントごとのMythosクラス能力アテステーション・ログ(5月9日のarxiv 2605.05933リーケージ・フリーダム証明 + Anthropic Project Glasswingプリミティブ)をコンプライアンス証拠の形として指名する。強制機能は、AI Policy InstituteとKnight-EFFアミカス書簡が結晶化した訴訟ベクトルが、DPA Section 708の任意情報共有言語のみでは答えられないことである;EOドラフターは、コメント・ウィンドウ対応に手続き的フロアを与えStat Farm記録に証拠的ベースラインを与える多国間レシプロシティ・アンカーを必要とし、EU-UK-インド太平洋コホートはAISIの32ステップThe Last Onesレンジを中心に既に運用上整合している。可能性の高い形状はEOに対する名指し管轄レシプロシティ・アネックスで、既に署名済みの4レジーム + 韓国ミラー + ニュージーランド・オブザーバー・ラダーが、5月21日のCISA連邦民政部門KEVミラーリング・ケイデンスに紐付く運用レビュー・ティックとして結ばれる。ベア・ケースはEOが先に単独で出荷され、OSTPレター交換経由でレシプロシティを後付けする;それ以外の場合、署名済みEOはQ3 2026内にラダーを着地させる。
prediction_summary_locales.es: Para Q3 2026 el borrador de la orden ejecutiva del Frontier Model Review Board de la Casa Blanca ahora circulando en revisión interagencial (confirmación del press-pool de OSTP de que no se abre ventana de firma antes del 22 de mayo, briefing clasificado de umbral S-407 del 15 de mayo 14:00 EDT con la directora de NIST Locascio, el responsable cyber de ODNI, y un representante del Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative de CISA asistiendo, la coalición AI Policy Institute más R Street más Public Knowledge más Lawyers for Civil Justice más el Knight First Amendment Institute más EFF presionando un registro documentado de decisión razonada según State Farm y una ventana de comentarios públicos de la Defense Production Act Sección 708 de 60 días) combinado con la extensión de fin de semana del perímetro de reciprocidad de eval cyber Indo-Pacífico (señal de reflejo formal de South Korea PIPC más Ministry of Science and ICT, compromiso de observador de New Zealand GCSB con reflejo Q3 2026, superpuesto al memorándum-de-cooperación EU AI Office más UK AISI del 7 de mayo y el MoC paralelo Singapore IMDA más Japan AISI del 8 de mayo con observadores Canada CCCS más Australia ASD ACSC) fuerza a la orden ejecutiva firmada del FMRB a incorporar una escalera de reciprocidad de evaluación-cyber aliada nombrando el régimen de la Sección 51 del EU AI Act, el programa voluntario de modelos-frontera de UK AISI, y la cohorte Indo-Pacífico Singapur más Japón más South Korea como la superficie operativa de satisfacción para el requisito de notificación pre-lanzamiento de 30 días del FMRB, con corridas de rango TLO administradas por AISI tratadas como evidencia recíproca dentro de una ventana de colocación de 120 días y logs de atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant (la prueba de libertad-de-fuga de arxiv 2605.05933 del 9 de mayo más la primitiva Anthropic Project Glasswing) nombrados como la forma de evidencia-de-cumplimiento. La función forzante es que el vector de litigio que AI Policy Institute y la carta amicus Knight-EFF han cristalizado no puede ser respondido con lenguaje voluntario de intercambio-de-información de la DPA Sección 708 solo; los redactores de la EO necesitan un ancla multilateral de reciprocidad que dé a la respuesta de la ventana de comentarios un piso procesal y al registro State Farm una línea base evidenciaria, y la cohorte EU-UK-Indo-Pacífico ya está operacionalmente alineada alrededor del rango The Last Ones de 32 pasos de AISI. La forma probable es un anexo de reciprocidad de jurisdicción-nombrada a la EO con los cuatro regímenes ya firmados más el reflejo de South Korea más la escalera de observador de New Zealand, atado a la cadencia de KEV-mirroring federal-civil de CISA del 21 de mayo como el tick operativo de revisión. El caso bajista es que la EO se envíe unilateral primero y agregue la reciprocidad vía intercambio de cartas de OSTP; en ausencia de eso, la EO firmada aterriza la escalera dentro de Q3 2026.
prediction_summary_locales.fil: Sa Q3 2026 ang White House Frontier Model Review Board executive-order draft na umiikot ngayon sa interagency review (OSTP press-pool confirmation na walang signing window na bubukas bago ang May 22, ang May 15 14:00 EDT S-407 classified threshold briefing kasama ang NIST Director Locascio, ang ODNI cyber lead, at isang CISA Joint Cyber Defense Collaborative representative na dadalo, ang AI Policy Institute plus R Street plus Public Knowledge plus Lawyers for Civil Justice plus ang Knight First Amendment Institute plus EFF coalition na nagtutulak sa documented State Farm reasoned-decision record at sa 60-day Defense Production Act Section 708 public-comment window) kasama ng weekend extension ng Indo-Pacific cyber-eval reciprocity perimeter (South Korea PIPC plus Ministry of Science and ICT formal-mirror signal, New Zealand GCSB observer commitment na may Q3 2026 mirror, na nakapatong sa May 7 EU AI Office plus UK AISI memorandum-of-cooperation at sa May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI parallel MoC na may Canada CCCS plus Australia ASD ACSC observers) ay pumipilit sa signed FMRB executive order na isama ang allied cyber-evaluation reciprocity ladder na nagngangalan sa EU AI Act Section 51 regime, sa UK AISI voluntary frontier-model program, at sa Indo-Pacific Singapore plus Japan plus South Korea cohort bilang operative satisfying surface para sa 30-day pre-release notification requirement ng FMRB, na ang AISI-administered TLO-range runs ay tinatrato bilang reciprocal evidence sa loob ng 120-day placement window at ang per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs (ang May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof plus Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive) ay pinangalanan bilang compliance-evidence shape. Ang forcing function ay na ang litigation-vector na pinabalakubak ng AI Policy Institute at ng Knight-EFF amicus letter ay hindi masasagot ng DPA Section 708 voluntary information-sharing language lamang; ang EO drafters ay nangangailangan ng multilateral reciprocity anchor na nagbibigay sa comment-window response ng procedural floor at sa State Farm record ng evidentiary baseline, at ang EU-UK-Indo-Pacific cohort ay nasa operationally aligned na sa paligid ng AISI's 32-step The Last Ones range. Ang malamang na shape ay isang named-jurisdiction reciprocity annex sa EO na may apat na already-signed regimes plus ang South Korea mirror plus ang New Zealand observer ladder, na nakatali sa May 21 CISA federal-civilian KEV-mirroring cadence bilang operative review tick. Ang bear case ay ang EO ay nag-ship ng unilateral muna at bina-bolt ang reciprocity sa pamamagitan ng OSTP letter exchange; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang signed EO sa ladder sa loob ng Q3 2026.

nodes.description: By Q3 2026 the agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE wave converging across the May 8 to May 11 window forces CISA to publish a Binding Operational Directive that treats per-CVE remediation status and per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs as paired federal-civilian-executive-branch procurement and operating requirements, with the operative review cadence pegged to the May 21 n8n CVE-2026-21858 federal-civilian remediation deadline. The catalysts landing in a single news cycle are concrete and mutually reinforcing: the AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 checkpoint-deserialization remote-code-execution path plus the Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 plugin-manifest authenticated server-side request forgery to internal cloud-metadata endpoints extend the May 8 CrewAI plus Haystack and the earlier LangGraph plus LiteLLM CVE cluster across the full Microsoft open-source agent stack inside one weekend, with Trail of Bits cataloging the shared agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; CISA's Sunday-edition KEV catalog note expressly reminds federal-civilian-executive-branch agencies of the May 21 n8n remediation deadline while the agentic-AI CVE wave compounds on top; the Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center director plus the NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director joining the May 15 S-407 classified Frontier Model Review Board threshold briefing carries the operational view of Mythos-class capability exposure on enterprise tenants directly into the executive-order interagency-review conversation; the Sunday three-hyperscaler registry interop matrix (AWS Bedrock public-preview FedRAMP-Moderate pull-forward, Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center adding Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry interop, and the Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog mirroring the South Korea PIPC plus New Zealand GCSB cyber-eval reciprocity attestation fields in the tenant-policy schema alongside the May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI integration) demonstrates that the cross-vendor compliance plumbing already exists across all six Indo-Pacific reciprocity-cohort jurisdictions; the May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof for per-tenant capability attestation plus the May 10 arxiv 2605.06012 multi-tenant compositional safety theorem give the directive drafters a citable formal-verification anchor; and the NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist (Ni8mare plus LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 plus LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 plus CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 plus Haystack CVE-2026-44391, now with AutoGen and Semantic Kernel as obvious additions) already demonstrates the publishable per-CVE blocklist shape that an allied public-sector procurement regime can pair with the attestation-log evidence requirement. The structural force is that the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline arrives before the May 22 earliest FMRB executive-order signing window, leaving CISA as the operative federal-civilian-executive-branch enforcement vehicle while the policy regime is still in interagency review; the agency cannot let the AutoGen plus Semantic Kernel disclosure pattern sit as a coincidence after publishing four prior agentic-platform KEV additions in three weeks. The most likely shape is a Binding Operational Directive scoping agentic-AI workflow platforms (named explicitly to include n8n, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) with a paired requirement: per-CVE remediation status plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation log evidence (the Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive plus the formal-verification framework from the arxiv 2605.05933 plus 2605.06012 papers as the cited compliance evidence) on a federal-civilian estate, with the review cadence aligned to the n8n CVE-2026-21858 May 21 deadline. Sovereign-cloud and FedRAMP-Moderate tenants comply first because the AWS Bedrock plus Google Cloud Vertex public-preview interop matrix already exposes the attestation-log field. Bear case is that the FMRB executive order ships first with the agentic-AI workflow scope pre-empted; absent that, Q3 2026 lands the directive across the federal-civilian-executive-branch perimeter.

description.es: Para Q3 2026 la ola de CVEs de plataforma de workflow agentic-AI convergiendo a través de la ventana del 8 al 11 de mayo fuerza a CISA a publicar una Binding Operational Directive que trate el estatus de remediación por-CVE y los logs de atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant como requisitos emparejados de adquisición y operación de federal-civil-executive-branch, con la cadencia operativa de revisión fijada a la fecha límite de remediación federal-civil del n8n CVE-2026-21858 del 21 de mayo. Los catalizadores que aterrizan en un solo ciclo de noticias son concretos y mutuamente reforzantes: la ruta de ejecución-de-código-remoto de deserialización de checkpoint de AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 más la falsificación de petición server-side autenticada de plugin-manifest a endpoints internos de cloud-metadata de Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 extienden el cluster de CVEs del 8 de mayo de CrewAI más Haystack y el anterior de LangGraph más LiteLLM a través de todo el stack de agentes open-source de Microsoft dentro de un fin de semana, con Trail of Bits catalogando el patrón de exposición compartido de cargador de agent-checkpoint-y-manifest; la nota del catálogo KEV de la edición del domingo de CISA recuerda expresamente a las agencias del federal-civilian-executive-branch la fecha límite de remediación del n8n del 21 de mayo mientras la ola de CVEs agentic-AI se acumula encima; el director del Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center más el director de la NSA Cybersecurity Directorate sumándose al briefing clasificado de umbral S-407 del 15 de mayo del Frontier Model Review Board lleva la vista operativa de la exposición de capacidad clase Mythos en tenants empresariales directamente a la conversación de revisión interagencial de la orden ejecutiva; la matriz de interop de registro de tres hyperscalers del domingo (pull-forward FedRAMP-Moderate de preview público de AWS Bedrock, Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center agregando interop con el registro de habilidades sandboxed de Anthropic Claude Code 3.0, y el Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog reflejando los campos de atestación-de-reciprocidad de eval cyber South Korea PIPC más New Zealand GCSB en el esquema de política-de-tenant junto con la integración Singapore IMDA más Japan AISI del 8 de mayo) demuestra que la plomería de cumplimiento cross-vendor ya existe a través de las seis jurisdicciones de la cohorte de reciprocidad Indo-Pacífica; la prueba de libertad-de-fuga del arxiv 2605.05933 del 9 de mayo para atestación-de-capacidad por tenant más el teorema de seguridad composicional multi-tenant del arxiv 2605.06012 del 10 de mayo le dan a los redactores de la directiva un ancla citable de verificación-formal; y la lista de bloqueo de CVE de plataforma de workflow agentic-AI de NHS England (Ni8mare más LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 más LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 más CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 más Haystack CVE-2026-44391, ahora con AutoGen y Semantic Kernel como adiciones obvias) ya demuestra la forma publicable de lista-de-bloqueo por-CVE que un régimen de adquisición público-sector aliado puede emparejar con el requisito de evidencia de log-de-atestación. La fuerza estructural es que la fecha límite de remediación federal-civil del 21 de mayo llega antes de la ventana más temprana de firma de la EO del FMRB del 22 de mayo, dejando a CISA como el vehículo operativo de aplicación federal-civil-executive-branch mientras el régimen de política está aún en revisión interagencial; la agencia no puede dejar que el patrón de divulgación AutoGen más Semantic Kernel se asiente como una coincidencia después de publicar cuatro adiciones previas de KEV de plataforma-agentic en tres semanas. La forma más probable es una Binding Operational Directive abarcando plataformas de workflow agentic-AI (nombradas explícitamente para incluir n8n, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) con un requisito emparejado: estatus de remediación por-CVE más evidencia de log de atestación de capacidad clase Mythos por tenant (la primitiva Anthropic Project Glasswing más el marco de verificación-formal de los papers arxiv 2605.05933 más 2605.06012 como la evidencia de cumplimiento citada) en una propiedad federal-civil, con la cadencia de revisión alineada con la fecha límite del 21 de mayo del n8n CVE-2026-21858. Los tenants sovereign-cloud y FedRAMP-Moderate cumplen primero porque la matriz de interop de preview público de AWS Bedrock más Google Cloud Vertex ya expone el campo de log-de-atestación. El caso bajista es que la orden ejecutiva del FMRB se envíe primero con el alcance de workflow agentic-AI preempted; en ausencia de eso, Q3 2026 aterriza la directiva a través del perímetro federal-civil-executive-branch.
description.fil: Sa Q3 2026 ang agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE wave na nagko-converge sa buong May 8 hanggang May 11 window ay pumipilit sa CISA na maglathala ng Binding Operational Directive na tumatrato sa per-CVE remediation status at per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs bilang paired federal-civilian-executive-branch procurement at operating requirements, kasama ng operative review cadence na nakatali sa May 21 n8n CVE-2026-21858 federal-civilian remediation deadline. Ang mga catalysts na lumapag sa isang news cycle ay konkreto at mutually reinforcing: ang AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 checkpoint-deserialization remote-code-execution path plus ang Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 plugin-manifest authenticated server-side request forgery sa internal cloud-metadata endpoints ay nagpapalawak sa May 8 CrewAI plus Haystack at sa naunang LangGraph plus LiteLLM CVE cluster sa buong Microsoft open-source agent stack sa loob ng isang weekend, kasama ng Trail of Bits na nagka-catalog sa shared agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; ang Sunday-edition KEV catalog note ng CISA ay hayagang nagpapaalala sa federal-civilian-executive-branch agencies tungkol sa May 21 n8n remediation deadline habang nag-co-compound ang agentic-AI CVE wave; ang pagdalo ng Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center director plus ng NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director sa May 15 S-407 classified Frontier Model Review Board threshold briefing ay nagdadala ng operational view ng Mythos-class capability exposure sa enterprise tenants direkta papasok sa executive-order interagency-review conversation; ang Sunday three-hyperscaler registry interop matrix (AWS Bedrock public-preview FedRAMP-Moderate pull-forward, Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center na nagdaragdag ng Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry interop, at Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog na sumasalamin sa South Korea PIPC plus New Zealand GCSB cyber-eval reciprocity attestation fields sa tenant-policy schema kasama ng May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI integration) ay nagpapakita na ang cross-vendor compliance plumbing ay umiiral na sa lahat ng anim na Indo-Pacific reciprocity-cohort jurisdictions; ang May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof para sa per-tenant capability attestation plus ang May 10 arxiv 2605.06012 multi-tenant compositional safety theorem ay nagbibigay sa directive drafters ng citable formal-verification anchor; at ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist (Ni8mare plus LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 plus LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 plus CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 plus Haystack CVE-2026-44391, kasama na ngayon ang AutoGen at Semantic Kernel bilang obvious additions) ay nagpapakita na ng publishable per-CVE blocklist shape na maaaring ipares ng allied public-sector procurement regime sa attestation-log evidence requirement. Ang structural force ay na ang May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline ay dumarating bago ang May 22 earliest FMRB executive-order signing window, na nag-iiwan sa CISA bilang operative federal-civilian-executive-branch enforcement vehicle habang ang policy regime ay nasa interagency review pa rin; ang agency ay hindi pwedeng hayaang manatili lamang ang AutoGen plus Semantic Kernel disclosure pattern bilang coincidence matapos maglathala ng apat na naunang agentic-platform KEV additions sa tatlong linggo. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang Binding Operational Directive na sumasaklaw sa agentic-AI workflow platforms (hayagang pinangalanan upang isama ang n8n, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) kasama ng paired requirement: per-CVE remediation status plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation log evidence (ang Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive plus ang formal-verification framework mula sa arxiv 2605.05933 plus 2605.06012 papers bilang cited compliance evidence) sa federal-civilian estate, kasama ng review cadence na naka-align sa n8n CVE-2026-21858 May 21 deadline. Ang sovereign-cloud at FedRAMP-Moderate tenants ang unang sumusunod dahil ang AWS Bedrock plus Google Cloud Vertex public-preview interop matrix ay naglalantad na ng attestation-log field. Ang bear case ay na ang FMRB executive order ay nag-ship muna kasama ang agentic-AI workflow scope na pre-empted; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 2026 sa directive sa buong federal-civilian-executive-branch perimeter.

summary.fil: Sa Q3 2026 ang agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE wave na nagko-converge sa buong May 8 hanggang May 11 window ay pumipilit sa CISA na maglathala ng Binding Operational Directive na tumatrato sa per-CVE remediation status at per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation logs bilang paired federal-civilian-executive-branch procurement at operating requirements, kasama ng operative review cadence na nakatali sa May 21 n8n CVE-2026-21858 federal-civilian remediation deadline. Ang mga catalysts na lumapag sa isang news cycle ay konkreto at mutually reinforcing: ang AutoGen CVE-2026-44612 checkpoint-deserialization remote-code-execution path plus ang Semantic Kernel CVE-2026-44638 plugin-manifest authenticated server-side request forgery sa internal cloud-metadata endpoints ay nagpapalawak sa May 8 CrewAI plus Haystack at sa naunang LangGraph plus LiteLLM CVE cluster sa buong Microsoft open-source agent stack sa loob ng isang weekend, kasama ng Trail of Bits na nagka-catalog sa shared agent-checkpoint-and-manifest-loader exposure pattern; ang Sunday-edition KEV catalog note ng CISA ay hayagang nagpapaalala sa federal-civilian-executive-branch agencies tungkol sa May 21 n8n remediation deadline habang nag-co-compound ang agentic-AI CVE wave; ang pagdalo ng Microsoft Threat Intelligence Center director plus ng NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director sa May 15 S-407 classified Frontier Model Review Board threshold briefing ay nagdadala ng operational view ng Mythos-class capability exposure sa enterprise tenants direkta papasok sa executive-order interagency-review conversation; ang Sunday three-hyperscaler registry interop matrix (AWS Bedrock public-preview FedRAMP-Moderate pull-forward, Google Cloud Vertex AI Agent Governance Center na nagdaragdag ng Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 sandboxed-skill registry interop, at Microsoft Azure AI Foundry Skill Catalog na sumasalamin sa South Korea PIPC plus New Zealand GCSB cyber-eval reciprocity attestation fields sa tenant-policy schema kasama ng May 8 Singapore IMDA plus Japan AISI integration) ay nagpapakita na ang cross-vendor compliance plumbing ay umiiral na sa lahat ng anim na Indo-Pacific reciprocity-cohort jurisdictions; ang May 9 arxiv 2605.05933 leakage-freedom proof para sa per-tenant capability attestation plus ang May 10 arxiv 2605.06012 multi-tenant compositional safety theorem ay nagbibigay sa directive drafters ng citable formal-verification anchor; at ang NHS England agentic-AI workflow-platform CVE blocklist (Ni8mare plus LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 plus LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 plus CrewAI CVE-2026-44352 plus Haystack CVE-2026-44391, kasama na ngayon ang AutoGen at Semantic Kernel bilang obvious additions) ay nagpapakita na ng publishable per-CVE blocklist shape na maaaring ipares ng allied public-sector procurement regime sa attestation-log evidence requirement. Ang structural force ay na ang May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline ay dumarating bago ang May 22 earliest FMRB executive-order signing window, na nag-iiwan sa CISA bilang operative federal-civilian-executive-branch enforcement vehicle habang ang policy regime ay nasa interagency review pa rin; ang agency ay hindi pwedeng hayaang manatili lamang ang AutoGen plus Semantic Kernel disclosure pattern bilang coincidence matapos maglathala ng apat na naunang agentic-platform KEV additions sa tatlong linggo. Ang pinakamalamang na shape ay isang Binding Operational Directive na sumasaklaw sa agentic-AI workflow platforms (hayagang pinangalanan upang isama ang n8n, LangGraph, LiteLLM, CrewAI, Haystack, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) kasama ng paired requirement: per-CVE remediation status plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation log evidence (ang Anthropic Project Glasswing primitive plus ang formal-verification framework mula sa arxiv 2605.05933 plus 2605.06012 papers bilang cited compliance evidence) sa federal-civilian estate, kasama ng review cadence na naka-align sa n8n CVE-2026-21858 May 21 deadline. Ang sovereign-cloud at FedRAMP-Moderate tenants ang unang sumusunod dahil ang AWS Bedrock plus Google Cloud Vertex public-preview interop matrix ay naglalantad na ng attestation-log field. Ang bear case ay na ang FMRB executive order ay nag-ship muna kasama ang agentic-AI workflow scope na pre-empted; kapag wala iyon, lalapag ang Q3 2026 sa directive sa buong federal-civilian-executive-branch perimeter.

bridges.text: On the CISA agentic-AI CVE plus capability-attestation pairing prediction (May 11): the May 15 S-407 classified threshold briefing witness slate firms to five with the CISA Director joining NIST Director Locascio, ODNI cyber lead, NSA Cybersecurity Directorate director, and Microsoft MSTIC; LangChain CVE-2026-44712 completes the seven-CVE agent-loader wave; Shadowserver day-eleven exposed-instance count falls to approximately 4,920 with residual unpatched share at 33 percent; Censys honeypot exploitation attempts spike to 6.4x baseline; and OSTP holds the no-signing-before-May-22 floor while the May 21 federal-civilian remediation deadline holds, leaving CISA as the operative enforcement vehicle.

motivation_locales.ja: CISAは、3週間で4件の先行エージェンティック・プラットフォームKEV追加を公表した後、AutoGenとSemantic Kernel開示パターンを偶然のままにしておくことができない;5月21日のn8n連邦民政修復期限が5月22日の最早FMRB大統領令署名ウィンドウより前に到来し、政策体制が省庁間レビュー中である間、CISAを運用上の連邦民政・行政部門執行ビークルとして残す。

needs.actor: Federal civilian agency CISOs plus chief AI officers plus FedRAMP-Moderate authorization owners plus enterprise audit committees converting the CISA BOD into procurement-grade RFP language and supplier-attestation requirements
needs.job: convert the CISA Binding Operational Directive paired CVE-remediation plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation log evidence requirement into federal-civilian agency RFP-template language, FedRAMP-Moderate authorization checklist items, and enterprise audit-committee supplier-attestation requirements so that procurement officers and audit committees can gate agentic-AI workflow-platform vendor selection on the BOD-named seven platforms with the attestation-log evidence shape — defensible against State Farm reasoned-decision challenge and aligned with the FMRB reciprocity-ladder placement window.
needs.outcome: Federal-civilian agency RFP templates plus FedRAMP-Moderate authorization checklists plus enterprise audit-committee supplier-attestation requirements citing the CISA BOD seven-platform scope plus per-tenant Mythos-class capability attestation-log evidence shape as the operative gating surface for agentic-AI workflow-platform vendor selection, with the review cadence pegged to the May 21 n8n remediation cadence.
needs.motivation: Federal-civilian CISOs plus chief AI officers plus FedRAMP authorization owners plus audit committees need a single named compliance surface to gate agentic-AI workflow-platform vendors against; without the BOD-to-RFP conversion the procurement-grade demand-side surface remains fragmented across bespoke vendor-by-vendor attestation language, exposing procurement officers to litigation over arbitrary-and-capricious vendor selection and weakening the BOD's operational teeth.
